rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: In each case there are three things to be attended to: place 1 - the beginning 'mubdá'; place 2 - the end 'muntahá'; and place 3 - the casting point 'malqá'... These three points are called respectively 'manqud' [amount subtracted], 'manqud minhu' [that from which it is subtracted] and 'muzad ralaihi' [amount added].
rules.translation: 点（Lot）计算三要素：起点 mubdá（被减者）、终点 muntahá（减数）、投射点 malqá（通常为上升）；又称 manqud / manqud minhu / muzad ralaihi。例：福点昼公式 Asc+(Moon−Sun)——日=起点、月=终点、上升=投射点。
rules.notes: Al-Biruni《Elements of the Art of Astrology》v.476，R. Ramsay Wright 1934 译；Houlding 现代格式整理

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: R 点夜盘：Asc + 起点反转 - 终点反转
rules.original_text: S = the calculation remains the same by day and night. R = the calculation is reversed by night. The reversed formula of the first 7 parts are shown, the others follow the same procedure of reversing the order of the planets.
rules.translation: 昼夜标记：S=昼夜同式；R=夜盘反转（起点与终点互换后自上升投射）；前 7 点（行星点）给出反转式，其余照此反转顺序。
rules.notes: S/R 标记贯穿全部公式表

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: 父母点改用 Asc+Jupiter−Sun（昼）/反转（夜）
rules.original_text: With regard to the lot of parents when Saturn is under the rays of the Sun, they take from Jupiter to the Sun by night or vice versa by day, and cast from the ascendant.
rules.translation: 差异实践·父母点：土星在日射线内（距日15°内，v.481）时——昼取 Jupiter→Sun、夜反之，自上升投射（即以木星代土星）。
rules.notes: v.477；常规公式 Asc+Saturn−Sun

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: 改用狮首或日→土星（昼夜反向）
rules.original_text: In the case of the lot for grandparents, if the Sun is in Leo, they take from the beginning of Leo to Saturn by day, and by night in the opposite direction. And if it is in the domicile of Saturn then from the Sun to Saturn by day, and vice versa by night; in both cases cast from the ascendant.
rules.translation: 差异实践·祖父母点：日在狮子——昼自狮首至土星、夜反向；日在土星庙位——昼自日至土星、夜反向；皆自上升投射。

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: Should two lots indicate the same point, it is regarded as very fortunate.
rules.translation: 两点同指一处——视为非常吉。
rules.notes: v.477 综合判据

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: 按问事性质择义（不做重复计算）
rules.original_text: Many of the parts listed by Al Biruni share the same formula because the part takes definition from the nature of the query... In other instances the same calculation is listed under alternate but similar titles - as seen in the section on the 'fortunes of the 7th house' where the calculation Asc + Mars - Moon is known as the part of 'misconduct by women', 'trickery and deceit of men by women', 'intercourse (of women)' and 'unchastity of women'.
rules.translation: 同一公式多名称：点之定义取自问事之性质（同式计算见于多名目）。例：7宫诸点中 Asc+Mars−Moon 同时名 misconduct by women / trickery of men by women / intercourse / unchastity of women。
rules.notes: Houlding 注1：点多以问事定性，非各自独立公式

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.condition: 孩子点（Asc+Saturn−Jupiter 夜反转）之判断
rules.result: 子女数/生死/吉凶系列判据
rules.original_text: Dorotheus on the lot of children: wherever it happens to be, look at its lord. Then count from the lot to its lord how many signs there are... whatever there is of signs between these two, that is the number of children. If you find a malefic between these two, it indicates the death of the children. If you find that there is no planet in the lot or aspecting it, then the first child will not be benefited by it because he will be miscarried or will die horribly. If you find the lot in a cardine or a good place, then it is a good indication in the matter of children. If it happens to be in the 6th or 12th place, then neither a male nor a female will be born to him... If the lot happens to be where none of the planets is in quartile or opposition to it, then these natives have a need for children. But if there are planets in opposition or quartile to the lot, then it indicates he will have a multitude of children. If the lot happens to be in a sign of few children, then it indicates a small number of children. If Saturn is with it, then it indicates he will be sterile or will have few children.
rules.translation: Dorotheus《Carmen Astrologicum》II.10 孩子点断法：观其主星，自点至主星数星座=子女数；其间有凶星=子女死；点中/照点无星=首子流产或惨死；点在角/吉位=吉；点在6/12宫=无子女（有则离散）；无星四分/冲点=求子；有星四分/冲=多子；点在少子星座=少子；土星同点=不育或少子。
rules.notes: 注6 引 Dorotheus CA II.10（跨书引用，Houlding 辑）

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: If the Sun or Moon is in quartile or opposition with the lot [of children], then the Sun will increase the male children, the Moon the female.
rules.translation: Dorotheus 孩子点：日/月四分或冲点——日增男、月增女。
rules.notes: CA II.10

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: Dorotheus uses this as the lot of the time of having children: 'When Jupiter transits that lot or its opposition or aspects it from quartile, then will be born children to this native. When Venus happens to transit this lot, it indicates children.'
rules.translation: Dorotheus 生子时点（Asc+Jupiter−Mars）：木星过点/其冲/自四分照——当有子女；金星过点——亦示子女。
rules.notes: CA II.11；注7

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: 凶照=辱婚；点主坏位+金灼+凶照=不婚
rules.original_text: Dorotheus refers to this [lot of marriage] as the lot of happiness and wedding: 'See which planet is its lord and which is with it and which aspects it, as, if a malefic is in this lot or aspects it, say that the native will marry disgraced and one in whom there is no good. If the lord of this lot is in a bad place while Venus is under the rays of the Sun and the malefics aspect then most of those whose nativity is thus will never marry.'
rules.translation: Dorotheus 婚点（幸福婚点）：凶星在点/照点——娶辱妻（无善之人）；点主在坏位+金在日射线内+凶星照——多数终身不婚。
rules.notes: CA II.5；注13 引

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.result: 点落星座→对应身体部位
rules.original_text: Dorotheus gives detail on the use of this part [of disease]: 'There were men among the ancient scientists who calculated by day from Saturn to Mars and by night from Mars to Saturn, then they cast their number from the ascendant; wherever their counting reached... they saw what was the lord of that sign, then they said to what limb of the body this sign belonged, then they predicted that the chronic illness would be in such and such a limb of the body according to what was named for that sign. Aries is the head, Taurus the neck.'
rules.translation: Dorotheus 疾病点用法（古代算法）：昼自土至火、夜自火至土，自上升投射；计数落点之星座主断身体部位——牡羊=头、金牛=颈……（慢性病按星座对应肢体）。
rules.notes: CA IV.1.75；注9 引；人形占星（melothesia）

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: Albiruni states that the formula [for the lot of brothers] remains the same by day and night. Other authors, such as Dorotheus (Carmen Astrologicum, I.19), instruct us to reverse the formula for night.
rules.translation: 兄弟点昼夜分歧：Albiruni 昼夜同式（S）；Dorotheus（CA I.19）夜盘反转。
rules.notes: 注2：跨书分歧如实记录，引擎需按学派开关

rules.original_text: This entry [lot of grandparents] is not very clear. Robert H. Granite in The Fortunes of Astrology uses Ascendant + Saturn - cusp of 2nd house. Ramsay Wright's translation indicates a roman numeral II which could represent the cusp of the 2nd house, but... The symbol should probably be taken as the glyph for Gemini.
rules.translation: 祖父母点公式歧义：原文符号 II 不明——Granite 解作 2 宫尖（Asc+Saturn−2宫尖）；Wright 疑为双子座符号。
rules.notes: 注4：如实标注歧义

rules.book: Al-Biruni《The Book of Instruction in the Elements of the Art of Astrology》——阿拉伯点（Parts/Lots）公式全表
rules.original_text: It is impossible to enumerate the lots which have been invented for the solution of horary questions... they increase in number every day, but the following 97 different lots, 7 of which belong to the planets, 80 to the houses and 10 to neither are those most commonly in use.
rules.translation: 点之总数说明：卜卦点与日俱增不可尽数；下列 97 点为最常用——7 属行星、80 属宫位、10 属二者皆非。
rules.notes: v.476；另有年/季/庄稼/卜卦点（v.479）另行列出

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 提问须心意+星体+自由意志三者俱备
rules.original_text: The First, is to observe what it is that moves a person to propose or ask a question of an Astrologer; where we must take notice of three motions: the First, of the mind, when a man is stirred up in his thoughts and hath an intent to enquire; a Second, of the superior and celestial bodies; so that they at that time imprint on the thing enquired after, what shall become of it; the Third, of the free will which disposes him to the very act of enquiring; for although the mind be moved to enquire, 'tis not enough, unless the superior bodies sympathize therewith; nor is such motion of the stars enough, unless by the election of his will the person does actually enquire.
rules.translation: 第一考量：观察是什么推动人向占星家提问。须注意三种动因：一为心意，人思绪被激起而有意询问；二为天上星体，彼时在所问之事上印下其未来结局；三为自由意志，使人实际采取询问之行动。心虽动而星体不相应，不足；星动而人不经意志之择而实问，亦不足。
rules.notes: radical 问题三要件之一

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 问者须郑重、诚敬、所问正当重要
rules.original_text: The Second consideration is (what we hinted at before) the method or manner everyone ought to observe that enquires of an Astrologer; which is, that when he intends to take an artist's judgment of things past, present, or to come, he should, first, with a devout spirit, pray unto the Lord, from whom proceeds the success of every lawful enterprise, that he would grant him the knowledge of those things of the truth of which he would be resolved; and then let him apply himself to the astrologer with a serious intent of being satisfied in some certain and particular doubt, and this not on trifling occasions, or light sudden emotions, much less in matters base or unlawful, as many ignorant people used to do; but in matters of honest importance, and such as have possessed and disturbed his mind for the space of a day and night or longer; unless in sudden accidents which admit not of delay.
rules.translation: 第二考量：问者当守之法。欲问过去现在未来之事，先以虔诚之心向主祷告（一切合法事业之成败由主所赐），然后以郑重之心向占星家求答特定疑难；不因琐事、轻率冲动而问，更不问卑劣非法之事；当问诚实重要、已萦绕其心一日一夜或更久之事，除非急变不容迟延。
rules.notes: Lilly 注：轻浮问者使智者答错，错在问者非占星家

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 事物的成毁由这16种方式决定
rules.original_text: The Third, is to consider how many ways Planets operate upon Inferior Bodies according to the divers Qualities of their motions: there being Sixteen different ways of such their operations and effects in all things that are either wholly or in part perfected or destroyed.
rules.translation: 第三考量：行星依其运动之不同性质，作用于下界事物有十六种方式；一切事物之成毁，全部或部分由此十六种运作方式决定。
rules.notes: 16 种运作方式之总纲，详见第4条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 十六种行星运作方式（阿拉伯术语列表）
rules.original_text: The Fourth, is to consider particularly these several Sixteen ways, and what are the assisting causes that help forward things to perfection, and what there are that destroy things after they are perfected. Now of these the first is Profection, or an advance of or in, things, which the philosophers call 'Alchecohol.' 2. Detriment, which they call 'Aliber.' 3. Conjunction or Reversion, which they call 'Alitifall.' 4. Separation, which they call 'Alnichirat.' 5. Translation of light, which they call 'Annecad.' 6. Collection, which they call 'Algemei.' 7. Prohibition, which they call 'Almana.' 8. Reception, called 'Alcobol.' 9. Being void of course, called 'Gastalcobal.' 10. Permission, called 'Galaalocir.' 11. The restoring or giving of virtue or disposition, called 'Alteat.' 12. The withdrawing of virtue, called 'Dalpha Alchoa.' 13. The withdrawer or driver away of disposition, called 'Daffaredbit.' 14. Fortitude, 'Alcoevah.' 15. Debility, 'Adirof.' The 16th is the state of the Moon called 'Gnaymel,' or the Moon ill-affected; which the ancients generally hold to be of ill signification.
rules.translation: 第四考量：详列此十六种方式及其助成与破坏之因：1.进动/进展（Profection，哲人谓 Alchecohol）；2.失势（Detriment，Aliber）；3.合相或反转（Conjunction/Reversion，Alitifall）；4.分离（Separation，Alnichirat）；5.传递之光（Translation of light，Annecad）；6.集光（Collection，Algemei）；7.禁止（Prohibition，Almana）；8.接纳（Reception，Alcobol）；9.出界（void of course，Gastalcobal）；10.许可（Permission，Galaalocir）；11.恢复或授予德性（Alteat）；12.撤回德性（Dalpha Alchoa）；13.驱走德性（Daffaredbit）；14.强健（Fortitude，Alcoevah）；15.虚弱（Debility，Adirof）；16.月亮之恶态（Gnaymel），古人恒视为凶。
rules.notes: 术语为阿拉伯文音译，是古典占星术语表核心

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮处于17种受害状态之一
rules.original_text: The Fifth, is to consider, how many ways the Moon comes to be so ill-affected, which are generally reckoned to be Ten, but in my opinion Seven more may be added, whereby hindrances and damage happen in all Questions, Nativities, Elections, and actions whatsoever; the First is, where the Moon is combust, that is to say under the Sun's Beams, which is counted from 15 degrees of the body of the Sun as she applies to him to 12 degrees distance from him as she is separating from him; and the impediment is greater when she is going to the Sun than when she is going from him; because as she goes off, when she is got five degrees distant, she is said to be escaped, though not wholly freed. The 2nd is when she is in the degrees of her descensions, that is in the 3rd degree of Scorpio, or in any part of Scorpio or Capricorn or injoined with any planet that is in her or its own descensions. The 3rd is when she is posited in any of the combust degrees, of which the worst are: those 12 degrees which are before the degree which is directly opposite to the degree in which the Sun is. The 4th is when she is in conjunction, opposition, or square to either of the Infortunes, Saturn or Mars, without a perfect reception. The 5th is when she is with the Dragon's Head or with the Dragon's Tail, that is, within twelve degrees of either of them. The 6th is when she is in Gemini, which is the twelfth from her own House. The 7th is when she is in the end of Signs, which are all Terms of the Infortunes, except the last 6 degrees of Leo, which belong to Jupiter; but in the first eight she is weakened because they are the Terms of Saturn. The 8th is when she is in the 6th, 8th, 9th or 12th Houses (not in reception with the Ascendant), or joined to any Planet that is in any of them or posited in the Third House; yet because the Third is said to be her joy, she is not afflicted there so much as in other Cadent Houses. The 9th is when she is between the 15th degree of Libra and the 15th degree of Scorpio, which 30 degrees are called Combust Way. The 10th when she is void of course, that is, not joined to any planet by body or aspect, or in that condition when they call her Feral or Desart, that is, in a place where she has not any dignity. The 11th when she is slow of course, because then she may be compared to a Planet Retrograde. The 12th when she is in want of light, so that no part or very little of her is seen, which happens about the end of the lunar month. The 13th when she is besieged by the two Infortunes impediting her. The 14th if she be in Azimene degrees. The 15th if in Pitted degrees. The 16th if in Smoky Degrees. The 17th and last is when she is posited in those degrees which are called Dark.
rules.translation: 第五考量：月亮受害之方式。通常计十种，我意可再加七种，共十七：1.灼伤（combust，在日辉下：向日合相15°内至离日12°内；向日的阻碍大于离日；离日5°即谓脱逃虽未全脱）；2.在落陷度数（天蝎3°、或天蝎/摩羯任何部分，或与自身落陷之星相合）；3.在灼伤度数（最坏者为对日之点前12°）；4.与土星或火星成合相/冲/四分而无完全接纳；5.与龙头或龙尾合相（12°内）；6.在双子座（自其庙之第十二位）；7.在星座之末（皆凶星之界，狮子座末6°属木星除外；首8°为土星之界故弱）；8.在6/8/9/12宫（与上升无接纳）或与其中行星相合，或在3宫（3宫为其喜乐位，受害较轻）；9.在天秤15°至天蝎15°之间，此30°称灼伤之道；10.出界（无任何合相/相位，或 Feral/Desart 无尊贵之位）；11.运行迟慢，可比逆行；12.缺光（月末不见）；13.被二凶星围困；14.在 Azimene 度数；15.在 Pitted 度数；16.在 Smoky 度数；17.在称为 Dark 的度数。
rules.notes: 17 种月亮阻碍完整列表，灼伤阈值：向日15°内/离日12°内；5°脱逃

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 行星处于10种受损状态之一
rules.original_text: The Sixth Consideration, is to regard another manner whereby planets are debilitated or weakened and afflicted, not much different from the former, which comes to pass Ten ways. The 1st, when a planet is Cadent from Angles or from the Ascendant, so that he does not behold the same. The 2nd, when the Planet is Retrograde. The 3rd, if they be combust, that is, within 15 degrees before or after the Sun; the lower Planets are more debilitated, being behind the Sun, and the less before him, when they are direct; but when retrograde the contrary. 4. When any of them is in Opposition, Corporal Conjunction, or Square of either or both the Infortunes without Reception. 5. When they are besieged by the Infortunes, so as to separate from one and be joined to another, without perfect reception of House, Exaltation, or two of the smaller Dignities, which are Term, Triplicity and Face. 6. When a Planet is joined to another in his Declension or Fall, that is, in Opposition to its own House or Exaltation. 7. When it is joined to a Planet Cadent from the Ascendant, or separates from a Planet that did receive him, and is joined to another that doth not. 8. When a Planet is Peregrine, that is, in a place where he hath not any Dignity; or being one of the Superiors is followed by the Sun, or being of the Inferiors when it follows the Sun. 9. When a Planet is with the Head or Tail of the Dragon, without Latitude. 10. When a planet weakens itself, that it, when it is in the seventh house from its own, Feral, or not in Reception.
rules.translation: 第六考量：行星受损虚弱之十种方式：1.自角宫或上升落陷（不照上升）；2.逆行；3.灼伤（日前后15°内；内行星在日之后更弱，顺行时在日之前较弱，逆行反之）；4.与一或二凶星成冲/合相/四分而无接纳；5.被凶星围困（离一而合另一），无庙/旺或界/三分/面两种小尊贵之完全接纳；6.与在其落陷（冲其庙或旺）之星相合；7.与自上升落陷之星相合，或与曾接纳它之星分离而合于不接纳之星；8.游走（Peregrine，无尊贵）；或外行星被太阳追，或内行星追太阳；9.与龙头龙尾相合而无纬度；10.行星自弱：在其自庙之第七宫、Feral、或不在接纳中。
rules.notes: 行星10种阻碍完整列表，与第5条月亮17种并列

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 问者不诚/时间错/太阳位置不明/吉凶星均势/问题不Radical
rules.original_text: The Seventh Consideration, is to beware of those cases wherein the Astrologer is subject to err and mistake; of which the learned have named four: 1. When the Querent is so silly that he knows not how to ask, nor what he would have. 2. When the time for which the figure is erected is mistaken. 3. When the Artist knows not whether the Sun be gone off the line of the Mid-Heaven, or still upon it: or be behind or before it. 4. When the Fortunes and Infortunes shall be of equal strength; at which time thou therefore oughtest not to receive any question. But, in my opinion, there may well be added yet three ways more: 1. When the Querent comes only to try him, or put a trick upon him. 2. When the Querent does not ask out of a serious or settled intention, but by-the-bye. 3. When the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the Hour are not the same, nor of the same Triplicity, or be not of the same Complexion with the Ascendant; for then the Question is not Radical.
rules.translation: 第七考量：占星家易犯错之情形。古人列四种：1.问者愚昧不知如何问、问什么；2.起盘时间弄错；3.占星家不知太阳是否已离天顶线（在线上、之前或之后）；4.吉凶星力量相等之时，此时不应接盘。我意再加三种：1.问者来试探设局；2.问者非出于郑重坚定之意，顺口而问；3.上升主星与时辰主星不相同、不同三分、或与上升性质不同——此时问题不成立（not Radical）。
rules.notes: radical 判定核心；验盘方法：上升若近星座末尾则非诚问（Bonatti 经验）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 行星在其喜乐位（4种喜乐）
rules.original_text: The Eighth Consideration is, To mind how many of the aforesaid manners or points necessary to be used and heeded in giving Judgments thou hast to consider; and they are Thirty, that is to say, sixteen impediments of the Moon, ten of the other Planets; as hath been said, and besides all those the Planets' several joys, which are four. Of which the first is the House which each Planet does delight in, as Mercury in the Ascendant, the Moon in the Third, Venus in the fifth, Mars in the sixth, the Sun in the ninth, Jupiter in the eleventh, Saturn in the Twelfth. The second is, when a Planet is in a sign he delights in, as Saturn in Aquarius, Jupiter in Sagittary, Mars in Scorpio, Sol in Leo, Venus in Taurus, Mercury in Virgo, and the Moon in Cancer. The third is when Diurnal Planets, as Saturn, Jupiter, Sol, and Mercury, are in Diurnal Houses in the East and Oriental of the Sun near the Horoscope; and the Nocturnal Planets, as Mars, Venus, Luna and Mercury, are in Nocturnal Houses in the West and Occidental of the Sun; especially near the cusp of the seventh. The fourth is when the three Superiors, Saturn, Jupiter or Mars, are in Masculine Quarters; which are counted from the cusp of the Tenth House to the cusp of the Ascendant, and from the cusp of the fourth House to the cusp of the seventh House; and when the Feminines, viz., Venus or the Moon are in Feminine Quarters. As for Mercury, he delights when with Masculine Planets in Masculine Quarters, but with Feminine Planets in Feminine.
rules.translation: 第八考量：判断须留意之要点共三十：月亮十六阻碍、他行星十阻碍，另加行星之四种喜乐（joy）：1.各星所喜之宫：水星喜上升，月亮喜第3宫，金星喜第5宫，火星喜第6宫，太阳喜第9宫，木星喜第11宫，土星喜第12宫；2.各星所喜之星座：土星喜水瓶，木星喜射手，火星喜天蝎，太阳喜狮子，金星喜金牛，水星喜处女，月亮喜巨蟹；3.日行星（土木日水）在东方日行星之宫且东出于太阳近上升；夜行星（火金月水）在西方夜行星之宫且西没于太阳，尤近第7宫尖轴；4.三外行星（土木火）在阳性象限（第10宫尖至上升尖、第4宫尖至第7宫尖），阴性星（金月）在阴性象限；水星与阳性星在阳性象限则喜，与阴性星在阴性象限则喜。
rules.notes: 四大喜乐（宫/星座/昼夜/象限）完整列表，算法第3层可编码

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Ninth Consideration is, To take notice of the several ways, as well secret as manifest, good and evil, whereby things are helped or hindered to be done or not done, and of these there are one and twenty in number. 1. A most strong secret helper. 2. A very strong secret Helper. 3. A strong secret helper. 4. A weak secret Helper. 5. A weaker secret Helper. 6. A most weak secret Helper. 7. A most strong manifest Helper. 8. A very strong manifest Helper. 9. A strong manifest Helper. 10. A weak manifest Helper. 11. A weaker manifest Helper. 12. A most weak manifest Helper. 13. A most strong secret Hinderer. 14. A very strong secret Hinderer. 15. A strong secret Hinderer. 16. A weak secret Hinderer. 17. A weaker secret Hinderer. 18. A most weak secret Hinderer. 19. A most strong manifest Hinderer. 20. A very strong manifest Hinderer; and 21. A strong manifest Hinderer.
rules.translation: 第九考量：事物成毁之助碍方式，分秘密/显明、吉/凶共二十一种：1-6 秘密助成（极强/很强/强/弱/较弱/极弱）；7-12 显明助成（同六级）；13-18 秘密阻碍（极强至极弱六级）；19-21 显明阻碍（极强/很强/强三级）。其要旨：升盘时先取所问之事的主征象星，看与其同性质之恒星是否在其庙/旺/或与之合相至分数——若是，则此星极大助成其事，出乎问者之望（最极强之秘密助成）；恒星距主征象星15分前至5分后仍在同度仍助但不甚；16分至50分内稍助；若主征象星在有二小尊贵之处，16分内助更弱……反之，主征象星在无尊贵之处而与相反性质之恒星相合，则极强秘密阻碍。显明者：主征象星在己庙、角宫尖轴正分、顺行、速行、被接纳、无任何凶碍——极强显明助成（极少见）；在庙或旺、角宫距尖轴1-2°内、无碍、被接纳——很强；在角宫己庙或旺、尖前3°或后5°——强；二小尊贵在角宫尖前5°或后15°内、或庙旺在续宫无碍——弱；庙旺或二小尊贵在果宫而照上升——较弱；大尊贵或二小尊贵不照上升、或一小尊贵仅照上升、或与照上升而有尊贵之星相合——极弱。极强显明阻碍：主征象星无尊贵、无喜乐、不被接纳、被二凶星围困、自角宫与上升落陷；更若与凶性恒星相合。
rules.notes: 秘密=恒星相助；显明=行星尊贵状态；此条为判断核心之一

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 恒星合相/相位主征象星
rules.original_text: The Tenth Consideration, Is warily to observe what Fixed Stars may either help or hinder the matter in question; for they have oftentimes great power, and lead the Astrologer sometimes into error; and let the Artist be sure to consider the places of the Fixed Stars, as they are in the present age carefully reduced.
rules.translation: 第十考量：谨慎观察恒星对所占之事之助碍；恒星常有大力量，有时使占星家犯错。须按当代精确归算的恒星位置（岁差校正）考量。
rules.notes: 注：恒星黄经每年增加50′25″（岁差）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星接纳征象星/月亮则抑制恶；不接纳则恶增；冲四分更甚、六分三分较轻
rules.result: 凶星之害随接纳与相位而异
rules.original_text: The Eleventh Consideration, Is to take notice of the Malevolent Planets, and what they signify; for Saturn and Mars are naturally bad, Saturn for excess of cold, and Mars for excess of heat; not that either of them is really hot or cold, but virtually so; and these are their effects. And so they signify evil and damage and hindrance, unless they receive the Significator or the Moon by House, Exaltation, or two of their smaller dignities; or shall themselves be Significators; for then they will bridle in their malice, and not weaken or hinder him whom they receive, with what aspect soever they behold him; but if they do not receive, their malice is increased; and so much the more if they be in Opposition or Square; for in Sextile or Trine the mischief is less.
rules.translation: 第十一考量：凶星（土星、火星）本凶——土星因过冷、火星因过热（非实热实冷，乃性能上）。其示凶害与阻碍；除非以庙、旺或两种小尊贵接纳主征象星或月亮，或本身为主征象星——则抑制其恶，不以任何相位伤害所接纳者；若不接纳，其恶增；冲/四分更甚；六分/三分则害较轻。
rules.notes: Zael 谓凶星在三六分时暂抑其恶，非全消

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 吉星相位：三六分>四分>冲；接纳则更佳
rules.result: 吉星之吉随相位与接纳而增减
rules.original_text: The Twelfth Consideration, Is to behold the Fortunes, and see what they signify; for Jupiter and Venus are Fortunes by Nature, and being temperate, are said to be without any malice, because they do hurt to none, unless now and then by accident; which is beside their intention and very seldom for they make their impression temperately and profitably, and always endeavour to help both their own and others, whether they receive them or not; but so much the better if they receive them; and their Trine or Sextile is better and more advantageous than their Square, and their square than their Oppositions.
rules.translation: 第十二考量：吉星（木星、金星）本吉而温和，无恶意，除非偶然意外之害（非其本意，极少见）。其印迹温和有益，恒欲助己助人，无论是否接纳；被接纳则更佳。其三分/六分优于四分，四分优于冲。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 太阳被冲则凶；合相使星灼伤；cazimi 则强
rules.result: 太阳之吉凶随相位与距离而异
rules.original_text: The Thirteenth Consideration, is to regard the Sun and his Significators, for he is also called a fortune, and so, whatever aspect he shall be beheld by, unless it be Opposition; but by Conjunction he becomes an Infortune, because then he renders every star that is so in Conjunction with him, combust and unfortunate; unless the same shall be in the heart of the Sun, and there every star is fortified.
rules.translation: 第十三考量：太阳亦称为吉星。任何相位照之皆吉，唯冲相除外；但太阳以合相论则成凶星——因其使与之合相之星灼伤而不幸；除非该星在太阳之心（cazimi，16分内），则反被加强。
rules.notes: cazimi=heart of the Sun，16′内

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 水星/月亮与其他星相合
rules.result: 其征象随所合之星而定
rules.original_text: The Fourteenth Consideration is to mind Mercury and the Moon, and what Planets they are joined with; because they will have the signification with those with whom they are so joined; being of a convertible nature.
rules.translation: 第十四考量：留意水星与月亮所合之行星；因其性可转易，其征象随所合之星而定。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Fifteenth Consideration, is to regard the several ways in general whereby Planets make impressions on these inferior things, which are two, one good and the other bad; for the Fortunes have power of imprinting good naturally, and the Infortunes as naturally shower down ill impressions; whence thou mayest, wherever thou seest the Fortunes, hope for good; and when thou beholdest the Malevolents, fear mischief, unless the same be restrained as aforesaid.
rules.translation: 第十五考量：行星作用于下界之途有二：吉凶。吉星自然印善，凶星自然降恶。见吉星则望吉，见凶星则惧害，除非其被如前所述之条件抑制。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星光照征象星（按容许度）
rules.result: 征象星受碍直至凶星过1′/1°
rules.original_text: The Sixteenth Consideration is to take notice whether the Planet that is Significator of anything, be afflicted by either of the Malevolents; which is when one of them casts his rays upon the rays of such Significators, according to the quantity of their Orbs; And Whilst he so continues with his rays or light under those of the Malevolent, such Significator is said to be impedited, hindered or afflicted, till the Malevolent have passed him; and 'Zael' says, After the ill Planet has passed the Planet he did afflict, one whole degree, the Planet shall be said to be freed of him. But I rather think that after the Malevolent is passed him one minute, he may be said to be free and excepted; for afterwards he can only frighten him. True it is he raises a greater fear when he is passed him only one minute, than when he is gone by a whole degree; but yet even then it is such a kind of fear as is not altogether without some glimmering of hope.
rules.translation: 第十六考量：主征象星是否受凶星之害——凶星按其容许度（Orb）将光线投于征象星之光上。凶星之光覆盖期间，征象星受碍，直至凶星过之。Zael 谓凶星过其害之星整整1°后方为脱离；我意凶星过1分即可言脱——此后只能吓唬它。过1分时的恐惧反大于过1°时，但此恐惧亦带希望之光。
rules.notes: 例：上升双子13°，水星水瓶7°54′与土星水瓶7°53′——水星刚离土星（死之宫主）1分，故战事中濒死而终得脱；Zael：落陷凶星不能真碍事，只致惊恐

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 吉星光照征象星（未过1分）
rules.result: 事将完成；过1分后只成希望
rules.original_text: The Seventeenth Consideration, is to view whether the Planet that is Significator, be safe and prosperous, that is free from any affliction from the Infortunes; and one of the Fortunes casts his beams or light on the beams of such Significator; for then shall that Planet be said to be safe and guarded till the Fortune is passed by the space of one minute, and signifies the perfection of the thing. But after he has passed him one minute, it will not be perfected or accomplished; for it only raises hopes.
rules.translation: 第十七考量：主征象星是否安好顺遂——无凶星之害，且一吉星之光投于其上；则该星受护直至吉星过1分，此时兆事之完成。吉星过1分后事反不完成——它只引起希望（如凶星只引起恐惧）。
rules.notes: 例：天蝎17°升，火星金牛12°13′，金星摩羯12°14′——金星三分火星且互纳，看似全成，但问时金星已过火星1分，事终一场空；Zael：落陷吉星只以辉煌希望奉承，永不完成其事

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 行星在凶星之角（凶星宫位起第4/7/10）且无接纳
rules.result: 处境恶劣；有接纳则无害
rules.original_text: The Eighteenth Consideration, Is to take notice when a planet is in the Angles of the Infortunes, for unless these receive him there, he shall be said to be in an ill condition, and in straits and troubles; as a man on whom some have made an assault; who has many to combat with and none to assist and take his part. Now a planet is said to be in the Angles of a Malevolent, when the Malevolent or Infortune, viz., Saturn or Mars, is in one sign, and the other Planet in the fourth, seventh or tenth from him: as if Mars be in Aries, and Mercury in Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn, he is said to be in his Angles: understand the like of their Corporal Conjunction. But if there be Reception, he does not afflict; for reception abates all malice, as we have said elsewhere.
rules.translation: 第十八考量：行星在凶星之角（凶星所在星座之第4/7/10位）——除非凶星接纳之，否则此星处境恶劣困顿：如遭围攻之人，众敌环伺而无援手。例：火星在牡羊，水星在巨蟹/天秤/摩羯即谓在其角；合相同理。若有接纳，凶星不加害——接纳消解一切恶意。
rules.notes: 凶星之角=四分身/冲相位之位置

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 事不得成，问者蒙羞受损
rules.original_text: The Nineteenth Consideration is, To behold the Moon if she be 'void of course,' for then it signifies an impediment to the thing in question, it will not come to a good end, nor be accomplished; but the Querent shall be forced to desist with shame and loss.
rules.translation: 第十九考量：月亮出界（void of course）——兆所问之事受阻，不得善终，不会成就；问者将蒙羞受损而罢手。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮/征象星所合之星：吉星接纳/无接纳授德性/凶星接纳
rules.result: 吉星接纳则事成；凶星有接纳则事成但劳苦
rules.original_text: The Twentieth Consideration is, To observe whether the Moon or Significator be joined to any of the Planets, for thence you must derive your judgment of what is like to happen in business. Take notice therefore whether the planet to which the Moon or Significator joins, receives them; for then there will be good laudable end; and the matter will be accomplished with success, if the receiver be a Fortune. But if there be no reception, yet if the Moon or Significator shall give virtue to that planet, the thing will still come to pass. But if it be an Infortune, though they do not give him virtue, yet without a reception it will not do; but with a reception, if he be not afflicted, it signifies a good end of the matter, though not without much labour and tediousness.
rules.translation: 第二十考量：月亮或主征象星所合之星——以此判断事之走向。若所合之星接纳之，则有美好可赞之终局，若接纳者为吉星则事成。若无接纳，但月亮/征象星授德性于该星，事仍能成。若为凶星：虽不授德性，无接纳则不成；有接纳且凶星无碍，则事有好终，虽须多劳苦烦难。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Twenty-first Consideration is, To see from what planet the Moon separates: for that signifies what is past of the business: as from a Fortune the good, from an Infortune the ill that hath been.
rules.translation: 第二十一考量：观月亮自何星分离——示事之过去：自吉星分离示过去之吉，自凶星分离示过去之凶。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Twenty-second Consideration is, To note which of the planets the Moon is now joined to, for that signifies what is now present; and from thence we must judge of the present state of the matter.
rules.translation: 第二十二考量：月亮现时所合之星——示事之现在；由此判断事之当下状态。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 示未来之事，依所合之星断吉凶
rules.original_text: The Twenty-third Consideration is, To behold to whom the Moon is now joining [or by applying Aspect], so as her Conjunction is not yet completed: for that signifies what is to come: wherefore if thou wouldst judge of a thing, which as yet is not, but 'tis hoped will hereafter be brought to pass, 'tis necessary then thou shouldst see to whom the Moon will next join; and according to her Significations judge whether good or evil.
rules.translation: 第二十三考量：月亮正向何星趋合（相位未成）——示事之未来。欲断未成而有望之事，须看月亮下一个将合之星，依其征象断吉凶。
rules.notes: 过去=分离星；现在=合相星；未来=趋合星

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Twenty-fourth Consideration is, To note whether the planet who is Significator be in his Declension, for then it causes a hindrance to everything thereby signified, and trouble and grief about it; and if the Question be about a prison wherein the Querent fears he shall be put, it signifies he shall be cast into the same together with disgrace and prejudice; and if the Question concerns one already in prison, it signifies a tedious confinement and more affliction than he believes.
rules.translation: 第二十四考量：主征象星在其落陷（Declension）——对一切所征之事造成阻碍、烦忧与悲伤。若问将入狱之事，兆其入狱且蒙羞受损；若问已在狱者，兆其监禁漫长、痛苦超其所料。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星逆行/将逆行驻留
rules.result: 逆行示现祸；驻留示祸已过
rules.original_text: The Twenty Fifth Consideration is, Whether the Planet that is Significator be Retrograde, or Stationary to Retrogradation: for then it signifies mischief and damage, discord, contradiction, and going backward with damage; yet being stationary, is not so bad, as being Retrograde. For the last notes the mischief to be, as it were, present and in being. But being Stationary notes that 'tis past and over.
rules.translation: 第二十五考量：主征象星逆行或将逆行驻留——兆祸害损失、不和、矛盾、倒退受损。驻留不如逆行之恶；逆行示祸害正在发生，驻留示其已成过去。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星第二驻留（将顺行）
rules.result: 示已过之碍与凶，不如顺行之善
rules.original_text: The Twenty Sixth Consideration is, Whether the Significator be in his Second Station, that is towards Direction; for that signifies also hinderance and evil, which already hath been and is past; yet some say that this Second Station is as good as direction: but this is only a way of speaking, as when one hath been sick and begins to grow well, we say he is recovered and sound, which is not simply true, but somewhere near it; for as the First Station is not so bad as Retrogradation, so the Second Station is not so good as direction.
rules.translation: 第二十六考量：主征象星在第二驻留（将转顺行）——亦示阻碍与凶，但已成过去。有人说第二驻留与顺行同佳，此乃修辞——如病初愈而言康复，近是而非全真。第一驻留不如逆行之恶，第二驻留亦不如顺行之善。
rules.notes: Lilly 注：第二驻留示万物更新与力量，第一驻留示解体与毁灭

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The Twenty Seventh Consideration is, Whether the Infortunes are the Significators of anything; for if they signify ill, the evil will be much augmented, and if good it will be much diminished, abated, imperfect, and with difficulty; so that the party will scarce think his business done, unless by chance they be in a very good condition and excellently disposed.
rules.translation: 第二十七考量：凶星为主征象星——所征若凶则凶大增；所征若吉则吉大减、受损、不完全、困难；事主几不觉得事成，除非凶星处于极佳状态、布置极善。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星迟行；所在星座之缓速
rules.result: 迟行则事迟延；星座速度分级
rules.original_text: The 28th Consideration is, Whether the Significator be slow of Course, for then it delays the effect; and if it be in the beginning of anything, retards it, so that it will be scarce ever be finished: besides, things proceed slowly, where Significators are pointed in Sagittary, Capricorn, Aquary or Pisces: or who are the Lords of them, whether they be slow of course; in Aries or Scorpio they are not quite so dilatory. In Leo they hasten business; more in Taurus or Libra; but most of all in Gemini or Virgo.
rules.translation: 第二十八考量：主征象星运行迟慢——迟延其效；若事方起则拖延，几乎永不完成。征象星在射手/摩羯/水瓶/双鱼（或其为这些星座之主）则事行迟缓；牡羊/天蝎稍不迟；狮子则催速；金牛/天秤更快；双子/处女最速。
rules.notes: 星座速度序列：双鱼最迟→双子处女最速

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 示当下；下一合星示未来
rules.original_text: The 29th Consideration is, Whether the Moon be joined to any planet by body or aspect exactly to a minute; for that signifies the present state of things; and from that minute observe what planet she joins next, for he shall be Significator of all that shall happen of that thing; as the planet she was last before with, was of what has already passed as aforesaid.
rules.translation: 第二十九考量：月亮是否精确至一分与某星合相（实体或相位）——示事之当下状态；由此分起观其下一合之星，彼即所事未来一切之主征象星；正如其前一合之星示过去。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 力转入下一星座，原星座吉凶皆无效
rules.original_text: The 30th Consideration is, To observe when a planet that is Significator, or the Moon, shall have past the 29th degree of the Sign wherein it is, and touches the 30th, and especially if it have passed one minute of that degree; for then it shall have no strength in that Sign, but in the next; so that if in the first it signified any evil, it shall hurt the person or thing threatened no more than the fall of a house shall one that is just got out of it.
rules.translation: 第三十考量：主征象星或月亮过其所在星座之29°而触30°（尤过1分）——则其力不在该星座而在下一星座；原星座所征之凶，其害如屋塌于刚出屋之人（无害）；所征之吉亦无所益，如张网捕鸟仅触其尾羽而不得其体。
rules.notes: Zael：星在29°其力仍在原星座，因未全过29°

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 趋合星换星座后合相+接纳=事成；先合他星=事败；合相禁相位
rules.result: 事之成否由合相地点与接纳决定
rules.original_text: The 31st Consideration is, To look when one planet applies to the Conjunction of another, if he be near the end of the same Sign wherein he is himself, or that other to whom he applies; so that he will pass out of that Sign before the Conjunction is perfected; and to see if he be joined with him in the following Sign to which he is changed, because then the cause is perfected; if that planet confers anything on him in that Sign wherein he is so joined to him; that is, if any reception happen, unless the said planet, or he to whom he applies, be first joined to another; for then the business comes to nothing, and will not be perfected. Nor must it be forgotten that a Corporal Conjunction forbids an Aspect and cuts it off, but an Aspect cannot do so by a Conjunction.
rules.translation: 第三十一考量：一星趋合他星，若其在己星座之末或所趋之星在星座之末，合相未成即出星座——看是否在换入之下一星座完成合相：若在该星座得接纳（他星授德于彼），则事成；除非该星或所趋之星先与他星相合，则事归于无。又须知：实体合相禁断相位并截断之，而相位不能截断合相。
rules.notes: conjunction forbids aspect 规则

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 吉/凶；强居庙旺之凶星胜弱吉星
rules.original_text: The 32nd Consideration is, If an Infortune be the Significator, what his condition is; for if it be good, there will good come of the thing; if bad, rather evil; as 'Sarviator' says in 'Pentadera,' An ill-planet strong in his own Home or Exaltation, not joined with any other Infortune to impede or weaken him, is better than a Fortune Retrograde afflicted.
rules.translation: 第三十二考量：凶星为征象星时看其状态——状态好则事吉，状态坏则事凶。如 Sarviator 于《Pentadera》所言：凶星强居己庙或旺、无他凶星相碍者，胜于逆行受碍之吉星。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星征象星被凶星碍/被升主或月亮四分冲合
rules.original_text: The 33rd Consideration is, To see whether either of the Infortunes be the Significator of anything, and be joined to another Infortune impeding him, or has joined to him the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon, by a Square or Opposition; for then this Infortune will perfect the business, but the business will not be good, or rather it will be destroyed after it seems perfected. But if the Infortune that Impedes be the lighter of the two, so that he apply to a Conjunction, with the Significator, it will hinder less than if the Significator apply to the other.
rules.translation: 第三十三考量：凶星为征象星而与另一凶星相合受碍，或上升主星/月亮以四分/冲与之相合——则该凶星将完成其事，但事不好，或于看似完成后被毁。若碍之凶星较轻且向征象星趋合，其碍小于征象星向彼趋合。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星在上升且状态佳（或在其旺）
rules.result: 弃恶行善、事得成；弱则毁事
rules.original_text: The 34th Consideration is, To mind in Questions or Nativities, whether the Significator of the business be an Infortune and Lord of the Ascendant, and in the Ascendant; direct, not vitiated, and in good condition; for then he would both affect the same and bring it to a good conclusion; nay, although he be not Significator nor Lord of the Ascendant, but only be in the Ascendant, and that the same be his Exaltation; he lays aside all his malice, and is restrained from mischief; but if he be weak and afflicted, his malice and contrariety is increased so as to destroy the business wholly.
rules.translation: 第三十四考量：问盘中凶星为征象星、上升主星、且在上升，顺行、无碍、状态佳——则其能成就其事且得善终；即使非征象星非升主，仅居上升且为其旺位——亦弃其恶意、不行凶。若弱而受碍，则其恶意增大，全然毁事。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 同性减恶；异类且无尊贵则凶
rules.original_text: The 35th Consideration is, To look whether an Infortune be in Signs like him, or of his own nature, for that abates his ill effects; like a cross fellow when he is pleased and has what he will, as Saturn in Capricorn, Aquary, or Libra, or in a cold Sign, especially if he have any Dignities there: and so Mars in Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn, or a hot Sign, &c. But if Saturn be in a hot Sign, or Mars in a cold Sign, out of their dignities, it will be bad, and the business be no more completed, than oil will mix with water; but if strong and well disposed, they will mix in good, like water and wine, or milk with honey.
rules.translation: 第三十五考量：凶星是否在与己同性（或同类）之星座——减其恶效：如乖戾之人得其所欲则悦。土星在摩羯/水瓶/天秤或冷星座（尤有尊贵）；火星在牡羊/天蝎/摩羯或热星座。若土星在热星座、火星在冷星座且无尊贵——则凶，事如油水不相混；若强而布置佳，则如水酒、乳蜜相融。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 吉星三分/六分照凶星（尤接纳）
rules.original_text: The 36th Consideration is, To observe when the Infortunes are the obstructors of a business, whether the Fortunes behold them with a Trine or Sextile aspect; for then their ill-nature will be allayed and mitigated; but much more if these receive them.
rules.translation: 第三十六考量：凶星碍事之时，吉星以三分/六分照之——则其恶性被缓和；若吉星接纳凶星则更甚。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 37th Consideration is, To look if the Fortunes are the Significators? Whether the Infortunes behold them with Oppositions or Squares; for that will much lessen their kind effects, and diminish the good they otherwise promised.
rules.translation: 第三十七考量：吉星为征象星时，凶星以冲/四分照之——大减其善效，削减其本许诺之吉。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 38th Consideration is, To consider if the Fortunes are Significators, whether they are Cadent from Angles, or from the Ascendant, so as not to behold the same, and be Retrograde; for under these Impediments they will be almost as bad as the Infortunes themselves, unless they be in reception.
rules.translation: 第三十八考量：吉星为征象星但自角宫或上升落陷（不照上升）且逆行——在此等阻碍下其坏几如凶星，除非被接纳。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 39th is, To consider if the Significator be in Reception; for if it be a Fortune, its signification will thereby be much bettered, and its impediment and mischief much lessened if it be an Infortune.
rules.translation: 第三十九考量：征象星是否被接纳——吉星被接纳其征大善；凶星被接纳其碍与恶大减。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 游走恶增；尊贵减恶（庙旺界>三面>hayz）
rules.original_text: The 40th is, To consider if an Infortune, whether he be Significator or not, be Peregrine; that is, not in any of his Dignities, for then his malice is increased; but when in his Dignities it somewhat abates it; that is in his House, Exaltation, or Terms; but in his Triplicity or Face very Little, and in Hayz least of all.
rules.translation: 第四十考量：凶星（无论是否征象星）是否游走（Peregrine，无任何尊贵）——则其恶增；在尊贵中则稍减：在庙/旺/界中减；在三/面中减甚微；在 Hayz（日夜阳阴位）中最不关紧要。
rules.notes: 尊贵减恶梯度：house/exaltation/terms > triplicity/face > hayz

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星在庙/旺/界/三分/角宫/续宫
rules.original_text: The 41st is, If an Infortune, being Significator, be in his own House or Exaltation, or in his own Terms or Triplicity, or in Angles or Succedent Houses; for by all these means he is fortified, and shall be counted strong as a Fortune.
rules.translation: 第四十一考量：凶星为征象星而在其庙/旺/界/三分，或在角宫/续宫——皆使其强健，其力可计如吉星。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 42nd is, If a Fortune be Significator, or give virtue or assistance to any of the Planets, and be in a House where he has none of the Lordly Dignities, then his good signification will be lessened and abated; and so on the contrary.
rules.translation: 第四十二考量：吉星为征象星（或授德性于他星）而居无尊贵之宫——则其吉征减弱；反之则增强。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 吉凶星同处劣位/逆行灼伤
rules.original_text: The 43rd is, If the Fortunes and Infortunes be together ill-posited, that is, in some of the said Impediments, as Houses where they have no Dignities, Combust or the like; then whatever they signify 'tis but weakly; according to that Aphorism of the Philosopher, A Planet Retrograde and Combust, has no strength in signification. The Fortunes when Combust and under the Sun's beams, signify none or very little good; and the Infortunes in like case have little or no virtue to signify ill.
rules.translation: 第四十三考量：吉凶星同处劣位（无尊贵之宫、灼伤等）——其所征皆微弱。哲人格言：逆行且灼伤之星，征象无力。吉星灼伤在日辉下，不兆或少兆吉；凶星同理，亦少有兆凶之力。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在庙/旺/三分/界/面
rules.original_text: The 44th is, To consider if the Significators, Fortune or Infortune, be in his own House, Exaltation, Triplicity, Terms or Face (but the latter being not of that virtue with the rest, 'tis necessary it should be assisted with another Dignity, which is Hayz or Light); for in such case the Infortune loses his sting; and being reined in like a wild horse from doing mischief, his malice is converted into good.
rules.translation: 第四十四考量：征象星（吉或凶）在其庙/旺/三分/界/面（面之力弱于其他，须以另一尊贵 Hayz 或光相助）——则凶星失其毒刺；如野马被勒而不行凶，其恶转为善。
rules.notes: 面须配 Hayz 或光方有效

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星在上升四分/冲位而害星
rules.original_text: The 45th is, To consider if the Infortunes are in angles of the Ascendant, that is, in such signs as are in Square or Opposition to the Ascendant, when they afflict any Planet by Square or Opposition; for then they assist so much the worse, and do more mischief, especially if they be in a stronger place than such afflicted Planet; but if they cast only a Trine or a Sextile, it is lessened and the Impediment mitigated.
rules.translation: 第四十五考量：凶星在上升之角（与上升成四分/冲之星座）而以四分/冲害某星——其害更甚，尤当凶星较受害星更强；若只投三分/六分则害减、阻碍缓和。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 46th is, To see whether the Significator be a Fortune or Infortune, the first naturally signifies good and prosperity, the last naturally evil by its malignity; therefore consider the Planets' places from the Ascendant where they are; for if a Planet be in his Light, or his Hayz in any of his Dignities, or in a good place from the Ascendant, it signifies good; and if it be a good planet the better.
rules.translation: 第四十六考量：辨征象星吉凶——吉星本兆吉与兴旺，凶星本兆凶。观行星自上升之位置：若在其光（Light）、或 Hayz、或有尊贵、或自上升看为好位置——兆吉；行星本身为吉则更吉。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 行星在其光中/在其光外
rules.result: 光中则强；光外则弱难成事
rules.original_text: The 47th is, To consider whether the Significator be in his Light or no, that is a Diurnal Planet in the day, above the earth, and in the night under the earth; and a Nocturnal Planet in the night above the earth, and in the day under it; for this renders such Planet more strong. But if a Nocturnal Planet be Significator of anything in the day above the earth, or a Diurnal Planet in the night, the same is thereby weakened and under a kind if impediment, that he can scarce accomplish what he signifies.
rules.translation: 第四十七考量：征象星是否在其光（Light）中——日行星昼在地平上、夜在地平下；夜行星夜在地平上、昼在地平下——此使其星更强。若夜行星昼在地平上为征象星、或日行星夜在地平上——则该星被削弱受碍，几乎不能成就其所征。
rules.notes: Light=section/hemisphere 与昼夜属性相符

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 木星照凶星（尤土星）；金星对火星
rules.result: 木星全毁土星之恶；金星消火星之怒，须借木星方改土星
rules.original_text: The 48th is, To consider, when an Infortune is Significator and his ill effects are mitigated, whether Jupiter behold him, or is joined corporally to him? For that will wholly destroy his malignity and turn his nature into good, how bad soever he be; so that if Saturn in that place of himself would not bestow some good or perform what he seems to promise, Jupiter will make him do it, provided he be not afflicted himself, as in his fall, Combust or Retrograde (yet even then he helps, but not so powerfully). On the other side Venus takes off the fury of Mars, by reason of that endearing intimacy which is between them, unless the thing be very difficult, as wars and bloodshed, etc. But she cannot so well divert the mischief of Saturn without the help of Jupiter.
rules.translation: 第四十八考量：凶星为征象星而其恶被缓和时——木星是否照之或实体相合？则全然毁其恶、转其性为善，无论其多恶；如土星本不肯行善或兑现其诺，木星逼其行之——除非木星自身受碍（落陷/灼伤/逆行，仍助但不强）。金星消火星之暴怒（因二者亲密），除非事极难（如战争流血）；但无木星之助，金星不能如此善改土星之凶——因土金无交感：土慢金速、土重金轻、土悦忧郁金悦欢愉。
rules.notes: 与 Ibn Ezra IE-016 同旨

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星征象星合另一凶星/合吉星（有无接纳）
rules.result: 合凶则吉毁凶增；合吉有接纳则转吉
rules.original_text: The 49th is to consider, Whether one of the Infortunes being Significator, be joined to another, for if he signified a good of himself, this will destroy or frustrate it; but if any evil, it will augment and double it, or change it into some worse mischief; but if joined to a Fortune with a Reception on either side, the evil will be converted into good; but without a Reception it will only be allayed and abated, according to the strength of such Fortune.
rules.translation: 第四十九考量：凶星为征象星而与另一凶星相合——其本兆之吉被毁；其本兆之凶被增倍或转为更恶之祸；若与吉星相合且有任一方接纳——凶转吉；无接纳则只按其吉星之力稍减。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 升主/月亮被凶星合冲四分；吉星照之（有无接纳）
rules.result: 有接纳则免险；无接纳则险转他险
rules.original_text: The 50th is, To observe the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon, whether they or either of them are afflicted by the Infortunes, by Conjunction, Opposition, or Square, the business will be spoiled without the aspect of a Fortune, but if the Fortune, that is, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun or Moon shall behold them, it slackens and dissolves the rigours of such Infortune, and the party signified shall be freed from the danger impending, although the aspect be a Square, provided it be with Reception: but if a Fortune without Reception, by a Square or Opposition, or an Infortune with a Trine or Sextile without Reception, shall behold the said Lord of the Ascendant, 'tis possible the party maybe delivered from the present danger; but it will be turned into another as great: so that it will not profit him.
rules.translation: 第五十考量：上升主星与月亮（或其一）被凶星以合相/冲/四分所害——无吉星之相位则事败。若吉星（木金日或月）照之，则缓和消解凶星之酷，所征之人免于将临之险——即使为四分，若有接纳。若吉星无接纳以四分/冲照，或凶星无接纳以三分/六分照上升主星——则人可能脱当下之险，但将转成同样大之另一险，于他无益。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星落陷+无尊贵+无喜乐
rules.original_text: The 51st is, To see whether the Significator be cadent from an angle or from the Ascendant, and in none of his Dignities, nor in his Joy; for then he signifies nothing but doubts and mischief, and there are no hopes of good or profit from a planet so disposed.
rules.translation: 第五十一考量：征象星自角宫或上升落陷、无尊贵、无喜乐——则其只兆疑虑与祸害，如此布置之星无望吉与利。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 行星自日辉脱出（内星日落现/外星晨升现）
rules.result: 脱出前弱；迟行则吉迟得
rules.original_text: The 52nd is, When the three Inferiors, Venus, Mercury, and Luna, come from under the rays of the Sun, and appear in the evening after his setting, for before (viz., till they are got from him 12 degrees) they, or any other planet, are weak, so that a Fortune can advantage little, and an Infortune prejudice as much. Now if the Fortune come forth slow in motion, as with labour, then will not the good expected be obtained without much pains and trouble; and if it be an Infortune, his signification will appear slowly. But in the Superiors, as Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars, these things happen when they come from under the Sun beams, that they rise in the morning before the Sun, and shine before his rising.
rules.translation: 第五十二考量：内行星（金水月）自日辉下脱出、日落后见于傍晚——此前（离日12°内）其或他星皆弱：吉星无益、凶星照常为害。吉星迟行而出（如吃力）——所期之吉须经劳苦方得；凶星则其征缓慢显现。外行星（土木火）则于日出前晨升、先日而明时（自日辉下脱出）同此。
rules.notes: 12°脱离阈值

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 效力微小；凶效略强于吉效
rules.original_text: The 53rd Consideration is, Whether the significator be under the Sun beams, for then he will be of small efficacy in anything as aforesaid; yet the Malevolents will be something more strong in evil than the Benevolents in good.
rules.translation: 第五十三考量：征象星在日辉之下——一切效力微小；凶星之凶效稍强于吉星之吉效。
rules.notes: Lilly 注：灼伤=距日≤12°（或≥16′）；cazimi（16′内）反强；12°-15°为脱离日辉

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 54th is, To consider whether a superior planet be removed 12 degrees from the Sun, going to his morning rising, or an Inferior is so much, and direct, going to his evening rising, for then he is said to be fortified; but when he is got 15 degrees, so that he appears, he is more fortified in everything: like one coming out of a battle rejoicing having destroyed and routed all his enemies. But when the Sun follows the three Superiors, and there shall be between them and him less than 15 degrees, their weakness is said to be increased, until there shall be only 7 degrees between them and afterwards, until they shall be in the heart of the Sun, they are said to be in extreme debility; but the debility of the Inferiors is contrary to them, for it is said to be increased when they follow the Sun, and that there is between them and the Sun from 15 degrees to 7 degrees, and from 7 degrees till they are in the heart of the Sun, they are said to be in their greatest debility.
rules.translation: 第五十四考量：外行星离日12°将晨升、内行星离日12°顺行将夕现——谓其被加强；至15°可见时更强：如胜战凯旋之人。太阳追三外行星且相距<15°时其弱增，至相距仅7°时更弱，至入太阳之心（cazimi）时极弱；内行星之弱相反：其随日而行、距日15°至7°时弱增，7°至入日心时极弱。
rules.notes: 外行星晨升强/内行星夕现强；追日则弱（内外相反）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 55th is, To consider whether the significator be Peregrine, for then the person whom he signifies, either in a Nativity or Question, etc., will be subtle, crafty, malicious, one that shall know how to act both good and evil, but more inclinable to the latter.
rules.translation: 第五十五考量：征象星游走（Peregrine，无尊贵）——其所征之人（本命或问盘中）机巧、诡诈、恶毒，知如何行善行恶，而更偏于恶。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 内行星东出顺行/外行星西没距日20′内=弱；外行星东出/内行星西没不逆行=强
rules.original_text: The 56th is, To consider if the significator of anything shall commit his disposition or virtue to any other planet? Whether it be to one that is Oriental or Occidental? For if he be Oriental and one of the Inferiors and direct, or if he be Occidental and one of the Superiors, and that there be not above 20 minutes between him and the Sun, he will be weak, says 'Sarcinator,' and not perform what he shows, but hinders many things; and so much further as such planet shall be from the Sun, so much less shall he be afflicted. And if it be Oriental, and one of the Superiors, or Occidental, and one of the Inferiors, and not Retrograde, he shall be strong and fit to perfect what he promises; as one that hath been ill, but is more perfectly recovered, or a building which fell and is repaired.
rules.translation: 第五十六考量：征象星将德性交付何星，看其东出或西没：若为内行星而东出且顺行，或为外行星而西没，且距日不超过20分——则其弱（Sarcinator 说），不成其所示而碍多事；距日越远其碍越小。若为外行星东出或内行星西没且不逆行——则强，能成其所诺：如病愈之人、修复之屋。
rules.notes: 20′ cazimi 阈值

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在8宫（吉/凶）；问战/问程
rules.result: 吉星无益；凶星断死或俘
rules.original_text: The 57th is, To consider whether the significator be in the Eighth from the Ascendant? For if he be there, and a Fortune, though he do not harm, he will do no good; and if he be an Infortune he will do greater mischief than in any other place of the Figure; and if the Question be of going to War, advise not the Querent to go there, although it be a Fortune; for always some evil is to be suspected, that is death, or at least captivity, for it is a place of darkness and death; but if it be an Infortune, judge death, unless he separate then from the Lord of the Eighth; for then it may be only a wound, or bruise, or a fall, wherein he was in danger of death, although he may escape; and if it be a journey, especially a long one, he will be taken prisoner, or in great dread of it.
rules.translation: 第五十七考量：征象星在自上升之第八宫——吉星在则虽不为害亦不为善；凶星在则其害大于盘中任何他处。若问战事，劝问者勿往——即使吉星，亦恒可疑凶（死或俘），因8宫为幽暗死亡之地。凶星在则断死，除非其与8宫主分离——则或仅伤、挫、坠而有死亡之危，或可逃。若问行程（尤长途）——将被俘或大惧之。凶星如此布置之害恒大于吉星。
rules.notes: 8宫=死亡宫

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 星过1°（Zael:5°）方稳固；离角尖5°内仍计角宫
rules.original_text: The 58th is to consider, Whether the Significator be fixed in that Sign where he is found? Now 'Zael' saith 'That a Planet is not said to be fixed in a Sign till he hath passed 5 degrees thereof'. But I am of the opinion that when he hath passed one whole degree of a sign he is firmly therein. So likewise he says: 'That a Planet is not said to be cadent from the Ascendant, unless he be removed from thence 5 degrees.'
rules.translation: 第五十八考量：征象星是否稳固于所在星座。Zael 谓：星未过星座5°不得谓稳固；我意过整1°即已稳固。Zael 又谓：星离上升未及5°不得谓自上升落陷。角宫判定经验：星在宫尖后5°内仍视为在角——曾以火星在摩羯（地角）尖后5°（南纬）断罗马皇帝被杀，果然。星离任何角尖5°或以上，方计为自该角落陷。
rules.notes: Ptolemy 等以宫尖同度±1°计角；Bonatti 经验用5°

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在角尖后15°内（Zael）/前5°后25°（Ptolemy）
rules.original_text: The 59th is to consider, whether the significator be behind the cusp of an angle 15° and no more; for he shall be said to be in an Angle as well as he that is exactly there, as 'Zael' affirms. For example, the Ascendant is 4 degrees of Taurus, and the end thereof was behind the Angle, whatever planet is posited from the 4th to the 19th degree thereof is in the angle, but what is beyond that is not. But Ptolemy seems to intimate, though he says not expressly, that every planet who shall be 5° before, or 25° after the cusp, is in the Angle.
rules.translation: 第五十九考量：征象星在角尖之后15°以内——仍计为在角，与恰在角尖者同（Zael 说）。例：上升金牛4°，凡自4°至19°（其后15°）之星皆在角，超出则否。Ptolemy 似暗谓：星在角尖前5°或后25°内皆在角。Lilly 注：任何宫内之星自宫起始至宫终皆谓在该宫（宫>星座，一宫可含多星座）。
rules.notes: 角宫边界两种口径：15°（Zael）/5°+25°（Ptolemy）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在固定/变动/双体星座
rules.result: 固定=稳定持续；变动=骤变速决；双体=改变而复返
rules.original_text: The 60th is to consider, Whether the significator be in a Sign fixed, common, or moveable; because in a fixed Sign he signifies stability and countenance of the thing begun, or to be undertaken, or enquired of. In a common Sign, a change with a return or repeating of it, that the same will once be broken off, and afterwards begun again, or something added, or other alteration happen; for which reason in things that require alteration, as buying, selling, or the like, we should put the Significator and Moon, or one of them, into a common sign, but in a moveable Sign it signifies a sudden change, a quick dispatch or end whether good or evil. And therefore in matters where we desire a sudden conclusion, we ought to put the Significator in moveable Signs; but in things that we desire should be fixed and endure, we ought to place them in fixed Signs, where we would have a mean, let them be in common Signs.
rules.translation: 第六十考量：征象星在固定/变动/双体星座。固定星座——示事之稳定与持续（已始/将始/所问之事）；双体星座——示改变而复返：事一度中断而后重起，或有所添加、或另有变更；故买卖等需变之事，宜使征象星或月亮居双体星座；变动星座——示骤变、速决速了（吉凶皆然）。故求速决者置变动星座，求恒久者置固定星座，求折中者置双体星座。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 升主/月亮与龙头龙尾实体合相；趋近vs离开
rules.result: 碍事；趋近龙头恶增；离龙尾1°内最凶、渐减至12°无
rules.original_text: The 61st is to behold, Whether the Lord of the Ascendant or Moon, be with the Dragon's Head or Tail; for that is an impediment in all affairs, and the hindrance or mischief will proceed from a cause signified by that House in which such conjunction happens. But no conjunction of the Dragon's Head or Tail hurts, unless it be corporal for they have no Aspect or Opposition. And it is worse when the Significator or Moon goes towards them, than when they go from them. And note that when the significator or Moon goes to the Dragon's Head, its malice is augmented, for its nature is to increase, and when they go to the Tail, the mischief is not absolutely at the worst, as 'tis when they go from it.
rules.translation: 第六十一考量：上升主星或月亮与龙头/龙尾相合——一切事务之阻碍，其碍来自合相所在宫所征之因。龙头龙尾之合相除非实体（body），否则无害——因二者无相位无冲。征象星/月亮向其趋近比自其离开更凶；向龙头趋近其恶增（龙头性增）；向龙尾趋近不如自龙尾离开之凶：离尾1°内最凶，1°-3°渐减，3°-5°更减，5°-7°甚微，7°-9°更微，9°-12°几无。
rules.notes: 龙头性增、龙尾性减；无相位无冲，仅实体合相有效

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 事难成；但宜宴饮沐浴脱毛（天蝎尤宜）
rules.original_text: The 62nd is to consider, Whether the Moon be void of course? for that signifies that the thing enquired after shall scarce ever come to a good end, or not without much labour, sorrow, and trouble, unless the Lord of the Ascendant or significator of the thing shall be in very good condition, and then it may be hindered, but not wholly frustrated; yet 'tis a good time then for drinking, bathing, feasting, etc., and to use ointments for taking away of hair, especially if she be in Scorpio.
rules.translation: 第六十二考量：月亮出界——所问之事几乎不得善终，或须多劳苦悲伤烦难；除非上升主星或征象星状态极佳，则事受阻但不全毁。然此时却宜饮酒、沐浴、宴乐、用脱毛膏——尤当月亮在天蝎。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮不与凶星光触、与吉星光触
rules.original_text: The 63rd is to consider, Whether the Moon be far from the Conjunction of the Infortunes, so as not to cast her beams on theirs, for then the event will be good, but rather if she touch with her beams those of the Fortunes. And yet better, if besides this the Lord of the Ascendant, or of the business, be in good condition; for if they be not well disposed, it may impair the good promised, but not wholly prevent it.
rules.translation: 第六十三考量：月亮远离凶星之合相而不投光于其光——则事之结果吉；更若其光触吉星之光则更吉。若再加之上升主星或事主星状态良好则更佳；若其布置不佳，则损其所诺之吉，但不全阻。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮在巨蟹/金牛/射手/双鱼
rules.result: 兆吉；出界碍减；灼伤则无益
rules.original_text: The 64th is to consider, Whether the Moon be in Cancer, Taurus, Sagittarius, or Pisces; for it signifies good in the business, although she be joined to the Infortunes and not to the Fortunes; nor does she, being void of course, prejudice so much in those places as elsewhere, provided she be not Combust, for then they will advantage her little or nothing.
rules.translation: 第六十四考量：月亮在巨蟹/金牛/射手/双鱼——兆事吉，即使与凶星相合而不与吉星相合；其出界在此时之碍亦不及他处，除非灼伤——灼伤则几乎无益。
rules.notes: 月亮在这些星座时的缓和规则

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 65th is to consider, Whether the Lord of the Seventh is afflicted or not? for that will be an impediment to the business. And you ought to defer judgment if you can, and warily search always whence such impediment shall arise, as well by the Conjunction of the Lord of the Seventh with the Planets, as by their separation, and also of the Moon; so may'st thou find whence it will proceed, and afterwards give judgment with more safety.
rules.translation: 第六十五考量：第7宫主是否受碍——碍事。能延判则延判，并仔细寻此碍之来源：察7宫主与诸星之合相与分离，及月亮之合离；由此知碍之所出，然后更稳妥地下判。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星威胁之处为吉/凶星尊贵地+吉星相位
rules.result: 吉星尊贵地+三六分则害全消；凶星尊贵地则害来自不义
rules.original_text: The 66th is to consider, When the Infortunes threaten mischief, whether the place on which their threats fall, be the Dignity of any of the Fortunes? And whether such Fortune behold the same place by Trine or Sextile? For then it will take away the mischief and annul it wholly. If by a square, it will only lessen it; if by an Opposition, take away some part of it; but if it cast no aspect at all, the mischief will happen; but it will proceed from honest, just persons. But if the aforesaid place be the Dignity of an Infortune, the prejudice will come from unjust men, false witnesses, a corrupt Judge, or some sentence unjustly given through a mistake.
rules.translation: 第六十六考量：凶星威胁之处若是吉星之尊贵地——且吉星以三分/六分照该处，则尽去其害、全然消灭；以四分照则只减其害；以冲照则去其一部分；全无相位则祸成，但来自正直公正之人（问者或正当地败诉于公正法官前）。若该处为凶星之尊贵地，则损害来自不义之人、伪证、贪腐法官、或误判之不公判决。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 蚀距征象星<12°；吉星尊贵在蚀处；吉/凶星照蚀处
rules.result: 蚀近=害；吉星尊贵减之；吉星照增恶、凶星照减害
rules.original_text: The 67th is to consider, Whether there by any Eclipse near, which is less than 12 degrees from the significator? For the same will bring damage and mischief to the Querent or business, unless there be a Fortune which hath Dignities in the same place, for then the same is abated; but if there be no such, thou oughtest to look what Planet beholds the said place of the Eclipse and how. For if the Fortunes behold it, they do but augment the evil; and if they are Infortunes, they lessen and abate it, which seems a kind of riddle or wonder in Art.
rules.translation: 第六十七考量：距征象星12°内是否有近临之蚀——将为问者或其事带来损害与祸，除非该处有吉星之尊贵则稍减。若无，观何星照该蚀处及如何照：吉星照之反增其恶，凶星照之反减其害——此乃术中似谜之奇事。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 医药无效须换医；或病转慢性
rules.original_text: The 68th is to consider, In questions relating to sick people, or Decumbitures, Whether the Lord of the Seventh, and Seventh House itself, be free from Impediments? For if they be, the sick may safely trust himself to the care of the Physicians, for medicines will do very well. But if the Seventh House and its Lord shall be Afflicted, Ptolemy saith 'The Physician must be changed, for neither his physic nor care will do any good'; for the seventh signifies the medicine as 'Zael' saith; or at least the disease grows chronical and lasting.
rules.translation: 第六十八考量：问病（卧病盘 Decumbiture）——7宫及其主是否无碍。无碍则可安心托付医师，药效佳。7宫或其主受碍——Ptolemy 谓当换医，其药其护皆无效（Zael：7宫征医药）；或病转慢性久拖。治疗之始若见同象亦然。
rules.notes: 7宫=医药（Zael）；Decumbiture 卧病盘

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 转以朔望主星/月亮首合星断
rules.original_text: The 69th is to consider, Whether the significators of the Ascendant, and of the House signifying the thing enquired, be of equal strength and debility? For then thou canst not safely give judgment: but in such case thou must mind the Lord of the Conjunction or Prevention (as the thing is either conjunctional or preventional) which was last before, and by that judge. But if the Lord of the Conjunction or Prevention, and of the thing, be still equal, thou must then turn to the Moon, and see to whom she first applies, and thence deduce judgment.
rules.translation: 第六十九考量：上升征象星与所问事宫征象星强弱相等——则不能稳判。此时看最近一次朔/望（先于问时者）之主星，依其断。若朔望主与事主仍均势，则转而看月亮首合何星，依之推断。
rules.notes: preventional=望（前满月）、conjunctional=朔（前新月）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 前朔/望主星在角宫=事成；在果宫=不成
rules.result: 角宫则成（除非问者自误）；果宫则不成
rules.original_text: The 70th Consideration is, To mind another secret; not well searched into by Astrologers, but often times doing them much prejudice; that is, see in all Questions, etc., whether the Lord of the New or Full Moon, preventional last before, be in any of the Angles of the thing enquired after; if it be, it denotes that the business will be accomplished, unless it be the Querent's own fault (or that God overrule against it), though perhaps by other significations it seemed not likely. But if it shall not happen so, but only the same is in the Ascendant; and the other significators that is, The Lord of the Ascendant of the thing enquired of, and the Moon, or any of them assist, the thing will be done with ease. If it be in Cadent Houses, it will scarce ever be, though other significators seem never so favourable; and if two at least of them be not so, take it for certain it will never be done.
rules.translation: 第七十考量：一秘密（占星家少究而常受害）：一切问盘，看最近一次朔/望（先于问时）之主星是否在问事之角宫——若是，事将成（除非问者自误或上帝干预），即使他征象看似不成。若不在角而仅在上升，且升主/月亮等征象星相助——事易成。若其在果宫——几乎不成，即使他征象皆佳；若相助者至少无二——可断定永不成。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在角与角之间的象限
rules.original_text: The 7lst is to consider, Whether the Significators falls between the Ascendant and the Twelfth, for that signifies continuance or length of time, when a thing will be done; or if done already, how long it will continue in days or hours. If between the twelfth and the tenth, it notes half-weeks; between the tenth and seventh, months or weeks; between the seventh and fourth, years; and between the Fourth and the Ascendant, half years.
rules.translation: 第七十一考量：征象星所在位置定事成之时长：在上升与第12宫之间——示日/小时；第12至第10之间——半周；第10至第7之间——月或周；第7至第4之间——年；第4至上升之间——半年。
rules.notes: 角间象限定时法；编者另引 Morrison/Simmonite 度数换算法

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 不宜行；必须行则择碍月之星为升主之时
rules.original_text: The 72nd is to observe, That if the question be of a journey, and the Moon afflicted, it is not safe to undertake it; but if it cannot be put off, make the Planet that afflicts her, Lord of the Ascendant at the time of the Querent's setting forth.
rules.translation: 第七十二考量：问行程而月亮受碍——不宜出行；若不可推延，则使碍月之行星在问者启程之时为上升主星（择时以避其碍）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 本吉+吉星照=吉增；本吉+凶星照=吉减；本凶+凶星照=凶增
rules.original_text: The 73rd is to mind, Whether the Questions signify good or evil? If good, whether the Fortunes beheld the Significator of the Question, or the Moon? For then the good Fortune thereof will be increased: but if the Infortunes cast in their beams, as much or more diminished. But if it originally signify evil, and the Infortunes behold the Significator or Moon, as aforesaid, the evil threatened will be increased and becomes much worse.
rules.translation: 第七十三考量：问事本兆吉凶。本吉——吉星照征象星或月亮则吉增；凶星投光则吉减（同量或更多）。本凶——凶星照征象星或月亮则凶增而更恶。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星第一驻留（将逆行）/第二驻留（将顺行）
rules.result: 第一驻留事不成（建屋永不完工）；第二驻留事慢成（地下则不成）
rules.original_text: The 74th is to consider, Whether the Significator be in his first station, going to be Retrograde? For that signifies crossness and disobedience, and that the matter, though never so probable, will not be accomplished. If any work or building be then begun, it will not be finished. And if such Significator, so asserted, be then under the earth, such building shall not be raised to any purpose in thirty years, and then not finished; and if it be raised a little then, it will be a raising thirty years more. And if not then completed, it will not be completed till ninety years after its first; and if not then, it will never be finished. But if the Significator be in his second station, going to be direct, it notes that the affair will be done, but slowly, intricately, and with pains and trouble.
rules.translation: 第七十四考量：征象星在第一驻留（将逆行）——兆乖戾不顺，事无论看似多成终不成；此时兴工起屋永不完工。若其星在地平下，三十年内不能建成，纵建一点再延三十年；若仍未成，九十年后仍不成；再不成就永不完工（除非产权易主）。征象星在第二驻留（将顺行）——事将成，但缓慢、曲折、劳苦烦难；此时起屋能成，但不如初料之快——除非其星在地平下：则始建者永不能成之、不能高出地面。
rules.notes: Lilly 注：第二驻留=万物更新强健；第一驻留=解体毁灭

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮受碍；月亮/害月之星照上升（三六分）
rules.result: 事受阻；三六分缓和；月亮受碍几无好终
rules.original_text: The 75th is to Consider, Whether the Moon be afflicted by any Planet? For then, whatever the question be, the same will suffer impediment. But if the Moon be in a good place from the Ascendant, so as to behold it with a Trine or Sextile, or if the Planet that afflicts her do behold the same, either of these Aspects will mitigate the mischief intended, and it may be, wholly take it away, as the said afflicting Planet is disposed; so that he be not Cadent from Angles, nor from the Ascendant, nor in his fall. 'Zael' seems to say 'That if an Infortune afflicting be cadent from the Ascendant, or Retrograde, it causeth fear in the Querent; but I always fear the affliction of the Moon above all other Impediments, and scarce Remember that I ever saw a good end of anything where she was afflicted: and in journeys, if to war, was apprehensive of the Querent's care and person; if for traffic, of straits, quarrels, sadness in his travels, and loss of money.'
rules.translation: 第七十五考量：月亮是否受他星之害——受害则一切所问皆受阻。若月亮自上升看居好位且以三分/六分照上升，或害月之星照上升——二相位任一皆缓和其害，或竟全消（视害月之星之布置，只要其非自角/上升落陷、非落陷）。Zael 谓害月之凶星若自上升落陷或逆行，只令问者恐惧。然 Bonatti 恒最惧月亮受碍——几乎未见过月亮受碍而事有好终：战事则忧问者之安危，贸易则忧困顿、争吵、途中愁苦、破财。
rules.notes: Zael：落陷/逆行凶星只致恐；Bonatti 经验：月碍无好终

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮分离/趋合四组合（吉凶）
rules.result: 凶→吉=坏已过；吉→凶=始善终恶；吉→吉=善终；凶→凶=丑终
rules.original_text: The 76th is to consider, From what Planet the Moon separates, and which she is joined to; he whom she separates from signifies what hath been, the other what is to come, as we have said. And therefore, if she separates from an Infortune, and applies to a Fortune, the worst is past; and what hitherto has been had, will end happily to the Querent's content. But if she separates from a Fortune, and goes to an Infortune, understand the contrary; the thing was good in the beginning, but proves naught in the end. If from a Fortune to a Fortune, is was and is good, and will have a laudable end. If from an Infortune to an Infortune, it will be an ugly conclusion.
rules.translation: 第七十六考量：月亮自何星分离、向何星趋合——分离星示过去，趋合星示未来。凶→吉：最坏已过，所历之害将幸福收场，问者满意。吉→凶：反是——事始善终恶。吉→吉：始终皆善，终局可赞。凶→凶：丑陋结局。
rules.notes: 月亮转换判定表（4组合）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 77th is to consider, Whether the Lord of the Ascendant or Moon be in Opposition, that is, whether the Moon be in Capricorn, Mercury in Sagittarius or Pisces, or Venus in Scorpio or Aries, the Sun in Aquarius, Mars in Taurus or Libra, Jupiter in Gemini or Virgo, Saturn in Cancer or Leo; for then such Lords of the Question abhor the business; nor does he love it should be accomplished, but is rather against it.
rules.translation: 第七十七考量：上升主星或月亮是否在其落陷（与庙相对）：月亮在摩羯、水星在射手/双鱼、金星在天蝎/牡羊、太阳在水瓶、火星在金牛/天秤、木星在双子/处女、土星在巨蟹/狮子——则问事之主厌恶其事，不乐其成，反而反对之。
rules.notes: 各星落陷表（与庙对冲）：月摩羯、水射手/双鱼、金天蝎/牡羊、日水瓶、火金牛/天秤、木双子/处女、土巨蟹/狮子

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 第1=人、2=财、3=兄弟…（宫位含义表）
rules.original_text: The 78th is to consider, The House that signifies the thing whereof the Question is asked. For the First signifies the Person, the second, substance, the third, brethren, etc., as we have before taught, and as it shall appear, so judge; having duly pondered all circumstances.
rules.translation: 第七十八考量：定所问之事所属之宫——第1宫为人、第2宫为财物、第3宫为兄弟等，按各宫所征而判，须细思一切情形。
rules.notes: 宫位含义索引

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星/月亮合相或相位吉凶星
rules.result: 与日实体合相为最大不幸
rules.original_text: The 79th is to consider, Whether the Significator, or Moon, be joined to good or ill planets, by Conjunction or by Aspect, which is diligently to be heeded and distinguished; for a corporal conjunction with the Sun is the greatest misfortune can befall a Planet.
rules.translation: 第七十九考量：征象星或月亮与吉凶星合相或相位——须仔细分辨；与太阳之实体合相（灼伤）是行星所能遭之最大不幸。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在己庙之第2/3/4…星座
rules.result: 按该位置所征判（如宫内位置同理）
rules.original_text: The 80th is to consider, How the Significator is posited in respect of his own House, whether in the second, third, or fourth, etc., sign, from it, according to the Signification of that sign shalt thou judge, as thou wouldest judge of any Planet in such an House from the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 第八十考量：征象星相对其己庙之位置——在其庙起第2、3、4等星座，即按该星座所征而判，如同按该星在自上升起之相应宫位而判。
rules.notes: 从庙计宫位=从上升计宫位的对应判断

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在角/续/果宫及其距尖轴远近
rules.result: 近角尖强、近果尖弱（强度梯度）
rules.original_text: The 81st is to consider, Whether the Significator be in an Angle or in a Succeedent or Cadent House? For how much any Planet is near to the cusp of any Angle so much is he the stronger: how much farther so much the weaker; and by how much sooner he shall be nearer the cusp of a Cadent House, so much shall he be the weaker; how much the farther, so much the less weak.
rules.translation: 第八十一考量：征象星在角/续/果宫。行星越近角宫尖轴越强，越远越弱；越近果宫尖轴越弱，越远（离角）越不弱。
rules.notes: 宫位力量梯度核心规则

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星自吉星/凶星接收德性
rules.result: 自吉星吉（状态佳更吉）；自凶星凶（越弱越凶）
