rules.original_text: The 82nd is to consider, Whether the Significator receive disposition or virtue from any Planet, Fortune or Infortune. If from a Fortune it signifies good; and the better if such Fortune be in a good condition. If from an Infortune, to the contrary; and so much the worse by how much the more weak and afflicted he is.
rules.translation: 第八十二考量：征象星自何星（吉凶）接收德性。自吉星——吉；吉星状态佳则更吉。自凶星——反是；凶星越弱越受碍则越凶。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 83rd is to consider, Whether the Fortunes and Infortunes are equally strong in the Question: for that signifies no positive judgment, either good or ill; but a kind of indifferency, and that the business will bring neither gain or loss.
rules.translation: 第八十三考量：吉凶星力量相等——不能下吉凶之确判，只示一种无差别；事无所得亦无所失。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 吉凶皆强，吉星胜/凶星胜
rules.original_text: The 84th is to consider, Whether the Fortunes or Infortunes are strongest; for if both be strong, and the Fortunes prevail in strength, it signifies a kind of mediocrity of good; if the Infortunes in such a case are strongest, a mediocrity of evil not in excess on either side.
rules.translation: 第八十四考量：吉凶星孰强。双方皆强而吉星胜——示中平之吉；凶星胜——中平之凶，不过度。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 幸运点之落点、相位、接纳
rules.result: 幸运点吉地增吉/劣地减吉（吉凶皆被幸运点修正）
rules.original_text: The 85th is to consider, Whether the Part of Fortune fall in a good or bad place of the Figure; that is in an Angles, or in a Succeedent or in a Cadent House; and how the same is aspected, and by whom, a Fortune or an Infortune? And whether it be in reception of that Planet by whom it is aspected? For questions may sometimes seem good but the Part of Fortune happening in an untoward Place, weakens it much and renders it less profitable so as to deceive the Querent's hopes. And on the contrary a question may seem ill, yet the Part of Fortune happening luckily, joined with a good Planet that receives it, etc., lessens the evil.
rules.translation: 第八十五考量：幸运点（Part of Fortune）落在图中吉/凶之地（角/续/果），何星以何相位照之（吉星/凶星），是否被照星接纳。问盘有时看似吉而幸运点落劣地——大弱其吉、减其利、使问者之望落空。反之问盘看似凶而幸运点逢吉地、与接纳之吉星相合——减其凶，问者之害不如盘示之甚。
rules.notes: 幸运点校正判语；Wilson 等不重本命幸运点，卜卦则重

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 凶星逆行+落陷+游走+异类星座照征象星
rules.result: 绝对之祸不可避（唯神能挡）
rules.original_text: The 86th is to consider, Whether either of the Infortunes behold the Significator both Retrograde, Cadent, Peregrine, and in signs contrary to their respective natures? For then they bring such an absolute mischief as cannot be avoided, nor averted by anything but God alone. And if any shall be born under such positions, he will always be a beggar, let him do what he can; or if any House be built then, no man shall ever live happily, or get money in it; but by losses and crosses his estates and goods shall moulder away, and come to nothing; and his most probable designs strangely frustrated and destroyed, unless the Divine Goodness in mercy interpose.
rules.translation: 第八十六考量：凶星照征象星且同时逆行、落陷、游走、在与其性相违之星座——则带来绝对之祸，无可避，唯上帝能挡。生于此布置者永为乞丐，无论何所为；其时建屋无人能安居获利；其产业财物因损失与挫折而消蚀殆尽；其最有望之谋略被奇异破坏，除非神恩怜悯干预。
rules.notes: 绝对凶象组合

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 87th is to consider, Novenarium Lunae, which is a thing much to be heeded, for it often hinders the Astrologer from discovering the truth, and leads him into error, not knowing the cause that makes him deceive.
rules.translation: 第八十七考量：月亮的九分位（Novenarium Lunae）——须极留意，常使占星家不得真相而入歧途，而不知其所以受欺之因。
rules.notes: Novenarium=月亮九分盘（每9°划分星座）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮分离/合相/将合三层次（相距51分内）
rules.result: 过去/现在/未来三层征象
rules.original_text: The 88th is to Consider, The Planet from whom not only the Moon separates, how he is disposed, etc., but the next to whom she is joined, so that there be not above 51 minutes distance between them, the first signifying what is past, the second what is now present, as we have already said, and also look to whom she will next be joined after separation from him with whom she is at present; for he will signify (according as he is disposed) the issue, or what is to come.
rules.translation: 第八十八考量：月亮自何星分离（其布置如何）及所合之星（相距不超过51分）——分离星示过去、所合星示当下；再看其自当下之星分离后下一合星——依其布置示结局与未来。
rules.notes: 51分合相阈值

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 89th is to consider, The Duodenariam Lunae, a thing that is observable in many cases, even more than divers things that we have said; for there is greatest danger of mistakes in abstruse considerations, and such as Astrologers, rather through sloth than ignorance, do not regard.
rules.translation: 第八十九考量：月亮的十二分位（Duodenarium Lunae）——许多情形下其可观察性更甚于前述诸事；玄奥之虑最易出错，占星家多因懈怠而非无知而不察。
rules.notes: Duodenarium=每星座分12份（每2.5°）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 日宫主/月宫主/升主皆东出、在角、友善互照
rules.original_text: The 90th is to consider, Whether the Lord of the House in which the Sun is, and of that wherein the Moon is, and also the Lord of the Ascendant be all oriental and in Angles (though that rarely happens), and mutually behold each other from good places with friendly Aspect; for these positions shall signify the greatest good, and most superlative future imaginable. If they shall not be all so disposed the remaining part shall signify prosperity and felicity proportionally as far as they are able.
rules.translation: 第九十考量：太阳所在宫之主、月亮所在宫之主、上升主星三者皆东出且在角宫（罕见），且自吉处以友善相位互照——则兆最大之吉、可想象之至高未来。若非全然如此，则依其能力成比例地示兴旺与幸福。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 火星在角宫（固定星座）/天蝎上升；木星三六分照
rules.result: 毁吉；木星三六分则缓和
rules.original_text: The 91st consideration is, To observe in Questions or Nativities, whether Mars be in any of the Angles of the Figure, especially in Fixed Signs; or when Scorpio Ascends, for then he destroys all the good signified by that question, or at least much impedes and diminishes it; Unless Jupiter behold him with a Trine or Sextile; for then his malice is mitigated; but yet as Jupiter is either strong or weak.
rules.translation: 第九十一考量：火星在图中角宫（尤在固定星座），或天蝎上升——则毁去问盘所示之一切吉，或至少大碍大减；除非木星以三分/六分照之——则其恶被缓和，视木星之强弱而定。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 8宫主/死征象星与命主/问者征象星互趋合
rules.original_text: The 92nd is to observe in Nativities and Questions especially of death, whether the Lord of the House of Death, or Significator of Death, or Lord of the House in which the Lord of the Eighth is posited, applies to the Significator of the Native or Querent, or he to them; because a Planet so affected becomes the destroyer of Life, and kills as well if it be a Fortune as an Infortune, and that whether there be a Reception or not.
rules.translation: 第九十二考量：本命与问盘中（尤问死事）：死亡宫（第8宫）之主、或死亡征象星、或8宫主所在宫之主，向命主/问者之征象星趋合，或反之——如此受动之星成为夺命者，无论吉凶星皆可杀人，有无接纳皆然。
rules.notes: 死亡征象星判定核心

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星照/合土星；土星在事宫
rules.original_text: The 93rd is to consider, If the Question concerns a thing that one would desire of another, or that one would get out of a secret hidden place, whether the Significator of the Querent, or thing inquired after, behold Saturn or is corporally joined to him; or whether Saturn be in the house of the thing inquired after? For then the business will hardly be done, or not without much labour and trouble, and more tediousness than the Querent can imagine.
rules.translation: 第九十三考量：所问之事系求于他人或出于隐秘之处——若问者或事之征象星照土星或与之实体相合，或土星在事之宫——则事几乎不成，或须多劳苦烦难，其周折超问者所料。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星/事宫行星落陷或逆行或与日恶
rules.result: 事受阻，即使盘其余良好
rules.original_text: The 94th is to consider, In Questions, etc. whether the Significator of the thing inquired about be Cadent from the Ascendant, or other Angles, or from the house that signifies the thing or business sought after, or its Lord? Or whether he be Retrograde, or in a bad condition with the Sun; or whether there be in the said house, signifying the thing inquired after, a Planet Cadent, or Retrograde, or in such ill condition with the Sun, or in an ill place from him, or ill aspected by him; for any of these things signify a hindrance to the thing, although otherwise the Question seems good and probable.
rules.translation: 第九十四考量：所问事之征象星是否自上升/他角/事宫或其主落陷；或逆行；或与太阳关系恶劣；或事宫中有行星落陷/逆行/与日关系恶劣/在日之劣位/被日恶照——任一皆为事之阻碍，即使问盘其余看似良好有望。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星彼此相合；相合星座合/不合其性
rules.result: 相合=事成；星座合性易、不合性难
rules.original_text: The 95th is Whether the Planets signifying the thing sought, join mutually with each other; for that signifies it will be done; yet, be not too confident to judge so, till thou hast well weighed the nature of the sign wherein they are joined, whether it be of their own nature; for then it will be easy, otherwise difficulty; or scarce at all.
rules.translation: 第九十五考量：征象所问之事之诸星是否彼此相合——相合示事将成；但勿轻断，须先细察相合之星座是否与其本性相合——本性相合则易成，否则难成或几乎不成。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星与月亮距角25°内/外
rules.result: 皆在25°内=事成；皆远离=不成；行程例外
rules.original_text: The 96th is to consider in Questions which seem to show, that what is enquired after shall be perfected, whether the Significator of the thing, and the Moon are in Angles; for if they both be above 25 degrees from Angles, it will not be accomplished; but if one shall and the other shall not be so far off, then it may be done but with difficulty, unless it be a journey; which will speed well enough if the significator be remote from Angles.
rules.translation: 第九十六考量：问盘看似所问将成——看事之征象星与月亮是否在角宫。二者皆离角25°以上——不成；一在角一不在——可成但难（行程除外——征象星远离角反而顺利）。
rules.notes: 25°角宫有效半径

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 判断随地理出没度数而异
rules.original_text: The 97th is to consider, In what climate thou receivest the Question; for judgment must be varied as the ascensions of countries and climates differ, there being not the order in the ascensions or elevations of signs, in one climate as in another, nor the same Ascendant in one region as in another.
rules.translation: 第九十七考量：在何气候/地区接盘——判断须随各地之出没度数（ascensions）而变：各气候/地区之星座升落顺序不同，上升亦异。行经东西南北诸地上升度随之而变。Lilly 注：须备各地海拔/出没表，气候间之差较地区间更难推。
rules.notes: 地理/气候对上升与判断之影响

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 合相/相位=直接成事；传递=经中介
rules.result: 成事方式由征象形式决定
rules.original_text: The 98th is to observe, Whether if what appears by the sign likely to be effected, be signified by the planets by corporal conjunction, or aspect or translation of Light? If by either of the two first the thing will be effected by the Querent, and the party enquired of, without any third person intermeddling; but if by the last it shall be done by ambassadors, friends, or some person interposing himself; and it shall be brought to pass by a person or thing signified by that House whose Lords translate the lights as aforesaid. Thus if it be the Lord of the second, it will be done by expenses, or a piece of money; and if by the third, by some brother or the like; if by the fourth, by the Father, etc., according to the respective signification of each House.
rules.translation: 第九十八考量：所问事之成，系以实体合相、相位、或传递之光示之？前二者——事由问者与被问者直接完成，无第三方介入；传递之光——经由中间人（使者/友人/居间者），且由传递之光之主星所在宫所征之人/物促成：2宫主则费财、3宫主则兄弟、4宫主则父，依各宫所征。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 恒星与征象星之合相（吉/凶性）
rules.result: 吉性恒星助成事、凶性恒星毁事
rules.original_text: The 99th is to consider well In Questions, Nativities, etc., what will certainly come of them; for sometimes by the Figure, a thing seems likely to be absolutely done; but is not wholly, but in part; sometimes it is wholly perfected, and sometimes neither wholly nor in part.
rules.translation: 第九十九考量：所问事之确定结局。盘有时看似全成，实则只成部分；有时全成；有时全不成。其判据系某些恒星（Coley 注：Bonatti 时代之恒星黄经已前移，须校正）：吉性恒星使行星所征之事得以完成（否则不成）；凶性恒星阻其完成——各星座中皆有，如 Bonatti 时代牡羊首有二凶星（13°45′、14°45′，南纬，土木之性）……（恒星清单见原文）。
rules.notes: 恒星作用核心条；Coley 补：恒星黄经已前移数度须校正；凶性恒星表见原文99条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星与吉性恒星实体合相
rules.original_text: The 100th Consideration is, To observe the Fixed Stars assisting and promoting the accomplishment of things, which are thus situated. In Aries there are two, one in 5°06', of the nature of V and T, another in 26°01' of the nature of V. In Taurus three, one in the l°03', another in 8°07', and the last in 9°0l', all of the nature of T. In Gemini are two stars one in 19°02', the other in 21°08', both of the nature of V and of the second magnitude. In Cancer likewise two, one in 2°02', the other in 29°05', both of the nature of V. In Leo one in 9°04', of the nature of V and T. In Virgo one in 4°07', of the nature of V and R. In Libra two, both of the nature of V and T, one in 13°45', the other in 14°45'. In Scorpio four, one in 9°55', another in 13°01', a third in 14°45', the last in 19°15', all of the nature of V. In Sagittarius two, one in 10°15', the other in 7°55', both of the nature of V. In Capricorn three, one in 2°03', another in 7°55', both of the nature of V. In Pisces two, one in 7°11' of the nature of T, the other in 14°59' of the nature of V. Wherefore always when thou findest the signification in a corporal conjunction with any of these, thou mayst pronounce happiness and a good end.
rules.notes: 助成恒星表（17世纪位置，今已前移须校正）；原文V/T缩写之行星对应存疑已标注

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 夺命星=尊贵最强者；升主/月亮所合之星劣态
rules.original_text: The 101st Consideration is, To mark in Nativities or Questions, which Planet is the cutter-off of life or years, or hinderer of a thing from being done; for he it is who destroys the life of the Native, etc., who is strongest in testimonies of dignities or power. Yet Messahala concealed this. Now after thou hast found who is this destroyer, etc., then see to whom the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon is joined, or the Lord of the thing enquired after, and Lord of the house of the Moon; for if it be joined to a planet Retrograde or Combust, or cadent from the Ascendant, or any other Angle, or to any of the Infortunes who doth not receive him; or is afflicted by an Infortune, which cuts off the light of the significator: the thing is destroyed, and so the years of the Native are diminished and he lives not long.
rules.translation: 第一百零一考量：断命之星（cutter-off of life）——在尊贵/力量证言中最强者即夺命之星（Messahala 曾秘而不宣）。既得夺命星，看上升主星或月亮、事主星、月宫主所合之星：若合于逆行/灼伤/自上升或他角落陷之星、或不合接纳之凶星、或被凶星害而截断征象星之光——则事毁，命主之年减而寿促。
rules.notes: 夺命星（Anareta）判定：尊贵证言最强者；同旨参见 101 后半

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 问者征象星+事征象星+月亮之合相
rules.result: 相合=事之确定效果；宫主星定事之结局
rules.original_text: The 102nd Consideration is, Of things signified, how they shall be found or known, and from what significator they are to be taken? Which must be from the significators of the querent, and of the thing Questioned or enquired after: which two significators, if they shall be joined together with the Moon it signifies wholly and absolutely the effect of the thing; if not joined, then the contrary. And from the conjunction of the significators we ought to know why, or by what the question is made. And by the Lord of the House in which such conjunction happens, we know of what the question will be, or the end thereof.
rules.translation: 第一百零二考量：所征之事如何知、取自何征象星——取自问者之征象星与所问事之征象星：二者与月亮相合则示事之绝对效果；不相合则反。由征象星之合相知问事之因由；由合相发生之宫主星知问事之内容或其结局（吉星则吉、凶星则凶，依其布置）。若宫/旺/二小尊贵之主投相位或有光之传递，可知事将成就；否则不可确知，事将由未明之因成之。
rules.notes: 判断方法论

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 财运起于该宫所征；布置佳则吉否则凶
rules.original_text: The 103rd Consideration is, To mind in Nativities and general Questions in what House the Part of Fortune happens; for from the things signified by that House will the Fortune or gain of the Native or Querent arise, if the same be well disposed, otherwise the same will be cause of his misfortune and loss.
rules.translation: 第一百零三考量：幸运点所在之宫——命主/问者之财运起于该宫所征之事；该宫布置佳则吉，否则为不幸与损失之由。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星在己庙第7位/冲升主
rules.original_text: The l04th Consideration is, To observe in Nativities and general Questions whether the significator of the Native or Querent be posited in the Seventh from his own House, or in Opposition to the Lord of the Ascendant; for he will not in such case signify gain from the things signified by that House, but rather expense and loss.
rules.translation: 第一百零四考量：命主/问者之征象星在其己庙之第7位（或冲上升主星）——则其不示得该宫所征之利，反示耗费与损失。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The l05th Consideration is, To observe in Nativities or general Questions, whether that an Infortune, unfortunate be in the Seventh? for that signifies that the Native or Querent shall not live in peace or any delight with his wives, sweethearts, or companions, but will perpetually have brawls and quarrels with them: it seldom happens otherwise from such a position.
rules.translation: 第一百零五考量：凶星受碍居第7宫——命主/问者与妻、恋人、伴侣永无宁日与欢愉，恒有争吵口角；此象罕有例外。
rules.notes: 未婚则影响公开敌人/合伙人（编者注）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 得佳偶；多嫉妒之敌、事业多劳
rules.original_text: The l06th Consideration is, To consider in Nativities and general Questions, it a Fortune fortunate, and in no way afflicted be in the Seventh? for then the Native or Querent shall be happy in good wives and associates, yet shall have many rivals and persons that hate him, but rather out of envy than cause, so that he shall seldom bring his enterprises and designs to pass, without much labour and trouble.
rules.translation: 第一百零六考量：吉星吉且无碍居第7宫——命主/问者得佳妻良伴之福；然多情敌与恨之者（出于嫉妒多于实因），以致其事业谋略鲜少不劳苦而就。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 火星在2/10宫：佳=得财/弱=损失
rules.result: 铁火餐饮之业得财或受损
rules.original_text: The 107th is, To consider in Nativities and general Questions, whether Mars be in the 2nd or in the 10th, and well disposed; for it denotes that the Native or Querent shall gain a Fortune or Estate by those persons that deal or work in Iron and Fire, as Smiths, Furnacemen, Glassmen, etc.: or in Victualling or keeping Inns, Taverns, etc.: but if Mars be weak or afflicted, loss and damage from all those.
rules.translation: 第一百零七考量：火星在第2或第10宫且布置佳——命主/问者由铁与火之业者（铁匠、炉工、玻璃工等）或酒食客栈业得财；火星弱或受碍——由此等皆受损失。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 108th is, To consider, If neither of the Planets beholds two Houses? For his virtue and fortitude shall be in that wherein he hath most dignities, and which is most proper for him, and the thing he signifies.
rules.translation: 第一百零八考量：若一行星同照二宫——其力与德性归于其尊贵最多、最适宜、最合其所征之宫。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 109th is, To consider whether the Lord of the Fifth be in the Seventh afflicted? For then the Native will never be happy at Feasts or Banquets; either be averse from or slighted at such meetings, or some affront put upon him; nor will he ever go neat in his clothes, nor get any credit by them.
rules.translation: 第一百零九考量：第5宫主受碍居第7宫——命主于宴饮游乐永不得乐：或厌此聚、或受轻慢、或受辱；衣着亦不整洁、不得其誉。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 110th is, To consider in Nativities, whether Scorpio ascends? for such a Native is never like to get any great preferment in the Roman Church: because Cancer (the Exaltation of Jupiter, natural significator of Clerks (priests, parsons, etc.)), will then be in the 9th House, which signifies the Church, and Jupiter is an enemy to Mars, who is Lord of the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 第一百一十考量：天蝎上升（本命）——其人永难得罗马教会之大升迁：因巨蟹（木星之旺、教士之天然征象星）此时居第9宫（教会之宫），而木星与上升主星火星为敌。
rules.notes: 时代性规则（罗马教会语境），现代用法已变

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 按宫位损害对方/他人（对命主反利）
rules.original_text: The 111th is, To consider in Nativities and Questions especially of Lawsuits and controversies, whether the Dragon's Tail be in the Seventh? For that signifies damage or overthrow to the Native's enemies and prosperity to the Native or Querent, because the Dragon's Head will then be in the Ascendant. If it be in the 8th it denotes the decay and loss of their estate or substances, and increase of the Native's. In the third, prejudice to the Native's Brethren. In the fourth, to his Parents. In the fifth, to his children. In the sixth, to his servants. In the ninth, to his journeys. In the tenth, to his preferment. In the eleventh, to his Friends. In the twelfth, to his cattle of the greatest sort, etc. And so to all other things signified by each House respectively: so do Saturn and Mars also, but not so much.
rules.translation: 第一百一十一考量：龙尾在第7宫（尤问讼争）——示敌方受损、命主/问者得利（因龙头在上升）。龙尾在8宫——敌人/对方财货衰败，命主财增；在3宫害其兄弟；4宫害父母；5宫害子女；6宫害仆役；9宫害行程；10宫害升迁；11宫害友人；12宫害大牲畜。土星火星亦同此效但不如此之甚。
rules.notes: 龙尾损害表（各宫）；编者注：作者漏8宫，现代占星家多不重龙头龙尾

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 处女升+水星佳=医成而酬薄；射手金牛双鱼升+木金水在升或cazimi=先知
rules.original_text: The 112th is strictly to examine and regard in every Nativity or Question, the Ascendant; for whosoever shall have Virgo ascend and Mercury in good condition, or at least not afflicted; if he study and practice Physic he shall have success and do great cures, but shall be unhappy in his salary or profit thereby; not being able to get his fees of most of his Patients; and besides, shall be unhappy in Lawsuits. But if he follow the Law, he shall be unfortunate in all his business. But far otherwise will it be if Sagittarius, Taurus, or Pisces ascend and Jupiter, Venus and Mercury, shall be in the Ascendant, or if Jupiter and Venus shall happen to be in Zaminium, or the heart of the Sun, whatever the Ascendant be the native shall be admired as a Prophet, and all his words received as Oracles, or the dictates of destiny.
rules.translation: 第一百一十二考量：细察上升。处女上升而水星状态佳（或至少无碍）——习医行医则成功、愈大病，然其报酬不佳（多数病人不给诊金），且讼事不顺；习法则诸事不利。射手/金牛/双鱼上升而木星、金星、水星在上升，或木金在日心（cazimi）——无论何上升，其人被崇为先知，其言被奉为神谕。
rules.notes: 上升与职业/声望规则

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 凶=无故被责难；吉=无故被尊崇
rules.original_text: The 113th Is To consider, Whether either of the Infortunes be in the 9th House, and without Dignity? for then the Native or Querent shall be often blamed and accused, and that without cause, as much as for one, But if a Fortune be there well affected (especially having Dignity there) he shall on the other side be praised, applauded, and honoured, whether there be cause or reason for it or no.
rules.translation: 第一百一十三考量：凶星在9宫而无尊贵——命主/问者常被无故责难控告；吉星在9宫且状态佳（尤有尊贵）——反被称赞、喝彩、尊崇，无论有无实因。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 吉=得亡者敌妻之财；凶=损财
rules.original_text: The 114th Is To consider, Whether the Lord of the Eighth be a Fortune, and in the Second? for then the Native or Querent shall gain considerably by the goods of people deceased, of his enemies, and by his wives, especially if such planet shall be free from Impediment or have Dignities there. But if an Infortune be there, it signifies loss and decay of the Native's estate, unless he have dignities there and be otherwise well affected, and in good condition.
rules.translation: 第一百一十四考量：8宫主为吉星且在第2宫——命主/问者由亡者之财、敌人、妻室得大利（尤当该星无碍或在此有尊贵）。凶星在——损失与衰败，除非有尊贵且状态良好。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 115th is To consider, Whether the Eighth House, or its Lord be afflicted? For then shall the Querent or Native be damnified, and lose an estate by the death of a wife, which she enjoyed for life or the like.
rules.translation: 第一百一十五考量：8宫或其主受碍——问者/命主因妻之死（其终身享有之产等）而受损失产。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 该宫所征之事受损/得利
rules.original_text: The 116th is, To consider which of the Houses, or their Lords are afflicted, or under impediment? For that signifies that hurt and damage will accrue to the Native, by reason of the things signified by that House: and so on the contrary, if they are Fortunes, good and advantage from the same things.
rules.translation: 第一百一十六考量：何宫或其主受碍——命主在该宫所征之事上受损；反之若为吉星，则于该宫所征之事得利。
rules.notes: 宫位受损通则

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 所得皆挥霍成空；龙尾所居宫示损
rules.original_text: The 117th is to consider, If the Dragon's Tail be in the Fourth; for that signifies, that whatever the Native or Querent shall get shall be squandered away, and come to nothing; and wherever it is, it signifies damage to the Native in and from that House represented.
rules.translation: 第一百一十七考量：龙尾在第4宫——命主/问者所得一切将被挥霍殆尽、归于无；龙尾在任何宫，皆示命主在该宫所征之事上受损。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 118th is, to consider in what House a Fortune shall be fortunate and strong, well disposed, and not afflicted; for in and by these persons or things by that House signified, shall the Native or Querent gain profit, and make his fortune; and so on the contrary of a House that is afflicted.
rules.translation: 第一百一十八考量：吉星吉而强、布置佳、无碍所在之宫——命主/问者由此宫所征之人/事获利发财；反之宫受碍则反。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 119th is to consider, If the Lord of the second be in the seventh, and the Seventh be in Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn or Aquarius; for then the Native's enemies shall easily take away his goods and right: and if he associate himself with persons, they shall rob him: and his wife or mistress shall cheat him, and steal whatever she can from him: unless the Lord of the Ascendant be in Trine or Sextile to the Lord of the Seventh, or in other Aspects with reception.
rules.translation: 第一百一十九考量：2宫主在第7宫且7宫为牡羊/天蝎/摩羯/水瓶——敌方轻易夺其货与其权；交游之人劫其财；妻妾欺之、尽其所能窃之；除非升主与7宫主成三分/六分或其他带接纳之相位。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 其所征之人为敌（3兄弟/4父母/5子女…）
rules.original_text: The 120th Consideration, is to observe whether the Lords of any of these Eight Houses, viz., the 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 9th, 10th, 11th, or 12th, be in the 7th? for which soever of them is there, the person by him signified will prove the Native's enemy, unless a perfect reception, with some good aspect as Trine or Sextile intervene. Yet a Square or Opposition with Reception will abate the enmity, but not wholly prevent it. Thus if it be the Lord of the 3rd, his Brethren will prove his enemies; if of the 4th, his Parents; if of the 5th, his Children, etc.
rules.translation: 第一百二十考量：3/4/5/6/9/10/11/12八宫之主是否在第7宫——在者，其所征之人将成为命主之敌；除非有完全接纳并伴好相位（三分/六分）。四分/冲带接纳亦减其敌意，但不全消。3宫主在则兄弟为敌、4宫主则父母、5宫主则子女等。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮在8宫+升主在1/2/12宫逆行
rules.original_text: The 121st is, Whether the Moon be in the 8th and the Lord of the Ascendant in the Ascendant; 2nd, or 12th, Retrograde? For then the Native or Querent will not be Fortunate, nor have any luck at playing at dice or any other gaming.
rules.translation: 第一百二十一考量：月亮在8宫且上升主星在上升/2/12宫而逆行——命主/问者不吉，掷骰或一切赌博皆无好运。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 幸运点在4宫各10°+龙头/月/金/木及其顺逆+照星
rules.result: 按组合断藏宝之寻获与吉凶
rules.original_text: The 122nd is, Whether the Part of Fortune be in the first 10 degrees of the 4th House, with the Dragon's Head, the Moon, Venus and Jupiter, and they direct? – for that signifies that the Native shall be lucky in discovering and finding out hidden treasure. If it be in the second 10 degrees, or but with two of the said Planets, he shall find some, but not in so great quantity. In the last 10 degrees, and with but one less, and yet a considerable parcel; and if only the Part of Fortune be there not afflicted, then a small quantity. If the Sun behold it with a Trine or Sextile, it will be Gold uncoined; if the Moon, Silver; if Jupiter, a mixture of Gold and Silver; if Venus, precious stones, Lockets, and for the most part Women's Ornaments. But if they be Retrograde, he shall discover the treasure, but not for himself, another shall get the profit. If the Lord of the 8th behold the Lord of the Ascendant with a square or Opposition, the finder shall die by reason of it; but if it be with a Trine or Sextile, he shall only catch some small disease or sickness. If the Dragon's Tail be there instead of the Head, he shall find it, but it shall be taken from him. If Mars or the Lord of the Eighth behold the Lord of the Ascendant, they that take it from him shall kill him. But if Mars and Saturn shall be in the place of Jupiter and Venus, the business will be only brass or copper or lead.
rules.translation: 第一百二十二考量：幸运点在4宫前10°且与龙头、月亮、金星、木星同处且顺行——命主善于发现寻获隐藏之财。在中间10°或只与其中二星——得财但不多；末10°或更少星——仍可观；仅幸运点无碍在——少量。太阳三分/六分照之=未铸之金；月亮=银；木星=金银混合；金星=宝石、饰坠、多为妇女饰品。若诸星逆行——虽发现宝藏，却非为己，他人得利。8宫主四分/冲升主——发现者因此而死；三分/六分则只染小病。龙尾代龙头在——寻得而被夺；火星或8宫主照升主——夺者杀之。若土星火星代木星金星——所获只是黄铜/铜/铅。升主与之相合——发现者被其物所累（无论贵贱）。
rules.notes: 藏宝寻宝专条；8宫主=死亡关联

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 日月合相（经纬同分）+吉星在上升
rules.result: 积大财；距离放宽则递减；凶星代吉则损财
rules.original_text: The 123rd Consideration is, to observe in Nativities or Questions: Whether the Sun and Moon are in Conjunction in one and the same minute, both according to Longitude and Latitude, and any of the Fortunes in the Ascendant that is within 15' above the cusp thereof, or 24' below it; for that signifies that the Native shall be happy in getting a great estate and heaping up of money; but if they be only in exact Conjunction to Longitude, and not according to Latitude, and their distance one from the other be within 15'; he will still be fortunate in acquiring substance; but so much the less, by how much the further such distance is and so proportionately. If they happen to be above 15' distance, the same thou mayst conclude if the Moon shall be ill the very minute of Opposition to the Sun, and a Fortune be in the seventh. And if at that time of birth Taurus ascend, and the Moon be there, or the very minute ascending, or Leo ascending, and the Sun in the minute ascending, and not afflicted by if either of the Infortunes, it signifies that the Native shall get much money, and come to great preferment and honour; but either of the Infortunes be in the said places instead of the Fortune, it denotes loss and destruction of estate.
rules.translation: 第一百二十三考量：日月同分合相（黄经与黄纬皆同），且有吉星在上升（尖上15′内或下24′内）——命主善积大财。仅黄经合相（纬不同）且相距15′内——仍财运佳，距越远则递减。距>15′，或月亮恰在冲日之刻且吉星在第7宫——同此断。生时金牛升且月亮在上升（或恰升之刻）、或狮子升且太阳恰升，且无凶星之害——命主多得财、得大升迁与尊荣；凶星代吉星居此等位——损失与财毁。
rules.notes: 日月合相与财运

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 10宫主/时光之/恒星组合（60-90°/30°+角宫+无碍）
rules.result: 达祖辈之尊、有吉恒星则远超；高位不逾27/30年且坠亡
rules.original_text: The 124th Consideration is, to regard in Nativities and Questions, the Significators of the Querent's and Native's estate and also of his preferment, calling or profession; which thou mayest take to be the Lord of the Tenth, or of the Ascendant, if the other shall not be fit to signify the same; for if the Lord or Almuten of the 10th, be with the Light of Time or erect and tall from it, and distant 60 degrees or upwards even to 90 degrees: if it be one of the Superiors, or 30 degrees if it be one of the Inferiors, and in the Angle of the Tenth, or in the Ascendant within 30 minutes above the cusp, or a degree and a half below it, and not afflicted; it signifies that the Native shall attain to the Dignity and profession of his Ancestors, and not exceed it, yet shall be more skilful, excellent, and perfect therein than any of them; but if there be in either of the said Angles any of the aforesaid helping and fortunate Fixed Stars with the Planet of Fortune or any of the Planets, he will far surpass his forefathers in dignity. And if such Fixed Stars shall be of the first Magnitude and sole Significators, the Native or Querent shall be raised to vast honours and riches, almost inestimable: which if beheld by the Lord of the Ascendant, then his fame and honour lies in his own person; if by the Lord of the 2nd, in his riches; if by the Lord of the 10th in his offices, command, or empire; and this though in never so poor and vile people; the meaner their condition was, to so much the greater height shall they arrive. But this shall not endure long, for they seldom go beyond 27 or 30 years. And look, how much the more sublime was their fortune, by so much the more grievous, miserable, and calamitous shall be their fall: for they shall die an ignoble filthy death, or if they escape it, the same shall happen to their next successor.
rules.translation: 第一百二十四考量：命主/问者之财运、升迁、职业征象星——取10宫主或升主（若彼不适任）。10宫主或 Almuten 与时光之（Light of Time）同处或高大直立，距其60°至90°（外行星）或30°（内行星），在10宫角或上升尖上30′内下1.5°内，且无碍——命主达祖辈之尊位与职业而不越之，然技艺超其先辈。若角宫中有助成之吉性恒星与吉星或任何行星同在——远超先祖之尊。恒星一等且为独征象星——升至浩瀚之荣与财、几不可估：被升主照则名荣在身；被2宫主照在财；被10宫主照在官职/统御/帝国——纵出身最贱者亦然，其境愈卑其升愈高。然此不长久——罕过27/30年。其运愈高其落愈惨：死于卑贱污秽之死，或逃之则及于其嗣。
rules.notes: 声望职业判定核心条；Almuten=尊贵最强星

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 上升星座=双庙行星之另一庙所在宫
rules.result: 按上升断历练之所（死亡/疾病/被擒/财/权/敌等）
rules.original_text: The l25th Consideration, is to observe in Nativities or Questions what sign ascends: if it be the sign of a Planet that hath two Houses, the exercise or troubles of the Native or Querent shall be chiefly in those things signified by the other House of the said Planet, which shall lightly happen to him and for the most part through his own means. As if the Ascendant be in Aries, he shall be exercised in those things as shall be in the cause of his own death or fall because Scorpio the other House of Mars will be then in the Eighth House: but if Mars be well disposed and the Part of Fortune happen in the Eighth he shall be very fortunate in all things signified by that House. If Taurus ascend he shall be exercised in those things as shall cause his own weakness, because Libra which is the other House of Venus will be then the Sixth House. But if Venus be well disposed, and Part of Fortune in the Sixth, he shall be most lucky in things appertaining to the Sixth House. If the Ascendant be in Gemini he shall be exercised in such things as shall occasion his being taken; because Virgo, Mercury's other House, will be on the fourth; but if Mercury be well disposed and Part of Fortune in the fourth, he will be prosperous in things belonging to the Fourth House. If Virgo ascend, he will be exercised in things that will gain him honour and power, because Gemini, Mercury's other House, is in the tenth. If Mercury be then in Conjunction with the Part of Fortune and in the Ascendant, he shall acquire as it were a king's revenue. But if Mercury be in the tenth with the Part of Empire, fortunate and strong, he shall undoubtedly obtain a Kingdom or supreme command; and if this Part of Fortune and the Moon be also in the Tenth, he will be a mighty Prince infallibly. If Libra ascend, he shall be exercised in things that shall hasten his own death, because Taurus the other House of Venus will be then in the Eighth. But if Venus be well disposed and the Part of Fortune in the Eighth he will be lucky in things represented by the Eighth House. Scorpio ascending the Native or Querent shall bring diseases on himself because Aries is the sixth. Sagittarius ascending, he shall fool himself into captivity because Pisces is on the Fourth. Capricorn ascending, he shall gain much by his industry, for Aquarius is then on the Second House. But if Saturn be ill disposed he shall squander away and waste his own substance idly. If Aquarius ascend he shall procure himself many secret enemies. Because Capricorn will be then in the Twelfth House. If Pisces ascend, he shall raise himself to honour.
rules.translation: 第一百二十五考量：观上升为何星座。若上升为双庙行星之星座，其人之历练/烦恼主要在该行星另一庙之宫所征之事（多由其自身所致）。牡羊升——历练于致其死/坠之事（火星另一庙天蝎居8宫）；火星佳且幸运点在8宫则8宫之事皆大吉。金牛升——历练于致其弱之事（金星另一庙天秤居6宫）；金星佳且幸运点在6宫则6宫之事大吉。双子升——历练于致其被擒之事（水星另一庙处女居4宫）；水星佳且幸运点在4宫则4宫之事吉。处女升——历练于获荣权之事（水星另一庙双子居10宫）；水星与幸运点合于上升则如获王者之入；水星在10宫与幸运点（Part of Empire）吉而强——必得王国或至尊之权；幸运点与月亮同在10宫——必成强君。天秤升——历练于促其死之事（金星另一庙金牛居8宫）；金星佳且幸运点在8宫则8宫之事吉。天蝎升——自招疾病（牡羊为6宫）。射手升——自愚而入俘（双鱼居4宫）。摩羯升——以勤勉得大利（水瓶居2宫）；土星布置恶则挥霍其资。水瓶升——多结暗敌（摩羯居12宫）。双鱼升——自跻于荣。
rules.notes: 上升与双庙行星规则（12星座全列）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 水星吉强在摩羯/水瓶（或牡羊/天蝎）
rules.result: 摩羯水瓶=深邃之智；牡羊天蝎=狡捷骄慢
rules.original_text: The 126th consideration is, to take notice in Nativities and Questions, whether Mercury be significator wholly or in part, fortunate and strong and in Capricorn or Aquarius? For then the Native shall be of profound and piercing wit, and great understanding; one that shall dive into the bottom of things, and see from the beginning what the issue will be; and so much the more if Saturn fortunate shall behold Mercury with a good aspect, especially if Mercury be in Aquarius, which is the delight of Saturn; and still more if a Fortune shall be with Mercury, and he with one of the propitious Fixed Stars. But if Mercury be in Aries or Scorpio, the Native will be bold, Perfidious, inconstant, arrogant, and yet quick of apprehension; rather nimble to repeat or find out things said by others than invent them himself.
rules.translation: 第一百二十六考量：水星为征象星（全部或部分）而吉而强，且在摩羯/水瓶——命主有深邃锐利之智、大悟性，能洞悉事物底蕴、初见即知其终；若吉土星以好相位照之更甚（尤水星在水瓶——土星之乐）；吉星与水星同处、且水星与吉性恒星相合则更甚。水星在牡羊/天蝎——命主大胆、背信、反复、骄慢而敏捷；善复述发掘他人之言而非自创。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 土/火为升主且独主命盘
rules.result: 味觉体质异于常人（土喜酸寡味/火喜辛臭秽）
rules.original_text: The 127th Consideration is, to observe in Nativities, if the Lord of the Ascendant be Saturn or Mars, and sole Lord of the Nativity, without any Fortune partaking in the dominion, the taste or smelling of the native or his complexion shall not be like those of other men, for if it be Saturn he shall delight in sour or insipid things, as 'Halion Ptolemy' avers; if it be Mars, in sharp and bitter, flesh half stinking, wine dead, and pallid aloes, snuffs of candles, dung, etc., as also with filthy, dirty, unhandsome women.
rules.translation: 第一百二十七考量：上升主星为土星或火星，且为命盘独主（无吉星参权）——命主之味觉/嗅觉/体质异于常人：土星主——喜酸或寡味之物（Halion Ptolemy 说）；火星主——喜辛辣苦涩、半臭之肉、死气之酒、苍白的芦荟、烛烬、秽物等，亦好污秽不洁丑陋之女。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 上升为人形/役畜/半野/野性星座
rules.result: 按星座形态断性格（合群/谦卑/野性）
rules.original_text: The l28th Consideration is, in Nativities, whether the Ascendant be a human sign or the Lord of it in a human sign? For that signifies the native an honest, sociable, and neighbourly man, more especially if both happen together. But if the Ascendant carry the similitude of some creatures which men use to labour with, as Aries, Taurus, the last part of Sagittarius and Capricorn, the Native is very submissive and humble to men, yet very sociable. But if it be a sign half-feral, as Cancer and Pisces, he will be yet less sociable; but if it be a feral, furious or savage sign, as Leo and Scorpio, he will be of a brutish temper, delighting in the woods, hunting and living upon spoils and rapine; caring not to associate himself with men.
rules.translation: 第一百二十八考量：上升是否人形星座或其主星在人形星座——命主诚实、合群、睦邻（二者同具尤甚）。上升为役畜之形（牡羊、金牛、射手末段、摩羯）——命主对人顺服谦卑而甚合群。半野之星座（巨蟹、双鱼）——更不合群。野性凶残之星座（狮子、天蝎）——性情如兽，喜山林、狩猎、以掠夺为生，不愿与人相处，罕久居父母近亲之侧。
rules.notes: 星座形态性格分类

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月亮冲日+云雾星10分内=眼疾；光体+凶星西没角宫=双盲
rules.result: 眼疾不可救；双盲或单目失明
rules.original_text: The 129th Consideration is, to observe in Nativities, whether the Moon be in Opposition to the Sun, with any of the stars called 'cloudy' which are 'Althazaic', and the 'Head of Gemini,' or in a place called 'The Place of Falling into the Water,' which Aquarius spouts forth, or the drops of the Lion, said to be near his heart, and others which by reason of their mixture with each other do not shine distinctly (nebulous stars). For when the Moon shall not be above 10 minutes' distance from them, according to Longitude and Latitude, it seems unavoidable that the native shall have diseases in his eyes; not to be remedied by any human help or medicine. If the Moon be then Occidental in an Angle and Mars and Saturn likewise Occidental, not far distant from her, or opposing the Sun in any of the Angles: it signifies that the native shall be blind of both eyes at his death. But if it be not of luminaries, but only one, he shall lose but one eye, and if it be Sol and a man the right eye, if a woman the left eye: but if it be the Moon and a man, the left eye; but if a woman, the right eye.
rules.translation: 第一百二十九考量：月亮冲日且与云雾星（nebulous stars，如毕宿、双子之首、水瓶倾水之“落水处”、狮心之滴等，相混不明之光）同在——月亮距其黄经黄纬10分内，命主必患眼疾，人力医药不可救。若月亮西没在角宫，火星土星亦西没、不远离之、或于角宫冲日——命主临终双目皆盲。若二光体中只一与其合——只失一目：日（男右/女左），月（男左/女右）。
rules.notes: 云雾星/眼疾专条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 月水不相合+升非其性+日盘土/夜盘火在角=狂乱；月水合=智全
rules.original_text: The 130th Consideration is, to regard in Nativities whether the Moon be joined with Mercury by Body or Aspect, or there be a translation of light by any planet between them? If there be nothing of this and the sign ascending be neither of the nature of Mercury or the Moon; and Saturn in a diurnal nativity and Mars in a nocturnal, and one be in an Angle, the native will be mad, distracted, troubled with fits, a fool or at least exceedingly forgetful, unless a Fortune very strong shall at the same time behold the Ascendant, Mercury, or the Moon: and so much the worse if the Angle wherein such Infortune is, happen to be Cancer, which is the exaltation of Jupiter, or Virgo the exaltation of Mercury, or Pisces the exaltation of Venus. The reason is because the Moon in Nativities is the general Significatrix of the native's Person; and the Planet with whom she is joined of his faculties and powers; and therefore if she be corporally joined or applying to such Planet, the native will prove of good understanding, and very well retain his senses and intellectuals. And if Mercury be in Capricorn or Aquarius, not afflicted, but in good condition, the native will be of an exceeding wit, and a great Philosopher, and if Jupiter and Venus be in (Zamini Solis) he will prove a Hermit or kind of Prophet, whose words shall be received as Oracles beyond those of other men.
rules.translation: 第一百三十考量：月亮与水星实体/相位相合，或有星传递光于其间？皆无，且上升非水星/月亮之性；又日盘土星、夜盘火星，其一在角宫——命主狂乱、癫痴、惊厥、愚昧或至少极健忘；除非极强吉星同时照上升/水星/月亮。凶星所在角宫为巨蟹（木星旺）、处女（水星旺）、双鱼（金星旺）则更坏。因月亮本命为命主身体之总征象星，其所合之星为其才能智力：故月实体相合或趋合该星——命主悟性佳、感官智识保全。水星在摩羯/水瓶无碍且状态佳——命主极慧、为大哲人；木星金星在日心（Zamini Solis）——成隐士或先知，其言被奉为超越他人之神谕。
rules.notes: 月水关系与心智专条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 日月/金火在阳性/阴性星座、东出/西没之组合
rules.result: 按组合断性别气质与情欲倾向
rules.original_text: The 131st Consideration is, To take notice of the Nativity of a man, whether the Sun and Moon be both in Masculine Signs, or both in one Masculine Quarter or one Masculine Sign; for if so, it signifies that the native's acts and temper shall be naturally such as belong to men. But in a woman's Nativity, the Luminaries so disposed, make a kind of Virago, one that shall despise men, and obtrude herself into their affairs; and such a one, if she marry, will be sure to wear the breeches. If Venus and Mars shall be both in Masculine signs, the native will be moderately affected towards the delights of Venus, and use them according to nature and law; but if they happen to be Oriental, he will be more fallacious and immoderate, inclinable to incest, sodomy, etc. But if they be Occidental and in Feminine Signs, his spirits will be nasty and brutish; and so much the more, if Saturn cast any Aspect to them. But if it be a Woman, and Mars and Venus Oriental and in Masculine Signs, she will abhor men's embraces. But if Mars and Venus be in Feminine Signs and Occidental, she will love and take delight in men's kindness. And Ptolemy in his Centiloquium affirms, That if Venus be joined with Saturn in a Nativity, and have Dignities in the Seventh, the Native shall be somewhat faulty and untoward in his venereal caresses.
rules.translation: 第一百三十一考量：男子本命日、月皆在阳性星座（或同阳性象限/星座）——其行止性情天然属男子。女子本命如此布置——成悍妇（Virago）：轻蔑男子、闯入男事；若嫁人必掌裤权。金星火星皆在阳性星座——对情欲适度、依性依理而行；若东出——更欺诳放纵，倾向乱伦、鸡奸等。西没且在阴性星座——其性污秽粗野；土星投相位更甚。女子本命金火东出在阳性星座——厌恶男子拥抱；金火在阴性星座西没——喜爱男子温存。Ptolemy《百言》谓：金土合于本命且金星在7宫有尊贵——其人情事上有瑕疵、不乖顺。
rules.notes: 性别气质/情欲专条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 火星合Algol16分内+日/旺/尊贵主冲四分+无吉星在升/8宫
rules.result: 斩首；纬度6分内必然；组合变体断各死法
rules.original_text: The 132nd is to mark in Nativities, Whether Mars be corporally joined with a certain Fiery star of his own nature in Taurus, called 'Algol', so that they are not above 16 minutes asunder, Mars applying thereunto and the Lord of the House wherein the Luminary, for the time ruling is pointed, which is called the Lord 'Anaubae'; or of its Exaltation, and two others of its Dignities, and shall be in Opposition or Square of Mars, and neither of the Fortunes shall behold the Ascendant, nor be pointed in the 8th House; it undoubtedly signifies the native shall be beheaded. And if Mars shall not be distant from it in Latitude above 6 minutes, it will infallibly happen so; not to be avoided but by God alone.
rules.translation: 第一百三十二考量：火星与金牛座之火性恒星 Algol（大陵五）实体相合（相距不过16分，火星向其趋合），且当值光体所在宫之主（称 Lord Anaubae）或其旺主及另二尊贵与之成冲/四分——且无吉星照上升、无吉星居8宫——则命主必遭斩首。火星距其黄纬不过6分——必然而不可避，唯神能免。纵吉星逆行或灼伤照上升亦难救：只或非因己罪。无碍吉星或可救其免恶死、得终老于床，然死于热屋之重病、未及五十。火星非此布置，而凶星在8宫——命主横死或死得可耻；吉星在8宫状态佳——善终；吉星受碍——死于意外之灾。Lilly 引 Ptolemy：时光之在天顶（如前述）——命主被绞；二凶星一在双子一在双鱼——手足被斩；火星与升主合于狮子而无尊贵、无吉星在8宫——焚死（逆行/灼伤/落陷则为罪而死，否则意外或冤）。土星在天顶且其 Dispositor（Anauba）冲之、4宫尖为干星座——被击头或坠物砸死；湿星座——溺死；人形星座——被绞死。火或土在上升且游走——头脸有疤；凶星受碍灼伤逆行——其疤甚丑。
rules.notes: Algol 大陵五=最凶暴之星（金牛24°17′，土木之性）；死亡方式专条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 双子射手/处女双鱼/牡羊天蝎摩羯水瓶上升+主星状态
rules.result: 按上升断财运与慷慨吝啬
rules.original_text: The 133rd consideration is, To mark in Nativities, whether Gemini or Sagittarius ascend, and whether its Lord be well disposed, that is, fortunate and strong, and likewise the Moon; for that signifies that if the native live, he will get great riches. If Virgo or Pisces ascend and its Lord or the Moon be well affected, he shall get money and lay the same out well, and live splendidly, being beloved for his generosity and bounty. But in the other case where the Ascendant is Gemini or Sagittarius, he will not be so liberal, but very frugal and sparing; besides, he who hath Gemini or Virgo for his Ascendant may lose his estate and come to want; but he that hath Sagittarius or Pisces shall never lose his means, nor fall into poverty. If Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn, or Aquarius ascend, the native will be miserably covetous. If Jupiter behold the Ascendant, he may somewhat mitigate the sordid humour, but will not wholly prevent or take it away.
rules.translation: 第一百三十三考量：双子或射手上升，其主与月亮布置佳（吉而强）——命主若活则得大富。处女或双鱼上升而其主/月亮状态佳——善得财善用财、生活华美、以慷慨博爱见爱。双子/射手上升者不如此慷慨，反节俭吝啬。双子/处女上升者可失产致贫；射手/双鱼上升者永不失其资、永不落贫。牡羊/天蝎/摩羯/水瓶上升——命主悭吝可怜；木星照上升稍减其鄙吝之性，然不全除。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 火/金在6宫佳=良医；水金合（金逆）=歌手；水在12宫无碍=哲名
rules.original_text: The 134th is, to mind in Nativities, whether Mars or Venus be in the Sixth, and likewise well disposed? for that signifies that the native shall be not really fit for Physic, and grow a perfect doctor in every part of the Art. If Mercury be in conjunction with Venus and she Retrograde, he will make naturally a good singer; but if Mercury be in the Twelfth not afflicted, he will be studious and famous in most sciences, especially Philosophy.
rules.translation: 第一百三十四考量：火星或金星在第6宫且布置佳——命主极适医道，为全艺之良医。水星与金星合相而金星逆行——天然好歌手；水星在12宫无碍——勤学，于多门科学（尤哲学）有名。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 升主/月/木/金在上升或三六分照
rules.original_text: The 135th consideration is, To consider in Nativities, whether the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon, and Jupiter, and Venus, are either all in the Ascendant, or whether Jupiter and Venus behold the Lord of the Ascendant, and the Moon in the Ascendant by a trine or Sextile, and free from affliction? for then the native will prove very strong and courageous; and none will dare to disobey his commands.
rules.translation: 第一百三十五考量：升主、月亮、木星、金星皆在上升；或木金照升主、月亮在上升以三分/六分照且无碍——命主极强健勇敢，无人敢违其令。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 两光体在旺/庙同度+木星受诸星德性后归土星（东出角宫）
rules.result: 成帝、君主或权臣；名望持久
rules.original_text: The 136th consideration is, To note in the Nativities of Kings and rich men, and such grandees as are fit to bear rule, whether both Luminaries are in the Degrees of their Exaltations, or in their own Houses, in the dame degree one with the other, and free from affliction? for this signifies that the native shall obtain great honours; for he shall be made Emperor, or something like it; so that he shall be as it were monarch of the world, which shall continue to the fourth generation of his posterity. But if all the Planets below Jupiter shall be disposed of by him and he shall receive virtue from every one of them, notwithstanding the condition aforesaid, and afterwards commit both them, and himself to Saturn, and both be Oriental from the Sun and in Angles, the native will be a person of great renown and power, although perhaps not with the title of king; but his fame shall endure for a long time, that is to say, all his lifetime; and after his death for three revolutions of Saturn, or longer.
rules.translation: 第一百三十六考量：王侯贵人本命——两光体皆在各自旺度或其庙、同度相并、无碍——命主得大尊荣，为帝或类似，几为世界之君主，延及四代后嗣。若木星以下诸星皆由其安排且自各星受德性（如前述），后将其与己皆付于土星，且皆东出于日、在角宫——命主为大有声名与权力之人（虽或无王号），其名持久：终其一生，死后历土星三周（约84年）或更久。
rules.notes: 帝王命专条

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.original_text: The 137th is, To see whether Mercury be in conjunction with Saturn in the Ascendant? For that signifies that the native is a foolish talkative fellow, that would be counted wise; he shall speak ill of both men and women; the greatest wit he hath is to invent many lies; nor doth he ever open his mouth, but something of untruth appears intermixed with his discourse: so natural it will be for him to tell lies, Saturn give him a foul tongue, and Mercury a sharpness of malice to employ it.
rules.translation: 第一百三十七考量：水星与土星合相于上升——命主为愚笨多话之徒、自以为智；贬损男女；其最大之才在编造谎言；一开口其言必杂不实；说谎近乎本能——土星予其秽舌，水星予其施恶之尖巧。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 二凶星在4宫/变动星座占角宫而火土居之
rules.result: 一生穷苦不幸（木星/三分主可救）
rules.original_text: The 138th is to see in Nativities, Whether the two Infortunes are in the Fourth House, or whether the Angles are possessed with moveable signs, and Mars and Saturn in them? For then the native will be poor, wretched, and unfortunate, above all others, all his lifetime, unless Jupiter, of the Lord of the Triplicity ascending prevent.
rules.translation: 第一百三十八考量：二凶星在第4宫，或角宫为变动星座而火星土星居其中——命主一生穷苦、悲惨、不幸，超乎众人；除非木星或上升三分之主阻止。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.result: 该宫所征之事被耗损毁灭
rules.original_text: The 139th is, To be careful, both in Nativities and Questions, where the Dragon's Tail is? For that signifies the wasting and destruction of the thing signified by that House, especially if it relates to gain, for in the first it signifies expenses, and loss of gain to the Querent, from or by reason of his person: in the 2nd, destruction and loss by means of money and substance; in the 3rd, loss by means of Brethren, Sisters, Neighbours, etc.: in the fourth, damage that one shall sustain by one's Grandfather, Father-in-law, and such things relating to Inheritances; and that the Native shall change Houses often, and get little by it; in the 5th, damage from or by reason of children, in the 6th, losses by servants or small cattle; in the 7th, loss by Women, Companions, or open Enemies: in the 9th, loss by Religious Men, and on the account of religion; in the 10th, by or in his preferments, honours, etc.: in the 11th, loss by his friends, or for their sakes: and in the 12th, damage sustained by great Cattle, or by means of hidden enemies.
rules.translation: 第一百三十九考量：本命与问盘——龙尾所在之宫示该宫所征之事的耗损与毁灭（尤关财利）：1宫——因身耗财失利；2宫——因钱财资财之毁损；3宫——因兄弟姊妹邻人之损；4宫——因祖父、岳父、遗产等之损，且命主常迁居而少得；5宫——因子女；6宫——因仆役小牲畜；7宫——因妇女伴侣公开之敌；9宫——因宗教人士/宗教之事；10宫——因升迁尊荣；11宫——因友人/为友之故；12宫——因大牲畜/暗敌。
rules.notes: 龙尾耗损表（12宫全列）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象星/月亮弱；双征象星距离+上升度投射
rules.result: 投射落宫之主断事之吉凶（替代判断法）
rules.original_text: The 140th consideration is, to see whether the Significator of the thing in question, or the Moon be so weak that it cannot bring the matter to perfection? And if they be, take the Significator of the Querent and thing inquired after, and subtract the lesser from the greater, and add to the remainder the degrees of the sign Ascending, and project what they amount unto from the Ascendant, and observe where it happens; for the Lord of that sign signifies what was enquired of and according to his conditions shalt thou give judgment, as thou findest him fortunate and strong, or unfortunate and weak. For if the business concern a man's estate, and he be placed in the Second, as he is; so shall the Querent's estate prove; if in the Third, the Brethren, Neighbours, etc.; in the fourth, those of greatest Relations; in the Fifth the Children; in the Sixth, Servants; in the Seventh, Wives; in the 8th Wives' portions; in the 9th, Long journeys; in the 10th his preferments; in the 11th his Friends; in the 12th, his secret Enemies.
rules.translation: 第一百四十考量：事之征象星或月亮过弱不能成事——取问者与所问事之征象星（双星黄经），大减小，余数加上升之度数，自上升起投射；落于何星座，其主星即示所问之事，依其状态（吉强/凶弱）断之：落2宫则问者之财如彼、3宫兄弟邻人、4宫至亲、5宫子女、6宫仆役、7宫妻、8宫妻之妆奁、9宫长途、10宫升迁、11宫友人、12宫暗敌。
rules.notes: 弱征象星之替代判断法（投影法）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 恒星/行星之赐予及持续
rules.result: 恒星赐短（人不契）、行星赐久；建城用恒星建屋用行星
rules.original_text: The 141st Is to consider in Nativities the gifts and properties bestowed on men by the fixed Stars, and how long they continue, together with the reason why they prove, not lasting as those which proceed from the Planets. Now the reason that the gifts of the Fixed Stars to men, abide less with them than those given by the Planets is, because the fixed stars being the Agents, and the men the Patients; the subject on which they are to operate are not agreeable to them, nor are born to be able to receive their impression; for it is requisite that there should be some conformity and likeness, or agreeableness between the Agent and the Patient; but the fixed stars are most slow in motion; and consequently in mutation, whence it comes to pass that their impressions require subjects and patients of the same nature; that is to say, such as are the most lasting. For the Revolution of the Fixed Stars is finished, but in six and thirty thousand years, but the life of man, generally exceeds not three revolutions of Saturn: that is to say, the space of ninety years. And therefore their gifts or the good promised by them continue no longer with men, because men are of so small a duration, and subject to a swift mutability. And upon this is that Aphorism grounded, that Advises to make use of Fixed Stars in the foundation of Cities, but of Planets in the erection of Houses.
rules.translation: 第一百四十一考量：恒星赐人之礼物与其持续之长短及原因。恒星之赐不若行星持久，因恒星为动因（Agent）而人为受因（Patient），受动之对象与恒星不相契、非生来能受其印——动因与受因须有相类相合；恒星运行至缓、变化至缓，故其印迹须同类之受者，即最长久者。恒星之轮回须三万六千年，而人寿不过土星三周（九十年）。故恒星之赐不能久存于人——人太短促、太快变。由此格言：建城用恒星、建屋用行星（城最耐久于可朽之物）。恒星之印施于城者按比例更久、施于堡者久于屋、施于人身者最不契——恒星之征如此高洁不腐，难与速朽之物相混。然在伟人巨富身上其效或久（如腓特烈二世、Ecilinus 等忽起忽落之例，见原文长段）。
rules.notes: 恒星/行星赠赐差异之原理长条；历史例证（腓特烈二世等）见原文

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 各行星之赐予及世代持续数
rules.result: 按行星断所赐之事与持续代数（月7代→土1代）
rules.original_text: The 142nd Consideration is, To observe in Nativities and general questions, the gifts and good advantages bestowed on men by the Planets: because those are applied more easily to them, and continue longer extended to their successors, according as they are well disposed in the Radices of their Nativities; but they are seldom exceeding great, unless when applied by fortunate Fixed Stars.
rules.translation: 第一百四十二考量：行星赐人之礼与利——因行星更易施于人且施于后嗣更久（视其在本命根基中之布置）；然其赐少有过大者，除非得吉性恒星之助。Lilly 注七行星之赐：土星东出且佳（强而被纳）——建房、植久长之树、垦地、兴水工之大利；木星——法学等科学之吉与尊位（主教、法官等）；火星——率军等；太阳——俗世升迁（王国、治权）；内行星之赐更附于人身而更久：金星——女子之事、饰物、求爱；水星——贸易、书写；月亮——航海、植葡、饮酒、售酒。月之所赐可持续至第七代（月为自土星下数第七星），过七代不过八（42至45岁间）；水星至第六代、金星至第五、太阳第四、火星第三、木星第二、土星仅一代不能过（罕达三代）——如亚里士多德言有不可越之限。不义之财（高利、谎、诈、窃、怨）不能守至第五或第三代。
rules.notes: 七行星赠赐与世代表（Lilly 注）；不义之财不逾5/3代

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 14点判断法（真诚性/征象星/宫位/相位/传递/本性/接收者）
rules.original_text: The 143rd Consideration, Is to understand the true method of judging, and by what ways thou mayest come to some result, that thou mayst examine and rightfully discuss the same, and discover the truth of what the stars shall show thee? And herein there are 14 points to be considered and heeded: 1. Whether the Querent proposes the question really and intentively or not? For if the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the hour be the same or the Signs wherein those Significators are placed be of the same Triplicity or complexion the Question is serious; but otherwise, if the Ascendant shall be the end of any Sign, the Question is not Radical. 2. Behold the Ascendant and his Lord, the Moon and the Planet from which she separates and assign them for Significators of the Querent; the Seventh and the Planet with which the Moon is joined, shall represent the person enquired after. 3. Consider the nature of the thing enquired about, the House and Sign whereby it is signified. 4. The Aspects of the Planets both good and malevolent to the Significators of the things sought after. 5. In what place from its own House each of the Significators are. 6. Whether they are found in Angles Cadent or Succedent Houses. 7. Diligently see where the Querent's Assistants must come. 8. By the mirth of the Querent, as if the Lord of the Ascendant shall be in the fifth, or elsewhere joined with its Lord; free from being afflicted by the Infortunes. Or by his sadness; as if his Significator happen in the 6th, 7th 8th, or 12th. 9. By the Fortunes and Infortunes, according as thou findest them in places signified; if the benevolents are more, 'tis good, if otherwise the contrary; if the testimonies are equal, then indifferent. 10. Whether the Lord of the Ascendant be in the House of the thing enquired after, or with its Lord. 11. In what House the Lord of the first is joined with the Significator of the things looked after; for by the Significator of that House, or his occasion, thou mayst judge the matter will be brought about. 12. If the Significators are not joined there, whether there be any Translation of Light between them by any Planet. 13. By the natures of the Significators themselves, agreeing in their natures and significations with each other. 14. According as the receiver of the Significators' virtue or disposition shall be a Fortune or Infortune strong or weak, and does behold the Significator, or the Moon, or any with Aspect of love or enmity, so shalt thou pronounce judgment.
rules.translation: 第一百四十三考量：真正判断之方法与途径（14 点）：1.问者是否真诚郑重——升主与时辰主相同或同三分/同性质则问严肃；上升在星座之末则问题不 Radical。2.取上升与其主、月亮及其分离星为问者之征象星；第7宫与月亮所合之星代表所问之人。3.察所问之事之性质及其所属之宫与星座。4.吉凶星对所问事征象星之相位。5.各征象星相对其己庙之位置。6.其在角/续/果宫。7.细察问者之助者来自何处（父/子/王/亲/友）。8.问者之喜：升主在第5宫或与其主相合且无凶碍；其忧：征象星在6/7/8/12宫（除非所问即此等宫之事）。9.按吉凶星在相关宫位之布置：吉者多则吉、反则凶、证言相等则中性。10.升主是否在所问事之宫或与其主同处。11.升主与事征象星相合于何宫——由该宫征象星/其情境断事之促成。12.若征象星不相合，有无他星传递之光于其间。13.征象星彼此之本性是否相合相应。14.按接收征象星德性之吉凶星强弱、及以爱憎相位照征象星或月亮——如是下判。
rules.notes: 判断方法论总纲（14点）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 征象不显时：升主与月宫主距离+上升度投射
rules.result: 落宫之主为征象星，依之判断
rules.original_text: The 144th Consideration is, To observe in Questions, Nativities, or Elections, when the Significators shall not clearly show thee what thou wouldst know but the signification remains dubious, so that the mind is in suspense, take the place of the Lord of the Ascendant, and the place of the Lord of the House of the Moon, and see the distance of degrees between them, beginning from Aries, of which make signs, and add the degree of the sign ascending: and project from the Ascendant as well by day as night, and where the number falls, the Lord of that House shall be Significator and from him take the Signification of the business enquired, for according to his disposition thou mayest judge.
rules.translation: 第一百四十四考量：问/本命/择时盘征象不显、判断存疑而心悬——取上升主星之黄经与月宫主之黄经，自牡羊起计其间度数（化为星座），加上升之度数，昼夜皆自上升投射；落于何宫，其宫主即为征象星，依其布置断所问之事。
rules.notes: 疑难盘替代判断法（与140条投影法同族）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 日生盘轩辕十四在上升/10宫（无吉星合相）
rules.result: 大荣大权（出身贱）；终遭不幸之死或荣没
rules.original_text: The 145th Consideration is, That thou see in Diurnal Nativities, whether Cor Leonis be in the Ascendant, that is to say in the Oriental Line or above it one degree or below it three degrees; or whether it be in the tenth in like degrees, without the Conjunction or Aspect of any of the Fortunes; for this alone signifies that the Native shall be a person of great note and power, too much exalted, and attain too high preferment and honours, although descended from the meanest parents. And if any of the Fortunes behold that place also, his glory shall be the more increased: but if the Nativity be nocturnal, his fortune will be somewhat meaner, but not much; but if the Infortunes cast their aspects there it will still be more mean; but if the Fortunes behold it also they will augment the good promised a fourth part, and mitigate the evil as much; yet still whatever of all this happens, it signifies that the Native shall die an unhappy death; or at least that all his honours, greatness, and power, shalt at last suffer an eclipse, and set in a cloud.
rules.translation: 第一百四十五考量：日生盘——轩辕十四（Cor Leonis，狮子座α）在上升（东出线或其上1°或其下3°内），或在10宫同度内，且无吉星合相/相位——仅此即示命主为大有声名权力之人、过于高扬、达过高升迁与尊荣，纵出身最贱。吉星照其处则其荣更增。夜生盘——其运稍逊（不多）。凶星投相位——更逊。吉星亦照则增其所诺之吉四分之一、减其凶如许。然无论如何——命主终将死于不幸；或其一切尊荣权势终遭蚀而没于云。
rules.notes: 轩辕十四（狮子α）一等星，火星之性；Royer：此星主军功之荣、财富大誉（然火星性之星之荣皆短暂）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Anima Astrologiae》(The Astrologer's Guide) — 146 Considerations
rules.condition: 上升主/12宫主/幸运点主之投影求合伙人
rules.result: 主/次/第三合伙人共掌征象；强弱定主次
rules.original_text: The l46th consideration is, That thou take the place of the Lord of the Ascendant, and the place of the Lord of the 12th, and subtracting the lesser from the greater add to the remainder the degrees of the sign ascending and project from the Ascendant; and where the number falls the Lord of the sign shall be partner with the Lord of the Question, and shall be called the Principal Partner. Again, take the place of the Lord of the said sign, and the place of the Lord of the Part of Fortune, and subtracting the lesser from the greater add the degrees of that sign ascending ; and where the number falls, the Lord of the Sign shall be another Partner, and be called the Secondary Partner; which if it happen to be the same Planet, regard only that; but if different, then take both and subtract the lesser from the greater and add the degrees of the sign ascending, and the planet on whose House the number falls shall be the third Partner; and which of those three is the strongest shall be the chiefest sharer in the significations of the thing enquired after. If all the remainders, or two of them, shall happen on the House of one Planet; that shall be preferred. If the Question seem good, and those Partners are ill disposed, they will diminish of the good signified by the Question, and so on the contrary; but if the Question seem evil, and they are well disposed, they will allay and mitigate the evil signified by the Question, and so likewise on the contrary.
rules.translation: 第一百四十六考量：取上升主星之黄经与12宫主之黄经，大减小，余加上升之度数，自上升投射——落于何星座，其主星即为问事主之合伙人，称主合伙人（Principal Partner）。再取该星座主星黄经与幸运点主星黄经，大减小加上升度数投射——落宫主为另一合伙人，称次合伙人（Secondary Partner）；若与主合伙人为同一星则只取之；不同则再取二者黄经大减小加上升度投射——落于何星之宫，该星为第三合伙人。三者中最强者为所问之事征象的最大共享者。若三余数（或二）落于同一星之宫——优先取之。问盘本吉而诸合伙人布置恶——减其吉；问盘本凶而诸合伙人布置佳——缓其凶。
rules.notes: 合伙人算法（投影三次）；用于判断之最后校正

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 调1宫主+月+月主+4宫主+福点主（保底：月+4宫）
rules.original_text: If you wanted to elect the hour for someone wishing to buy some inheritance or a house or land or other estate, adapt the first and its Lord, even the Moon and the Lord of the sign in which she is; the fourth also and its Lord; adapt even the Part of Fortune and its Lord; and if you cannot adapt all of these, adapt the Moon and the fourth, and add to them the Part of Fortune if you can. And if not, at least do not let the adaptation of those two be lacking.
rules.translation: 第一章·买房/遗产/土地：择时调适1宫及其主、月及月所在星座之主、4宫及其主、福点及其主；不能全调则调月与4宫，能则加福点；至少此二者不可缺。
rules.notes: Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时，Dykes 译；择时字段：需调适之星清单

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月位+照相位+4宫星座+角宫主东出北行
rules.original_text: You will even see if the place were fit or should be adapted so that it may be inhabited: let the Moon be in Cancer or in Taurus, or let her be in the 10th or at least in the 11th and let her aspect the Lord of the first by a praiseworthy aspect. And beware lest she should aspect Mars from any aspect: and if you cannot free her from his aspect, make it so that he receives her by a trine or sextile aspect, and let him not be impeded then. And let the 4th house be Taurus or Leo or at least Aquarius; even let the Lords of the angles be oriental in the world and from the Sun; and let them be ascending northern.
rules.translation: 宜居之地：月在巨蟹或金牛，或在10宫至少11宫，以可嘉相位照1宫主；防月照火星（不能免则令火星以三分/六分接纳月且不受碍）；4宫为金牛/狮/至少宝瓶；角宫主于世东出、离日东出且上升北行。
rules.notes: 东出（oriental in the world and from the Sun）——可编码为日距判断

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 吉星角宫尊贵+光体照升/4宫+无逆行
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said, in the buying of any inheritance let there be benefics having dignity in the angles; and if they could not have dignity in all the angles, let them have them in the first or in the fourth, or at least in one of them; let even the luminaries be aspecting the ascending and the fourth by an aspect of love; nor let the Lords of the angles be retrograde; nor let there be a retrograde planet in the angles.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：买地时吉星在角宫有尊贵（不能全角则1或4宫至少其一）；光体以爱之相位照上升与4宫（或其一）；角宫主不逆行；角内无逆行星。
rules.notes: al-Rijal（早期阿拉伯权威之一）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Kindi said, do not let a malefic be in the 9th or first or 11th, nor let the 4th house be a fiery one, nor let a fiery planet be in it, and especially if it were cadent from the benefics. And if the 4th house were a watery sign, beware lest Saturn aspect it. And you must beware lest the Lord of the 10th be a malefic.
rules.translation: al-Kindi：凶星不入9/1/11宫；4宫不为火象、火行星不入其中（尤若其自吉星落陷）；4宫水象则防土星照之；防10宫主为凶星。
rules.notes: al-Kindi 判据

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: For the Ascendant and its Lord signify the land itself which someone buys, and its possession and the usefulness of it. The 10th or 11th and its Lord signify whatever is erected from it above the earth and from its surface, like trees and other things born of the earth which grow old in it. Indeed the 7th and its Lord signify its cultivators.
rules.translation: 宫位征象分工：1宫及其主=土地本身、占有与用途；10/11及其主=地面之上所生（树等生于地之物）；7及其主=耕作者。
rules.notes: 宫位-征象映射（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said that it seemed to certain people that the 7th signifies herbs; indeed the 4th and its Lord are said to signify the goodness of the matter and whatever is had in it in terms of seeds. And he said whichever one of them were to be found good, judge good in the things which it signifies. If you were to find the benefics in the 1st, judge the goodness of the trees... If however you were to find a benefic in the 4th, judge the goodness of the matter and the goodness of the seeds located in it. And if you were to find one of the malefics in one of those places, judge malice according to what is signified by that house, and particularly in the 7th... Saturn signifies their deceit and dishonesty, Mars signifies their inconstancy and thievery.
rules.translation: al-Rijal 补充：7宫示草；4宫及其主=事之善与种子。吉星在1宫=树善；在7宫=农人善；在4宫=种子善；凶星在相应宫=相应之恶（7宫尤甚：土=欺诈不诚、火=反复与偷窃）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Tabari said Jupiter and the planet from which the Moon is being separated belong to the buyer; he to whom the Moon is joined signifies the end of the matter and into what it will devolve. If however you intended to buy land or a vineyard... without building... only that you might use it and have it and keep its fruit... adapt the aforesaid—namely the Ascendant and its Lord, and the Moon and her Lord; the Part of Fortune also and its Lord; even adapt Saturn (because he signifies these things on account of his severity, and because from severe work put into the land, they will be acquired).
rules.translation: al-Tabari：木星与月所离之星属买者；月所趋之星示事之终局。买地不建（用其果/佃租收益）：调1宫主、月及月主、福点及其主、土星（其严酷示勤作而得——土主此类）。
rules.notes: al-Tabari 判据

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 土星安置（昼夜分）+木星照+火星落陷+月增光
rules.original_text: Therefore put Saturn in Libra; or if the purchase were made in the day, put him in Capricorn or Aquarius; and if it were made at night, put him in Aries or Leo or Sagittarius (Aries however, is less useful)... Or let him be in one of his own bounds; and let him be made fortunate and strong; let even Jupiter be aspecting him by a trine or sextile aspect, or a square from an angle; and make Mars cadent from the angles; and let the Moon be in the beginning of the increase of her light (namely in her first quarter), increasing in number, aspecting Saturn with an aspect of friendship. And if Jupiter were to aspect her, it will be good, because he signifies the population of the land, and that it will be planted around with many fruitful trees.
rules.translation: 土星放天秤；昼买放摩羯或宝瓶；夜买放牡羊/狮/射（牡羊较劣；昼买亦可用但不如夜强）；或在其界内；令其吉而强；木星以三分/六分或自角四分照之；火星自角落陷；月在其光增之初（一象限）增数、以友相位照土星；木星照月=吉（示土地之众、多果树）。
rules.notes: 土星昼夜安置表（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 木星不可得则用金星；月位
rules.original_text: And Sahl said if you could not have an aspect of Jupiter with Saturn, make it so that you have the aspect of Venus with him instead... and you will make the watery signs fortunate, because when you make them fortunate with the benefics, they will be better than the airy signs. And he said, let the Moon be in her own exaltation, or in the Midheaven, and the Lord of the Ascendant aspecting her. And he said, let the Moon also and the Ascendant be cleansed of the malefics and from defects.
rules.translation: Sahl：不能得木星照土星则以金星代之；水象星座受吉星之福胜于风象；月在己旺或天顶、上升主照之；月与上升免于凶星与缺陷。
rules.notes: Sahl 判据

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 4宫主三/六合1宫主+接纳+上升照+月照两主
rules.original_text: Chapter 2: On the reconciliation of a father with a son. Adapt the Ascendant and its Lord, the Moon too and the Lord of the sign in which she is; adapt even the fourth and its Lord (which signifies the father and the uncle, and a father-in-law, and all older blood-relatives—naturally the ancestors). And let the Lord of the fourth be joined to the Lord of the first by a trine or sextile aspect and with reception, if it can be done; and let it aspect the Ascendant by the same aspect, and let the Lord of the first be in the first or the 10th or the 11th; let the Moon be aspecting the Lord of the first and the Lord of the fourth (or at least one of them): for these signify a useful and good and durable reconciliation.
rules.translation: 第二章·父子和解：调1宫及主、月及月所在星座主、4宫及主（4宫=父、叔伯、岳父、年长血亲、祖先）；4宫主以三分/六分+接纳合1宫主（若能），以同相位照上升；1宫主在1/10/11；月照1宫主与4宫主（至少其一）——示有用、善、持久之和解。
rules.notes: 4宫主=父亲征象（本然宫位）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 调1宫主+月+月主+福点主；上升置吉性固定星
rules.original_text: Chapter 3: In the building of cities or castles. If you wished to elect the hour for someone so he might build a city or castle, adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; the Moon also, and the Lord of the sign in which she is; and likewise the Part of Fortune and its Lord; and in the Ascendant of the building... put one of those fixed stars which are of the nature of Jupiter or the Sun or Venus or Mercury or Saturn (if Saturn were of good condition), or of the Moon, or at least of the nature of the Lord of the Ascendant of that hour. For these signify the prolongation of the city or the castle and its perpetual durability on account of their most slow motion.
rules.translation: 第三章·建城/城堡：调1宫及主、月及月所在星座主、福点及其主；上升置固定星（木/日/金/水/土[若吉]/月之性，或至少1宫主之性）——示城之延长与恒久（其行最慢、变化最缓）。
rules.notes: 固定星清单（按行星之性）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And it seemed to al-Rijal that Saturn is to be adapted in the building of cities. Indeed Sahl seemed not to want us to give Saturn a role in the building; still however they do not contradict each other. Because al-Rijal understood this in terms of the building of cities. Indeed Sahl understood this in terms of the building of houses.
rules.translation: al-Rijal 建城调土星；Sahl 建屋不给土星角色——不矛盾（城vs屋之分）。
rules.notes: 学派差异如实记录

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 土象固定+月增光趋旺合吉星被接纳
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said that the Ascendant should be an earthy sign, fixed, in buildings; and the Lord of the Ascendant likewise, and the Moon, in earthy, fixed signs. And he said that the Moon should be in increased light and number, going toward her exaltation; and that she should be joined to a benefic which should be in its own exaltation or in the exaltation of the Moon, and she should be received. And al-Rijal even said that it seems fitting to him that the Moon be in a watery sign, and that it is useful if she is otherwise ascending, and she should be more in the middle of her light.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：建屋上升为土象固定星座；上升主与月同在土象固定；月增光增数趋己旺，合于己旺或月旺中之吉星并被接纳；月在水象亦可（他处上升时有用）、光居中。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 金星三分/六分合火以制之；土星避金星
rules.original_text: And Sahl said, make Mars cadent from all of the significators of the building, and never should you give any role in the building to him. And he said that if you cannot make it so without giving him a role in it, put Venus strong in her own place; and join her to him from a trine or sextile aspect: because Mars will not impede the matter of Venus if reception or even some benefic aspect (namely a trine or sextile) intervenes, on account of the greatness of their friendship. And he said, make Saturn cadent from Venus according to your ability, on account of her enmity with him.
rules.translation: Sahl：火星自一切建物征象星落陷、永不给火星角色；若不能——置金星强于己位、以三分/六分合火星（火不碍金——因友谊之大）；土星自金星落陷（金土之仇）。
rules.notes: 行星友谊/仇恨（可编码为相位质+行星关系表）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 调1+月+4+2+10及主；防征象星在地下
rules.original_text: Chapter 4: On the building of houses. In the building of houses you will not consider the fixed stars, but only the planets, whence the Ascendant and its Lord are to be adapted; the Moon also and the Lord of the domicile in which she is, and the planet to which she is joined; the fourth also and its Lord; even the second and its Lord; likewise the tenth and its Lord (and more strongly so if it were a building that ought to be elevated far above the ground). And beware lest you put the significators of the building below the earth, because they will not permit the building to be elevated unless perhaps after a great time... Still however, if the Moon were below the earth (namely in the 5th or the 3rd), joined to a planet (not impeded) above the earth, it will not be horrible.
rules.translation: 第四章·建屋：不看固定星只看行星——调1宫及主、月及月所在庙之主、月所合之星、4及主、2及主、10及主（建筑高升时10更强）；防建物征象星在地下（否则屋难起——Viviani 塔例）；月在地下（5/3宫）合于地上不受碍之星则不恶。
rules.notes: Viviani 塔（Forlì 圣古列摩）案例

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 福点在角+龙头12宫+合相主强+土星三合接纳
rules.original_text: And al-Tabari said, let the Moon be in crooked signs (which signify increase). Indeed al-Kindi said, let the Part of Fortune be in an angle, and do not let the angles be removed; and let the Tail be in the 12th, and the Lord of the conjunction be in one of its own dignities, fast in course (the which opinion al-Rijal praised). And he likewise recommended that Saturn aspect the significators from a trine aspect with reception, and he recommended this very much.
rules.translation: al-Tabari：月在歪斜星座（示增）；al-Kindi：福点在角、角不移动、龙头在12宫、合相主在己尊贵且行快（al-Rijal 赞）；土星以三分+接纳照征象星（极力推荐）。
rules.notes: 歪斜星座=crooked signs（示增加）；龙头/尾=月交点

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 上升旺主→固定星；防凶性固定星于上升度±2°
rules.original_text: But whereas on the other hand it seems somewhat impossible always to be able to adapt all the things which are necessary for us in buildings... we must adapt what can be adapted... if someone wanted to build a city or castle, adapt the Ascendant and the other things which were said above; and if you cannot adapt them all, adapt the Lord of the exaltation of the Ascendant, and use him more in this than the Lord of the domicile or of the other dignities. And if again you cannot do this, adapt the Ascendant with one of the aforesaid fixed stars. And beware lest one of the fixed stars which are of the nature of the malefics should fall in the ascending degree or near it by 2º. I tell you likewise concerning the 4th house.
rules.translation: 备选（每日建屋择时之现实）：全不能调——调上升之旺主（优于庙主/他尊贵）；又不能——上升配前述固定星之一；防凶性固定星落上升度或近2°内；4宫同理。
rules.notes: 择时降级优先级（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月合木星（非冲）+木星2宫+旺主优先
