rules.original_text: Indeed in building houses, if you cannot adapt all the aforesaid, adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; likewise the Moon and the second and the fourth and their Lords (or at least the second); and make the Moon to be joined with Jupiter from any aspect except for the opposition; and if you can, put Jupiter in the second... And even the Lord of the exaltation of the sign in which the Moon is, should be adapted more strongly than the Lord of the domicile... since indeed, the conjunction of Jupiter with the Moon signifies the comeliness and beauty and goodness of the house.
rules.translation: 建屋降级：调1宫及主、月及2/4宫及其主（至少2宫）；月以除冲外任何相位合木星；能则木星在2宫；月所在星座之旺主强于庙主（建/植皆然）；木星合月=屋之俊美善好。
rules.notes: 旺主优先原则（择时通用）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 各凶征（土=毁坏难居、火=焚毁失财、南交=损资）
rules.original_text: And beware in the building of houses lest you give Saturn or Mars some role in them, even though Saturn may be given a role in the building of cities; indeed in no building should Mars be given a role. And beware lest you put the Tail in the first or the 2nd or the 4th (and especially in the 2nd), because it diminishes substance. However, put the Head in them with confidence, because it increases it. And beware of the Moon in the conjunction of Saturn or Mars or with the Tail in the first, even the 2nd or in the 4th... For Saturn in the first or in the 4th signifies deformity and its slowness, and that the house will hardly or never be raised up; and if it were raised up, it will hardly or never be inhabited; and if it were inhabited, its inhabitants will suffer many inconveniences (like fears, horrible dreams, and diverse tribulations); and it signifies that the building will be shattered and broken... Indeed in the 2nd he signifies the diminution of substance. Mars however, when he is in one of those places, signifies the burning of the house or of the building, and its fall and destruction, and the loss of money through fires and thievery; and all the more so if he were ascending to his awj or to the further longitude, or were otherwise ascending.
rules.translation: 建屋防土/火有角色（土可于建城；火任何建物不可）；防龙头（南交）在1/2/4宫（尤2——损资）；龙头（北交）放心用之（增资）；防月在土/火/龙头之合于1/2/4（火星于金之调适可例外）；土在1/4=屋之畸形缓慢难起难居（居者恐惧恶梦多扰），屋毁裂塌；土在2=损资；火在诸处=屋焚毁塌、失财于火与偷盗（尤若升向其 awj/远经度）。
rules.notes: awj=apogee（远地点）；南交损/北交增（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 月增光+月庙主照+上升主照上升
rules.original_text: And Sahl said, let the Moon be increased in light and number then, because it signifies the usefulness of the Lord of her domicile, and let the Lord of her domicile be aspecting it. And he said that the Lord of the Ascendant should be aspecting the Ascendant, and be cleansed of the malefics. And he said if the Lord of the Ascendant did not aspect the Ascendant, the master of the house will not stay long in it. (If however the building were of a low-class or ignoble or humble person, adapt all that you can of the aforesaid; moreover because many adapted significators will make up for the weakness of the root of that nativity).
rules.translation: Sahl：月增光增数（示月庙主之益）、月庙主照之；上升主照上升且免凶星；上升主不照上升——屋主不久居（低贱者之屋尽量调——多征象星补本命根之弱）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: Chapter 5: On the building of churches. If it were a humble building, nor very expensive, as are common churches, small hermitages... and the like (which are not of great fame): in such cases you will adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; likewise the Moon and her Lord; the 9th and its Lord. If however it were famous or stately, as are great monasteries... you will not elect for them as you do for spiritual buildings, but as for temporal ones. Whence, for them you will adapt the Ascendant and its Lord, and the Lord of the exaltation of the Ascendant; chiefly the Moon and her Lord; and likewise the tenth instead of the ninth.
rules.translation: 第五章·建教堂：宗教建筑分级——卑小（普通教堂、小隐修院、小修道院、礼拜堂、小寺院）：调1宫及主、月及月主、9宫及主；显赫（大修道院、圣马可、比萨主教座、圣维塔利斯等）：按世俗建筑——调1宫及主、上升之旺主、月及月主、以10宫代9宫。
rules.notes: 灵性/世俗建筑分野（可编码分类）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And if it were the building of a house of study, adapt Mercury, and make him of good condition, fortunate and strong; and put him in a good place, so that he aspects the Ascendant by a trine or sextile aspect.
rules.translation: 学堂建筑：调水星，吉而强、好位、三分/六分照上升。
rules.notes: 建筑类型-行星映射（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: If however it were a building of delights, as is one of drinking, games, and the like, adapt Venus, and make her fortunate and strong and of good condition, and let her aspect the Ascendant from an aspect of friendship.
rules.translation: 娱乐建筑（饮宴、游戏）：调金星，吉而强、友相位照上升。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: If however it were a building in which victuals ought to be served (like grains, wine, olive oil, honey, and other edibles and potables), adapt Jupiter, make him fortunate and strong, and so that he aspects the Ascendant with a praiseworthy aspect.
rules.translation: 粮仓/食物建筑（谷物、酒、橄榄油、蜜）：调木星，吉而强、可嘉相位照上升。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: If however it were a building in which some people ought to be put in prison, adapt Saturn, and make him strong in his own place, and so that he aspects the Ascendant by any aspect except for the opposition.
rules.translation: 监狱：调土星，强于己位、除冲外任何相位照上升。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 上升+上升主+月皆火/风象
rules.original_text: Chapter 6: On the destruction of constructed buildings. If you wanted to destroy some building, make the Ascendant one of the fiery or airy signs; and let the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon be in fiery or airy signs.
rules.translation: 第六章·毁坏建筑：毁屋——上升为火/风象；上升主与月在火/风象。
rules.notes: 毁坏=建屋之反（与建屋择时相反原则）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 征象星全面弱化（尤火星）→不复建
rules.original_text: And al-Tabari said, let the Ascendant be a sign of direct ascension, and let the Lord of the Ascendant be occidental, decreasing in number, going toward a sign in which it is cadent; nor however should it be retrograde, but let it be cadent from the angle. Also, let the Moon be decreasing in light and number, cadent from the angle, even joined to a planet cadent from the angle and going to its own fall; or let her be in Scorpio or Capricorn, and let her be below the earth or joined to a planet located below the earth; and let her be descending southern, or let her be joined to a retrograde planet; even let her be in the last quarter of the lunation, and let the Moon be cadent from the Sun (nor let her be received); and let the Lord of the 4th house be weak, and the planet to whom the Moon is joined, and even the other significators of the building. And above all else you will weaken Mars, even if you cannot weaken all the others; nor however should you forget to weaken him, because just as he is contrary to someone building, so in the contrary of destruction he strives to rebuild the building. For those things which I told you above do not permit the torn-down building to be remade, nor rebuilt.
rules.translation: al-Tabari 毁屋细则：上升直升星座；上升主西没、减数、趋落陷星座、不逆行、自角落陷；月减光减数、自角落陷、合于自角落陷且趋己落陷之星；或在蝎/摩羯、地下、或合地下之星；南行下降；或合逆行星；残月象限、自日落陷（不被接纳）；4宫主弱、月所合之星及其余建物征象星皆弱；尤重弱化火星（否则其在毁坏中反而重建）；上述诸事使屋不复建。
rules.notes: 火星在毁坏择时中的反作用（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月离凶合东出吉/被接纳→易毁
rules.original_text: If however the inceptor did not care whether the building would be rebuilt or not, let the Moon be separated from a malefic, and joined to an oriental benefic, or let her be received, and the building will be torn down more easily.
rules.translation: 若不介意重建——月自凶星分离、合于东出吉星或被接纳——毁屋更易。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 宫位征象：1=租者/7=出租者/10=租金/4=结果
rules.original_text: Chapter 7: On the renting or leasing of houses or lands. Adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; also the Moon and the Lord of the sign in which she is. For the Ascendant and its Lord signify him who rents the thing, indeed the seventh and its Lord signify him who leases it out. Indeed the tenth signifies that which is given for the rental. However the fourth signifies the end of the matter, and what the rental results in.
rules.translation: 第七章·租/赁：调1宫及主、月及月所在星座主。1宫及其主=租者；7及其主=出租者；10=租金；4=事之终与结果。
rules.notes: 宫位-角色映射（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: Therefore, see which of the aforesaid places are made fortunate, and which unfortunate. For if the Ascendant and its Lord were made fortunate, it signifies good for the renter, and the renter will be truthful, and lawful, and will observe for the lessor those things which he promised him. If however it were unfortunate and evil, it will be to the contrary. If indeed the 7th and its Lord were fortunate, it signifies that the lessor will observe those things which he promised to the renter, and he will be lawful and of good faith. If however it were evil and unfortunate, he will lie to his partner, and will not observe what was promised, and he will be fraudulent to him.
rules.translation: 断法：1宫及其主吉——租者诚信守诺；凶——反之。7及其主吉——出租者守信合法；凶——说谎诈伪。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: If indeed both significators were fortunate and good, each will observe the faith of the other, and they will both be lawful. If both were evil and unfortunate, each of them will strive to deceive the other, and will be fraudulent to him.
rules.translation: 双吉——互守信用合法；双凶——互相欺诈。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 出租者/租者归属；月主=事终
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said, he to whom the Moon is joined signifies him who leases out, and he from whom she separates, signifies him who rents; al-Rijal, however, as I believe, considered it if the leasing were motivated first from the lessor; but if the renter were motivated first, it will be to the contrary. The Lord of the sign in which the Moon is, signifies the end of the matter.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：月所趋之星=出租者、月所离之星=租者（若租者先动则反之）；月所在星座主=事之终。
rules.notes: 动因先后修正（可编码为询问者角色）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Tabari said we should adapt Jupiter and Saturn, and put them aspecting each other from a praiseworthy aspect. And he said, for this purpose, that the promises of the one leasing out and of the renter would be observed and would be firm.
rules.translation: al-Tabari：调木土以可嘉相位互照——双方承诺坚稳。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said that in leasing out, let the Ascendant be adapted, and its Lord, and let him be going toward the angle in an earthy sign (and likewise the Moon); or let him be in the angle of the earth. Indeed let the planet from which the Moon is being separated be free, and let it be in one of its own dignities (because it signifies the land). And he said that the Lord of the seventh should be made fortunate, harmonizing with the Lord of the Ascendant... the seventh and its Lord, and the planet to which the Moon is joined, signify the one leasing the land from the owner; and the Ascendant and its Lord, and the planet from which the Moon is being separated, signify the owner who rents out the land... And wherefore the fourth and its Lord signify the land. And he said that in the inception of an election of the land you are to use the same election.
rules.translation: al-Rijal 租地细则：上升及主趋角在土象（月亦然）或在地之角；月所离之星自由、在己尊贵（示土地）；7宫主与上升主调和而吉；月所求合之星与月所离之星调和；7及其主与月所趋之星=租地者；1及其主与月所离之星=地主；4及其主=土地；地之择时以同法。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 土星东出+上升主东出+月在地下3/5土象（或10/11）
rules.original_text: Chapter 8: On the extending of rivers or canals. If someone wished to extend a river or canal, or other waters, and you wanted to elect for him the hour fit for this, adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; the Moon also, and the Lord of the sign in which she is; even adapt Saturn so that he is oriental; and let even the Lord of the Ascendant be oriental, free from impediments in an angle, in one of its own dignities; and let the Moon be below the earth, in the 3rd or the 5th, in an earthy sign. And if she were above the earth, let her be in the 10th or 11th.
rules.translation: 第八章·开河/运河：调1宫及主、月及月所在星座主、土星东出、上升主东出无碍于角在己尊贵；月在地下3/5宫土象；月在地上则10/11。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said that it is good for Saturn to be in the 11th, provided that the Moon is not joined to him by body. You will even adapt Jupiter. Nor let any malefic be in the 10th.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：土星在11宫佳（月不与其身体合）；调木星；10宫无凶星。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 月日四分+月增光在角+上升水象受福
rules.original_text: And al-Kindi said, let the Moon be in the 1st, square from the Sun, made fortunate, in increased light and number; and let her be in an angle (namely of the first or the tenth or the fourth); and do not let the angles be removed; and let the Ascendant be a watery sign, made fortunate with a strong benefic.
rules.translation: al-Kindi：月在1宫、与日四分、受福、增光增数、在角（1/10/4）；角不移动；上升水象、以强吉星受福。
rules.notes: 日四分（月球与太阳成90°）为可选配置而非绝对

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 首选调月；次调上升主与福点
rules.original_text: Even the Part of Fortune is to be adapted, and the Lord of the conjunction or the prevention which was before the election, and the rest of the things which were said in the renting of land; which if you cannot adapt all of these, adapt those which you can—of which one is chiefly the adaptation of the Moon. You will even adapt the Lord of the Ascendant and the Part of Fortune.
rules.translation: 福点亦调；合相/预防主与租地同法；不能全调则调能调者——首要为月；亦调上升主与福点。
rules.notes: 合相/预防（conjunction/prevention）=择时前之合相或满月（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 植树择时月位降级序列
rules.original_text: Chapter 9: On the planting of trees and fig-trees. Whence if you wanted to elect the hour for someone in order to plant trees or orchards or plug fig-trees, begin from the Moon and put her in Taurus joined to Venus by whatever method, if you can. And if you could not put the Moon in Taurus, put her in Aquarius (though Aquarius is below Taurus in effectiveness). Which if you could not do this, put her in Leo (however Leo is below Aquarius). Which again if you could not do this, put her in Pisces or in Virgo (but they are below Leo), provided that she is aspected by some planet from a watery sign, if she were in Leo. But Taurus is to be preferred before all the others.
rules.translation: 第九章·植树/插无花果：自月始——月在金牛合金星（任何方式）；不能则宝瓶（次于金牛）；不能则狮（次之）；不能则双鱼或处女（又次之；月在狮需水象行星照之）；金牛最优先。
rules.notes: 月位降级序列（可编码为优先级）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 土星1/11/5/2宫；降级木星照土→月入宫；火星无角色
rules.original_text: And let Saturn be in the first (and direct), or in the eleventh, or the fifth, or the second, in any one of his own dignities or strengths, or let him occupy one of the aforesaid signs there. And if you could not put him in the first, put Jupiter there aspecting Saturn... And if neither of them could be put in the first, put the Moon there, or put her in the tenth or in the eleventh, or at least in the fifth or third. And you should never make her impeded in plantings and seedings. And beware lest you give Mars a role in planting or seedings, except in buildings; and make the Moon (and the Lord of the sign in which she is) cadent from him, and likewise the Part of Fortune; and adapt the Lord of the exaltation of the Ascendant if you can do it, because it is not evil if it is preferred to the Lord of the domicile in this.
rules.translation: 土星在1宫（顺行）、或11/5/2宫、在己尊贵或强；不能置1宫则置木星照土星（友相位、有证词之位）；二者皆不能置1宫则置月于1宫或10/11或至少5/3；种植播种永不使月受碍；防火星在植/种有角色（建屋除外）；月及月所在星座主、福点自火星落陷；调上升之旺主（可优于庙主）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 上升主东出/西没+升降向
rules.result: 树速长/迟果等四种组合
rules.original_text: And al-Khayyat said, let the Lord of the domicile of the Moon be aspecting her from a watery sign; and if the Ascendant were not a fixed sign, let the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon (or at least one of them) be oriental, ascending. For if the Lord of the Ascendant were oriental, and were ascending to its own awj, or the farther longitude, it signifies that a tree which is planted then will grow quickly. Indeed if it were ascending and it were not oriental, it signifies that the tree will grow quickly, but it will delay the bearing of its fruit. And this does not bring harm in trees that are not fruit-bearing. And if it were oriental, descending from its awj, or toward its nearer longitude, it will grow slowly, but it will hasten to bear fruit. And if it were occidental, descending, it will delay the growing and bearing of its fruit.
rules.translation: al-Khayyat：月庙主自水象照月；上升非固定则上升主与月（至少其一）东出上升——东出升向 awj（远经度）=树速长；升而不东出=速长而迟果（无果之树无害）；东出离 awj（近经度）=慢长而速果；西没下降=长与果皆迟。
rules.notes: 东出-运动方向-果实映射（可编码为日距+方向）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月入金牛/射手末合木星；木星入1/10/11/5/4
rules.original_text: But since it is difficult to adapt all things which can be considered in elections... in the planting of trees, if you cannot adapt something else, adapt at least the Moon and put her in Taurus, free, not impeded, or in the last part of Sagittarius joined to Jupiter by any sort of aspect (except for the opposition). Nor let Jupiter be impeded, and put him in the Ascendant, if you can, free, or in the 10th, or the 11th, or the 5th, or the 4th. And I tell you the same concerning the Part of Fortune, if it can be done.
rules.translation: 植/种降级：不能全调——至少月入金牛无碍，或射手末段合木星（除冲外任何相位）；木星不受碍，放1宫（能则）、或10/11/5/4；福点同法。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 上升动/双体+上升主动星座；自月始
rules.original_text: Chapter 10: On the sowing of seeds. If you wanted to elect the hour of sowing seeds for someone, it is necessary in every sowing that the Ascendant be a movable or common sign, and the Lord of the Ascendant be in a movable sign (if it can be done). However, just as I told you in plantings, start from the Moon, and work through her: because her virtue in plantings is to be preferred to the virtues of all the other planets.
rules.translation: 第十章·播种：每次播种上升为动/双体星座、上升主在动星座（能则）；自月始（植/种之德月最胜）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月动/双体土象；牡羊需水照；处女最优
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said, let the Moon be in movable signs; whence she is to be put in a movable or common sign, earthy (or of sowing). But if she were in Aries, it is necessary that a planet aspect her from a watery sign, lest a portion of the seed dry out. And al-Rijal praised Cancer and Capricorn; indeed he praised Virgo before all the other earthy signs or those of sowing, both in seeds which bear fruit in the same year, and in those which bear fruit in the following year (like those which are seeded when they are planted, like leeks, cabbages, and the like).
rules.translation: al-Rijal：月在动星座；置于动/双体土象（或播种象）；月在牡羊需水象行星照之（防种子干）；赞巨蟹与摩羯；赞处女先于一切土象/播种象（当年果与次年果皆然——韭、甘蓝等）。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 上升双体+上升主免凶+月增光增数
rules.result: 种子繁茂（反之受阻/减量）
rules.original_text: Indeed Sahl said that the Ascendant should be a common sign, and its Lord in a movable sign, aspecting the Lord of its own domicile; and let the Lord of the Ascendant be free from the malefics: because if the malefics were to aspect him, the seed will be found impeded. And let the Moon be increased in light and number: because if she were under the rays, or were decreasing in number, it signifies that the seed will be decreased, and nothing will emerge out of it except for a middling amount.
rules.translation: Sahl：上升双体、其主在动星座照己庙主、上升主免凶星（凶照则种子受阻）；月增光增数（月受日射线/减数则种子减、仅中量出）。
rules.notes: 月受日射线（under the rays）——可编码为合日距离阈值

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 金牛（需多种）/射手末半/双鱼/树种金牛/备选处女
rules.original_text: And of the fixed signs, Taurus is recommended, but it thins the seed according to the quantity that is sowed. Whence it is necessary that something more be cast forth of the seed than is usual; nor however should it exceed the proper limit. And even the last half of Sagittarius is of value in sowings, and even Pisces is recommended. If indeed it were the seed of trees... let the Moon be in Taurus. You however, if you cannot adapt all of the aforesaid, put the Moon in Virgo free from impediments, and you have adapted the hour of sowing.
rules.translation: 固定星座中金牛被荐但使种子变少（需多种些，不过量）；射手末半于播种有价值；双鱼被荐；树之种子（种树再植）——月在金牛；备选：月在处女无碍即成。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 1宫主+月+月庙主皆被接纳；吉星2宫
rules.original_text: Chapter 11: On beginning to cultivate inheritances. If you wanted to elect the hour for someone wanting to begin to cultivate an inheritance which he had obtained, adapt the Ascendant and its Lord, and the Moon, and the planet in whose domicile she is, so that all are received; and let the planet which receives any one of them be in an angle or a succeedent, free from impediments; and if not all of this can be done, let at least the Moon be received by a strong and fortunate planet, and let her be in a good place. And make it (if you ever can) so that a benefic, free from impediments, is in the second.
rules.translation: 第十一章·开始耕耘遗产：调1宫及主、月及其庙主，使皆被接纳；接纳者（其中任一）在角或续宫、无碍；至少月被强吉星接纳、在好位；能则无碍吉星在2宫。
rules.notes: 接纳（reception）机制复用第3层

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 福点主+合相主在角；月主吉星
rules.result: 耕耘吉；降级=月在上升被接纳
rules.original_text: And al-Kindi said, let the Lord of the Part of Fortune and the Lord of the conjunction or the prevention be in any angle, or going toward it, and let the Lord of the sign in which the Moon is, be a benefic; which if all of these were absent, at least make it so that the Moon is in the Ascendant, or in a good place from it, received.
rules.translation: al-Kindi：福点主与合相/预防主在任何角或趋之；月所在星座主为吉星；全缺——至少月在上升或在好位、被接纳。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 1/月/月主入角；上升固定；4宫水象；7宫主弱
rules.original_text: Chapter 12: On putting together ships or galleys. If someone wanted to put together a galley or other ship of passage, either for overcoming enemies, or for sailing the sea by another method of speed, adapt the Ascendant and its Lord; even the Moon and the planet in whose domicile she is in; and put them in the Ascendant or in the 10th or in the 11th; and let the Ascendant be a fixed sign; and if it can happen, let the other angles likewise be fixed signs. And adapt the 4th and its Lord, because it naturally signifies ships. And make it, if you can, so that the 4th is a watery sign; or at least put its Lord in a watery sign, free from impediments, and joined to some benefic. And let the planet from which the Moon is being separated, be strong and fast. And if you cannot put the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon in the 10th, put a benefic there, strong and made fortunate... however, let the Lord of the seventh be weak and slow in course.
rules.translation: 第十二章·造船：船分三种——桨船/战船、大运输船、小商船。桨船/快速船：调1宫及主、月及其庙主，置1/10/11；上升固定（能则诸角皆固定）；调4宫及主（本然主船）；4宫水象（或至少其主在水象无碍合吉星）；月所离之星强而快；上升主/月不能入10宫则置吉星于10宫（强而受福、有强证词、东出快行）；7宫主弱而慢。
rules.notes: 造船三分类（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.original_text: If however it were a boat for transport, let the Moon be in her own average course with the other things above being adapted, as was said, so that she does not run more than her average course in one day; and if she were to travel less than that by three or four minutes, it will not be bad on account of the fear that it would be harmed by excess speed.
rules.translation: 运输船：月在其均速（日行不超均速；少3-4分无害——防过速之伤）。
rules.notes: 月均速日行≈13°10′（编码可用 sweph 实算）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月不慢过均速31′/日；上升主趋角
rules.original_text: If indeed it were of the other aforesaid ships, you will adapt the aforesaid, but it does not matter whether the Moon is fast in course or not, provided she is not very slow so that she does not go less than her own average course by more than by 31' in one day. And strive to adapt the Lord of the conjunction or the prevention according to your ability, because this is good; and if the Moon were separated from another planet, make her to be joined to some benefic; and if the Lord of the Ascendant were not in an angle, make it so that he goes toward it.
rules.translation: 他船：同上但月不须快（不得慢过均速31′/日以上）；调合相/预防主（善）；月自他星分离则令其合吉星；上升主不在角则令其趋角。
rules.notes: 31′阈值（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 月金牛/双子；防火照；10宫主调
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said that certain people affirmed it was good if the Moon were in Taurus or in Gemini. And he said we must beware of the aspect of Mars with the Moon or with the Lord of the Ascendant, or with the Lord of the fourth in the putting together of a ship. And al-Rijal said that it is useful if the Moon were above the earth. And he said these same things are to be adapted in the launching of ships into the water, and in their purchase; you, however, adapt all that you can adapt; but always let it be your concern to adapt the Moon. And when a mast is raised higher in the ship, then the tenth is to be adapted, and its Lord; likewise the Moon is to be put in it.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：某辈言月在金牛或双子佳；防火星照月/上升主/4宫主（造船）；月在地上有用；下水/买船同法——总以调月为要；桅杆升高时调10宫及其主、月入其中。

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.condition: 磨坊类型-上升星座映射
rules.result: 船磨=双鱼末/处女末；吊磨=牡羊前/天秤末；横磨=固定水土；风磨=风象
rules.original_text: Chapter 13: On the building of mills. Mills are built in many ways: for one kind is built on ships... another is built on pole-bars, so that it is raised up and pressed down as the puller wishes (and that is said to be a hanging mill). Another is built to be immovable... called a transverse mill. Another is built in a house to be inhabited, which is turned by some animal... called a posternum. Another is built in high places, which is turned by the wind, and it is called a windmill. Whence if someone wanted to build one of the aforesaid mills... if it were a mill on ships, let the Ascendant be the last half of Pisces or the last of Virgo. If however it were a mill that is called hanging... let the Ascendant be the first half of Aries or the last half of Libra; because the one and the other signify equality. If indeed it were a fixed mill... or a mill in a house which is turned by beasts... called a posternum, let the Ascendant be a fixed sign, either a watery one or an earthy one. If indeed it were a mill that is turned by the wind... let the Ascendant be an airy sign, and the Moon in the aforesaid signs or in the Ascendant or in the tenth or the eleventh.
rules.translation: 第十三章·建磨坊：磨坊多种——船磨、吊磨（杆上可升降）、横磨（固定）、屋内畜/机磨（posternum）、风磨（高处风转）。船磨：上升为双鱼末半或处女末段；吊磨：牡羊前半或天秤末半（示平等）；横磨/posternum：固定星座（水/土象）；风磨：风象上升、月在上述星座或在1/10/11。
rules.notes: 磨坊类型-上升映射（可编码）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 防巨蟹摩羯；避双子射手；月均速或略快
rules.original_text: And al-Rijal said, beware lest the Moon be in Cancer or Capricorn; likewise to be avoided are Gemini and Sagittarius on account of the great inequality of the days and nights when the Sun is in them; and let the Moon, in any building of a mill, always be in her average course, or a little faster, if it can be so.
rules.translation: al-Rijal：防月在巨蟹或摩羯；避双子与射手（日月不均——日在其间昼夜差大）；建磨月恒在均速或略快。
rules.notes: 昼夜不等之由（太阳在双子/射手时）

rules.book: Guido Bonatti《Liber Astronomiae》第4宫择时（4th House Elections）
rules.result: 凶照可、吉照更善；各磨起点定义
rules.original_text: If however you could not put the Moon in the aforesaid signs, nor could you make them the ascending signs, but the Moon and the Ascendant were in other signs, al-Rijal said that if it were with the aspect of a malefic it will be good; nevertheless if it were with the aspect of a benefic it will be better. The beginning of a ship-mill is when its renter begins to build the first ship. Indeed the beginnings of the other mills are when it begins to be built by the professionals which are of the substance of the mill. And if it were a mill that needs a watermill, make the watermill begin to be dug when the other aforesaid beginning comes to be.
rules.translation: 备选：月与上升不能入上述星座——al-Rijal 言凶星照之则善、吉星照之更善。起点定义：船磨之始=租者开始造第一船；他磨之始=专业人员开始建造；水磨需先挖水渠（与前述之始同时）。
rules.notes: 择时起点（inception）定义——工程语义

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按四正点入宫图判四季
rules.original_text: [CHAP. XV. 1-2] Ptolomy gives us this Rule; By the Sun his entrance into Aries, we are to judge the Events and Success of the Accidents of the Spring-Quarter... It seems to me most convenient and Natural in the Judgment of Annual Events to assume four Beginnings, Regard being had to the New and Full Moon next Preventional, especially if thereat either of the Luminaries are Eclipsed, and so give Judgment of the state of the Spring Quarter from the beginning of Aries, Summer from Cancer; of Autumn from Libra; of Winter from Capricorn.
rules.translation: Ptolomy 四正点法（世俗判岁）：以太阳入白羊之图判春季、巨蟹判夏、天秤判秋、摩羯判冬；兼取最临近之前次朔望（尤其其中日月蚀者）。日=世界之魂。
rules.notes: CHAP XV；Quadr. Lib.2 Chap.10；各国诸贤同此（亦参 Prev/Postvential 朔望与蚀）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [3] Origanus he proceeds yet farther, and sayes; We must observe not only in what form of Heaven the Luminaries move unto, but also in what manner they leave the Cardinal Points in their several Conjunctions and Oppositions: That is, to Erect three Figures for every Quarter, one for the Conjunction or Opposition of the Sun and Moon, preceding the Ingress; the second for the time of the Ingress it self; and the third for the Conjunction or Opposition succeeding or following the same.
rules.translation: Origanus 三图法：每季起三图——①入宫前之日月合/冲图、②入宫时刻图、③入宫后之日月合/冲图；合观以断该季。
rules.notes: CHAP XV §3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按升点座性定图效期与年主
rules.original_text: [4] But Haly, and Guido Bonatus were of another Opinion, and would have the Judgment of the Year deduced after this manner, viz. If at the Sun's Ingress into Aries the Ascendant shall be a Fixed Signe; then that Figure shall serve for the Judgment of the whole Year; and that Planet which is Almuten of the Figure shall be Lord of the whole Year; but if the Ascendant be a Common Signe, the Figure shall continue but half a year, and end at the Sun's entrance into Libra, for which moment another Scheme shall be Erected for the other half Year... But if the Ascendant be a Moveable Signe at the Sun's Ingress into Aries, then that Revolution Figure shall be of force but till the Sun enters Cancer, and New Schemes are to be Erected for the other three Quarters of the Year, and their several Almutens Elected, with this provisor, that the Lord of the first Quarter shall participate, or be Co-partner with the Lord of the second, and the Lord of the second with the Lord of the third, &c.
rules.translation: Haly & Bonatus 升点座性法：春分图升点=定座→此图判全年（Almuten=全年主）；变座→判半年（秋分另起图判后半）；动座→仅至夏至、另起三季图（季主递相 Co-partner：一季度主与二季度主、二与三…互参）。
rules.notes: CHAP XV §4；Almuten 概念=图中最强行星（见 Part I 尊贵表 p.85-86）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 尊贵最高者=年主星；以年返照判诸事
rules.original_text: [5] The Doctrine of Ptolomy is generally accepted to be the most Rational... Erect for every Year, Figures for the Sun's Ingress into the four Cardinal Points, Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn; as also the Lunations preceding, and succeeding the Sun's Ingress into the same Signs: then collect the Essential Dignities and Debilities of the Planets, viz. examine what Planet hath the most Testimonies of Strength in the Ascendant, Mid-heaven and the Places of the Luminaries, in each of the three aforesaid Figures, and that Planet so qualified shall be chief Ruler, or Almuten for that Revolution, or Lord of the Year. [6] We know by the Revolutional Figures of the years of the World, what accidents will happen each year, whether Good or Ill, Peace or War, Plenty or Scarcity; the Condition of Kings, Princes, Nobles, the Religious, and all other sorts and degrees of Men...
rules.translation: Ptolomy 法（最受推崇）：每年起四正点入宫图+前后朔望图；集升点/天顶/日月位三处之 Essential Dignities，最高分者=年主星（Almuten）。年返照图可判该年：和平/战争/丰歉、君王/贵族/宗教/诸色人等、物价贵贱、土地果实（Bonatus 引）。
rules.notes: CHAP XV §5-6；与 Part I 尊贵表联动——这是引擎'年主星=升/天顶/日月位尊贵最高'的可编码算法

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [7-12] In General Accidents from Saturn Judgment is drawn of Antiquities, of Sects, Schisms, Heresies, Renovation of Ancient Customs, Depopulation and Destruction of Kingdoms; he hath in particular Influence upon Monks, Fryers, Jesuits, all Jewish Ceremonies, Ruined or Antient Buildings, all sordid inhumane Debauchery, Shipwrecks, Captivities, Death, Famine, &c. Jupiter signifies Religion, the more Pure and Orthodox Principles, the Nobility and Gentry, the Clergy and Lawyers. From Mars Judgment is drawn concerning all Martial and Military Affairs, Wars, Commotions, Insurrections, Massacres, Persecutions, Fireing of Houses, Theft, Rapine, Tyranny. The Sun signifies new Monarchies, Empires, Kingdoms, Kings, Princes and Magistrates. From Venus Judgment is declared concerning all manner of Delights and Pleasure, Adulteries, Fornications, Women, Gameing, Sports; but a General Tranquility, and Plenty of all things. Mercury signifies all manner of Arts and Sciences, Merchants, Treasurers, Secretaries, Clerks, Scribes, Philosophers, Astronomers, Mathematicians, Accomptants; the Discovery of all secret devices, and all Ingenious Inventions. From the Moon Judgment is drawn concerning the Condition or State of the Common people; but she being but the Earths Attendant, cannot signifie such grand Alterations in the world, as the Primary and Superiour Planets do.
rules.translation: 七行星世俗征象（详见映射X）：土=古事/宗派分裂/异端/旧俗复兴/国毁/修士/犹太仪式/废墟/沉船/囚/死/饥；木=宗教正统/贵族绅士/教士/律师；火=军事战争/暴动/屠杀/迫害/焚屋/盗/暴政；日=新王朝/帝国/君王/官员；金=享乐/通奸/女性/赌博/安宁丰足；水=艺术科学/商人/司库/秘书/学者/发明；月=平民（次行星不能致大变迁）。
rules.notes: CHAP XV §7-12；映射X=七行星世俗征象全表

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 年返照+蚀/大会合/彗星合参
rules.original_text: [3+] Note that Annual Revolutions are rather Signes of what Accidents shall or may happen in each Respective Countrey, for which the Revolutional Figure is made, than Causes of Natural Events, and must be considered with other Over ruling Configurations and Phoenomena's; for a Revolutional Figure of the Sun's Ingress into any point of the Zodiac is not sufficient for the Judgment of the Year without the Consideration of Eclipses, great Conjunctions, Comets, Blazing-Stars, &c.
rules.translation: 通则：年返照是征兆（Signes）而非自然事件之因；单凭春分图不足判全年，必须参日月蚀、大会合、彗星/焰星等天象。
rules.notes: CHAP XV §3+（附注）；Coley 自注：星辰为神之铭文

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按落宫判施于何类事（映射E宫位事类）
rules.original_text: [CHAP. XVI. 2] Whatever portents shall be signified by the Lord of the Year will more especially be manifested in those Regions or Countreys subject to the Signe of his position; (as also of the Signe that Planet is in, which is in Aspect with the Lord of the Revolution) and the Nature thereof is taken from the consideration of the house of the Figure, wherein he is posited; If in the Ascendant, judge the effects may operate upon the Lives and persons of those people; if in the second house, in their Estates and Substance; if in the third House, in their Journeys and Relations; if in the fourth house, on their houses, Lands, and Inheritances, &c.
rules.translation: 年主星效应之所施：主要显现于年主星（及其照星）所在星座所属之地区；施于何类事项看年主星落宫——升=人身、2宫=财产、3宫=旅行亲戚、4宫=房屋土地、依宫序类推。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §2；宫位事类沿用 Part I 表

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [CHAP. XVI. 1] Observe what Planet is Lord of the Year, and if you find him well Dignified, it denotes a Plentiful Year, Temperate and Healthful for the People, Successful and Prosperous, and generally good in all the Significations of that Planet, Signe, and House; but if you find him weak and unfortunate, judge the contrary; especially if the Moon concur in Signification, for she is the General Significator of the People.
rules.translation: 年主星强弱通则：年主星本然强=丰年、温和健康、繁荣、诸事吉；弱而凶=反之；月（平民通征）同参则更验。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [3] Observe if the Lord of the Year be beheld by any Laudable Aspect of his Dispositer, and free from Impediment, this denotes good in its proper Signification; But if he be not well Aspected by his Dispositer, judge the contrary; viz. that Trouble and Anxiety may succeed; but if he be well beheld and not strong, or strong and not beheld by his Dispositer, judge between both, Consideratis Considerandis.
rules.translation: 年主星与 Dispositer 之照：年主星受其 Dispositer 吉照且无碍=其征象吉；不吉照=忧患；吉照而弱、或强而不受照=中判（Consideratis Considerandis）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按强弱断（强=兴造丰收；弱=严寒疾灾）
rules.original_text: [4] Saturn, Lord of the Year, and well disposed in the Figure, inclines the people of the Country to Build and Erect new Fabricks; the Husbandman shall much increase his Store, and be very sucessful in all his Labours; the People shall be Honoured and Esteemed, and Love one another: But if he be weak and afflicted, he portends much Cold, and many grievious infirmities, Damages, and Afflictions to Mankind; also the death of Ancient People in General. If Saturn be not Aspected of Mars, expect an extream cold Season for the most part in most Northern Countreys.
rules.translation: 土年主细则：土强=民兴造建筑/农夫丰储/民相爱敬；土弱受克=严寒/重疾/灾损/老人多亡；土未受火照=北方诸国极寒之季。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [5] Jupiter, Lord or Ruler of the Year, well posited, shews much Prosperity to the Nobility and Gentry, and to all sorts of Men of Religious Orders, or of the Ecclesiastical Function; also Lawyers... People in general shall live prosperously, with great Content and Respect to and from their Superiours; and this the more certain if Jupiter happen also to be in Reception with their Significator: But if Jupiter be Infortunate judge the contrary; or if Jupiter be in Conjunction or bad Aspect of Saturn, this portends much Sadness to Mankind; if Mars afflict Jupiter, judge much prejudice, Loss and Damage shall happen to persons of Dignity and Renown; If Jupiter be in no Aspect with any other Planet, it portends a very temperate Aire, and wholesome North-wind.
rules.translation: 木年主细则：木强=贵族/教士/律师兴隆、民富足受上敬（与征象星互容更验）；木凶=反之；木合/恶照土=民悲；火克木=贵人受损；木无相=温和空气与健康北风。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 强=军事荣；弱=反之；天蝎=雨雹
rules.original_text: [6] If Mars be Lord of the Year, and powerful and free from affliction, this portends much Felicity and Prosperity to all Martial Persons; Souldiers will now be very successful, and perform many notable Exploits, and overcome their Enemies; but if Mars he found weak, and ill posited, then judge the contrary in all particulars. Cardan sayes, if Mars be Lord of the Year, Great Heat follows, Burning of Houses, Lightning, Warrs, &c. If Mars be in Scorpio, it portends much Rain and Hail, unless he be joyned with other Planets; if so, moderate your Judgment accordingly.
rules.translation: 火年主细则：火强=军士胜利成名、荣；火弱=反之。Cardan：火年主=大热/焚屋/闪电/战争；火居天蝎=多雨雹（合他星则中和）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §6；Cardan 引

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 强=王民吉丰；卑且□冲=灾歉
rules.original_text: [7] If the Sun be Lord of the Year, and posted in some good place of the Figure strong, this denotes that the King and his Nobles shall not only be happy and Fortunate that Year, but shall be much esteemed and Honoured by the People... Corn, Cattle, and other Provisions shall be plenty; also Gold and all Solar things: But if the Sun be posited in an abject place, and in Square or Opposition of Saturn or Mars, judge the contrary; viz. much predjudice and Detriment to the aforesaid Persons, with scarcity of Provisions. The Sun alters the Seasons and Quarters of the Year as to change of Air, according as he happens to be in Configuration with other Planets; as if Saturn be with the Sun in Aspect to Mars, this increases the Cold in Winter, and abates the Heat in Summer, especially if they are in Cold Signes, or neer Fixed Stars of that Nature.
rules.translation: 日年主细则：日强=国王贵族幸福受民敬、民情佳、五谷六畜黄金丰；日居卑宫且□冲土火=反之、食物缺；日与其他行星配置改季候（土火照日=冬增寒夏减热，冷座/冷固定星更验）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [8] If Venus bear Rule, and have the chief Dominion of the Year, and well disposed, Haly sayes, that the year shall prove Fortunate and successful, the people shall thrive and prosper, and delight themselves in Sports and Recreations; they shall rejoyce and be merry, Feast and Contract many Marriages, Women shall delight in the society of their Husbands, and easily conceive and bear Children; but if Venus be not well qualified, judge the contrary. Venus bearing Rule in any Quarter or Revolution, usually increases Humidity in Winter, and abates Siccity in Summer or Autumn, and this the more certain if her position be in a moist or watry Signe, viz. Scorpio, Cancer, or Pisces; or if she be in a moist Asterisme, and in Aspect to no Planet of a contrary Nature, as Mars in particular.
rules.translation: 金年主细则：金强=丰年/民乐/婚嫁多/女易孕（Haly）；金弱=反之；金主季度=冬增湿、夏秋减燥（居湿/水座——天蝎巨蟹双鱼更验、无火照）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §8；Haly 引

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 强=学术发明兴；弱=反之；多风
rules.original_text: [9] If Mercury be Dominus totius Anni, or chief Ruler of the Year, and well seated in the Figure, free from Impediments, Haly, Part 8. Chap. 6. tells us, it denotes much Profit and good success to all persons addicted to Learning and Science; as Mathematicians, Philosophers, Poets; also to Merchants, and Tradesmen, Artificers, &c. Men should be much addicted to the searching after New and Curious Inventions this Year; but if you find Mercury afflicted, the contrary may be expected. Mercury usually produces much diversity, and varies the Quality of the Air, and corrupts the Winds according to the Nature or Quality of the Signe he is posited in; generally he produces great Winds, &c.
rules.translation: 水年主细则：水强=学者/数学家/哲人/诗人/商人/工匠获利、好奇发明兴（Haly P.8 Ch.6）；水弱=反之；水使空气多变、依座性乱风、大体多风。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §9；Haly Part 8 Chap. 6 引

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [10] If the Moon be Lady of the Year, and well disposed, this promises Felicity to great Persons of the Female Sex, and to the Common People in general, for now Men enjoy their Healths well, and deal justly one with another; 'tis a very calm and tranquil time, but if you find the Moon chief governess of the Year, and ill disposed, judge the contrary in all respects. And note that the Quality of the Air is frequently altered every month, when the Moon meets with the body of the Sun; the Moon is accounted warm and moist in her first Quarter; in her second Quarter warm and dry; in the third cold and dry, and in the fourth cold and moist; if the Moon have Dominion, she produces by her gentle Influence, plenty of seasonable Showers. If you find the Lord of the Year strong in the Ascendant... the Ascendant in a Figure of the world represents the Common People, and general state of the Kingdome or Countrey.
rules.translation: 月年主细则：月强=女性贵人与平民吉、人康健公平、安靖；月弱=反之。月行四相改气：一相温热、二相温干、三相冷干、四相冷湿；月主年=及时甘霖。年主星强居升（升=人民与国情）且月吉照=平民福受上敬；受克=民受扰。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §10；月=平民通征；月合日改月令之气

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按星座性质表+行星尊卑断
rules.original_text: [10+] Aries is Violent, Cancer Sudden, Libra Moderate, Capricorn Slow, Taurus Heavy, Gemini Nimble, Leo Valiant, Virgo Barbarous, Scorpio False and Treacherous, Sagittarius Manly, Aquarius Sober and Moderate, Pisces Cowardly. Great Actions have the superiour Planets for their Significators, Petty matters are from the inferiours. Saturn in Aries shews high matters transacted with fear and care, but in Taurus with great Labour to no purpose; in Gemini with much speech to no effect, &c.
rules.translation: 星座性质表：白羊Violent、巨蟹Sudden、天秤Moderate、摩羯Slow、金牛Heavy、双子Nimble、狮子Valiant、处女Barbarous、天蝎False/Treacherous、射手Manly、水瓶Sober/Moderate、双鱼Cowardly（详见映射Z）。大事=上星主、小事=下星主；土居白羊=高事而惧、金牛=苦劳无成、双子=多言无效。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §10末；映射Z=星座性质全表

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 理性+历史对照+蚀/彗/合参证
rules.original_text: [10末-11] It is the Opinion and Advice of my Honoured Friend Mr. William Lilly, that an Artist ought rather to judge by the strength of his Reason guided by Art, from the Consideration of the Aspects and mixtures of the Planets, than from ill concocted Aphorismes laid down by some Authors... Ptolomy writ judiciously when he in his first Aphorisme of his Centiloquium begins with Arte & Scientia. He that would be excellent in these General Judgments, should be conversant in Histories... a general Calamity and Misery never afflicts any People, but you shall find Saturn much concerned, Peace and Plenty are from the Influence of Jupiter; Commotions from Saturn, the Moon and Mars; Warrs from Mars and the Sun. Consider what Fixed Stars of first or second Magnitude are neer the Place of any Greater or lesser Conjunction or Comet... whether the Declination be North or South, also their Colour.
rules.translation: 方法论语（Lilly）：以理性+艺术（行星相位与混合）判断，优于劣质格言；Ptolomy 首句 Arte & Scientia。历史对照法：查古时行星尊卑/彗星/大会合/日月蚀。灾=土重涉、和平丰足=木、动乱=土木月、战争=火日；参近处一/二等固定星、彗星之南北赤纬与颜色。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI §10末-11；Lilly 意见；此条为元方法论而非判据

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [CHAP. XVII. 1-3] The Moon is a Dark and Opacous Body, receiving light of the Sun by Reflection. At the Ecliptical Conjunction of the Luminaries (or New Moon) the Dark Body of the Moon passeth directly between the Sun and us, and doth hide or Eclipse him from our sight: But at an Ecliptical Opposition (or Full Moon) the Sun, the Moon and the Earth are in one Direct and Diametrical Line, the Dark Globe of the Earth being between the Sun and Moon, doth deprive the Moon of the Sun's Light. The Line or way wherein the Moon maketh her continual Periodical Revolutions, doth cross the Ecliptick, whereon the Sun doth alwayes move at an Angle of about five degrees; and the distance of these Lines is the Moon's Latitude; the places where these Lines Cross each other, are called the Dragons Head, and Tayl, and these places of the Moon's Nodes are not alwayes in one place of the Ecliptick, but move once through the same, contrary to the sequel or succession of the Signes in eighteen years and two hundred twenty one dayes.
rules.translation: 蚀之成因：月=暗体借日反光。朔（黄道合）时月体过日地之间=日蚀；望（黄道冲）时地居日月之间、地影蔽月=月蚀。月道与黄道交角约5°=黄纬；交点=龙首/龙尾；交点在黄道逆行，18年221日一周。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §1-3；交点周期18年221天=引擎算法参数

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [4] If the Moon at the Full be distant from the Dragons Head or Tayl more than 15 degrees there can be no Eclipse of the Moon; and when at the time of the Change, the Moon is more than 19 degr. distant from the Dragons Head, according to the succession of the Signes, or from the Tayl more than 19 degrees, contrary to the succession of the Signes there can be no Eclipse of the Sun; neither can there be any Eclipse of the Sun when the Moon at the Change is above seven degrees from the Tayl, according to the succession of the Signes, or more than seven degrees from the Head, contrary to the sequel of the Signes.
rules.translation: 蚀限（引擎算法参数）：望时月距交点>15°无月蚀；朔时月距龙头>19°（顺）或龙尾>19°（逆）无日蚀；朔时距龙尾>7°（顺）或龙头>7°（逆）无日蚀。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §4；15/19/7 三蚀限=可编码阈值

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 日蚀随视差异、月蚀同见
rules.original_text: [5-6] Eclipses of the Sun are various both in Quantity and Quality, being beheld from several parts of the Earth... The Reason whereof is the Sun his Eclipses is not indeed obscured, but only hid from our sight by the Interposition of the Moon, whose various parallaxes cause this diversity. The Eclipse of the Moon appeareth in like manner and quantity to all those above whose Horizon she is at the time thereof.
rules.translation: 蚀之可见性：日蚀因月之视差不同，各地所见蚀量与方位各异（北侧/南侧/全不见）；月蚀对当时地平之上者同见同量。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §5-6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [7] For the more Methodical Estimation of the Quantities of Eclipses, their Diameters are supposedly divided into twelve equal parts, called Digits, because their Diameters appear to sight about a foot in length, so that when the Moon hideth half the Sun's Diameter, he is said to be fix Digits Eclipsed, &c.
rules.translation: 蚀量 Digit 制：蚀体直径分12等分=12 Digit；月蔽日径之半=6 Digits 蚀。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §7；Digit 制=引擎输出蚀量单位

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 地圆/地中/日地距差等天文结论
rules.original_text: [8-15] Amongst the Coelestial Phoenomena the Doctrine of Eclipses takes precedency, because from their Observations the primary Foundation of the whole Body of Astronomy is Confirmed and Demonstrated. Solar Eclipses do manifest the Moon to be lower, and less than the Sun: Lunar Eclipses do manifest that the Earth is on every side perfectly Round or Terminated by a Globular Figure... Lunar Eclipses demonstrate the shadow of the Earth to be Conical, terminating in a sharp point... By Eclipses also of the Moon we know that the Earth is moved (or placed) in the middle of the Zodiac, because she is Eclipsed in the Opposite places thereof. The Lunar Eclipses best discover to us the Longitude of places upon the Earth, and assure us that the Earth and Water make but one Globe... The true and certain place of the Moon cannot be had by any Instrument whatsoever, because of her Parallaxes; the God of Nature hath supplyed this defect by her Eclipses. By Lesser Eclipses we gather that the Sun is far greater than the Earth, and the Moon lesser; so by Solar Eclipses are Demonstrated the distance of the Luminaries from the Earth to be different...
rules.translation: 蚀学之天文验证义：蚀观测为天文学之基石——日蚀证月低于小于日；月蚀证地为球（影圆/东西计时差）、地影圆锥、地居黄道中、定经度、日月距地不同（偏心/本轮）。月真位唯蚀可确证（视差故）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §8-15；科学内容，与预兆无关

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [16] By Eclipses of the Luminaries, the God of Nature fore-warns this Sinful World of the Revolutions of Kingdoms and States, the Death and Detriment of Princes, Governours, and Great Men; of Heresies, Sects, and Seditions in the Church; Alterations of Laws and Customs, of Drought and Inundations of Rivers, Wars, Famine, Plague, and Pestilence; in fine, the Vicissitude of all Sublunary things.
rules.translation: 蚀为警世之兆：王国更迭/君王大臣之死/教会异端教派叛乱/律法风俗之变/旱涝/战争/饥荒/瘟疫——凡月下万物之变。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII §16；预兆类，仅规则引擎研究

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 被蚀位+后继角宫最强星=蚀主
rules.original_text: [CHAP. XVIII. 1] Erect your Coelestial Scheme to the middle time of your Eclipse, and observe what Planet is Lord thereof, according to Ptolomy's Rule, viz. Take the place of the Luminary Eclipsed, and the Angle succeeding it, which must alwayes be the Ascendant or Mid-heaven in a visible Eclipse, that is to say, the Ascendant, if the Eclipse happen in the Oriental Quarter, before Noon, or the Mid-heaven if after Noon.
rules.translation: 蚀主星择定（Ptolomy 法）：以蚀之中时起图；取被蚀光体之位+其后继之角宫——日蚀在东方象限（午前）取升点、午后取天顶；该处最强者=蚀主。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §1；Ptolomy 法可编码：蚀图升/天顶尊贵最高者

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [2] It is the Judgment of Origanus, Chap. 2. Part 3. de Effectibus, that we ought to take that Planet to be Lord of the Eclipse, who hath most Dignities in the Ascendant, Mid-heaven, and place of the Eclipse: If one Planet hath not the same Dominion in both places, or in the aforesaid three, then accept of that Planet who is Lord of the place Deficient, with this Caution, that the Planet who hath most Dignities in the aforesaid place of the Eclipse, shall be Co-partner, or joyned with him in Dominion. If many Planets claim an equal share, yet that Planet who is Angular, Oriental, or Direct, &c. shall be preferred before the other.
rules.translation: 蚀主星择定（Origanus 法）：取升点/天顶/蚀位三处尊贵最高者为蚀主；不全同者取蚀位之宫主，而以蚀位最高尊贵者为 Co-partner；并列时角宫/东出/顺行为先。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §2；并列优先序=角宫>东出>顺行——可编码排序规则

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [3] When Saturn is Lord of an Eclipse, He is generally the Cause of Corruptions by reason of Cold; continued Diseases, a general decay of Nature, Wasting or a Consumption from some deflux of Rhume, disturbance of the Radical Humours, Fluxes, Quartane Agues, Banishments, Poverty, Misery, Lamentation, vain Fears, Mortality of old Men especially, a scarcity of such Cattle as are useful for Mankind. In the Aire violent Colds, tedious Frosty Weather, Cloudy and Pestilent, Misty and Foggy, much Snow. In Rivers and the Sea strange Tempests, sudden Shipwracks, Scarcity of Fish, and Water Fowl, Overflowings of the Sea-Banks, Inundations and Corruption of Rivers. Upon the Earth a scarcity of Corn and Fruit, Provisions Dear, Grass and Hay destroyed by Floods, Hail, Storms, whence Famine may be feared; Aged Persons now dye more; much Controversie, Malice and Envy between men, and tedious Law-suits follow, especially amongst the most Rural sort.
rules.translation: 土蚀主预兆：人身=冷腐/久病/消耗/根液扰/四日疟/流放/贫困/哀恸/虚惧/老人多亡/畜病；空气=酷寒霜雪霾雾；海=风暴沉船/鱼鸟稀/堤溃河滥；地=谷果贵/洪水饥荒/乡土间多讼。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §3；映射Y=七行星蚀主预兆对照表

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [4] When Jupiter bears Rule, or has the chiefest Dominion in an Eclipse, he produces the increase of all things in general; As to Men, increase of Riches and Goods, Glory, Fertility, Tranquility, Peace and Plenty: every person signified by Jupiter enjoyes Health of Body, and Peace of mind; many times they receive Favour or Gifts from great Persons; Magistrates, and Rulers have Honour and Fame confirmed upon them. All Creatures fit for the use of Man do now increase. Jupiter declares a wholsome temperature of the Air, moderate and seasonable Showers. Merchants and Saylers receive little or no Damage, but make prosperous Voyages: Ecclesiastical Persons are advanced to great preferment: now the Laws are well executed... new Customs or Priviledges, new Corporations, new Honours are now most happily conferr'd upon the People in General.
rules.translation: 木蚀主预兆：万物增长——人=富足/荣/和平丰稔/受贵人恩/法司清明/新权新法新公司；健康；合用之畜增、害物毁；空气温和及时雨；商旅安利；教士升迁。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按映射Y火蚀主行断；吉照缓解
rules.original_text: [5] If the Planet Mars be Lord of the Eclipse, he usually by his influence stirs up amongst men Warrs, Tumults, Intestine Hatred, Distentions, and much Violence, Imprisonments, Banishments, sudden Death, the wrath of Men of the highest degree: Tertian Feavers, and divers diseases proceeding from the Corruption of Blood: many Roberies and Manslaughters, Lawsuits, Duels, Burning of houses. In the Air Thunder and Lightning; unwholsome or Infectious Winds, and notable Droughts. In the Seas Terrible Shipwracks, and Tempestuous violent Storms: he dries up Rivers, and signifies a Dearth or Scarcity of Corne. Nothing but Mischief can rationally be expected to follow, unless at that time some other Planet of a more Gentle Influence happen by his Friendly Rayes in part to Aleviate his Malice.
rules.translation: 火蚀主预兆：战争动乱/囚禁流放/暴死/三日疟血腐病/盗杀/讼斗/焚屋；空气=雷电毒风旱；海=沉船风暴/河干/谷歉；除非柔星吉照缓其恶（通则：凶星恶可由吉照缓解）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按映射Y金蚀主行断（弱吉）
rules.original_text: [5+] Venus is accounted a Planet of gentle Influence and hath signification equivolent to that of Jupiter: To Mankind she produces kind effects, Fortunate Marriages, many Children, increase of Honour, much Joy, Health of Body and Plenty, a wholsome Air, and a very fruitful Season, and all things contrary to what has been exprest may be the Effects of Mars, though not so powerfully; for Venus is an Inferiour Planet.
rules.translation: 金蚀主预兆：吉（同木而弱——金星为次星）：婚嫁/多子/荣/乐/健康/丰年/空气好/季候丰。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §5末；金=柔星、效同木而弱

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 按所合星取兆；盗贼风雷
rules.original_text: [5末] Mercury is a Planet Controvertible in Nature, and Operates in his Influence according to the Nature or Quality of that Planet he is joyned with by Body or Aspect; but generally in Humane Affairs he signifies much Subtilty, and a quick dispatch of what matters may be in Controversie; he signifies Robbers upon the Highwayes, and Pyrates at Sea; and as to Diseases of Mankind, Coughs, Consumptions, Quotidian Feavers, &c. In the Aire, High Winds, Thunder and Lightning, with sudden Tempests, much prejudicial to the Fruits of the Earth: If he be Lord of an Eclipse, and joyned by Body or Aspect to any other Planet, mixt the Portent of that Planet more especially.
rules.translation: 水蚀主预兆：性变（依所合之星取兆）；人事=诡诈/速断；盗/海贼；疾=咳/消耗/日疟；空气=大风雷电暴风伤果；蚀主水+合某星则取该星之兆为主。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §5末；水=Controvertible（性随所合）——引擎须先判合星

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 火风/火座蚀=焚屋；土土/水座+火恶照=洪震
rules.original_text: [6] If at an Eclipse of the Sun Mars be chief Gubernator thereof, and posited in an Airy or Fiery Signe, and also Lord of the Year, this portends Fireing or Burning of houses. If Saturn be Lord of the year and place of Heaven wherein the defect falls free from affliction, and posited in Earthy or Watry Signes, Mars at the fame time being ill aspected, Authors say it signifies Inundations or Earthquakes.
rules.translation: 特例：日蚀主火+居风/火座+又为年主=焚屋之兆；年主土居土/水座无克、火恶照=洪水或地震之兆。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [7] Eclipses of the Luminaries in the Firy Triplicity, threatens the Distruction of Sheep and Oxen, &c., also the Banishment, Imprisonment, or Deposition of some Great Person, with Discord and Hatred between the Common People and some great Ruler: many Repinings, Grudgings, and Dissentions; Motions of Armies, much Warr and Slaughter of Men, Burning of Houses, Depopulations, Rapes, Thefts, Sharp Feavers, Pestilent Diseases, Abortive Births, scarcity of Fruit and Corn; and these things will happen principally in those Countries or Regions that are subject to the Signe Eclipsed. But if either of the Luminaries happen to be Eclipsed in the Earthy Triplicity, this portends a scarcity of Corn and Fruit; if in the Airy Triplicity, it betokens Famine, pestilent Diseases, with Stormy Tempestious Winds; If it happen in the Watry Triplicity, this portends the Death of the most Inferiour common sort of people; also Warrs, Destruction of Fish and Fowl, and all such Creatures that live in or neer the Water.
rules.translation: 四元质三合蚀兆（主应于蚀座所属地区）：火象三合=毁羊牛/大人物流放囚禁/民与君不和/兵动/焚屋/流产/果谷缺；土象=谷果歉；风象=饥荒瘟疫风暴；水象=下民多亡/战/水族之毁。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §7；Junctinus de Eclipsibus 引；映射X2=四元质三合蚀兆表

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 角宫=损身；小时=年/月；比例定生效期
rules.original_text: [8] Ptolomy tells us that an Eclipse of either of the Luminaries falling in any of the Angles of a Nativity or Annual Revolution portends much Detriment to the Native; the same if it happen in the Radical place of the Sun or Moon: and Hermes sayes there shall be many Troubles happen in the world when both the Luminaries shall be eclipsed in one moneth; and especially in such places where there is a particular Signification of them. Note that so many hours as the Sun is Eclipsed, so many years will the Effects thereof continue; but if it be a Lunar Eclipse, judge so many Moneths: As to the time when the Effects begin to operate, observe at the middle of the Eclipse how far the Luminary Eclipsed is distant in time from its Rising, and how long it continues above the Horizon, Reduce this time into Minutes, and say by the Golden Rule, if the whole continuance of the Luminary above the Horizon give one year or 365 dayes, what shall the time from the Eclipse give?
rules.translation: 蚀落本命/年返角宫=大损于本人（落日月本命位亦然）；Hermes：一月内日月俱蚀=世间多事（尤其其征处）。蚀效计时：日蚀 N 小时=N 年、月蚀 N 月；生效期以 Golden Rule 算——蚀体在地平上时间与全日之比→年月。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII §8；计时法可编码：蚀时长(h)→年/月；地平上时间比例→生效期（Origanus 认为蚀即日生效）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 非长寿多病；土金互容+月六合土=缓
rules.original_text: [SECT. I. Paragr. I.] Is the Querent Long-liv'd? Here I find Saturn the Lord of the Ascendant in Capricorn his own House, in the twelfth, in Square of Venus, Lady of the eighth (or House of Death) and the Moon lately in Opposition of Mars from Angles, Mercury is also Lord of the fourth, Combust of the Sun light of the time in the eighth. Hence I conclude, that according to causes, the Querent is not long lived, but subject to Disease... But this Judgment is in part mittigated by reason Saturn and Venus are in Reception by Exaltation, and Triplicity, and the Moon locally in the Ascendant, and in Sextile to Saturn.
rules.translation: 判例一·问寿：升主土星居12宫摩羯本宫、□金星（8宫主=死宫主）；月刚自角宫离火星之冲；水星（4宫主）灼于8宫（死宫、近日光）→按因非长寿、多病（月6宫主受火克）寿短；然土金擢升/三体互容、月居升六合土→其判部分缓释。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.I；Part II 示例盘

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 不在家而近家、同伴为水所表
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] If the Question were, Is the Party at Home I would speak withal? Here I take the Lord of the seventh, viz. the Sun to be his Significator, and finding him not to be in an Angle, I conclude the party is not at home, but neer home, because the Sun is in a succedent House viz. the eighth, neer the Southwest quarter in Conjunction of Mercury representing the person he is in company withal, and probably the Querent may be directed to him by some female servant, because the Moon, Lady of the sixth, was lately in Opposition of Mars, who is posited in the seventh House.
rules.translation: 判例二·问人在家否：7宫主=日（无亲之人以7宫主表之）；日不居角（居续宫8宫、近西南、☌水=同伴）→不在家而近家；月6宫主刚离火冲（火居7宫）→或由女仆引至。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.II；7宫主=无亲者之征（IIA CE-078）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 今康、近历死险/大病；夫/亲族境恶
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] If the Question were, Is the Absent Party Dead or Alive? If the Party be not Related, then the Ascendant & his Lord, with the Moon, signifies the Absent Party; finding Saturn Lord of the Ascendant in his own Dignities, and in Sextile to the Moon, I may hope well that the Quesited is at present in health; but by reason Saturn is in Square to Venus, Lady of the eighth, and posited in an abject House, he hath been in some danger of death, or lately undergone some sharp conflict with a Disease; the Moon lately afflicted by Mars, Lord of the ninth and second Houses, may intimate trouble in mind concerning Religion, or by reason of some long journey, or probably suffered for the want of Moneys, and thereby Imprisonment, because Saturn is in the twelfth house.
rules.translation: 判例三·问缺席者死活：非亲者以升+其主+月表之——土（升主）本尊六合月→今康有望；然土□金8宫主且居卑宫→近历死险或大病；月受火（9/2宫主）克→心忧宗教/远行、或乏钱被囚（土居12宫）。若问夫/妻则以日7宫主与7宫内火断之（日居8宫在土四分之容许内=境恶）；问兄弟姊妹亲族同理（金3宫主受土□自凶位、其损自问主（土=凶星通征）而起）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.III；亲疏取征规则（IIA CE-078）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 今安、近历覆船海盗之险
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Is a ship at sea, in Safety or Danger? The Ascendant, and the Moon being Significators of the Ship, and Lord thereof, & Saturn of those persons in her. Finding Saturn so strong in his own Dignities, and in Sextile to the Moon, the Ship at present is safe and free from danger. But Saturn hath & still is in Square to Venus, Lady of the eighth, & the Moon lately separated from the Opposition of Mars intimates that they have lately been in great perplexities, & in danger of Death, or being Cast away, but also of Pyrates... this Judgment is the more to be credited by reason Saturn is also Lord of the twelfth, and in the twelfth, having great Dignities in the eighth, and Mars Lord of the ninth, Angular, lately beholding the Moon by a Malevolent Aspect.
rules.translation: 判例四·问海船安危：升+月=船与其载、土=船上人——土强本尊六合月→今安无险；然土□金8宫主+月刚离火冲→近历大险（死/覆船/海盗）；土兼12宫主居12宫且8宫大尊、火9宫主角宫恶照月→益验其险。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.IV；船判法见 IIA CE-082

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 无大险、有小损；慎权贵流言
rules.original_text: [Paragr. V.] If the Question were, Shall good or ill succeed the thing that hath suddenly happened? I find Mars Lord of the House of the Sun, Jupiter of the House the Moon is in, intercepted in Pisces in the Ascendant, and Saturn Lord of the Ascendant in his own Dignities, here Saturn is strongest, and in Sextile to the Moon, which intimates the Querent needs not much fear danger, but yet he will not be altogether freed from some kind of prejudice... Because Saturn is also Lord of the twelfth, and in Square to Jupiter Lord of the tenth from Cardinal Signes, and the Dispositer of the Moon in the Ascendant, which advises the Querent to beware of a Magistrate, or Man in Power, or some Scandal (for the Dragons Tail is in the tenth) occasioned by some secret Enemy, and the Querents own Head-strong Actions.
rules.translation: 判例五·问突发事吉凶：火（日宫之主）、木（月宫之主、截居双鱼升内）、土（升主本尊）——土最强且六合月→无需大惧、然不免小损；土兼12宫主、□木（10宫主、月之Dispositor）自角宫→慎权贵/当权/流言（龙尾10宫）——由暗敌与己卤莽之行而起。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.V

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 膝/左足/胸各一记；宫位定部位
rules.original_text: [Paragr. VI.] If it were desired to know what Marks, Moles or Scars the Querent hath about his Body. The Querent should have another upon, or neer one of his Knees, because Saturn is in Capricorn, afflicted by the Square of Venus; also another upon one of his feet, but not so apparent, because the Moon in Pisces is not yet past the Opposition of Mars, and this should be upon the left foot, because Pisces is a Feminine Signe, and the Moon a Feminine Planet; you may also discover another upon the Breast, for Cancer descends upon the Cusp of the sixth, the Moon afflicted as before. A Planet in the Ascendant discovers one upon the Head or Face; a Planet in the second, a mark upon the Neck or Throat, &c.
rules.translation: 判例六·问身体胎记：土居摩羯受金（8宫主）之□→膝上或近膝一记；月居双鱼未过火冲→足上一记（左足：双鱼与月俱阴）；巨蟹临6宫头+月受克→胸上一记。宫位胎记法：星居升=头面之记、居2宫=颈喉之记、依宫位类推。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.VI；体貌占断类，置信度低

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 宫-星座-行星对应表（轮转）
rules.original_text: Note that the twelve Houses have for their Cosignificators, the twelve Signes, and seven Planets, beginning with Aries and Saturn, for the first House; and Taurus and Jupiter the second; Gemini and Mars for the third, and so on to the rest, beginning again with Saturn for the Cosignificator of the eighth House.
rules.translation: 宫位共征表（十二宫共征十二星座与七行星，轮转）：1宫=白羊+土、2宫=金牛+木、3宫=双子+火、4宫=巨蟹+日、5宫=狮子+金、6宫=处女+水、7宫=天秤+月、8宫=天蝎+土、9宫=射手+木、10宫=摩羯+火、11宫=水瓶+日、12宫=双鱼+金（第八宫起土星复始轮转）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.VI 末；可编码为宫位-星座-行星三映射

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [SECT. II. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent be Rich, or ever attain to any Competent Fortune? I Consider Mars is Lord of the second, and posited in Virgo, the House of Mercury intercepted in the seventh, and Jupiter located in the second in Aries Retrograde, but in Sextile to the Part of Fortune in the fifth House in Gemini who is beheld by a Trine of Mercury, Dispositer thereof, and the Moon vertually in the second House, the House of Substance; all which promise a very Competent Fortune to the Querent, according to his Degree or Capacity.
rules.translation: 判例一·问致富：2宫主火居处女（水之家、截于7宫）；木居2宫白羊逆行、六合5宫双子之福点（福点受水三合、水为其Dispositor）；月虚入2宫（财宫）→按身份才具可至颇足之财。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.I

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 赌博/五宫之事或妻财、以才智成富
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] If it be Enquired by what Means it shall be Obtained? Finding the Lord of the second in the seventh, disposited of by Mercury, who is also the Dispositer of the Part of Fortune in the fifth, I conclude the Querent may be a Gainer by Gameing, or by following such things that are signified from the fifth House, as being a Player, or by keeping an Ale-house, or Tavern and the like, or by the means of a Wife, the reason is the Lord of the second is in the seventh, & in Reception with his Dispositer, and Venus being so strong in the eighth, the House of the Wives Substance confirms the same. In fine, the Querent may arrive to a competent Fortune by the exercise of his Wit... in the procuring of a Wife, and thereby raise his Fortune.
rules.translation: 判例二·问何法致富：2宫主居7宫、为水（福点Dispositor）所容→赌博/五宫之事（玩家/开酒馆客栈）或妻之助（2宫主在7宫与Dispositor互容、金强居8宫=妻财之宫为证）；终以才智娶妻以成其富。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] Shall the Estate I now posses be Durable, or Continue? I consider the Cusp of the second House is Aries, a movable Signe, and Jupiter Retrograde therein, and the Lord of the 2d. in Virgo having no Dignities there. And lastly, Mercury the Dispositer of the Part of Fortune is combust of the Sun, to which I may add Venus, the Significatrix of a Wives Substance, she being in Square to Saturn; All which are Arguments of its no long continuance... Jupiter in the second is in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, which intimates the Querent will be Extravagant, and addicted to illicit Courses, and thereby deminish, and at length totally wast what Substance he had before heaped together: he ought also to beware of trusting, for loss is threatened by Debts likewise, because the Lady of the eighth beholds the Lord of the Ascendant, Saturn, by a Square from Cardinal Signes, and from bad Houses, she being in Opposition to Jupiter from the same Signes also.
rules.translation: 判例三·问产业持久否：2宫头白羊（动座）、木逆其中、2宫主居处女无尊、水（福点Dispositor）灼于日、金（妻财征象）□土→不持久、所得速耗；木居2宫□土升主→奢靡、行邪途、渐损尽前积；慎信托——金8宫主自角宫恶照土升主且冲木→债务之损，宜倍勤勉以缓。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.III

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 升月遇木体时=得财；升冲火=身财损
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] The time when the increase of Fortune may happen: Authors advise to take the degrees of distance, that the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon wants of a perfect Sextile or Trine Aspect of the promising Planet, and thereby to proportion out the time; observing also that fixed Signs prolong the expectation; double bodyed Signs shew a medium; moveable Signes give great hast; and this must be conjectur'd at by discretion whether to give dayes, weeks, months, or years... where the business is of consequence, the time is best pointed out by the direction of the several Significators, to their Promittors. In this Figure, when the Ascendant or the Moon meets the Body of Jupiter by direction is the most hopeful time of gain, and the Ascendant directed to the Opposition of Mars, Lord of the second, shews prejudice both to Body and Estate.
rules.translation: 判例四·问进财时机：度距法——1宫主/月距吉星六合三合成相之度数按比例计时；定座迟、双体中、动座速；按事酌定日月年；大事以方向法为确。本盘：升/月方向遇木体=最有望得财之时；升向2宫主火之冲=身财两损。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.IV；度距计时法可编码（IIA CE-080 同构）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 费力得部分；王公之债得而有烦
rules.original_text: [Paragr. V.] Shall I receive the Money I have lent? Consider the Sun, who is Lord of the seventh, signifies the Person, and the Lady of the eighth, Venus, his Substance. The party is in a Capacity to pay, because Venus is in Libra, her own Dignity; but being in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, signifies no great willingness to part with his Money, and the rather because the Sun is within his Orbs of a Square of Saturn also; but by reason there is reception between Saturn and Venus, the Querent with much ado may at length procure some Moneys, though perhaps not all the Debt; for Venus is in Opposition to Jupiter from the eighth and second, the two houses representing both parties Substance. If you did expect Moneys from some Noble-man, then consider the Lord of the tenth, Jupiter, who is in the Querents second, he is also Lord of the eleventh and denotes the Noble-man's Substance, and disposes of the Moon, but in Square to Saturn, which intimates the Querent may have his Money, but with some trouble...
rules.translation: 判例五·问讨债：日（7宫主）=债务人、金（8宫主）=其财——金居天秤本尊→有偿债之能；然金□土升主、日亦在土四分之容许内→其无大愿付；土金互容→费力终得部分（非全债——金冲木自8/2两宫=双方财宫相碍）。若望王公之债：10宫主木居问者2宫（兼11宫主=贵人之财）Dispose月、然□土→得钱而有烦/受贵人之色。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.V；8宫=债务人之财（IIA CE-089）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [SECT. III. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent and his Brethren, Sisters or Neighbours Agree together? Finding Venus, Lady of the 3d, in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, this argues but small Love; nay, it is an Argument of almost perfect hatred between the Querent and those Relations; here both their Significators are in their own Dignities, strong and potent (though accidentally posited in bad Houses) which intimates the Querent and his Relations are very high, and care not one for the other, but stand upon their Reputation, the one scorning to stoop or submit to the other, yet the Querent will expect the most observance.
rules.translation: 判例一·问兄弟姊妹邻居相合：金（3宫主）□土（升主）→少爱、几近憎恶；双方征象俱本尊强（虽偶发居凶宫）→各守其荣、互不相让、问者犹期望最大之顺从。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT III Paragr.I

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] If the Question be concerning an Inland Journey, whether it may be Prosperous? Venus, Lady of the third House, is strong in her own Essential Dignities, and therefore denotes a prosperous Journey; but being in Square to Saturn, & Opposition to Jupiter, it declares rather that the Querent shall receive prejudice thereby, both to his Purse, and Person, and probably light amongst Thieves, who may endanger his Life. In short, the person of the Querent is by the Figure threatned with eminent danger, in case he takes his Journey, and therefore he ought to be disswaded from it.
rules.translation: 判例二·问内陆旅行吉否：金3宫主本然强→途本身吉；然金□土+冲木→反损囊与身、恐遇盗有性命之危——图示明险、当劝阻勿行。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT III Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] If the Question be, Is the Report true or false? I then consider the Lord of the Ascendant, and the Moon and her Dispositer; now the Lord of the Ascendant being in Square to Venus and Jupiter, the Dispositer of the Moon, (as well as Lord of the tenth) and the Moon lately separated from an Opposition of Mars, this argues there is but small probability that the News is true, and this the rather, because the Angles of the tenth, and fourth Houses are not fixed, but Common-Bi-corporeal, or double bodyed Signes.
rules.translation: 判例三·问流言真伪：1宫主与月及月之Dispositor——土□金与木（月Dispositor兼10宫主）、月刚离火冲→流言不真；10/4宫头皆双体座→益验其伪。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT III Paragr.III

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Concerning the Advice of a Friend, whether it be for Good or Evil? Finding the Dragons Tail in the tenth House, and the Lord of the tenth, Jupiter Retrograde, and in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, I thence conclude the Counsel or Advice of this pretended Friend is not given with an honest intent, but that he meant thereby to injure the Querent, and therefore let him by no means take this deceitful Admonition.
rules.translation: 判例四·问朋友建议吉凶：龙尾10宫、10宫主木逆且□土升主→此伪友之谏非善、意在伤问主→断不可从。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT III Paragr.IV

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [SECT. IV. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent Purchase the House or Land he is about? Here Mercury is Lord of the fourth House, Combust of the Sun in the eighth, & both within their Orbs of a Square Aspect, with Saturn Lord of the Ascendant, the Sun denotes the Seller, Mercury the Land, and being in Square to Saturn, the Buyers Significator; this argues both it will be purchased with great toyl, expence & pains, and that the Seller is indifferent whether he deals with the Querent or not. Although Mercury be Combust, and may denote some incombrance upon the House or Land, yet 'tis a frequent thing for Mercury to be neer the Sun, I look upon that affliction the less considerable: Mercury being Dispositer of the Part of Fortune, and the Dragons Head in the fourth, doth somewhat abate the evil, and argues the Land to be good, the Moon and Saturn beholding the Cusp of the fourth by benevolent Aspects (Sextile and Trine within Orbes) declare a willingness in the Querent to it, and that with much ado, he may at last obtain his desire, although the Seller be a person of a contrary nature.
rules.translation: 判例一·问购房地：水4宫主灼于8宫、与土（升主=买方）在容许内相□；日=卖方、水=土地——购之费大力/高价/多劳、卖方不在乎成否；水灼虽示宅地有累（然水近日常事其害轻）；水为福点Dispositor+龙头4宫→地良；月土吉照4宫头（六合三合在容许）→问者有意、费力终得之（纵卖方性异）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.I

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Is it good to remove unto some other House or stay where I am? Finding the Dragons Head in the fourth House, and the Lord of the fourth, viz. Mercury, and the Sun in Trine to Pisces, the Intercepted Sign in the Ascendant, I should advise the Querent to stay where he is, and the rather because the Lord of the Ascendant and the Moon do very well behold the Cusp of the 4th House, therefore it argues the Querent will reap more Advantage to continue where he is, than to remove to another place; besides, to encourage him to stay, the Moon applyes to a void of Course.
rules.translation: 判例二·问搬迁去留：龙头4宫+4宫主水+日三合双鱼（升内截座）→劝留原处（升主与月吉照4宫头）——留则益多；月将入 Void of Course（无后续相位）→更宜留。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 父子少爱、然可得可观父产
