rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] Shall I enjoy my Fathers Estate? I consider my Scheme, and finding Mercury the Significator of the Father, (within Orbs) in Square to Saturn, the Lord of the Ascendant, Argues but small Love between the Father, and the Querent his Son, but finding Mars Lord of the second, and Mercury of the fifth (the Fathers house of Substance) in strong Reception by House, and applying to a Sextile Aspect, this is an Argument the Querent may enjoy what he desires, and that the Estate is considerable, because the Part of Fortune is in the fifth House.
rules.translation: 判例三·问父产：水（父之征象）在容许内□土（升主）→父子少爱；然火2宫主与水5宫主（父之2宫=5宫）本宫强互容+入相六合→可得所求、产业可观（福点居5宫为证）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.III；转宫法：父之财=5宫（IIA CE-092 同构）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Is there Treasure Hidden in such a place, and whether is it Attainable? The Dragons Head being posited in the fourth House, and the Moon in Sextile unto the Cusp thereof, argues that there is Treasure hid, and by reason Mercury is Lord of the fourth house, he in particular denotes the quality thereof; it must be therefore, Medals, Books, or Pictures, &c. And finding Mercury afflicted by the Conjunction of the Sun, & Square of Saturn, intimates that the Querent shall very hardly find it, or that there is but small hopes of attaining the Treasure so hidden, and therefore in vain for the Querent to make any attempt.
rules.translation: 判例四·问藏宝：龙头4宫+月六合4宫头→有藏宝；水4宫主=其质（奖章/书/画）；水灼于日+□土→甚难寻/寻之无望→徒劳莫试。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.IV

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. V.] Concerning any thing that is hidden or mis-laid, Whether it may be found in the House? Consider Mars being Lord of the second House, and in an Angle, denotes it to be in the house, the Moon being Angular, the same; and by reason Mars is in the seventh House and the Moon in the Ascendant, it declares the thing to be hid in the Room in which the Querent and his Wife most frequent, where you ought to make diligent search.
rules.translation: 判例五·问藏失物在屋否：火2宫主居角（月角宫同证）→在屋内；火居7宫+月居升→物藏于问主夫妇最常之室，宜细搜。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.V；参 CHAP IV SECT 4 p.171（指认物之方位）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 有子女、多为男、两性俱有不多
rules.original_text: [SECT. V. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent have Children? The Cusp of the Fifth House is a Barren Sign, Mars in Square thereunto, Mercury Lord of the fifth in Square to Saturn, (the other Infortune) and in Conjunction of the Sun, these are Arguments of no Issue; to which I may add the Opposition of Jupiter and Venus; But finding the Moon in Pisces, a fruitful Signe, and applying to a Sextile Aspect of the fifth House, Mercury is also in Scorpio, a fruitful Signe, and in Conjunction of Venus, who is in Libra her own Dignities, these Arguments are the most prevalent; ergo, the Querent may have Children, which Judgment is augmented by the position of the Part of Fortune in the House of Children, & in all probability they may be most males, for the Lord of the Ascendant is a Masculine Planet, and the Moon is just entering a Masculine Sign, also the Lord of the fifth is in Conjunction of the Sun a Masculine Planet; but the Querent may have Children, and those of both Sex, yet not many of either. The best way is to collect the Testimonies pro and con. and judge by the Major.
rules.translation: 判例一·问子女：5宫头荒芜座、火□其头、水5宫主□土（另一凶星）且灼日→无子诸证（木金之冲亦证）；反证：月居双鱼（多产座）入相六合5宫头、水居天蝎（多产座）☌金（金居天秤本尊）→多产证胜→可有子女（福点居5宫增验）；多为男（升主阳星、月将入阳座、5宫主☌日阳星）；两性俱有而不多——正反证集取多数决。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT V Paragr.I；多产/无产证集多数决（IIA CE-347 同构）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Is the Querent with Child or not? The Moon making to a Sextile of the Cusp of the fifth House, the Part of Fortune in the fifth, and the Lord thereof in Conjunction of Venus, to which I may add, the natural Significator of Children, being in Sextile to the Part of Fortune in the fifth, are Arguments the Querent hath Conceived; but considering also the Square of Venus & Saturn, and the Opposition of Jupiter and Venus from Cardinal Signes, with the Square of Mars to the Cusp of the fifth, and the Lord of the fifth being in Conjunction with the Sun a barren Planet; hence I may conclude 'tis but a false Conception, and the Birth will prove Abortive, and come to no Maturity.
rules.translation: 判例二·问怀孕否：月入相六合5宫头、福点5宫、5宫主☌金、子之通征六合5宫福点→已受孕；然金□土+木金冲（自角宫）+火□5宫头+5宫主☌日（不毛星）→伪孕/流产不成熟。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT V Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] Concerning the success of a Messenger being sent of an Errand? Mercury is the Significator of the Messenger, and the Sun the person to whom he is sent; I find Mercury in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, which is an Argument the Messenger doth not intend with Honesty to discharge his Trust; yet he is in Conjunction with Venus, and applying to a partile Conjunction of the Sun, Lord of the seventh House, which intimates he is safely arrived to the person to whom he is sent, and great probability there is that he hath delivered his Message; and when the Moon comes to a good Aspect of Mercury, or Mercury of Saturn, the Querent may expect an account of his proceedings.
rules.translation: 判例三·问信使成败：水=信使、日=收信人——水□土升主→信使不诚心尽职；然水☌金+入相合日（7宫主）→已安抵收信人、大抵已递信；月入相水之吉照（或水与土）时=可望回音。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT V Paragr.III

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 大体佳、不能大富、时有损
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Shall the Querent gain by Play? The Lord of the fifth is in Square to Saturn (as yet) but applyes to his Sextile Aspect, and is in Conjunction of Venus the lesser Fortune, & the Part of Fortune in the fifth house, to which I may farther add, that Mercury doth dispose of the Lord of the second, viz. Mars, and there is Reception by House, between them, all which are Arguments that the Querent shall be (for the most part) fortunate in gameing, yet seeing Mars is in Square to the Cusp of the fifth house, and Mercury Combust of the Sun, and in Square to Saturn: This therefore signifies that the Querent shall not be much inrich'd thereby, but must expect to see and end of what comes that way; and also (sometimes) loss and detriment therein.
rules.translation: 判例四·问赌运：5宫主入相土之六合（今尚□土）+☌金（小吉）+福点5宫+水Dispose 2宫主火（本宫互容）→赌运大体佳；然火□5宫头+水灼日+□土→不能大富于此、其得必有尽、时亦有损（善赌者亦难免）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT V Paragr.IV；赌博性占断，仅规则引擎研究

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 腿腹之疾（冷湿因）、甚危、误药；或终愈
rules.original_text: [SECT. VI. Paragr. I.] Concerning a Sick Person, what part of the Body is afflicted or whether he may Recover? I find the Moon: Lady of the sixth House in Pisces in the Ascendant, and she lately afflicted by the Opposition of Mars, who is posited in an Angle in Virgo; Now Mars being the afflicting Planet, Rules the Leggs & Belly, & in those parts lies the parties Grief; the Diseases thereof are the Plague of the Guts, Hypocondriack, Melancholy, & all kind of Obstructions therein; & those of the Leggs must needs be, Cramps, Swellings, Aches or Blood settled. In fine, the Disease proceeds from a cold and moist Cause. Moreover, that the Party will very hardly escape death is plain, because the Lady of the eighth is in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, so is Mercury Lord of the fourth, and Jupiter, who hath Dignities in the Ascendant, is in Opposition to the Lady of the eighth also, all which are Testimonies of a dangerous Consequence, and the worse, because these Aspects are from Cardinal Signes. All the hopes that may be gather'd is, the Moon being in Sextile to Saturn out of the Ascendant, Saturn having Exaltation in the 8th House, and being in Reception with the Lady thereof... but the Dragons Tail in the tenth, and Jupiter in Square to Saturn, doth aggravate the evil, and denotes Improper Physick is Administred.
rules.translation: 判例一·问病者：月6宫主居双鱼升点、刚受火（角宫处女）之冲；火（克星）主腿与腹→其痛在腿腹；疾=肠瘟/忧郁/诸滞塞；腿疾=抽筋/肿/痛/瘀血；源=冷湿之因。8宫主□土升主、水4宫主亦然、木（升内有尊）冲8宫主→危候（自角宫更凶）；唯月六合土（自升点）、土8宫擢升与8宫主互容本尊→或终能胜病；龙尾10宫+木□土→恶化、示误药。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VI Paragr.I；病位依克星所主肢体（Part I 人体表）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Shall the Querent be Fortunate in his Servants, as also Small Cattle? Considering the Moon, Lady of the sixth House, is in the Ascendant, and in friendly Sextile to Saturn, Lord thereof, 'tis an Argument the Querent may have faithful Servants, and be Fortunate in small Cattle; yet the Querent is advised not to impose too much Confidence in them, because the Moon was lately in Opposition to Mars, Lord of the second, and Jupiter who is posited Retrograde in the second, hath great Dignities in the sixth, & is in Square to Saturn Lord of the Ascendant from Cardinal Signes, hence the Querent ought to have a strict eye over them; but in general, the Figure speaks well for them to be honest and love their Master.
rules.translation: 判例二·问仆役小牲畜：月6宫主居升六合升主土→可有忠仆、利于小畜；然慎过信（月刚冲火2宫主、木逆居2宫于6宫有尊□土自角宫）→须严管则无虞；大体盘吉、仆忠爱主。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VI Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 罕婚；若婚=异质之人多憎恶
rules.original_text: [SECT. VII. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent Marry? [If the Question be demanded for a woman, take Signification from Venus, but determinately from the seventh House.] The Moon (a general Significatrix of Marriage in mens question) is in a prolifical Sign, in friendly Sextile to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant: one Argument of Marriage, but the Square of Venus (another general Significatrix) to Saturn speaks to the contrary, and this Judgment is confirmed the rather because Saturn is in Square to the Lord of the seventh, viz. the Sun and Mars in the seventh, in Virgo a barren Signe, and Leo upon the Cusp thereof, another barren Signe, from hence I may conclude that notwithstanding the Native or Querent may have a strong inclination at sometime of his life to Marriage, yet he will rarely Marry, (if at all) for the former Reasons; or if he happens to Marry, he will find much trouble in the prosecution thereof, for Saturn and the Sun are Planets of contrary Natures, and here they behold each other very ill. Again, if the Querent Marryes, 'twill be a Person so different from his own Nature, that there will be no mutual Love and Concord between them, but on the contrary, much hate and Discord, which is not meanly seconded by the position of Mars in the seventh, and Venus in Square to Saturn before noted. The Querents Wife (if he should Marry) you must describe by the Sun and Mercury.
rules.translation: 判例一·问婚否：月（男问婚通征）居多产座六合土升主→一婚证；金（问卦本命婚通征）□土→反证；土□7宫主日+火居7宫处女（荒芜座）+狮子临7宫头（又荒芜）→虽有婚向、然罕婚（若婚多烦：土日性相反互仇）；若婚=异质之人、无相爱多憎恶（火居7+金□土佐证）；妻之形容取日与水。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.I；女问取金为征、指名取7宫

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Is her portion Considerable, and whether obtained with ease or Difficulty? Venus, Lady of the eighth House, in Trine to the Part of Fortune and in her own Dignities posited in the eighth, declare a very considerable Portion, but that it will be difficult for the Querent to obtain is not to be doubted, because Venus is in Square to Saturn from Cardinal Signes, and bad Houses of the Figure, as also in Opposition to Jupiter.
rules.translation: 判例二·问妆奁：金8宫主居8宫天秤本尊三合福点→妆奁甚丰；然金□土（自角宫凶位）+冲木→得之甚难（勿疑）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 问主胜或和解；战事安返
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] If it be demanded whether the Querent may overcome his Publick Enemies, or in a Suit of Law, which may have the Day? Or if Return safe from the warr? Finding Saturn so strong in his own Dignities, and the Moon in the Ascendant, and in Sextile unto him, and finding the Sun Lord of the seventh in Scorpio, having no Dignities in that place, may in reason conclude the Querent is strongest, and shall therefore overcome his Adversaries; yet the Sun is in Sextile to his Dispositer and in Conjunction of Venus, and Mercury, who is Lord of the tenth and eleventh, from the 7th House, which argues the Quesited may have great hopes, and find many Friends, and Jupiter Lord of the tenth being in Square to Saturn may intimate some unwelcome news from the Judge, or some great Lawyer concerned with the Querent; yet notwithstanding all this, the Querent (in all probability) will come off Victor (though perhaps with some expence more than ordinary) for the former Reasons, or they may at length compound, because the Sun applyes to a Sextile of Saturn not Saturn to the Sun. Judge the same in Warr Affairs; that notwithstanding all danger, the Querent returns home safe from the Warr.
rules.translation: 判例三·问公敌/讼/战：土强本尊+月居升六合土、日7宫主居天蝎无尊→问主较强、可胜敌；然日六合其Dispositor+☌金与水（10/11宫主自7宫）→所问方有望多友；木10宫主□土→法官/大律师之不利消息；然问主终胜（或耗资逾常）、或终和解（日入相土之六合而非反之）；战事同断：虽险、问主安返。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.III；入相方向定胜方（IIA 通则）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Shall I have the Desired Party? Here is a person in particular Nominated, & in the Figure, signified by the Sun, and at the time of the Question she seems to deny, for the Sun is in Square to Saturn, but within a short time the Querent may have his desire; for the Sun not long after comes to a Sextile of Saturn, and then the business may be concluded, and brought to a final end, and the rather, because the Moon (a general Significatrix) is in Sextile to the Querents Significator, the Moon did also separate from a Trine of the Sun, and applyed to an Opposition of Mars, the Dispositer of the Sun, and in the next place translates their light and vertue to Saturn by an Aspect, and meets with the Aspect of no other Planet during the time she continues in that Sign, and therefore the Quesited will comply, as well as her Significator doth apply to Saturn, the Significator of the party enquiring.
rules.translation: 判例四·问得人否：指名之人以日表之；问时似拒（日□土）、然不久可得（日将入相土之六合）→事可成；月（通征）六合问主征象、月离日三合就火（日Dispositor）冲、传其光德于土→所问者将顺从。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.IV；传光/月为通征（IIA 核心技法）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 暂无归意、后必闻讯；在南/西南
rules.original_text: [Paragr. V.] Which way is the Fugitive or Stray gone, or whether will he be found, or Return again? Mercury and the Moon with the Sun, Lord of the seventh Denotes the Fugitive or Stray, and by reason I find Sun and Mercury in Conjunction, and as yet within the Orbs of a Square Aspect of Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant, I conclude at present he hath no mind to return; but by reason the Moon is in Sextile to Saturn, & Mercury applying to the Sextile of Saturn also, it argues the party will be heard of again, and probably return when the Sun and Mercury come to a Sextile of Saturn. The Quarter he is in, is, Southerly, or rather South-west.
rules.translation: 判例五·问逃犯：水月与日（7宫主）表逃者；日水☌、在土四分之容许内→今无归意；月六合土+水入相土六合→将再闻其讯、或归（日水入相土六合之时）；所往=南/西南。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.V；逃者取征（IIA 逃犯章）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 盗=日征（中龄）、难追回、无获无归
rules.original_text: [Paragr. VI.] There are Goods lost, Shall they be recovered, or what kind of Person did the Fact? Some would take Mars, being Peregrine in an Angle to be the Significator of the Thief, but by reason he afflict not the second House and he is in Reception with the Dispositer of the Part of Fortune, and doth not as yet behold the Part of Fortune by a Square Aspect, and because he is Lord of the Querents second, I shall not accept him as Significator. But I shall accept the Sun to be Significator of the Thief, who is Lord of the seventh, & within the Orbs of Opposition of Jupiter in the second, and thereby afflicts the Significator of the Querents Substance; therefore the Sun is true Significator, and the rather, because he also Combusts Mercury the Dispositor of the Part of Fortune; Say the Thief is about a middle age. Now there is but small probability that the goods lost will be recovered again, by reason Venus, Lady of the Thiefs 2d, is in the eighth, in Opposition to Jupiter in the Querents second, and in Square to Saturn Lord of the Ascendant... And the Sun and Venus are both in Trine to the Part of Fortune, which intimates the Thief will keep the Goods, and loves them too well to restore them again. Lastly, finding the Sun Lord of the seventh in Conjunction with Venus, Lady of the eighth, the Moon under the earth, the Sun in Square to the Ascendant, and Mars in Opposition to the Ascendant, argues no Discovery or Restitution. If it were Cattle lost, finding the Moon Lady of the sixth in Sextile to Saturn, Lord of the twelfth house in the twelfth; Saturn being also in Square to Jupiter in the second, gives very small hopes of recovery.
rules.translation: 判例六·问失物盗贼：火游走居角（或取为盗征），然其不克2宫、与福点Dispositor互容、未□福点、且为问者2宫主→不取；取日为盗征（7宫主、在木（2宫）冲之容许内克问者财征象、且灼福点Dispositor水）→日=真盗征（中等年纪）；金（盗之2宫主）居8宫冲木（问者2宫）+□土升主+日□土及升头→失物难追回；日金三合福点→盗留其物且爱之；日☌金（8宫主）、月在地平下、日□升、火冲升→无获无归；若失大畜：月6宫主六合土（12宫主居12宫）、土□木（2宫）→甚难寻回。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.VI；盗征择法（克2宫/福点征象之星，IIA 失物章）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. VII.] Shall two Partners Agree together? Finding the Lord of the Ascendant, Saturn, and the Lord of the seventh (viz. the Sun) in bad Aspect, viz. Square, and being Planets of contrary natures, I should hence conclude they would agree like Fire and Water, and by No means advise them to joyn together in Partnership.
rules.translation: 判例七·问合伙：1宫主土与7宫主日恶照（□）、性相反→如水火不相容→断勿合伙。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.VII

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 终降（受贿多惧）、水日六合土时成
rules.original_text: [Paragr. VIII.] (in the time of War) whether such a Town or Strong-hold should be taken? Finding Saturn who in particular signifies the Besiegers to be strong, and in his own Dignities argues they are strong, and in good heart, Couragious and Resolute. Mercury is the Significator of the Governour of the place besieged, as also of his strength, viz. men, Ammunition, Provision, &c. as being Lord of the fourth & fifth Houses. Now considering Mercury is in the eighth combust of the Sun, and applying to the Sextile of Saturn, this is an argument that the Governour at last will rather yield up the Fort then stand it out... But not presently for Mercury is now in Square to Saturn, and the Dragons Head is in the fourth, and the Part of Fortune in the fifth, which declares they are in a good condition within, and do perhaps expect more supplies, by reason Mercury is in reception with Mars, but considering Mars is the Lord of the second, and dispositor of Jupiter Lord of the tenth, and in reception so strongly by house with Mercury the Significator of the Governour, this intimates that he would willingly accept of a Bribe, and is possest with many fears in the case, and in the conclusion, rather resigns up upon conditions then longer to stand in opposition, now when Mercury and the Sun come to a Sextile of Saturn is the time most probable, that this should be effected.
rules.translation: 判例八·问攻城（战时）：土（攻者之征）强本尊→攻方强勇果决；水（守城将帅征象、兼4/5宫主=人/弹药/粮秣）灼于8宫+入相土六合→将帅终降（力不能支）；然非即降（水今□土、龙头4宫、福点5宫→内况尚佳、或盼援，水与火互容）；火2宫主兼木（10宫主）之Dispositor、与水（将帅）本宫强互容→其将愿受贿、多惧、终依约弃守；水日入相土六合之时=事成之时。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.VIII；战时占断，仅规则引擎研究

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 以本命方向法断、此处不赘
rules.original_text: [SECT. VIII. Paragr. I.] Of the Time of Death. To enquire after the time of a parties Death, I take to be a very nice Question; but if the Nativity be known, and the Directions run down according to Art, the Native may then see as in a glass, the most dangerous Direction that threatens to cut assunder the Thread of Life; but I pass by any farther Discourse of this Subject, in this place.
rules.translation: 判例一·问死期：死期之问甚险；若知本命、依方向法观最危之方向（详见第三部分）——此处不赘。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VIII Paragr.I；Coley 婉拒正面作答

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] If it be demanded, what manner of Death the Querent may dye? Finding Venus the Lady of the eighth House, and in the eighth strong and Potent, and neer Spica Virginis, a Benevolent fixed Star, argues a natural gentle death, and this the rather, because Venus is in Conjunction of Mercury Lord of the fourth, but Venus, Lady of the House of Death, being in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Ascendant from Cardinal Signs, denotes an unwillingness in the Querent to leave this world, and to interchange this life for a better.
rules.translation: 判例二·问死法：金8宫主居8宫强、近角宿一（吉恒）→自然安逝（金☌水4宫主佐证）；然金□土升主（自角宫）→问者不愿离世。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VIII Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] Shall the Man or Wife Dye first? Finding Saturn the strongest Planet, I should judge the Querent longest live'd, be it who will, Man or Wife, and the Lord of the seventh House, viz. the Sun, comes first to a Conjunction of the Lady of the eighth, before Saturn to her Square, which confirms the Judgment; thus an Artist may give a probable conjecture upon such a Question: but the surest way is to view both their Nativities... but to say the truth, I do not much approve of such kind of nice Questions; and an Artist ought to be exceeding wary in giving Judgment thereupon.
rules.translation: 判例三·问夫妻孰先死：土最强→问主（无论夫妻）最寿；7宫主日先合8宫主（金）而后土至其□→验之；最稳=取双方本命推之（不能得则以问图如本命处理）；Coley 自评不喜此类刁问、术者当极慎。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VIII Paragr.III；Coley 之审慎立场

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [SECT. IX. Paragr. I.] If a Person be going to Sea, whether his Voyage will be Prosperous or Dangerous? I find Scorpio upon the Cusp of the ninth House, and Mars Lord thereof in Virgo angular, and in strong Reception with Mercury Lord of the fourth & fifth, who is the Dispositer of the Part of Fortune, and Mars Dispositer of Jupiter in the second House, these are Arguments that the Querent may advantage himself by the Voyage, and need fear no danger that can happen therein, because the ninth House, & Lord thereof are no way afflicted, and although Mars be not in his own Essential Dignities, yet he is accidentally reasonably well posited... yet the Querent is not hereby promised an extraordinary profit by the Voyage; but he may expect to reap advantage, rather than loss or damage.
rules.translation: 判例一·问航海：天蝎临9宫头、火9宫主居处女角宫、与4/5宫主水（福点Dispositor）强互容、火Dispose 2宫木→此行有利无险（9宫其主无克、火偶发亦佳）；然非厚利；得利多于损。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IX Paragr.I

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Whether a Clergy-man may obtain the Benefice desired? Considering there is no Aspect between the Lord of the Ascendant, and the Lord of the ninth house, this declares but small probability thereof; and finding the Moon lately separated from an Opposition of the Lord of the ninth, and Jupiter (a General Significator in these matters) being in Square to Saturn Lord of the Ascendant, this gives small encouragement to seek after it, for 'tis but in vain, and for these Reasons he can expect but a small Revenue thereby. The same Judgment might be given, if a man desires to know whether he may profit by any Art or Science intended; For what advantage can follow, when the Dragons Tail is in the tenth House, (the second from the ninth) and the Lord thereof Retrograde, and in Square to Saturn from Cardinal Signes.
rules.translation: 判例二·问俸禄/技艺：1宫主与9宫主无相→甚难；月刚离9宫主之冲、木（此类通征）□土升主→不必求（徒劳、利微）；同断于技艺之学（龙尾10宫=9宫之2宫+其主逆□土自角宫）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IX Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [SECT. X. Paragr. I.] Shall the Querent obtain the Place or Office he seeks after? The Sun is a General Significator of Honour and Dignity, and he is here in Square to Saturn, Jupiter Lord of the tenth house is Retrograde in the second, and in Square to Saturn from Cardinal Signes; to which may be added the Dragons Tail in the tenth, from these Considerations, 'tis plain that the Querent shall hardly obtain the place desired; if he do, 'twill be with much difficulty, and expence of Mony; and when procured, not so beneficial to the Querent as he expects. 'Tis true, the Sun doth apply to the Sextile of Saturn, which Argues it may perchance come to pass; but finding Jupiter the particular Significator of the Place in Square to Saturn, as aforesaid, it intimates there is but small hopes of continuing therein, without he bribes those concerned in it, which shall not countervail; for the Dragons Tail in the tenth house, declares the place not worth acceptation gratis, and therefore disswade the Querent from farther progress therein.
rules.translation: 判例一·问得位：日（荣通征）□土；10宫主木逆居2宫□土（自角宫）；龙尾10宫→难得位；得亦费力耗财、得不偿所期；日虽入相土六合（或可成）、然木（位之专征）□土→居之不稳（除非行贿、然不值）；龙尾10宫→位不值白受→劝止。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT X Paragr.I

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 贸易不佳、不宜掌；租客多损
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Shall the Querent benefit himself by his Trade or Profession? Finding the Dragons Tail in the tenth House, argues the Querent shall have but bad Trading, generally, yet 'tis probable he may get moneys thereby, but he shall not inrich'd with it; for Jupiter, Lord of the tenth House, being Retrograde in the second, and in Square to Saturn, denotes that what he gains with one hand, he will spend with the other, ergo, not fit to manage a Trade, but think of some other imployment; in short, his Trade will no way prove Fortunate to the Querent. The same you may understand by taking of Lodgers (as is much used in London) you ought to be cautious in this particular, for you shall generally lose more than gain by entertaining such persons in your House, upon such a position of Heaven.
rules.translation: 判例二·问贸易：龙尾10宫→贸易大体不佳；虽或得钱然不致富（10宫主木逆2宫□土=左手进右手出）→不宜掌贸易、当另谋；招租客（伦敦俗）亦然：此天象下多损少得。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT X Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 不得/得之难损大；指名物亦不果
rules.original_text: [SECT. XI. Paragr. I.] May the Querent obtain what he hopes for? If the thing hoped for be not nominated, but propounded in a general way, I consider Jupiter is Lord of the eleventh House, and in Square to Saturn Lord of the Ascendant from Cardinal Signes, and this gives a denyal of the Querents hopes, or that he shall not obtain the thing hoped for, but with much difficulty, and greater loss thereby, than the thing it self can make recquital or restitution, if obtained. Now if the thing hoped for be nominated, I consider its Significator, and accordingly judge as I find him Aspect the Ascendant or his Lord: as suppose a man hopes to receive Money in a General way; considering Mars is Lord of the second House, and in Opposition to the Ascendant, and not beholding the Lord thereof, and Jupiter a Planet in the second in Square to Saturn, this argues the Querents hopes will not take effect.
rules.translation: 判例一·问获所求：未指名——11宫主木□土升主（自角宫）→所望不得/得之甚难且损大于得；指名（如钱）——火2宫主冲升且不照其主、木居2宫□土→所望不果、不得所期之钱。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XI Paragr.I；指名物察对应宫主（补遗 CE-236 同构）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Shall my Friends prove true and faithful, according to their promises and pretenses? The Querents Friends are figured by Jupiter, he being in Square to the Lord of the Ascendant (which alwaies denotes the Querent) this is but a bad Signe of their Fidelity; nay it intimates they will prove deceitful and perfidious, caring not for the Querent for their own ends, and the Querent will rather receive loss and prejudice by them; for Jupiter beholds Saturn ill out of the second House.
rules.translation: 判例二·问友真伪：友以木表之（□1宫主）→伪而背信、只图自利、问主反受其损（木自2宫恶照土）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XI Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 有暗敌（非庸流）然害不足惧
rules.original_text: [SECT. XII. Paragr. I.] Hath the Querent private Enemies? Finding Saturn in the twelfth House in his own Dignities, I might Judge, if the Querent be not an Enemy to himself, he need not fear another; but by reason I find Venus in Square to Saturn from the eighth House (viz.) both obscure places of the Figure, I may thence conclude the Querent hath private Enemies, and such that are of no mean account; but Saturn being strong, and the most ponderous Planet, the Querent need not fear what prejudice they can do unto him. Note that if a Question be propounded concerning private Enemies, absolutely or in general, judge from the twelfth House, but if it be determinately, or a person nominated, then judge from the seventh House.
rules.translation: 判例一·问暗敌：土居12宫本尊→若非自敌、他敌可无惧；然金（8宫）□土（俱幽暗之位）→有暗敌且非庸流；土强最重→其害不足惧。通则：绝对/笼统问=12宫、指名问=7宫。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XII Paragr.I；笼统/指名取宫通则

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. II.] Is there any probability a Prisoner may be released? Saturn the Querents Significator being Lord of the Ascendant, and twelfth House, and posited in the twelfth, there in Square to Venus & Jupiter, declares a long imprisonment; and this the rather, because a fixed Sign Ascends.
rules.translation: 判例二·问囚释：土升主兼12宫主居12宫、□金木→久囚（固定座升益验）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XII Paragr.II

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.original_text: [Paragr. III.] Shall the Querent be fortunate in great Cattle? I consider the position of Saturn in the twelfth House, strong and potent, but in Square to both the Fortunes from Cardinal Signs, Saturn being Lord of the Ascendant also, which is the second from the twelfth, and denotes the profit that may arise from all things signified by the twelfth House; so that what the Querent gains this way, he may put in his eye and see never the worse. According to the usual Proverb.
rules.translation: 判例三·问大牲畜：土居12宫强、□两吉星（自角宫）、土兼升主（12宫之2宫=其利）→此道所得可置目中而不伤目（谚：所得微乎其微）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XII Paragr.III；转宫法（12宫之2宫=1宫）

rules.source: 规则库-Clavis十二宫问事判例卷.xlsx
rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley
rules.result: 被毒舌/被蛊；Coley 不复深论
rules.original_text: [Paragr. IV.] Is the Party Suspected, Bewitched or not? Finding Saturn the Lord of the Ascendant and twelfth Houses, and posited in the twelfth in Square to Venus Lady of the eighth, and the Moon Lady of the sixth in Sextile to Saturn, argues the Querent is under an ill tongue, or bewitched. This is a matter in these dayes much controverted by Learned Persons, and therefore I shall insist no farther upon the Subject. And thus I have briefly run over several Questions belonging to the twelve Houses, which, with the Rules before given, are sufficient to instruct any Ingenious Tyro in the Judicial part of Astrology.
rules.translation: 判例四·问蛊：土1/12宫主居12宫□金8宫主、月6宫主六合土→问主被毒舌/被蛊；此道近日学者多争、不复深论——至此十二宫诸问已简要遍述，与前述规则并足以启后学。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT XII Paragr.IV；Part II 问卜判例之收束

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 同一征象星处于不同宫位或不同征象星处于同一宫位
rules.result: 判断须随宫位与行星的组合而异，不可一概而论
rules.original_text: The same Planet in different Houses hath different effects; different Planets in the same House have different effects.
rules.translation: 同一行星落不同宫位产生不同效果；不同行星落同一宫位效果也不同。
rules.notes: 序论 Of the Elements 公理1，卜卦根本方法论，引擎应按 行星×宫位 双键索引

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 两星形成不同相位类型
rules.result: 按相位性质分别取效，不混为一谈
rules.original_text: Conjunctions, Sextiles, Quadrates and Oppositions have different effects.
rules.translation: 合、六合、刑、冲各有不同效应。
rules.notes: 公理2，相位类型为独立判据维度

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 凶星相刑冲 vs 吉星相刑冲
rules.result: 凶星刑冲主破坏性事件，吉星刑冲效应较轻且性质不同
rules.original_text: The Quadrate or Opposition of ♄ and ♂ hath different effects from the Quadrate or Opposition of ♃ and ♀.
rules.translation: 土星与火星的刑冲，其效应不同于木星与金星的刑冲。
rules.notes: 公理3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 同一星是不同宫的宫主
rules.result: 须按其所主之宫的议题分别取效
rules.original_text: The same Planet being Lord of different Houses hath different effects.
rules.translation: 同一行星作为不同宫位的宫主，其效应不同。
rules.notes: 公理4；引擎需维护 行星→多宫主 映射

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 出生盘中某星所在黄道点
rules.result: 该点终身携带该星性能（行运/推运到此时触发）
rules.original_text: In the Radix of a Nativity, the Points wherein the ☉, ♄, ♃ &c. are placed, retain their several operations for ever in the life of the Native.
rules.translation: 本命盘中日、土、木等星所在之点，在命主一生中永久保有各自的作用。
rules.notes: 公理5，本命点敏感度概念，支撑第3层敏感点体系

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 出生时刻有差异或社会身份不同
rules.result: 判断须结合时刻精度与个人身份调整
rules.original_text: Twins born not at the same moment have not the same fate; persons born at the same moment, of mean or great condition, differ in their courses.
rules.translation: 非同一时刻出生的双胞胎命运不同；同一时刻出生的常人与贵人，人生轨迹亦不同。
rules.notes: 公理7-8，Coley 承认同盘异运之限，引擎输出宜带置信度而非独断

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 效果 = 落宫议题 与 所主宫议题 两路叠加
rules.original_text: A Planet's nature is mixed in the subject it operates upon; the effect of a Planet out of his own House depends on the House he is in, another on the House he rules.
rules.translation: 行星之性在受作用的对象中混合；星在其宫外的效应，一部分取决于其所落之宫，另一部分取决于其所主之宫。
rules.notes: 序论定理，双宫主原则

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 不同固定星与行星会合/成相
rules.result: 按各固定星本性分别取效
rules.original_text: Fixed Stars have different effects, as Spica and Cor Scorpii.
rules.translation: 固定星效应各异，如角宿一（Spica）与心宿二（Cor Scorpii）不同。
rules.notes: 第3层固定星表需带本性标签

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按六项经验科学路径收集数据校验规则
rules.original_text: Six things proposed for the restauration of Astrology: 1. Collect the great mutations of several Countreys with their configurations. 2. Observe the temperature of the Air, and the difference at the same hour in several places, with schemes. 3. Take the Nativities of such as die of Acute Diseases, Wounds, Blindness, &c. and observe the afflicted parts. 4. By Physitians observe the times of the invasion of Acute Diseases. 5. Re-examine ancient Authors, correcting the figures by the old Astronomers' errors. 6. Demonstrate the Copernican and Tychonic systems by physical Astronomy.
rules.translation: 重振占星六项建议：①收集各国史上巨变并对照当时天象；②观察气温风候并设图对照同一时刻各地之异；③收集夭折/病/盲/跛/创/灼者的命盘，记录临危部位（伦敦巴黎大城医院可行）；④借医者记录急病发作时刻设图（放血过频会扰乱古法应验）；⑤重读古著，按旧天文误差修正实验图；⑥以物理天文论证哥白尼与第谷二体系。
rules.notes: 序论结尾所引某博学哲人方案；Coley 结论：占星不但合法且真，且为基督徒所需

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 升主+月不受凶照、不焦伤、本然强，且不被4/6/8/12宫主恶照
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant and the ☽ be free from the malignant beams of the Infortunes, not Combust, essentially strong, and not beholden by the Lords of the 4th, 6th, 8th, or 12th Houses, the party shall be long-lived.
rules.translation: 若升主与月亮免受凶星恶照、不焦伤、本然强健，且不被第4/6/8/12宫宫主恶照，则问者长寿。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT I 人寿长短总则

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 月或升主在8宫或合8宫主
rules.original_text: If the ☽ or Lord of the Ascendant be in the eighth House, or joyned with the Lord thereof, it argues shortness of life.
rules.translation: 若月亮或升主落第8宫，或与第8宫宫主相合，主短寿。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT I；更精确年限须待 Part III 推运法（Hyleg→Anareta）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Ascendant be afflicted by the presence of an Infortune, or the ☋ therein, the Querent is subject to much sorrow and detraction.
rules.translation: 若升点受凶星临照或龙尾落升，问者多忧愁与诽谤。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 指示一生中哪段最吉（每宫按星力给5/6/7年量法）
rules.original_text: Fortunate Planets in the 1st, 12th, or 11th Houses shew the happiness of Youth; in the 10th, 9th, or 8th, of middle age; in the 7th, 6th, or 5th, of the middle part of life; in the 4th, 3rd, or 2nd, of old age.
rules.translation: 吉星落第1/12/11宫主幼年之吉；落第10/9/8宫主青年之吉；落第7/6/5宫主中年之吉；落第4/3/2宫主晚年之吉。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT II；Coley 自评：先以行星位置论，另有按宫主强弱势法，最上者为命盘推运

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 以吉星与福点落点定方位；按议题选对应宫主
rules.result: 指示最吉利的方向/领域
rules.original_text: For the Quarter of Heaven most fortunate, observe the places of ♃, ♀, ☽, and ⊕; the place most fortified by them is best. In questions of health regard the Ascendant and ☽; of wealth the 2nd House and ⊕; of honour the 10th House and ☉.
rules.translation: 何方最吉：看木、金、月、福点所落方位，众吉汇聚者最佳。问健康顾升主与月；问财顾第2宫主与福点；问荣顾第10宫主与日，并兼顾升主、2宫主、月的友人。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT III；Coley 反对单纯取本然尊贵多之处

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按关系取对应宫主或升主+月
rules.original_text: Relations are signified by their proper Houses: a Brother by the 3rd, a Wife by the 7th, &c. Persons not related are signified by the Lord of the Ascendant and the ☽.
rules.translation: 亲属按各自宫位指认：兄弟=第3宫、配偶=第7宫等；不相识者以升主与月亮为征象。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT IV；Coley 例：熟人用7/11宫主

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 缺席者征象星的落宫与受克情况
rules.original_text: If the Significator be in the eighth, or in ☌ or ☍ with the Lord of the eighth out of a bad House, death; if afflicted by the Lord of the sixth, sickness. Lilly's experience: if the Lord of the Ascendant be in the 9th, 10th, or 11th, the party lives, contrary to vulgar opinion.
rules.translation: 征象星落第8宫，或在劣宫合/冲第8宫主，主死；受第6宫主所克，主病。莉莉经验：升主落第9/10/11宫则其人存活（与世俗说法相反）。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT IV；Lilly 经验见 Christian Astrology p.151

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 征象星入相升主吉照时按宫位性质定单位
rules.result: 得出听闻之期（度距换算）
rules.original_text: The time of hearing of the absent is when the Significator shall come to a good Aspect of the Lord of the Ascendant; or the Lord of the Ascendant to a ∗ or △ of the Lord of the 11th. The measure of time: Angular and Fixed Signes give years or months; Succedent and Common, months or weeks; Cadent and Moveable, weeks or days.
rules.translation: 听闻缺席者消息之期：征象星会升主之吉照时（或升主与第11宫主六合/三合）。计时法：角宫+定座=年/月；续宫+变座=月/周；降宫+动座=周/日。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT IV；度距计时法为可编码算法（角/续/降 × 定/变/动 → 年/月/周/日）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the seventh be in any Angle, the party is at home; in a Succedent House, not far off; in a Cadent House, absent. If the Ascendant and the ☽ be in ∗ or △, they shall meet by the way.
rules.translation: 第7宫主落角宫，则所寻者在家（Coley 注：此则鲜失）；落续宫，离家不远；落降宫，不在。升主与所寻者入六合/三合，途中可遇。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT V；Coley 自评此法激励多学子深造

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象星强弱与凶星所克判安危
rules.original_text: The Ascendant and ☽ signify the Ship and her Lading; the Lord of the Ascendant with those joyned to him, the persons in her. If the Significators be strong and free from affliction, the Ship is safe. If ♂ afflict the Mid-heaven, burning; ♄ afflicts, storms and leaks.
rules.translation: 升点与月=船身与所载；升主及其合星=船上之人。征象星强且无凶照=船安。火星克天顶=焚船之险（火在人形座=敌战之险）；土星克=暴风漏水之灾。
rules.notes: CHAP I SECT VI；船体十二分见映射A（Haly）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 2宫头+2宫主+福点+宫内吉星皆旺且免凶照
rules.original_text: If ♃, ♀, the ☊, and ⊕ be in the second House, essentially strong and free from the beams of the Infortunes, the Querent shall be rich; the contrary if the Significators be in Cadent Houses and weak.
rules.translation: 木、金、龙头、福点落第2宫且本然强、免受凶星恶照，问者必富（按出生身份把握）；反之征象星居劣宫弱则贫。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT I 致富判

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant or the ☽ be in ☌ with the Lord of the second, or the Lord of the second in the Ascendant, the Querent shall get his estate by his own labour.
rules.translation: 升主或月合2宫主，或2宫主落升，则问者靠自身劳力经营而得财。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 凶星在2宫 vs 征象星疾行居角
rules.original_text: ♄, ♂, or the ☋ in the second House signify poverty and scarcity; Significators swift in motion in Angles, sudden riches beyond expectation.
rules.translation: 土、火或龙尾落第2宫主贫困拮据；征象星疾行且居角宫主骤富超乎预期。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT I-II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: By what means the Querent shall get his estate: the Significator in the Ascendant, by his own industry; in the 2nd, by Merchandise; in the 3rd, by his Brethren, Kindred, or Neighbours; and so of the rest.
rules.translation: 以何途得财：征象星在升=自业；在第2宫=买卖；在第3宫=赖兄弟亲友邻里（依次类推各宫）。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 财星与木星吉照入相且互纳
rules.result: 历艰而富；刑冲则先富后劳
rules.original_text: Lilly: When the Lords of the 1st and 2nd are with ♃ in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 10th, or 11th, not in ☌ but in ∗ or △, with mutual reception, the Querent shall gain an estate with much labour; if by □ or ☍, riches first, labour after.
rules.translation: 莉莉断语：第1/2宫主与木星聚于第1/2/4/7/10/11宫，不相合而互以六合/三合入相、且有互纳，则历经艰难而富；即便刑冲入相，亦先富后劳。
rules.notes: 引 Christian Astrology p.172

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 征象星距成相之度数距离
rules.result: 按宫性×座性换算月/周/日/年
rules.original_text: The time of wealth: by directions; or by the distance of the Significators, converting degrees into time: Angular & Fixed, months; Angular & Moveable, weeks; Angular & Common, days; Succedent & Fixed, years; Succedent & Common, months; Succedent & Moveable, weeks; Cadent & Moveable, months; Cadent & Common, years; Cadent & Fixed, hopes are at an end.
rules.translation: 何时得财：推运法为最；次用度距=时距法：角宫+定座=月、角+变座=周、角+动座=日；续宫+定座=年、续+变=月、续+动=周；降宫+动=月、降+变=年、降+定=希望已尽。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT III；另一种年计时法：当年春分日入白羊图的升点斜升差（约85-86°/年）≈4天多/1°

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 征象星合8宫主或8宫内吉星且吉照→可追回；互纳更稳
rules.original_text: Guido Bonatus: If the Lord of the Ascendant or the ☽ be joyned to the Lord of the eighth (the substance of the debtor) or to a good Planet in the eighth with good aspect, the debt may be recovered. This holds most true amongst the common people and merchants, but not with Princes and Nobles.
rules.translation: 波拿图法：升主或月合8宫主（=被问者之财）或合8宫内吉星且吉照，则借贷可追回。此法对平民与商贩之间最验，王公贵族当除外（Guido 亲注）。
rules.notes: CHAP II SECT IV；收尾总则：征象星互从好宫吉照、免凶星恶照=速成，否则反

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉星照3宫=吉途；土克=迟滞
rules.original_text: If ♃, ♀, or the ☊ be in the third House, or the Lord thereof free from the Infortunes and well beheld by the Ascendant and ☽, the journey is good. ♄ afflicting the Ascendant, 3rd, or ☽, delays and crosses the journey.
rules.translation: 木、金、龙头落第3宫，或3宫主免凶照且被升主月亮吉照，则短途吉。土星克升点、第3宫或月亮，则旅程迟滞、失路多挫。
rules.notes: CHAP III SECT I；♄在天蝎3宫=遇盗；♂在火象/人形座=受伤——出行宜先择时

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按吉凶星位置与入相判和争
rules.original_text: ♃ and ♀ in the Ascendant with dignity, or not aspected by ♄ and ♂, shew peace among Brethren and Neighbours; ♄ or ♂ ill placed in the Ascendant, or afflicting the Ascendant and ☽, shew strife. The most stubborn are those that have no application; those that apply by good aspect are most willing to yield.
rules.translation: 木金在升有尊贵或与土火无照=兄弟亲邻平和；土火劣位在升或克升主月亮=急躁好争。无入相者最顽固；有吉照入相者最愿让步。
rules.notes: CHAP III SECT II；♄/龙尾在3宫=亲邻吝啬土气；♂在3宫=奸诈偷窃（不本然尊贵尤验，Lilly）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 问缺席兄弟（或任何关系人）状况
rules.original_text: The condition of an absent Brother is judged from the House of his Significator: in the 4th, gain of estate; in the 5th, well and delights in company; in the 6th, sick; in the 8th, in misery or dead; in the 9th, gone further or retired; in the 10th, preferment; in the 11th, at a friend's house; in the 12th, great cattle or despair; in the Ascendant, well beloved; in the 2nd, imprisoned.
rules.translation: 缺席兄弟状况按其征象星落宫判读（以3宫为问者之1的转宫法通用于一切关系）：落4宫=增财有望；5宫=境佳喜其侪；6宫=有病（再被8主克将致死）；8宫=境惨或死；9宫=远行更远或归隐；10宫=得职/权/命；11宫=安于友家；12宫=营大畜有利或绝望难归；升=境佳且为人所爱；2宫=受困被囚。
rules.notes: CHAP III SECT III；逐宫判条见映射B

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉星在天顶=真；凶星在天顶或动座=假
rules.original_text: If good Planets, ♃, ♀, or ☊ be in the 10th, or the ☽ in good aspect to the Ascendant, the counsel of Neighbours is good and true; if ♄, ♂, or ☋ be in the Mid-heaven, or the Ascendant and ☽ in moveable or double-bodied Signs, they seek to deceive.
rules.translation: 吉星木金龙头在天顶，或月亮吉照升主，则亲邻忠告真善；土火龙尾在天顶，或升主月亮居动座/双体座，则诓骗构陷、欲夺荣光。
rules.notes: CHAP III SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按月之状态与入相对象判真伪
rules.original_text: If the ☽ be in the Ascendant, 10th, 11th, or 3rd, separating from a good Planet and applying to the ☌, ∗, or △ of the Ascendant, the report is true; the ☽ void of course, false and suddenly contradicted; if the ☽ be in □ or ☍ of ☿, and neither behold the Ascendant, false.
rules.translation: 传闻真假：月在升/10/11/3宫、自吉星分离而入相升主之合/六合/三合=真；月空亡=假且旋即被驳；月与水星刑冲且皆不照升=假；升主/月居角宫+定座或与日月金吉=真；月/升主与凶星恶照居降宫、水星合龙尾或合冲刑土火=假。
rules.notes: CHAP III SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按5主与2主互照及4主与升关系判
rules.original_text: The Father's estate is signified by the 5th House (4th's 2nd): if the Lord of the 5th be in good aspect to the Ascendant or Lord of the 2nd, the Querent shall enjoy his Father's estate; if the 5th Lord be afflicted, or Infortunes in the 4th or 5th, no hope.
rules.translation: 父之遗产：第4宫=父、第5宫（4之2）=其财。5宫主吉照升主或2宫主=可承父业；吉星在5宫照升主/2主、5主在2宫或2主在5宫、福点由5主且5主在升或2宫=大吉；5主受克或凶星在4/5宫=无望。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT I；旁注：5宫头星座=父业根本质性；5主之落宫/所照/所居=父业显化与位次

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象星互涉判可否成交
rules.original_text: Buying houses or land: if the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽ be in ☌ with the Lord of the 4th or a Planet therein, or in good aspect or reception, or the Lord of the 4th in the Ascendant, it may be effected. The 7th Lord by Haly signifies the Seller.
rules.translation: 买地置业：升主或月合4宫主/宫内星、或吉照互纳、或4宫主落升=可成。第7宫主按 Haly 代表卖方，卖方主吉照/入相升主=愿售；有互纳或光线承转、月承光=可成或赖他人成之；无互纳/光线/无望之相=不成。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT II；若4/5宫见凶星则房/地有瑕疵，无好结局

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按4宫头星座元素判地质
rules.original_text: The quality of the ground: a Fiery Sign on the 4th Cusp, hilly, dry, hungry, stony; an Airy Sign, good and mixed; an Earthy Sign, good plain pasture; a Watry Sign, moist, springs or a river; Scorpio on the 4th, boggy, unwholesome, standing water.
rules.translation: 土地质地：4宫头为火象星座=山丘干燥石质；风象=总体好、质地混杂；土象=良好平缓牧场；水象=潮湿、有泉或河流过；天蝎座落4宫头=沼泽不洁、积水易涝。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT II；有作者称吉星顺行在天顶=地上多林木

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In buying or hiring a Ship: the Ascendant and Lord thereof with the ☽ signify the Buyer; the 7th House and Lord, the Seller; the 4th House and Lord, the Ship; the 10th House and Lord with Planets therein, the Tackling and Masts. Judge as in buying houses.
rules.translation: 买船/租船：升点+升主+月=买方；第7宫+7宫主=卖方；第4宫+4宫主=船；第10宫+10宫主及宫内星=帆具桅杆。各征象按买屋之法判，并参酌船体十二分座（见映射A）。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Removal: if Fortunate Planets be in the Ascendant or 4th, stay; if the Ascendant or 4th be afflicted by the Infortunes, remove. The 7th House signifies the place you would remove to; the 4th, the present habitation; the 10th, the benefit or prejudice of removing.
rules.translation: 搬迁：吉星在升或第4宫，宜留；升或第4宫受凶星所克，宜迁。第7宫=将迁之地；第4宫=现居；第10宫=搬迁之利弊。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT III；观察月之分离与入相大有助益

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按吉星与4宫状态判有宝/无宝；月或4主曾自木金分离=宝已被移走
rules.original_text: Hidden Treasure: if Fortunate Planets be strong in the North Angle free from the Infortunes, or ⊕ or ☊ be therein, or the Lord of the 4th in the 4th, there may be Treasure; its nature is of the Significator (☉=Gold, ☽=Silver). If the 4th be afflicted by the Infortunes, no Treasure.
rules.translation: 藏宝：吉星强居北角免受凶照，或福点/龙头在角，或4宫主落4宫，则疑处可能藏宝，其质按征象星定（日=金、月=银）。4宫受凶星临/照则多半无宝。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT IV；是否可得：升主/月在4宫或吉照4主=可掘得

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 问错放/遗失之物在何处
rules.result: 按2宫主落宫与星座元素定位（见映射H）
rules.original_text: Things mislaid: the Lord of the 2nd in the Ascendant, the thing is in the house, in the part the Querent delights in; in the 10th, in the Shop or Hall; in the 7th, in the Wife's chamber; in the 4th, in some decayed part where old people lodge; in Fiery Signs, near the Chimney; in Earthy, lower rooms or the floor; in Watry, near water (Cistern, Wash-house, Dairy); in Airy, upper rooms.
rules.translation: 错放之物定位：2宫主落升=在屋内问者常处之部；落10宫=店铺/厅堂（绅士=饭厅、乡人=入门首间）；落7宫=妻室或女眷常处；落4宫=旧败之处/老人所居；落火象座=近壁炉；落土象座=下层房间或地板；落水象座=近水处（水池、洗衣房、奶房）；落风象座=上层房间或高处。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT IV；Coley 称此等规则屡经验证

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
planets: 升主/7主/4主/土/火/龙尾/木/金
rules.result: 按双方征象星强弱判城之得失（Haly 相反分法见原文）
rules.original_text: A City or Fort besieged: the Ascendant and Lord signify the Besiegers; the 7th, the Enemy; the 4th, the Town; the Lord of the 4th, the Governour; the 10th, the Commander of the besiegers; the 5th, the Ammunition and Provision of the besieged. If ♄, ♂, or ☋ be in the 4th, and ♃ or ♀ in no friendly aspect, the Fort cannot hold long.
rules.translation: 围城能否攻下：升点+升主=围攻者；第7宫=敌军；第4宫=城/要塞；4宫主=守将；第10宫=围攻军统帅；第5宫=守方弹药粮草。土/火/龙尾落4宫且木金无吉照，则城难久守。
rules.notes: CHAP IV SECT V；注：行星在擢升位强于在庙位；上位星优于下位星；火星为战事本主

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
planets: 升主/月/5宫主/土/火/龙尾/金星
rules.result: 按征象星与5宫互涉判有子/无子
rules.original_text: Issue: if the Lord of the Ascendant and ☽ behold the Lord of the 5th, or transfer his light, or be in fruitful Signs, the Querent may have Children; if ♄, ♂, or ☋ be in the 5th, or ♀ combust, or the Sign of the 5th barren, very rarely.
rules.translation: 能否有子：升主与月照5宫主、或传递其光线、或征象星居多产星座，则可望有子；土/火/龙尾落5宫、或金星焦伤、或5宫头为不育星座，则极难得子。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT I；升主/月在5宫、5主在升、木金在5宫亦为吉兆

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上述判据判有孕与否与性别
rules.original_text: With Child: if the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽ be in fruitful Signs, beholding the Cusp of the 5th or its Lord by ∗ or △, or ♃ or ♀ Angular free from ♄ ♂, she is with Child. Sex by the majority of Masculine or Feminine testimonies.
rules.translation: 是否怀孕：升主/月在多产星座照5宫头或其主六合/三合，或木金居角宫免受土火之克，则有孕。性别按征象星阴阳性星座多数判（多阳=男，多阴=女）。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 双体/多产征象=双胎；定座=单胎
rules.original_text: Twins: if the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽ be in double-bodied Signs, or the Ascendant or Cusp of the 5th bicorporeal, or ☊ in the 5th in fruitful Signs, the Querent is with twins or more; if fixed Signs be on those Houses with ☉ or ☽ therein, a single conception.
rules.translation: 双胎：升主/月居双体星座，或升点/5宫头为双体座，或龙头落5宫多产座，则可能双胎或多胎；若定座临宫且日月在内，则单胎。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按最近分离相位查映射F
rules.original_text: The time of conception: Lilly's Rule — consider the ☽, Lord of the 5th, and Lord of the hour; observe from which they last separated: if from a △, the 5th or 3rd month; from a ∗, the 2nd or 6th; from a □, the 4th; from a ☍, seven months; from a ☌, one month.
rules.translation: 怀孕月数（莉莉法）：看月、5宫主、时主最近自何相位分离：△=第5或3月；六合=第2或6月；刑=第4月；冲=7月；合=1月。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT II；Coley 注：一点经验可印证或反驳此规则

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按多产-不育征象数差判
rules.original_text: The number of Children: allow one for every Planet in a fruitful Sign, two for every Planet in a common or double-bodied Sign; subtract the testimonies of barrenness; the remainder shews the number.
rules.translation: 子女数：每行星居多产座记一，居变/双体座记二；减去不育征象数，余数即子女数。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT II；生产时间：把子女点（日夜均自♂至♃，从升起算）指向5宫头，每度=1天；5宫主距宫头每星座=1月

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象星吉凶相位判忠信与结局
rules.original_text: Embassadours and Messengers: the Lord of the 5th signifies the Messenger, the ☽ co-significator; the Planet he applies to shews the cause; the 6th, his Assistants. For a common Messenger: 5th the Letter, 7th the person sent to, 3rd and 9th the journey, 4th the conclusion.
rules.translation: 使者与书信：5宫主=使者（月为共同征象），其所入相之星=出使之由；6宫=随从。普通书信：5宫=信，7宫=收信人，3/9宫=旅途之事，4宫=结局成败。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT III；5主自7主分离=使者返程中

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Play or Gameing: if there be reception between the Lord of the 5th (the Game) and the Lord of the Ascendant, or a friendly aspect, the Querent may gain; ♀ beholding the Lord of the 2nd or Ascendant helps; the Lord of the 8th signifies the Adversary's substance.
rules.translation: 赌博：5宫主=赌局、升主=问者，两者互纳或吉相=可赢；金星照2宫主或升主=更验；8宫主=对手之财。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: A Petition: the 5th House, its Lord, and the ☽ signify the Petition; the 10th House, its Lord, and the ☉, the Person presented unto. Reception or good aspect between the Lord of the 10th and Lord of the 5th, the Petition is heard.
rules.translation: 请愿：5宫+5宫主+月=请愿书；10宫+10宫主+日=所呈贵人。10宫主与5宫主互纳或吉照=请愿被受理；升主受4/8/10/12宫主刑冲、或月/5主受克=被拒。
rules.notes: CHAP V SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上述指认分派征象星
rules.original_text: The Ascendant and its Lord with the Almuten of the Figure signify the Sick; the 6th House, its Lord, the Sign he is in, Planets therein, with the ☽ and her Sign, the Disease; the 7th, the Physician; the 10th and its Almuten, the Medicine.
rules.translation: 疾病问事指认：升点+升主+图之主=病人；6宫+6宫主+所临星座+宫内星+月及其星座=疾病；7宫=医生；10宫及其主=所用之药。7宫受克=医者难治愈；10宫受克或凶星在内=药不对症反增病。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT I；验尿：病人未同意则升=问者，病人按关系取宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The parts of the body governed by the Planets: ♄ bones, teeth, spleen, right ear, retentive faculty; ♃ liver, lungs, ribs, sides, blood, veins, digestion; ♂ gall, taste, stones, face; ☉ sight, right eye, heart, back, arteries; ♀ instruments of generation, throat, reins, kidneys; ☿ the rational part, brain, imagination, tongue, hands, feet, spirits; ☽ the brain, stomach, bowels, bladder, right eye of a Woman, left of a Man.
rules.translation: 行星所主人身部位：土=骨/牙/脾/右耳/保留力；木=肝/肺/肋/侧/血/静脉/消化力；火=胆/味觉/睾丸/脸；日=视觉/右眼/心/背/动脉；金=生殖器/喉/腰/肾；水=理性/脑/想象/舌/手/脚/精神；月=脑/胃/肠/膀胱/女右眼男左眼。四功能：吸引=日（火象三分）、消化=木（风象）、保留=土（土象）、排泄=月（水象）。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT I；详见映射D

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上述判据判康复/速愈
rules.original_text: Recovery: if the ☽ and Significator of the Disease be not afflicted but apply to the good aspects of the Fortunes, or be in reception, great hopes of recovery; if ♃ or ♀ or ☉ or ☽ be in the Ascendant, none of them Lords of the 8th, speedy recovery.
rules.translation: 康复判据：月与病征象不受克、入相吉星吉照或互纳=有望康复；木/金/日/月居升且皆非8宫主=速愈；月合金居图之好宫亦吉。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上述判据判慢性或急性
rules.original_text: Chronic or Acute: ♄ signifying the Disease, or a fixed Sign on the Cusp of the 6th, shews a long disease; the latter degrees of a Sign, or ♃ or ♂ signifying, or moveable or common Signs on the 6th, or ♀ ☿ ☽ signifying, shew a short disease or sudden alteration.
rules.translation: 慢性/急性：土星为病征象或定座临6宫头=病拖延难除；星座末度、或木/火为病征象、或动/变座临6宫头、或金/水/月为病征象=病短或骤变。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT I；单凭此可判 Chronique 或 Acute

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按8宫主强度与月状态判危险度
rules.original_text: Danger of death: if the Lord of the 8th be strong and Angular, the ☽ weak and Cadent, or the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽ afflicted by the Infortunes or Combust of the ☉, dangerous testimonies threatening death; if the Lord of the 8th be in his Essential Dignities in the Ascendant, or in ☌ with its Lord, a mortal sign.
rules.translation: 死亡危险：8宫主强居角宫、月弱居降宫；或升主/月受凶星所克、焦伤于日；8宫主本然尊贵居升、或合升主——均为致命征兆。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT I；除非吉星接纳或吉照介入

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按落座元素查映射E判病性
rules.original_text: The nature of the Disease: ♄ lingering distempers, Consumptions, Coughs, Quartain Agues; in Fiery Signs, long dangerous fevers; in Watry, gross vitious humours, chronic, flux; in Earthy, melancholy; in Airy, Gout.
rules.translation: 土星病性：拖延之病——消耗、咳嗽、四日疟。落火象座=长久危险之热病；落水象座=粗浊体液/寒湿慢性病兼泄泻；落土象座=久缠忧郁；落风象座=痛风。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT II；详见映射E

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按落座元素判病性（见映射E）
rules.original_text: If ♃ signify the Disease, the Liver is disordered: in Fiery Signs, a fever of uncorrupted blood, not long; in Earthy, the Collick or Scurvey; in Airy, surfeits; in Watry, Scurvey, Dropsie, Itch. If ♂, a violent fever of corrupted blood: in Fiery, burning fever or Plague; in Earthy, bloody flux or Jaundice; in Airy, Quotidian fevers, frenzy, madness; in Watry, small-pox, measles, dropsie, scurvey.
rules.translation: 木星病性：肝失调。火象=血热短热；土象=绞痛/坏血；风象=暴食之疾；水象=坏血/水肿/疥。火星病性：暴热腐血。火象=烧热/瘟疫；土象=血痢/黄疸；风象=每日热/狂躁疯癫；水象=痘/麻疹/水肿/疥。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the ☉ be afflicted by ♄ at the Decumbiture, the disease arises from Melancholy; if by ♂, from Choler; the first may produce a Consumption, the last a Jaundice. If ♀ signify the Disease, from Intemperance or Debauchery; in ill aspect to ♄, danger of poyson; to ♃, a surfeit; to ♂, a venereal distemper; to ☉, a fever; to ☿, disturbed fancy; to ☽, a palsie.
rules.translation: 日受土克=病起于忧郁（可致消耗）；受火克=病起于胆汁（可致黄疸）。金星为病征象=纵欲所致；金受土克=中毒之险；受木克=暴食；受火克=性病；受日克=热病；受水克=情志错乱；受月克=瘫痪。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If ☿ be afflicted, the distemper lies in the Brain, madness or frenzy; if ♄ afflicts, melancholy; if ♀ beholds, love-sickness; if ☽ in ☍ or □ of ☿, convulsion-fits or falling sickness. If the ☽ be in ♈ principal Significator in the 8th, the head is afflicted, probably the Megrim.
rules.translation: 水星受克=脑病（狂躁疯癫，火/日克之尤验）；土克=忧郁；金照=相思病；月刑冲水=痉挛癫痫。月在白羊且为8宫主征象=头部受病（偏头痛）。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT II；行星述病、其落座述病位、所居宫述病因

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象与其主宰状态判
rules.original_text: If the ☉, ☽, or Ascendant be much afflicted, and their Lords or Dispositors free, the Body is distempered and the Mind free; but if the Ascendant and Luminaries be free and their Dispositors debilitated, the Distemper lies in the mind.
rules.translation: 身心之别：日月升点受克而其主/主宰未受阻=身病而心宁；反之升与日月无恙而其主宰受损=病在心。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT II；精神病因：土=忧、木=宗教、火=争吵、日=虚荣、金=情欲、水=过劳、月=小人

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 卧病图中月受土或火所克
rules.original_text: Hermes' Diagnosticks: the ☽ afflicted in the four Triplicities by ♄ or ♂ at the Decumbiture, gives the nature, part, remedy, and danger of the disease.
rules.translation: 赫尔墨斯诊断法：卧病时月亮于四大元素三分星座受土星或火星合/刑/冲所克，其落座与克星组合决定病性、病位、用药与危险日。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT III；24条全表见映射C（月落12座×土/火二克星）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按日月升主受克数与8宫关联判
rules.original_text: The sick is in great danger when at the time of the Question the Luminaries are under the Earth, more dangerous if afflicted; if the ☉ and ☽, or Lord of the Figure, or Lord of the Ascendant be free from affliction and have no affinity with the Lord of the 8th, the sick recovers; if two of these be afflicted, very ill.
rules.translation: 问病时日月在地平线下=病危（受克更危）；日月/图之主/升主三者中任一无受克且与8宫主无涉，则必愈；其中两者受克则病况极差。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT IV 精选格言

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant be in the 8th House of the Figure, and received by the Lord of the 8th in some Essential Dignity, the Patient recovers beyond expectation.
rules.translation: 升主落卧病图第8宫、且被8宫主以本然尊贵接纳（纵无互纳），病人出乎意料地康复。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT IV；精选格言

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Servants: if the Lord of the 6th be in good aspect to the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽, or in the Dignities of the Fortunes, or good aspect to the Lord of the 2nd, the Servants are just and honest; if in bad aspect to the Ascendant or 2nd, or in evil configuration with ♄ ♂, or ☋ in the 6th, dishonest.
rules.translation: 仆役诚实：6宫主吉照升主/月、或居吉星尊贵、或吉照2宫主=仆诚实；6宫主恶照升/2宫、或与土火恶配、或龙尾落6宫=仆不诚不可信。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT V；仆脱身：升主与10宫主（主人）合相或与日合=可得自由；征象逆行=迟得自由

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Small Cattle: if the Lord of the 6th be strong, free from affliction, in good aspect to the Lord of the 2nd, its Cusp, or ⊕, or in the Dignities of ♃ or ♀, the Querent shall be fortunate in Sheep, Hogs, Goats, Conies, and Birds.
rules.translation: 小牲畜（羊/猪/羊兔/禽鸟）：6宫主强无克、吉照2宫主/宫头/福点、或居木金尊贵，则问者经营小牲畜得利。
rules.notes: CHAP VI SECT V；反则 6主受克/龙尾在6=无利；大牲畜归第12宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Marriage in general: if the Lord of the Ascendant with the ☽ or ♀ be in ☌, ∗, or △ with the Lord of the 7th, or in the 7th House, or in reception with the Lord of the 7th, or ♀ in the Ascendant, the Querent may marry.
rules.translation: 婚姻总则：升主（连同月/金）与7宫主成合/六合/三合、或落7宫、或与7宫主互纳、或金星在升，则可婚。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If none of these testimonies, but the Lord of the Ascendant, ☉, ☽, ♀, or the major part, be in barren Signs, or behold each other by cross aspects without reception, dejectedly placed, the Querent will not marry, having an antipathy.
rules.translation: 若无上述征象，且升主/日/月/金之多数居不育星座、或互以刑冲相照而无接纳、局促于劣位，则问者不婚且生反感。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按相位与接纳判成否及难易
rules.original_text: To obtain the desired party: the 7th and its Lord signify the person; if the Lord of the Ascendant or ☽ be joyned by body or aspect (especially ∗ or △) with reception, obtained with ease; by □ or ☍ without reception, obtained with difficulty, interest exceeds affection.
rules.translation: 求婚成败：7宫+7宫主=所求之人。升主/月与其合体或吉照（六合/三合尤佳）且有接纳=易成；刑冲而无接纳=虽成而难，利害盖过真情，无甚幸福。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按阻断行星之宫位判破坏者与原因
rules.original_text: If the Significators be in cadent houses, not beholding each other, no reception nor translation of light, small hopes; if ♄ or ♂ interpose their malicious beams before the perfect aspect, the match shall be broken off by the person signified by the frustrating Planet; if he be Lord of the 2nd or 8th, money is the occasion.
rules.translation: 征象星居降宫互不相照、无接纳无光线传递=事难成。吉相临成之际土火恶光插入=婚约被其所主之人破坏；若破坏者为2/8宫主，则缘由在金钱。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The time of Marriage: the degrees of distance the Significators want of a partile aspect, measured into weeks, months, days, and years, as directed Chap. 2. Sect. 3. The surest is by direction of a Significator to a proper Promittor in the Nativity.
rules.translation: 婚期：征象星距成相（partile）的度数距离，按第2章第3节之法换算周/月/日/年；最确者为本命中征象星对合适应期星的推运。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I；婚后和睦：征象星吉照/互纳=和睦；凶星在7宫=妻争强；在升=夫为争端之源

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Marry more than once: many Planets in the 7th in good aspect to the Ascendant, or the Significators in bicorporeal Signs, argue more than one marriage; fixed Signs, or the Significators in no aspect, but one wife. The Wife's Portion is judged from the Lord of the 8th.
rules.translation: 再婚：多星落7宫吉照升主、或婚征象星居双体座=多婚；定座临7宫头、或征象星无相=只一妻。妻之嫁妆看8宫主及宫内星。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To try whether the party be married: if there be application between the Lord of the Ascendant, ☽ and Lord of the 7th, or between ☉ and ♀, the person is or hath been married; if the Significator be in bad aspect to ♂ from the 5th, or ☋ therein, suspicion of debauchery.
rules.translation: 测验是否已婚：升主/月与7宫主有入相、或日月金之间有入相，则已婚或曾婚；征象星受5宫火星恶照或龙尾在5宫，可疑其失贞。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I；处女测：征象星居定座免火克、无凶星在升/5宫=贞洁

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象星强弱与焦伤先后判
rules.original_text: Which of the two, Man or Wife, may die first: the old rule is to consider which of their Significators is strongest, or goes first to Combustion of the ☉, or is afflicted by the Lord of the 8th; in fixed Signs, some considerable time; in moveable, a short time; in common, something longer.
rules.translation: 夫妻谁先死：古法看双方征象星孰强、孰先入日之焦伤、孰受8宫主所克；落定座=尚有时日、落动座=不久、落变座=略久。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT I；最确法看本命推运 Hyleg 对8宫主/Anareta 之凶向（详第三部分）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 比较双方征象星强弱判胜负
rules.original_text: Law-suits: the Querent is signified by the Ascendant and its Lord, the Adversary by the 7th, the Judge by the 10th, the Jury by the ☽, the end by the 4th. The strongest Significator overcomes.
rules.translation: 诉讼：升点+升主=问者，7宫=对方，10宫=法官，月=陪审，4宫=结局。征象星强者胜。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT II；升主强于7主=问者胜；2主强于8主=问者钱袋足

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If both Significators apply to a ∗ or △, or there be reception, they may compose the business; the Planet that applies signifies the party that shall first move to reconcile. The ☽ in the 11th in ∗ or △ to the Ascendant, the Jury is favourable.
rules.translation: 双方征象星入相六合/三合或互纳=可和解（先入相者=先动议和之人）；月落11宫六合/三合照升=陪审有利。10宫主吉照2宫主=法官受赂；10宫主为下位星而升主为上位星=法官易偏袒问者。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT II；同法适用于决斗与公开之敌

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Partnership: if both Significators behold each other by a friendly aspect, or be in reception by house or exaltation, a good agreement; if by bad aspect, the contrary. If ♄ ♂ or ☋ be in the 2nd, the Querent suffers in estate; in the 8th, the evil falls on the Partner's estate.
rules.translation: 合伙：双方征象星吉照/互纳=善合；恶照=不合。土火龙尾在2宫=问者受损；在8宫=祸及对方之财；吉星在升=问者奸诈；在7宫=对方失当。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Return safe from War: if the Ascendant be free from the Infortunes, its Lord free from the 8th Lord, good encouragement; ♂ strong in his Ascendant, prosperous; if ♄ or ♂ be in the Ascendant and its Lord weak, not good to go to war; if an Infortune be in the 8th or 4th, taken, killed, or dangerously wounded.
rules.translation: 战争归来：升点免凶星、升主免8宫主之克=可赴；火星强居升=既荣且安。土火落升而升主弱=不宜赴战；凶星落8/4宫=被擒、战死或重伤。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: A Man of War setting out: if the Lord of the 7th apply to a bad aspect of the Lord of the Ascendant, or the ☽ near ☌ □ ☍ of the Lord of the 7th or 9th, meeting an enemy; many Planets in the West Angle, many enemies or prizes; double-bodied Signs on the 7th Cusp, or its Lord in such a Sign or in ☌ with several Planets, the same.
rules.translation: 战船出海：7宫主入相克升主、或月临近7/9宫主之合刑冲=遇敌；多星聚西角=多敌或多获；7宫头双体座、或7主居双体座/合多星=同断。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上述判据取盗贼征象星
rules.original_text: The Significator of the Thief (Haly): the Ascendant and its Lord signify the Querent; the 2nd House, its Lord with ⊕, the goods lost; the 4th, the place where the goods are. A Peregrine Planet in an Angle having dignity in the 7th, afflicting the 2nd, its Lord, or ⊕, is the Significator of the Thief; many Peregrine Planets in Angles afflicting the Significators, more thieves than one.
rules.translation: 盗贼征象星（Haly）：升点+升主=问者；2宫+2宫主+福点=失物；4宫=物之所在。在角宫而客居（peregrine）、于7宫有尊贵、且克2宫/2主/福点之星=盗贼征象；多颗客居星居角克征象=不止一贼。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT III；升主客居=失物确系被盗；7主或客居星在升克2主/福点=真被盗

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Whether the Querent be the Thief: if the Lord of the 4th or ☽ be joyned to the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Lord of the 7th in the Ascendant, suspect the Querent; if the Lord of the 7th be Peregrine in the Ascendant and Lord of the 2nd, the Querent consented to the theft.
rules.translation: 问者是否即贼：4宫主或月合升主、或7宫主落升，疑问者即贼（若此星形貌吻合尤验）；7宫主客居落升且兼2宫主，则问者纵容失窃。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT III；Coley 警告此类判断宜谨慎使用

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按征象星性别/东出西入/月相/天区查映射G
rules.original_text: The Age and Sex of the Thief: a Masculine Planet in a Masculine House and Sign, a Man; a Feminine, a Woman. Oriental, young; Occidental, more in years. ♄ old (unless in the very beginning of a Sign); ♀ and ☿ youth; ♃ ♂ ☉ middle age, thirty to forty; the ☽ by her quarters: first, youth; second, 25 or 30; third, 40 or 45; last, 45 to 50 and upwards. The Quarter of Heaven: East Angle, youth; Mid-heaven, middle age; between 7th and 4th, declining age; between 4th and Ascendant, old age.
rules.translation: 盗贼年龄性别：阳星居阳宫阳座=男；阴星居阴宫阴座=女。东出=年轻，西入=年长。土=老（除非在星座初度）；金水=少；木火日=中年（30-40）；月按四相：初相=少、二相=25-30、三相=40-45、末相=45-50以上。天区：东角=少、天顶=中年、7至4宫之间=渐老、4至升之间=老年。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT III；颜色从行星颜色+落座+所成相推

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按日月落宫与相位查映射G
rules.original_text: The Thief's House: ☉ signifies the house of the Thief, ☽ the Door; if the ☽ be in a fixed Sign, one door; moveable, steps to the door, more than one way; ♄ beholding the ☽, the door old and decayed; ♂ in ☌ or ☍, part burnt; Infortunes in ∗ or △, the door strong with iron. If the Significator be in the Ascendant, East; Mid-heaven, South; 7th, West; 4th, North.
rules.translation: 盗贼住处：日=其屋，月=其门。月落定座=一门；落动座=门有阶、进路不止一条；土星照月=门旧破；火星合/冲月=门有焚迹；凶星六合/三合照月=门以铁加固。征象星落升=城东、落天顶=城南、落7宫=城西、落4宫=城北。
rules.notes: CHAP VII SECT III；贼是否在城中：征象星将出星座=离城；入本然尊贵=去亲友处；入客居=避匿生人处；7主角宫合2主=尚在城中

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 断不长寿、多病（月为6主受火克）；然土金有互纳（土擢升于天秤、金得摩羯三分）+月在升六合土=部分缓解
rules.original_text: Example I (1st House): ♄ Lord of the Ascendant in ♑ his own House in the 12th, in □ of ♀ Lady of the 8th; the ☽ lately in ☍ of ♂ from Angles; ☿ Lord of the 4th Combust in the 8th.
rules.translation: 判例一（第一宫·寿限）：升主土星居摩羯本庙在12宫，刑第八宫主金星；月亮刚出火星冲相（自角宫）；4宫主水星焦伤于8宫。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.I；示范 征象星受克=断凶 与 互纳/尊贵=缓解 之权衡

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 问欲访之人是否在家（无亲属关系者取7宫主）
rules.result: 断不在家、然离家不远，可由女仆指引寻得（月6主刚出火冲、在升六合土）
rules.original_text: Example II (1st House): the ☉ Lord of the 7th (no relation) not in an Angle but in the 8th, a Succedent House, neer the South-west quarter.
rules.translation: 判例二（第一宫·缺席者）：7宫主日不在角宫而落续宫8宫近西南向，且合水星（=所伴之人）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 断目前安健；然曾险死或重病一场（8主金受土刑、月在6宫曾出火冲）；土落12宫=或因缺钱受困
rules.original_text: Example III (1st House): the Absent party (no relation) signified by the Ascendant, its Lord and the ☽; ♄ Lord of the Ascendant in his own Dignities and in ∗ to the ☽, but in □ to ♀ Lady of the 8th.
rules.translation: 判例三（第一宫·缺席者生死）：不相识者以升点/升主/月为征象。升主土星居本然尊贵且六合月亮，但刑第八宫主金星。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.III；若问夫/妻则取7宫主日+宫内火星

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 现安、曾历险（海盗/覆舟之危）
rules.original_text: Example IV (1st House): Ship at Sea — Ascendant & ☽ signify the Ship, its Lord & ♄ the persons in her; ♄ strong in his own Dignities in ∗ to the ☽, but in □ to ♀ Lady of the 8th, the ☽ lately separated from the ☍ of ♂.
rules.translation: 判例四（第一宫·海船）：升点+月=船，升主+土星=船上之人。土星居本庙且六合月=船现安；但土刑8主金、月方出火冲=曾历大险（死难/覆舟/海盗），土为12主落12宫且8宫得强=益证。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.IV；虽关航海实属第一宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 大体无凶、然防权贵构陷与自身鲁莽
rules.original_text: Example V (1st House): sudden accident — ♂ Lord of the ☉'s house, ♃ of the ☽'s house intercepted in ♓ in the Ascendant; ♄ Lord of the Ascendant in his own Dignities in ∗ to the ☽.
rules.translation: 判例五（第一宫·突发之事）：火星为日宫主、木星为月宫主（被截于双鱼在升）；升主土星居本庙六合月=无需过虑；然土为12主自基本星座刑10主木星（龙头在10）=防官员/权贵/名誉之损，且自招之祸。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Example VI (1st House): Marks and Moles — ♄ in ♑ afflicted by □ of ♀ Lady of the 8th: a mark on or neer one of the Knees; the ☽ in ♓ not yet past the ☍ of ♂: another upon the left Foot (♀ Sign & ☽ a Feminine Planet); ♋ descending on the Cusp of the 6th: another on the Breast.
rules.translation: 判例六（第一宫·痣疤）：土落摩羯受8主金刑=膝上或膝近有痣；月在双鱼未过火冲=左脚有痣（双鱼为阴座、月为阴星）；巨蟹落6宫头=胸上有痣。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I Paragr.VI；宫位共征：星在升=头面、2宫=颈喉（各宫类推）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 可致富，财从赌博/酒馆/妻室（2主落7宫受水主宰、金强居8宫）而来，兼凭机智
rules.original_text: Example (2nd House): ♂ Lord of the 2nd in ♍ (house of ☿) in the 7th, ♃ in the 2nd in ♈ Retrograde in ∗ to ⊕ in the 5th; the ☽ virtually in the 2nd.
rules.translation: 判例（第二宫·致富）：2宫主火星居室女座落7宫（受水星主宰），木星逆居2宫白羊、六合5宫双子之福点，月虚入2宫=断问者可得与身份相称之财。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II Paragr.I-II；财之持久：2宫头白羊动座+木逆+福点主焦伤=不久散

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 问与兄弟亲邻是否和睦（示范）
rules.result: 不相睦、各守体面互不让步
rules.original_text: Example (3rd House): ♀ Lady of the 3rd in □ to ♄ Lord of the Ascendant; ♀ strong in her own Dignities.
rules.translation: 判例（第三宫·兄弟）：3宫主金星刑升主土星=兄弟间几近相恨；双方征象星皆居本然尊贵强健（虽在劣宫）=各自高傲互不相让。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT III Paragr.I；内路行程例：♀强而受刑冲=途中有财与身之损、或遇盗

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Example (4th House): ☿ Lord of the 4th Combust of the ☉ in the 8th, both within Orbs of a □ with ♄ Lord of the Ascendant; the ☊ in the 4th; ♀ Lady of the 8th in ♎ her own Dignity in △ to ⊕.
rules.translation: 判例（第四宫·置业）：4宫主水星焦伤于日居8宫，与升主土星入相刑=屋地虽可购成然费大力多周折，卖方无意主动成交（日为卖方）；龙头在4=地佳、月土吉照4宫头=问者有诚意，终以难成之劳而得之。
