rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT IV Paragr.I；移居例：龙头在4+月空亡=劝留；父业例：5主受2主接纳=可承父业、福点在5=父业可观

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 能有子女、男女皆有而不多
rules.original_text: Example (5th House): Cusp of the 5th a barren Sign, ♂ in □ thereunto, ☿ Lord of the 5th in □ to ♄ and in ☌ of ☉; but the ☽ in ♓ a fruitful Sign applying to ∗ of the 5th; ☿ in ♏ in ☌ of ♀ in ♎ her Dignities; ⊕ in the 5th.
rules.translation: 判例（第五宫·子女）：5宫头为不育星座+火星刑之+5主水星刑土且合日=本无子之兆；然月在双鱼多产座入相六合5宫头、水落天蝎合金（金居天秤本庙）、福点在5=多产之兆更胜=可得子女、多为男（升主阳星、月将入阳座、5主合日）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT V Paragr.I；验孕例：月入相5宫头+福点在5=已孕，但刑冲多=恐为假孕/流产

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.condition: 问病人何部位受病与能否愈（示范）
rules.result: 病在腿腹、冷湿之因，药有不当，然终能渐愈
rules.original_text: Example (6th House): the ☽ Lady of the 6th in ♓ in the Ascendant, lately afflicted by ☍ of ♂ in an Angle in ♍; ♂ rules the Legs & Belly; ♀ Lady of the 8th in □ to ♄; the ☋ in the 10th.
rules.translation: 判例（第六宫·疾病）：月为6宫主居双鱼在升、方出火星冲（火居角宫室女座）=病在腿与腹（火主之部位）：肠痞、忧郁、阻塞；腿病=抽筋/肿痛/血滞，病因冷湿。8主金刑土、龙头在10=药不对症（龙尾在天顶），吉者仅月在升六合土、土于8宫得擢升并与8主互纳=终可渐愈。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VI Paragr.I；仆役例：月6主在升六合土=仆忠、小牲畜利，然不宜过信（月方出火冲2主）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 难成婚、纵成亦多磨且性情不投
rules.original_text: Example (7th House): the ☽ in a prolifical Sign in ∗ to ♄ Lord of the Ascendant (argument of Marriage); but ♀ in □ to ♄, ♄ in □ to the ☉ Lord of the 7th, ♂ in the 7th in ♍ a barren Sign, ♌ on its Cusp, another barren Sign.
rules.translation: 判例（第七宫·婚姻）：月居多产座六合升主土=有婚之兆；然金刑土、土刑7主日、火落7宫室女（不育座）且狮子上7宫头（亦不育座）=难得成婚，纵成亦多磨（土日天性相敌）；妻性以日水述之，婚期以推运定。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT VII Paragr.I；嫁妆例：8主金居本庙三合福点=妆厚，然刑土冲木=难取；诉讼例：升主强于7主=问者胜；逃亡例：月六合土、水入相土=将回、向西南；失物例：以7主日定贼、贼约中年、难追回；合伙例：升主7主刑冲=水火不容不宜合伙；围城例：4/5主水焦伤8宫=守将终降

rules.original_text: The Zodiack is a great Circle of the Sphere, and is divided into 360 degrees, every degree into 60 minutes, every minute into 60 seconds... Every Sign contains 30 of those degrees... The whole Sphere of Heaven is divided by the Horizon into two Hemisphears, each Hemisphear divided by great Circles into six Parts, by Astrologers called Mansions, or Houses.
rules.translation: 黄道基本参数：360°/12 座×30°/度 60'/分 60''；黄道赤纬 ±23°30'（太阳最大赤纬）；天球由地平分两半球、各大圆分 6 分=12 宫；固定星 1022 颗、48 像（北 21/南 15/黄道 12）。

rules.original_text: These Heavenly Bodies are of two special kinds, that is to say, either Fixed or Wandering. Wandering Stars are those which are called Planets, and they are in Number seven. The Moon crosseth the Ecliptick in two places, called her Nodes, or the Dragons Head and Tayl.
rules.translation: 星体分类：恒星（第八层不动）与游星（七曜）；月之交点=龙头☊龙尾☋；七曜+两交点+福点⊕为占星基本对象。

rules.original_text: These Signs of the Zodiack are divided into 5 Triplicities according to the 4 Elements, Fiery, Airy, Earthy, and Watry. Fiery Signs are said to be in Nature hot and dry; Airy signs hot and moist; Earthy cold and dry; and Watry cold and moist.
rules.translation: 星座三元性（四元素）：火象♈♌♐热干、风象♊♎♒热湿、土象♉♍♑冷干、水象♋♏♓冷湿。

rules.original_text: They are also divided into Moveable, Fixed, and Common. Moveable: ♈♋♎♑; Fixed: ♉♌♏♒; Common: ♊♍♐♓.
rules.translation: 星座质别：动宫座♈♋♎♑、固定座♉♌♏♒、变宫座♊♍♐♓。

rules.original_text: Signs Fiery and Airy are termed Masculine; Earthy and Watry are termed Feminine. ♊♓ and the beginning of ♐ are double-bodied Signes.
rules.translation: 阴阳座：火风=阳、土水=阴；双体座=双子/双鱼/射手开头。

rules.original_text: ♋♏♓ are Fruitful Signs, ♊♌♍ are Barren Signs.
rules.translation: 多产座=巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼；不育座=双子/狮子/处女。

rules.original_text: The Signes are divided into four parts, answerable to the four Quarters of the year: Vernal ♈♉♊ hot and moist, Sanguine. Aestival ♋♌♍ hot and dry, Cholerick. Autumne ♎♏♐ cold and dry, Melancholly. Winter ♑♒♓ cold and moist, Phlegmatick.
rules.translation: 四季对应与体液：春♈♉♊热湿多血、夏♋♌♍热干多胆、秋♎♏♐冷干多郁、冬♑♒♓冷湿多痰。

rules.original_text: The Signes are also termed Mute as ♋♏♓.
rules.translation: 哑座=巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼（同多产座）。

rules.original_text: The first 8 degrees of Aries are Masculine, the ninth degree is Feminine, from 9 to 15 is Masculine, from 15 to 22 is Feminine, from 22 to 30 is Masculine, and so as they stand in order, in the rest of the Signes understand the same. The three first degrees of Aries are Dark, from thence to 8 are Light, from 8 to 16 are Dark, from 16 to 20 are Light, from 20 to 24 are Void, from 24 to 29 are Light degrees, the last degree is Void.
rules.translation: 度数性质表（每座同构）：阴阳度=1-8阳/9阴/9-15阳/15-22阴/22-30阳；明暗=1-3暗/3-8明/8-16暗/16-20明/20-24虚/24-29明/30虚；另有深陷度、减损(Azimene)度、增财度列。用法：升度明=貌清、暗=肤晦；虚度=心智浅；深陷=身或心缺；减损=畸形（曲/跛/盲）；增财度临 2 宫=发财。问盗贼或胎儿性别时度数阴阳定男女。
rules.notes: 其余座按原文'同构'推衍（映射H）

rules.original_text: A Conjunction is when two Planets possess one Signe and Degree... A Sextile when 60 degrees... a Quartile when 90 degrees... a Trine when 120... an Opposition when 180... these Aspects are two-fold, Sinister and Dexter, the Sinister falls according to succession of the Signes, and the Dexter contrary; the Dexter Aspects are most Powerful and Efficatious.
rules.translation: 五老相位：合☌（同座同度）、六合∗60°、刑□90°、三合△120°、冲☍180°；左右之分：Sinister 顺行序、Dexter 逆行序；Dexter（右）相位更有力。

rules.original_text: The New Aspects are eight in Number, viz. Semisextile SS, Tridecile Td, Quincunx Vc, Decile dcc, Sesquadras SSq, Semictuadrat S, Quintile Q, Bictuintile Bq.
rules.translation: 八新相位（Kepler 增）：半六合 SS(30°)、三合十分 Td(108°)、补八分 Vc(150°)、十分 dcc(36°)、八分之三 SSq(135°)、半八分 S(45°)、五分 Q(72°)、双五 Bq(144°)。
rules.notes: Heydon 1650 论文证其力；效力仅限入相内（orb 内）

rules.original_text: The ∗ Aspect is two whole Signes distant, and is accounted an Aspect of Imperfect Love. The □ Aspect is three Signs distant, and is an Aspect of Imperfect Hatred. The △ Aspect continnes 4 Signes, and is an Aspect of Perfect Love. The ☍ or Diametral, is an Aspect of perfect hatred.
rules.translation: 相位性质：六合=不完全爱、刑=不完全恨、三合=完美爱、冲=完美恨；合=吉与吉、凶与凶相随（中性随星）。

rules.original_text: By this Table you may see that a Planet in ♈ casts a sinister ∗ to ♊, and dexter ∗ to ♒ a □ dexter to ♑, and sinister to ♋; a △ to ♐ and ♌ and an ☍ to ♎... Where note that the Fiery and Airy Signes behold by a ∗, so do the Earthy and Watry; The △ Aspect is made from Signes of the same Triplicity; the Fiery Signes and Airy behold the Earthy and Watry by a □, and the contrary.
rules.translation: 相位落座表：火风座互相六合、同元素三合、火风照土水为刑；右相位较左有力。

rules.original_text: The Use that may be made of the Aspects... see from what Planet the Moon, Lord of the Ascendant, or Significator last separated: Also what Planet they are in Partile Aspect withal, and what Planet they apply unto... the power of an Aspect is said to continue twelves hours before and after the time thereof.
rules.translation: 相位用法：看月/升主/征象星与谁分离（过去）、与谁入相（未来）、入何相位落何宫；相位效力=精确时刻前后各 12 小时。

rules.original_text: The form and feature of any person, is to be judged from the Signe Ascending, the Lord thereof, and Planet posited in the Ascendant or in Aspect thereto; the fixed Stars are not to be neglected... in especial manner the Luminaries.
rules.translation: 形貌判断总则：升座+其主+升内行星/照升行星；恒星（尤其日月所在）亦参与；混合各征象得出完整描述。

rules.original_text: The Rule that I generally follow, and rarely fails, is to account Fiery Signes East; Airy Signes West; Earthy Signes South; and Watry Signes North. Note that the Northern Signes give a more Cheerful Countenance than the Southern.
rules.translation: 星座方向归属（Coley 主用法）：火=东、风=西、土=南、水=北；北座貌更开朗（另有两体系：按三方与按赤纬，见原文）。

rules.original_text: Saturn is also called Chronos, Phoenos, and Falcifer. Jupiter sometimes called Phaeton and Zeus. Mars, Aries, Pyrois, Mavors, Gradivus. The Sun, Titon, Ilios, Phoebus, Apollo, Paeon, Osyris, Diespiter. Venus, Cytheria, Aphrodite, Erycina, Phosphorus. Mercury, Hermes, Stilbone, Cyllenius, Archas. Luna, Lucina, Cynthia, Diana, Phoebe, Proferpina, Noctilurea, Latona. Note that ♂ and ♄ are generally called Infortunes, ♃ and ♀ Fortune, ☉, ☿, and ☽ Indifferent.
rules.translation: 行星别名（希腊罗马诸神名）与吉凶分类：土火=凶星、木金=吉星、日月水=中性。

rules.original_text: The Antiscions of the Planets in Signes are no more but Signes equally distant from the first points of ♋ and ♑ the two Tropicks... a Planet in ♈ casts his Antiscion to ♍, a Planet in ♓ sends his Antiscion to ♎ & contra... to obtain the Planets Antiscion in degrees: substract the degrees of a Planets Longitude from 30 degrees, and the Remainder is the exact place of the Antiscion.
rules.translation: 映点 Antiscion：对巨蟹/摩羯两至点对称（如日金牛10°→狮子20°）；映点=六合/三合之力（吉星尤验）、反映点 Contrantiscion=刑/冲之力。映点配对：♈-♍、♓-♎、♉-♌、♒-♏、♊-♋、♑-♐；度数=30-黄经。

rules.original_text: Saturn: ♒ Day-house, ♑ Night-house. Jupiter: ♓ Night-house, ♐ Day-house. Mars: ♈ Day-house, ♏ Night-house. Venus: ♉ Night-house, ♎ Day-house. Mercury: ♊ Day-house, ♍ Night-house. Moon: ♋. Sun: ♌. The Joyes of the Planets: ♄ in ♒, ♃ in ♐, ♂ in ♉, ☉ in ♍, ♀ in ♋, ☿ in ♊?, ☽ in ♊?
rules.translation: 行星宫位（昼夜）：土♒昼/♑夜、木♓夜/♐昼、火♈昼/♏夜、金♉夜/♎昼、水♊昼/♍夜、日♌独、月♋独。喜乐：土♒、木♐、火♉、日♍、金♋、月♊（水喜乐原文不清）。
rules.notes: 喜乐原文排版：土宝瓶/木射手/火金牛/日处女/金巨蟹/水双子/月双子——水月同座存疑，标注

rules.original_text: ♄'s houses are in ☍ to the Houses of the Luminaries... ♃'s two houses are in △ to the houses of the Luminaries... ♂'s two houses are in □ to the houses of the ☉ and ☽... ♀'s Houses are in ∗ to the houses of the ☉ and ☽... ☿'s two houses do immediately precede and follow the House Luminaries.
rules.translation: 宫位分配逻辑（相对日月宫）：土=冲（大凶）、木=三合（大吉）、火=刑（小凶）、金=六合（小吉、爱）、水=邻（中性可随）。

rules.original_text: A Table of the Orbs of the Planets: ♄ 10°0' (some say 9), ♃ 12°0' (others 9), ♂ 7°30' (most hold 7), ☉ 17°0' (some 15), ♀ 8°0' (others 7), ☿ 7°30' (all agree 7), ☽ 12°30' (others 12).
rules.translation: 行星轨道（相位容许度，Orbs）：土10°/木12°/火7°30'/日17°/金8°/水7°30'/月12°30'（括注异说）；platic 相位=两星在各自轨道一半之和内（例：日♈10°20'+木♊15°15'=差 14°50'，半日轨8°30'+半木轨6°=14°30'，在容许内）。

rules.original_text: A Table of the Planets Latitudes: Saturn greatest 2°48' N / 2°49' S; Jupiter 1°38' / 1°40'; Mars 4°31' / 6°47'; Venus 9°2' both; Mercury 3°33' / 3°35'; Luna 5°0'17 / 5°0'12. The ☉ moves always in the Ecliptick, and hath no Latitude.

Saturne is said to be by Nature Cold and dry, Melancholly, Masculine, Diurnal, the greater Infortune and slow in motion, neer 30 years finishing his Course. He Signifies... Old Men, Grand-fathers, Beggars, Husbandmen, Monks, Jesuites, Curriers, Diggers of the Earth, Brick-layers, Tinners, Plummers, Colliers, Dyers of Black, Black-smiths... Aged people, Lands, Houses and all Country Affairs. If well dignified, gives Men of Grave and Sober Spirits, Sound Judgments... heaps together the Goods of this life.
rules.translation: 土星本性：冷干、忧郁、男、昼、大凶、慢行、约 30 年一周。征象：老人/祖父/乞丐/农夫/僧侣/皮匠/挖土工/砖瓦匠/锡匠/铅匠/煤商/黑布染匠/铁匠；地产房屋乡务。吉时=庄重明智好学聚财；凶时=固执贪婪恶毒自利。

rules.original_text: He is a Planet Masculine and Diurnal, and by Nature temperately Hot and Moist, the greater Fortune, Author of Moderation, Temperance, Justice and Sobriety he finisheth his Course in about 12 years. Jupiter Denotes... Lawyers, young Scholars, all sorts of Clergy-men, Cloathiers, Woollen-drapers... if well disposed he incites men to honest Principles... but being ill plac'd, gives profligate, stout persons, unfaithful, weak in Judgment. ♃ Generally denotes Youth.
rules.translation: 木星本性：男、昼、温湿热、大吉、节制/公正/清醒之祖、约 12 年一周。征象：律师/年轻学者/教士/呢绒商/羊毛商；青年。吉=诚信虔诚宽宏勤勉；凶=放荡不忠判断弱。

rules.original_text: Mars is a Masculine Nocturnal Planet, by Nature Hot and Dry, the lesser Infortune, the Author of Strife, Debate, Quarrels and Contentions; he is about 12 years finishing his Course in the Zodiack. The Qualities and Professions are for the most part Souldiers, or such as use Weapons or Edge-tools, also Apothecaries, Watch-makers, Barbers, Dyers, Tanners, Chyrurgions, Butchers, Gunners, Smiths, Marshals, Bayliffs.
rules.translation: 火星本性：男、夜、热干、小凶、争斗/争辩/冲突之祖；原文'约12年一周'（笔误——火星实约2年，土星才是30、木星12，此处忠实原文并在引擎中按 2 年处理）。征象：士兵/兵器匠/药剂师/钟表匠/理发师/染匠/鞣皮匠/外科医/屠夫/炮手/铁匠/执达员。吉=勇慷慨鲁莽轻财；凶=暴虐偷盗谋杀煽乱。
rules.notes: 原文行 2113 写'about 12 years'，实为笔误（火星会合周期约2年2月）；引擎用 2 年

rules.original_text: The most glorious body of all the Planets, he is Masculine Diurnal, and by Nature Hot and Dry... He finisheth his Course in one year; for by the Suns motion, is all time measured out into Days, Months, and Years. The Sun predominates over Chief Rulers, Governours, Commanders, whether Emperours, Kings or Princes... Gold-smiths, Coopersmiths, Engravers, Minters, and Coyners of Money; all Pewterers and Braziers. ☉ is a general Significator of men in Love Questions.
rules.translation: 太阳本性：男、昼、热干、一年一周（一切时间之源）。征象：君王/统治者/指挥官/君主王侯；金匠/铜匠/雕刻师/铸币匠/锡匠铜匠。卜卦中=男性征象星；主荣誉/尊贵/贵族。

rules.original_text: Venus is a Feminine Nocturnal Planet, and by Nature Cold and Moist, the lesser Fortune, and finishes her Course in about a years time; she is the Author of Pleasure, Mirth, and Jollitry. Qualities and Professions: all men and women that deal in divers sorts of Apparel or Linnen... Lapidaries, Silkmen, Mercers, Linnen-drapers, Upholsters, Picture-drawers, or such as sell Perfumes. Venus well plac'd makes men pleasant, fair-spoken... But if ill-affected, inclines men to be Effeminate, Timerous, Lustful... ♀ generally denotes Women in Questions.
rules.translation: 金星本性：女、夜、冷湿、小吉、欢乐/欢笑/游乐之祖、约 1 年一周。征象：衣料亚麻商/宝石匠/丝绸商/布商/家具商/画师/香水商。吉=愉快善辞社交慈悲；凶=阴柔胆怯好色懒怠。卜卦中=女性征象星。

rules.original_text: Mercury is said to be a Planet convertible in Nature, and participates of the Planet he is joyned with, and therefore cannot be said to be either Masculine or Feminine; he is by Nature Cold and Dry, and finishes his Course in about one Year, and is the Author of all subtil tricks, Thefts, and Perjuries. Qualities and Professions: all men of Learning as Clarks, Merchants, Scholars, Secretaries... Embassadors, Commissioners, and Poets, Orators, Printers, Stationers, Usurers, Cheaters (if ill dignified) and all such as live by their Wits. In Questions ☿ generally signifies Youth.
rules.translation: 水星本性：可变中性（随所合之星）、冷干、一年一周、巧计/偷窃/伪证之祖。征象：文士/商人/学者/秘书/大使/委员/诗人/演说家/印刷商/书商/放债人/骗子（凶时）/靠智谋生者。吉=锐智好学；凶=狡猾奸诈虚谎。卜卦中=青年。

rules.original_text: This Planet is a Feminine Nocturnal Planet, and by Nature Cold and Moist, finisheth her Course in about 28 days, she is a general Significatrix in all Questions. She signifieth the highest sort of Women, whether Queen, Governess, or Mistress of the House; also Men whose Imployments lie upon the Waters; all Dealers in Fish, Vitners, Tapsters, Midwives, Nurses, and all sorts of common people; to which may be added Travellers, Fugitives, and Stray's amongst Cattle... ☽ is said to be a General Significator of all Sick people.
rules.translation: 月亮本性：女、夜、冷湿、28 天一周、一切问卦之总征象星。征象：高位女性（王后/女主人）、水上职业者、鱼商/酒商/酒吧老板/助产士/护士/平民；旅行者/逃亡者/走失牲畜；病人之总征象星。

rules.original_text: Brief Observations in drawing a Description from the Planet that is Lord of the Ascendant: 1. If no Planet Aspect the Ascendant, nor be locally there, then judge by it [the Ascendant sign]. 2. If the Lord of the Ascendant or any other Planet behold the Ascendant, Judge by the Signe Ascending. 3. If two Planets Aspect the Ascendant, him that beholds it most partile, or he that is in his own House, before a planet in his exaltation.
rules.translation: 升主描述法三则：①无星照升/居升→按升座判；②升主或他星照升→按升座判（主星定心性——Hermes 79：升=身、其主=心）；③两星照升→取入相最精确者，或本宫者优先于擢升者。

rules.original_text: Of the particular Descriptions... Saturne in Aries gives a Ruddy Complexion, but somewhat obscure, a spare, raw-bon'd person, full fac'd, big voice, a dark hair, nor much beard; sad, dull, but boasting and commending himself for his Valour...
rules.translation: 行星落座描述字典（7 星×12 座=84 行，见映射A）：每行星落每座给出体型+气质要点；兼有行星落座共性（木落风座=健壮匀称、土水座=多病等）。
rules.notes: 映射A；第4层描述数据库

rules.original_text: Saturn in general is Significator of Tooth-ach, Leprosie, Rhumes, Consumptions, Black Jaundices, Palsie, Trembling, Vain fears, Gouts of all sorts, Hemorrhoides, Fractures, Dislocations, Ruptures, Deafness, pains in the Bones, Chin-cough, pains in the Bladder, Madness, and all long and tedious Diseases, that proceed from Melancholy, Fear, or Grief...
rules.translation: 行星总疾病表：土=牙痛/麻风/风湿/痨/黑黄疸/瘫痪/颤/虚惊/诸痛风/痔/骨折脱臼疝/聋/骨痛/百日咳/膀胱痛/疯/一切忧郁恐惧悲伤之久病；木=肝脉/肺炎/胸肋脓/喉炎/血中风败/暴食/坏血/肝胃阻；火=血败胆热诸病（瘟疫烧热疟痈疫疮烧伤癣狂黄胆血痢瘘带状疱疹圣安东尼火生殖器病肾石膀胱石天花麻疹铁伤怒伤糖尿病）；日=心/红胆/面疱/疹/眼弱/晕/烧热；金=子宫/生殖器（淋花柳女月母疯）情欲之病；水=卡他/口吃/嘶哑/咳/鼻塞/脑病（晕中风疯）/肺（哮喘痨）/脑舌记忆；月=绞痛/腹痛/水肿/痢/女经/冷风湿/眼泪/虫/烂咳/惊厥/癫痫/瘰疬/脓/天花麻疹/嗜睡/痰。

rules.original_text: For your better instruction in finding out the nature of a Disease from the Figure of the Persons decumbiture observe these three particulars: First consider the sixth, seventh, and twelfth Houses (which principally signifie Diseases) as also the Lords thereof. Secondly consider the nature of the Signs upon the Cusps thereof; for Fiery Signs signifie Diseases proceeding from Choler, Earthy from Melancholy, Airy from Wind and corruption of Blood, Watry from Salt and watry Phlegm. Thirdly observe the nature of the Planets themselves, as also those Planets with whom they are in Aspect.
rules.translation: 病盘三观察：①6/7/12 宫及其主星（主疾病）；②宫头星座元素定体液（火=胆、土=郁、风=血气、水=痰湿）；③行星本性及其相位星。混合判断致病体液。

rules.original_text: If Mars his Significator was in Leo; I enter this Table with Mars at top, and I search the Sign Leo... against which I find Leo and Capricorn; this tells me that Patient is much afflicted at his Heart, with pains in the Back, also weakness in the Knees... The Foundation of this Table is grounded upon this Rule, that every Planet governs the Head posited in his own house, in the second Sign to his own House, the Neck and Throat; in the third Sign from thence, the Arms and Shoulders.
rules.translation: 身体部位表（行星落座=部位，见映射B 附列）：每行星落自身宫=头、第二宫=颈喉、第三宫=臂肩…；疾病判例：火落狮子→查表得狮+摩羯→心痛背痛膝弱。
rules.notes: 原表 7 行×12 列 84 格，映射表已数字化

rules.original_text: A Table of the Members of the Body, every Planet Governs, being posited in any of the Signs... [84-cell table]
rules.translation: 行星落座疾病字典（7 星×12 座=84 行，见映射B）：每行星落每座的具体病症（土落白羊=头风郁气齿聋耳鸣…）。
rules.notes: 映射B；第4层疾病判断数据库

rules.original_text: Saturn's Government is assigned, Furnitory, Shepheards-purse, Night-shade, Poppy, Mandrake, Henbane, Hellebore... To Jupiter: Bettony, Centory, Marjoram, Violets, Borage... To Mars: all manner of Thistles, Onions, Leeks, and Garlick... To Sol: Saffron, the Mary gold, Rosemary, Celandine... To Venus: Cowslips, Dazies, Feather-few... To Mercury: Hore-hound, Pellitory of the Wall, Dill, Fennel... To the Moon: Cole-wort, and Cabages, Flower-de-luce, Water-Lillies... As to the time of gathering these Herbs, it should be when the Planet that governs the Herb is essentially dignified, if possible; however let the Planet be Angular, either in the Ascendant, or tenth House, and in some good Aspect of the Moon.
rules.translation: 草药归属表（7 星各一组，见映射C）+ 采集时机：当值行星本然尊贵为佳；至少行星落角宫（升/10 宫）且与月成吉相位；取其盛时鲜绿。
rules.notes: 映射C

rules.original_text: A Planet is said to be essentially dignified when he is posited in his own House, Exaltation, or Triplicity... Farther, there is a greater probability that what they signifie may be effected and come to pass when they being Significators are essentially strong, then when they are weak and much debilitated.
rules.translation: 本然尊贵总则：庙（House）/擢升（Exaltation）/三分（Triplicity）为本质尊贵；征象星本然强则所主之事更易成就。

rules.original_text: A TABLE OF ESSENTIAL DIGNITIES OF THE PLANETS ACCORDING TO PTOLEMY... ♄ hath ♑ and ♒, ♃ ♐ and ♓, ♂ ♈ & ♏, ☉ ♌, ☽ ♋... one of these Houses is called Diurnal, noted by D; the other Nocturnal, noted by N... In the 13 Column, over against ♈ you find ♀ detriment... In the 14 Column, over against ♈ you find ♄, over his Head, Fall.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 本然尊贵表（映射D）：12 座×庙（昼/夜）/擢升/三分/失势/陷落（界/面列原文划去，用 Valens 卷五十界表与 SATA 面表补）。
rules.notes: 映射D；第3层尊贵权重核心

rules.original_text: The exaltations: ☉ in 19 ♈, ☽ in 3 ♉, ☊ in ♊ 3°, ♄ in 21 ♎, ♃ in 15 ♋, ♂ in 28 ♑, ♀ in 27 ♓, ☿ in 15 ♍, ☋ in ♐ 3°. The ☉... has the Sign Aries for his exaltation, as being the principal point of the whole Zodiack, and the Superiour Planets have Assigned unto them the other Cardinal points, as ♎ to ♄, ♋ to ♃, ♑ to ♂.
rules.translation: 擢升度数表：日 19°白羊、月 3°金牛、龙头 3°双子、土 21°天秤、木 15°巨蟹、火 28°摩羯、金 27°双鱼、水 15°处女、龙尾 3°射手。逻辑：日=白羊（黄道首点）、三上星分其余三角点（土=秋分♎、木=夏至♋、火=冬至♑）、下星取角点邻座（水=处女、金=双鱼、月=金牛）。

rules.original_text: These twelve Signs are divided into four Triplicities. The fourth Column tells you which Planet or planets, both Night and Day govern each Triplicity; as over against ♈, ♌, ♐, you find ☉ & ♃, viz. ☉ governeth by Day, and ♃ by Night. Over against ♉, ♍, & ♑, you find ♀ and ☽... Over against ♊, ♎, ♒, you find ♄ & ☿... Over against ♋, ♏, ♓, you find ♂, who according to Ptolemy, and Naibod, ruleth only that Triplicity, both Day and Night.
rules.translation: 三分主表（昼夜分）：火象♈♌♐=昼日/夜木；土象♉♍♑=昼金/夜月；风象♊♎♒=昼土/夜水；水象♋♏♓=火独掌（Ptolemy+Naibod 昼夜同）。

rules.original_text: Essential Dignities: In House or reception by House 5; In exaltation or in reception thereby 4; In Triplicity or reception thereby 3. Essential Debilities: In Detriment 5; In Fall 4; Peregrine 5.
rules.translation: 本然尊贵分值：庙/入庙接纳=5、擢升/入擢升接纳=4、三分/接纳=3；失势=5、陷落=4、游走=5。
rules.notes: 第3层尊贵打分

rules.original_text: Accidental Fortitudes: In the MC or Ascendant 5; In the 7th, 4, and 11 Houses 4; In the 2d and 4th Houses 3; In the 9th House 2; In the 3d House 1; Direct 4; Swift in motion 2; ♄♃♂ Oriental 2; ♀☿ or ☽ Occidental 2; Free from combustion 5; In Cazimi or in the heart of the ☉ 5; Besieged by ♃ or ♀ 5; Partile ☌ with ☊ 4.
rules.translation: 偶然尊贵分值：MC/升=5、7/4/11 宫=4、2/4 宫=3、9 宫=2、3 宫=1；顺行=4、疾行=2、土木火东出=2、金水月西入=2、离焦=5、Cazimi 日心=5、木金围=5、合龙头=4。

rules.original_text: Accidental Debilities: In the 12th House 5; In the 8th and 6th 4; Retrograde 1?; Slow in motion 2; ♄♃♂ Occidental 2; ♀ and ☿ Oriental 2; ☽ decreasing in light 2; Combustion of the ☉ 5; Under the ☉ beams 4; Besieged of ♄ and ♂ 6; Partile ☌ with ☋ 4; Partile ☌ with ♄ or ♂ 5; Partile ☍ of ♄ or ♂ 4.
rules.translation: 偶然弱分值：12 宫=5、8/6 宫=4、逆行=1、慢行=2、土木火西入=2、金水东出=2、月减光=2、焦伤=5、日光束下=4、土火围=6、合龙尾=4、合土火=5、冲土火=4。

rules.original_text: A TABLE OF THE FORTITUDES AND DEBILITIES OF THE PART OF FORTUNE: the Ascen. or MC 5; the 7, 4 or 11 House 4; the 2 or 5 House 3; the ninth House 2; the third House 1. In Debilities: the 12 House 5; the 8 House 4; the 6 House 4; ☌ with ♄ or ♂ 5; ☌ with ☋ 3; ☍ of ♄ or ♂ 4; □ of ♄ or ♂ 3; ☌ with Caput Algol in 21d of ♉ 4; ☌ with ☊ 3; Combust 5; ☌ with Regulus 25d ♌ 5; ☌ with Spica ♍ 19d ♎ 5; not Combust 5.

Friends and Enemies: Saturn's friends ♀? ☿♃, enemies ♂♀☽; Jupiter's friends ☉♀☽, enemies ♂♄; Mars' friends ☉♀, enemies ♄♃☿☽; Sol's friends ♃♂♀♄☽, enemy ☿; Venus' friends ♃☉☽♂, enemy ♄☿; Mercury's friends ♄♃☉☽♀, enemy ♂; Luna's friends ♃☉♀, enemies ♄♂☿. Colours: ♄ Black; ♃ Purple; ♂ Red Yellow Fiery; ☉ Purple or Yellow; ♀ Skie colour or Blew; ☿ Various; ☽ Mixt spotted with White. Friends by agreement of Nature are ♂ and ☉, ♃ and ♀, ♀ and ☽. Enemies by ☍ of Houses are ♄ and the ☉, ♄ and the ☽, ♃ and ☿, and ♀. Enemies by exaltation are ♄ and ☉, ♃ and ♂, ☿ and ♀.
rules.translation: 行星友敌与颜色表（映射）：性近友=火日/木金/金月；宫冲敌=土日/土月/木水/金月；擢升敌=土日/木火/水金；颜色：土黑/木紫/火红黄/日紫黄/金天色蓝/水随座/月杂白斑。

rules.original_text: Application of Planets are considered three ways... Retrograde... Separation... Reception... Translation... Prohibition... Frustration... Refranation... Combustion... Peregrination... Void of Course... Cazimi... Sun Beams... Besieged... Oriental... Occidental... Increasing in light... Swift of Course... Longitude... Latitude... Declination... Right Ascention... Oblique Ascension... Oblique Descension... Ascentional Difference... Pole of Position... Circles of Position.
rules.translation: 术语 27 项（映射E）：应用（快星向慢星三式）/逆行/分离/接纳/传递/禁止/挫败/返行/焦伤/游走/空亡/Cazimi/光束/围困/东出西入/增光/快慢/黄经纬赤纬赤经斜升斜降升降差位置极位置圈。
rules.notes: 映射E；第4层判读术语库

rules.original_text: First, add the units of the seconds together... 30d. make a sign... because 17 signs is more than the Circle, I cast away 12 and there rests 5 signs...

Subtract the Sign, degree, and minute of the Suns place from the sign, degree, and minute, of the Moons place, by adding 12 signs... To the Remainder add the sign, degree, and minute of the Ascendant... that sum shall be the place of Sors or the part of fortune. Whence note, that so far as the ☉ is distant from the Moon, so far distant is the true place of the ⊕ from the point Ascending. If the ⊕ be taken upon a new Moon, it falls in the Ascendant, if upon the first quarter in the fourth house, if at the Full Moon in the 7th, and upon the last quarter in the tenth house.
rules.translation: 福点公式：⊕=月-日+升（宫数 12 进制）；验证：升-⊕=日月距；月相定位：新月⊕在升、上弦在 4 宫、满月在 7、下弦在 10（新月→上弦⊕行于升与 4 宫之间…）。福点吉位吉照=财丰安稳。
rules.notes: 昼生公式（Coley 未分昼夜，与 Valens 昼式同）

rules.original_text: An Ephemeris is a Dyary or Day book, containing the daily motion of the Luminaries, and the rest of the Planets, with the Retrocession of the Dragons head... The left hand page contains 10 Columns: days, week-days, ♄♃♂☉♀☿☽, ☊. The Latitudes of the Planets noted by M.S.D.A: M.A. South Latitude Ascending, S.A. North Latitude Ascending. The letter R. signifies Retrograde, D. Direct. In the right hand page 8 Columns: the Moons Aspects to the Planets; the last Column the Planets mutual Aspects. Begin the day at noon.
rules.translation: 星历结构：左页 10 列=日/周/七曜/龙头（龙尾=龙头对宫）；纬度标 M.S.D.A（M=南纬、S=北纬、A=增、D=减）；R=逆行、D=顺行；右页 8 列=月对各星相位+星互位；日从正午起算。

rules.original_text: Seek the place of the ☉ for the time proposed; if the odd minutes be above 30, add 1 degree; if less then 30 minutes neglect them, and enter the Tables of Houses with the whole degrees of the ☉ place in the Column of the tenth house, and right against it find certain hours and minutes to be added to the hours after noon of your given time... seek the remainder in the Column Time from Noon, and just against that number you shall find the signs and degrees to be placed upon the Cusps of the 10th, 11th, 12, 1st, 2d and 3d houses; upon the Cusps of the other six houses are to be placed their opposite signs and degrees.
rules.translation: 设图法（Tables of Houses）：日度取整（>30'进 1）→查 10 宫列得 Time-from-Noon 修正值→+给定时刻（超 24 减 24）→查表得东六宫宫头（10/11/12/1/2/3）→对宫填西六宫。宫位对：10-4、11-5、12-6、1-7、2-8、3-9。

rules.original_text: If the time given be not just at Noon their places will require a Reduction... gain the Planets Diurnal motion, by subtracting their places, the Noon before from the Noon after, and then say by the Golden Rule, If 24 hours gives so many degrees and minutes, what shall the hours of your time from Noon give... But there needs none of this exactness in a Horary question, for a mentall reduction will be sufficient: allowing about a degree in the Moons place for every 2 hours afternoon, and 5 minutes for every 2 hours in the Suns place.
rules.translation: 行星归时：日运动×（给定时刻/24）比例法（精确）；卜卦粗略法=月每 2 时约 1°、日每 2 时约 5'；星历底部附行星小时运动表（如 36'/24 时→1'30''/时、月 14°/日→35'/时）。

rules.original_text: If your Planet be more degrees in any Sign then is upon the Cusp of the House, you are to set him farther into the house over the Cusp, but if less, place him without the house; as ♄ being 26 deg. 9m. in Cap., and but 3 degrees 25 minutes upon the Cusp of the 12th, I place him over the Cusp in the house.
rules.translation: 行星入宫规则：行星度数>宫头度数=置宫内（越过宫头）、<宫头=置宫外（上一宫）。例：土摩羯 26°09'、12 宫头摩羯 3°25'→土入 12 宫；日天蝎 5°、9 宫头天蝎 5°→日置 8 宫。

rules.original_text: Turn to the Tables intituled, A Table of the Right Ascention of the sun in time; seek October at top, and the day (18)... I find 14 hours 12 minutes (which is the right Ascention of the Sun that day in time) unto which I add my two hours afternoon, and it amounts to sixteen hours twelve minutes, which I seek at top amongst the Schemes... in which Scheme I find ♐ 4 deg. upon the Cusp of the 10 house, and 3 deg ♒ upon the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 太阳赤经表用法（书内预排 scheme 法）：查日赤经（时）+给定时刻=总时→查预排图（每 7-8 分一图）得宫头；超 24 减 24。

rules.original_text: The first house is called the Ascendant... it signifies the Life, Complection, Disposition, Will, Manners and Understanding... the head and face... The second House signifies Riches, gain and traffick, gold, silver, and all moveable goods without life... The third: brethren, sisters, kindred, small voyages, short journeys, dreams, Rumors, advice, Letters, Messengers... The fourth: fathers, houses, lands, immoveable goods, orchards, tillage, minerals, hidden treasures, prisons, the grave... The fifth: Children, joy, pleasure, gifts, delights, bravery, the riches of the father... gaming, drinking, revelling... The sixth: Servants, Sickness, all Cattle unfit for Labour, Hunters, Goalers, Prisons, false Accusations, Uncles and Aunts... The seventh: marriage, wives, law-suits, contention, common persons, the Defendant, the Enemy, Thieves and Thefts, the Doctor, the Artist... The eighth: death, sadness, legacies, dowries, the estate of those we deal with, the Defendants Estate... The ninth: religion, pilgrimage, dreams, long journeys, ceremonies, sacrifices, faith, Clergy-men, Navigations, Arts and Sciences, the Law, the kindred of the wife... The tenth: honour, dignities, preferment, offices, trade or calling, Magistrates, Kings, Princes, the mother, the father of the wife... The eleventh: friends, hope, desire, companions, the counsel of friends, the profit of the tenth, praise and dispraise... The twelfth: secret or private enemies, prisons, captivity, bondage, evil spirits, torments, treasons, slavery, villany, great Cattle, sorrow and tribulation.
rules.translation: 十二宫完整含义（映射F 12 行）：1=命/体质/心性/头面（角、阳、白）；2=财/动产/买卖（续、阴、绿）；3=兄弟/短途/梦/谣传/书信（降、阳、黄）；4=父/房屋土地/宝藏/墓（北角、阴、红）；5=子女/乐/礼/游戏/父财（续、阳、黑白蜜色）；6=仆/病/小畜/猎人狱卒/叔伯（降、阴、黑）；7=婚/诉讼/敌/盗贼/被告/医者/艺术家（西角、阳、暗黑）；8=死/遗产/嫁妆/对手之财（续、阴、绿黑）；9=宗教/长途/梦/神职/航海/法律/妻族（降、阳、绿白）；10=荣誉/职位/王侯/职业/母/妻父（南角、阴、红白）；11=友/望/求/顾问/十宫之利/誉毁（续、阳、黄）；12=私敌/监狱/奴役/恶灵/叛变/大畜/忧患（降、阴、绿）。拉丁口诀：Vita Lucrum Fratres Genitor Nati Valitudo Uxor Mors Pietas Regnum Benefacta Carcer。
rules.notes: 映射F；第3/4层宫位语义核心

rules.original_text: Morinus doth in his Cabal of the 12 houses very Learnedly shew the reason of the division of the 12 houses... The heavens are divided into four equal divisions by the Horizon and Meridian... every one of those parts are divided into three other parts... which beholds by a Partile Trine... as in the Circle there are no more Aspects considerable, so in the Number 12 no more parts.
rules.translation: 十二宫之由来（Morinus 论证）：四角由地平+子午自然划分；每角再三分（赤道上成精确三合）→4×3=12；数字 12 恰容纳全部相位（1=合、2=六合、3=刑、4=三合、6=冲）。

rules.original_text: The life of man consists of 4 parts or ages: Childhood, Youth, Manhood, and old Age; and in man are 4 different things observable: Life, Action, Marriage and Passion... life to the East Angle, Action to the Mid-heaven, Marriage to the West Angle, and Passion to the Angle of the Earth. Whence arise 4 Triplicities of the same Generical Nature, and 12 houses.
rules.translation: 宫位含义由来（Morinus 卡巴拉论证）：四角=人生四阶段与四事（升=生命/童年、MC=行动/青年、降=婚姻/壮年、IC=激情/老年）→四三角 12 宫；三角内按赤道运动序分角/续/降。

rules.original_text: The Person that propounds the Question is always signified by the first House, and his Lord in particular... The Quesited, or matter sought after is known by that House which signifies the thing in Question, and the Lord thereof. If concerning Riches judge from the second; Journeys or Brethren from the third; Father or Treasure from the fourth; Children or a Woman with Child from the fifth; Sickness or Servants from the sixth; Law, Marriage or Theft from the seventh; Wives Dowry or manner of Death from the eighth; long Journeys, Religion, Dreams from the ninth; Honour, Preferment, Mother from the tenth; Friends, hopes from the eleventh; Captivity, private Enemies, great Cattle from the twelfth.
rules.translation: 问卦人与所问指认：问卦人=1 宫及其主；所问事项=对应宫及其主（财=2、兄弟短途=3、父宝藏=4、子女孕=5、病仆=6、婚讼盗=7、嫁妆死法=8、长途宗教=9、荣誉母=10、友望=11、囚私敌大畜=12）。判法：所问宫主之落宫/尊弱/与升主相位。

rules.original_text: Things are brought to pass five wayes: 1. When the Planet that denotes the Querent, and that Planet that signifies the thing inquired after, are applying by a ∗ or △ Aspect, or going to a conjunction in a good House. 2. When the Significator of the matter shall apply to the Lord of the Ascendant, and be in his essential Dignities. 3. If the Significators be in reception, or apply friendly from Houses they delight in, or from Signs they joy in. 4. If Significators do not behold each other, yet if a fortunate Planet collect or translate their beams. 5. When the promising Planets dwell in Houses proper and convenient, though there be no Aspect.
rules.translation: 成事五途：①问卦人主与所问主入六合/三合/吉宫合相；②所问主入相升主且在本然尊贵（意外成事）；③两主互纳或自喜宫喜座入相；④无相位但吉星收集/传递光线；⑤所问主居适宫（无相位亦成——如征象星在升或吉宫）。

rules.original_text: If the very beginning or the latter end of a Signe ascend, 'tis not safe to give Judgment, for the Querent hath been tampering with others... See that the seventh house and his Lord be not impedited, or the Moon in the very beginning or end of the Signe or in the combust way, if so, the Ancients forbid to give Judgment. But when the Sign Ascending, his Lord, or a Planet in the Ascendant signifie the Querent truly, you may safely venture. A Question well and seriously propounded cannot fail of a satisfactory Resolution.
rules.translation: radical 盘判据：①升座首/末度=不可判（问卦人已咨询他人）；②7 宫及其主受阻、月落座首末或焦伤途=古人禁判；③升座/其主/升内星真实表问卦人=可判；④问卦人诚实严肃=必有满意解答（愚者问卦致术士误判）。

rules.original_text: Consider the Ascendant, and what Sign the Lord thereof is posited in... See the Sign upon the Cusp of the 6th... Take notice also what Sign the Moon is in... If the Signs be Masculine, the Mark is on the right side; if Feminine, on the left. If the beginning of a Sign Ascend, the mark is on upper part of the Member... if ♄ signifie the Mark, it is a black duskish one; ♂ a red one; in a fiery Sign, a Cut, Scar, or Spots of Gunpowder; ♃ a Blewish or Purple Mole; ☉ a Chesnut or Olive; ♀ Honey; ☿ whitish or pale Leaden; ☽ a white Mark.
rules.translation: 痣疤判据：看升座+升主座（身部）、6 宫头+6 主、月座；阳座=右、阴座=左；座首升=上部、中末=中下部；行星定色：土=黑晦、火=红（火座=刀疤/火药斑）、木=青紫、日=栗/橄榄、金=蜜色、水=白铅、月=白。
rules.notes: Hermes 87 条：出生时受克之座对应身部有缺陷

rules.original_text: The 12th House signifies his private Enemies, the Ascendant their Substance, and the 2d their short Journeys... The 7th House always signifies publick Enemies, for a Wife, or Husband: Then the 8th is their 2d and denotes their Riches, the 9th their Brethren... The 4th House signifies the Querents Father, then the 5th denotes his Substance, and the 6th his Brothers and Sisters (the Querents Unkles and Aunts), the 7th the Grandfathers. Ptolomy, Aphor. 89: Require what concerns the Grandfather from the 7th House, but the Unkle from the 6th.
rules.translation: 宫位转置法：以所问对象为 1 宫、顺推其 2/3…宫（敌=12 宫→其财=升、其短途=2 宫…；公共敌/配偶=7 宫→其财=8、其兄弟=9；父=4 宫→父财=5、父兄弟=6（问者叔伯）、祖父=7；Ptolemy 89 条：祖父问 7 宫、叔伯问 6 宫）。

rules.original_text: My Honoured Friend Mr. William Lilly tells us, that there hath been a large Disputation amongst the Arabians, concerning the Time an Artist should take for the Basis of the Question... the latter seems the most Rational, and therefore wholly to be imbraced: that very instant of time that an Artist understands the desire of any Querent, he ought to take for the true and radical time. If a Letter be sent, let him not accept of the time it comes to his hands, but of that moment he breaks it open... if the Artist be much perplexed, let him take the moment of time he is most desirous of a Resolution, and judge his own Question... if the Querent have but his own Radical Figure of Birth, he may draw the judgment much more safely; a Question is a second Birth, the Birth or motion of the mind.
rules.translation: 问卦时间（Lilly 论）：取术士明悉问卦人意图之刻为 radical 时刻（非入门时刻）；书信=拆读之刻；自问=最渴求解之刻；有本命盘优先于卜卦（尤其普遍性问题）；卜卦=心智的二次出生。

rules.original_text: Choice Aphorisms: 1. In a Question truly Radical, there is an Agreement between the face of Heaven and the Question... 2. No person moves a Question with earnest desire, but the Ascendant will be either the same, or of the same Triplicity with the Signe ascending at Birth. 3. Judge not upon light Motions... 4. Figures prove true or false according to the intent of the Querent. 5. Astrologers ought to be Impartial... 6. Seldome comes a good end when the Moon is Impedited... 7. If you find the Lord of the Ascendant opposite or Quartile to the Ascendent, or the Moon detrimented, it argues the Querent is careless. 8. Take notice from what Planet the Moon last separated, and that shews what hath already past. 9. The Application of the Moon to a Fortune gives great hopes; if to an Infortune, ill Application. 10. Be not forward to give Judgment when the seventh House and his Lord are afflicted, for those signifie the Artist himself. 11. The Moon cannot be more afflicted than to be ☌ of the ☉; the business lies very obscure when the Significator is under the Earth, or under the Beams of the ☉. 12. If the Nativity or Revolution may be had it will help much. 13. Observe what Planet is Lord of the Ascendant... you may Judge of the thoughts of the Querent. 14. The Position of the Infortunates or ☊ in the tenth foreshews no credit to the Artist. 15. An Infortune unfortunate, beholding the Significator, brings powerful Mischief. 16. Great hopes where the Fortunes are Significators; but ♄ and ♂ being Significators, great danger; ♂ spoils by haste, ♄ by delay. 17. ♄ and ♂ Significators in Angles essentially dignified perform what is promised; nor ought an Artist to confide in the Fortunes unless they are in their Essential Dignities. 18. The Part of Fortune well seated promises Gain; if debilitated expect the contrary. 19. Beware of such Men and Things signified by that House where you find the ☋. 20. Be not too forward to give a positive Judgment, although your Significators be in Conjunction, before you have considered the Signe they are in. 21. The Nature of the fixed Stars joyned to your Significators ought warily to be considered: same Nature help, contrary Nature retard.
rules.translation: 卜卦精选格言 21 条（映射G）：radical 图与问题相合（升座同本命或同三元）；月最后与谁分离=过去之事；月向吉星应用=大希望、向凶星=坏结局；7 宫受克=术士自己受损忌判；月最苦=焦伤；征象星在地平下/日光束下=事隐；凶星落 10 宫=术士无信；凶星照征象星=大损害；吉星为征象=希望大、土火=危险（火快坏、土迟坏）；土火角宫本然尊贵=能兑现、吉星非本然尊贵不可信；福点吉位=获利；龙尾所在宫之人事=损失诽谤；合相亦需看星座是否其喜；恒星光线同性质助、反性质阻。
rules.notes: 映射G；第4层卜卦判读要点

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 昼行星时=日长/12；夜行星时=夜长/12；昼时长一分则夜时短一分
rules.original_text: Every Artificial day (from Sun rising to Sun setting) is divided into twelve equal parts, called Planetary or unequal Astrological hours; the night likewise into twelve equal parts.
rules.translation: 行星时辰定义：人造日（日出至日落）均分十二等份为行星时（昼行星时=日长/12）；夜亦均分十二等份（夜行星时=夜长/12）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT I；夏至昼行星时>60分；春秋分=60分；表按英格兰 Lat.52 编制，1668-4-15 示例：日在金牛6°=第4昼时至 9:35，周三日=第4行星时轮值木星

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In the hour of ♄, take no Voyage to Sea, neither any long Journey; take no Physick; entertain no Servant; not good to put on a new Garment or cut Hair; good to buy Grain, dig in the Earth, or Plow; not good to borrow Money, or fall sick in, for it threatens a long Disease, sometimes death.
rules.translation: 土星时辰：忌航海远行、服药、雇仆、新衣、理发；宜买谷、掘土、耕作；忌借债；病于此=久病或死。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV；时辰吉凶总表见映射I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In the hour of ♃, good to apply to Ecclesiastical Persons and great Men, Senators, Judges, Lawyers; good to take a Journey or go out with success; good to sow or Plant; not good to be let blood; he that falls sick recovers soon; good to lend or borrow; not good to enter a Ship or buy Beasts; good to contract Matrimony.
rules.translation: 木星时辰：宜谒宗教长者与贵人、参议员/法官/律师；宜出行、播种栽植；忌放血；病于此速愈；宜借贷；忌登船买畜；宜婚娶。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In the hour of ♂ begin no worthy Action or Enterprize, for it is a very unfortunate hour in all things; ill to take a Journey (danger of Thieves); very ill to take a Voyage to Sea.
rules.translation: 火星时辰：忌一切重大举动（大凶之时）；行路有盗贼之险；航海大凶。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The hour of ☉ is not to be chosen, generally infortunate, unless in application to great Persons; not good to begin a building, put on new Garments, or enter into his own house; good to receive preferment; not good to court the Female Sex, or lay down moneys; very dangerous to fall sick in.
rules.translation: 太阳时辰：一般主凶，唯宜谒贵人/受职禄；忌动工、新衣、入己宅（恐不睦口角）；宜受擢升；忌求爱、放款；病于此险。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In the hour of ♀ good to court Women, or begin a Journey (not a voyage), good to enter upon Play, Sport or Pastime; not good to be let blood; good to take Physick; he that falls sick in that hour, the disease proceeds from some venereal distemper; good for Marriage; not good to begin a new Garment.
rules.translation: 金星时辰：宜求爱、行路（非航海）、游乐、服药、婚姻新衣；忌放血；病于此=淫病。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The hour of ☿ is very good to Merchandise, buy or sell, write Letters, send Messengers, take Physick, send Children to School, begin a Journey, lend or borrow, put forth Apprentices, begin any Building; not good to contract Marriage, buy houses or Lands, re-enter your house, take or hire a Servant, or redeem a Prisoner; good to Plant or Grafft, and to make Suit to great Persons.
rules.translation: 水星时辰：宜买卖通书、遣使、服药、送学、行路、借贷、拜师、兴工、嫁接、谒贵；忌婚娶、购房置地、返家（恐口角）、雇仆、赎囚。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The hour of ☽ is not good to buy Cattle (especially of the smaller sort), take Physick, begin any Building, lend Money, or make new Cloaths; good to court the Male Sex, send Children to School, in some cases take a Journey, pursue an Enemy, and leave your Native Countrey (but choose another hour when you return).
rules.translation: 月亮时辰：忌买卖小畜、服药、兴工、放款、制衣；宜追敌、出乡远行（归乡另择时）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT IV；Coley 注：时辰之义甚古、经阿拉伯人认可、Haly 及后世作者证实，然效力不及依本命善择时

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 必须以本命为根基，否则虽天象美亦不益
rules.original_text: An Election is an apt time chosen for the obtaining of some desired good, or the avoiding of some evil threatned at the time of the Nativity. Questions end in the knowledge of the business; Elections are ordained for Action. Ptolomy saith, the Election shall then be advantagious when 'tis constituted from the Nativity; otherwise, though well made, it shall not profit (Centiloque Aph.6).
rules.translation: 择时定义与原则：择时=就所欲之利、避所惧之害而选时。问卦止于知、择时主于行（Ptolemy Centiloquium Aph.6：不由本命起则不验）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT V；非知本命而为之事=邪妄（升主在事主本命为8/12主时纵天象美亦受害）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: From an unfortunate Geniture there can no good Election be constituted; for an accidental good can no way extinguish an Essential Evil in the Radix.
rules.translation: 厄命无吉择：本命升点或其主大受克，纵择时再善亦无益于其人——偶然之善不能消除本然之恶。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT VI 要则1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Consider the position of Heaven at the Sun's Revolution to his Radical point, and see how that concurs with the Radix: sympathy, the year proves fortunate; antipathy, cross and unfortunate.
rules.translation: 参日返与 Radix 之协/抗：日返图与本命相协=是年诸事顺遂；相抗=诸事不顺、或终有损。
rules.notes: 要则2；并参推运/行运照本命大角日月升

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 本命角与月位须安全且配本事宫
rules.original_text: Let not the Ascendant, Mid-heaven, or place of the ☽ in the Radix be evilly beheld at the time of your Election, neither let those places be the Cusps of the 8th or 12th, but rather of such Houses as concern your Business; and let the proper Significators be well beheld by the Fortunes (except the Fortunes were Lords of bad Houses in the Radix).
rules.translation: 勿令本命升/天顶/月位在择时受克或为8/12宫头；务令其为本事相关之宫头；吉星吉照征象星（吉星若为本命凶宫主则不作吉）。
rules.notes: 要则4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Begin no Enterprize when the ☽ separates from the ☍ or ☌ of the ☉, and applies to the body or aspect of an Infortune (especially if that Infortune was Ruler of a bad House in the Nativity); neither let the ☽ be in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 忌月起于日月之冲/合而转入相凶星，尤忌该凶星为本命凶宫主；月忌落升点（日居升亦不佳，除非狮子/人马/白羊）。
rules.notes: 要则5；日月亦忌合逆行星（实则逆行无真实之力，仅视象）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 月须强且免本命凶星之克
rules.original_text: Let not the ☽ be afflicted by any of the Planets that were Infortunate in the Genesis when you begin a work of Consequence; but whatever you do, fortifie the ☽ in any Election, for she is a general Significatrix and brings down the Influence of the other Planets upon us.
rules.translation: 择要事勿令月受本命凶星之克；事无巨细必固月——月为通星之使、诸事之共主。
rules.notes: 要则6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Let the ☽ be posited in that House which signifies the thing you elect for (especially if that house were Fortunate at Birth); let not the Infortunes be placed in Angles or behold the Ascendant, except they were Lords of good Houses in the Radix. ♃ ♀ though general Fortunes may accidentally (as Rulers of bad Houses) prove Infortunes, and ♄ ♂ to many men are Fortunes, being Rulers of good Houses.
rules.translation: 如可能令月落本事之宫（本命吉宫尤佳）；勿令凶星居角或照升点，除非其为本命吉宫主。木金可因主凶宫而偶发为凶，土火可因主吉宫而为吉——择时要义。
rules.notes: 要则7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you would Elect a time for any thing that requires speed, choose a moveable Sign to Ascend; but if for durability, a fixed Sign, provided they belong to no bad Houses in the Radix.
rules.translation: 速事取动座升；久事取定座升（须非本命凶宫）。
rules.notes: 要则8

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The fixed Stars ought to be considered in all Elections: those Principal Stars neer the Ecliptick of benevolent Nature joyned with the Significators do much help.
rules.translation: 恒参近黄道之吉性固定星吉照征象星，其助大。
rules.notes: 要则9

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 本命升再升、月复生时为佳
rules.original_text: In all Elections let the Ascendant of the Nativity (if possible) Ascend, with no bad Planet therein or otherwise Angular; and 'tis good to have the Fortunate Planets in Angles also. As often as the ☽ comes to that Age she was at any persons Birth, that day proves more Fortunate (the Election then made is very effectual).
rules.translation: 凡择时若能令本命升点再升为妙（升无凶星、角有吉星）；月复生时（月返出生相位之日）择时最利。

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: It is good the ☽ should be strong in all Elections, and in good Aspect of those Planets that were Fortunate and Lords of good Houses in the Radix; neither should the Lord of the Geniture be in a Cadent house (if an Infortune, place him in a succedent House); fortifie the Ascendant and Mid-heaven in the Radix; it is not amiss to make the 10th or 11th House in the Radix Ascendant in the Election.
rules.translation: 择时宜月强且吉照本命吉宫主、避本命凶照；主人勿落降宫（凶则置续宫）；固本命升与天顶；可令本命吉宫（10/11）升。
rules.notes: 要则12；择时升主（本命升主）须落择时吉位（角或续宫）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In all things relating to the second House (Money matters) fortifie ♃, free from Combustion, and let the Lord of the 2nd in the Nativity be free from affliction and placed in a good place, in benevolent Aspect of the Fortunes.
rules.translation: 财务择时：固木星免焦伤，本命2宫主免克、置吉位、受吉星吉照。
rules.notes: 要则14；兄弟邻人事固本命3宫与主；求长兄令土吉照升/3主；短途行固升主月主福点与3宫主（要则15）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In all Business relating to the fourth House (Houses, Lands) ♄ should be fortified, also the 4th House and Lord thereof in the Radix, not neglecting the ☽, choosing such a time when Fortunate Planets are in friendly Aspect to these Significators.
rules.translation: 4宫事务（屋地）：固土星与本命4宫主，吉星照之（月亦顾）。
rules.notes: 要则16

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: For Play or Gameing, place the Signe of the Radical fifth House upon the second Cusp in the Election, beheld by ♃ or ♀, the Ascendant free from affliction, and debilitate the 7th House and Lord as much as may be; if the ☽ be in good Aspect to ☿, or in ∗ or △ to the Cusp of the second, so much the better.
rules.translation: 博弈求赢择时：置本命5宫座于择时2宫头、受木金吉照、升免克、尽量弱7宫主；月吉照水星或六合三合2宫头更佳。
rules.notes: 要则17

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: For a Distemper afflicting the whole Body, let the Ascendant be ♎ or some other humane Sign; if only a particular Member, let the Sign representing that Member be upon the Ascendant, both Ascendant and Lord free from affliction. In taking a Servant, let the Lord of the 6th be in good Aspect with the Lord of the Ascendant and the 2nd in the Radix, and the ☽ free from affliction.
rules.translation: 疗病择时：全身病取天秤或其他人类座升；局部病取该部位座升且升主免克、再固该部主星。雇仆：6宫主吉照升主与本命2宫、月免克。
rules.notes: 要则18

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In Elections for Marriage, fortifie the Ascendant, its Lord and the ☽ with their Dispositers; the Ascendant ought to be a fixed Signe, and the ☽ therein in ∗ or △ to the ☉; by any means let not ♏ Ascend. If a Fortune be in the 10th in the hour of Marriage, the Woman shall Conceive the first night. For Marriage for Gain: let the Ascendant be a Moveable or Common Signe, the ☽ in any Common Signe except ♊, the Lord of the ☽'s House in ♌; fortifie the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 10th, 11th Houses with their Lords and the ⊕.
rules.translation: 婚娶择时：固升/升主/月及其主，升宜定座、月在升六合/三合日；忌天蝎升（天蝎=诈伪之座，Hermes 亦戒）。婚时有吉星在10宫=初夜受孕。为利联姻：升与升主月主固、升宜动/双体、月宜双体（双子除外）、月宫主落狮子，固1/2/4/10/11宫与主及福点受木金吉照。
rules.notes: 要则19；忌天蝎升另见 Hermes Aph.9

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In making Wills, let the ☽ be slow in Motion and increasing in Light; 'tis so much the better if the ☽ and Lord of the Ascendant behold ♄ by some benevolent Aspect. In taking a long journey, beware no Infortune be in the 9th of the Radix, and the Lord of the 9th free from affliction. In setting up a Profession, let the Ascendant of the Election be the Cusp of the 10th in the Radix, its Lord strong, the ☽ well seated.
rules.translation: 遗嘱：月迟行增光、月与升主吉照土星尤宜。远行：本命9宫无凶、9主免克（学艺同理）。立业：令择时升=本命10宫头、其主强免克、月得位。

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In entering into Contracts, let the ☽ be in the Ascendant or in a Sign of the same Triplicity, in some Essential Dignity or good Aspect of her Dispositer; the Lord of the 11th in the Radix free from affliction. To Buy a Horse, fortifie the Ascendant, its Lord and the ☽ applying to a good Aspect of a Fortunate Planet; the Lord of the 12th in the Radix in no bad Aspect to ♄ or ♂.
rules.translation: 契约：月落升或同三合座、有尊贵、吉照其主；本命11主免克置吉位。买马畜：固升/升主/月，月入相吉照免克吉星；本命12主不与土火凶照。

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In Elections for Horse-races, aptate the Lord of the 12th, make him more powerful than the Lord of the 6th; place a Signe of the Superiour Planets on the Horoscope (especially ♐); let the ☽ and Lord thereof be strong, swift, in good Aspect from good places; debilitate the Lords of the 6th and 7th as much as may be.
rules.translation: 赛马择时：固12宫主使其强于6宫主；以上位星之座升（尤人马）；月与月主强而速、互吉照于吉位；尽量弱6/7宫主。
rules.notes: 要则25；Coley 总注：此等要则若遵守，除非此人本命之总命运作对，艺者不易出错

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按月之分离入相判买卖之利
rules.original_text: He that would sell to profit, let the ☽ be in ♉ ♋ ♍ or ♓, separating from the ☉ ♃ ♀ or ☿; if she separates from good and applies to bad, good for the seller, ill for the buyer. To buy cheap, the ☽ in the same signs separating from evil and applying to good.
rules.translation: 卖货取月居金牛/巨蟹/室女/双鱼、自日月木金水分离而向凶=利卖者害买者；买便宜取同座自凶分离向吉=利买。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT VII；Coley 自注：试之可、不敢言必然（月座择时8条见映射J）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
signs: 双子/室女/金牛/狮子/巨蟹/水瓶/双鱼/天蝎/人马
rules.original_text: If thou wilt take a Servant, let the ☽ be in ♊ ♍ or ♉; if in ♌ he will prove proud and a great Trencher-man; if in ♋ or ♒ he will run away, but return again; if in ♓, unfaithful and dishonest; fixed Signes (♌ ♏ ♉ or the latter part of ♐) reputed good.
rules.translation: 雇仆：月落双子/室女/金牛=吉；月落狮子=骄横大食；巨蟹/水瓶=逃去复来终去；双鱼=不忠；稳妥取月居定座（狮子/天蝎/金牛/人马末段）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT VII；男仆取月落双子/室女/天秤/人马/水瓶；女仆取金牛/巨蟹/双鱼

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按四至点入宫图+朔望断四季
rules.original_text: Ptolomy (Princeps Astrologorum): By the Sun's entrance into ♈ we judge the events of the Spring Quarter; take four Beginnings (♈♋♎♑ Ingresses), regard being had to the New and Full Moons next Preventional, especially if at thereat either Luminary is Eclipsed.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 法：以太阳入白羊为岁首断春季之事；取四至点入宫（♈♋♎♑）四图，并参其前后之朔望（若有日月蚀尤须顾）。
rules.notes: CHAP XV；Ptolemy 公认最理：取各年四至入宫图与前/后朔望图，按升/天顶/日月位之尊贵总证选最强星为 Almuten=岁主（Ptolemy 法见 CE-187）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Origanus: Erect three Figures for every Quarter, one for the ☌ or ☍ of the ☉ and ☽ preceding the Ingress, the second for the Ingress it self, and the third for the ☌ or ☍ succeeding the same.
rules.translation: Origanus 法：每季设三图——季前之日月合/冲、入宫时刻、季后之合/冲。
rules.notes: CHAP XV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按升座性质定图数与岁主
rules.original_text: Haly and Guido Bonatus: if at the Sun's Ingress into ♈ the Ascendant be a Fixed Sign, that Figure serves for the whole Year, and its Almuten is Lord of the whole Year; if a Common Sign, the Figure ends at the ☉'s entrance into ♎, another Scheme for the latter half Year; if a Moveable Sign, of force but till the ☉ enters ♋, new Schemes for the other three Quarters, each Quarter's Lord co-partner with the next.
rules.translation: Haly 与 Bonatus 法：春分入宫图升为定座=全年一图（图之 Almuten 为岁主）；双体座=半载至秋分另设图；动座=仅至巨蟹且四季各设新图，各季主相续共治。
rules.notes: CHAP XV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Doctrine of Ptolomy generally accepted: Erect for every Year Figures for the Sun's Ingress into the four Cardinal Points, as also the Lunations preceding and succeeding; then collect the Essential Dignities, and that Planet with most Testimonies of Strength in the Ascendant, Mid-heaven, and places of the Luminaries shall be chief Ruler or Almuten for that Revolution, or Lord of the Year.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 岁主选举法（公认最理）：每年设四至入宫图+前后朔望图，集行星本然尊贵，于升/天顶/日月位得最强证之星为 Almuten=岁主。
rules.notes: CHAP XV；岁主所在座=应象国族、落宫=应于何途（升=民命、2=财货、3=行旅、4=屋地遗产，各宫类推）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按土星之世俗主象断年
rules.original_text: From ♄ Judgment is drawn of Antiquities, Sects, Schisms, Heresies, Renovation of Ancient Customs, Depopulation and Destruction of Kingdoms; influence upon Monks, Fryers, Jesuits, Jewish Ceremonies, Ruined Buildings, sordid Debauchery, Shipwrecks, Captivities, Death, Famine.
rules.translation: 行星世俗主象——土星：变古俗、异端宗派分立、毁国灭邦；僧侣/犹太旧仪、颓垣、污行、船难、囚亡、饥荒。
rules.notes: CHAP XV；岁主象征总表见映射I（含木金火日水月）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Observe what Planet is Lord of the Year: if well dignified, a Plentiful, Temperate, Healthful Year, generally good in all the Significations of that Planet, Signe, and House; if weak and unfortunate, judge the contrary, especially if the ☽ concur, for she is the general Significator of the People.
rules.translation: 岁主强弱判年：岁主尊贵强健=丰稔温和之年，其星/座/宫之义皆吉；岁主弱凶=反是（月若同证尤凶——月主民）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI；岁主征兆逐星见映射K

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Whatever portents the Lord of the Year signifies will more especially be manifested in the Regions subject to the Signe of his position; the Nature thereof is taken from the House wherein he is posited: in the Ascendant, upon the Lives of the People; in the 2nd, their Estates; in the 3rd, their Journeys; in the 4th, their Houses, Lands, Inheritances.
rules.translation: 岁主落宫定应途：落升=应于民命；2宫=财货；3宫=行旅关系；4宫=屋地遗产（各宫类推）；其应象国族按岁主落座。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI 要则2；岁主受其主吉照=吉、受克=忧

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: ♄ Lord of the Year well disposed: people build, Husbandmen increase their Store; people honoured and loved. If weak and afflicted: much Cold, grievous infirmities, death of Ancient People in general. If ♄ be not aspected of ♂, expect an extream cold Season in most Northern Countries.
rules.translation: 土星为岁主：吉=民多营造、农夫丰收、民受尊爱；凶=酷寒多疾、老人多亡。土不被火照=北地极寒之冬。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI 要则4；木星岁主：吉=宗教/士绅/律师之利、民安居、木不与他星合照=温和北风养万物；凶=土合克=悲、火克=贵人损（要则5）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If ♂ be Lord of the Year powerful, Soldiers prosperous and overcome their Enemies; if weak, the contrary. Cardan sayes, ♂ Lord of the Year: great Heat, Burning of Houses, Lightning, Wars. If ♂ be in ♏, much Rain and Hail, unless joyned with other Planets.
rules.translation: 火星为岁主：强=军人得胜；弱=反。Cardan 云：大火/焚屋/雷电/兵戈。火居天蝎=多雨雹（合他星则减）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI 要则6；补论：吉星增各宫义、凶星反；引 Lilly 劝言宁以理据相位断、勿奉劣造格言；征验史事须观当时曜/彗星/交会/蚀象——大灾必土大涉、太平属木自然之力

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the ☉ be Lord of the Year strong in a good place: the King and Nobles happy, Corn, Cattle and Provisions plenty, Gold and Solar things plentiful. If in an abject place in □ or ☍ of ♄ or ♂, much prejudice to the aforesaid persons with scarcity.
rules.translation: 太阳为岁主：强居吉位=君王贵族吉、五谷牲畜丰、金货足；弱居劣位且受土木刑冲=贵人受损、物用匮乏。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI 要则7；金岁主：Haly 云丰福、婚嫁多、女子乐育；水岁主：宜学艺商贾、多风多变；月岁主：平民吉、气候随月相（1温湿/2温干/3冷干/4冷湿）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按日月地三体位置断蚀型
rules.original_text: The ☽ is a Dark Body receiving light of the ☉ by Reflection. At the Ecliptical Conjunction the ☽ passes between the ☉ and us; at an Ecliptical Opposition the Earth is between the ☉ and ☽.
rules.translation: 蚀之原理：月为暗体受日反照。朔蚀=月体居日地之间遮日；望蚀=地球居日月之间蔽月。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII；月轨交黄道约5°（=月纬）；交点（龙头龙尾）18年221日一巡

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the ☽ at the Full be distant from the ☊ or ☋ more than 15 degrees there can be no Eclipse of the ☽; at the Change, more than 19 degrees from the ☊ (or ☋) no Eclipse of the ☉; neither can there be any Eclipse of the ☉ when the ☽ at the Change is above 7 degrees from the ☋ or ☊.
rules.translation: 蚀之界限：望时月距交点>15°无月蚀；朔时月距交点>19°（顺/逆序各别）无日蚀；>7°亦无日蚀。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII 要则4；蚀量以日面12指（Digits）计、半蚀=6指

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Eclipses of the Luminaries fore-warn the Revolutions of Kingdoms and States, the Death of Princes, Heresies and Seditions in the Church, Alterations of Laws, Drought and Inundations, Wars, Famine, Plague and Pestilence; in fine, the Vicissitude of all Sublunary things.
rules.translation: 天示世事：蚀兆王侯之死、国祚之变、教中异端分立、法度改易、旱潦兵饥大疫，总之凡尘世之变。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII；蚀象亦证地圆、影锥、日远月近等天文事实

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 蚀位与随角之主星司其兆
rules.original_text: Erect your Scheme to the middle time of the Eclipse: Ptolomy's Rule — take the place of the Luminary Eclipsed, and the Angle succeeding it (the Ascendant if before Noon, the Mid-heaven if after Noon).
rules.translation: 设盘中时图，Ptolemy 法定蚀主：取蚀光体之位+随角（午前=升为角、午后=天顶为角）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII 要则1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Origanus: take that Planet for Lord of the Eclipse who hath most Dignities in the Ascendant, Mid-heaven, and place of the Eclipse; if none hath dominion in all three, accept him who is Lord of the place Deficient, with that Planet who hath most Dignities in the place of the Eclipse as Co-partner; if many claim equal share, that Planet who is Angular, Oriental, or Direct is preferred.
rules.translation: Origanus 法：取升/天顶/蚀位尊贵最多者为蚀主；无一星三处皆主则取蚀位之主为蚀主、以蚀位尊贵最多者为共治；多星相争则角/东/顺行者先。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII 要则2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: ♄ Lord of an Eclipse: corruptions by Cold, continued Diseases, decay of Nature, Consumption, disturbances of radical humours, Fluxes, Quartane Agues, Banishments, Poverty, Mortality of old Men, scarcity of useful Cattle; in the Air, violent Colds, frosty pestilent weather, snow; in Rivers and Sea, Tempests, Shipwracks, scarcity of Fish, Overflowings; upon Earth, scarcity of Corn and Fruit.
rules.translation: 土星为蚀主：冷湿致疾——持续之病/消耗/体液扰动/四日疟/放逐/贫困/老人之亡/六畜之灾；空中酷寒霜雪雾霾；河海风暴船难鱼水禽之荒、水溢；地上五谷果木之歉。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII；♃蚀主=万物丰增民康贵荣（p.303 起）；♂蚀主=兵戈内乱监流暴死热疾劫杀焚屋、雷电疫风旱（唯吉星吉照可缓）；♀蚀主=同木次之（婚庆子女荣乐丰熟）；☿蚀主=随风质生变、主盗贼海盗咳嗽劳瘵狂风雷暴、合某星则混其兆

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Eclipses in the Fiery Triplicity threaten destruction of Sheep and Oxen, banishment or deposition of some Great Person, Discord between the People and the Ruler, Armies, Wars, Burning, Rapes, Thefts, sharp Feavers, pestilent Diseases, Abortive Births, scarcity of Fruit and Corn. In the Earthy Triplicity, scarcity of Corn and Fruit; in the Airy, Famine, pestilent Diseases, stormy Winds; in the Watry, death of the inferior common sort, destruction of Fish and Fowl.
rules.translation: 蚀于火三合=牛羊之损、权臣黜囚、兵戈焚掠、疫疠流产、果谷荒歉（应受灾之国，Junctinus）；蚀于土三合=谷果歉；风三合=饥馑疫疠风暴；水三合=庶民之死、水族鱼鸟损。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII 要则7-8

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按蚀落宫位与蚀时长断
rules.original_text: An Eclipse falling in any of the Angles of a Nativity or Annual Revolution portends much Detriment to the Native; the same if it happen in the Radical place of the ☉ or ☽. Hermes: many Troubles when both Luminaries shall be eclipsed in one moneth. Note: so many hours as the ☉ is Eclipsed, so many years will the Effects continue; if a Lunar Eclipse, so many Moneths.
rules.translation: Ptolemy：蚀落本命/年返之角或日月本命位=其人不利；Hermes：一月双蚀=举世多难。效期：日蚀一小时=一年、月蚀一小时=一月。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII；起效时间：蚀中时蚀曜离地平位/升后时间按 Golden Rule 折算（全升续=1年/365日之比例）——Coley 从 Origanus 主当日即起；详见 Lilly《Annus Tenebrosus》1652

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To predict the Winds: ♄ and ☉ the East Wind, ♃ the North, ♂ and ☽ the West, ♀ the South; ☿ is indifferent, according as he is in ☌ or Aspect to ♄, cloudy or rainy weather with lofty winds; to ♃, some rain and warm winds; with the ☽ or ♀, moist winds. Fiery Signes are appropriated to the North West Wind, Airy to the North East, Watry to the South West, Earthy to the South East.
rules.translation: 风属星：土与日=东风、木=北风、火与月=西风、金=南风；水星随风合星变（合土=云雨大风、合木=微雨暖风、合月/金=湿风）。星座：火象=西北风、风象=东北、水象=西南、土象=东南。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX Part.I；☿停滞/逆行/换座/变纬=大风；土换座=数日变天（北纬尤验）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按行星与风性恒星偕出没断
rules.original_text: If either ♄ ♃ ♂ the ☉ or ♀ Rise or Set with any of these Fixed Stars, viz. Arcturus, Hercules, Auriga's Right Shoulder, Orion's Girdle, Praesepe, the Two Asses, or the Triangle, all these produce Winds, and many times violent Tempests, especially if any Planet be Retrograde or Stationary. ☿ with the Pleiades, Rams Head, Thigh of Pegasus, Auriga, Hydra's Heart, the Vulture, Dolphin, either of the Doggs, Regulus, Praesepe, the Eagle, produces Winds.
rules.translation: 固定星共出没起风：大角/武仙/御夫右肩/参带/积尸/二驴/三角——土木火日金与之偕出没=风、甚则暴风（行星逆/驻更验）；水星与昴宿/羊头/天马股/御夫/长蛇心/天鹰/海豚/天狼南河/轩辕/积尸=风起。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX Part.I；☿与木性恒星偕=暖风晴天

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按上星参与度与星行迟速断
rules.original_text: There is never any great Mutation of the Aire (even in England) without the Conjunction or Aspect of either of the Superiour Planets ♄ ♃ or ♂; great Conjunctions of contrary Natures cause much Rain, violent Winds, Snow or Hail. The wandering stars in swift motion generate Heat and Drought (if direct and Oriental); if slow, Retrograde or Occidental, they produce Rain, except ♂. If the Planets are Stationary, Winds. Many Conjunctions at one time seldom fail of a great Alteration.
rules.translation: 英格兰常验：天地大变异不离土木火三上星之合相/相位；吉凶相反之星大会=风雨雪雹。疾行者生热旱、顺东=热、迟逆西=雨（火例外）；停滞=风起；多星同时入相=大变。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX Part.I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Planets have the greatest power at their ☌, which continues longest in force; the ☍ is the next, then the □; the ∗ or △ is the weakest, seldom observed in weather, unless in the superiour Planets ♄ ♂; or ♀ ☿ ☽ separating from ♃ and applying to ♄ or ♂, then an alteration of the Aire is near.
rules.translation: 相位权重：合最强且最久、冲次之、刑又次、六合三合最弱（唯上星土木当参）；金水月离木入相土木=天将变、或致季灾。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX Part.I；逐对行星合刑冲之四季气象见映射K（20对）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Use of the Weather Table: observe what Aspects are upon the day (especially a ☌ □ or ☍); consider the Quality of the Signe: ♈♌♐ hot and dry, ♉♍♑ cold and dry, ♊♎♒ hot and moist, ♋♏♓ cold and moist. The Apertio Portarum, or opening of the Gates, is when there is a ☌ or Aspect of those Planets whose Houses are opposite, or when the ☽ separates from one Planet and applies to another whose Houses are opposite; upon these you may certainly expect change of Weather.
rules.translation: 天气表用法+四元质：白羊狮子人马=热干、金牛室女摩羯=冷干、双子天秤水瓶=热湿、巨蟹天蝎双鱼=冷湿。开门之象（Apertio Portarum）=敌对宫（两星之家相冲）行星合/相、或月离一星向敌对宫星之合——必变天。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX 表用法；延伸阅读 Cock《Raven in Duck Lane》小册

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: For the Southing: find the R.A. of the Point (by Trigonometry or Tables) and the ☉'s R.A. for the same time; subtract the ☉'s R.A. from the Planet's R.A. (adding a circle if occasion); the remainder converted into time is the time of Southing; if under 12 hours, after noon; if more, subtract 12, the residue is in the morning.
rules.translation: 中天（Southing）计算：星之赤经−日之赤经（不足加360°）、余数化时（<12h=午后、>12h 减 12=晨）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII 要则1；亦可日赤经之补角（360−RA☉）+星赤经

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: For the Rising: get the Star's Oblique Ascension and the ☉'s R.A.; from the O.A. (increased by a circle if need) subtract the ☉'s R.A.; if the remainder exceed 90d. subtract 90d. from it, if less than 90d. add 270d.; converted into time, is the time of Rising.
rules.translation: 出（Rising）计算：星斜升−日赤经（不足加整圆）；余>90°减90、<90°加270；化时=出时。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII 要则2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 按对点斜升化时并修正视差
rules.original_text: For the Setting: find the Oblique Ascension of the opposite point, with opposite latitude; proceed as in computing the Rising. By reason of parallax and refraction, the ☽ appears to rise later and set sooner than really she doth; contrarily all the planets and stars seem to rise sooner and set later, by the quantity of 2 minutes of an hour.
rules.translation: 没（Setting）计算：以对点（反纬度）之斜升照 Rising 同法。视差折射：月视升迟没早约2分/时；星视升早没迟约2分/时。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII 要则3；固定星年行经度仅约50-52秒可略，行星月须先估时再算真位

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: A Star of the first Magnitude is greater than the Earth 68 times; a Star of the second Magnitude exceedeth the Earth 28 times; a Star of the third Magnitude is greater than the Earth 11 times.
rules.translation: 星等义：一等星>地68倍、二等28倍、三等11倍。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII 表末；32主星出没表见映射N（升/南中/没/中天高度/幅度/星等；中天高度>38°（赤道高，52°纬补角）幅度偏北、<38°偏南）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 六段：寿命/寿主/年主/命主/体质容貌/才智品性/总命运
rules.original_text: In the Judgment of this House I shall consider these following (Particular) Sections; viz. Sect. 1. Whether the Life of the Native may be long or short... 2. Who is Significator or giver of Life? viz. Hyleg, or Hylech. 3. Who is Alchocoden, or giver of Years? 4. The Lord of the Geniture, viz. Almuten? 5. The Temperature, or Complexion of the Native, his Stature, Form, &c. 6. The Wit or Ingenuity, Understanding, or Manners of the Native, Lastly, The Fortune or Misery of the Native in General.
rules.translation: 第一宫判断六项纲领：①寿命长短；②寿主（Hyleg/Hylech）；③年主（Alchocoden）；④命主（Almuten）；⑤体温质/容貌/体形；⑥才智/悟性/品性；末总观命主之祸福。此即判例盘一宫判断的六段结构，可作本命判断引擎的总框架。
rules.notes: CHAP XII 引言；1650 示例盘

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Aphetic 位之日月按昼夜取舍，否则取升点
rules.original_text: Here, according to the given Rule, I am to consider (1.) Whether the Birth be Diurnal or Nocturnal. (2.) The Position of the Luminaries, whether either of them are posited in such places of the Figure which are accounted Aphetical; viz. the seventh, ninth, tenth, eleventh, or Ascendant, &c. The Nativity being Diurnal, and the Sun being the Light of the Time, so strong in the eleventh House, a fit Aphetical place in the Figure, and there in the Dignities of Exaltation, I may therefore accept him for Hyleg, or Giver of Life. Had not the Sun been found posited as aforesaid, I must then have accepted the Ascendant for Hyleg: The Moon in this case is not to be taken notice of; for had the Birth been Nocturnal, she being posited in the sixth House, the Ascendant must therefore have been taken according to the Rule given Sect. 2. Chap. 10.
rules.translation: Hyleg（寿主）择法判例：①先定昼生/夜生；②察日月是否居 Aphetic 位（7/9/10/11宫或升点）。本盘昼生、太阳（当令之光）强居11宫（适切之 Aphetic 位）且在其擢升尊贵——取太阳为寿主。若太阳不居上述之位则取升点为寿主（月不作数）；夜生而月居6宫（非 Aphetic 位）者亦取升点（依 CHAP X SECT II 之规）。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT II；判例盘：日居11宫白羊擢升=Hyleg

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 尊贵最多者=年主，可授 Co-partner
rules.original_text: Here I am to consider what Planet hath most Essential Dignities in the Signe Aries, wherein the Sun, giver of Life, is posited, Mars hath Aries for his Day-House, and a Terme and Face in that Signe also; But the Sun having Exaltation, Triplicity, and Face in the same Signe, should rather be accepted for Giver of Years; but in regard they are both so well dignified in that Signe, and both posited therein, upon that consideration I may elect the Sun not only Hyleg, but Alchocoden, and Mars Co-partner, who hath no less than Eighteen Testimonies of Fortitude Essential and Accidental in the Scheme, and the Sun only Thirteen.
rules.translation: Alchocoden（年主）择法判例：取寿主所在星座中 Essential Dignities 最多者——判例盘日居白羊，火星有昼宫+界+面，太阳有擢升+三体+面，太阳当取年主；然二星同座同驻且俱强，故授太阳为 Hyleg 兼 Alchocoden、火星为 Co-partner（其尊贵 Testimonies 十八、太阳十三）。年主小/中年限之判：太阳四分土星且合火星（二者于8宫有大尊贵）→已过火日之最小年限，可望太阳之平均年限；太阳火星之强（居吉位、受月三合照）可延命。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT III；判例盘：日=Hyleg+Alchocoden、火=Co-partner；土四分日

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 古法看月水位、现代法看全盘总分
rules.original_text: Some of the Antients were of Opinion, That we ought to examine what Planet hath most Essential Dignities in the place of the Moon and Mercury, and accept of him to be Lord of the Figure; if so, I find the Sun to have most Essential Dignities in the place of Mercury, and Mars in the place of the Moon... But our Modern Astrologers do rather accept of that Planet which surmounts all the rest in Essential and Accidental Fortitudes; (which is most rational) if so, Saturn will be found Almuten, as appears by the Table; but the Sun, Mars and Venus must also be admitted as Co-partners, by reason of their strength.
rules.translation: Almuten（命主）择法两派：古法——察月与水星之位中 Essential Dignities 最多者（判例盘：日于水星之位、火于月亮之位居首）；现代法（Coley 以为最合理）——全盘 Essential+Accidental Fortitudes 总和最高者（判例盘=土星），日月火金因强而并为 Co-partner。命主星之性决定命主之行事、倾向与状况，及其体质、体液与品性之所宗。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT IV；判例盘：土=Almuten（居升），日月火金为 Co-partner

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 冷热干湿逐项计数，星性可改判
rules.original_text: This must be Discovered by considering the Sign Ascending, and the Lord thereof; the Planets posited in the Ascendant, or beholding the same; also the position of the Luminaries. The Sign Ascending is Gemini hot moist; The Lord thereof Mercury cold dry, who is posited in Aries a Sign hot dry; Saturn in part Almuten cold dry; In Gemini an Aireal Sign hot moist; Saturn neer the Degree Ascending cold dry; Season of the Year March hot moist; The Moon in her last Quarter cold dry; Mercury Lord of the Ascendant in Conjunction with Mars hot dry; The Moon in the end of Scorpio very neer Sagittary hot moist; The Moon in Trine of the Sun from Aries hot dry. Hot 7, Moist 4, Cold 4, Dry 7. Hence it appears the Native should be Cholerique and Phlegmatique, viz. Hot, and Moist; But in regard Saturn is posited so neer the Degree Ascending, strong, and in good Aspect to Mercury Dispositer, 'tis a strong Argument the Native should notwithstanding be very subject to Melancholy.
rules.translation: 体温质判法（判例示范）：以升星座、命主、升内行星、照升之星、日月之位置、季节、月相逐项列冷/热/干/湿并计数——判例盘：升双子热湿、命主水星冷干、水居白羊热干、土（Almuten）冷干、升内土星冷干、季节三月热湿、月在下弦冷干、水合火热干、月近人马热湿、月三合日热干；计数热7干7湿4冷4→胆质偏湿、然土强居升度且吉照命主水星→仍甚易忧郁。此法即'四质投票计数法'。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT V；判例盘：胆多液质偏忧郁

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 升星座主形、凶星在升改品性不改形
rules.original_text: Of the Natives Stature, and Form of Body, which is also taken from the Sign Ascending, and Lord thereof. In the Nativity the last Decade of Gemini Ascends, and Saturn posited therein, Mercury Lord of the Ascendant is in Conjunction with the Sun, and Mars in Aries. Gemini personates an upright, strait, and tall Body, well sett, a decent Composure, a good Colour (though not very clear) bright Eyes, and good sight, long Arms, brown Hair, an accute Wit; in fine, an ingenious Person, and an active Body. The position of Saturn in the Ascendant, and Mercury in Aries, in Conjunction with the Sun and Mars, doth not much alter this Discription, but rather the Natives Inclination, and Manners.
rules.translation: 体形判法（判例示范）：以升星座与命主取形——双子座表征挺直修长匀称之躯、容色尚佳（非甚明净）、目明善视、长臂、棕发、锐智、颖悟之人、身体活跃。升内土星与命主水星居白羊合日月火并不大改此形貌，而改其性情与品行（归下节）。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT V 末；双子形貌描述本于 Part I 各星座章（页21）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 升内星为主征、无星取命主
rules.original_text: The Manners, or Natural Humour, Disposition, or Temper of the Native is usually considered (Astrologically) from that Planet which is posited in the Ascendant; and more especially if he happen to be Ruler thereof, or in Aspect to the Moon, or Mercury: if many Planets be found in the Ascendant, it presages variety of Manners; if no Planet be in the Ascendant, this Judgement must be taken from the Lord of the Ascendant, and those Stars that are neer the Significator. In this Figure I find Saturn just arising neer the very Degree of the Horoscope, and there in Quartile to Mercury Lord thereof, therefore I may Rationally accept him to be the only Significator of the Qualities of the Mind; now considering he is partly Lord of the Geniture, and Angular, this shews the Native to be a serious, solid Person, and very Grave in his Behaviour... very affable, obliging, and courteous to all Persons.
rules.translation: 品性判法（判例示范）：通常以升内之星为品性之征——尤以命主、或照月/水之星；多星在升=品性多变；升内无星则取命主及近 Significator 之星。判例盘：土星恰升近升度且四分命主水星→独取土星为心性之征；土为命主（Almuten）之一部且居角→庄重、坚实、举止端严、处事谨慎、待人谦和恭顺。其忧郁不时发作而不久（水星居火象星座、为日月火所围而三合于月，故减其忧郁、偶生多变之念而罕为鲁莽之行）。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT VI 1-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 水三合月=颖悟，受克则减
rules.original_text: The Ingenuity of the Native, which should be principally considered from the position of Mercury, who in the Scheme I find in Trine to the Moon, but neerly in Quartile to Saturn Retrograde and Combust of the Sun, and in Conjunction of Mars. Mercury being in Trine to the Moon, gives a most excellent Understanding, a pregnant Wit, a large Capacity; But considering Mercury is thus afflicted by both the Infortunes, as also by the Light of the Time, this doth much abate the aforesaid good signification, but yet doth not greatly stupifie, or dull the Natives active Fancy in regard he is posited in Aries a Fiery Sign, and a Sign of Activity so neer the Body of Mars; and hence I conclude the Native to be of a moderate sharp Fancy.
rules.translation: 才智判法（判例示范）：主察水星之位与受克——判例盘水星三合月→颖悟卓绝、才思敏给、容量广大；然水为双凶（土四分、日灼、逆）所克且为当令之光所灼→大减其吉、然不钝其思（居白羊火象活动之座、近火星之体）→终断：中度敏锐之才。术者亲验：其人于神学、哲学、医学诸题皆善思辨。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT VI 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 四质+星强+吉方向→命运大吉
rules.original_text: In the next place I return to the Nativity, wherein I find four Planets above the Earth, and posited in the eleventh House (which Astrologers note to be the Mansion of Friendship) they are also beheld by a friendly Trine Aspect of the Moon, who Rules that part of the Heavens, which denotes the Natives Estate, or Substance: The Part of Fortune is posited in the Angle of Honour, there disposed of by Saturn, who casts a benevolent Trine thereunto.
