Most of the Planets are Essentially strong... the Sun is in Aries, wherein he hath the Dignity of Exaltation, and Triplicity; Mars is posited in his own House, and face; Saturn in his Triplicity, and Terms, and Venus in her Exaltation, to which may be added that the Number of good Directions exceed the bad. Hence it Naturally follows that the Natives Fate should be exceeding good.
rules.translation: 总命运判法（判例示范）：察诸星之位与强弱、彼此吉凶照应、方向之吉凶多数——判例盘：四星上地平聚11宫（友谊之宫）、受2宫主月亮之吉三合照；福点居天顶、受土星吉三合而为其 Dispositor；诸星大体本然强（日擢升+三体、火本宫+面、土三体+界、金擢升）；吉方向多于凶方向→命主之命运极佳（就出身教养之质而言），友多且常助其进身。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT VII 2-5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Native is advised, notwithstanding, to beware of Rash Actions, because Mercury is in a Fiery Signe, and so neer the Sun and Mars, whence he may prejudice his own Honour and Reputation, in regard Saturn, Lord of the tenth House, is in the Ascendant, and within the Orbs of a Quadrat of Mercury, Lord of the Ascendant. Let him not put too much confidence in pretended Friends, neither (such I mean of the Female Sex) because though Venus be strong in the eleventh House (having great Dignities therein) yet she is in Square to Saturn, Lord of the Angle of Honour, posited in the Horoscope.
rules.translation: 一宫判例附警示两条：①水星居火象星座且近日火→慎鲁莽之行，否则损名（土为10宫主居升、四分水星命主之故）；②勿过信伪友（尤女性）——金星虽强居11宫（大尊贵）然四分土星（荣位之主、居升）。
rules.notes: CHAP XII SECT VII 6-7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 宫头/主/宫内星/福点+吉照
rules.original_text: This Judgment is usually deduced from Consideration of the second House, the Cusp thereof, the Planets (if any be) posited therein; the Ruler of the second House, the Part of Fortune, and their Dispositors: also any Planets that are in good Aspects to the aforesaid Significators.
rules.translation: 第二宫判断纲领：察2宫头、宫内之星、2宫主、福点及其 Dispositors、吉照上述 Significator 之星。判例盘：巨蟹临2宫头、月（2宫主）初入人马、三合11宫四星（在容许度内）；福点居天顶、受其 Dispositor 三合照，木星（擢升于2宫）三合2宫头→财丰。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT I；判例盘：财丰

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照征象定财源（父遗/友亲/妻妆奁/遗嘱/商贸）
rules.original_text: consideration ought to be had to those Planets that do friendly behold the Significators of Substance. And here I find the Moon is not only in Trine to Mars and Mercury, the Natives Significator, but to the Sun also, who is Lord of the fourth House, and posited in the eleventh, which Demonstrates that much of the Natives Estate should be settled upon him by his Father; which he has already lived to see performed. The Friendly Trine of Jupiter, Lord of the seventh, who has Dignities in the Mansion of Substance, as also the eleventh House, shews the Native may Advantage himself in Estate by the Marriage of a Wife; as also Merchandizing, or dealing with such persons as are signified by Jupiter in Scorpio. Saturn is Lord of the eighth House, and friendly beholds and disposes of Fortune, and he is posited in the Ascendant, which is the eighth House from the place of Jupiter and the Moon: Hence I conclude the Native may be Enriched by the Wills or Legacies of the Dead, (as well as by a Portion or Dowry of a Wife,) and in respect Saturn properly signifies Land and Houses; therefore part of the Natives Estate should be therein.
rules.translation: 二宫财源判法（判例示范）：察吉照财之 Significators 之星——月（2宫主）三合日（4宫主居11宫）→父遗多；木（7宫主、于2宫有尊）吉照→妻妆奁之利、及与木居天蝎所征之人（亲故或他人）商贸之利；土（8宫主）吉照并 Dispose 福点、居升（木月之第八宫）→死者遗嘱/遗产之财（兼妻之妆奁）；土本性主土地房屋→遗产多为地产，然细察亦含可观现款。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II 1-3；四源：父、友亲、妻奁、平民商贸

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉 Promittor 进财、凶 Promittor 损财
rules.original_text: Something as to the time when the Native should expect an increase (or loss) of Estate should be hinted, but that is best discovered from a due Consideration of the Directions; their effects being considerable... such as delight in those Speculations, should carefully observe when the Significators of Substance meet the hopeful and promising Beams of Promittors, which are the most probable times that Riches may drop in; and on the contrary when the Significators are Directed to bad Promittors then loss and damage usually follows, unless Miraculously prevented by other Causes.
rules.translation: 二宫进财/损财之时机：以方向法察之——财之 Significators（2宫主/福点等）会吉 Promittor 之吉照时最可能进财；被方向引至凶 Promittor 时则损财（除非他因奇迹般地阻止）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIII SECT II 5；方向法跨章引用

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 兼有兄弟姐妹、然体弱短寿
rules.original_text: I find the last degree of Cancer upon the Cusp of the third House, and the Moon, Lady thereof, in Partile Trine thereunto, but in regard that Signe is so neerly off, the Sun must be accounted a Co-significator of such Relations, he is in Trine to the Moon; Jupiter is in Scorpio, and Venus in Pisces, both fruitful Signes... I conclude the Native should have both Brothers and Sisters. Now their Condition can be no wayes mean or bad, because the Sun is in his Exaltation, and in Trine to the Moon, yet they should be persons of no healthful Constitutions, or strong able Bodies, because Saturn, being Lord of the sixth House from the third House, is in Quartile to the Sun, their principal Significator. Moreover, Mars is Lord of the sixth House... exalted in the eighth, the sixth from the third... doth not improperly import that the Natives Brothers and Sisters should be no long livers, but much subject to Diseases and Crasiness of Body.
rules.translation: 三宫兄弟姐妹判法（判例示范）：3宫头末度巨蟹、月（3宫主）分照三合其头；星座将出、日复为共征（三合月）；木居天蝎、金居双鱼俱多产之座、金又三合3宫头→兄弟姐妹兼有。其状况：日擢升+三合月→不卑不恶；然土（3宫之6宫主）四分日（其主征）→体弱；火（6宫主、于8宫擢升=3宫之第6宫）近日→不长寿、多病。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT I；凶星自6/8宫照3宫征象→体弱

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Native and his Brothers and Sisters should agree reasonable well together, and live in Amity for the most part, because the Luminaries are in Trine, and the Lord of the third is posited in the eleventh House, (which is accounted the House of Friendship) But Saturn in the Horoscope in Quartile to the Sun and Mercury Combust, shews also sometimes a disagreement between the Native and his Brother in particular, or Brethren in general; or that there should not be so real a Unity between the Brethren themselves, as between the Brothers and Sisters.
rules.translation: 三宫和睦判法（判例示范）：日月三合、3宫主居11宫（友谊之宫）→兄弟姐妹与命主大体和融；然土居升四分日与灼水→有时与兄弟（或诸兄弟）生隙、兄弟之间之团结不如兄妹姐弟之间；火（兄弟之通义征象）克并 Dispose 水星→其隙益着。然水居白羊（火星之家）虽有受克，仍可使命主以活动与机敏自护于日月火之近逼。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 愉吉为主、偶有劳顿危险
rules.original_text: The Sun being Lord of the third chiefly, and posited in his Exaltation in the eleventh House (which is Sextile to the Ascendant) declares the Native will take many pleasant and Fortunate short Journeys, which Judgment is also confirmed by the Trine of the Luminaries. Yet the former Reasons, also considered, (viz. the Quadrat of the Sun and Saturn, and the Combustion of Mercury) these are Arguments the Native must expect to meet with some Toyl and Trouble, and probably (at sometimes) Danger also in his short Journeys.
rules.translation: 三宫短途旅行判法（判例示范）：3宫主（日）擢升居11宫（六合升点）、日月三合→短旅多愉吉；然土四分日+水灼→途中时遇劳顿、偶或危险；终断：大体愉吉，然有时（若不慎）反损身财、且或于无兴时而行。
rules.notes: CHAP XIV SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 父有才具、父子中度相合
rules.original_text: The Natives Father is Signified by the Sun (which is a General Significator of Fathers) also Sol is very potent in his own Dignities in the eleventh House or Mansion of Friendship and Hope... That Benevolent Fixed Star of the first Magnitude, called the Virgins Spike, is posited in the fifth House, the Fathers second, and Jupiter in Sextile to the Cusp thereof, which shews the Natives Father to be a person of Ability, as well as of a Noble Spirit, and large Hearth, somewhat inclined to Choller or Passion, as the Sun in Aries in Conjunction of Mars, and Cor Leonis in the fourth, very naturally portends. What was said of the Agreement between the Native and his Brethren may in part be understood in this Case... a Reasonable or moderate Concordency may be expected, and sometimes (though perhaps rarely) there will arise Jarring and Difference.
rules.translation: 四宫父子判法（判例示范）：父以日（父之通义征象）为主——日强居11宫（友谊希望之宫）→父为命主之实友；角宿一（Spica，一等吉恒）居5宫（父之2宫）+木六合其宫头→父有才具、气宇轩昂、心量宽大；日居白羊合火+轩辕十四（Cor Leonis）临4宫→父性稍近嗔急。父子相合：中度相合、偶（罕）起龃龉，然父之自然亲爱不减（日在其擢升处收受水星、水虽灼然不离日体）。
rules.notes: CHAP XV SECT I；Spica 在5宫=父之2宫、轩辕十四在4宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Nativity being Diurnal, the Sun is not only Significator of the Natives Father, but of his Patrimony also... Now the Sun being strong Essentially in the Figure, (viz. in his Exaltation and Triplicity) I therefore judge the Natives Patrimony to be considerable; and the more, in respect that the Sun darts a favourable Trine Aspect to the Moon, Lady of the Natives House of Substance. It may be objected, that Saturn is in Square of the Sun; but that is the less material, by reason of the great strength of Sol, if it be also considered that Saturn is not Ascended above the Horizon at Birth, which was Diurnal; and in case the Natives Patrimony should be deminished, it will be occasioned partly by his own means.
rules.translation: 四宫祖产判法（判例示范）：昼生之日兼征父与祖产——日本然强（擢升+三体）+三合2宫主月→祖产可观；土四分日之碍较轻（日甚强、且昼生土未上地平）；若祖产有损，多由命主自身之故。
rules.notes: CHAP XV SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Finding the first Decade of that Stigmatized Signe Scorpio descending upon the Cusp of the sixth, and Mars, Lord thereof, in Conjunction with Sol, Light of the time, or giver of Life, and afflicting Mercury; Also Jupiter, Lord of the seventh, Retrograde in the sixth House, and the Moon posited therein neer Cauda Draconis: These are Arguments in Art, that the Native should be often afflicted in Body by the malignancy of Diseases... Saturn in the Ascendant in Quartile to the Sun and Mercury (within Orbs) confirm the same, which is the more aggravated in that he hath Dignities in the eighth house. But on the other side, Jupiter being a Benevolent Planet (though posited in that Turbulent Signe Scorpio) is still a friend to nature, and disposes of Venus... who friendly beholds several Planets in the eleventh House from the sixth, or House of Diseases: This doth something aleviate the aforesaid evil.
rules.translation: 六宫疾病判法（判例示范）：天蝎初度临6宫头、火（6宫主）合日（寿主/当令之光）并克水星、木（7宫主）逆居6宫、月居6宫近龙尾、土居升四分日月水（在容许内）且于8宫有尊→常罹病。反证：木（吉星虽居蝎）仍为天性之友、Dispose 金星并近照月、吉照11宫诸星（自6宫数起）→稍缓其恶；终断：非健全之质、然病不至于大损。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI SECT I；月居6宫近龙尾

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 湿痰水胀/肝胃滞/痛风/肿痛热烧
rules.original_text: And those I judge may proceed from moist humours abounding in the Body, or from the corruption of the Blood, whence Surfeits, or the Dropsie may be feared (as is aptly denoted by Jupiter in Scorpio in the sixth House) also obstructions of the Liver and Stomach; Saturn in the Ascendant in an Airy Signe sometimes afflicts the Native with the Gout, and advises him to be careful of all Chronique Distempers arising from the Putrifaction of the Blood; and Mars in Aries afflicting of Mercury naturally portends the same; whence breakings out and swellings in several parts of the body may ensue, with violent pains in the Head, and Feavours of dangerous consequence, if not carefully prevented in time. (But those diseases of Mars, Lord of the sixth, are something mitigated by the friendly Trine of the Moon.)
rules.translation: 六宫疾类判法（判例示范）：湿痰充体、血腐→伤食/水肿之虞（木居蝎于6宫）；肝胃滞塞；土居升（风象座）时致痛风、慎一切血腐之慢性病；火居白羊克水星→体表疮肿、暴头痛、险热（火为6宫主之病为月之吉三合所缓）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 凶星克命主→仆多伪；吉照→忠仆
rules.original_text: Mars, Lord of the sixth house, afflicting Mercury in the eleventh, shews the Native will have such Servants that, notwithstanding their fair pretences, may not really affect him; and consequently not discharge their trust with that fidelity as they ought to do; which is confirmed by the Quadrate of Mars to the Cusp of the second House, and the position of the Dragons Tayl in the sixth; the Native ought therefore to be careful of such Servants as are signified by Mars in Aries, which will not want for boldness and confidence, as also such dissembling fellows signified by Jupiter in Scorpio; but those by the Moon in Trine to Mercury and the Sun, the Native may justly impose confidence in... and such I describe thus, viz. persons of a moderate, large stature of Body, pale Complexioned, round fac'd, grey ey'd, much hair of a sad colour, and the whole body somewhat corpulent, plump, or fleshy.
rules.translation: 六宫仆人判法（判例示范）：6宫主（火）克水星（命主）于11宫→仆多虚表不忠、难尽其职（火四分2宫头+龙尾居6宫为证）；慎火星白羊所征之仆（鲁莽自信）与木居天蝎所征之伪诈者；月三合水日所征之仆可托信——其形容：中上身材、面白、圆脸、灰眼、发多而色暗、体丰腴。由此亦易判其畜养小牲（羊/豕/犬/禽）之成败。
rules.notes: CHAP XVI SECT III；忠仆形容为判例示范

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 婚向有、婚期迟至33岁（升→金三合）
rules.original_text: In the Geniture there is 23 degrees of Sagitary descending upon the Cusp of the seventh House, and Jupiter, Lord thereof, in Scorpio a fruitful Signe; (2.) the Moon is just leaving Scorpio, and hasting to the Cusp of the seventh House (though in her own Dignities) besides Venus is in Conjunction with the part of Marriage... all which are Testimonies that the Native will have an inclination to Marriage... which Judgment is confirmed by the Trine of the Moon and Mercury, Lord of the Ascendant. Thus I conclude that Native may Marry, but rarely above once, because Saturn is in the Ascendant, and in exact Square to Venus (a general Significatrix of Marriage) and she in Square to the Cusp of the seventh House, which may retard the business till thirty years at least, but may be effected probably upon the Direction of the Ascendant to the Trine of Venus, which will not be till 33 years at soonest.
rules.translation: 七宫婚姻判法（判例示范）：7宫头人马23°、木（7宫主）居天蝎（多产座）、月初离蝎将及7宫头（在其尊贵）、金合婚点（Part of Marriage）→有婚向（月三合水星命主为证）；然土居升、精确四分金（婚姻通义征象）、金又四分7宫头→婚迟至三十岁以后，升点方向至金之三合时成婚=最早三十三岁。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT I；判例盘：升→金三合方向=33岁（Naibod 度量）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 形貌取宫头座、品性取宫主（弱则减）
rules.original_text: The Description of her Person is taken in particular from the Sign Sagitary descending upon the Cusp of the seventh house, and her qualities from Jupiter Rx in Scorpio having no Aspect to any of the other Planets in the Scheme. Sagitary usually gives a Person of a well proportioned Body, rather tall than otherwise; or a Person above a middle Stature, of a Cheerful Countenance, Oval Visage, Brown Hair... As to Conditions, Jupiter generally signifies a Person of a most excellent Conversation, Just, Noble, Prudent, and a real Friend where he, or she do fix their Affections, yet perfect haters of all base, and unworthy Actions; but this must be understood where Jupiter is essentially Dignified: Now in this Nativity finding Jupiter posited in the very worst Sign in the Heavens (as it is accounted by all Astrologers) viz. Scorpio Retrograde in the sixth House and in no Aspect with the Luminaries; I therefore conclude the Person the Native shall Marry will not be altogether so well qualified as aforesaid, yet ingenious, alive, and moderately well tempered.
rules.translation: 七宫妻质判法（判例示范）：妻之形貌取7宫头星座（人马）——匀称之躯、偏高、悦容、鹅蛋脸、棕发、周身合度；妻之品性取7宫主（木居天蝎逆行于6宫、不与任何星成相）——木本性温良公正明哲忠诚，然此须木本然受尊之时；今木居天蝎（诸星家以为最劣之座）逆行、不与日月成相→妻品不及上述之全美，然仍聪慧、活泼、性情中度。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT II 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 中度相合、妆奁不薄；金火无照以月三合解
rules.original_text: Their Agreement should be reasonable good yet no extraordinary fondness on either side, because Saturn is in the Ascendant in Quartile to Venus; I say a reasonable good Agreement in respect I find the Moon did separate from a Conjunction of Jupiter, and applies to a Trine of Mercury Lord of the Ascendant, and thereby transfers the Vertue of Jupiter, not only to Mercury, but to Mars, and the Sun also. The Portion of the Wife, I Judge, should not be inconsiderable, because Saturn, the Significator thereof, is in Trine to the Part of Fortune, and disposes thereof in the Mid-heaven. There is an Aphorisme in Astrology, that the Person that hath not Venus in some good Aspect of Mars in his Nativity will assuredly suffer many Inconveniences in his Love, or Affections, here Venus is in no Aspect of Mars; but the Moon being in Trine to Venus takes off all danger in that particular.
rules.translation: 七宫婚配相合/妆奁/恋爱格言（判例示范）：①相合——土居升四分金→相合中度、无过甚之昵爱；月离木合而就水星命主之三合、传木星之德于水/火/日→相合可佳。②妆奁——土（妆奁之征象）三合福点并居天顶 Dispose 之→妆奁不薄。③恋爱格言（Aphorism）：本命金与火无吉照者恋爱多不利；本盘金不与火成相、然月三合金解其危。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT II 3-4；金火恋爱 Aphorism 为独立格言

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: As to the Quarter of Heaven, from whence she may come, Finding the Moon, and Jupiter posited in the Western part of the Heavens; intimates she should come from that Quarter, or rather West, North-west from the place of the Natives Birth.
rules.translation: 七宫妻来向判法（判例示范）：察7宫主与月之所在方位——判例盘月木俱居西半部天→妻来自西/西北方（自出生地言之）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT II 5；Coley 判例示范，方位判法置信度低

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In order to the Resolution of this Question, I am still to consider the position of Jupiter, who is Lord of the seventh (there being no Planet Located therein) and finding him Retrograde in Scorpio in the sixth House in no Aspect to Mercury, or the Moon, nor to Saturn, who is in the Ascendant; hence I conclude that the Native need not fear prejudice from publique Enemies, nor is there any danger that he should be afflicted with any; and those which may accidentally shew themselves, will be Persons very inconsiderable... To confirm this Judgement, I find the principal Significator of the Native much stronger, and better placed than the Lord of the seventh House.
rules.translation: 七宫公敌判法（判例示范）：7宫主（木）逆居6宫、不与水/月/土成相→命主无公敌之虞、偶现之敌亦微不足道；命主主征（水/土）远强于7宫主（月离木合就水星三合）为证。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Ascendant, and Lord of the seventh are both very meanly dignified, and Retrograde; which argues if the Native should Casually happen to have any Suit in Law, as there is no danger of losing much thereby; so there is but small hopes on the other side that he should profit much by such Contests. But considering the Native is not only signified by Mercury, but by Saturn also (who is Almuten of the Geniture) I may hence rationally conclude that he shall contend very rarely with any Person but he will come off the Victor; yet let not the Native voluntarily attempt such Controversies, unless justly provoked thereunto; because Jupiter is in a treacherous Sign. Lastly, As to Partnership... if the Native happen to engage therein, he should rather advantage himself thereby, than suffer loss, or prejudice; for Saturn Lord of the eighth is in the Ascendant in Trine, (and dispositor) of the Part of Fortune, and Jupiter is also in Trine to the Cusp of the second House, and exalted therein.
rules.translation: 七宫讼与合伙判法（判例示范）：1/7宫主俱弱且逆行→讼无大失亦无大得；然命主以水（Almuten 土亦为命主之征）为主→罕有争而不胜者，然勿自启争讼（木居诈诡之座）；合伙则利——土（8宫主）居升三合（并 Dispose）福点、木三合2宫头且擢升于其内→合伙反得利。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
signs: 处女/双子/白羊/天秤/双鱼
rules.result: 荒芜座+受克→极少且孱弱多男
rules.original_text: Finding Virgo, a Barren Sign, upon the Cusp of the fifth, and Gemini another Barren Sign Ascending upon the Cusp of the Horoscope, also Mercury Lord of both Houses in Aries in Conjunction of the Sun and Mars; these Testimonies barely considered, denyes Issue: But to Ballance this judgement, on the other side, I find a benevolent fixed Star (viz. Spica virginia) Intercepted in the fifth in Libra, and therefore disposed of by Venus, who is posited in her Exaltation in the eleventh house, and there in Trine to the Moon; these are Arguments the Native may have Issue. But considering the Lord of the Ascendant, and fifth Houses, are so much afflicted in the eleventh, by the Sun and Mars, and Venus, who is also Lady of the twelfth House (the eighth from the fifth) in Quartile to Saturn... I hence conclude the Native will have very few Children (if any) and those sickly and weak, and consequently not long Vitall; and in all probability they should be of the Male kind, because Mercury is posited in Aries, a Masculine Sign, and in Conjunction with the Sun and Mars, two Masculine Planets.
rules.translation: 五宫子女判法（判例示范）：处女（荒芜座）临5宫头、双子（又荒芜座）升、命主/5宫主（水）居白羊合日月火——仅此则星言无嗣；反证：角宿一（吉恒）截居天秤5宫内（金星 Dispositor、金擢升11宫三合月）→可有子；终断：水星（1/5宫主）于11宫受日月火克、金（12宫主=5宫之8宫主）四分土→子女极少（若有）且孱弱夭折、多为男（水居白羊男座合日月火两男星、月初入男座、金土相亦男星为证）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII(2) SECT I-II；Spica 截于5宫=反证有嗣

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Finding the Lord of the Ascendant, and fifth house one Planet, and afficted by the presence of the Sun, and Mars in an Opposite House to the fifth: also Saturn in the Ascendant in Square to Venus, shews that the Native should have small inclination, or delight in any such Exercises (in which is also included Musick, and Dancing) and this I know to be true, the Native will rather be reserved, and Contemplative in misterious matters, and yet sometimes mounts upon the Wings of an Active Fancy. The Native delights not at all in Musick, or any Airy Divertisement, but is generally Melancholy, unless more than ordinary moved... here's no great incouragement for the Native to hope for gain by Gaming.
rules.translation: 五宫娱乐判法（判例示范）：升主=5宫主同星、受日月火克（居5宫之对宫）、土居升四分金→寡于娱乐（含音乐舞蹈）；其人静观默想神秘之事、偶乘活跃之想象；不喜音乐或轻浮之娱、常带忧郁（非大动不形于外）；赌戏亦无利可图。
rules.notes: CHAP XVII(2) SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 旅兴强东南向，然有险不宜远
rules.original_text: I consider that part of Capricorn is descending upon the Cusp of the ninth house, but just passing off, and therefore Aquary should rather be accepted; however, Saturn is still Ruler of the said house, and disposed of by her only in the Ascendant; Mercury is in a moveable Sign in Trine of the Moon, the Sun and Mars, these are strong testimonies in Art, that the Native should have a strong inclination to Travel, to see remote Countreys of the world; or at least to undertake some long Voyage to Sea, and probably, South-Eastward, because the Significators are located in that Quarter. Now Saturn being Lord of the ninth House in the Horoscope, and well dignified, argues the Native should not only be propense to Travel, but advantage himself thereby; which is seconded by the Moons Sextile to the Cusp of the ninth house. But in regard the Lord of the Ascendant is afflicted, and Saturn, Lord of the ninth is in Quartile to Venus, not beheld by Jupiter or the Moon, I shall not encourage the Native to adventure himself.
rules.translation: 九宫旅行判法（判例示范）：摩羯末度临9宫头（将出、当取水瓶）、土（9宫主）居升（其 Dispositor 独在升）、水星居动座三合日月火→旅兴强、欲观远邦或至少作海上长航、大抵东南向（征象星居该象限）；土为9宫主居升而强→旅行且能利己（月六合9宫头为助）；然命主受克、9宫主土四分金且不受木月之照→未可鼓励冒险远行（留本土可全避其害）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII SECT I-II；动机=好奇非求富

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 土9宫主居升且9宫无星→梦多应验涉阴秘怖事
rules.original_text: As to the Natives Dreams, finding Saturn Lord of the ninth House in the Ascendant strong and Angular, denotes the Natives Dreams should for the most part prove true; and probably, at sometimes somewhat terrible or frightful to the Native; for 'tis the opinion of Astrologers that if Saturn be Lord of the ninth House, (and more especially being located in the Ascendant and no Planets in the ninth) that then the Natives Dreams should be of Persons, or things Saturnine, and therefore many times produces fear and horrour, or affords Dreams of occult and hidden things, Visions, Apparitions, &c.
rules.translation: 九宫梦兆格言（Aphorism）：土星为9宫主、尤其居升点且9宫无星时——命主之梦多应验、且多为恐怖惊骇之梦、涉阴秘幽隐之事、幻视异象等（土星性之物）。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII SECT III；独立格言，判例盘验证

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 信仰坚定、兼善批判好科学
rules.original_text: the premises being considered, and also the Sun, the Dispositor of Mercury, both in Trine to the Moon, this argues that the Native should be of solid and sound Principles as to Faith and Religion in the General, though the position of Saturn, Ruler of the ninth House in the Ascendant in Gemini, doth naturally signifie the Native should also know how to be Crittical in some matters where he sees occasion, and have also an inclination to Science, yet he deviates not much from those Principles he has been educated in.
rules.translation: 九宫宗教判法（判例示范）：日（水星之 Dispositor）与月三合→信仰宗教之原则坚定纯正；土为9宫主居升双子→其人善择机批判、好科学；然不离其受教之本。
rules.notes: CHAP XVIII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 荣位可观、难至极、声名持久
rules.original_text: I consider that Saturn is Lord of the tenth, Angular and strong, Sol a general Significator of Honour and Dignity, is posited in Aries his Exaltation in the eleventh House, and there in exact Trine to the Moon; moreover the Part of Fortune is posited in the Mid-heaven, and the Moon in Sextile thereunto: these are Arguments that the Native should arrive to a considerable degree of Honour and Estimation in the world. But it cannot be expected that this Judgment should take place to the height thereof, in regard Saturn, Lord of the tenth, is within Orbs of a Quadrate of the Sun from the Ascendant and eleventh Houses; howbeit the major Testimonies demonstrate Honour, and a good Reputation in the general. What Honour is conferred upon the Native should be for the most part acquired by his own industry or deserts, because of the position of Saturn in the Horoscope; and in regard a fixed Signe (viz. Aquary) possesses the Cusp of the tenth House, it imports the Natives Honour and Renown should remain fixed and durable.
rules.translation: 十宫荣位判法（判例示范）：土为10宫主居角而强、日（荣位之通义征象）擢升11宫精确三合月、福点居天顶月六合之→荣位可观（就出身教养之质而言）；然土四分日（自升与11宫在容许内）→难至极峰；大体吉征居多→名誉良好；所获之荣多由己力（土居升）；水瓶（固定座）临10宫头→声名持久。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX SECT I-II；土四分日=限高

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 风象座+土居双子→商贸与金水之事
rules.original_text: As to the Natives Magestery and Profession; The Determination thereof is not easily performed; but in this Nativity, finding an Aiery Sign both upon the Mid heaven and Horoscope, and Saturn therein, and in particular in Gemini, the House of Mercury, this aptly denotes some kind of Merchandizing, and that the Native should delight to deal in such matters, or things that are both Venereal, and Mercurial; he was bred to a Gentile Profession, sutable to his Birth and Education, and is indeed capable of excellent things, being a person qualified both with an apt and pregnant Genius, and a notable working active Fancy, well signified by Saturn in Gemini in the Ascendant and Mercury his Dispositor in Conjunction with the Sun, and Mars in the AEquinoctial Signe Aries.
rules.translation: 十宫职业判法（判例示范）：天顶与升点俱风象座、土居其间（双子=水星之家）→商贸之属、好金银水星之事（Venereal and Mercurial）；其人受适其出身之文雅教育、才具甚优、颖悟敏给、想象活跃（土居双子升+水星 Dispositor 合日月火于白羊春分座为征）。
rules.notes: CHAP XIX SECT III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Considering the Constitution of the Scheme, and finding so many Planets in the House of Friendship, I conclude the Native should have many Friends and Acquaintance; and in regard the Moon doth behold those Planets by a Trine Aspect, 'tis an Argument they should (for the most part) be real; yet I conjecture the Native will be sensible of some that may prove meer Pretenders, only for their own particular ends, and to serve themselves, because Mercury is afflicted by Mars and the Sun, and Venus is in Quartile to Saturn.
rules.translation: 十一宫朋友判法（判例示范）：多星聚11宫（友谊之宫）→友多；月三合诸星→大体为真友；然水星受火日之克、金四分土→中有假友（仅为自利）。真友能久（命主颖悟善结之），假友之害不足损其福。
rules.notes: CHAP XX SECT I-II；四星聚11宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: As to the Natives Hopes. From a due consideration of the position of the Significators aforesaid, the Native should be sometimes crossed or thwarted therein, though not much to his prejudice, but generally reasonable Fortunate in most affairs he Hopes or Desires to accomplish; because the Moon, Lady of the second House, doth so friendly behold Mercury, and those other Planets in the eleventh House. Let the Native, if it be possible, gain the Nativities of those persons he has much Conversation withal, and compare his own therewith; and if he finds a convenient Harmony between them, it is a confirmation of true Friendship; if not, he ought to be the more wary how he trusts them: See Ptolomy's Centiloquium, Aphor. 33.
rules.translation: 十一宫希望判法（判例示范）：希望偶受挫而不大损、大体顺遂（月为2宫主吉照水星及11宫诸星）。验友法：尽可能取所交者之本命盘与己盘相较——相得则真友之证、不合则慎托之（参见 Ptolemy《Centiloquium》第33格言及十一宫总断诸格言）。
rules.notes: CHAP XX SECT III-IV；Ptolemy Centiloq. Aph.33

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: I find in the Nativity that Venus is Lady of the Twelfth House, and in Quartile to the Ascendant and to Saturn therein, which denotes the Native may have secret Enemies, such as are signified by Venus and the Moon also (who is in platique Trine to Venus) possibly they may be of the Female Sex, and such as would be accounted, or at least pretend themselves to be real Friends, because of the position of Venus in her own Dignities in the eleventh house. Yet Saturn being a Superiour Planet, and in the Ascendant, and in Quartile to Venus, shews the Native cannot be much injured by any such persons; it rather intimates he may by unpleasent carriage, or strangeness, give distaste or offence to some of his Female Friends, and in Revenge thereof they may become his private Enemies, but not sufficiently able to prejudice the Native thereby; for Saturn is the Afflicting Planet, and Venus was Passive, and suffer'd by the beams of Saturn darted upon her at Birth.
rules.translation: 十二宫暗敌判法（判例示范）：金为12宫主、四分升点与升内之土→有暗敌（金月之性所征者；月又成相金）——或为女性、且因金强居11宫而貌为真友者；然土（上星）居升、四分金→其害不能大伤命主；或为命主以冷淡疏远开罪女性友、彼等报复而为暗敌——土为克星、金为受克之被动者，故害微。
rules.notes: CHAP XXI SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: As to Captivity or Restraint. I conclude from the Premises, that the Native will never suffer thereby, yet he may I confess be sometimes oppressed with Melancholy, and discontented thoughts; and I fear too oft be subject thereunto, by reason of the presence of Saturn in the Ascendant in Quartile to Venus, Lady of the Twelfth, (which is the House of Sorrow). Lastly, from these Considerations it doth also follow, that the Native should be but reasonably Fortunate in Dealing in great Cattle.
rules.translation: 十二宫囚禁/畜养判法（判例示范）：无囚禁之虞；然土居升四分金（12宫主=忧患之宫）→常为忧郁不满之念所困。大牲畜（12宫所主）之交易仅中度之利（命主本无此好）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXI SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Anareta=土；暴死证弱化→晚年忧郁痰湿之疾
rules.original_text: Now the Planet that in this Scheme appears to be the Abcissor, or Destroyer of Life, is Saturn in the Horoscope, Lord of the eighth House; and when the giver of Life, or Hylech meets with the Body of the Killing Planet in this Figure, is the most dangerous time. The Sun is Hylech, and about the sixtieth Year of the Natives Age meets with the Body of Saturn by Direction according to Naibods Measure of Time (being Directed in the Aequator according to the usual Method,) yet the Native may labour some Years under the effects thereof before he change this Life for a better. As to the kind of Death... considering the Sun is Hylech, and Lord of the fourth, and in Conjunction with Mercury Lord of the Ascendant in Aries a violent Sign, within the Orbs of a Square of Saturn in the Ascendant; and Capricorn, another violent Sign, descends upon the Cusp of the eighth: I say, these are Arguments that the Native may be in great danger of a violent Death... But on the other side (although the Moon be in a violent Sign) she beholds Mercury, the Sun, and Mars by Trine Aspect; also Venus, and Jupiter (both the Fortunes) are in Sextile to the Cusp of the eighth house, and no violent fixed Star posited therein; and therefore I conclude the Native may expire rather by some Disease proceeding either from Melancholy, or from Phlegm, and moyst humours too much abounding; but at a considerable Age.
rules.translation: 八宫死亡判法（判例示范，判例盘封顶之断）：①Anareta（夺命星）=土星（8宫主居升）；Hyleg（日）方向遇夺命星之体=最险之时——日约六十岁按 Naibod 度量方向至土星体（赤道法），其效或先发数年。②死法：暴死诸证——日（Hyleg、4宫主）合水星（升主）于白羊（凶暴之座）、在土星（居升）四分之容许内、摩羯（又一凶暴座）临8宫头→大险于暴死；反证——月（虽居凶暴座）三合水/日/火、金木（两吉星）六合8宫头、8宫无凶暴恒星→终断：晚年死于忧郁或痰湿之疾（年齿颇高）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVII(1) SECT 1-3；Naibod 度量约60岁为最险时；暴死诸证与吉照8宫头权衡

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To find the first Arch. As Radius is to the Tangent of the Latitude, so is the Sine of the distance of the Planets place from the next AEquinoctial point, to the Tangent of the first Arch.
rules.translation: 第一弧求法（带纬度求赤纬赤经·第一步）：半径:纬度正切 = 距近春分点黄经之正弦:第一弧正切——即 tan(第一弧)=sin(黄经距春分点)×cot(纬度)。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVI Prop.1；判例盘以木星黄经天蝎26°39'23"、南纬1°21'26"为例：距春分点30°、第一弧29°18'

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 同侧减/异侧加23°30'，超象限取补角
rules.original_text: If the Latitude, and Longitude of the Planet be of the same denomination, viz. either both North, or both South, then Substract 23 deg. 30 min. from the first Arch, and the Remainder is the second Arch. But if the Latitude and Longitude be of contrary denominations, then add 23 deg. 30 min. to the first Arch, and the Sum is the second Arch; but if the second Arch exceeds a Quadrant, the Arch it self is not to be taken, but the Complement thereof to a Semicircle.
rules.translation: 第二弧求法：黄纬与黄经（距春分点之方向）同侧（俱北或俱南）→第二弧=第一弧−23°30′；异侧→第二弧=第一弧+23°30′；若第二弧超象限（>90°）则取其对 180° 之补角（非其本身）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVI Prop.3；例：木星南纬与南黄经同侧→29°18'−23°30'=5°48'第二弧

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To find the Declination. As Radius is to the Co-sine of the second Arch, so is the Co-sine of the first Arch to the Sine of the Declination: That is, multiply the Sine of the Latitude by the Co-sines of the first and second Arches, the Product is the Sine of the Declination.
rules.translation: 赤纬求法：sin(赤纬)=cos(第一弧)×cos(第二弧)×sin(纬度)（即以半径:第二弧余弦 = 第一弧余弦:赤纬正弦之比例式）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVI Prop.4；例：木星 sin=cos29°18'×cos5°48'×sin1°21'26"→赤纬南2°6'21"（log 运算）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: tan(赤经)=sin(1弧)×sin(2弧)×tan(黄经)，按象限调
rules.original_text: To find the Right Ascention. As Radius is to the Tangent of the Longitude from the next AEquinoctial point, so is the Sine of the second Arch to the Tangent of the Right Ascention: But you must consider the Quadrant wherein the Planets place falls, and accordingly add or Substract 180, or 360 degrees, as the case requires.
rules.translation: 赤经求法：tan(赤经)=sin(第一弧)×sin(第二弧)×tan(黄经距春分点)；须按行星所在象限加或减 180°/360° 以定真赤经。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVI Prop.5；例：木星赤经 232°50'25"（天蝎=210°+22°50'25"）；象限调整规则：距春分点之弧位于星之黄经象限内时按其加

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Planet have no Latitude, then find his Declination by this Proportion; As Radius to the Sine of the Longitude from the next AEquinoctial point, so is the Sine of the greatest Declination 23d. 30m. to the Sine of the Declination. And for the Right Ascention; As Radius to the Co-sine of the greatest Declination 23d. 30m. so is the Tangent of the Longitude from the AEquinoctial to the Tangent of the Right Ascention.
rules.translation: 无纬度简法（Prop 2）：sin(赤纬)=sin(黄经距春分点)×sin(23°30′)；tan(赤经)=tan(黄经距春分点)×cos(23°30′)（不必求第一/第二弧）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVI Prop.2；适用于黄道点（福点/宫头等无纬点）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To find the Distance of any Planet from the Meridian. The Right Ascention of the Planet being known, and likewise the Right Ascention of the Meridian (which is either that of the tenth, or fourth House, according as the Planet is above, or under the Earth) the difference of their Right Ascentions is the Distance of the Planet from the Meridian.
rules.translation: 行星距子午线之赤经距离：行星赤经与子午线赤经（星在地平上取10宫 R.A.、地平下取4宫 R.A.）之差。判例示范：木星 R.A.232°50′ − MC R.A.215°17′ = 17°33′（地平上、东侧）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVII Prop.5（19412 起）；星在角宫东侧=MC 之赤经距

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: cos(4弧)=cos(距子午线)×cos(纬)；4弧±赤纬=5弧
rules.original_text: To find the Poles Elevation above the Circle of Position of any Star or Planet. First find the Stars distance from the Meridian, as before taught; then make two Operations; as first, As Radius to the Co-sine of the Stars distance from the Meridian, so is the Co-sine of the Latitude to the fourth Arch. Secondly, From this fourth Arch Substract the Sine of the Stars Declination, and the Remainder is the Sine of the fifth Arch, if the Star hath North Declination; but if South, add the Sine of the Declination to the fourth Arch, and the Sum is the Sine of the fifth Arch.
rules.translation: 位置圈极求法·第一运算（Prop VI）：①求星距子午线之赤经距离；②第一运算——cos(星距子午线赤经):cos(纬度) = 半径:第四弧（即 cos(第四弧)=cos(距子午线)×cos(纬度)）；③第四弧 ± 星之赤纬正弦——北纬则减、南纬则加→得第五弧正弦。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVII Prop.6 第一运算；判例示范：木星 4弧47°33'+南纬正弦=5弧49°35'

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Then for the second Operation, As the Sine of the fifth Arch is to the Sine of the Stars distance from the Meridian, so is the Co-tangent of the Latitude to the Tangent of the Pole above the Circle of Position.
rules.translation: 位置圈极求法·第二运算：sin(第五弧):sin(距子午线) = cot(纬度):tan(位置圈极)——tan(位置圈极)=sin(距子午线)×cot(纬度)÷sin(第五弧)。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVII Prop.6 第二运算；判例示范：木星位置圈极 54°22'（因在11宫近天顶甚高）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: sin(升差)=tan(圈极)×tan(赤纬)；斜升=赤经∓升差
rules.original_text: [The Oblique Ascention under the Pole of Position is then found by the ordinary Rule; viz. As Radius to the Tangent of the Poles Elevation above the Circle of Position, so is the Tangent of the Declination to the Sine of the Ascensional Difference; which Ascensional Difference Substracted from, or added to the Right Ascention (in Northern Latitudes Substract, in Southern add) gives the Oblique Ascention sought.]
rules.translation: 位置圈极下之斜升求法：sin(升差)=tan(圈极)×tan(赤纬)；北纬斜升=赤经−升差、南纬斜升=赤经+升差；星在地平下（4-9宫）时以斜降（赤经+升差）代之。
rules.notes: CHAP XXVII 附；此为方向法求升点 Significator 斜升之基础

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [The Proportion of a Direction in the AEquator being thus obtained, the Ark of Direction is reduced to Years, Dayes, &c. by the Measure of Time described in CHAP. XXV; and the AEquation of the Direction (whether by Latitude, or by the Equation of Time) is alwayes to be added to the Ark of Direction, as in the Examples following.]
rules.translation: 方向弧归年总则：赤道方向弧按 CHAP XXV 之时间度量（Naibod 平运动法）归为年日；方向之归算（纬度归算或时间均差归算）恒加于方向弧（判例三例皆然：加29'-32'）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 前承 CHAP XXV；三例归算见映射P

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Equation 加于Sig赤经或减于Prom赤经
rules.original_text: I. Rule. If both Significator, and Promissor have North Latitude, then the difference of their Ascensional Differences, or the AEquation, is to be added to the Right Ascention of the Significator, or Substracted from the Right Ascention of the Promissor: the Sum or Remainder is the Right Ascention sought.
rules.translation: 升差差数归算法则·规则一（双北纬）：取两星升差之差为 Equation（归算数），加于 Significator 之赤经、或减于 Promissor 之赤经——所得即所求赤经（用于方向弧换算）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 五规则之一；Equation=两星升差之较

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Equation 减于Sig赤经或加于Prom赤经
rules.original_text: II. Rule. If both have South Latitude, then the AEquation is to be Substracted from the Right Ascention of the Significator, or added to the Right Ascention of the Promissor.
rules.translation: 升差差数归算法则·规则二（双南纬）：Equation 减于 Significator 之赤经、或加于 Promissor 之赤经。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 五规则之二

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: III. Rule. If the Significator have North Latitude, and the Promissor South, then the Sum of their Ascensional Differences is the AEquation, which is to be added to the Right Ascention of the Promissor.
rules.translation: 升差差数归算法则·规则三（Sig 北纬、Prom 南纬）：取两星升差之和为 Equation，加于 Promissor 之赤经。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 五规则之三

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: IV. Rule. If the Significator have South Latitude, and the Promissor North, then as in the 4th. Rule is the AEquation to be taken, and added to the Right Ascention of the Significator.
rules.translation: 升差差数归算法则·规则四（Sig 南纬、Prom 北纬）：按第四法（升差之和）取 Equation，加于 Significator 之赤经。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 五规则之四；原文 '4th Rule' 疑为 '3d Rule' 之笔误，按升差和取

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 地平下斜降方向时全程反号
rules.original_text: V. Rule (Caveat.) But here observe, that if the Significator be under the Earth, and you Direct the Ascendant by the Oblique Descention, that then the aforesaid Operations are to be performed by Contrary denominations.
rules.translation: 升差差数归算法则·规则五（告诫）：若 Significator 在地平之下、以斜降方向升点时，上述诸运算须全部以相反之符号进行（加变减、减变加）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 五规则之五

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [This Method by the Ascensional Difference being thus regular and universal, may serve to Verify the Common Method of Directing (by Oblique Ascentions) and is by the Author commended to practice; the difference in the two ways seldome exceeding a few minutes.]
rules.translation: 三角归算法之用途：此法正则而普遍，可互验常用之方向法（斜升法）——两法之差鲜超数分；术者（Coley）荐以此法为常用法之校验（尤其在方向弧接近角宫或星近天顶、升差差数显著之时）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 引言及五规则后；作者自注此法为方向法之正确原理

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 1. The Direction of the Ascendant to the dext. Trine of Venus. The Oblique Ascention of the Ascendant 63°13'. The Promissor, the dext. Trine of Venus, being 19°35' of Virgo, by the 5th Rule of this Chap. whose Oblique Ascention (with half her Latitude 1°40' South) is found 123°26'. The difference is the Arch of Direction 60°13', to which add the AEquation (per Table p.641) 29', and the Sum is 60°42' the Ark reduced = 60 Years 42/60...]
rules.translation: 方向法三角·例一（升点→金之右三合）：升点斜升63°13′；Promissor=处女19°35′（金星之右三合点），按其纬度南1°40′取半纬归算，斜升123°26′；方向弧=60°13′，加归算29′（p641表）=60°42′=60年。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 例一；半纬取用（三合反号半纬，卷A CP3-395）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 2. The Direction of the Mid-Heaven to the Conjunction of Venus. The R.A. of the MC being 215°17', and the R.A. of Venus 250°25'; the difference 35°8' is the Arch of Direction, to which add the Equation 31', and the Sum 35°39' = 35 Years 39/60, i.e. 35 Years 237 dayes; answering to the beginning of November 1685.]
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 例二；赤经方向法（卷A CP3-396）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 3. The Direction of the Sun to the Opposition of the Moon. The Suns R.A. 37°19', the Opposition of the Moon R.A. 73°54'; the difference 36°35' is the Ark, add the Equation 32', the Sum 37°7' = 37 Years 7/60, i.e. 37 Years 42 dayes, answering to April 23. 1687.]
rules.notes: CHAP XXIX 例三；三例归算皆按 p641 之 AEquation 表（卷A 映射J 时间度量三法之一）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 以太阳周年/周日运动推方向
rules.original_text: I have here in this thirtyth Chapter, resolved to deliver the Method of Directing made use of by that most famous Astronomer John Keplerus, by him stiled Sportula Genethliacis Missa, wherein he doth perform Directions by the Annual, and Diurnal Motion of the Sun, as being most true, and rational, and the most certain way of all others; and which (as I said before) is preferred before all others, by Mr. John Eyres, in his most Learned, and Ingenious Epistle to his Forein Friend.
rules.translation: 开普勒方向法（《Sportula Genethliacis Missa》）总纲：以太阳之周年与周日运动行方向——开普勒称其最真最理、为诸法中最确；Mr. John Eyres 于其致外邦友人书中亦推此法为首。其原理：方向以日之周年周转成岁、以周日周转成日；此即'自然日=一年'之度量。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 引言；卷A CP3-390 已引此法

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: To Rectifie the Nativity according to this Method... the difference between the true place of the Sun at the time of the Nativity, and the place of the Sun by the Tables, at the same time, being known, the same difference is to be added, or Substracted... [Table] The Suns Diurnal Motion from the 60th to the 70th day after Birth.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·校正（事故校正法）：以生后第60至70日间太阳之日行表为据——知生时太阳之真位（由事件校正得之）与表算太阳位之差，依比例加减；表列生后60-70日逐日太阳日行（度分），以年数当日数推太阳位，余日出按比例加分。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT II；表以整点列太阳黄道日行（如 23日=0°59'42"、60日=0°54'20"等）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom斜升+270°−本命日斜升=正午时值
rules.original_text: [Example of Rectification by the Ascendant.] The Oblique Ascention of the Promittor (in this Method the Suns place in the Ecliptick is to be used) being found, add 270 degrees to it, from which Sum Substract the Oblique Ascention of the Radix Sun (or its Right Ascention taken at Noon) and the Remainder is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the time of the Nativity sought; which being found, the time of the Nativity is known by proportion...
rules.translation: 开普勒法·校正例一（以升点为据）：Promittor（此法中以太阳之黄道位置为 Promittor）之斜升 + 270° − 本命太阳之斜升（或其正午赤经）= 所求正午起算之太阳赤经（Radix 正午赤经时值）；由此按比例得命时。判例示范：Prom 斜升（金星合）约 47°28′ + 270° − 124°34′ = 193°34′ ≈ 12h54′16″ PM。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT III 例一；所得 R.A.193°34'≈12h54'16" PM

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom R.A.−本命日R.A.=正午时值（不可减加360°）
rules.original_text: [Example of Rectification by the Mid-heaven.] Substract the Right Ascention of the Radix Sun from the Right Ascention of the Promittor, and the Remainder (adding a whole Circle if it cannot be Substracted) is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the time of the Nativity, by which the time of Birth is known.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·校正例二（以天顶为据）：Promittor 之赤经 − 本命太阳之赤经（不可减则加一周圈）= 正午起算之太阳赤经时值；由此按比例得命时。判例示范：金星 R.A.250°25′ − 56°51′ = 193°34′——与例一（以升点法）互验一致，两法俱得 12h54′16″ PM。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT III 例二；与例一互验

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 日位−月位=日月距；Prom−距=升黄经→斜升+270−本命R.A.
rules.original_text: [Example of Rectification by the Part of Fortune.] Substract the Moons place from the Suns, and the Remainder is the distance of the Luminaries; Substract the said distance from the Promittor (viz. the true place of the Sun by the Tables) and the Remainder is the Longitude of the Ascendant for the time of the Nativity; whose Oblique Ascention (at the Latitude of Birth) add 270 degrees, and from the Sum Substract the R.A. of the Radix Sun, and the Remainder is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the time of the Nativity, as before.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·校正例三（以福点为据）：日位−月位=日月距；Promittor（表算太阳真位）−日月距=命时升点之黄经；于出生地纬度取其斜升 + 270° − 本命太阳赤经 = 正午时值。判例示范：⊕校正得 193°34′——与例一/例二互验一致。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT III 例三；三校正法互验得同一正午时值

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom斜升+270°−正午时值=方向日R.A.→年日
rules.original_text: [The time being thus rectified, the Direction of the Ascendant to any Promittor is thus performed.] Find the Oblique Ascention of the Promittor, to which add 270 degrees, and from the Sum Substract the Right Ascention of the Sun at Noon (the Radix AEquation, or noon-time value) and the Remainder is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the day of the Direction; by which R.A. find the Suns true place by the Tables, which reduced to years by the Diurnal Motion of the Sun, gives the time of the Direction.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·升点方向规则：Promittor 之斜升 + 270° − 正午时值（Radix 正午赤经时值）= 方向日之太阳赤经；查表得太阳真位、按太阳日行归为年日=方向之期。判例：升点→金星之合 = 24年162日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 规则一；例见 CP3-713

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom R.A.−正午时值=方向日R.A.→年日
rules.original_text: [The Direction of the Mid-heaven.] Substract the Right Ascention of the Sun at Noon from the Right Ascention of the Promittor, and the Remainder is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the day of the Direction; which found, the Suns true place and the time of the Direction are known, as before.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·天顶方向规则：Promittor 之赤经 − 正午时值 = 方向日之太阳赤经；查太阳真位→按日行归年日。判例：MC→月之四分 = 17年144日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 规则二；例见 CP3-714

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom−日月距=升黄经→斜升+270−正午时值=方向R.A.
rules.original_text: [The Direction of the Part of Fortune.] Substract the Moons place from the Suns, and the Remainder is the distance of the Luminaries; Substract the said distance from the Promittor, and the Remainder is the Longitude of the Ascendant for the day of the Direction; whose Oblique Ascention (at the Latitude of Birth) add 270 degrees, from which Sum Substract the R.A. of the Sun at Noon, and the Remainder is the Right Ascention of the Sun for the day of the Direction, as before.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·福点方向规则：日位−月位=日月距；Promittor 真黄经 − 日月距 = 升方向之黄经；于出生地纬取其斜升 + 270° = MC 带圈方向赤经，再减正午时值 = 方向日太阳赤经→年日。判例：⊕→火之四分 = 27年323日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 规则三；例见 CP3-715

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 查太阳至Prom黄经之日=方向期（超量加减）
rules.original_text: [The Direction of the Sun to any Promittor.] The time of the Direction is known from the Ephemerides, or Tables, in which is set down the Suns true place for every day; viz. by finding the day in which the Sun arrives at the Longitude of the Promittor; but with this caution, that if the Suns place at Noon exceed the Radix place, the excess is to be added to the Direction, if it be less, Substracted.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·太阳方向规则：于星历/日行表中查太阳到达 Promittor 黄经之日即方向之期；注意：正午太阳位超本命日位时其超量加于方向、不足则减（校正时反之——校正时以本命真位为据）。判例：日→木之四分 = 12年213日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 规则四；例见 CP3-716

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Prom黄经−本命星位=方向弧；+本命日位=方向日太阳位→年日
rules.original_text: [The Direction of the Moon, or any of the Planets.] Substract the Longitude of the Planet in the Radix from the Longitude of the Promittor, and the Remainder is the Arch of Direction; to which add the Longitude of the Sun in the Radix, and the Sum is the true place of the Sun for the day of the Direction; which by the Tables, or Ephemerides, and the Diurnal Motion of the Sun, gives the time of the Direction.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·月亮与五星方向规则：Promittor 黄经 − 本命星位 = 方向弧；方向弧 + 本命日位 = 方向日之太阳真位；查表/星历并按日行比例得年日。判例：月→金之冲 = 15年18日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 规则五；例见 CP3-717

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 方向加超量、校正减超量
rules.original_text: [The general Caveat.] If the place of the Sun at Noon of the Direction-day exceed the place of the Sun in the Radix, the excess is to be added to the Arch of Direction; if it be less, Substracted: but in Rectification it is contrary; for there the time being rectified by the true place, whatever excess is found above the Radix, the same is to be Substracted, &c.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·超量加减总则：方向中日午之太阳位超本命日位→其超量加于方向弧；不足则减。校正时反之——校正以真位为据，凡超本命之量减之。此总则贯通升/MC/⊕/日月诸方向与三校正。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT IV 附则

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 4. The Direction of the Ascendant to the Conjunction of Venus.] The Oblique Ascention of the Ascendant (i.e. the Promittor Venus in Conjunction with the Ascendant) 47°28', add 270° = 317°28', Substract the R.A. of the Sun at Noon 193°34', the Remainder 123°54' is the R.A. of the Sun for the day of the Direction; in the Tables I find the Sun in 15°38' of Leo the 24th day after Birth 162 dayes; so that this Direction shews the 24th Year, 162 dayes.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·例四（升点→金之合）：Prom 斜升（金星合升点）47°28′ + 270° = 317°28′ − 正午时值193°34′ = 123°54′（方向日太阳赤经）；表查太阳至狮子15°38′ 乃生后24年162日——方向之期=24年162日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例四；升点方向规则之实例

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 5. The Direction of the Mid-heaven to the Quadrat of the Moon.] The R.A. of the Promittor (viz. the Quadrat of the Moon 19° of Taurus) 47°49', Substract the R.A. of the Sun at Noon 193°34', not Substractable; add a whole Circle 360° to the R.A. of the Promittor, and the Sum 407°49', Substract 193°34', the Remainder 214°15' is the R.A. of the Sun for the day of the Direction, answering to 17 Years 144 dayes.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·例五（天顶→月之四分）：Promittor（月之四分点=金牛19°）赤经47°49′，减正午时值193°34′不可减→加一整圈360°=407°49′，减193°34′=214°15′（方向日太阳赤经）→17年144日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例五；MC 方向规则之实例；不可减时加360°

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 6. The Direction of the Part of Fortune to the Quadrat of Mars.] The distance of the Luminaries 89°53' (viz. the Suns place 23° Aries Substract the Moons place 23° Capricorn... but because the Moons place exceeds the Suns, add a Circle) Substract from the Promittor (viz. the true place of Mars 5° Aquary) 5° Aquary Substract 89°53' not Substractable, add 360°, the Sum 365° Substract 89°53' = 275°7' the Longitude of the Ascendant for the day of the Direction; whose Oblique Ascention at the Latitude of Birth 52°18' is 319°27', add 270° = 589°27', Substract 360° = 229°27', Substract the R.A. of the Sun at Noon 193°34', the Remainder 35°53' is the R.A. of the Sun for the day of the Direction, which by proportion gives 27 Years 323 dayes.
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例六；⊕方向规则之实例；多步含加圈运算

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 7. The Direction of the Sun to the Quadrat of Jupiter.] The Suns place at the day of the Direction is to be sought in the Ephemerides, or Tables of the Suns true motion, and the day in which he arrives at 17°55' of Aquary (the Quadrat of Jupiter) is the time of the Direction; which I find to be the 213th day after the 12th Year, answering to 12 Years 213 dayes.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·例七（日→木之四分）：于星历/日行表中查太阳到达水瓶17°55′（木之四分点）之日=方向之期——生后12年213日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例七；日方向规则之实例（直接查表法）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 8. The Direction of the Moon to the Opposition of Venus.] The Longitude of the Moon in the Radix 26°54' of Sagitary Substracted from the Longitude of the Promittor (viz. the Opposition of Venus 6°30' of Virgo, adding 12 Signs) the Remainder is 9 Signs 9°36' = 279°36' the Arch of Direction; to which add the Longitude of the Sun in the Radix 23°23' Aries, the Sum is 302°59' the true place of the Sun for the day of the Direction, which by the Tables, and the Diurnal Motion, gives 15 Years 18 dayes.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·例八（月→金之冲）：本命月位（人马26°54′）自 Promittor（金之冲=处女6°30′，加12宫）减之=9宫9°36′=279°36′（方向弧）；+本命日位（白羊23°23′）=302°59′（方向日太阳真位）；查表按日行归算→15年18日。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例八；月五星方向规则之实例

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Example 9. The Direction of the Ascendant, M.C. Part of Fortune, &c. for the 27th Year.] To find what Directions are in force at any Year proposed; as for the 27th Year, Substract the R.A. of the Sun at Noon 193°34' from the Oblique Ascention of the Promittor (27 Years = 27 dayes after Birth, viz. the Sun in 17°55' Aquary, whose O.A. 331°46') add 270°, the Sum is 601°46', Substract 360° = 241°46', Substract 193°34' = 48°12' the R.A. of the Sun for the Direction; the Sun in 27° of Pisces; so the Direction of the Ascendant falls upon the Sun, &c.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·例九（求任意年第27年之方向）：年数当日数——27年=生后27日，表查太阳至水瓶17°55′（斜升331°46′）+ 270° = 601°46′ − 360° = 241°46′ − 正午时值193°34′ = 48°12′（方向日太阳赤经）→太阳至双鱼27°；升点之方向正落于太阳（即升→日之合）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 例九；逆算法（由年求方向）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [The Manner of the Work by the following Schemes.] The Directions being thus performed, the Author shews how to dispose the whole work in Tables of Six, Seven, Three, and Five Columns; viz. for the Ascendant six Columns (Year, Day, the Ark, the Promittor, the Suns R.A., the Suns true place); for the M.C. six Columns (Year, Day, the Ark, the Promittor, the Suns R.A., the Suns place); for the Part of Fortune seven Columns (adding the Longitude of the Ascendant); for the Sun three Columns (Year, Day, Ark); for the Moon and Planets five Columns (Year, Day, the Suns place, the Ark, the Promittor); by which the whole Life of the Native may be computed, and the Directions of every Year surveyed at pleasure.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·作业表格式（Speculum 化）：升点六栏（年/日/弧/Promittor/日赤经/日真位）、天顶六栏（同）、福点七栏（增升点黄经一栏）、太阳三栏（年/日/弧）、月与五星五栏（年/日/日位/弧/Promittor）——由此可推命主一生诸方向、任意年份之方向一览无余。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX SECT V-VI；判例示范表（1650 盘）即按此格式

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 升/MC走赤道、日月星走黄道；意义同通行法
rules.original_text: [The Conclusion of Keplers Method.] And here (according to Mr. John Eyres) you may observe that the Ascendant, and M.C. are directed in the AEquator, and the Sun, Moon, and Planets in the Ecliptick; the Directions of the Ascendant and M.C. being reduced from the AEquator to the Ecliptick, the same may be compared with those of the Luminaries; and 'tis certain that whatsoever Directions are made by the Motions of the Stars, they are such, and of that signification, as the Significators and Promittors in the Geniture do declare, as well in this as in the common Method.
rules.translation: 开普勒法·结论：升点与天顶在赤道上推方向，日月五星在黄道上推方向；升/MC 之方向弧可由赤道归算至黄道而与日月诸方向相较。凡由星动所作之方向，其义皆随 Significators 与 Promittors 在本命盘中所征之事——与通行法无异。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 末；Eyres 之评语

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 异仅在时间度量：日周年运动=年
rules.original_text: [Kepler's Method compared with the common Method.] The difference between this Method and the common one consists in the Measure of Time only: For the common Method measures the Ark of Direction by the Naibod, or Ptolemy Measure in the AEquator; but this by the Annual Motion of the Sun in the Ecliptick, reducing every natural day to a Year. The Directions themselves, Significators, and Promittors are the same in both; only the time when the effect happens may differ, and this last is judged the more exact by its Author and followers.
rules.translation: 开普勒法与传统法之比较：二法之异惟在时间度量——传统法于赤道上以 Naibod/Ptolemy 度量方向弧；此法以太阳在黄道之周年运动为度量、自然日=一年。方向本身、Significators 与 Promittors 两法相同，惟效验之时或异；其作者与从者以为此法更确。
rules.notes: CHAP XXX 末总评；与卷A CP3-406/408（Naibod/视赤经度量）对照

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 太阳回本命位之天图=年返照
rules.original_text: The Revolution of the Year is that Figure of the Heavens, which the Sun returning to his Radical place, at the same Latitude, doth at that moment constitute; which being diligently examined, and compared with the Nativity, affordeth a true, and rational method of judging of the Fortune, or Misfortune of the Year.
rules.translation: 太阳返照（Revolution of the Year）定义：太阳回归其本命之位（同纬度）时所成之天图；以之与本命盘详较，为断一年祸福之真而理的方法。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI 引言

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The true time of the Revolution is exactly found by Astronomical Tables... Substract the place of the Sun in the Radix from the place of the Sun in the Table for the same time (adding 12 Signs if need be) and the difference is the Anomaly; with which enter the Table of Revolutions, and you have the number of Hours and Minutes to be added to the time of the Nativity (if the Anomaly be less than six Signs) or Substracted (if greater) by which the true time of the Revolution is known.
rules.translation: 返照时间求法：以天文表求之——本命太阳位自同时之表算太阳位减之（不足则加12宫）得 Anomaly（距正位之弧）；以 Anomaly 入 Revolutional Table 得时分数——Anomaly 小于6宫则加于生时、大于6宫则减——即得返照真时刻。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT I；闰年时须自本命日前后推（闰年表）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [The Example.] For the 29th Year of the Native, viz. Anno 1678. I find the Suns place in the Tables for March 11. at Noon, 22°4'34" of Pisces; the Radix Sun 23°23' Aries; Substract the Radix from the Tables place (adding 12 Signs) the Anomaly is 11 Signs 28°41'34", greater than six Signs, therefore Substract from the time of the Nativity (21h 5m 8s) the Hours and Minutes found in the Table for that Anomaly, viz. 5h 8m 18s, and the Remainder 15h 56m 50s is the true time of the Revolution for the 29th Year of the Native, viz. March 11. 1678. at 15h 56m 50s afternoon.
rules.translation: 返照时间算例（判例盘第29年=1678年）：1678-3-11 正午表算太阳双鱼22°4′34″ − 本命日白羊23°23′（加12宫）= Anomaly 11宫28°41′34″（大于6宫故减）；查表得 5h8m18s，自生时（21h5m8s）减之=15h56m50s——即第29年返照时刻（1678-03-11 下午3时56分50秒）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT I 例；Anomaly>6宫故减

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照本命征象=吉年、恶照=凶年
rules.original_text: The Judgment of the Revolution is performed by comparing the same with the Nativity; the general way is this; if the principal Significators of the Revolution (viz. the Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution, the Lord of the second, the Luminaries, the Part of Fortune, &c.) are in good Aspects to the Significators of the Nativity, or posited in good places of the Figure, it denotes a good Year; but if in evil Aspects, or bad places, the contrary.
rules.translation: 返照判断总则：以返照与本命相较——返照之主征（返照升主、2宫主、日月、福点等）吉照本命之 Significators、或居图之吉位→吉年；恶照或居凶位→凶年。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 1. The Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution, being in good Aspect to the Lord of the second House of the Radix, or the Part of Fortune of the same, denotes gain, and profit to the Native by his own industry, or pains in his Calling, or Employment.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言一：返照升主吉照本命2宫主或本命福点→命主以己之勤业/职任获利。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言一

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 2. If the Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution be afflicted by the Lord of the eighth, or twelfth Houses, or by Saturn, or Mars, in the eighth, or twelfth of the Revolution, it denotes loss, detriment, or prejudice to the Native that Year, by such persons, or things, as are signified by the afflicting Planets.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言二：返照升主受返照8/12宫主、或土/火居返照8/12宫之克→当年受损（损于克星所征之人/事）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言二

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 3. If the Lord of the Ascendant of the Radix be strong, and posited in good places of the Revolution, and in good Aspects to the good Planets of the same, it denotes health, and prosperity to the Native that Year, with joy, and comfort in his undertakings.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言三：本命升主强、居返照之吉位且吉照返照吉星→当年健康亨通、行事喜乐。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言三

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 4. If the Lord of the second House of the Revolution be posited in the Ascendant of the Revolution, or in the place of the Part of Fortune of the Radix, or in good Aspects to the Significators of the second, it denotes increase of Estate, and profit by Merchandizing, or Trade that Year.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言四：返照2宫主居返照升点、或居本命福点之位、或吉照2宫之征象→当年财增、商贸得利。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言四

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 5. If the Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution be afflicted by Combustion, or Conjunction of the Sun, or by the evil Aspects of Saturn, or Mars, it denotes detriment, loss, or prejudice to the Native that Year, unless the said Lord be essentially dignified, and then he may bear the greater part of the affliction.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言五：返照升主受灼、或合日、或受土火恶照→当年受损；然若其本然受尊则可御大部分之害。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言五

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 6. If the Luminaries be afflicted in the Revolution, it denotes prejudice to the Parents of the Native that Year, the Sun denoting the Father, the Moon the Mother; and more especially if the affliction be from the Lord of the eighth, or twelfth Houses, or by the Infortunes.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言六：返照中日月受克→当年父母受损（日征父、月征母），尤以受8/12宫主或双凶之克为甚。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言六

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 7. If the Luminaries be Eclipsed in the Revolution, in any of the Cardinal, or Angles of the same, and more especially in the Ascendant, it denotes great danger, and misfortune to the Native that Year.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言七：日月蚀于返照之角宫（尤升点）→当年大险大祸。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言七

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 8. If the Sun in the Revolution be in Quadrate, or Opposition to the Lord of the Ascendant of the Radix, it denotes trouble, and disturbance to the Native that Year, by the Father, or some person in Authority over him.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言八：返照日四分/冲本命升主→当年多扰（自父或权贵之人）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言八

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 凶合返照MC=坠落/损誉/当权之害
rules.original_text: 9. If the Infortunes be Conjoined with the Mid-heaven of the Revolution, it denotes danger of falling, or hurt from some eminent place, or from the displeasure of some persons in Authority; if Saturn, loss of Reputation, or prejudice by the Father, or some aged person; if Mars, by fire, or the Sword, or by the displeasure of some person in power, &c.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言九：双凶合返照天顶→自高处坠落/跌伤之险、或权贵不悦之害；土=损誉、损于父或长者；火=火/刀剑之害、或当权者之怒。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言九

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: 10. If the Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution be posited in the eighth House of the Revolution, and afflicted by the Lord of the eighth, or by the Infortunes, without the friendly Aspects of the Beneficks, it threatens death, or great danger to the Native that Year; the same also if the Moon be Conjoined with Saturn, and Saturn in Aspect to the Ascendant of the Revolution.
rules.translation: 返照判断格言十：返照升主居返照8宫、受8宫主或双凶之克、且无吉星吉照→当年死险或大危；返照月合土、土照返照升点者同论。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT II 格言十

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [The Judgment of the Example Revolution.] The Ascendant of the Revolution is Virgo, the Lord thereof Mercury, who is in the seventh House of the Revolution, and in good Aspect to the Sun, Jupiter, and Venus, the Significators of the Radix... The Lord of the second of the Revolution is Saturn, posited in the second House of the Revolution, in Trine to the Moon of the Radix... I judge the Native should receive profit, and advantage by Merchandizing, or Trade, or by his own industry in his Calling that Year; yet the profits will not be so considerable, in regard the Lord of the second is an Infortunate...
rules.translation: 返照判断判例（第29年返照）：返照升处女、命主水星居返照7宫、吉照本命征象日/木/金→当年顺遂；返照2宫主土居返照2宫、三合本命月→当年由商贸/己业得利，然利非甚巨（2宫主为凶星之故）；返照升主水星居7宫吉照诸吉→婚事/合伙之事顺遂（当月土相）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXI SECT III 判例（1678 年第29年返照）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 返照MC/升→本命Promittor；两返照=一年
rules.original_text: [The Directions of the Revolution, viz. of the M.C. and Ascendant of the Revolution to the Promittors in the Nativity.] The Method of Directing the Revolution is the same with that of the Nativity; viz. Direct the M.C. and Ascendant of the Revolution to the Promittors in the Nativity, but with this difference, that the Revolution, or the space of a Year is the Measure of Time; for as the Ascendant of the Nativity is directed to its Promittors by the space of a Year, so the Ascendant of the Revolution to the Promittors of the same, and the time of the Direction is to be computed from the Revolution to the next Revolution of the same Ascendant... two Revolutions answering to one Year.
rules.translation: 返照方向法：返照之天顶与升点方向至本命之 Promittors——方法与本命方向相同，惟时间度量以返照（一年）为单位：本命升点以一年空间方向，返照升点亦然，其方向之期自本返照至下一年同升点返照计之（两次返照=一年）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 不计纬度、整度表；兼察本命方向
rules.original_text: [The Manner of the Work.] First, Direct the M.C. of the Revolution to the Conjunctions, Sextiles, Trines, &c. of the Planets in the Nativity... Secondly, Direct the Ascendant of the Revolution in the same manner... the Directions of the Revolution are performed without the consideration of Latitude, and with the Tables of the Right, and Oblique Ascentions of the whole Degrees of the Signes, or by the Circle of Position... the Native having attained to the time of the Direction, the events of that time are to be considered from the Directions of the Revolution as well as of the Nativity.
rules.translation: 返照方向操作：①返照天顶方向至本命诸星之合/六合/三合等；②返照升点同法；返照方向不计纬度、用整度之赤经/斜升表或位置圈；命主至方向之时，其期之事件须兼察返照与本命之方向。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXII SECT II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: [Against the vulgar way of directing the Revolution.] The common way of directing the Revolution, viz. by allowing 59 minutes of the Suns motion to every day, and so to direct the whole Figure round the Heavens in a Year, is by the Learned rejected as vain, and absurd; the true way being that delivered above, viz. by directing the M.C. and Ascendant of the Revolution to the Promittors in the Nativity.
rules.translation: 返照方向·驳俗法：俗法以太阳日行59分为一日、使全图一年周转一周——博学之士斥其虚妄；真法即上述之返照天顶/升点方向至本命 Promittors 之法。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXII SECT III；Coley 以此俗法为例戒

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 返照MC→本命土合，期在次年返照
rules.original_text: [The Direction of the M.C. of the Revolution to the Conjunction of Saturn in the Nativity.] Example... the M.C. of the Revolution being directed to the Conjunction of Saturn in the Radix, the time of that Direction is found from the Revolution of the Year 1678. to the Revolution of the Year 1679. in which the M.C. of the second Revolution comes to the Conjunction of Saturn; so that the time of this Direction falls within the second Year after the Revolution, &c.
rules.translation: 返照方向判例：返照天顶方向至本命土星之合——其期自1678年返照计至1679年返照（次年返照之天顶至土星合点）——方向之期落于返照后之第二年内。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXII 末例

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Profections of the Year, Month, and Day, are threefold; but that of the Year is most used, and most considerable; the other two (viz. of the Month, and Day) being of small regard, though not altogether to be neglected.
rules.translation: 岁进（Profections）三式：年/月/日三式，惟年式最常用最要；月/日二式虽非全可弃、然所系者微。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII 引言

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Profections of the Year are thus performed; as the Figure of the Nativity hath twelve Houses, and the Ascendant passeth through the twelve Signes in as many Years; so the Profections of the Year do make the Ascendant to pass through the twelve Signes in twelve Years, allowing one whole Signe to every Year, the Planets themselves being fixed in the Figure.
rules.translation: 年岁进法：本命十二宫、升点以十二年过十二星座——年岁进即令升点（及诸宫头）每年前进一宫、每宫=一年，行星本身固定于盘中不动（仅宫头与星座之位置前移）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照角宫=吉年、恶照=凶年
rules.original_text: The Judgment of the Profections is taken from the consideration of the Signe, and House wherein the Significators are profficiently fallen; as if the Significator of the Year be in good Aspect to the Ascendant, or M.C. as in Sextile, or Trine, it denotes a good Year; but if in Quadrate, or Opposition, the contrary; as Mr. Lilly observes, in his Introduction, fol. 550.
rules.translation: 岁进判断（Lilly 引）：察 Significators 岁进所落之星座与宫——年之 Significator 六合/三合升点或天顶=吉年；四分/冲=凶年（Lilly《Introduction》fol.550）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT II；Lilly 引证

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 须合方向/返照/行运同证
rules.original_text: But this Judgment is not to be taken from the Profections alone, but from a due consideration of the Directions of the Nativity, the Revolutions of the Years, and the Transits of the Planets; which being all concurrent, the Judgment is certain, and true; but if the Profections only be considered, the Judgment is weak, and uncertain.
rules.translation: 岁进效力通则：岁进之断不可独取，须合本命之方向、年之返照、行星之行运——诸法合证则断真确；独取岁进则断微弱不定。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT III；与卷A 方向久暂条（CP3-402）互参

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Directions of the Profections are thus performed; Substract the Significator from the Promittor, and the Remainder (adding a whole Signe if it cannot be Substracted) is the Arch of the Profection; every degree whereof allows 12 dayes, 4 hours, and 12 minutes of the Year; which added to the time of the Nativity, gives the time of the Profection.
rules.translation: 岁进方向算法：Significator 自 Promittor 减之（不可减则加一整宫）得岁进弧；弧每度=12日4时12分（一年360日计），加于生时即得岁进之期。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT IV；此为按日度岁进（Profections in time）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 弧度×12+本命日位=方向日太阳位
rules.original_text: Or otherwise, multiply the degrees of the Arch of Profection by 12, and add the Product to the place of the Sun in the Radix, and the Sum is the true place of the Sun for the time of the Profection; which being found by the Tables, or Ephemerides, the time of the Profection is known.
rules.translation: 岁进方向算法·另法：岁进弧之度数 ×12，加于本命日位——即方向日之太阳真位；查表/星历即得岁进之期（与开普勒日方向法同构）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT IV 另法

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 29年：升岁进狮子、水岁进7宫冲土
rules.original_text: [The Profections of the Example.] As the Profections of the Native for the 29th Year, the Ascendant is profficient in the 5th Signe (viz. Leo) the M.C. in Scorpio, &c. the Significator Mercury profficient in the 7th House, in Opposition to Saturn in the Ascendant of the Radix; whence the Judgments of the Year are accordingly to be made, as well from the Profections, as from the Directions, and Revolutions.
rules.translation: 岁进判例（第29年）：岁进29年——升点岁进至第五座（狮子）、天顶至天蝎等；年之 Significator 水星岁进居7宫、冲本命升内之土星→当年之断须合岁进/方向/返照同作（7宫事与土星之征相应）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT V 判例（1678 年）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 月岁进=月均日行13°11'/月，罕用
rules.original_text: [Of the Profections of the Moon.] The Profections of the Moon are sometimes observed, viz. by allowing 13 degrees, 11 minutes to every Month (the Moons mean Diurnal Motion) and so directing the Moon through the whole Circle in 27 dayes, 7 hours, 43 minutes; but this being a matter of small regard, and seldom used, I shall not insist upon it.
rules.translation: 月之岁进（简述）：月之岁进以每月13°11′（月之平均日行）行全圈于27日7时43分；然其用微而罕用，故不复详。
rules.notes: CHAP XXXIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 行星过本命征象之位=行运
