rules.original_text: If you find the Lord of the fourth in the ninth House, well-seated, and free from the Hostile Beams of infortunate Planets; then Judge the Native acquires profit, or advantage, from some thing properly signified by the ninth House, whether by travail, or some Religious means, or otherwise by some secret Mistery which he may discover; but it also intimates the Natives Parents to live in a very servile, mean, and low condition (the Father more especially).
rules.translation: 4宫主落9宫（吉）：由旅行、宗教或所悟秘术得利；然父母（尤父）境况卑贱低微。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But if posited in the tenth house, the Native and his Father, are then much esteemed by Honorable Persons, he then lives happily by his Imployment; and is generally accounted a Person of good Credit in the World, (unless you find other Arguments in the Scheme, to contradict this Judgement.)
rules.translation: 4宫主落10宫：命主与父皆受显贵敬重、职业安泰、世誉良好（除非盘中他证相抵）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House (which is the eighth from the fourth) and therein ill affected, this threatens short Life to the Father, and many Disasters to attend him during Life; but if well posited therein, Judge the contrary; and that the Native for the most part shall be happy; and fortunate, during Life.
rules.translation: 4宫主落11宫（4之8宫）：受恶=父寿短多灾；得位则反——命主一生大抵幸福。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Lord of the fourth in the twelfth House; 'tis then very probable that the Natives Friends (I mean his Parents) may be much afflicted with Poverty, and other Crosses, which may occasion them to try their Fortunes, in some remote part of the World... It also portends no great good to the Native himself; and shews he may end his days in a strange Country.
rules.translation: 4宫主落12宫：父母多困于贫苦波折，或远适异邦谋生；命主自身亦无大吉，或终老异乡。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IV

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the fifth in the Ascendant, signifies the Native should have many Children, and be respected by them; the Native should also delight in Sports, Games, and other Recreations, sometimes to his prejudice.
rules.translation: 5宫主落1宫：多子女且受其敬；好运动博弈诸乐，有时反受其损。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the second, and free from affliction, it denotes profit to the Native by the indeavours of his Children; it shews they should thrive, and get Estates, and assist the Native thereby.
rules.translation: 5宫主落2宫（无克）：子女勤力致富、助益命主之财。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fifth House be posited in the third, (which is the eleventh from the fifth,) the Natives Children are happy in their Friends, and acquaintances, and he takes many delightful, and profitable short Journeys.
rules.translation: 5宫主落3宫（5之11宫）：子女友朋和乐；命主多愉悦而获利之短途。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If posited in the fourth House, [Schoner] sayes, the Native will enjoy an Estate from his Parents; others say, it signifies many Children, which unless he be strong, and free from affliction, they may sustain many troubles, and vexations, and probably Imprisonment.
rules.translation: 5宫主落4宫：Schoner 云得父母遗产；亦有说主多子女——若宫主不强且受克，子女多忧患，或致囚禁。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V；诸家之说并存

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth House well seated, it denotes the happy, and prosperous condition of the Natives Children; and that the Native will be very propense to delights, and pleasures.
rules.translation: 5宫主落5宫（吉）：子女幸福兴旺；命主极好逸乐。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, the Natives Children prove good, and profitable Servants to the Native; and are not much afflicted with Diseases, unless other Testimonies concur.
rules.translation: 5宫主落6宫：子女为命主良仆、利其家业，少病（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh House, the Natives Wife and Children hold together to hi prejudice; they sometimes prove his professed Enemies, unless there happen some benevolent Aspect between the Lord of the Ascendant, and Lord of the fifth House.
rules.translation: 5宫主落7宫：妻与子女合力损其利益、有时竟为其公开之敌（除非1宫主与5宫主有吉照）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House free from affliction, the Natives Children generally thrive, or gain by deceased persons, and so doth the Native also.
rules.translation: 5宫主落8宫（无克）：子女兴旺，或由亡者得财，命主亦同。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, the Natives Children will delight to take their pleasure, and to Travel long Journeyes; they should be ingenious, and apt to search after new Inventions; and probably to good purpose: they should be Religious also, or concerned in matter, or things relating to the Church.
rules.translation: 5宫主落9宫：子女好游远行、聪慧善创、多有所成；且敬神或从事教会之事。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If posited in the tenth House, the Natives Children may be advanced by the means of great and potent persons, to the honour of the Native; and in regard 'tis the sixth House from the fifth, the Children of the Native pay prove but sickly Persons, or at least be much afflicted thereby.
rules.translation: 5宫主落10宫：子女得贵人提携、光耀命主；然10为5之6宫，子女多孱弱或受此苦。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: By being posited in the eleventh House, it denotes to the Natives Children in the general; they will meet with many Adversaries, and strange Oppositions, if other testimonies contradict not; but the Native should be very prosperous in his hopes, and delight in the Company of his Friends.
rules.translation: 5宫主落11宫：子女多遭敌手与意外之阻（无他证时）；然命主诸望顺遂、乐与友处。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the fifth House shall be posited in the twelfth House, this shews but few Children; and such as will be very unnatural, and bring sorrow and trouble to the Native; but they may thrive by dealing in great Cattle.
rules.translation: 5宫主落12宫：子女少且忤逆、为命主忧患之源；然可由大牲畜之业兴旺。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the sixth in the Ascendant, unless strong, and well posited therein; shews that the Native may suffer much from Diseases of the Nature of the Planet; and that his Servants, and small Cattle should prove unfortunate unto him in the general.
rules.translation: 6宫主落1宫（不强）：受该星性之疾病大苦，仆役小畜大抵不利。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But it posited in the second House, this shews prejudice to the Natives Estate, chiefly occasioned from Sickness, and Servants; and notwithstanding all the Natives Indeavours, he will rarely acquire an Estate, unless other good Arguments of Riches appear in the Figure.
rules.translation: 6宫主落2宫：财受病与仆役之损；虽勤难积财（除非盘中有其他富证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, the Natives Brethren should be sickly, and he himself subject to Diseases; and many times in his short, or In-land Journeys.
rules.translation: 6宫主落3宫：兄弟多病，命主亦多疾，且常发于短途行旅中。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, the Natives Father lives a poor Servile Life; and he himself, together with his family, suffer much by Sickness; and this the more certain if the Lord of the sixth be Combust, or much afflicted in the Scheme.
rules.translation: 6宫主落4宫：父过贫贱仆役之生；命主与家人多病（6宫主焦伤或重克尤验）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 纵欲致病或子女忧致病
rules.original_text: By being posited in the fifth House, the Native is then afflicted with Sickness, proceeding from great Intemperence, Surfeits, and Debauchery; or from troubles of Spirit, arising from the affliction of the Natives Children.
rules.translation: 6宫主落5宫：纵欲暴食荒淫致病，或因子女之难而心神忧苦致病。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the sixth house, be posited in the sixth House, strong, and in good Aspect to the Lord of the Ascendant; then the Native is strong, and healthful for the most part, otherwise Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 6宫主落6宫（强且吉照1宫主）：大抵强健少病；否则反断。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh house, the Native will be subject tn prejudice from, or by the means of the Female-sex; he may be afflicted with diseases taken from them, unless he be more than ordinary careful: it shews also that the Natives Wife should be sickly, and Infirm; and the Native guilty, or at least accused of many evil Actions.
rules.translation: 6宫主落7宫：受女性之害，或染其疾（非格外谨慎不可）；妻孱弱多病；命主多行恶或常被指为恶。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the sixth be in the eighth House, my Author says, the Native shall be healthy, and survive his Enemies, and Servants; but if the Lord of the Ascendant apply to the Lord of the sixth in the eighth, or the contrary; the Native then must expect to undergo Sickness, and great danger of Death also.
rules.translation: 6宫主落8宫：作者云命主健康、寿过其敌与仆；然若1宫主入相6宫主于8宫（或反之），则命主须经重病与死亡大险。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If posited in the ninth house, unless strong, and potent there, or in good Aspect to fortunate Planets; the Native will be afflicted by sickness in his Travels; and not only so, but addicted to deceitful, and vitious Actions.
rules.translation: 6宫主落9宫（不强/不吉照）：行旅中多病，且惯行诈伪恶行。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When posited in the tenth House, and weak; the Native is afflicted by disturbance in Body, or Mind, proceeding from much Labour in his Profession, or striving to gain Honour, or the favour of great Men, and attains not his desire; but if he be strong in the tenth, or in reception or good Aspect with the Lord of the Ascendant, or tenth House, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 6宫主落10宫（弱）：因职业劳苦或求誉求宠而身心俱扰、所求不得；强或与1/10宫主互容吉照则反断。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh house, he confides too much in pretended Friends, or suffers prejudice from new acquaintance; except there be other Arguments to Ballance this Judgement.
rules.translation: 6宫主落11宫：过信伪友或受新知之害（除非他证相抵）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But being posited in the twelfth house, the Native suffers affliction by diseases, which may Invade his Body in Prison, or proceed from much sorrow, or vexation of Spirit; he receives injuries, and affronts, from base, and unworthy Persons; or from private Enemies, &c. and this Judgement is the more aggravated, if the Lord of the sixth House be unfortunate in the twelfth.
rules.translation: 6宫主落12宫：狱中染疾或忧怒致病；受卑劣之辈与暗敌凌辱（6宫主在12宫凶则更甚）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the seventh House, posited in the Ascendant, shews that the Native shall be well beloved by the Female sex, and gain by them; but he must not expect to live free from Controversies, and if the Lord of the seventh vitiate the Ascendant, the Judgement is the more certain, that discords will arise, as well between the Native and his Wife, as between him and others.
rules.translation: 7宫主落1宫：得女性爱慕并从其得利；然不免争讼——7宫主若伤升点则命主与妻及他人必起纷争。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the seventh, in the second House, no way afflicted, the Native is then enrich'd by a Wife, or Wives; but if unfortunate therein, Judge the contrary; yet he may survive her, and many of his profest Adversaries; and rarely escapes prejudice in Estate from Theeves, or other Enemies; or at least, much contention, and debate, concerning such matters.
rules.translation: 7宫主落2宫（无克）：妻室致富；凶则反——或寿过其妻与诸公开敌，然难免盗贼敌手损财或为此大起争讼。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, well dignified; there is a good agreement between the Native, and his Relations; and sometimes Marries one of his own Kindred: but if you find the Lord of the seventh ill affected in the third, the Native, and his Relations, do not affect each other, but live at variance.
rules.translation: 7宫主落3宫（有尊贵）：与亲族和睦、或娶亲族中人为妻；受恶则命主与亲族彼此不睦。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If posited in the fourth House, the Native may enjoy the Possessions of his Father; and Marry one of his own Relations, who should prove vertuous, and honest; but if ill dignified in the fourth, he may meet with trouble, or contention about some Estate in Houses, or Lands, formerly appertaining to his Ancestors.
rules.translation: 7宫主落4宫：得享父产，娶亲族中贤淑者；在4宫失尊则因祖辈屋地遗产起争讼。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth house, ill dignified; the Native will have vexation, both with Wife, and Children; but if well posited, he Marries a young Person, which should be a woman of a good deportment, and behaviour; and not only vertuous, but beautiful.
rules.translation: 7宫主落5宫：失尊=妻与子女皆烦恼；得位=娶年少淑美有德之女。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, and ill dignified therein; the Native Marries a Person of low, and mean esteem; and it shews the Native to be guilty of lying, and treacherous Acts, unless contradicted by other Aspects that are friendly, and benevolent.
rules.translation: 7宫主落6宫（失尊）：娶卑贱之人；命主多撒谎背信（除非吉照相抵）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the seventh be posited in the seventh House, and well dignified therein; the Native Marries credibly, and doth not dishonour himself thereby; but if afflicted there, Judge the contrary: it also shews an ill agreement, and much discord, and contention with women, either Sweethearts, or others.
rules.translation: 7宫主落7宫（有尊贵）：婚配得体、不辱门楣；受克则反——与女子（恋人及其他）多失和口角。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If Located in the eighth House, and free from Combustion, or other affliction; the Native may Marry a Rich Wife, and be much bettered by her Fortune; yet he must also expect some trouble, and vexation concerning the Wills, or Legacies of deceased Persons, unless other Testimonies of good concurr.
rules.translation: 7宫主落8宫（免焦伤克）：娶富妻、因妻财大益；然于亡者遗嘱遗产事有扰（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 妻族争、远行险、或异邦婚
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, ill affected; the Native meets with some Controversie with his Wifes Relations; and not only so, but danger in his long Journeys, and perhaps Marries in another Countrey; sometimes it signifies differences in point of Religion: but if well dignified there, the evil is much abated.
rules.translation: 7宫主落9宫（受恶）：与妻族起争、远行有险、或娶于异邦、或宗教相异；得尊贵则祸大减。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When posited in the tenth House, Authors affirm, the Native shall Marry a Wife, both Rich, and Noble; and thereby come into the favour of great, and honourable Persons; but if he be afflicted there, the native is perplext in his Imployment, and all things signified by the tenth House.
rules.translation: 7宫主落10宫：娶富且贵之妻、藉以得显贵宠信；受克则职业与10宫诸事皆困。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When you find the Lord of the seventh in the eleventh (which is the fifth House from the seventh), the Native, in all probability, may Marry a Widdow, with whom he may live happily, though she have Children; yet if ill dignified in that House, the Wife proves none of the best, perhaps addicted too much to Good-fellowship; and the Friends of the Native unhappily prove unkind unto him also.
rules.translation: 7宫主落11宫（7之5宫）：大抵娶寡妇（虽有子女亦相安）；失尊则妻非善类、或纵情酒乐，友朋亦不义。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the twelfth House, ill placed; this signifies an unfortunate Marriage, he meets with a very unworthy Woman, which proves treacherous, and hateful... it also shews many secret Enemies, and much trouble, and contention by their means... but if the Lord of the seventh be well affected in the twelfth House, this evil is very much mittigated, if not totally abated.
rules.translation: 7宫主落12宫（凶位）：婚姻不幸、妻极不肖而背恨；又多暗敌、因之惹扰；若7宫主在12宫得位则此祸大减或全消。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the eighth House, posited in the Ascendant, signifies short Life; the Native shall be troubled, or afflicted by the Wills of deceased persons, or such like; he should be very covetous, and ambitious; and very reserved, and doubtful in his Actions, for the most part.
rules.translation: 8宫主落1宫：寿短；为亡者遗嘱之事所扰；极贪且傲、行事多隐晦犹疑。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉=遗产得财/凶=遗产损财
rules.original_text: If in the second, and he be not unfortunately placed there; the Native gets an Estate, or Riches by deceased Persons, or such other things as the eighth House signifieth; but if he be unfortunate in the second, this Judgement is contradicted, and then the Native may look for much prejudice from such matters.
rules.translation: 8宫主落2宫（吉位）：由亡者及8宫诸事得产获财；凶位则反——由此类事受大损。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, it signifies the Natives Brethren, or Kindred should be short-liv'd; unless the fortunate Planets behold that place, or the Lord thereof; if so, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 8宫主落3宫：兄弟亲族寿短（除非吉星照该宫或其主，则反断）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, the Native shall be very industrious to gain an Estate by immoveable Goods; but it portends danger of Death to his Father, or that his Father's Possessions are in danger of being wasted, unless other good Arguments intervene.
rules.translation: 8宫主落4宫：勤营不动产以求富；然父有死亡之险或其产有耗散之危（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In the fifth House, the Natives Children will be very healthy, strong, and lusty, and of no long life, if the significators agree; unless the Fortunes be there, or cast any of their benevolent Aspects to the said House.
rules.translation: 8宫主落5宫：子女强健好壮而寿不长（征象相符时）；除非吉星在彼或施吉照。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, the Native may be much afflicted with long, tedious Sicknesses; and his Servants, and small Cattle are in danger of Mortality; if the significator be strong, this Judgement is mittigated.
rules.translation: 8宫主落6宫：多患缠绵久病；仆役小畜有夭亡之险（征象星强则减）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh House, the Natives Wife (if a Woman be signified) proves of no good life, nor conversation; short lived; and also the Natives open Enemies are few, or such as dye before him: but if the Lord of the eighth be in Reception with the Lord of the seventh House, he Marries one of short life.
rules.translation: 8宫主落7宫：妻（若为女）品行不端、寿短；公开之敌少或先死；若8宫主与7宫主互容则娶短命之人。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House, well beheld of the fortunate Planets, and free from the beams of the infortunes; the Native, in general, leads a quiet, peaceable, and contented Life; and dies at last in the decrepit age of old-age, if the Lord of the eighth House be in the eighth, and well dignified there; but if the Lord of the eighth be afflicted in the eighth, then the contrary, and also many strange Accidents happen.
rules.translation: 8宫主落8宫（吉照、免凶星照）：一生安宁知足，若8宫主在8宫得尊贵则终以耄耋之年而逝；若受克则反、多怪灾。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, the Native shall Travel into remote parts, and be much bettered by such Voyages; this also denotes the Death of some Learned Person, or that he comes by his Death in some Forreign part of the World; and it portends some trouble, or vexation to the Native from Ecclesiastical Persons.
rules.translation: 8宫主落9宫：远游异邦且大获其益；主某学者之死或己客死于外；亦主受教会人士之扰。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the tenth House, the Natives Mother proves a careful, and laborious Woman, or such a one as gets her Living by her hand-labour; and the Father may live to a good old-age; it also threatens short life to Princes, or Persons in great Authority, and such as bear Office in the Common-wealth.
rules.translation: 8宫主落10宫：母为勤苦操劳（或靠手工谋生）之妇、父得高寿；亦主君王显宦及公职者寿短。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House, and unfortunate, the Friends, and Acquaintance of the Native may be short-liv'd, or such as prove very unconstant; but if well dignified there, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 8宫主落11宫（凶位）：友朋多短命或极不常情；得尊贵则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the twelfth House, the Native should beware of the Treachery of his own Servants; he is in danger of Death in Prison, or of being strangled, murthered, or otherwise clandestinely put to death, unless the Significator be well dignified, and beheld of the Fortunes.
rules.translation: 8宫主落12宫：慎防仆役之叛；有死于狱、被绞杀或暗杀之险（除非征象星得尊且受吉照）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT VIII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the ninth House be posited in the Ascendant, and no way vitiated, the Native proves Religious, and to be a great lover of the Mathematicks, and of all Mysteries, whether Divine or Humane; and 'tis probable he Travels into remote Countries, and by that means arrives to Honour, and Preferment.
rules.translation: 9宫主落1宫（无伤）：敬神好数理，酷爱神人诸秘；或远游异国、因之获荣进。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the second, the Native is enriched by Merchandize, or by dealing in Sea-affairs, or in such things as are signified by the ninth House; as Church-livings, or such like: but if unfortunate therein, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 9宫主落2宫：由商贾、海事或9宫诸事（如教会俸禄）致富；凶位则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, the Native, and his Brethren, live in love; and he takes several short Journeys, but chiefly for pleasure, and delight.
rules.translation: 9宫主落3宫：与兄弟友爱，多短途行旅（主要为游乐）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, the Native in process of time may possess some of the Goods of the Church; and the Father of the Native proves a Religious Person, or a Traveller.
rules.translation: 9宫主落4宫：日后或得教会产业；父为敬神之人或行旅者。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth House, the Native's Children prove Religious, and Ingenious; he takes many pleasant Journeys for his recreation; and it denotes the Native to be very propense to Plays, and Sports, and other Recreations.
rules.translation: 9宫主落5宫：子女敬神聪慧；命主多快意游程，极好戏剧运动诸乐。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, the Natives Servants are Religious, and Ingenious; his Sicknesses, for the most part, proceed from Surfeiting, and Drunkenness, or such like intemperances.
rules.translation: 9宫主落6宫：仆役敬神而巧；命主之病大抵源于暴食纵酒等过度。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the ninth be in the seventh House, the Native Marries a Religious Woman; but then, he takes several Journeys, occasioned by Law Suits, and other Controversies; and if he be much afflicted in the seventh, he may be in danger of Death by some Judicial Sentence.
rules.translation: 9宫主落7宫：娶敬神之女；然因讼争多行旅——若在7宫重克，有遭司法判决丧命之险。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House, the Native dyes, for the most part, in a Forreign Countrey; unless some other Testimonies intervene; but this must be understood, if he be there unfortunately placed.
rules.translation: 9宫主落8宫（凶位）：大抵客死异邦（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, well dignified, and no way afflicted; the Native is then Religious, and very happy in all his long Voyages, and Journeys, and in all things signified by the ninth House; but if unfortunately placed there, the contrary, and he shall meet with many strange, and tedious dangers in his Travels.
rules.translation: 9宫主落9宫（尊贵无克）：敬神，远航远行及9宫诸事皆极顺遂；凶位则反——行旅多怪异久缠之险。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When posited in the tenth House, the Native is both Religious, and Honest; his Father is a man of good Credit, and Repute; and the Native may attain to Church-preferment.
rules.translation: 9宫主落10宫：命主敬神诚实；父有美誉；命主可得教会高职。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House, the Native is happy in his Friends, and his Friends prove Religious, and ingenious; and some of them may be made great in the Church.
rules.translation: 9宫主落11宫：友朋和乐、敬神而巧，其中或有大成于教会者。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 教扰、暗敌、或以教事入狱
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the ninth be posited in the twelfth House, it denotes the Native to be perplexed, and molested by Ecclesiastical Persons; he is afflicted by little, secret, and private Enemies; and if he be unfortunate there, the Native may be in danger of Imprisonment, for some pretended religious matter.
rules.translation: 9宫主落12宫：受教会人士困扰、多小暗敌；凶位则或因涉教事罪名而陷狱禁。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT IX

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the tenth House be posited in the Ascendant, the Native proves Famous, and Honest; he gains Honour, and Riches, and generally arrives to the top of his Profession; provided the significator be no way afflicted.
rules.translation: 10宫主落1宫：显赫诚实、获荣得富，大抵登其职业之巅（征象星无克为限）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉=职业置业/凶=职不利财
rules.original_text: If in the second House, the Native obtains an Estate by his Profession, or by dealing in such things as are signified by the tenth House; but if the Lord of the tenth be afflicted there, Judge the contrary; and also, that the Native hath but little hopes of being enriched by his Imployment.
rules.translation: 10宫主落2宫：由职业或10宫诸事置业；受克则反——难望以职务致富。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, the Native hath good, and useful Friends amongst his Kindred, which prove Assistant to him; he takes several short Journeys to the augmentation of his Honour and Estate.
rules.translation: 10宫主落3宫：亲族中有良友相助；数作短途以增荣益产。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, and well dignified, the Native may be enriched by his Father's Estate, or by some thing properly signified by the fourth House; and he may attain to Honour by such means; but if unfortunately placed there, the Native then expects but little good from such matters.
rules.translation: 10宫主落4宫（尊贵）：由父产或4宫诸事致富并获荣；凶位则此类事鲜有善果。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth House, the Native gains Honour by his Children; or that his Children prove famous, and ingenious; the Native also delights in Plays, and Sports, and other Recreations, and spends much time therein.
rules.translation: 10宫主落5宫：子女为荣或子女成名聪慧；命主好戏剧运动、多耗时光于其中。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, it shews the Native will have but a sickly body; yet he may be advanced by the means of Servants, or Physicians; or such things as are signified by the sixth House.
rules.translation: 10宫主落6宫：体多病；然可借仆役、医师或6宫诸事而进身。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh House, the Native Marries a Wife, by whom he gains Honour, and preferment; and it sometimes happens, that the Native falls into great discord with his Wife, which turns to his Prejudice; especially if the significator be much afflicted.
rules.translation: 10宫主落7宫：娶妻藉以获荣进；然有时与妻大起纷争反受其损（征象星重克尤验）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House, and well placed, the Native may come to Honour, or Preferment by the means of dead Mens Wills; and he may also be much improved in his Estate thereby; but if unfortunately placed there, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 10宫主落8宫（吉位）：借亡者遗嘱得荣进并增产；凶位则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, the Native attains to Honour by Sea, or Land-Journeys; he is Religious, and well inclined to the Mathematicks; and this signification is the more strong, if he be not afflicted in the ninth.
rules.translation: 10宫主落9宫：由海陆行旅得荣；敬神好数理（无克尤强）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the tenth House, and well dignified, the Native may safely promise himself Honour, and Preferment; but if unfortunately placed, or afflicted there, he is in danger of losing what Honour, or Reputation he hath, or may be in danger of Imprisonment; and the general signification of the tenth House is much weakened.
rules.translation: 10宫主落10宫（尊贵）：可望荣进；凶位受克则有失名之险或入狱，10宫总征大减。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House, the Native gains Honour, and Preferment, by the means of his Friends, or Acquaintance; and he may be advanced thereby to some eminent Office, or Place.
rules.translation: 10宫主落11宫：赖友朋引进获荣，或升至显职。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the twelfth House, ill dignified; the Native may be advanced by the means of Enemies, or malicious Persons; but it's probable he may be very much perplexed, and molested by them, or by the means of great Cattle; if he be strong, and well dignified there, then the contrary, and he may expect good from such.
rules.translation: 10宫主落12宫（失尊）：由敌与恶人而进，然反受其扰或损于大畜；强且得尊则反得其益。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT X

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the eleventh House, posited in the Ascendant, shews the Native to be fortunate, and successful in his Hopes, and that he may gain Honour, and Dignity, by the means of his Friends.
rules.translation: 11宫主落1宫：诸望顺遂，赖友朋之力得荣得位。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the second House, it shews the Native gains Riches by his Friends, or such things as are signified by the eleventh House; and that his hopes are generally attended with good success.
rules.translation: 11宫主落2宫：赖友朋及11宫诸事得财，诸望大抵顺遂。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, the Natives Relations, and Kindred are generally good, and faithful to him; and he takes several short Journeys, for his pleasure, and recreation.
rules.translation: 11宫主落3宫：亲族良善忠信；命主数作短途游乐。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, the Native may have hopes of the Estate of his Father; and it denotes he may gain profit, or profit by his Father, or such as are signified by the fourth House.
rules.translation: 11宫主落4宫：有望得父之产，由父或4宫诸事获利。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth House, the Natives Children are happy, and fortunate, and prove good, and excellent Persons; the Native also delights in Sports, Pastimes, and other Recreations, which he doth not spare to take, or use, upon all occasions.
rules.translation: 11宫主落5宫：子女幸福幸运、成材出众；命主好运动游艺，随时纵情行之。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, it signifies the Natives Servants are fortunate, and that his Sicknesses are but of small duration; yet it sometimes happens, that the Native is much troubled with his Friends, or Servants, or both, unless the significator be strong.
rules.translation: 11宫主落6宫：仆役有幸、病期短促；然有时友或仆役（或二者）甚扰命主（除非征象星强）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh House, the Native Marries a Woman of a noble, and generous disposition; and it signifies a good agreement between them, and his Friends; unless other Testimonies intervene.
rules.translation: 11宫主落7宫：娶高贵宽厚之女，妻与己及友朋皆和洽（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House, the Native gains by the Wills, and Legacies of deceased Persons, or by the means of his Friends; it also signifies, that some of his Friends shall dye before him.
rules.translation: 11宫主落8宫：由亡者遗嘱或友朋得利；亦主友朋中有人先其而逝。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, the Natives Friends are Religious, and generally Travel into remote parts; and by that means the Native may be much bettered by them.
rules.translation: 11宫主落9宫：友朋敬神、多远游异域，命主或大受其益。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the tenth House, the Natives Friends may be advanced to some eminent Office, or Dignity; and the Native may be partaker of their Honours; unless the significator be afflicted.
rules.translation: 11宫主落10宫：友朋升显职，命主得沾其荣（征象星无克为限）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House, and well dignified, the Native proves happy, and fortunate in his Friends; and by their means attains to Riches, and Honour; but if ill dignified there, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 11宫主落11宫（尊贵）：友朋幸福幸运，赖之以得财得荣；失尊则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the twelfth House, the Natives Friends are in some measure his Enemies, and prove false, and unconstant to him; they may be advanced by secret means, but they are Instrumental in the ruining of their own Fortunes.
rules.translation: 11宫主落12宫：友朋有几分如敌、虚伪无常；或由暗途进身，然终自毁其福。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XI

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the twelfth House, posited in the Ascendant, shews the Native to be much afflicted by private Enemies; if the Lord of the twelfth be strong, and not afflicted, he proves Victorious over his Enemies; and is advanced by them.
rules.translation: 12宫主落1宫：多受暗敌之扰；12宫主强且无克则克敌致胜、反因之得进。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the second House, it shews the Native may be damnified by Theeves, or by the means of his own private Enemies; but if he be strong, and well dignified in the second, the contrary, he may be enriched by his Enemies, or by such as are signified by the twelfth House.
rules.translation: 12宫主落2宫：为盗贼或暗敌所损；强且得尊则反——因敌或12宫诸事致富。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the third House, the Native hath Enemies amongst his Kindred, and Relations; and some secret evil is intended against him by them; but if the Lord of the twelfth be well dignified, the contrary.
rules.translation: 12宫主落3宫：亲族中有其敌、密谋相害；12宫主得尊则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fourth House, the Natives Father hath Enemies, and receives damage by them; and the Native himself may suffer imprisonment, unless other Testimonies prevent it.
rules.translation: 12宫主落4宫：父有敌而受损；命主自身或陷狱禁（除非他证）。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the fifth House, the Natives Children are afflicted by private Enemies, or by such things as are signified by the twelfth House; and they sometimes suffer Imprisonment.
rules.translation: 12宫主落5宫：子女受暗敌或12宫诸事之扰，有时受囚。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the sixth House, the Native hath Enemies amongst his Servants; and his Sicknesses prove very tedious, and of long continuance.
rules.translation: 12宫主落6宫：仆役中有其敌；病况缠绵久延。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the seventh House, the Natives Wife hath private Enemies; and the Native himself is much afflicted by them: but if the Lord of the twelfth be strong, and well dignified, it denotes the contrary, and that the Enemies of the Native may be overcome by him, or that he may be advanced by their means.
rules.translation: 12宫主落7宫：妻有暗敌，命主受其扰；12宫主强且得尊则反——克敌或赖敌得进。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eighth House, it signifies the Natives Enemies, or such as maliciously intend him evil, are in danger of a violent Death; and the Native himself may be in danger of death by some private, secret means.
rules.translation: 12宫主落8宫：命主之敌（或蓄意害之者）有暴死之险；命主自身或有遭暗算丧命之险。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the ninth House, the Natives Enemies are Ecclesiastical, or Religious Persons; or the Native may be molested by them in his Travels, or long Journeys.
rules.translation: 12宫主落9宫：其敌为教会或敬神之人；或行旅远行中受其扰。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the tenth House, the Natives Enemies are in Authority, or in Office, and by their means the Native suffers prejudice; if the Lord of the twelfth be ill affected in the tenth.
rules.translation: 12宫主落10宫（受恶）：其敌居权位、借以损命主。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the eleventh House, the Natives Friends are, or become his Enemies; and he is molested, and prejudiced by them; but if the Lord of the twelfth be well dignified there, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 12宫主落11宫：友朋成仇、反受其扰损；12宫主得尊则反。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If in the twelfth House, and unfortunately placed therein; the Native proves unfortunate, and is afflicted by secret Enemies; he is in danger of Imprisonment, and other Punishments; but if he be strong, and well dignified, and happily beheld of the Fortunes; then the Native may be advanced by such as are signified by the twelfth House.
rules.translation: 12宫主落12宫（凶位）：命主不幸、受暗敌所扰、有狱禁刑罚之险；强且得尊并受吉星吉照则反——由12宫诸事得进。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII SECT XII

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But because it is impossible for the Lord of every House to be in every House; therefore, in such Cases, you are to observe the Significators, or Planets, that are posited in those Houses, and judge accordingly; always remembering, that the Lord of the House being well beheld, or assisted by the Fortune, or Luminaries, augments the good; and being afflicted by the Infortunes, or otherwise impedited, the contrary. And in all your Judgments, let this be a general Rule, That you regard the Significator, or Significators, as free from, or as affected by the following Conditions, viz. Strong, or Weak; Essential Dignities, or Debilities; In an Angle, or not; Oriental, or Occidental; Swift, or Slow; in Combustion, or Cazimi; Retrogradation; Peregrine; or otherwise affected; all which you may find largely treated of in the first Part of this Clavis.
rules.translation: CHAP VIII 总注：宫主不可能落遍十二宫，凡未落宫者以彼宫所落行星为征象星照断；总则=宫主受吉星/日月吉照增其吉、受凶星克或其他碍则反。凡判断必察征象星诸态：强弱、本然/偶然尊贵或失尊、角宫与否、东出西入、疾行徐行、焦伤或 Cazimi、逆行、游走等——详见 Clavis Part I。
rules.notes: CHAP VIII 末总注；本条为144条落宫规则的总纲，引擎须先查本条再逐条落宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and Jupiter, signifies, to the Native, many good Possessions, and Inheritances, and many wayes of profit to the Native, if they are not evilly beheld by Mars.
rules.translation: 土木合相：多产业承继、多途得利（若非受火星恶照）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 引言段（未编号）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and Mars, in a Nativity, shews the Native may be intrusted, but shall not accomplish his desires, without great difficulty; he shall survive his Brethren, but end his dayes before his Parents.
rules.translation: 土火合相：可受托付，然愿望须历大难方成；寿过兄弟，而先于父母而终。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and the Sun, shews loss of Patrimony, and great trouble to gain Riches; but the most danger is in such Nativities which are Nocturnal.
rules.translation: 土日合相：失祖产、求财极难；夜生盘为害尤甚。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 2；夜生尤验

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and Venus, signifies the Native may Marry a Widdow, or a Person much older than himself, by whom he shall have no Male Children; sometimes it denotes the Natives Wife to be a vile Contemptible Person, by whom he, and his Parents are much dishonoured.
rules.translation: 土金合相：娶寡妇或远长于己者，无男嗣；有时妻为鄙贱之人，命主与父母皆受辱。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and Mercury, shews the Native should have an Impediment in his Speech; and that he should be a mean, inconsiderable Person, and rarely capable of any Trade, or Profession.
rules.translation: 土水合相：言语有障、身分卑贱，罕能习任何技艺职业。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Saturn, and the Moon, denotes an Indigent Person, weak in Body, and loss from his Parents.
rules.translation: 土月合相：贫乏之人，体弱，损于父母。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Jupiter, and Mars promises him Riches by Command in Warr; and renders the Native a Person of good Credit, and Renown, in all Martial Enterprises.
rules.translation: 木火合相：以军中指挥致富，于武事皆得信誉与声名。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 日非东出=贫损/东出=父福
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Jupiter, and Sol, shews poverty, or loss, if the Sun be not Oriental; if so, the Father will be Fortunate, and by him the Son, and his Children also.
rules.translation: 木日合相：太阳非东出则贫或损；若东出则父福泽，子及其孙皆受其荫。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Jupiter, and Venus, shews the Love, and Friendship of great Persons; and profit by their means.
rules.translation: 木金合相：得显贵之爱与友谊，并因之获利。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 8

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Jupiter, and Mercury, denotes the Native may prove a Lawyer, Secretary, or Chancellor, &c.
rules.translation: 木水合相：可为律师、书记、掌玺大臣之流。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 9

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Jupiter, and Luna, prenotes great Riches, according to the Capacity of the Natives Birth.
rules.translation: 木月合相：预兆大富（按其出身地位而论）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 10

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Mars, and Sol, signifies loss of Patrimony, and Goods; a short Life to the Father, and great danger the Native may be burnt, or perish by Fire.
rules.translation: 火日合相：失祖产财物；父寿短；命主有焚身或死于火之重险。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 11

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Mars, and Venus, shews that the Native may suffer many strifes, and Debates concerning Women; and sometimes shews the Native should be a great Adulterer, or Lover of Women of a most Infamous Name, or Reputation in the World.
rules.translation: 火金合相：因女子多争讼口角；有时为巨奸大淫之徒，或好世间恶名昭著之女。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 12

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Mars, and Mercury, usually produces a Lyar, a Deceiver, a Babling, Prating Person; yet ingenious, and eloquent; and for his own Interest, very diligent.
rules.translation: 火水合相：多产说谎欺诳饶舌之徒，然机敏善辩，为己利而极勤勉。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 13

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Mars, and the Moon, prenotes a short Life to the Native; sometimes a violent Death by Fire, by Iron, or by the fall of some Ruinous Building; and sometimes by Blows, or Wounds from the hands of Men.
rules.translation: 火月合相：预兆寿短；有时死于火、铁器、危楼倾塌，或遭人手殴伤。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 14

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of the Sun, and Venus, shews the Native should be a person of good Renown (the Birth considered) he shall do many praise-worthy Acts, and gain the favour of Women in general.
rules.translation: 日金合相：享美誉（按其出身）、行多可颂之举，得众女性之欢。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 15

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of the Sun, and Mercury, denotes Wisdome, Learning, Science, and great Estimation thereby; the Native is skilful in many things.
rules.translation: 日水合相：主智慧、学问、科学，因此备受推重；命主多才多艺。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 16

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of the Sun, and Moon, signifies a short Life; and that the Native shall bear Rule, and delight in honourable Company.
rules.translation: 日月合相：寿短；命主执政掌权，喜与显贵为伍。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 17

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉=好乐快友/焦伤=生殖缺、女害
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Venus, and Mercury, inclines the Native to the love of Musick, and Dancing, &c. such a Position makes a pleasant merry Companion; yet if they are conjoyned under the Sun Beams, the Native is defective in the Parts of Generation, and receives prejudice from, or by the means of Women.
rules.translation: 金水合相：好音乐舞蹈，为欢乐伴侣；若合于日轮光下（焦伤）则生殖器有缺，并受女子之害。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 18

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉=快谑伶俐/火照=挥霍流荡
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Venus, and the Moon, gives a pleasant jocular Person, fair spoken, yet proud; and if Mars dart his malignant Beams, the Native and his Wife should be extravagant, and wander in strange Pasture; unless Jupiter interpose his friendly Rayes.
rules.translation: 金月合相：愉快乐谑、口齿伶俐而骄傲；若受火星恶照则命主与妻挥霍无度、流荡异乡（除非木星善照相救）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 19

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Conjunction of Mercury, and the Moon, shews a good inclination to Science, and ingenious Arts, by which the Native gains Reputation; yet he should be very fickle, and unconstant.
rules.translation: 水月合相：向学好奇技，因之得誉；然性极轻浮无常。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT I 20

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and Jupiter, denotes the Native should enjoy the Goods of this Life plentifully, whether in Houses, Lands, hid Treasure, or Inheritances, it matters not; this is the more certain if they are in good places of the Figure.
rules.translation: 土木三合：丰享世间之财——无论屋宅、田地、藏宝或承继；若居图中吉位尤验。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 引言段（未编号）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and Mars, promises great advantage to the Native by preferment, honour in bearing Rule, either in Towns, or Countries; and he survives his Brethren.
rules.translation: 土火三合：许以进身之利、治城治邦之荣；命主寿过兄弟。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and the Sun, presages honour, and preferment to the Native, some Place, or Office of Credit is conferr'd upon him, if the Nativity be Diurnal; if Nocturnal, the Native squanders away his Patrimony; but in the end, by some worthy Action, he retrieves all again, to his great Fame, and Reputation.
rules.translation: 土日三合：昼生=得荣进、授以要职；夜生=先挥霍祖产，终以伟行复得一切、享大名。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 2；昼夜分别

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and Venus, Indues the Native with a modest shamefac'tness; he is just in his Actions, a Person of a good Conversation, and Repute; yet much envied by base sordid Persons, and Marries not till after thirty Years of Age.
rules.translation: 土金三合：性谦逊知耻、行事公正、谈吐声望俱佳；然为卑劣之徒所深忌，三十岁后方婚。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and Mercury, renders the Native a very prudent Person, yet subtile in most of his Affairs; a Person of a pregnant Fancy, sometimes studious in the Mathematicks, or other Curious Arts; a fit Person to make a Chancellor, Secretary, General Register, or Publique Notary, &c.
rules.translation: 土水三合：极审慎而多事机巧；想象力丰沛，或好数学奇艺；宜任掌玺、书记、总注册官或公证人。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Saturn, and the Moon, promises much favour from great Persons of both Sex; it shews the Native may have a popular applause, and be advanced to great Honour, and Dignity; and probably bear great Rule over others.
rules.translation: 土月三合：得男女显贵之眷顾，众望所归、进至高荣高位，或统御众人。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Jupiter, and Mars, denotes Boldness, Victory, Honour, the favour of great Persons, Government; and a very considerable Fame in the World, the Capacity of Birth considered.
rules.translation: 木火三合：主勇、胜、荣、得显贵之宠、执政，世誉颇著（按出身地位而论）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Jupiter, and the Sun, produces (in a Natural way) to the Native great Honour, and Estimation in the World; much Riches, and Noble Possessions, also many Children.
rules.translation: 木日三合：自然地产出大荣大誉、厚财贵产，且多子女。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Jupiter, and Venus, presages a comly Person, vertuous, and much obliging to all; the Native will be both faithful, and honest, and be enriched by Wives, or the means of Women; as also be preferr'd to Dignity, according to the Capacity of the Native.
rules.translation: 木金三合：仪容端丽、有德、待人和厚；忠信诚实，由妻室或女性致富，并按出身获升显位。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 8

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Jupiter, and Mercury, shews an ingenous person of a pregnant Fancy, and able to Administer good Counsel, or Advice; the Judgement should be sound, and not impaired; and consequently, the Native should be successful in most Enterprizes, and a fit Person, if his Education corresponds, to make a Judge, or Counsellor, or perform some Eminent Office of trust.
rules.translation: 木水三合：聪颖富想象力、善献良谋；判断健全无损，诸事多成；若教育相应，宜任法官、顾问或显要之职。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 9

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Jupiter, and the Moon, demonstrates the Native to be of a Noble Mind, and a Person of an Aspiring Brain, who may acquire much Honour, and Renown; a true lover, and promoter of Vertue, and all just Actions in general.
rules.translation: 木月三合：心性高贵、志向高远，可获大荣大名；真爱好德、普倡公正之行。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 10

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Mars, and the Sun, presages advancement according to the Quality of the Native; he gains much Honour by War-like Actions, and Exployts; and from thence is promoted to great Dignity, and Government; and probably to be the General, or Conductor of an Army, or something equivolent.
rules.translation: 火日三合：按命主品级而进身；以战功武勋获大荣，由此升高位掌权，或为军之统帅。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 11

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Mars, and Venus, prenotes to the Native in the first place, profit, and considerable gain from, or by the means of Women; and it renders the Native of a lofty spirit, much puff'd up with Pride; and a great delighter in the Company of the Female-sex.
rules.translation: 火金三合：首主由女性得可观之利；命主气性高傲、自满骄矜，极好与女性相处。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 12（原文标 XIII）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Mars, and Mercury, denotes the Native to be prudent, and crafty; a Person of a searching Fancy, capable of any thing he desires to attain; it signifies a good Oratour, or Disputant, and no less knowing in Arithmetick, or the Nature of Numbers.
rules.translation: 火水三合：审慎而狡黠、探究心强、凡所欲皆能成；善辩之演说家，于算术数理亦深晓。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 13

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Mars, and the Moon, signifies happiness to the Native in most of his Affairs; a rising Person, capable of bearing Rule, and able to manage Business with prudent Severity, by which he gains Honour and Renown.
rules.translation: 火月三合：诸事多福；崛起之才、能任统御，以慎严治事、因之获荣得名。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 14

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Benevolent Aspects of the Sun, and Venus, are not much different from what was said of the Trine of Mars, and Venus, viz. profit from, or by the means of Women, &c. it rather imports much more Honour, and Advantage, than what was before Intimated; but these are Rare.
rules.translation: 日金吉相（原文并入三合章）：与前述火金三合略同——由女性得利等；然所含荣利更厚于前者；此相少见。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 15；Coley 泛言日金之善相，不专指三合

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Venus, and the Moon, signifies the Native should be Beautiful; a comley Person, delighting to go neat in Apparrel, somewhat proud. And easily tempted, if a Woman; and as Amorous, if a Man.
rules.translation: 金月三合：貌美仪端、好衣着整洁、稍傲；女则易受诱，男则多情好色。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 16

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Trine of Mercury, and the Moon, shews the Native to be an ingenious Person in his Imployment; and is had in great Estimation for the same, whether it be Musick, Singing, Dancing, Painting, or any such Airy Fancy, &c.
rules.translation: 水月三合：于其职业极有巧思并因此大受推重——无论音乐、歌唱、舞蹈、绘画或诸般风雅巧艺。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT II 17

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 忧烦多灾、失子；三十后转安
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn, and Jupiter, in any Nativity; shews a continued Series of troubles, and vexations; many Mischiefs, and Tribulations occur to the Native, to his great Detriment, also loss of Children; and if Saturn be in the Ascendant, and Jupiter in the Seventh, the Native suffers most of his Infortunances in the fore-part of his Life; and after thirty Years of Age, he lives reasonable happy, and quiet to the end of his dayes.
rules.translation: 土木冲相：连绵忧烦、多灾多难、损及子女；若土在升、木在7宫，则前半生灾祸最重，三十岁后生活宁适安乐以终。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 引言段（未编号）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 重灾病、坠水瘟疫暴死、父厄
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn and Mars, in any Nativity (except Jupiter, or Venus interpose their friendly Rayes) declares Superlative troubles to the Native; many Conspiracies are Hatched against him, and he is afflicted most intollerably with Diseases; and subject to prejudice by the fall of Ruinous Buildings, or by falls from high places, danger by Water, sometimes expires by the Plague, or some violent Death aforesaid; and the Native is most unhappy in a Father.
rules.translation: 土火冲相（除非木金施吉照）：至重之灾——多阴谋图之、病苦难堪；损于危楼倾塌、高处坠、水厄，或死于瘟疫等暴死；且于父最为不幸。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn, and the Sun, without the friendly Aspects of the Fortunes, decyphers to the Native, danger of a violent Death; it produces many Tribulations, Sorrows, and Vexations, sometimes occasioned from the loss of Goods, or Estate, or other Disasters equivolent.
rules.translation: 土日冲相（无吉星吉照）：暴死之险；多忧患悲苦，或源于失财失产之类灾祸。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn, and Venus, destroyes the Beauty, and Vertue of the Native; and renders him, or her, vitious, and infamous; especially in all things relating to unlawful desires.
rules.translation: 土金冲相：毁命主之美与德，使之邪恶声名狼藉——尤涉非法情欲诸事。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn, and Mercury, afflicts the Native in his (or her) Elocution; it produces a great Impediment in the Speech (as I have experimented in several Nativities) and not only so, but the Fancy is also stupified; and such a Person is unfit to make an Orator, or Astrologer. Authors tell us, such an Aspect disperses the Natives Brethren also.
rules.translation: 土水冲相：伤口才——大言语障碍（Coley 自称多盘亲验），且想象力迟钝，不宜为演说家或占星家；作者云此相亦使兄弟离散。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 4；Coley 亲验注记

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Saturn, and the Moon, shews troubles, and danger to the Natives Mother; and also to the Native of some violent Death by Water, consideration being had to the Nature of the Sign wherein the Moon is posited.
rules.translation: 土月冲相：母有忧患；命主有溺毙之暴死险（须察月所落星座之性质）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Jupiter, and Mars, in any Nativity, denotes the Native to be ungrateful to his Friends, from whom he has received great favours; it renders him a very rash, head-strong Person; a destroyer of his own Substance, and a Person of a very mutable Fortune.
rules.translation: 木火冲相：对受其大恩之友忘恩负义；性极鲁莽刚愎、自毁其财，命运多变。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Jupiter, and the Sun, declares the Native to be an Extravagant, and a Person that will squander away his Patrimony, (unless other Testimonies fall in) and not only so, but freely dispossesses himself of his Imployment, and Honour.
rules.translation: 木日冲相：挥霍之人、散尽祖产（除非他证），且自弃其职与荣。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 7

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Jupiter, and Venus, in a Nativity, declares the Natives Friends to be very mutable, and unconstant in their Affections of the Native, who is too subject to be rewarded with ingratitude; otherwise he injoys a moderate Fortune, according to his Quality, or Degree.
rules.translation: 木金冲相：友朋情意多变无常，命主易遭以怨报德；此外按其身分得中平之福。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 8

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Jupiter, and Mercury, demonstrates many Strifes, and Contentions, in which the Native should be Involved; oftentimes strange things are conspired against his Person, and Interest, difference with his Brethren, many Enmities against him; and probably Law Suits, which may even weary out the Native to Death, unless there be other Arguments of Assistance in the Scheme.
rules.translation: 木水冲相：多陷纷争；常有怪事谋其人身与利益、与兄弟失和、多敌；或致诉讼，累其至死（除非盘中有他助证）。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 9

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Jupiter, and the Moon, shews some petty difficulties which the Native will overcome and afterward live reasonable happy.
rules.translation: 木月冲相：有小小难处，命主终能克服，此后生活颇为安乐。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 10

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 目（右）险、暴死毁产、父短寿
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Mars, and the Sun, shews, in any Persons Nativity, danger to the Eyes, but more especially to the right Eye; and not only so, but as great a danger of a violent Death, and a destruction of his Patrimony; let him beware of falls from some high place, and generally of all rash Actions; it also portends a short Life to the Father.
rules.translation: 火日冲相：眼（尤右眼）有险；并同有暴死大险、祖产遭毁；慎高处坠与一切鲁莽之举；亦主父寿短。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 11

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Mars and Venus, renders the Native a Person too much addicted to his Pleasures and Delights; oftentimes very vitious, generally mutable, and unconstant, and a grief to both Wife, and Children; if it fall from Tropical Signs, the Native Marries Wives of ill Repute, or frequents too much the Company of scandalous Women.
rules.translation: 火金冲相：过于沉溺逸乐、常多邪行、大抵心性善变无常，为妻与子女之忧；若由天象座（巨蟹/摩羯）发出，则娶声名狼藉之妻，或过近丑闻之女。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 12

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Mars and Mercury, and no friendly Aspect from Jupiter, presages the Native to be an unjust Person, and one of vitious Principles naturally; and consequently, guilty of many Crimes, for the which he may justly be exil'd, chiefly if Mercury be in the House of Saturn, nor may his Children be expected to be much better than their Father.
rules.translation: 火水冲相（无木星吉照）：性本不公、禀恶德，多行罪行——或当被流放（水星落土星之宫尤验）；其子女亦不见胜于其父。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 13

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Mars, and the Moon, alwayes shews prejudice, or blemishes to the Eyes, especially the left Eye; nor doth the Body escape Wounds, and Hurts, and other accidental Infirmities: the Native hath many Enemies, abhors Marriage; and rarely escapes a violent Death.
rules.translation: 火月冲相：眼（尤左眼）受损或有疵；身不免刀伤、意外之疾；多敌、厌婚、罕能免于暴死。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 14

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 命运多变、荣辱病福无常
rules.original_text: The Opposition of the Sun, and Moon declares the Native a very mutable Fortune; sometimes the Native lives and enjoys much happiness, and suddenly his condition is changed into misfortune; sometimes his Reputation is good, and splended, and in a short time he receives as much dishonour; one while he enjoys his health well, and afterwards he is much afflicted with sickness; so that his whole Life is very mutable, and various, continuing in no state long.
rules.translation: 日月冲相：命运极多变迁——时享大福、忽转祸患；名誉时荣时辱；健康时佳时病；一生多变，无恒久之态。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 15

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Opposition of Venus, and the Moon, shews that the Native should be unfortunate in Marriage, and Women should prove injurious to him in the general; nor can he expect to be happy in his Children, except some other good Aspects of the Planets may alter this Judgement, which is almost infallibly true, as all Artists must needs confirm.
rules.translation: 金月冲相：婚姻不幸、大抵受女子之害；子女亦难望幸福（除非他星吉照改判）——Coley 称此判几乎无误，诸家皆可印证。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 16

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Lastly, The Opposition of Mercury, and the Moon, in a Nativity, shews the Native shall meet with many Oppositions in the Course of his Life, and many treacherous Acts shall be contrived against him, of which he himself should be somewhat guilty, and therefore justly paid in his own Coyn; such an Aspect in a Nativity when Mercury is Lord of the Ascendant, shews the Native to be a very mutable, inconsiderable Person, conceited, and yet void of reason, and good manners.
rules.translation: 水月冲相：一生多阻，多遭背信之谋（其自身亦有几分过错，可谓以己之道还治己身）；若水星为1宫主，则命主极善变、不足取、自负而乏理性与教养。
rules.notes: CHAP IX SECT III 17

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 六合=弱三合、四分=弱冲；相位须合宫主与来源宫座同参
rules.original_text: [And thus I have shewed something of the Planets significations in any Native, according as they shall behold each other; but the Artist ought also in his Judgement to consider what Houses they govern, and from what Signs, and parts of the Figure they behold each other; and from thence (together with these general Rules) form his Judgement suitable to the quality, and condition of the Native...] Note that the Sextile Aspects of the Planets have the same signification with those of the Trines, but not altogether so forcible; and therefore they need not be again repeated. The same I may say of the Quartiles, in respect of the Oppositions; therefore I shall only treat of the Oppositions of the Planets, and omit the Squares as superfluous.
rules.translation: CHAP IX 附注：①六合与三合同义而力弱、四分与冲同义而力弱，故本章不重复列六合/四分；②占断相位时须兼察二星所主之宫、自何宫何座发出照视，与总则合参，依命主品级状况裁断——无更多通则可授，端赖术者之能与审。
rules.notes: CHAP IX 章末两处注记合并；原文另一处重复段（15727-16038）为书本分卷页序所致，仅录一次

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 五证验=短寿；不验且有吉照=长寿
rules.original_text: I) Consider whether the Degree Ascending, or the Lord thereof be afflicted or not, by the Presence, or [evil] Aspect of the Infortunes, or the Lord of the eighth; or whether the Lord of the Ascendant be Combust, Peregrine, Retrograde, or Cadent. II) Consider whether Saturn, or Mars be in Conjunction in the Ascendant, or in Opposition from the first, and seventh, or an Eclipse happening in the Degree Ascending, or Fixed Stars of an evil Nature Arising therewith; these are dangerous Arguments. III) The Light of the time afflicted, or Eclipsed at the hour of Birth, is sometimes fatal to the Native. IV) The Moon in Quartile, or Opposition, of Saturn or Mars, in the fourth, sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses; or if she be Besieged of Saturn, and Mars, or of Sol, and Mars, and in no good Aspect of the Fortunes; these are dangerous Testimonies that the Native is not designed for a long Life. V) Lastly, Many Planets in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth, and the Lord of the Ascendant not beholding them; or the Sun, or Moon, or Ascendant with any good Aspect, shews danger.
rules.translation: 寿命长短五判据：I 升点或其主受凶星/8宫主克照，或1宫主焦伤/游走/逆行/落续降宫；II 土火合于升或自1-7对冲，或升度逢蚀、凶性恒星并升；III 时主光体（日/夜生光体）于生时受克或蚀；IV 月在4/6/8/12宫与土火成刑冲、或被土火（或日火）包围而无吉星吉照；V 多星落6/8/12而1宫主不照，或日月升点无吉照。若五者皆不验、吉星日月吉照升点或其主，则可望寿至强力方向（升点/光体对凶 Promittor）斩断为止。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I 开篇；先审父母命盘5宫征象（能得则用），不得方据本盘五判据；'准无谬'为作者口径

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 日/月/升点（依昼夜与落宫）
rules.original_text: I) If the Birth be Diurnal, and the Sun in the seventh, ninth, tenth, eleventh, or Ascendant, (or not far from the Degrees thereof) these being accounted the only Aphetical places proper unto him, he shall then be accounted for the Hyleg, or giver of Life. II) If the Birth be Nocturnal, and the Moon posited in the Ascendant, or any of the aforesaid Houses (or near the Degrees of the Cusps thereof) she shall then be accepted for the giver of Life. III) Lastly, If in a Diurnal, or Nocturnal Nativity, the Luminaries are not found in those Aphetical places, but Located in any of the other Houses; in this Case, the Ascendant must be taken for Hyleg, or giver of Life.
rules.translation: Hyleg（寿主/授命者）三则：I 昼生且太阳落7/9/10/11/1宫（或其宫头近度）→太阳为Hyleg；II 夜生且月亮落1宫或前述诸宫（近宫头度）→月亮为Hyleg；III 昼夜二光皆不在上述 Aphetical 诸宫→取升点为Hyleg。作者并云取日月与升点中强者。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.1；Aphetical 五宫=7/9/10/11/1；诸家说法有异，作者从日月+升点之说

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Hyleg 位本然尊贵最强者（吉照优先）
rules.original_text: See what planet hath most Essential Dignities in the place of the Hyleg, and that Planet (by the Antients) is termed Alchocoden, or giver of Years; and this the rather, if he be in Aspect to the place of the giver of Life. If either of the Luminaries happen to be Hyleg, or giver of Life; and are also strong, and potent, as being in their own Houses, or Exaltations, &c. Then account that Luminary, so Dignified, both Hyleg, and Alchocoden; but being Hyleg, and void of the aforesaid qualifications, viz. Essentially strong, they cannot then be admitted giver of Years. If many Planets happen to be neer equal in strength in the place of the giver of Life, so that the Artist may be at a stand which to take; then consider which of them behold the Hyleg by a friendly Aspect, and take him to be the true giver of Years. Alwayes observing that an Oriental Planet, if the Birth be by day, is preferred before an Occidental.
rules.translation: Alchocoden（岁主/授年者）：取在 Hyleg 之位本然尊贵最多之行星（若其照 Hyleg 位尤取）；日月自为 Hyleg 且强（入本宫/擢升）则兼为 Alchocoden，若 Hyleg 而无本然之强则不得为授年者；诸星势均难决时取以吉照 Hyleg 者，昼生东方星先于西方星。
