rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.2 1-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.rule_type: 宫判-第一宫寿命-年限表
rules.original_text: The use of the Alchohoden is briefly thus, if you find him strong, and Angular in his own Dignities, it intimates the Native may live the Old Years that Planet signifies; if in a Succedent house, his Mean Years (here the eighth House is Excepted) if in a Cadent House his Least Years; this is according to the Doctrine of the Arabians. Here follows a Table of the Great, Mean and Least Years the Planets give, as they are set down by Argol; and with small variation from Schoner, and Origanus. Saturn 57/43/30, Jupiter 79/45/12, Mars 66/40/15, Sol 120/69/19, Venus 82/45/8, Mercury 76/48/20, Luna 108/66/25.
rules.translation: Alchocoden 用法：强且角宫+本然尊贵=给该星之大年；续宫=中年（8宫除外）；降宫=小年（阿拉伯人学说）。Argol 大/中/小年限表：土57/43/30、木79/45/12、火66/40/15、日120/69/19、金82/45/8、水76/48/20、月108/66/25（与 Schoner、Origanus 微异）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.2 3；年限表同时录入映射子表'Argol年限表'

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Some Astrologers (in former Ages) took this way of finding the Lord of the Geniture, viz. Diligently to enquire what Planet had most Essential Dignities in the place of the Moon, and Mercury; and that very Planet they took to be Lord of the Geniture, because Mercury signifies the Spirit, and the Moon the Body. But it is now generally received (amongst Modern Artists) to be that Planet which hath most Accidental, and Essential Dignities in the Scheme of Birth... Collect, into a Table, all the Planets Essential, and Accidental Dignities, and Debilities, by the Tables for that purpose, Page 85. and 88. of the first Part; and by Substraction of the lesser Number from the greater, you will easily see the strength, or weakness of each Planet; and lastly, discover the Planet that surmounts all the rest in Essential Fortitudes, and therefore Lord of the Geniture, which this provisor, that if two Planets have equal strength in your Figure, you are to accept him for your Almuten, who hath most Essential Dignities in the Horoscope; and the rather, if he friendly behold it, or the Lord thereof, or either of the Lights.
rules.translation: Almuten / 命主（Lord of the Geniture）：古法取月在月与水星之位本然尊贵最多者（水星主灵、月主身）；今法则取全盘本然+偶然尊贵总和最强之星——按 Part I 尊贵表集计，以多减少得每星强弱，居首者为命主；二星同强时取升点本然尊贵多者，尤取吉照升点、其主或日月者。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.3 1-2；尊贵表见 Part I 页85/88

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 多血/黏液/胆汁/忧郁四质
rules.original_text: I) Consider what Sign possesseth the Horoscope (or Ascends at Birth) and Judge according to the Nature of that Sign, as if Gemini ascend an Aireal Sign, the Native is Sanguine; if Cancer a Watry Sign, Phlegmatique; if Leo a Fiery Sign, Cholerique; if Scorpio an Earthy Sign, Melancholy, &c. If two Signs are concerned in the Ascendant, mix their significations. II) You are also to consider the Lord of the Ascendant, the Planet, or Planets therein, or in Aspect thereunto. III) The Moon, and those Planets she is in Aspect with. IV) The Lord of the Geniture, and Sign the Sun is in. V) Lastly, Consider the qualities of the several Significators, and Collect their Testimonies, viz. Hot, Moist, Cold, Dry; and Judge according to the Major Testimonies. If Heat and Moisture Predominate, the Native is Sanguine; if Cold, and Moisture, Phlegmatique; if Heat, and Dryness, Cholerique; if Cold, and Dryness, Melancholy. Note that if one Planet be Almuten of the Geniture, and Lord of the Horoscope, allow him a threefold Vertue in the Complexion of the Native, or the Moon in the Ascendant, you are to double her Testimonies.
rules.translation: 体质（Complexion）四行质判法：I 依升座四质（风=多血质、水=黏液质、火=胆汁质、土=忧郁质，双座并升则混）；II 参1宫主与宫内/照宫之星；III 参月亮及其所照之星；IV 参命主与太阳所在座（季节）；V 汇总诸征象星热/湿/冷/干，从多数证——热湿=多血质、冷湿=黏液质、热干=胆汁质、冷干=忧郁质。注：星既为命主又为1宫主，于体质权重三倍；月亮在升点则其证加倍。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.4；星座行星性质见 Part I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Note that the qualities of the Moon in her quarters are thus accounted From her ☌ to the first qu. is Hot & Moist that is Sanguine. From her first qu. to the full is Hot & dry that is Choleric. From her full to the last q. is Cold & dry that is Melanch. From her last q. to the cha. is Cold & moist that is Phlegm.
rules.translation: 月亮四分位性质：朔至一弦=热湿（多血质）；一弦至望=热干（胆汁质）；望至三弦=冷干（忧郁质）；三弦至朔=冷湿（黏液质）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.4 末

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Any Planet in the Ascendant, whether Intercepted, or upon the Cusp thereof, shall be the principal Significator of Manners [especially if he be Lord of the Ascendant, or Nativity, or have Dignities in the Sign Ascending, or be in any Partil Aspect of the Moon, or Mercury.] Many Planets in the Ascendant, gives variety of Manners... but that Planet which is most strong, and powerful, signifies the most Durability. If no Planet be in the Ascendant, Judge from the Lord of the Ascendant (if his Dispositer behold him) or rather the Lord of the Geniture, or that Planet that forcibly beholds Mercury, or Luna. When a good Planet is Significator of the Qualities of the Mind, it argues the Native to be of a most excellent, and commendable Deportment; on the contrary, if a Malevolent Planet signifie the Manners, it declares him to be of an ill disposition, Clownish, and Brutish. The Durability, or Continuance of the Natives Manners is known from the Directions of the Ascendant, and the Moon.
rules.translation: 品性（Manners）：升宫内任何行星（拦截或临宫头皆可）为品性主征象（尤若为1宫主/命主、于升座有尊贵、或与月水成精确相位）；升内多星=品性多变，最强之星主其恒久；升内无星则看1宫主（其主星照之）、或命主、或强力照月水之星；吉星主心性=德容佳善，凶星主品性=粗鄙野蛮；品性久暂看升点与月之方向。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.5 1-5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 依水星位置强弱定才性
rules.original_text: The Wit, or Understanding of the Native is taken from Mercury chiefly, and his Configuration with the Moon; Mercury governs the Animal Spirits in the Brain, and the Moon the strength thereof; hence then if these Planets be well posited in any Geniture, it argues the Native to be of a most pregnant Wit, and excellent Understanding... if you find these Significators ill posited, weak, or afflicted, Judge the contrary. The Quartile Aspect of Mercury, and the Moon, gives plenty of Wit to the Native; but 'tis unpolish'd, and rugged: the Opposition of Luna, and Mercury, from Angles, gives a very stubborn, and turbulent Wit, Mercury in reception of Mars from Aries, sharpens the Wit: Mercury swift in motion, shews the Native to have a very quick apprehension, but subject to mutability in his Opinion: if Mercury be under the Earth, the Native is very propense to Arts, and Sciences; if above the Earth, his Inclinations are more to Oratory... Mercury in an Angle, and free from the affliction of Saturn, or Mars; or if Mercury be posited in Aireal Signs, in Aspect with the Fortunes, this argues the Native hath a good Understanding, a sharp Wit.
rules.translation: 才智（Wit）：主看水星及其与月之配置（水星主脑内动物精、月主其力）——二星吉位=颖悟绝伦；弱受克则反。细则：水月四分=才智丰而粗野；从角宫相冲=倔强躁动之才；水星在白羊受火星互容=才锋更锐；水星疾行=悟性迅捷而意见易变；水星在地平下=好文艺科学，在地平上=趋辞令雄辩；水星角宫且无土火之克，或落风象座而与吉星成照=善解善悟、卓绝之才。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.6 1-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: In Judging of this, you are first to consider the Sign Ascending, the Lord thereof, and those Planets that are in the Ascendant; as also the Luminaries according to the Signs they are in, not omitting the consideration of the fixed Stars that arise at Birth. If you find the Planets in Aireal, or Firy Signs, they declare the Native to be of a full, and large, Stature; but if in Watry, or Earthy Signs, it signifies the Body more Short, and little. If they have South Latitude, the Native is active, and nimble; if North Latitude, more heavy, and sluggish. If you find the Lord of the Ascendant, or Planets therein, to be strong, and potent, the Body will be more Decent, and Comly, and well proportioned; if the Significators be weak, and much debilitated, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 体形（Stature）：参升座、其主、升内之星，及日月所落之座与并升之恒星。行星落风/火象座=身材高大丰满，落水/土象座=矮小；南纬=轻捷，北纬=沉重迟钝；1宫主或升内星强=体态端正匀称，弱且损=反。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.7 1-3；星座行星形貌详见 Part I

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: All the Planets Essentially dignified, or many Receptions between them, argue the Natives general Fortune to be exceeding good; more particularly, if you find the Luminaries well posited, as also the Part of Fortune, this confirms the Judgement; consider also the Lord of the Ascendant, and Almuten of the Geniture if they are well seated in the Figure, and in good Aspect of the Fortunes, these are notable Arguments that the Native will live happily in the World; and this according to the Degree, or Quality of Birth... but withal the Direction of the Nativity must be consulted. II) If in the Figure you find the Planets weak, and debilitated, and posited in Abject places thereof, &c. then you may conclude the Native will be subject to many Miseries and Misfortunes, divers Changes, and Mutations; and in fine, but a disconsolate, and dejected Life in the general, except upon the force of some good Directions the Sun may shine upon him... but he rarely arrives to any height of Honour, for continuance in the World.
rules.translation: 总命运：诸星皆有本然尊贵或互容众多=大吉；日月与福点得位尤验；1宫主与命主吉位且受吉星吉照=一世幸福（按出身地位，常超其本分）——然必参方向法之吉凶以定起伏；反之诸星弱损、落卑贱之位=多灾多变、一生抑郁（仅偶蒙善方向之阳光），罕至高位。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT I S.8；作者自云第一宫论之最详，以其总摄诸宫

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: You are to consider the Cusp of the second House, the Lord thereof; and any Planet, or Planets posited therein. The Part of Fortune, and his Dispositor, with those Planets that behold either of the aforesaid Significators, let their Aspect be good, or evil.
rules.translation: 财帛征象星：2宫头、2宫主、宫内诸星，及福点与其主星——凡照临上述征象之星亦须并察（吉凶照皆论）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT II S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Having taken a serious view of these several Significators, and their strength, or weakness; you may from thence Judge of the Natives worldly Estate... whether it will be considerable, or not; or whether the Stars threaten him with Poverty, Penury, and want, &c. If by a diligent Collection of Testimonies, you find the major part to be very strong, and Fortunate; this is an Argument that the Native shall enjoy a very competent Fortune, and live happily in the World. But if they are found Weak, and much Debilitated, Judge the contrary: If the Testimonies happen to be equally Ballanced on both sides, Judge a Mediocrity, that then the Native shall live in a mean way, seldome sensible of much want, and rarely at any time abound, but make a shift to struggle along in the World.
rules.translation: 富贫总判：汇总诸征象星强弱证——多数强吉=家资丰裕幸福；多数弱损=贫乏；势均=中产之命，罕有大乏亦罕有余，勉强过活（纵因善方向偶获非常之入，亦不久长）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT II S.1 2-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If Jupiter be Essentially strong in the second House, and in any good Aspect with the Luminaries, or Lord of the Ascendant; or if the Moon be in the Ascendant, or hath Dignities in the second. this shews the Native shall enjoy a considerable Fortune, and durable. The Luminaries beholding each other by a Benevolent Aspect, from good places of the Figure, denotes the Native shall arrive to great Honour, and abound in Riches; and the rather if both (or either) of them be essentially strong; the same you may judge if the Part of Fortune be Located in the second, and well Dignified, or friendly Irradiated by the Fortunes, especially Jupiter, who is a general Significator of Wealth. If Jupiter, Venus, the Part of Fortune, or Caput Draconis be posited in the second House; or if the Fortunes behold the Cusp thereof friendly; or if the Luminaries be near Benevolent fixed Stars; or lastly, many Planets strong, and potent in the second; these are all strong Arguments that the Native shall be blessed with a most excellent Fortune, and sufficiently stored with Riches, even to his own hearts content.
rules.translation: 富之诸证：木星在2宫本然强且吉照日月或1宫主；月落升点或于2宫有尊贵；日月从吉位互作吉照（尤本然强）；福点落2宫得尊或受吉星（尤木星——财之总征）吉照；木金福点或龙头落2宫；吉星吉照2宫头；日月近善性恒星；多星强居2宫——皆为富足之强证。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT II S.2 1-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But on the contrary, if you find none of these Testimonies, Judge the condition of the Native will be but low, and his Fortune very inconsiderable; especially if you find the Significators much afflicted, or the Dragons Tayl in the second, or many Planets ill Dignified therein; if so, you may be confident the Native shall not be troubled much with worldly Wealth, but live in a very Poor, Mean way in the world... The Sun, or Mars in the second, wastes the Natives Estate; the same you may Judge if you find Saturn in Conjunction with Luna in an Angle, or if Saturn, or Mars afflict the second House, or Lord thereof, or Part of Fortune; or if the Part of Fortune near violent fixed Stars: these are Arguments of Poverty, and that the Native shall be reduced to Want, although once he (for a time) enjoyed an Estate.
rules.translation: 贫之诸证：诸征象皆不验=命低福薄；征象星重受克、龙尾落2宫、多星失尊居2宫=贫苦微贱；日或火落2宫耗产；土月合于角宫；土或火克2宫/2宫主/福点；福点近凶暴恒星——皆主贫乏，纵曾一时拥产亦将沦于匮乏。求财之道则视许财之星为何、主何宫，依其性裁断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT II S.2 4-6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Observe the Sign of the third house, the Lord thereof, and the Moon; and examine whether any (or all) of them be posited in fruitful Signs, or fruitful Planets posited in the third house. If you find the Significators posited in such Signs, it argues the Native either hath, or may have Brothers, or Sisters; or if any of them are in good Aspect of fruitful Planets, viz., Jupiter, Venus, or the Moon, Judge the same. But on the contrary, if you find the aforesaid Significators in Barren Signs, or in Aspect with Barren Planets, (as Saturn, and Mars, which are accounted Steril) or the Dragons Tayl in the third, this argues the Native will have no Brethren, or Sisters: Judge the same if the third house, or Lord thereof be much afflicted.
rules.translation: 兄弟有无：察3宫座、其主与月亮——落多产星座、或吉星（木金月）照临=有兄弟姊妹；反之落无产星座、与无产星（土火，称绝育）成照、龙尾在3宫、或3宫及其主重克=无兄弟姊妹。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT III S.1 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find Testimonies that the Native may have Brothers or Sisters; then consider whether the Significator be in Masculine, or Feminine Signs, and Houses, or in Aspect with Masculine, or Feminine Planets; and accordingly Judge whether the Native will have most Brethren, or Sisters. If the Significators themselves are Masculine, and posited in such Signs, or in Aspect with Masculine Planets; this argues the Native may have most Brethren; But if in Feminine Signs, Most Sisters.
rules.translation: 兄弟性别：察征象星落阳性/阴性星座宫位、与阳性/阴性行星之照——阳性=多兄弟，阴性=多姊妹。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT III S.1 3-4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find their Significators strong, and potent, and well Located in the Figure; Judge their Condition to be Fortunate, and happy; but if weak, or much afflicted, Judge the contrary: if some Significators are weak, and others strong, moderate your Judgement accordingly, as Reason will direct you.
rules.translation: 兄弟状况：征象星强而有位=兄弟幸福幸运；弱而受克=反；强弱参半则酌中而断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT III S.1 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find a friendly Aspect, or Reception between the Lord of the Ascendant, and Lord of the third House, from good places of the Figure; and the Moon separate, and apply well, from, and to the Significators; this argues a good agreement, and much unity, between the Native, and his Kindred: But if there be no Aspect between their Significators, this prenotes very little familiarity between them, but rather an unnatural kind of strangeness, and no mutual Love... If the Significators behold each other by some Malevolent Aspect, or if the Infortunes happen to be posited in the third House; this signifies much hatred, and discord, between the Native, and his Kindred; and oft-times he is much injured by them. [By what hath been said 'twill be very easie to Judge of the Natives short (or In-land) Journeys whether they will prove Fortunate, and Prosperous, or the contrary.]
rules.translation: 兄弟相合：1宫主与3宫主从吉位成吉照或互容、月之出入相善=命主与亲族和睦统一；无相位=疏远冷淡、无相爱；恶照或凶星居3宫=仇恨失和、常受亲族所害（据此亦可断短途行旅之利否）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT III S.2 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照=承产增广/受克=祖产耗散
rules.original_text: Consider whether the Birth be Diurnal, or Nocturnal. In a Diurnal Geniture, if the Sun be in any good Configuration of the Fortunes from the second, and fourth houses; it signifies the Native may have a considerable Patrimony, and shall much improve the same: This is the more certain, if they have any Dignities in the fourth house. Understand the same if the Birth were Nocturnal, and the Moon and Saturn well Configurated with Jupiter, or Venus, as aforesaid; on the contrary, if you find either in a Diurnal, or Nocturnal Geniture, the Significators afflicted, and no interposition of the friendly Rayes of the Fortunes; this declares a Consumption of the Natives Patrimony, and that he shall be little bettered thereby.
rules.translation: 遗产（父留产业）：昼生=太阳自2/4宫与吉星吉照=可承可观祖产且大增（吉星于4宫有尊贵尤验）；夜生=月与土与木金吉照同断；反之昼夜二生征象星受克而无吉星吉照=祖产耗散、所承甚微。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IV S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Fortunes posited in the fourth House, and free from the malignant Rayes of Saturn, or Mars, denotes good success to the Native in all things, relating, or signified by the fourth House; as Husbandry, Purchasing of Land, hidden Treasure, Mines, &c. This is the more confirmed if the Part of Fortune, or the Dragons Head happen to be there also, and well beheld by their dispositor; it also signifies much Riches to accrue to the Native towards the latter part of his Life (or when he grows Antient.)
rules.translation: 吉星居4宫且免受土火恶照=农事、购地、藏宝、矿务诸事顺遂；福点或龙头同在且受其主吉照尤验；并主晚年（老耄时）财帛大丰。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IV S.1 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The condition of the Father is known by the strength, or weakness, of the Lord of the fourth, or the Sun in a Diurnal Geniture; and the Moon, and Saturn in a Nocturnal. The Sun, Saturn, Mars, or Mercury, in the fourth, signifies the short Life of the Father; the same if they cast bad Aspects thereunto. But if the Fortunes are posited therein, or friendly Irradiate the same; Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 父之状况：看4宫主强弱（昼生兼看太阳、夜生看月亮与土星）；日土火水居4宫或向其施恶照=父寿短；吉星居4宫或吉照=反断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IV S.1 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find Reception between the Lord of the fourth, and the Lord of the Ascendant; or if they behold each other by Sextile, or Trine Aspects; this argues much Love, and Amity, between the Native, and his Father; the same you may Judge if the Moon do well behold the Significators, or translate the Benevolent Rayes of Light of the one to the other; or if she, or the Lord of the Ascendant do friendly behold Saturn, or Sol. But if you find the aforesaid Significators evilly beholding each other from bad places of the Figure, or from Angles without Reception, you may Judge the contrary; and positively conclude but an ill Agreement and a low ebb of mutual Love between the Native, and his Father. [Argol in Ptol. Parv.: 父之状况——4宫主为吉星、居角或续宫、东出、有尊贵、无凶星照=父于子诞生后得荣、显达、位至优。]
rules.translation: 父子之情：4宫主与1宫主互容或成六合/三合=父子深爱；月亮吉照征象星、或转传一方吉光于另一方、或月/1宫主吉照土星或太阳=同断；征象星从凶位或角宫（无互容）互作恶照=父子失和、情爱低落。（附 Argol《Ptolemy 小集》：4宫主为吉星、居角或续宫、东出、有尊贵、无凶星照=父于子诞后获荣显达、位至最优——永远照此理解。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IV S.2 1-2；附 Argol 拉丁引文意译

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The health of the Body is discovered from the strength of these several Significators. As First, the Sign Ascending, and Lord thereof. Second, The Luminaries. Thirdly, From the sixth House, and the Lord thereof, or Planets posited therein. Fourthly, From the seventh house, and Lord thereof, because 'tis opposit to the Ascendant, which signifies the Life, and Temperament of the Native; the Sun rules the Vital Spirits, and the Moon the humours of the Body. If in any Geniture you find these several Significators (or the major part of them) strong, and potent, and favourably beheld by the Fortunes, being free from the malitious Aspects (or Bodies) of Saturn, and Mars, these are Arguments that the Native is of a very healthful Constitution... But if you find the Significators weak or much afflicted, either by the Infortunes, or the presence of Malevolent fixed stars; Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 健康征象星四组：I 升座及其主；II 日月；III 6宫及其主、宫内星；IV 7宫及其主（7对宫升点，升点主性命与体质——日主活力精、月主体液）。四组（或其多数）强健且受吉星吉照、免受土火恶照（或合体）=体魄康健；弱而受凶星克或近凶暴恒星=反。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.1 1-2；各行星星座所主之病详见 Part I 页66起

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Luminaries afflicted by the Infortunes, especially from Angles; it threatens great danger to the eyes, and many times absolute Blindness; Judge the same if the Sun, and Moon are in Opposition; and the more certain if the Opposition happens from Angles. Note that if Saturn be in the Ascendant in any Sign, except Capricorn, or Aquarius, he greatly afflicts the Teeth.
rules.translation: 目疾：日月受凶星克（尤从角宫）=眼有重险、常致全盲；日月对冲亦然（角宫对冲尤验）。附：土星在升点（除摩羯、水瓶座外）大损牙齿。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.1 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If Mercury happen to be much afflicted by the Malevolent Aspects of Saturn, it signifies some defect in the Hearing; and threatens the Native with Deafness. If Mercury be Lord of the sixth house, or have great Dignities therein, or in the twelfth, Judge the same.
rules.translation: 耳疾/聋：水星受土星恶照重克=听觉有缺、有聋之险；水星为6宫主、或于6宫（或12宫）有大尊贵者同断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.1 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Take this for a general Rule, that wherever you find Mercury Lord of the sixth much afflicted, or in Conjunction of the Sun, or evilly beheld by the Moon, Saturn, or Mars, especially from Angles, the Native then is sure to have some defect in his Speech; and is either subject to Stammering, or (at least) has a very ill Delivery, or Elocution.
rules.translation: 言语缺陷：水星为6宫主而重受克、或与太阳合、或受月土火恶照（尤从角宫）=必有言语之缺——口吃或辞令拙劣（至少）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.1 5；病性详见 Part I 第7章页66及第二部第6章页181

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the fortunate Planets posited in the sixth House, and free from affliction; it declares the Natives Servants to be just, and honest; or that he shall gain by them, or any small Cattle he shall happen to deal in; and this the rather, if they behold the Ascendant or Lord thereof, with any Benevolent Aspect; judge the same if you find the Moon, or Lord of the sixth, and Mercury fortunate in an Angle; or if there be any good Aspect, or Reception between the Lord of the sixth, and the Lord of the Ascendant; For these are strong Testimonies of Diligent, and Faithful Servants... The same is (in all respects) to be understood of all sorts of Cattle of the smaller sort, as Sheep, Hogs, &c.
rules.translation: 仆役与小畜之吉证：吉星居6宫无克=仆役忠信、因仆役及小畜得利（吉照升点或其主尤验）；月/6宫主/水星吉居角宫、或6宫主与1宫主吉照/互容=仆役勤勉忠实、大获其益；小畜（羊猪等）之判与此同。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.2 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Infortunes in the sixth but weak, and in an ill Aspect to the Ascendant, or Lord thereof; or if the Lord of the sixth be in Quartile, or Opposition to the Lord of the Ascendant, or Mercury much afflicted (which is a general Significator of Servants) you may then judge the Natives Servants to be very knavish, and careless Persons, such as he will receive much damage by, Ergo no way to be trusted unto... neither can he expect to be fortunate in dealing in small Cattle of any sort, under which is Included all kind of tame Fowl, Birds, and Poultry, &c.
rules.translation: 仆役与小畜之凶证：凶星弱居6宫且恶照升点或其主；6宫主与1宫主刑冲；水星重克（仆役之总征象）=仆役奸猾疏懒、大受其损、不可信任；小畜（含家禽鸟类等）诸业亦难有幸。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT V S.2 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Significators of Marriage are, first, the Cusp of the seventh house, and Lord thereof, the Planet, or Planets posited therein. Secondly, the Moon, and Venus, are general Significators in Mens Nativities; and the Sun, and Mars in Womens Genitures.
rules.translation: 婚姻征象星：7宫头、7宫主、宫内诸星；男命通征=月与金星，女命=日与火星。并察诸征象与1宫主之配置及其照升度之法。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI 开篇

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Lord of the first apply by any good Aspect to the Lord of the seventh, or if they be in Reception; or if Venus, or the Moon be in any good Aspect, or Reception with him, the Sun, or Mars, the Native will have a propensity to Marriage; Judge the same if you find the Significators in fruitful Signs. Sol, Jupiter, or Venus, friendly Irradiating the Cusp of the seventh House, signifies the Native will assuredly Marry.
rules.translation: 嫁娶之证：1宫主以吉照入相7宫主或与之互容；金星或月亮与太阳或火星（男命征象）吉照/互容；征象星落多产星座；日木金吉照7宫头=必婚。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: When you find the Significators weak in sterill (or Barren) Signs, or Saturn strong posited in the first, fifth, seventh or eleventh Houses in Barren Signs; or if Venus, and the Moon, are in Quartile, or Opposition of Saturn; this shews an Indisposition in the Native to Marriage, and presages a single Life; Judge the same if Venus be unfortunate in Leo.
rules.translation: 不婚之证：征象星弱落无产（不毛）星座；土星强居1/5/7/11宫且落不毛星座；金星与月亮刑冲土星=对婚无欲、主独身；金星在狮子失势同断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Significators in fruitful Signs, or the Moon, and Venus, posited strong in the seventh House, in a double bodyed Sign, being free from the Malevolent Rayes of the Infortunes; this declares the Native will Marry more than once. If the Moon, or Venus apply to many Planets, and posited in any double bodyed Signs, or if you find many Planets in the seventh, although they behold not Venus, or the Moon, especially if the Lord of the Ascendant be there; or if the Lord of the Ascendant be in any friendly Aspect with the Lord of the seventh from Bi Corporeal Signs: these are Arguments of plurality of Wives. Judge the same if the Significators of Marriage behold each other well, and are at Unity amongst themselves from good Houses of the Figure.
rules.translation: 多婚之证：征象星落多产星座；月与金强居7宫之双体星座、免凶星恶照；月或金入相多星且落双体星座；7宫多星（纵不照金月，尤若1宫主在其中）；1宫主自双体星座与7宫主吉照；婚姻征象星自吉宫互照和睦——皆主多次婚娶（多妻）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Significators are afflicted by the Infortunes, and posited in Signs representing one Form; then you may be confident the Native shall Marry but once, if at all.
rules.translation: 单婚之证：征象星受凶星克且落单形星座（非双体）=仅婚一次（若婚的话）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 东出强=妻当家/10宫=贵姻/2宫=财婚
rules.original_text: Venus Oriental, and strong, being essentially dignified in any Geniture, most aptly denotes the Wife will predominate, and wear the Breeches. If Venus, in any Nativity, be posited in the tenth House, shews the Native shall Marry into a Credible Family, and gain much profit (as well as honour and preferment) thereby. But if she be posited in the second House in any Geniture of either Sex, the Native Marries more for Money than Love.
rules.translation: 婚姻格言一：金星东出而强、有本然尊贵=妻主内政（穿裤子当家）；金星在10宫=娶入体面之家，因之获利并获荣进；金星在2宫（男女皆然）=为财而婚多于为爱。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 Aphorismes 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Venus in Aquarius, or Cancer in Quartile, or Opposition to the Moon, and posited in the North Angle, signifies such Natives will be very subject to wander beyond their own Limits to satisfie their Lusts. If Venus happen to be in Conjunction, Quartile, or Opposition of Mars; Judge the same that such Natives will not only be of very high Spirits, but frequently change their Pasture, and make use of more than lawfully belongs unto them, i.e. Much guilty of Adultery, &c.
rules.translation: 婚姻格言二：金在水瓶或巨蟹、与月刑冲、居北方角宫（4宫）=易越界纵欲；金与火合/刑/冲=性气高傲、常易其偶、多用非分（即多犯奸淫）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 Aphorismes 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 7宫受土克=配偶性弱/6宫=不诚/摩羯巨蟹=端正
rules.original_text: Venus afflicted by Saturn in the seventh, denotes the Person the Native Marries to be deficient, and weak in Venereal Sports. Or if she be with Saturn, or Mars in the sixth, the Native Marries a very dishonest Person. If in Capricorn, or Cancer there, assure your self the Person the Native Marries, either Man, or Woman, will prove such as we term RIGHT.
rules.translation: 婚姻格言三：金星在7宫受土克=所娶（所嫁）之人房事乏力；金与土或火在6宫=娶极不诚实之人；金在摩羯或巨蟹被克=所嫁娶之人将证为'正人'（RIGHT，意为端正之人——Coley 反语/特指）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 Aphorismes 4；RIGHT 一词为原文用词，义涉双关，按原文直录

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But if Venus be in Configuration with Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury all together; this signifies the Native to Marry a very Careful, Industrious, and Laborious Person.
rules.translation: 婚姻格言四：金星与土星、木星、水星三者同成配置=娶（嫁）极勤谨劳苦之人。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.1 Aphorismes 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Having carefully observed the Sign of the seventh, and Lord thereof; also any Planet posited in the seventh House by a Judicious Commixture of their several Descriptions, you may artificially make a Description her person; which if you find them posited in Gemini, Virgo, Libra, or Sagitary, they signifie a Neat, Handsome, and Comely Creature; and this the rather, provided the Significators be strong, and essentially dignified; if you find them in Aries, Taurus, Capricorn, or Leo, this declares a Person much Deformed, and no way Beautiful, or Lovely: and so much the worse if the Significators be weak, or afflicted. If in Cancer, Scorpio, Aquarius or Pisces, it intimates the Person the Native shall Marry should be indifferent handsome, not much Commendable, nor very Contemptible. But if Saturn should afflict the Significators, or they happen to be but weak, it signifies the Person to be Incomposed in Body, and perhaps Conditions Unsavory enough, unless other Testimonies contradict. But the Moon in good Aspect of Jupiter, or Venus, or friendly beholding the Cusp of the seventh; denotes a well Composed, Compleat, Proportioned Body.
rules.translation: 配偶品貌：察7宫座、其主与宫内星之形貌描述——落双子/处女/天秤/射手=整洁俊美（征象星强且本然尊贵尤验）；落白羊/金牛/摩羯/狮子=形体不美、无可悦（弱受克更甚）；落巨蟹/天蝎/水瓶/双鱼=中等姿色、无可称亦不贱；土星克征象或征象弱=体态不整、品性或鄙（除非他证）；月吉照木金或吉照7宫头=体态匀称完整。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.2 1；面容发色肤质详见 Part I 星座行星描述

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you desire to know what Agreement there will be, consider the Significators of both Parties, and see how they behold each other; if it be by good Aspect, and there be Reception between them, it argues a good Agreement; if they behold each other by Quartile, or Opposition, the contrary: if they are in no Aspect, it declares little, or no Respect they bear unto each other. The Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon, in Quartile, or Opposition of the Lord of the seventh from Angles in movable Signs, presages much Contention, and Discord; so doth the Dragons Tail in the seventh. But their Love, and Hatred might be best discovered by considering the Simpathy, or Antipathy, that is between their Genitures, (if they may be procured.)
rules.translation: 夫妻相合：比双方征象星（1宫主与7宫主等）之照——吉照且互容=相得；刑冲=失和；无相=彼此无敬重。1宫主或月亮自角宫（动座）与7宫主刑冲=多争纷；龙尾在7宫亦然。二人命盘交感（若可得）最能判其爱与憎。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.2 Agreement 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 东出疾行=早婚/西入缓行=晚婚
rules.original_text: The time of Marriage is best discovered by Directions, viz. when the Ascendant comes to the Sextile, or Trine of the Lord of the seventh, the Moon, or Venus, or the Degree of the Cusp of the seventh, to the aforesaid Significators, &c. or rather the M.C. directed to any Aspect of Venus if she were strong in the Radix, or the Moon, or Lord of the seventh, Directed to the aforesaid Promittors, Direct, and Converse. If all the Significators of Marriage be Oriental of the Sun Swift and Direct, declares Marriage in youth, but if Occidental of the Sun and slow in motion, or Retrograde, and more especially if Saturn be in the seventh, he then either Marries being pretty well in years, or else an ancient Maid or Widdow in his youth.
rules.translation: 婚期：以方向法判——升点行至7宫主/月/金之六合或三合、或7宫头度至上述征象星；或 MC 行至金星（若本命金星强）任何相位、或月/7宫主行至上述 Promittor（顺逆皆可）。诸婚姻征象星皆东出、疾行、顺行=少壮成婚；西入、徐行或逆行（尤土星在7宫）=晚婚，或少壮娶老处女/寡妇。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.2 Time of Marriage 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
planets: 8宫主/2宫主/木/金/龙头/龙尾/土/火
rules.original_text: Lastly, if you consider the strength of the Lord of the eighth, and how he Aspects the Lord of the second you may judge of the Portion of the Wife, whether it be considerable or not. If the Lord of the eighth behold the Lord of the second by Sextile, or Trine, or if there be Reception between them, or if Jupiter, Venus, or the Dragon's Head be in the eighth, you may conclude she hath a Portion considerable, and you shall be bettered thereby; but if the Significators of her Substance be weak, Afflicted, or any wayes Debilitated, or Saturn, Mars, or the Dragon's Tail in the eighth, judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 妆奁：看8宫主之强弱及其照2宫主——六合/三合或互容、木金龙头在8宫=妻奁可观、因之受益；妻财征象弱受克、或土火龙尾在8宫=反。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.2 Portion 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Again, if you find the Lord of the Ascend. Stronger, or more potent than the Lord of the seventh, you may conclude the Native may probably survive the person he Marries; But if the Lord of the seventh be strongest, or the Lord of the Ascendant goes first to Combustion of the Sun, judge the contrary. Note that what hath been said of Mens Marriages, the same may be understood of Womens also; Consideration had to the general Significators mentioned at the beginning of this Section; and for a person to know whether he or she shall marry one of the same Countrey or not, I hold it not worth inserting; for it signifies little, neither are the Rules laid down by the Antients in that particular to be deemed infallible.
rules.translation: 婚寿生死：1宫主强于7宫主=命主或寿过所婚之人；7宫主强、或1宫主先入相太阳焦伤=反断。男女婚姻诸判通用（女命按开篇通征换日/火）；Coley 明言'是否娶同国之人'一事不值得插入，所关甚微、古人规则亦不足为无谬之据。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.2 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant be more strong and potent than the Lord of the seventh, the Native needs not fear the malice of any of his publick Adversaries. Or if the Lord of the seventh be in any good Aspect or Reception with the Lord of the Ascendant or the Moon, the Native will have few or none that shall oppose or molest him. The same you may understand if the Fortunes be well placed in the seventh House. On the contrary, if you find the Infortunes posited there, or the Lord of the seventh in Quartile or Opposition of the Lord of the Ascendant, then the Native shall be perplexed and troubled by the means of his publick Enemies more or less continually. [Ptol. Parv.: 敌之起因——从12宫与7宫主所在之宫及其所主之星取之。]
rules.translation: 公开敌强弱：1宫主强于7宫主=不惧公开之敌；7宫主与1宫主或月吉照/互容、吉星得位居7宫=敌少或无人扰；凶星居7宫、或7宫主与1宫主刑冲=受公开之敌绵延之扰。（附 Ptolemy 小集：敌之起因取自12宫与7宫二主所在之宫，及居7宫或12宫之星所主之宫。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VI S.3 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Here you are to observe the Cusps of the first, fifth, and eleventh Houses, (viz. the Wives fifth House, or House of Issue) together with their Lords: See if there be fruitful Signes possess the Cusps of those Houses; or if their Lords are Fruitful Planets, or Jupiter or Venus posited in Prolifical Signes; if so, these are assured Testimonies the Native shall have Issue.
rules.translation: 有无子女：察1/5/11宫（11=妻之5宫、即子女宫）宫头及其主——宫头落多产星座、其主为多产星、或木金落多产星座=必有子女（确定之证）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lords of the aforementioned Houses, or the Moon be in fruitful Signes, either in Conjunction or good Aspect from Such Signes, it presages the Native shall have many Children. Judge the contrary if you find the Significators in barren Signes, or otherwise much afflicted of the Infortunes, &c.
rules.translation: 子女多少：上述宫主或月亮在多产星座成合相或吉照=子女众多；征象落不毛星座或受凶星重克=反。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.1 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Having seriously considered the Testimonies of fruitfulness and barrenness, judge by the Major Testimonies; if they fall equal, help your self from Revolutions and Directions; but more especially have regard to the stock from whence the Native sprung. It's the greatest Argument of having no Children, when the Lord of the fifth is Retrograde or Combust, especially when the Significator is an Infortune.
rules.translation: 子女有无终判：依多产/无产证之多数决；势均则借流年与方向法辅断，尤须观命主家世血统。绝嗣之大证=5宫主逆行或焦伤（征象星为凶星时尤验）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.1 3；引用 Ptolemy 格言 Circa filiorum numerum difficilis conjectura

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: As to the Life of the Natives Children you are to consider the strength of the Significators; if you find them essentially Dignified, and friendly assisted by Fortunes, you may conclude they will live to a considerable age, and their lives will be sufficiently Fortunate, and conveniently happy. But if you find the Significators weak, and much Afflicted or Debilitated, or Saturn, Mars, or the Dragons Tail posited in the fifth or eleventh Houses, Judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 子女寿命与境况：征象星本然得尊且受吉星相助=子女寿至相当之年、一生幸运安乐；征象弱损、或土火龙尾居5/11宫=反。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.2 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Lord of the fifth in the eighth, or Mercury in Opposition to Saturn, from the first and seventh; or Mars or Saturn in Opposition of Jupiter or Venus, these are strong arguments the Natives Children are but short liv'd, and live to no Maturity.
rules.translation: 子女短命诸证：5宫主落8宫；水星自1宫冲土星于7宫；火或土冲木或金——皆为子女夭折不长成之强证。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.2 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Sex is easily discovered by Collecting the several Significators, if most Masculine judge most males, if most Feminine, say most Females, if they fall equal, conclude as many of the one Sex as of the other, &c. [Ptol. Parv.: 男命盘中，火星若离金星土星而稍近木星之亲，预兆其行房事纯净、谦逊、守自然之道、以节制自持。]
rules.translation: 子女性别：汇总诸征象星之阴阳——阳证多=男多，阴证多=女多，均=男女相当。（附 Ptolemy 小集：男命盘火星若离金星土星而稍近木星之亲，主其房事纯净、知羞、守自然常道、以节制自持。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VII S.2 5；附 Argol 拉丁引文意译

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Here you are to consider the ninth House, the Lord thereof, and Planets posited therein, together with the Moon and Mercury, (and some say Mars) from the consideration of these Significators, &c. Judgment may be drawn whether the Native shall Travel out of his own Native Land yea or no? The Signe of the ninth moveable, and the Lord thereof posited in a moveable Signe, or if there be any Reception between the Moon and Mercury, or Conjunction or Aspect from moveable Signes, this argues the Native may have a propensity to Travel... judge the same if you find Mercury, the Moon, or the Lord of the Ascendant in the ninth; or Mercury & the Moon in the third; or the Lord of the third, or the ninth in the Ascendant. Farther observe whether the Lord of the Ascendant or the Sun be posited in the Houses of the Moon & Mercury, or in Conjunction, Aspect or Reception, with either of them or the Lord of the ninth, these are strong arguments the Native will Travel. Lastly, if you find none of the Significators posited as aforesaid, but the ninth House and his Lord in fixed Signes, &c. Judge the contrary, that the Native will rarely Travel.
rules.translation: 行旅与否：察9宫、其主、宫内星、月亮与水星（或说火星）。动座之9宫及动座之主、月水互容或自动座成合照、水/月/1宫主落9宫、水月在3宫、3宫主或9宫主落升点、1宫主或太阳落月水之宫或与之（或9宫主）合/照/互容=强证远行；诸征象皆不验而9宫及其主落固定座=罕行远路。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you would know towards what part or Quarter of the world the Native shall Travel, then warily observe the Signs and Houses the Significators are posited in... if you find them in the Fiery Triplicity judge Eastward, (and the rather if they are posited in the Eastern quarter of the Figure) if in the Watry Triplicity, Northwards. But if in the Earthy Triplicity, Southwards, &c.
rules.translation: 行旅方位：察征象星所落星座宫位——火象三分=东方（尤落图之东方区）；水象三分=北方；土象三分=南方（风象三分与各国分野详见 Part I 页30/91/115），汇总从多数证。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.1 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
planets: 9宫主/1宫主/2宫主/木/金/龙头/福点
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the ninth and the several Significators of Travel be in good Aspect with the Lord of the Ascendant and second House, or otherwise strong and fortunate, will advantage himself by Travel; but finding them weak and infortunate, or in any bad Aspect of the Native or his Substance, judge the contrary. If you would know what places may be most profitable consider the Signs of the first, second, tenth and eleventh Houses, as also the Signs wherein they are placed, the Lord of the second, Jupiter, Venus, the Dragons Head, or Part of Fortune, and see what Countreys are under those Signes, and to those places let the Native chuse to Travel.
rules.translation: 行旅利否与择地：9宫主及行旅征象星与1宫主/2宫主吉照、或强而有幸=行旅获利；弱而失幸、或恶照命主或其财=反。择利之地：察1/2/10/11宫头之座及2宫主、木金龙头福点所落之座，按各国分野择地而往。（附 Argol：行期依升点或 MC 行至日月火（多次水星）之本体或光线及福点之方向而取。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.1 3；附 Argol 拉丁引文意译

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: He that hath Jupiter, Venus, or the Dragons Head in the ninth or third Houses, in good Aspect or Reception with Jupiter, or of the Sun, Venus, Mercury, or the Moon, these are notable Arguments the Native will be a great lover of Religion, having a strong inclination to Godliness; and in fine, a Vertuous, Religious, Godly person. Judge the same if Saturn be in his Essential Dignities in the ninth. [The Stars do signifie the inclinations of Persons in this particular also, but the operation of their effects are chiefly upon those that continue in their Natural state and condition. It is the grace of God implanted in the heart, that makes persons persue after (and delight in) Godliness; and only the operations of the Spirit of God which causes them to be Religious, &c. The Stars only shew the natural propensity of the Native to good or ill, and the durability thereof.]
rules.translation: 宗教虔诚：木金龙头居9/3宫，与木星、或与日金水月吉照/互容=笃爱宗教、倾心敬虔、为有德敬神之人；土星在9宫得本然尊贵同断。（作者按：星仅示人之自然倾向，惟上帝之恩植于心者使人好敬虔、神之灵使人真宗教——星只示向善向恶之天然趋性与久暂。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.2 1-2；含 Coley 神学立场按语（星只示倾向不决定恩典）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But if Saturn, Mars, or the Dragons Tail be posited in the ninth House weak, or otherwise afflicting the Lord thereof, or the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon, or if Jupiter be afflicted of the Infortunes, these denote the Native to be a person of no Religion, but a meer Atheist, having no inclination to any thing of Godliness, or whatsoever is termed Religious.
rules.translation: 无神论：土火龙尾弱居9宫、或克9宫主/1宫主/月亮，或木星受凶星克=无宗教之人、纯然无神论者，于一切敬虔无向。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.2 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: By what hath been spoken as to the Natives Religion, viz. the position of good Planets in the ninth, &c. may also inform the Student the truth or falsity of the Natives Dreams; for if the ninth house be fixed and fortunate as aforesaid, the Natives Dreams are generally pleasant, and the effects thereof correspondent: so that whatsoever his Dreams be, they usually prove very true, or rarely fail. But on the contrary, if you find the ninth House afflicted by the presence of the Infortunes, or the Lord thereof with Saturn, Mars, or the Dragons Tail you may conclude the Natives Dreams to be terrible, and so hideous, that he is (often times) much afrighted thereby, and whatsoever they be, shall come to prove altogether false, and insignificant. This is the more certain if the Signe of the ninth house be moveable.
rules.translation: 梦之验否：9宫固定而有幸（吉星居9）=梦多甜美、效验相应、大抵皆真罕失；9宫受凶星临或9宫主与土火龙尾同=梦多恐怖狰狞、常受惊骇、所梦皆虚妄无征——9宫落动座尤验。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT VIII S.2 Dreams

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Signficators of Preferment, Honour or Profession of any Native is taken from the Cusp of the Tenth House, the Lord thereof, the Planet, or Planets, and fixed Stars posited therein, having well observed the Significators, and how they behold the Ascendant or his Lord, you may from thence be able to judge of the forementioned particulars appertaining to this House.
rules.translation: 尊贵职业征象星：10宫头、10宫主、宫内诸行星与恒星；并察诸征象如何照升点或其主——据此判断该宫诸事。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX 开篇

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Significators aforesaid well placed in the Figure essentially strong in any good Configuration of the Fortunes, this argues the Native shall attain to a very considerable degree of Fortune and Advancement in the World, and this according to his capacity and quality, or degree of Birth, (for this must (in such cases) alwayes be understood.)
rules.translation: 显达判据：诸征象星得位、本然强、与吉星成吉配置=命主于世间达颇高之福禄地位（按出身才具而定，此永远须如此理解）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: But if the Significators be partly strong, and partly weak, judge a medium, that the Native shall neither come to any great advancement, or become much contemptible in the World, but live in a handsome mean way, never expecting to soar very high, or be greatly dejected.
rules.translation: 中平判据：征象星强弱参半=中等之命——不至高升、亦不为人所轻，安然度日于中平之境，不期高飞、亦不深坠。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Significators debillitated, or afflicted, and located in abject places of the Figure, this intimates the Native shall live in low esteem, and never come to Honour, (except upon the effects of some good Direction of the M.C. That may a little support more than ordinary for a time) but in general, the Natives Credit and Reputation in the world remains obscure, and generally continues at a very low ebb.
rules.translation: 无显达判据：征象星弱损、落卑贱之位=声望低下、终不获荣（纵偶蒙 MC 善方向一时之助）——世誉暗淡、常在低谷。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Sol, or Jupiter posited in the M.C. and well beholding the Ascendant or Lord thereof, or the Moon, denotes much Credit in the world; and that Honour shall be conferred upon the Native considerably. Yet if Saturn, and Mars, or either of them behold them, or cast a Malevolent Aspect unto to the tenth house; it denotes a Catastrophe of the Natives Dignity, and Honour; and that he shall never Ascend so high, but he shall be brought down again with much Disgrace, and Contempt. [Note that the Dignity of the Native will be durable, and of long continuance when the Significators thereof are Angular, and in their own Essential Dignities, strong, and potent, free from the Malevolent Aspects of Saturn, or Mars, or any way supported by the Benevolent Rayes of Jupiter, or Venus.]
rules.translation: 日/木在MC且吉照升点或其主或月=世誉大、获荣甚厚；然土火（或其一）照之或向10宫施恶照=尊荣之灾变——无论登多高，必遭大辱轻贱而坠。附注：征象星角宫、本然尊贵、强而有力、免土火恶照、或受木金吉照支持=其尊位久长。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The general Significators of Magistery are accounted, by the Antients, to be Mars, Venus, and Mercury; Mars declares the strength, and ability of Body; Venus signifies the pleasure and delight any man hath in his Profession; and Mercury denotes the Capacity, and Understanding of the Native. Now if either of these happen to be located in the tenth House, or in any good Aspect to the Lord thereof, these may with more Reason be accepted as Co-significators of the Natives Trade, otherwise they cannot have much to do therein. Therefore (as in all the other Houses) take the Lord of the tenth, or any Planet posited therein, to be Significator of Trade; and according to his signification Judge.
rules.translation: 职业总征：古法以火（体力）、金（职业之乐）、水（才具理解）为 Magistery 通征——三者之一落10宫或与10宫主吉照方得为职业副征象，否则不与闻；最终仍以10宫主或宫内星为职业征象星，按其性判断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX S.2；各星所主职业详见引言部

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Consider the Lord of the tenth, Planets therein, observe also the Signs they are posited in, and the Trades appropriated to those Planets... If in movable Signs, they intimate Witty, Ingenious Professions; if in humane Signs, such Trades as are more Noble, &c. If the Significators be in Fiery Signs, Judge such Trades as are much conversant therein; and this the rather, if the Planet that is Lord of the tenth simpathize therewith; viz. Smiths, Bakers, &c. And all kind of Martial, and Solar Professions. If in Watry Signs, the Native will be inclinable to such kind of Professions, as Water-men, Saylors, Brewers, Vintners, &c. and all kind of Lunar Professions. If in Airy Signs, it portends all kind of pleasant delightful Professions, as Milliners, Musitioners, Painters, &c. and all Venerial, and Mercurial Imployments. If in the Earthy Signs, it denotes such Professions that relate only to the Earth, viz. all kind of Husbandry, Digging, Sowing, Planting, &c. and all Saturnine vulgar Professions.
rules.translation: 职业细则：动座=机智巧思之业；人形座=较尊贵之业；火象座=火属诸业（铁匠面包师等，10宫主同象尤验）及一切武职日属之业；水象座=船夫水手酿家酒商等月属之业；风象座=愉悦之业（帽商乐师画师等）及一切金水之务；土象座=土属之业（农垦掘种植）及土星俗业。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX S.3 1-6

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Sun is the chief Significator of Honour, and Soveraignty; and being posited in the M.C. in a Fiery Sign, with Jupiter, Venus, or Mars in his own House, declares that the Native shall undoubtedly attain to great Dignity, and Honour, and come to bear Rule in the World. The same if the three superiours are strong and potent, the one having great Dignities in the tenth House, the other in the Ascendant. That Person born at Noon the same Day the Sun enters Aries, or Leo, shall assuredly mount to great Soveraignty and Dominion; or if Jupiter in a Diurnal Geniture happen to be posited in the tenth House in Trine to Sol, Judge the same. The Moon denotes Soveraignty by being placed in her Exaltation in Conjunction with Venus, or in her own House in Conjunction with Jupiter; and this more especially if placed in the tenth House: the same if she behold Sol, or Jupiter by a Trine Aspect, and be with Kingly fixed Stars. The Sun, Jupiter, and Mars in Trine from Fiery Signs, or Sol, Jupiter, and Venus joyned to regal fixed Stars of the first Magnitude, do declare the Native shall be preferred to a very considerable Degree of Honour, and Soveraignty in the World.
rules.translation: 主权格言一至四：①日为荣与主权之首征，落MC之火象座、且木金火（任一）在其本宫=必登大位、执掌天下；三上星（土木火）皆强、一于10宫有大尊贵一在升点亦然。②生于太阳入白羊或狮子当日正午=必升大主权；昼生木星居10宫三合太阳同断。③月亮在擢升处合金、或本宫合木（尤居10宫）=主权；月三合日或木、且近王者恒星亦然。④日木火自火象座三合、或日木金合一等王者恒星=命主获相当之高荣主权。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX S.3 Aphorismes 7-10

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.rule_type: 宫判-第十宫-主权格言凶
rules.original_text: Saturn in the tenth, or in Opposition thereunto, and the Lord of the tenth in a Fiery Sign, conjoyned with Mars, this denotes that Native, though arrived to a very high pitch of Honour, shall be brought to a fatal end. If Saturn, or Luna shall be in Quartile or Opposition to the Lord of the tenth, or the Sun, it signifies that Person then Born shall be strangely Ruined, and come to nothing, by vulgar Rusticks, and such as were abundantly beneath him, Comparatively as much as the Dignity of a King transcends that of a Beggar.
rules.translation: 主权格言五至六：⑤土星在10宫或冲10宫，10宫主落火象座与火合=虽登高位，终遭致命之败。⑥土或月与10宫主或太阳刑冲=所生之人竟为乡野俗夫等远在其下之辈所毁、归于乌有（其落差如王尊之于丐贱）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT IX S.3 Aphorismes 11-12

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Cusp of the eleventh house, or Lord thereof, well Fortified, or Benevolent Planets posited therein, or friendly beholding it; this argues the Native shall meet with faithful Friends, and such as he may confidently impose trust in. The contrary is easily discovered by what hath been said before.
rules.translation: 友之有无：11宫头或其主坚固、吉星居11宫或吉照之=遇忠实可信托之友；反则易知。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 并居=真假兼有/刑冲=少而伪
rules.original_text: If good and bad Planets are posited in the eleventh House, or are in Aspect unto it, or the Lord thereof; Judge the Native shall have Friends of two sorts, some real, others pretenders; and if so be they behold the Lord of the eleventh by Quartile, or Opposition, it intimates a scarcity of Friends, and those few that are, to be very mutable Persons, Inconstant, False, Perfideous, and by no means to be trusted unto, as having no real Love for the Native.
rules.translation: 友之真假：吉凶星并居11宫或共照之=友分两色——有真友有假友；凶星以刑冲照11宫主=友少，且此少数多变、无常、虚伪、背信，绝不可信托（无真爱于命主）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.1 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.rule_type: 宫判-第十一宫-双盘友谊
rules.original_text: If by any means the Genitures of both Persons can be procured, you may easily discover their Friendship whether it be real, or the contrary, by comparing them together, thus, viz. If in your Friends Nativity you find the Sun, or Moon, or Ascendant in Sextile, or Trine, to their places in the Natives Geniture; or if the eleventh house in the one, the Ascendant in the other, or the contrary: These are Arguments of Friendship. The same Judge if the Lord of the Ascendant, and the eleventh House in each others Geniture be in Sextile, or Trine, or Planets that are Naturally Friends, if none of these things be; but instead of Sextiles, and Trines, you find Quartiles, and Oppositions, &c. You may conclude the contrary, because you find a disagreement. This is according to Ptolomy's Rule Centiloq. Aphr. 33.
rules.translation: 双盘友谊判法（Ptolemy 格言33）：若得二人命盘——友盘中日月或升点与己盘中其位成六合/三合；或一方11宫与另一方升点互成（或反之）；或双方1宫主与对方11宫主互成六合/三合、或天然相善之星互照=真友谊；若只见刑冲=相背失和、断为无谊。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.1 3；依 Ptolemy Centiloquium Aph.33

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Contrary to the mind of some Authors, if Cancer be Horoscopical the Native rarely procures Friends; and this the rather if the Moon be weak, or afflicted; or if she be in Conjunction of Jupiter in Capricorn, (or Venus in Scorpio) Judge the same.
rules.translation: 友之格言一：巨蟹升=罕得真友（与某些作者意见相反）；月弱受克尤验；月与木星合于摩羯（或金在蝎）同断。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.2 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 上星吉照=友证显/多照=友多
rules.original_text: All the Planets above the Earth, and the Lord of the Ascendant in good Aspect with the superiours, they being strong, and potent, or the Light of the Time above the Earth, and in any good Aspect of Saturn, Jupiter, or Mars, being Essentially dignified, are Eminent Testimonies of Friendship. The same if many Planets are in Reception, or friendly beholding the Ascendant. The Moon, or Lord of the Ascendant in Aspect with many Planets, or many Planets Located in the first, or eleventh Houses, signifies the Native shall meet with diversity of Friends.
rules.translation: 友之格言二：众星居地平上且1宫主与上星（土木火）吉照（彼等强而有力）、或时主光体在地平上且与得本然尊贵之土木火吉照=友谊显著之证；多星互容或吉照升点亦然。月或1宫主与多星成照、或多星居1/11宫=命主友朋多样。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.2 2-3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If Jupiter, or Venus do both behold the Ascendant, or his Lord, or the eleventh House, &c. It presages many Faithful, Honest Friends; or if Jupiter, and Venus be located in the eleventh House, or in the fifth, tenth, seventh, or ninth Houses; this denotes the Native shall enjoy many Eminent, and Worthy Friends, and such as will assist him in his greatest extremity.
rules.translation: 友之格言三：木星与金星同照升点、其主或11宫=多忠实正直之友；木金居11宫，或居5/10/7/9宫=命主得众多显赫贵重之友，于其最困厄时相济。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT X S.2 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 失位=奸暗敌/得尊=贵而毒
rules.original_text: Observe the Lord of the twelfth House, and Ascendant, also the Planet, or Planets, posited in the twelfth house, and their Configuration with the Lord of the Ascendant; and thence Judge the Qualities, and Conditions of the private Enemies of the Native. Many Planets ill disposed in the twelfth House, Intimates many Treacherous Enemies, unknown to the Native. But if they are essentially Dignified there, they denote private Enemies, but of more Noble Spirits, and such Persons as are more able to vend their Malice against the Native.
rules.translation: 暗敌状况：察12宫主、1宫主、12宫内诸星及其与1宫主之配置。12宫多星失位=多不为人知之奸诈暗敌；若彼等本然得尊=暗敌而性较高贵、更能施其恶意。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.1 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.rule_type: 宫判-第十二宫-暗敌多寡
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Ascendant in the twelfth, or Lord of the twelfth in the Ascendant, signifies that the Native shall have divers secret Adversaries, of whom he ought to be exceeding careful; for he shall receive much prejudice by their means: But if no Planet be posited in the twelfth House, or there be a Benevolent Aspect between the Lord of the twelfth, and the Lord of the Ascendant; this argues the Native shall have none, or at least so few that he will be sensible of no Injury from them. If the Lord of the twelfth be in Conjunction with Mercury and the Moon in the seventh house, it argues the Native shall be perplexed continually with a company of Inveterate, Malitious Adversaries; and this the more certain if they behold the Lord of the Ascendant by an ill Aspect.
rules.translation: 暗敌多寡：1宫主落12宫或12宫主落升点=多秘密之敌、须极谨慎（其害大）；12宫无星、或12宫主与1宫主吉照=无暗敌或少至不觉其害。12宫主与水星合、而月在7宫=为积恶毒敌之群所缠扰（恶照1宫主尤验）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.1 3-4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Lastly, If you find the Lord of the twelfth stronger and better Fortified than the Lord of the Ascendant, the Natives Enemies will overcome; But on the contrary if the Lord of the Ascendant be strongest the Native will prevail over his private Enemies.
rules.translation: 敌我强弱：12宫主强于1宫主=暗敌胜；1宫主强=命主克敌。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.1 5

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If you find the Infortunes in Quartile, or Opposition to the Sun, or Moon, in Signs of a violent Nature, and posited in the seventh, or twelfth houses; this signifies that the Native will be very subject to suffer by Imprisonment, and Captivity: Judge the same if the Sun, or Moon, are posited in the twelfth house, or in Opposition to the Lord of the Ascendant in the sixth house; or if you find the Infortunes, or the Moon in the fourth, it declares the same; and so doth Mars, and Venus in the eighth, in Quartile, or Opposition of the Infortunate Planet, Saturn.
rules.translation: 囚禁诸证：凶星于凶暴星座自7/12宫刑冲日月；日月落12宫；日或月与6宫之1宫主对冲；凶星或月落4宫；火与金在8宫刑冲凶星土星——皆主命主易遭囚禁俘系之苦。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.2 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 水月12=尝囚/土7冲日月=狱终
rules.original_text: Mercury, and Luna, posited in the twelfth House, signifies the Native shall be well acquainted with Imprisonment. And if Saturn be in Opposition to the Sun, or Moon, and posited in the seventh House; this denotes the Native shall end his dayes in Prison.
rules.translation: 囚禁详证：水星与月亮落12宫=命主将深知囚禁之味；土星落7宫冲日或月=终老狱中。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.2 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Sol, Saturn, and Mercury, posited in the tenth House, and in an evil Aspect of Mars, argues the Native will be guilty of Robbery, and sometimes Murther; and consequently Imprisonment, and in the end, Death by the Law.
rules.translation: 刑杀之证：日、土、水居10宫且受火星恶照=命主犯盗窃、或竟杀人，因而入狱，终死于法。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.2 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Lastly, When the Significators of Imprisonment are Located in fixed Signs, this presages long, and tedious Captivity, and Restraint; But if the Benevolent Planets Interpose their friendly Rayes, and behold well the several Significators, it intimates the Native will gain his liberty by the means of such Persons signified by them. [The Premisas being well considered, 'tis no matter of difficulty to Judge concerning the Natives success in great Cattle, as Horses, Cows, Oxen, &c. or the contrary.]
rules.translation: 囚期长短：囚禁征象星落固定座=久长之苦囚；吉星施吉照护诸征象=将由其所表之人获释。（附：据上述诸判，亦不难断命主于大牲畜（马牛等）之得失成败。）
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XI S.2 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照=自然死/无暴证=不惧暴死
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon be in good Aspect, viz. Sextile, or Trine with the Lord of the fourth, or eighth Houses; this (according to the Rules of Astrology) Indicates a Natural Death. Judge the same if the Fortunes be Located in the eighth House, or if they are weak there, provided they are Sextile, or Trine to the Lord of the Ascendant, or the Moon, it prenotes no less. If neither the Lord of the Horoscope, or the Moon, or Lord of the eighth House be posited in violent Signs, or near violent fixed Stars, the Native need not fear a violent Death.
rules.translation: 自然死之证：1宫主或月亮与4宫主或8宫主六合/三合=自然之死；吉星居8宫（或弱居8宫）且六合/三合1宫主或月亦然；1宫主、月、8宫主皆不落凶暴星座、不近凶暴恒星=无须惧暴死。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.1 1

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the eighth, or Planets in the eighth House be strong, and Fortified Essentially, it argues he shall dye a very easie Death, and drop away insensibly.
rules.translation: 安易之死：8宫主或8宫内星强而本然坚固=死极安易、不知不觉而逝。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.1 2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Sun, or Mars Lord of the eighth, and posited therein in Cancer, Scorpio, or Pisces; it signifies the Native shall expire by a Disease occasioned from a superabounding of Hot, and Moist Humours; so Mercury Lord of the eighth in Quartile, or Opposition of Saturn, shews the Native shall dye of a very potent Melancholy; but Mars being the afflicting planet threatens Death by a Vertigo, or Megrim in the Brain, &c.
rules.translation: 病性之死：日或火为8宫主落巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼=死于热湿体液过盛之疾；水星为8宫主而刑冲土星=死于极重之忧郁（黑胆汁）症；火星为克星=死于眩晕/头风（偏头痛）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.1 3

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 火克=花柳/土克=麻风黄疸
rules.original_text: If Venus be Lady of the eighth House and afflicted by Mars, it advises the Native to beware of Death, occasioned from a Venereal Distemper, viz. Gonorrhea, or Morbus Gallicus, &c. But if Saturn afflict Venus it threatens a Leprosie, Illiack Passion, Black-Jaundies, &c.
rules.translation: 金病之死：金为8宫主受火星克=慎死于花柳病（淋病、梅毒等）；受土星克=麻风、肠绞痛（Illiack Passion）、黑黄疸等之危。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.1 4

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Sun, or Moon evilly beholding from Angles, or Otherwise afflicted by the Infortunes, this signifies a Violent Death; and this the rather, if Saturn, or Mars bear Rule in the house of Death: The same if the Sun, or Moon are posited near Violent Fixed Stars, or in Violent Signs, and in no Aspect together. The Infortunes Conjoyned in the M.C. or in Opposition from Angles, and posited in Violent Signs, presages a Violent Death: The same if the Lord of the Ascendant be posited in the eighth in a Violent Sign, or with Violent Fixed Stars; or otherwise afflicted by Saturn, or Mars, or if the Lord of the eighth be weak in the Ascendant in such Signs, or with such Stars; These are strong Testimonies (in Art) the Native shall dye a Death unnatural.
rules.translation: 暴死诸证：日月自角宫恶照或受凶星克=暴死（土火掌死宫尤验）；日月近凶暴恒星、或落凶暴星座且彼此无照；凶星合于MC、或自角宫对冲且落凶暴星座；1宫主落8宫之凶暴星座/近凶暴恒星、或受土火克；8宫主弱落升点之凶暴星座或近凶暴恒星——皆为死于非命之强证。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.2 1-2

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The kinds of Violent Death that a Man may dye are somewhat scrupulous and nice points absolutely to determine, but Astrologers have given divers Rules for the knowledge of the same; as Guido, Bonatus, Origanus, Albubatur, Schoner, and others; unto which I refer those that desire to be farther satisfied in this point and all the other also; or to Mr. Lilly's Works, who is very copious in this matter. But an Artist may nearly guess at the kind of Violent Death, by a due consideration of the nature of the afflicting Planet, and Signs they are In; and so Judge whether the Native may expire by Drowning, Hanging, Killing, Beheading, or by Falls from High places.
rules.translation: 暴死种类：绝对断定暴死之种类颇为棘手，诸家（Guido、Bonatus、Origanus、Albubatur、Schoner 等及详于此事之 Lilly 著作）各有规则可参；术者可依克星之性与所落星座近略猜其死法——溺、缢、被杀、斩首、或高处坠亡。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.2 3；Coley 荐读 Lilly 等

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: Hyleg 行至杀星恶相位=致死
rules.original_text: In the first house you are shewed how to find the giver of Life, and here it will be necessary to shew how to find the Interficient, or Killing Planet, vulgarly called Anareta, and that is the Lord of the eighth, or a Planet posited therein, or that hath great Dignities in the eighth House. Now when the giver of Life is Directed to the Conjunction, Quartile, or Opposition of the Anareta, this is accounted Mortal; and the rather, if it happen to be Saturn, or Mars, and contrary in nature to the Hyleg; the same may be understood if either of the Luminaries be so Directed, not withstanding they neither of them be propagator of Life. Or when the Ascendant, or either of the Lights be Directed to any of the Malevolent Aspects of Saturn, or Mars, especially having Dignities in the House of Death, and contrary in Nature to the Sign Ascending or place where the Direction falls, being much debilitated there; this hath been often experienced to cut assunder the thread of Life.
rules.translation: Anareta（杀星/致死星）：=8宫主、或8宫内之星、或于8宫有大尊贵之星。寿主（Hyleg）方向行至杀星之合/刑/冲=致死（土火为杀星且与Hyleg性相反尤验；日月如此被方向亦同，纵非寿主亦然）。升点或日月行至土火之恶照，尤彼等掌死宫、与升座或方向所落之位性相反且在该处极弱——屡验为斩断生命之线。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.2 Anareta

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 吉照/流年行运相抵=可缓免
rules.original_text: And it rarely fails to prove fatal to the Native, unless there happen another Direction at the same time to mittigate it, or the Revolution, and Transits contradict it, to which I may add if the Fortunes beheld the place of the Direction Radically, or at that present time by Transit; these may indeed mittigate the force of the Killing Direction, and so the Native may possibly escape at that time. Note that it is dangerous for the Ascendant to be directed to the Opposition of the Sun, or Moon, or the Luminaries to the Quartile, or Opposition of each other, having respect how the Direction falls, as before Intimated.
rules.translation: 致死方向之缓释：罕有失效，除非同时另有方向相缓、或流年（Revolution）与行运（Transits）相抵，再加吉星于本命或当时行运照临方向所落之位——皆可缓杀向之力，命主或能当时幸免。注意：升点行至日月之冲、或日月互为刑冲之方向亦险（视方向所落如何，如前所述）。
rules.notes: CHAP X SECT XII S.2 Anareta 续

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: A Direction (or rather a Deduction) is defined by Argol to be the Arch of the Aequator, intercepted between two places in the Heavens, viz. The Artificial measure of its Progress, which the Promissor doth absolve by the Motion of the Primum Mobile; or to Direct, is to find what Degrees of the AEquator pass through the Meridian, while the Promissor (or place inferiour) by the aforesaid Motion comes to the point of the Significator, (or place superiour) i.e. Until the Promissor comes to the very Semicircle of Position of the Significator. this Motion in Directions is real, and no way feigned.
rules.translation: Directions（方向/推运）定义（Argol）：赤道上夹于两处天位之间的弧——Promissor 借 Primum Mobile（原动天）之动所履行的人工进度量；即 Promissor（下位）行至 Significator（上位）之位置圈（Semicircle of Position）时，有多少赤道度经过子午线——此动真实不虚。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT I；Argol 法=Regiomontanus 法，为全欧通行

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: Others (and in particular one very Learned in Astronomy) defines Directions to be the Harmony of the Earth's Annual, and Diurnal Revolutions about the Sun; and Profections are defined to be the Harmony of the Moon's Mensural, and Diurnal Revolution about the Earth; from this ground; Keplar's Method of Direction is termed a most Demonstrative way. Yet Argol's Method is now generally received, and practised by all Astrologers of Europe, and is the same with Regiomontanus, the which hath been followed by many Learned Astronomers, and Mathematicians, as Johannes Keplerus, Tycho, the Danian School, Johannes, Antonius, Maginus, and others.
rules.translation: 另说（某深通天文者）：Directions=地球绕日周年与周日二动之和谐；Profections（岁进）=月绕地月周与周日二动之和谐——开普勒之法由此得名'最富论证性'。然 Argol 法（即 Regiomontanus 法）为今全欧星占家通行，开普勒、第谷、丹麦学派、Johannes、Antonius、Maginus 等皆从之。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT I II

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 五 Hylegiacals=升/天顶/日月/福点
rules.original_text: By a Significator you are to understand any Planet or place of the Ecliptick, that may signifie any matter, or thing in the Heavens, about the affection of the Native; as Life, Manners of the Mind, Preferment, Fortune, and any other thing... for which Prolong aligned the Ascendant, Mid-heaven, Sol, Luna, and Part of Fortune: These five are termed Hylegiacals, and Significators, by whose Directions all Accidents, as well prosperous, as unfortunate, are pointed out, according as they meet with the Bodies, or Aspects of Benevolent, or Malevolent Stars. This Opinion is generally followed, others have added the rest of the Planets, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury for Significators also... as also the Cusps of the Coelestial Houses, according to their several Significations; as the second House for Riches, the seventh for Marriage.
rules.translation: Significator（应征星）：行星或黄道之点，表征命主之事（寿命、心性、荣位、财帛等）。Prolong 定五 Hylegiacal 应征星：升点、天顶、太阳、月亮、福点——诸祸福事故皆按其方向所遇吉凶星之体或相而显。通行之说；他人复加土木火金水五星及各宫宫头为应征星（如2宫主财、7宫主婚）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT I III

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.original_text: The Promissor (or Promittor) is that point of the Ecliptick wherein the Body, or Aspect of any Star, or Planet that is said to be Directed unto, (or rather brought to the place of the Significator, as before noted) which may discry, or promise any thing to the Native, either good, or evil, denoted, or signified by the Significator. There is another sort of Direction which by Astrologers is termed Converse, or Retrograde, that is to bring the Significator to the Promissor, which is contrary to the Primum Mobile, and by Argol utterly abolish'd as feigned, and without a Foundation.
rules.translation: Promissor（应期星/承诺星）：被方向引至（带至）Significator 之位的黄道点——即被方向之星体或相位，预示命主吉凶。另有 Converse（逆行方向）：把 Significator 引向 Promissor，与 Primum Mobile 相逆，Argol 斥为虚设无据而全废之。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT I IV-V

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 取 Promissor 之圈，差为方向弧
rules.original_text: Converse Direction taken in the right sense, is nothing discrepant from direct Direction, as is testified by Carol, Antonius, Maginus in his Nova Dirigendi Ars, Printed 1626. But only in taking the Poles Elevation above the Circle of Position. For as in direct Directions you are to take the Circle of Position of the Significator; and so direct the Promissor under that Pole. So here in Converse Directions you are to take the Circle of Position of the Promissor only, and not the Significator, and under that Pole find the Ascention, or Descention of the Significator, and Substract the Oblique Ascention of the Promissor from the Oblique Ascention of the Significator, &c., and the difference is the Ark of Direction required.
rules.translation: Converse（逆行方向）正解：与顺行方向无异（Carolus、Antonius、Maginus《Nova Dirigendi Ars》1626 证之），惟位置圈取法相反——顺行取 Significator 之位置圈、Promissor 在该极下方向；Converse 则只取 Promissor 之位置圈，在该极下求 Significator 之斜升/斜降，以 Promissor 之斜升/斜降减之，差即所求方向弧。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT I V 末；例：升2°天秤、木星三合落处女5°10'（12宫），其位置圈极46°2'，升斜升183°24'−三合点斜升147°21'=方向弧36°3'

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 北纬减斜升/南纬增斜升
rules.original_text: all that are skilful in Mathematical Demonstrations, do unanimously agree that the Latitude of the Planets in Directions ought every where to be observed. for every Man... may easily apprehend that the Stars do unequally arise with, and without Latitude; so in these Northern Countreys that have Oblique Horizons where the North Pole is Elevated, 'tis apparent that a Star with North Latitude riseth sooner, and sets later than the place of the Ecliptick; and contrarily, those Stars having South Latitude, rise later, and set sooner than the place of the Ecliptick they are in.
rules.translation: 方向须察纬度：凡通数学论证者皆同意方向中行星纬度处处须计——北纬之星较黄道位早升迟落，南纬之星迟升早落；故北纬减小斜升、南纬增大斜升（例：伦敦纬度白羊10°无纬斜升4°10'，北纬1°=2°36'，南纬1°=5°43'）。
rules.notes: CHAP XXIII SECT II 1-2；斜降则反之（北纬增大、南纬减小）

rules.book: Clavis Astrologiae Elimata (1676, 2nd ed.), Henry Coley, with William Lilly's commendatory preface
rules.result: 四分0、冲=合反号、六合=半纬同号、三合=半纬反号
rules.original_text: if you Direct only to the Aspects of the Planets (which never have much Latitude, neglecting the Aspects of the Fixed Stars, as all Modern Astrologers do, except Hartgil) there needs no AEquation in the Longitude for the Sextile, or Trine Aspect, at eight degrees of Latitude (which is the most the Planets have) alters but 14 minutes in the Longitude... therefore to AEquate the Aspects only according to Argol is altogether sufficient. Argol, and others take half the Latitude in the Sextile, and Trine, and the side 60 degrees in the Ecliptick... the Quartile terminates in the Ecliptick, and therefore hath no Latitude, the Opposition the same Latitude but of the contrary denominator, to that of the Conjunction; But in a Trine, or Sextile, take half the Latitude (as before proved) the Sextile is of the same, and the Trine of the contrary denomination, of the Latitude in the Conjunction. To this Aequation Argol subscribes, agreeing with Observations in above 1000 Genitures.
rules.translation: 相位纬度归算（Argol/Blanchinus 法）：仅方向于行星相位（非恒星）时，无需黄经归算——行星纬度最多8°者，其六合/三合在黄经上仅差14分，可略；四分终止于黄道故无纬度，冲相纬度同合相而符号相反，六合取同号之半纬、三合取反号之半纬。Argol 依此归算，自称验于千余盘。
