rules.translation: 十二宫含义表：1生命身体/2资产财富仆人/3兄弟姊妹亲戚短途信义宗教/4父亲房屋土地遗产藏宝终点/5子女恋爱使节礼物/6疾病仆役小牲畜/7婚姻妇女争讼战争公开敌放逐劫盗买卖逃亡者/8死亡劳苦悲忧死者遗产/9宗教信仰异象智慧梦预兆长途大使半生/10王权帝国尊荣官职技艺母亲失物/11希望信任朋友王恩赞誉/12秘密敌欺诈忌妒监禁恶念耳语大牲畜。
rules.notes: 每宫三分主：第一主=少年期/第二主=中年/第三主=老年（各宫略异）

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: The first lord of the triplicity showeth the life and nature... By the second lord we do judge the force and strength of his body, and the middle age of his life. The third bath the same significations as the two first lords and governeth the old age.
rules.translation: 三分主分期法：第一主=事项之始/少年、第二主=中段/中年、第三主=末段/老年——适用于各宫之三分主（各宫按事项微调）。
rules.notes: 如 4 宫：一主=父、二主=城堡城邑、三主=万事之终

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: The second house doth always give certain judgements of the substance or riches of the house that goes before him; the third house of the brethren... And these significations are not only gathered beginning at the ascendant, but also take their beginning at every house... as if any man would ask in what house the substance or riches of the uncles is to be placed... the fourth house doth signify the father, and the third house from any other house doth signify the brethren. Therefore the sixth house... doth signify the uncles on the father's behalf, and the substance and riches of the uncles is contained in the seventh house, because it is the second house to the sixth.
rules.translation: 衍生宫位算法：任一宫作起点，以宫位相对序号推演（如问叔父之财：父=4宫，叔父=4之3宫=6宫，其财=6之2宫=7宫）；全 12 宫均可用此法展开无穷含义。
rules.notes: 1宫从12宫计=秘密敌之财；从10宫计=王之父等

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: The Lord therefore of the ascendant or of another house, is the planet which hath most dignities or greatest strength in that place... placing your index upon the fifth degree of Aries... I do see the Sun to be exalted in Aries and therefore to have four virtues... he hath also a dignity of a triplicity because the question is by day, and therefore hath three virtues, but Mars, because Aries is his house, he hath there five dignities and one by a face, Jupiter also lord of a term, hath there two dignities, the Sun therefore is lord or almuten of the ascendant because he doth excel with most dignities... but if two planets be found having like dignity in the same place, then must it be marked if any of them be in the ascendant within 2, 3, or 4 degrees near to the beginning of the first house... If none of them be in the ascendant then look if they do behold the ascendant... then which of them is strongest in the heaven, that is, if one of them be in an angle and the other in a succeeding house... then look which of them is in a degree most agreeable to his nature... Finally, if they be in all points alike, then the house is preferred before the other dignities, and the exaltation before the triplicity, the triplicity before the term, and the term before the face.
rules.translation: Almuten（宫主）计算算法：①尊贵计分求和（庙5/擢4/三分3/界2/面1，昼夜三分取昼主或夜主）②同分则取更近宫尖者（2-4°内）③无则在宫内者④照宫者（强相位）⑤角>续>果⑥度性质合宜者⑦仍平则庙>擢>三分>界>面。例：白羊5°=日擢4+三分3=7 vs 火庙5+面1=6 vs 木界2→日为almuten。
rules.notes: 判序链为机器可编码；例 2：白羊22°火=庙5+界2=7 vs 日=擢4+三分3=7，日居10宫四分照升点胜出为主、火分享

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: if the time of your figure be spoken for the afternoon, after the same manner you must seek out the degree of the Sun for your hour appointed... You must enter... in the column... under the title of the 10th house, going directly to the left hand in a little column, whose inscription is tempus a meridian... also because the Sun in six hours space doth run 15 minutes of a degree of the zodiac, by his proper motion, and to those 15 minutes doth answer one quarter of a degree of the equinoctial, the which quarter is in value one minute of time. Therefore for every six hours in the afternoon add one minute of time... But if the number of hours and minutes gathered, do surmount 24, then take away those 24...
rules.translation: 起盘法（Regiomontanus 表）：正午=日度置于 10 宫尖；午后=查 tempus a meridian 列，时数入表取 10/11/12/1/2/3 宫，其余六宫取对宫反度；午后每 6 时加 1 分时（日行 15′=赤道 1/4°=1 分时）；超 24 时减 24。

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: the degree of his place is in another house... for the character of the sign is written again when there is another sign marked in the beginning of any house... In this figure the Sun is found in the 15th degree of Aries... not in the tenth house, although the character of Aries be there marked, but in the ninth house, because that house bath his beginning with the 25 degree of Pisces, and doth end with the 26 of Aries.
rules.translation: ,行星入宫放置：按黄经度数所在之宫放置（非按星座符号所在）；宫界内符号重标。例：日 15° 白羊属 9 宫（9 宫起双鱼 25° 至白羊 26°）。
rules.notes: 龙首在星历标注，龙尾恒为对宫

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: The part of life in the day time is gathered from Jupiter to Saturn, and in the night contrariwise, and both times are projected from the ascendant. The part of fortune in the day time is taken from the Sun unto the Moon, and in the night from the Moon unto the Sun, and both day and night, like the part of life, is added to the ascendant. The part of death, as well by night as by day, is gathered from the Moon to the degree of the 8th house, and is projected from the sign wherein Saturn is. The part of the interficient or killing planet is reckoned in the day time from the lord of the ascendant to the Moon, contrariwise from the Moon to the lord of the ascendant, and is projected from the ascendant.
rules.translation: 阿拉伯点公式：生命点=昼(木→土)/夜(土→木)，投射自 ASC；福点=昼(日→月)/夜(月→日)，+ASC；死亡点=月→8宫头，投射自土星宫；杀手点=昼(升主→月)/夜(月→升主)，+ASC。
rules.notes: 计算：星座序数相减+ASC；不够减加 12 宫（例：昼图福点=月2宫3°11′-日0°15°5′+ASC4宫10°=处女28°06′）

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: First therefore the 7th house and the lord thereof are to be considered, for if the 7th house be letted by the aspect or presences of malign planets, or his lord be letted... you may not safely give judgment... Furthermore it is diligently to be marked whether the question be radical or no, which is known if the lord of the ascendant and lord of the hour be one, or of one triplicity or nature. For this constellation rising, the question is radical, contrariwise it is not.
rules.translation: 判前检查：①7 宫或其主受克（落陷/逆行/燃烧等）→不可判（Ptolemy 箴言 14）；②radical 判据=升主与时主同星或同三分/同性质→问题成立，否则不立。
rules.notes: 此二则不用于本命与已知确定时辰之问

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: the ascendant and his lord is to be attributed unto the querent or mover of the question, and the house that signifieth the thing that is demanded and his lord is attributed unto the question or thing demanded. The Moon, which in every question is common, is attributed always with the ascendant and his lord unto him that moveth the question... many times you must take many significators, as in those things which are done by personages or ambassadors coming between... the planet from which the Moon is separated is to be joined... And the planet whereunto the Moon doth apply, with the house that signify the thing demanded, with the lord of the same, is to be given to the question... if it be a man that is the querent, you shall join the Sun unto the other significators... if it be a woman, Venus is joined... and the Sun to the thing that is demanded.
rules.translation: 征象星分配：升点与主+月=问卦者；所问之宫与主=所问之事；月所离之星并入问卦者侧、月所就之星并入所问侧；男问加日、女问加金（所问侧反之）。
rules.notes: 婚姻例：问者=ASC主+月+月所离星+日；所求=7宫主+月所就星+金

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: which happens by four means and ways, that is to say, by conjunction, by translation of light and nature, by collection of light, and by being in houses: when as therefore the lord of the ascendant, the significator of the thing demanded, be either corporally joined or by aspect, the thing demanded without all doubt shall come to pass, especially if the conjunction be in the ascendant... Secondly it is brought to perfection by translation of light and nature... Thirdly, things are brought to pass when there is collection of their light by a planet more weighty than the lord of the ascendant or significator of the thing demanded... Fourthly, and finally, things are finished by the dwelling of planets in houses, for if the significators of any thing be in the first house, especially if they be received, it doth argue the thing shall come to pass without labour. But if the lord of the horoscope or the Moon... be in the house of the thing demanded, it shows that it shall come to pass, but with much labour and travail.
rules.translation: 成事四法：①合相（升主与事主合或相位，尤在升点）②光线传递③光线聚集（重于双方之星为中介，尤有接收）④入宫（事征象入 1 宫=无劳而成；问者主/月入事宫=有劳而成）。
rules.notes: 1555/6/6 12:56 判例：月传光=得兄弟之财；聚集不成立（无更重之星）；事主入升点=得

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: if unto every degree that is between their conjunction or aspect to Jupiter, or part of fortune, or one significator to another, you do give a day, a week, month or year, according to the qualities of the signs... The moveable signs do determine hours or days; the common signs months or weeks, the fixed signs months or years.
rules.translation: 时限判定：以两征象星（或至木星/福点）之间度数计——每度=日/周/月/年按星座性质：动宫=时或日、共宫=月或周、固宫=月或年。

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: look whether the lord of the ascendant, the Moon, or the lord of the 8th house be joined together, for that shows that the man is departed this life... if there be any application between the lord of the second house, the Moon, and the lord of the first house or not, also you must look if there be any translation of light and nature between them... If the lord of the third house be in the sixth, or the lord of the sixth in the third... it shows that he is sick... if the significators of the brother be in the seventh house... it shows that he hath or shall marry a wife... if these dispositions be found with the lord of the eighth house... it shows that he is dead.
rules.translation: 判例总则（宫位组合判据）：生死问=升主/月/8 宫主互合或传光、8 宫主在升点、升主在地角=死；财问=2 宫主/月/1 宫主互应用或传光/聚集、2 宫主在升点吉、福点或升主在 2 宫吉；兄弟问=3 宫主入 6 宫或 6 宫主入 3=病、入 7 宫=婚、会 8 宫主=死。
rules.notes: 征象星与吉星合=佳，与凶星=反

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: If the almuten of the ascendant or significator do behold any planet being in an angle it doth declare conception, contrariwise if they, being in an angle, do behold a planet in a falling house, or there be a moveable sign in the ascendant or any malign planet, it shows that there is no conception... but a fixed sign in the ascendant with a fortunate planet in the same, foreshows true conception... Now if you desire to know... whether she shall bring forth a man child or a woman, behold whether the lord of the ascendant, the Moon, and the lord of the fifth house be in masculine signs, or the most of them, for that doth signify the woman bears a man child... likewise mark if the lord of the hour and the lord of the house of children and the Moon or two of them be in masculine signs.
rules.translation: 生育判例：受孕=升主/征象星照角上行星；不受孕/流产=照果宫行星、升点动宫或凶星在升；真孕=升点固宫+吉星在升、5 宫主强入 5 宫且受月照、5 宫主强在升/10 宫；生男=升主/月/5 宫主多数在阳座（或时主+5 宫主+月 3 取 2 阳座），生女反之。

rules.book: A Brief and Most Easie Introduction to the Astrologicall Judgement of the Starres（卜卦总纲）
rules.author: Claudius Dariot（法国博恩医生；拉丁原文 1557《Ad Astrorum Judicia Facilis Introductio》、法文 1558、Fabian Wither 英译 1583）
rules.original_text: if the lord of the ascendant or the Moon be in the seventh house, and the planet from whom the Moon is separate doth behold or apply unto the planet whereunto the Moon doth apply, or the Sun do behold or apply unto Venus, it signifies that the marriage shall come to pass but with much labour and difficulty... if the lord of the seventh house be placed in the first... the querent shall easily obtain his wife... the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the tenth house being fortunate and beholding one another with reception... they promise the office unto the querent... the lord of the tenth house be falling from the tenth house, and doth not behold the same, except some fortunate planet do come between and translate the light... the querent shall not have the office... it signifieth that it is already given to another.
rules.translation: 婚姻/官职判例要点：婚姻=7 宫主入 1 宫或与升主合=易得；升主/月在 7 宫而月所离星照月所就星=有劳而成；四对无接收=难成。官职=10 宫主与升主三六合有接收=必得；升主从 10 宫主处落果且不相照=不得（已属他人），除非吉星传光；11 宫主凶照月凶=不授。
rules.notes: 旅行问：9 宫主与升主/月合或传光、多数动宫=速返；固宫=久行；6/12 宫主克=旅中病/囚

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The triplicities: Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius are a triplicity; Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn; Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius; and Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces. The lords of the triplicity of Aries by day are the Sun, then Jupiter, then Saturn, by night Jupiter, then the Sun, then Saturn; the lords of the triplicity of Taurus by day are Venus, then the Moon, then Mars, by night the Moon, then Venus, then Mars, and in Virgo is also a share for Mercury; the lords of the triplicity of Gemini by day are Saturn, then Mercury, then Jupiter, by night Mercury, then Saturn, then Jupiter; the lords of the triplicity of Cancer by day are Venus, then Mars, then the Moon, by night Mars, then Venus, then the Moon.
rules.translation: 三分主星表（昼/夜各三主序）：火相（a/e/i）昼日月木土、夜木日土；土相（b/f/j）昼金月火、夜月金火（处女加水星份）；风相（c/g/k）昼土水木、夜水土木；水相（d/h/l）昼金火月、夜火金月。
rules.notes: 与 Lilly/Tetrabiblos 三分体系不同——Dorotheus 用三主星；引擎三分查询可选两套

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Know the houses of the planets: Cancer is the house of the Moon, Leo the house of the Sun, Capricorn and Aquarius the houses of Saturn, Sagittarius and Pisces the houses of Jupiter, Aries and Scorpio the houses of Mars, Taurus and Libra the houses of Venus, and Gemini and Virgo the houses of Mercury. Saturn rejoices arriving at Aquarius, Jupiter in Sagittarius, Mars in Scorpio, Venus in Taurus, and Mercury in Virgo.
rules.translation: 庙表：月巨蟹、日狮子、土摩羯水瓶、木射手双鱼、火白羊天蝎、金金牛天秤、水双子处女。行星喜乐（joy）：土喜水瓶、木喜射手、火喜天蝎、金喜金牛、水喜处女。
rules.notes: 庙表与托勒密/Lilly 一致；喜乐为行星-星座层级（非宫位层级）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The ascent of the Sun, which is its exaltation, is in nineteen degrees of Aries, of the Moon in three degrees of Taurus, of Saturn in twenty-one degrees of Libra, of Jupiter in fifteen degrees of Cancer, of Mars in twenty-eight degrees of Capricorn, of Venus in twenty-seven degrees of Pisces, and of Mercury in fifteen degrees of Virgo. The descent of each one of them is opposite to its ascent.
rules.translation: 擢升度数：日白羊19°、月金牛3°、土天秤21°、木巨蟹15°、火摩羯28°、金双鱼27°、水处女15°；各星之落为其擢升对宫对度。
rules.notes: 与托勒密体系一致（土擢升天秤21° 为希腊化主流）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Each planet is benefic when it is in its house or in its triplicity or its exaltation so that what it indicates of good is strong, increasing. A malefic also, if it is in its own place, its evil becomes lighter and decreases. Saturn harms one who is born by day and Mars one who is born at night - then especially if Mars is in a feminine sign and Saturn in a masculine sign. The planets, if they are under the rays of the Sun towards the west, their power disappears and they have no power. If it is retrograde in motion, there is difficulty and misfortune.
rules.translation: 行星力量通则：吉星居庙/三分/擢=所主之吉强增；凶星居己位=其凶减轻。土星害昼生人、火星害夜生人（火居阴座、土居阳座尤甚）。行星西向日芒下=失力；逆行=艰险。
rules.notes: sect 原则：昼生土凶、夜生火凶

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.condition: 日月升点性别×角宫凶星
rules.original_text: If a woman gives birth, if the native is a male and you find the Sun and the Moon and the ascendent in male signs, then the native of his birth escapes what frightens him, and trouble does not strike his mother. If the native is female and you find the Sun and the Moon in female signs and the ascendent also a female sign, similarly. But if it is contrary to what I say it indicates misery and death, then especially when you find Saturn in a cardine which is a female sign.
rules.translation: 出生安危判则：男婴日月升点俱在阳座=顺产母安；女婴日月升点俱在阴座同理。反之主难产凶危——土星在阴座角宫尤甚；火星在角宫（尤阴座）=仓促急产。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Take care that you are not afraid because you find a malefic for him in a cardine because you desire that the first, second, and third lords of the triplicity of the ascendent aspect. If you find one of them in its term and a cardine or in what is equivalent to this, then this increases his life. If the three of them are together in strong places, it is best. If you find Saturn or Mars or both of them in the ascendent and the lords of the triplicity of the ascendent in places in which they are strengthened and not under the rays of the Sun, decree for him upbringing. If you find Jupiter in the ascendent or in the triplicity of the ascendent, then he will be brought up.
rules.translation: 养育判则：升点三分三主星强位=能养（一主在界+角宫=增寿；三主俱强最佳；吉星被凶在升点但有三分主护=仍养）。木星在升点或升点三分内=必养。
rules.notes: 三分主星为本卷核心机制

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The best of the places is the ascendent, then the midheaven, then what follows the midheaven, which is the eleventh, then the fifth from the ascendent which is called the house of the child, then the opposite to the ascendent, which is the sign of marriage, then the cardine of the earth, then the ninth place. Thus these are seven places which are preferred. The third from the ascendent because it is the place of the joy of the Moon, and the second, then the eighth, which is the sign of death. There remain equal to this two places which are the worst of the worst, and they are the sixth and the twelfth.
rules.translation: 宫位优势序（Dorotheus）：升点最佳，次天顶，次十一宫，次五宫（子女宫），次七宫（婚姻），次四宫（天底），次九宫——七强位；再月之乐宫三宫、二宫、八宫；最劣六宫与十二宫。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.result: 养育判定+升点近距规则
rules.original_text: If the nativity is diurnal and you find diurnal planets in one of these places (the four cardines, the triplicity of the ascendent, and the eleventh place), he will be brought up. If the nativity is nocturnal and nocturnal planets are in one of these places, similarly. If you find a planet such that there are fifteen degrees between it and the ascendent, then, even if it is in the second sign from the ascendent, reckon its power as if it were in the ascendent. But if it goes beyond this, it has no strength in the ascendent.
rules.translation: 昼夜分养判则：昼生昼星居强位=能养（夜生夜星同理）。行星距升点 15° 以内（即使已入第二座）其力按升点计；过此则无升点之力。
rules.notes: 引擎：距升点≤15° 力量归属升点（与 Lilly 5° 宫缘规则互补）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find the Moon between the two malefics and one of the malefics casts its rays upon it, then the livelihood of the native is little. If the Moon with this is decreasing in its light, it indicates fate and shortness of life. If you find a benefic with this it indicates his escape, but if it is a malefic ruin. If you find the Moon in the seventh place free from the benefics and a malefic is in one of the cardines, then the women give birth to what has no escape from ruin.
rules.translation: 月遭夹击判则：月夹于两凶星之间=生计微薄；月亏=命短之征；吉星相护=得免、凶星=毁。月居七宫无吉星相护且凶星在角=所生无救。
rules.notes: 夹击（besieging）概念早见于 Dorotheus

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Know the masculine and feminine hours: if the Moon is in a masculine dodecatemorion, he is masculine. If the Sun and the ascendent and the Moon are in masculine signs, then, even if the hour of the nativity is double, males are born in it. Count the dodecatemoria according to this manner: in a masculine sign two and a half days masculine and two and a half days feminine, and in a feminine sign: two and a half days feminine and two and a half days masculine.
rules.translation: 性别判定：月居阳之十二分度=男（阴反之）；日月升点俱阳=虽时辰偶亦生男。十二分度计数法：阳座内 2.5 度为阳、2.5 度为阴（阴座相反）。
rules.notes: dodecatemorion=星座十二分度（每座内 2.5° 阴阳交替）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you want to know whether the native is a slave or free, look first thing at the Moon. If you find the Moon in the twelfth or in the sixth and the lord of the triplicity of this sign is not in a good place, then the native is a slave. If you find a malefic in his cardine and you find Mars by day or Saturn by night aspecting the Sun or the Moon without the aspect of Jupiter, the reputation of the free will leave the native and he will be a servant. If you find the Moon with the malefics free from the benefics, it indicates slavery.
rules.translation: 奴役判则：月居六/十二宫且其三分主不吉=奴；凶星在角、昼火/夜土无木星护而刑克日月=沦为仆；月伴凶星无吉=奴。
rules.notes: 本卷大篇幅论奴役（时代背景），可编码为一般'社会地位受损'判则

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find Jupiter in the nativity of a slave in a cardine in any sign except Capricorn, it indicates his manumission and escape from slavery. If Jupiter aspects the Moon from wherever it aspects or is uninjured, the pains of slavery are completely loosened for him. If in the birth of a slave Venus is in a cardine without the aspect of the malefics, this is an indicator of manumission.
rules.translation: 解脱判则：木星在角（非摩羯）=获释；木照月或无损=奴役之缚尽解；金星在角无凶克=得释。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look in the day-time from the Sun to the lord of the triplicity of the lot of fortune, then whatever of the planets is between these two, and count these planets as rulers. If the nativity is nocturnal, from the Moon to the lot of fortune. Whatever planet you find in a sign having two bodies, double it.
rules.translation: 奴隶主人数算法：昼生自太阳数至福点三分主、夜生自月数至福点，其间行星数=主人数；双体座中之星计双。父之主人：日→日之三分主；母之主人：月→月之三分主。
rules.notes: 计数法：两参考点间行星数

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Calculate the lot of the father by day from the degree of the Sun to the degree in which Saturn is, and by night from Saturn to the Sun, and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day and subtract it from the ascendent by night thirty degrees at a time, and look where its lord is situated. If you find Saturn under the rays of the Sun, then mark off the lot of the father from Mars to Jupiter.
rules.translation: 父点公式：昼=日→土、夜=土→日，加（昼）减（夜）升点度数（满30进座）。土星在日芒下时改用火→木。
rules.notes: 引擎：lot = ASC + (A→B) 弧（日间）或 ASC − (A→B)（夜间）；满30°进位

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Calculate the lot of the mother in a nocturnal birth from the Moon to Venus and in the daytime from Venus to the Moon, and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by night or subtract it from the ascendent by day thirty degrees at a time; wherever it ends, there is the lot of the mother.
rules.translation: 母点公式：夜=月→金、昼=金→月，加（夜）减（昼）升点度数（满30进座）。
rules.notes: 注意：母点与父点加减方向相反

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you wish to compute the lot of brothers, count from the degree of Saturn to Jupiter and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day and subtract it from the ascendent by night. If you wish to know the number of brothers and sisters, count from the degree in which Mercury is to Jupiter, and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract by night; look at the number of planets which aspect that place, and in their number will he have brothers.
rules.translation: 兄弟点公式：自土星至木星，加（昼）减（夜）升点。兄弟数点公式：自水星至木星，加减升点——照此点之行星数=兄弟数。
rules.notes: 点数体系：父/母/兄弟/兄弟数/财富点各不同

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look at the lot of fortune. If you find the lot of fortune and the lot of brothers together, then he will benefit from his brothers and, if they die, he will inherit their properties. Count from the degree of the lot to the degree to which Saturn casts its rays in quartile or opposition or presence, as according to this the native will see the death of his brothers.
rules.translation: 兄弟利损判则：福点与兄弟点同位=得兄弟之益并可继承；自兄弟点至土星四分/对冲/合相之度=兄弟死亡应期。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If the nativity is diurnal then look at the Sun and the lords of its triplicity, if it is nocturnal then look at the Moon and the lords of its triplicity. If you find the first and second lords of the triplicity, both of them together or each one of them separately, in a good place, then his condition will not cease from the beginning of his age to the end of his life to be in excellence and elevation and wealth.
rules.translation: 财富判则（总纲）：昼生观日与其三分主、夜生观月与其三分主——首次二三分主俱在吉位=一生富贵不衰。
rules.notes: 三分主星位置序列=财富轨迹（首吉次凶=先好后败，反之先穷后发）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find Jupiter in a bad nativity in a cardine, then it will drive off the evil for twelve years, but if it is in what follows a cardine, then it will obstruct the calamity until it reaches a sign in which Jupiter indicates calamity. Venus will obstruct for eight years if it is in a cardine. Saturn will obstruct for thirty years if it is in a cardine and dominant in that nativity (and its dominance is when by day it is lord of the Sun's triplicity or by night the lord of the Moon's triplicity). Mercury for twenty years if it is in a cardine and it has a share. Mars for fifteen years. If the Sun in a diurnal nativity is in a cardine or in its own triplicity, it will drive off the evil for nineteen years. If the Moon is in a cardine which is a feminine sign, it will drive off the evil for twenty five years, but in masculine signs for twenty-five months.
rules.translation: 挡灾年数表：木星在角挡 12 年；金星在角挡 8 年；土星在角且为主（昼为日三分主/夜为月三分主）挡 30 年；水星在角有份挡 20 年；火星在角挡 15 年；昼生日在角或己三分挡 19 年；月在阴座角宫挡 25 年、阳座仅 25 月。
rules.notes: 引擎应期数据：吉星挡灾时长；角宫续宫递减

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find Saturn or Mars in a sign of property, especially if it is in the second from the ascendent, then it indicates a fall from property and status unless these two are in their portions (the portion of Mars is the night, the portion of Saturn the day). If Venus is the lord of that place, then predict that that is a disaster, and there will be a fall from his reputation among women. If Mercury is its lord, the disaster will be because of a book or calculation. If Jupiter is its lord, because of a man, a noble, or the wrath of kings. If this house is the house of Mars, then because of violent acts, anger, thieves or the burning of fire. If the house of Saturn, then from mature men and slaves or with respect to a building. If you find this place to be the house of the Sun, the disaster will be because of his fathers. If this sign is the house of the Moon, the disaster will be because of his mothers.
rules.translation: 败落判则：凶星居二宫=败产失位（除非各得其份——火份夜、土份昼）。灾因按二宫宫主星/宫主属性定：金主=因女人损誉、水主=因文书计算、木主=因贵人王怒、火宫=因暴行怒火盗贼火灾、土宫=因成年人与奴仆或建筑、日宫=因父辈、月宫=因母系。
rules.notes: 引擎：二宫主→灾因映射表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find the lot of fortune in a bad place, or the malefics aspecting it in conjunction or opposition or quartile, or its lord not aspecting it or being western without light, or its lord being in a bad place or in its dejection, while the benefics do not aspect it, then judge for him calamity and misfortune in his condition. The best that is possible is if the lord of the lot of fortune is in its house or triplicity or exaltation or term.
rules.translation: 福点判则：福点在凶位/被凶星合冲刑/其主不相照或西入失光或失势陷落且无吉护=命途灾厄。福点主在庙/三分/擢/界=最佳。
rules.notes: 福点公式（I.26 处）：昼=日→月+升点；夜=月→日+升点（即标准福点公式）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find the lord of the triplicity of the sign in which is the shining luminary. If you find it in one of these four cardines in such a way that there are fifteen degrees or less between it and the cardine, then predict about him that he will be most perfect in fortune and property. If it is in the second fifteen degrees, then the second fortune. If it is in the third fifteen degrees, then middling. If you find the lord of the triplicity after these degrees until it reaches the next cardine, then the natives will be needy and miserable.
rules.translation: 财富量级判则：光体三分主距角宫 ≤15°=至富；15-30°=次富；30-45°=中产；逾 45° 至下角=贫苦（度距按升时长计、非等黄经）。
rules.notes: '升时长'提示：古代用上升时间而非黄经度数——引擎可参数化

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find Saturn with the Moon in one of the cardines, then, even if he is the son of a king, it indicates his fall from fortune and property. If with this Mars aspects, it will be a disaster. If Jupiter is with them in a cardine, then his property and his fortune will remain for some time, but after that will decline.
rules.translation: 倾覆判则：土月合于角宫=纵帝王之子亦败产失位；火来照=成灾；木同在角=暂保而后衰。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: He for whom the Moon is in Leo or Sagittarius or whose ascendent is one of these two signs will have few brothers. Whoever has Scorpio or Cancer or Pisces for his ascendent, know that his mother will bear numerous children. Sterile signs are Leo, Virgo, Capricorn, and Aquarius, while great in number are Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces.
rules.translation: 兄弟数判则：月或升点在狮子/射手=兄弟少；升点天蝎/巨蟹/双鱼=母多产。不育座：狮子/处女/摩羯/水瓶；多产座：巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼。
rules.notes: 多产/不育座划分与 Lilly 一致（d/h/l 丰饶、c/e/f 不育）但 Dorotheus 另列

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If its lord (of the lot of brothers) aspects it from trine, it indicates love between them, and if it aspects from quartile, it indicates a medium amount of that love. If you find it in opposition to the lot, then it is an indicator of enmity and separation. If it does not aspect it, it indicates the estrangement of one of them from the other. Saturn and the Sun indicate older brothers, Jupiter and Mars indicate middling ones, Mercury younger ones, the Moon older sisters, and Venus younger sisters.
rules.translation: 兄弟情判则：兄弟点主三合照点=相爱、四分=中、对冲=敌对分离、不相照=疏远。行星序位：土日=长兄、木火=中兄、水=幼弟、月=长姐、金=幼妹。
rules.notes: 行星-兄弟序位映射表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look at his father's property from the Sun and Saturn by day. If you find them both in a place good in luck for them, then this is an indicator that his father's property will reach him. But if you find Mars in a cardine, and especially by day, then he will waste the property of his father during his father's lifetime and after his death. Look concerning the mother's property from Venus and the Moon and from their lords.
rules.translation: 继承判则：昼生父产看日与土——俱吉位=得承父产；火星在角（尤昼）=败父产于生前死后。母产看金与月及其主星。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you wish to know which of his parents will die before his companion, then look at the lots of these two; that in which the malefics are or which they aspect from opposition or quartile, that is the one who will die first. If you find Mars in quartile to the Sun on the left side, then his father will die before his mother. If the Sun is under the earth and the malefics aspect the ascendent, then his father will die first. If the Moon is in this position, then the mother.
rules.translation: 父母死亡先后：父点母点中为凶星所居或冲刑所照者先死；火星在太阳左方四分=父先死；日在地平下且凶星照升点=父先死（月同理=母先死）。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book I（本命养育卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: I.28: Knowledge of masculine and feminine signs, eastern and western, and diurnal and nocturnal.
rules.translation: 第28章：阴阳座、东西座、昼夜座之分类（正文以表列示，与托勒密系统一致：阳座 a/c/e/g/i/k、阴座 b/d/f/h/j/l）。
rules.notes: OCR 缺表格细节，分类表以通用系统补注

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Consider Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars. If you find them eastern or in one of their stations, then they are used, but, if they are under the Sun's rays in the degree of the Sun, then this is not counted, or if it is western. A planet is eastern if it is behind the Sun and western if it is between its hands. If there are fifteen degrees between Saturn and the Sun, and similarly fifteen degrees between Jupiter and the Sun, and eighteen degrees between Mars and the Sun, and nineteen degrees between Mercury and the Sun - whenever you find them behind the Sun by these degrees, then say concerning them that they have the power of being eastern.
rules.translation: 东西星判定（III.1）：行星在日之后（behind）=东、在日之前（日芒间）=西。距日度数表：土 15°、木 15°、火 18°、水 19°（金星度数 OCR 缺）——位于日之后此度数内即具东方之力。日芒下（太阳所在度）不计。
rules.notes: 引擎：距日弧/东西判定参数；金 15° 前后为通用值（OCR 原缺）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: See also on the third day from the nativity in the term of which planet the Moon is because, if this planet is a benefic and its lord is in a good place aspecting the Moon from a good place from trine while the Moon is in a cardine or what follows a cardine, then say that all of the nativity's condition is good. But if the lord of the Moon's term is a malefic and it is in a cardine while the lot of fortune is in opposition to the Moon, then say that there is no doubt that the nativity is bad.
rules.translation: 生后第三日月界主判命：生后第三日月入何星之界，界主为吉且吉位三合照月（月在角/续宫）=命全吉；界主为凶居角且福点冲月=命无善。
rules.notes: '第三日月界'=出生后三日月亮所在界——早期寿命判法

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The haylāj is the indicator and the kadhkhudāh is the governor of the matter of life. The haylāj by day is the Sun and by night the Moon, then the degrees of the term of the ascendent, then the lot of fortune. Whosoever's nativity takes place from conjunction to fullness of the Moon, for him it is the degree of the conjunction, and whosoever's nativity takes place in what is between fullness and conjunction, the degree in which the fullness is; each period is fifteen days in a month.
rules.translation: haylāj（寿指示星）选择序：昼生=日、夜生=月；其次=升点界度；再次=福点。月相定位：自合月至满月间出生取合月度、满月至合月间取满月度（各 15 日）。
rules.notes: kadhkhudāh=司时主（寿命时间统治者）；haylāj 为希腊化 hyleg 的阿拉伯语转写

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: It is necessary that the lord of the term aspect the haylāj, or the lord of its house, or the lord of its exaltation, or the lord of its triplicity, or the lord of its image (decan). If it is in this situation, it is the haylāj, but if there does not witness it the lord of the term or one of those which I mentioned, then it will not be good that you make it the haylāj. See which planet casts its rays to it from both quartiles and both trines and both sextiles or is present with it or in opposition.
rules.translation: haylāj 见证条件：须有界主/庙主/擢主/三分主/decans 主之一照之方可立为 haylāj（首选界主、次三分主）；无任何见证则不可立。照法：两四分/两三合/两六合/同座/对冲。
rules.notes: 界主优先于三分主——Dorotheus 特色（多数体系以界主/擢主为准）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: By day the Sun and by night the Moon, and the better of these two is what is in a cardine, especially the ascendent. In a diurnal nativity if the Sun is in the ascendent in the degrees above the earth and one of those planets which I mentioned aspects it, then it will have the power to be the haylāj. Similarly if you find it in midheaven or in the eleventh sign, which is the sign of good fortune. Similarly look in nocturnal nativities from the Moon. But if in diurnal nativities you find the Sun cadent, injured, but the Moon in those places, it has the power for the Moon to be ruling in it. Similarly in a nocturnal nativity, if you find the Moon cadent and the Sun in the ascendent, then speak about the Sun as haylāj.
rules.translation: haylāj 候选位序：日月之优者须在角宫（尤升点）；昼生日在升点/天顶/十一宫且获照=haylāj（夜生看月同理）。昼生日果宫受损而月在强位→改月；夜生月果宫而日在升点→改日。
rules.notes: 降级链：日→月→升点界→福点

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find the lord of this ascendent under the Sun's rays or cadent, then say that there is ruination in this nativity and that he will have no upbringing. But if together with this a benefic is in the ascendent in what is between it and fifteen degrees, then mix this planet with the haylāj. If the haylāj is the Moon and the Moon is in Cancer while the lord of its term is in quartile or trine to it, then say that the native will be brought up.
rules.translation: 降级与融合判则：升点主被灼/果宫=命有毁灭、无养育；吉星在升点 15° 内=与 haylāj 混合用之；haylāj 为月且月在巨蟹而界主四/三合照=能养。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Because the ascendent is in eighteen degrees (of Taurus), count from the ascendent to the rays of Saturn, and it does not come down to it. Then Mars in Taurus twenty-four degrees and fifty minutes casts rays to twenty-five degrees of Pisces. I wanted to know in how many years the ascendent would conjoin with the rays of Mars. I took the eighteen degrees of the ascendent and I found in the tables for my clime and the twelve parts that placed under it was three hundred and fifty-two time degrees and thirty seconds; I wrote this down separately. Then I took the twenty-four degrees and fifty minutes where Mars cast its rays to Pisces and I found the rising-times under this to be three hundred and fifty-six time degrees and forty-eight minutes; so I subtracted the three hundred and fifty-two degrees and thirty minutes which belong to the ascendent, and there were left four time degrees and eighteen minutes. I said that the degrees of the ascendent would conjoin with the sextile rays of Mars in four years and a fifth and a tenth of a year.
rules.translation: 推运应期算法（判例）：升点 18° 金牛，其上升时间=352;30 时分度；火星六合光线落双鱼 25° 之上升时间=356;48 时分度；相减=4;18 时分度=4+1/5+1/10 年——升点与火星六合光线相合之应期。
rules.notes: 算法=asc 黄经对应上升时间度差→年数（本地区上升时间表）；引擎需 rising-times 表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: I found the rising-times under thirty degrees of Aries to be nineteen time degrees and twelve minutes. I wanted to subtract from these the times which were under the degrees of the ascendent. Because they were greater than the nineteen and twelve which are in Aries and I was not able to subtract it, I added to it a complete rotation, which is three hundred and sixty degrees, and I subtracted from it the three hundred and fifty-two degrees and thirty minutes which were under the degrees of the ascendent; there remained twenty-six degrees and forty-two minutes. I said that the degree of the ascendent will depart from Aries in twenty-six years and a half and a fifth of a year.
rules.notes: 差分不足时加 360（整周天）再减——引擎须处理负差进位

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Then, when the degrees of the ascendent depart from Aries, they will descend to the first term of Taurus, which is the place in which Saturn is. In twenty-two degrees of Taurus the degree of the ascendent will arrive at where Mars was. I took twenty-two degrees of Taurus and entered with them in the table for the clime and the twelve parts, and I found that the rising-times were thirty-five degrees and twenty-four minutes. Because it was small and I could not subtract from it what I wanted to, I added to it a rotation, and it became three hundred and ninety-five degrees and twenty-four minutes, and I subtracted from it the three hundred and fifty-two degrees and thirty minutes which belong to the ascendent; there remained forty-two degrees and fifty-four minutes. I said that it will arrive at the term in which Mars is in forty-two years and a half and a third and two-thirds of a tenth of a year.
rules.notes: 推运沿星座界（term）段段推进，各段主星司其时

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Whenever the rays of the benefics are found with the rays of the malefics, then the benefic dissolves whatever the malefic indicates; but if the malefic and its term cast rays without the benefics, then it will not be long before he dies. Because Venus is in this term, it dissolves the fear and misery that Mars indicates and he will not die. Because the Sun cast its rays from sextile to the first term of Taurus where Saturn was staying, the heat of the Sun will drive away the maleficence of Saturn, and the harsh misery will pass him by, and he will not die.
rules.translation: 光线化解判则：吉星光线与凶星光线同处=吉星化解凶星之示；凶星与其界主光线而无吉星=命不久。判例：金星在火星六合光线之界=化解火星之惧；太阳六合照土星之界=日热驱土之恶。
rules.notes: 引擎：凶星应期命中处查吉星光线，有则化解

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Also it is not useful to look at the course of these degrees and their term, but to look at the course of the degrees of the Moon because the conjunction of the Moon's degree with the malefics indicates misery, especially if with this the benefics do not aspect as, if they do aspect, they dissolve misery and death. Look at the casting of rays in latitude also because sometimes a planet is aspecting from opposition, and if you calculate it in latitude and you find one planet in the south, the other in the north, then this is not in opposition and also does not cast its rays, which according to this indicates misery.
rules.translation: 补充判则：①月行推运优先于升点推运——月之度数会凶星=苦（吉照则解）；②纬度相位校验——南纬星与北纬星即使黄经对冲亦不成相位、不投光线（错判则生祸）。
rules.notes: 纬度相位：黄经相位须纬向相容——引擎相位函数须含纬度条件

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find both the Sun and the Moon in the sixth or the eighth or the twelfth and the malefics aspect them, then they indicate death when their degrees conjoin with the malefics. But if they are in a bad place but are not injured, and you find the malefics casting their rays close to their degrees, then the misery which would be will pass by, and he will not die in it.
rules.translation: 日月凶宫判则：日月俱居六/八/十二宫且受凶照=其度会凶星时死；居凶位而未受伤、凶星光线近其度而未会=凶将过身不死。
rules.notes: '光线接近但未合'=差之度未达——应期精度关键

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find a malefic casting its rays to the degree of the haylāj, it will harm him and injury will come to him in the period during which this malefic is governor of the prorogation or ray. If the Sun is in opposition to Mars from the ascendent, consider that this is an indicator of the squandering of his father's property, and striking and grief from the nobles of men, and ruination will harm him and a pain in his leg, and this will come to him in the period during which Mars is the governor of the ray.
rules.translation: 凶光线应期判则：凶星投光线于 haylāj 之度=其司推运之期受其害；太阳自升点冲火星=败父产、受贵人打击、腿痛——应期在火司推运之期。
rules.notes: 应期=光线司主时段（prorogation 分段主）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The lord of the term of the ascendent, Mars, was above the earth and near the East and the four parts which have been mentioned and in the place of good fortune aspecting the ascendent and casting its rays to that term in which the ascendent is, from above it, because it casts to the house and term together; if that casting were to the house only, it would not have this power. There is left of the term one degree that belongs to Mars. So Mars takes over the governorship of the prorogation and ray.
rules.translation: 推运司主判例（III.2 末）：升点界主为司时主（kadhkhudāh）——须同时照及升点之庙与界方有力（仅照庙无此力）。火星司其时：此年示火伤与疾病。
rules.notes: 司时主=界主（term lord）——推运分段主核心

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book III（hyleg 与推运卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Then the prorogation of the ascendent comes to the term of Venus till the eleventh degree. Because Mars has left and Venus has entered it is necessary to mix the power of these two together. Because of this the native will be blessed with love from his parents. Then till the nineteenth degree is the prorogation of Mercury, and in this period he will increase his learning and culture. Then the prorogation at puberty reaches Jupiter, and it will indicate praise on account of his culture and good from his eloquence. Even though Jupiter is retrograde in motion and does not aspect the Moon and the ascendent, this will not decrease it. Then the prorogation comes to Saturn while Venus casts its rays to the twenty-seventh degree of Scorpio from quartile, so that Saturn and Venus govern this prorogation together. Saturn indicates his slowness in work and disease and distance from his land and grief and obstruction and difficulty, and this is worse because Mars is elevated over Saturn. If it were not that Jupiter aspects Saturn it would be worse. Because of the place of Saturn his mother will die in this period, but he will acquire goods because Saturn indicates these, and he will marry a wife with a dowry, and a child will be born to him who will live a short while and die in the third year.
rules.translation: 推运分段混合判例（判例全流程）：金星界=父母之爱（火去金入，两力相混）；水星界=学文增；木星界=文化之誉（木逆且不照日月亦不减其示）；土星界+金四合照=双主共司——土=工缓/病/离乡/阻难，金=妻与子女之乐；土居十二度示生命末日。
rules.notes: 完整判例=上升时间推运法实战：界段主星轮流司时、凶吉混判

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: Haylāj usually hīlāj / hyleg 'giver of life' refers to the part of the chart that has the greatest signification of vitality. The equivalent Greek term is aphetēs, translated in Latin as prorogator. Kadhkhudāh / alcocoden is the ruling planet of the hyleg, whose own essential and accidental condition helps to establish the quality and length of life. The kadhkhudāh is a translation of the Greek oikodespotēs, 'ruler' or 'master of the house'.)
rules.translation: 术语定名（注释）：haylāj=hyleg=希腊 aphetēs（拉丁 prorogator 释放者）——生命活力最大指示；kadhkhudāh=alcocoden=希腊 oikodespotēs（家宰）——haylāj 之统辖星，其尊贵与偶然状态定寿命长短。
rules.notes: Ibn Ezra：光体如母、其位之主如父；Umar al-Tabari：haylāj 如妻、kadhkhudāh 如夫

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: judgement of the natural life-span was often determined by whether this planet (the kadhkhudāh) was strong, and so more likely to give its 'greater years'; mediocre, giving its 'middle years'; or weak, and so only able to give its 'lesser years'.)
rules.translation: 寿期判法：kadhkhudāh 强=给大年、中=中年、弱=小年（行星大/中/小年数表见映射表）。
rules.notes: 年数表出自 Lilly CA p.61 同源；大年数=各星全黄道所辖界度数总和

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: Dorotheus, and authors who follow him, prefer the kadhkhudāh to be the term-ruler of the hyleg. Medieval authors might prefer the planet that has the most powerful level of rulership over the degree of hyleg (i.e., rulership by sign or exaltation is preferred to rulership by term), or the greatest combined rulership with all the essential dignities considered. This planet must be in good celestial state and must be able to aspect the hyleg.)
rules.translation: kadhkhudāh 选择：Dorotheus 系=haylāj 之界主优先；中世纪系=按尊贵领导力序（庙>擢>界>三分>面）取最强统治权者或综合统治权最大者。须状态佳且能照 haylāj；不能照则其 haylāj 资格不成立。
rules.notes: Al-Qabīṣī 明言 Dorotheus 置界主于庙主之前；平手时再论 hayz 与 phase

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: As the hyleg is directed through the zodiac, its ingress into each new term indicates a shift of life-experience that adopts the signature of its new term-ruler. Whether this brings benefit or misfortune depends on 1) the term it has been moved to, 2) the state of the term-ruler, and 3) whether the term receives the aspect of a benefic or malefic planet. Perso-Arabic works call the term-ruler of the directed ascendant jārbakhtār, meaning 'dispenser of life' or 'time-lord'; which equates to what later works call 'the divisor'.)
rules.translation: 界段推运原理：haylāj 沿黄道推进，每入一新界=进入新界主司时之人生主题期。吉凶取决于：①所入之界（木界=荣、土界=挫）②界主自身状态 ③该界所受吉凶星光线。推运升点之界主= jārbakhtār（司命者/时主）=后世之 divisor。
rules.notes: 关键差异：星对星相位有容许度，星对界之光线无容许度、必须落界内方有效

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes quoting Ptolemy III.10: In the prorogation which follows the order of following signs, the places of the maleficent planets, Saturn and Mars, destroy, whether they are approaching bodily, or project their rays from any place whatever in quartile or in opposition, and sometimes too in sextile... However, it must not be thought that these places always inevitably destroy, but only when they are afflicted. For they are prevented both if they fall within the term of a beneficent planet and if one of the beneficent planets projects its ray from quartile, trine, or opposition either upon the destructive degree itself or upon the parts that follow it, in the case of Jupiter not more than 12°, and in that of Venus not over 8°; also if, when both the prorogator and the approaching planet are present bodily, the latitude of both is not the same.)
rules.translation: Ptolemy 破坏位规则（III.10）：推运中土星火星之位置必毁——无论合体接近或自任意处投射四分/对冲光线（六合有时亦毁）。但非必然：若落于吉星之界内、或有吉星自四分/三合/对冲投射光线于破坏度或其后续度数（木不逾 12°、金不逾 8°）即得免；推运者与来星俱在时若两者纬度不同亦不毁。
rules.notes: 防护半径：木 12°/金 8°；日芒下之星不参与助毁或助护

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: Take as the Lot of Fortune always the amount of the number of degrees, both by night and by day, which is the distance from the sun to the moon, and which extends to an equal distance from the horoscope in the order of the following signs... Ptolemy insists the calculation should not be reversed at night.)
rules.translation: 福点公式（Ptolemy 系）：昼夜一律自日数至月、自升点向前同距——即 ASC+月−日；Ptolemy 坚持夜生亦不反转（与 Dorotheus 卷一昼=日→月/夜=月→日相反）。
rules.notes: 福点=月之升点（'lunar horoscope'）；Ptolemy 系中福点仅夜生可为 hyleg

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: Using 1° to represent a year of life, each of the 60 minutes in a degree equates to 6.08 days. Saturn is 8 minutes past 12°, and 8 x 6.08 = 48.64 days, denoting the period the native lives beyond the ascendant's progression to 12° Sagittarius.)
rules.notes: 1′≈6 天 实用近似；判例 44CE 土星精位 12;08 射手

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes on the authentic chart, 2 October 44 CE, Alexandria: The ascendant at 6° Scorpio is in the term of Mars and receives a sextile from Mars at 7° Virgo. Mars is above the earth, oriental, in a masculine quarter, situated in the place of good fortune (11th), dominating the ascendant by its aspect, and ruling it not only by term but also by sign - a strong kadhkhudāh. Mars governs the first term of Scorpio which spans seven degrees; since the natal ascendant falls at 6° Scorpio, only one degree of this term remains - this will characterise life for the first year.)
rules.translation: 判例（真图 44CE 亚历山大）：升点 6° 天蝎居火星界、受 7° 处女火星六合照——火在地上/东向/阳象限/十一宫吉位/照升点/兼界与庙双重统治=强 kadhkhudāh。火星界辖 7°，升点居 6° 仅余 1°=一岁之命（火司期主火伤疾病）。

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes on the authentic chart: Saturn's term begins at 24° Scorpio and spans the remaining six degrees until the end of the sign, acting as the predominant influence for the next six years (ages 18-24). If Venus is placed at 27° Leo as the text suggests, its aspect falls into the third degree of Saturn's term, contributing to a following comment which predicts an unfortunate Venus-event three years later. Venus casting its aspect into the term of Saturn becomes influential throughout the whole term period. Unlike aspects from planet to planet, an aspect cast from a planet to a term is specifically relevant for that term, where it gains a recognition of effect that is not allowed in neighbouring terms.)
rules.translation: 判例（土界期）：土界 24-30° 天蝎辖 18-24 岁；金星照入土界之第 3°=三年后金星性事件（灾）。星对界之相位只在界内有效、不入相邻界——与星对星之容许度机制根本不同。
rules.notes: '金照土界=婚娶带妆之妇、生子而夭' 后为 Zadan Farrukh、Masha'allah《Book of Aristotle》所承

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes quoting Al-Qabīṣī IV.4: If it is by day, you begin with the Sun. If the Sun is before the ascendant by five degrees or less, or if it is in the tenth or in the eleventh place, whether the sign is masculine or feminine, then it is suitable for the haylāg. If it is in the seventh, eighth or ninth place in a masculine sign, then it is also suitable. If it is in one of these three positions in a feminine sign, then it is not suitable.)
rules.translation: Al-Qabīṣī 昼生 hyleg 日则：日居升点前 5° 内、或十/十一宫（不限阴阳座）=合格；日居七/八/九宫须阳座方合格、阴座不合格。
rules.notes: 宫位阴阳：阳宫 4/5/6/10/11/12、阴宫 1/2/3/7/8/9（Al-Qabīṣī 四分定义）

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes quoting Al-Qabīṣī IV.4: Then you look at the Moon. If the Moon is in the ascendant, second, third, seventh or eighth place, it is suitable for the haylāg whether the sign is masculine or feminine. If it is before the ascendant by five degrees or less or is in the tenth, eleventh, fourth or fifth place and the sign is feminine, then it is suitable. If it is in one of these positions in a masculine sign, then it is not suitable. If the birth is at night, we begin with the Moon.)
rules.translation: Al-Qabīṣī 月 hyleg 则：月居升/二/三/七/八宫=不限座性合格；月居升点前 5° 内或十/十一/四/五宫须阴座（夜生反之亦然）；夜生先取月。

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes quoting Al-Qabīṣī IV.4: When the two luminaries are not suitable for the haylāg, you look, after this, at whether the birth is conjunctional or oppositional. If the birth was conjunctional and the degree of the conjunction is in one of the cardines or succedents, then it is in the position suitable for the haylāg. If the degree is cadent from these eight positions, you look at the Lot of Fortune. If it is in one of the cardines or in one of the succedents, then it is suitable. After this we look at the degree of the ascendant, and the haylāgship belongs to it.)
rules.translation: Al-Qabīṣī 降级链：日月均不合格→看出生月相——合生且合月度在角/续宫=合格（冲生取满月度）；其度果宫→看福点（角/续宫=合格，果宫=不合格）；最后落到升点。
rules.notes: 与 Dorotheus 之差异：Al-Qabīṣī 以月相度替代福点之前置位

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes quoting Al-Qabīṣī IV.4: Each of the positions which we have explained is suitable for the haylāg when one of the rulers of the five shares aspects it. When one of the rulers of the five shares, i.e. the lord of the place, the lord of the exaltation, the lord of the term, the lord of the triplicity, or the lord of the decan, does not aspect it, it is not suitable for the haylāg.)
rules.translation: Al-Qabīṣī 见证条件：hyleg 候选须得五权主之一（庙主/擢主/界主/三分主/decans 主）照之；无任何一权主照=不合格（与 Dorotheus 同）。
rules.notes: 五权主=五尊贵层级之统治星；'领导力'定义用于 kadhkhudāh 排序

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes on the interpolated chart, 381 CE: The ascendant is directed to 24°55' Pisces. This falls in the term of Mars which begins at 19° Pisces and ends at 28° Pisces. Venus, at 26°50' Pisces, is present in the term so able to offer protection. At 24°55' Cancer the directed ascendant is in the term of Jupiter (19°-26° Cancer), but Venus casts its ray to 26°50' Cancer, which falls into the first degree of the following term, governed by Saturn. With no protection from a benefic planet, at this time the native dies.)
rules.translation: 判例（插补图 381CE）界内防护规则：推运升点抵双鱼 24°55′（火星界 19-28°），金星 26°50′ 居界内=得护不死；抵巨蟹 24°55′（木星界 19-26°）时金星光线落 26°50′——已出木界入土界首度，防护失效=死。
rules.notes: 核心机制：防护光线的有效=落点须在相关界内，出界 1° 即失效——'界=界限' 之得名

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: Al-Qabīṣī and all authors who report the scheme of planetary friends and enemies, consistently claim Saturn has Mars and Venus for enemies, and Venus has only Saturn as an enemy.)
rules.translation: 行星敌友表：土星之敌=火星、金星；金星之敌=仅土星（其余行星敌友关系按各书——此表为 Al-Qabīṣī 系）。
rules.notes: 土金相敌对=婚卷土金判词之理论基

rules.book: Notes on Dorotheus III: the haylāj, kadhkhudāh, and terms of life（注释续文）
rules.author: Deborah Houlding（2014，© All rights reserved）
rules.original_text: (Houlding notes: The greater years for each planet represents the total number of degrees that each planet rules by term throughout the zodiac, which either reflects or is the reason why the benefic planets have larger terms than the malefics.)
rules.translation: 大年数原理：各星大年=其在全黄道十二星座所辖界度数之总和——吉星界幅大于凶星界幅（故大年更长）。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look at Venus where it is and which are the first, second, and third lords of its triplicity as, if they are with Venus or in a cardine or in trine to it, then this is a good indication because Venus is full for the matter of marriage. If you find the lords of the triplicity of Venus in a bad place or a cadent, corrupted, or they are under the rays of the Sun or near the West, then predict differently from that about the badness of the marriage because those who are born will be of those who will never marry or whose marriage is with slave girls or whores or old women who are disgraced.
rules.translation: 婚姻总判：看金星及其三分三主星——与金同在角宫或三合=婚吉；三分主居凶位/果宫/被灼/近西=不婚或娶奴婢娼妓老妇。
rules.notes: 金星为本卷婚姻指示星；三分主三分位：首主主早年、次主中年、三主末年

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Venus is in the seventh place from the ascendent, it indicates injury and misery and calamity because of women and that he will have little stability with them. If Venus is in a bad place without the aspect of a benefic while Saturn does aspect it and is free of Jupiter, then it indicates that this native will remain without marriage. If Venus is in its own places, it indicates marriage, and the marriage will abound in children. If Venus is in the cardine under the earth, it indicates the death of the native's woman and of his child.
rules.translation: 金星入宫婚姻判则：金居七宫=因女人受灾厄且情不稳；金居凶位无吉照而土照（无木解）=终身不婚；金居己庙=婚且多子；金居天底=妻与子亡。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn is with Venus or Venus is in the term of Saturn while Saturn aspects it, then it is bad concerning marriage because he will marry a widow or an old woman or a woman who is deficient in the matter of caring about him or a young girl or a slave girl, insignificant in everything, or a woman disgraced in the matter of livelihood. But if Venus is with Mars or in the term of Mars, then the wife will be desirous of adultery.
rules.translation: 婚配对象判则：土合金/金在土界而土照=娶寡妇老妇少女奴婢贱女；金合火/金在火界=妻好淫（火金互入庙界=奸乱）。
rules.notes: 界（term）判定用界表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you find the lords of Venus' triplicity aspecting neither midheaven nor Venus, then men will have no pleasure in marriage. If with this the lords of the triplicity of the lot of wedding are aspecting neither the lot of wedding nor Venus nor midheaven, then this native will never marry. If the lord of Venus' triplicity is at the end of signs or in the terms of malefics or in the cardine under the earth or not in its own place, or the malefics aspect it, then this native will never marry.
rules.translation: 不婚判则：金星三分主不照天顶亦不照金=无婚乐；婚点三分主亦不照婚点/金/天顶=永不婚；金星三分主居星座尾度/凶星界/天底/失位或受凶克=永不婚。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The man is suitable for the woman and the woman for the man if the ascendants of these two are the same cardine. If the two luminaries or one of the two is in the ascendent or midheaven, then also it is suitable. Similarly if you find that wherever is the Venus of one of the two, there is the Moon of the other, or wherever is the Moon of one of the two, there is the Venus of the other, especially if the Moon of one of the two is in trine with the Moon of the other. But if, wherever one luminary of one of the two is, in this sign there is a malefic for the other, then it indicates injury and little agreement.
rules.translation: 婚配相合判则：双方升点同角=相合；日月或其一在升点/天顶=相合；一方的金星位=另一方的月亮位（或反之）尤佳，双方月亮三合更佳；一方光体所在座为对方凶星所居=有伤难和。
rules.notes: 合婚判则（synastry 前身）：现代可作比较盘规则

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If you wish to know how many wives he will marry, then mark off from midheaven to Venus; whatever number of planets is between these two, that number of wives will he marry, but wherever you find Saturn, then know his coldness and distress; wherever you find Mars, his death unless a benefic aspects it. In the nativities of women, count from midheaven to Mars, but if Mars is in midheaven then count from midheaven to Jupiter.
rules.translation: 妻数算法：自天顶数至金星，其间行星数=妻数（土在其中=冷漠困顿、火在其中=妻亡除非吉照）；女命数夫自天顶至火星，火在天顶则改数至木星。
rules.notes: 计数法：天顶→指示星间行星数

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look at the place of the lot of wedding. Count from the degrees of Saturn to Venus and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract it thirty at a time from the ascendent by night. If you find any of those planets in this place or in quartile to it, then this is the indicator of the wedding. If you want to see in the nativity of a woman the lot of marriage, then count from the degrees of Venus to Saturn and add to it the degrees of the ascendent.
rules.translation: 婚点公式：男命=土→金±升点；女命=金→土+升点。有行星入婚点或与其四分=婚之指示。
rules.notes: 注意性别反转：男土→金、女金→土

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Calculate also the lot of wedding by day and by night from the Sun to where the Moon is, and add to it the degrees of Venus by day or subtract it from where Venus is by night. If Jupiter is in opposition or quartile to it, it indicates marriage. If the lot of wedding happens to be in opposition to the ascendent or in the cardine under the earth while the malefics aspect it, then the native will see the death of his women.
rules.translation: 昼夜婚点（第二套）：自日数至月，昼加金星度数/夜减金星度数。木星冲/刑此点=成婚；此点冲升点或居天底而凶星照=妻亡。
rules.notes: 两套婚点并存：土→金 与 日→月±金——引擎应保留两套可切换

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Remember this lot: count from Venus to the degree of the seventh sign and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract it from the ascendent by night; wherever it reaches, there is the lot of happiness and wedding. See which is its lord and which is with it and which aspects it, as, if a malefic is in this lot or aspects it, say that the native will marry disgraced women. If the lord of this lot is in a bad place while Venus is under the rays of the Sun and the malefics aspect it, then most of those whose nativity is thus will never marry.
rules.translation: 幸福婚点：自金星数至七宫（降点）度数，±升点。凶星入此点或照此点=娶贱女；此点主星居凶位且金星被灼凶星照=多终身不婚。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The time of the wedding: whenever Jupiter transits where the lot was or in quartile from it or in opposition to it or in trine to it or the triplicity of Venus or Venus' quartile or opposition, then the marriage will occur unless Saturn aspects from opposition or quartile, because if Saturn aspects thus, it chills it and there will be nothing but destruction. Whenever Jupiter transits in the place in which Venus was, it is suitable for the marriage.
rules.translation: 婚期应期：木星行运至婚点/刑冲三合此点/金之三分或刑冲金星时=成婚，除非土星自冲刑照之（土照则冷婚）。木星行至金星原位=宜婚。
rules.notes: 行运应期：木=婚期指示星、土=寒婚星

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look at the first and second lord of Jupiter's triplicity; if they are both together in a good place departing from the Sun's rays, then the two of them indicate children and benefit from them. If one of them is in a good place and the other in a bad place, then he will have children, but misery and lamentation and weeping will reach him because of them. If you find the lords of Jupiter's triplicity, both of them, in a cardine under the Sun's rays, then he will be one of those who will not be blessed with children, then especially if Jupiter also is cadent under the Sun's rays.
rules.translation: 子女总判：木星三分首次二主俱在吉位离日芒=有子女且受益；一吉一凶=有子而悲；俱在角宫日芒下=无子之福（木星果宫被灼尤甚）。
rules.notes: 木星为子女指示星（与婚卷金星相对）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Calculate the number of children: look at the lords of Jupiter's triplicity, which of them is the stronger, and calculate its place which is above the earth, and count from it till it reaches the ascendent; whatever signs are between these two, according to that is the number of his children. If Jupiter and Venus are in what is between these, they indicate an increase in this number. If you find in what I told you of signs a sign possessing two bodies, then double it. If you find in what is between these Mars or Saturn, it indicates the death of the child.
rules.translation: 子女数算法：取木星三分主之强者，自其（地上之）位置数至升点，其间星座数=子女数；其间有木/金=增数；双体座=加倍；其间有火/土=子女夭亡。
rules.notes: 与兄弟数算法同构（数座法）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The lot of children: count from Jupiter to Saturn and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract it from the ascendent by night. Then count from the lot to its lord how many signs there are; whatever there is of signs between these two, that is the number of children. If you find a malefic between these two, it indicates the death of the children. If the Sun or the Moon is in quartile or opposition with the lot, then the Sun will increase the male children, the Moon the female. If Saturn is with it, then it indicates that he will be sterile or will have few children.
rules.translation: 子女点：自木星数至土星±升点。自子女点至其主星间星座数=子女数（其间凶星=夭亡）。日刑冲子女点=增男儿、月=增女儿。土星合子女点=不育或少子。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Lot of transit with respect to children: count from Mars to Jupiter and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract it from the ascendent by night. Wherever your counting ends, when Jupiter transits that lot or its opposition or aspects it from quartile, then will be born children to this native. When Venus happens to transit this lot, it indicates children. When Saturn also comes to that place, it also indicates children.
rules.translation: 子女推运点：自火星数至木星±升点。木星行至该点或其冲位/四分=得子应期；金星行至此点=得子；土星行至此点亦主得子。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Count what of degrees is between Jupiter and the Sun and add to it the degrees of the ascendent; wherever it comes to, there is the lot of male children. Count from the Moon to Venus and add to it the degrees of the ascendent by day or subtract it from the ascendent by night; wherever it ends, there is the lot of female children. Look at the two lords of these two lots and their power in their places, and know whether the birth of males or of females is more numerous and better.
rules.translation: 男女儿点：男儿点=木→日+升点；女儿点=月→金±升点。比较两点主星之力，判男女孰多孰优。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: Look from the fifth, from the sign which is the sign of children, and its lord - in what place it is, whether it is a benefic or a malefic, and how great its strength is in this nativity, because if it is cadent while Jupiter and Venus do not aspect the fifth place but the malefics do aspect this place, it indicates the fewness of his children and the shortness of their remaining with him. But if one benefic aspects that place, then you should not at all despair for his children. If a benefic aspects the fifth place and its lord is in a good place aspecting midheaven, then this is an indication of the abundance of his children and of their goodness.
rules.translation: 五宫子女判则：五宫主果宫且木金不照五宫而凶星照=少子且子不寿；一吉星照五宫=仍可有子；吉照五宫且五宫主吉位照天顶=多子且子佳。
rules.notes: 与五宫为子女宫的通用机制一致

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn aspects Jupiter from trine while Jupiter is in a good place, then it indicates an abundance of property and land and trees and buildings; sometimes he will be lord of a group and will agree with his father. If Saturn aspects Mars from trine without the aspect of Jupiter and Mercury, then he will be rich, a ruler of reason, strong, well known in the metropolis - he will be put up in the manner of kings, but he will see the death of his older brothers.
rules.translation: 三合总判（II.14）：土三合木（木在吉位）=地产丰、为群主、与父和；土三合火（无木水照）=富而强、声闻于都、如王，然见长兄死。
rules.notes: II.14 全章为行星两两三合判词——引擎可按对星查表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Jupiter aspects Venus from trine, then he will be handsome in his appearance and face and will have elevation because of women and love. If Jupiter aspects Mercury from trine, he will be quick-witted, intelligent, perfect, and it indicates that he will be better than his relatives; some of these natives are learned in the stars of heaven. If Jupiter aspects the Moon from trine, it will increase the praise for the native and he will have rank and status.
rules.translation: 木星三合判：木三合金=貌美因女人爱情而升；木三合水=敏慧完人胜于亲族、或通星学；木三合月=得赞获位。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Mars aspects the Sun from trine and the nativity is nocturnal and Mars is the lord of the hour, then he will be elevated in the good because sometimes he will be a powerful king. If Saturn is in quartile of Mars while Saturn is in the tenth sign, he will be weak in his body, unceasing in diseases because of fevers, he will be shaking, and the properties of his parents will be destroyed, and he will see the death of his brothers.
rules.translation: 火日三合与土火四分判：夜生火三合日且火为时辰主=贵为王；土在十宫四分手火=体弱多热病震颤、败父母产、见兄弟亡。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: The aspect of sextile: judge it in this about as the aspect of trine except that it is weaker. If Saturn aspects Jupiter from opposition, there will be no good in his condition or his work, and he will grieve for his children. If Saturn is in the ascendent and Jupiter in the West, then in the beginning of his years he will be miserable but in their end happy. If Saturn aspects Mars from opposition, it indicates misery and misfortune in his livelihood and grief and disease and harm and a decrease in his life and a paucity of children and an abundance of enemies.
rules.translation: 相位强弱总纲（II.14-17）：六合按三合论但力弱；对冲为凶。土冲木=身事皆无成且为子悲（土居升点木居西=先苦后甘）；土冲火=生计困苦多病伤、寿减、子少、敌众。
rules.notes: 关键相性表：三合吉、六合弱吉、四分凶、对冲凶（详判按对星）

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn aspects the Sun from opposition without the aspect of Jupiter, it indicates trouble for his father in his livelihood and chronic illness, and the spoiling of his father's property; his death will be a bad death. If Saturn aspects Venus from opposition, he will be excessive in fornication, a disgraced man, and he will not marry; if he does marry, he will marry a disgraced songstress or a stranger or one in whom there is a chronic illness.
rules.translation: 土星对冲判：土冲日（无木照）=父生计困顿久病、败父产、父死非命；土冲金=淫佚之名、不婚或娶贱女病女。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn is with Jupiter, he will abound in landed estates and will be the steward for kings and nobles, entrusted with properties other than his own, and he will be noble if Mars does not aspect it. If Saturn is with Mars, it indicates good in his character, but there will be no good in regard to his property, and reason will keep him waiting, and he will marry, and his body will be weakened; his father will die before his mother, and he will spoil his father's property.
rules.translation: 土星合相判（II.18）：土合木=富地产、为君王贵族管家、受托他人之产、贵（火不照则）；土合火=品性良而财产无成、身体弱、父先母亡、败父产。
rules.notes: II.18 全章：土与七行星合相判词

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn is with Venus, he will marry a blemished woman for whom he will not be suitable, or he will have intercourse with a barren woman or one in whom there is a chronic illness, and he will be blemished and will be despised because of this, and he will have few children. If Saturn is with Mercury, he will be a lisper, cumbersome with his tongue, slight in his work, but a calm man, a smart fellow and profound. If Saturn is with the Moon, then it will spoil the good of his mother and her work, and she will be emaciated.
rules.translation: 土星合相续：土合金=娶有瑕不宜之妇或与不育/久病之妇交、少子遭贱；土合水=口吃舌滞、工作平平然沉静深敏；土合月=坏母之善与其业、母瘦弱。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Jupiter is with Mars, it indicates leadership and property and honor in metropolises and cities, and he will be one of the judges for communities, abounding in work. If Jupiter is with Venus, he will be brought up in honor and wealth, he will love the generality of people, merciful, good in his intention, good in his appearance; property and leadership will come to him because of women. If Jupiter is with Mercury, he will be an expert in law, victorious in words, and perfect in reasoning and intellect, learned; some of them will be secretaries for the more powerful grandees or kings. If Jupiter is with the Moon, it indicates an increase in property, dignity, and good fortune.
rules.translation: 木星合相判（II.19）：木合火=领导/财/荣于都市、为社群之判官；木合金=养于荣贵、仁慈貌美、因女人得产与位；木合水=法学家、言胜、智理完人、或为贵人王侯之书记；木合月=产/尊/福增。
