rules.notes: II.19 全章：木与七行星合相判词

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Mars is with Venus, it indicates quarrelling and disaster and injury because of women. If the sign is tropical, then he will have intercourse with a bad woman, and he will be excessive in sexual intercourse. If Mars is with Mercury, then he will be a liar except that he will be reasonable, intelligent, learned, desirous of culture, and he will love arguments. If Mars is with the Moon, then it indicates the shortness of his survival and a terrible death and a chronic illness, and some of his flesh will be cut with iron, and it indicates misery for his mother.
rules.translation: 火星合相判（II.19 续）：火合金=因女人起争灾伤（座为二体座则交恶妇、纵欲）；火合水=巧言善辩之才但好辩；火合月=寿促、死非命、久病、皮肉遭铁伤、母悲。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Venus is with Mercury, he will be lazy in his jobs, desirous of joy and pleasure, abounding in women, adorned with culture and words, loquacious in poetry; but he will be disconcerted because of intercourse with women so that his pleasure and his desire will be in slave girls. If Venus is with the Moon, he will be great in his appearance, good in his children, joyful, fortunate, but he will have no constancy in his marriage. If Mercury is with the Moon, then he will be praiseworthy in his reason and understanding, perfect except that he will be a liar and will not be constant with respect to an affair.
rules.translation: 金水/金月/水月合相判（II.19 末）：金合水=工作懒散好逸乐、有文采好诗、好女色而情欲在奴婢；金合月=貌伟子佳喜乐有福但婚不恒；水合月=智理可赞完美但好说谎不守一事。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If the Moon is in the ascendent or midheaven good in its light, then, if the malefics aspect it, it decreases his good and livelihood, but if the benefics aspect it, they increase his good. If the Moon is in its house or its term or its exaltation by night, in the cardines or what follow the cardines, then it will be good because he will be well known, abounding in friends and acquaintances. If the Moon is in the West, which is the sign of marriage, it indicates sudden death for his mother. If the Moon is in the cardine of the earth and malefics aspect it, then it indicates an intense disease in a hidden place.
rules.translation: 月亮入宫判则（II.21）：月居升点/天顶光明=吉凶随照星（凶照减吉、吉照增吉）；月居己庙/界/擢（夜）在角或续宫=知名多友；月居西（七宫）=母暴亡；月居天底受凶照=隐疾深重。
rules.notes: II.21-27 为七行星逐宫判词——引擎可作宫位-行星判词表

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If the Sun is in the ascendent or midheaven in its own house or a male sign, then it will be good. If the benefics aspect it from the tenth place, he will be praiseworthy, a leader over groups in nobility. If the Sun is in the house of marriage, it indicates hidden misery for his parents and his brothers. If the Sun is in the cardine under the earth, it indicates a fall and a decrease in the property of his fathers, but if the lord of its house or its exaltation overpowers it, it will ameliorate this evil.
rules.translation: 太阳入宫判则（II.22）：日居升点/天顶己庙或阳座=吉；吉星自十宫照=可赞、为群贵之首；日居七宫=父母兄弟隐悲；日居天底=败落、父产损减（其庙/擢主压过之则减凶）。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If, when the nativity is diurnal, Saturn is in the ascendent in its own house or in one of its places, then he will have no harm because he will be a lord of landed estates and buildings and he will lead in this, except that he will be weak in body, conspicuous in diseases, and he will not attain complete nobility. If Saturn is in midheaven, it mars his livelihood for the native for thirty years and his good fortune, especially in nocturnal nativities when the sign is fixed. If Saturn is in the cardine under the earth, it indicates the death of his children and brothers or their paucity, and he will be heavy in his body, diseased, and injury will come to him from the sea or from water or from the coldness of his limbs.
rules.translation: 土星入宫判则（II.23）：昼生土居升点己庙/己位=无大害、为地产建筑之主但体弱多病难臻全贵；土居天顶=损生计与福 30 年（夜生固定座尤甚）；土居天底=子女兄弟夭亡或稀少、体沉多病、受水湿之伤。
rules.notes: 土居天顶 30 年之说与卷一挡灾年数呼应

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Jupiter is in the ascendent, he will possess a good marriage and children and brothers and reputation, especially in a diurnal nativity. If Jupiter is in midheaven, then he will be far out in his fame, noble, having good fortune and children, especially in a diurnal nativity. If Jupiter is in the cardine of the West, it indicates that in his old age his condition and his status will be better, and his end will be good; he will be troubled and miserable in his youth and he will see the death of his women and his brothers.
rules.translation: 木星入宫判则（II.24）：木居升点=婚/子/兄弟/名俱佳（昼生尤）；木居天顶=声名远扬尊贵有福有子（昼生尤）；木居西（七宫）=晚境佳终好、早年困顿且见妻与兄弟亡。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Mars is in the ascendent when the nativity is diurnal, it indicates misery and pain and a decrease in his good, and he will be malicious in character, have few children, filled up forcibly, and he will love debauchery; it is worse than this if Saturn aspects, but better than it if Jupiter aspects. If Mars is in midheaven in diurnal nativities or in what follows midheaven, then it indicates a fall and a terrible flight from his land. If Mars is in the house of property, it indicates the ruination of his property, but if a benefic aspects, then it will spoil some and leave some behind.
rules.translation: 火星入宫判则（II.25）：昼生火居升点=苦痛损福、性恶、少子、好淫（土照更凶、木照减凶）；火居天顶或其后（昼生）=败落、离乡奔逃；火居二宫=破财（吉照则破半留半）。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Venus is in the ascendent or in what follows the ascendent, eastern and rejoicing in its light, he will be praiseworthy, handsome, a master of women, well known among kings and lords of men. If Venus is in the ascendent which is a sign possessing two bodies, then the native will be named with the names of two fathers or two mothers or with two names. If Venus is in midheaven which is a masculine sign, in nativities of women she will be a harlot, especially if Mars or Mercury aspects. If Venus is in the West, it indicates that he will have a good end except that he will have no good in marriage.
rules.translation: 金星入宫判则（II.26）：金居升点/其后、东向光明=可赞貌美、掌控女人、闻名于王侯；升点双体座=名有二父/二母/二名；女命金居天顶阳座=为妓（火水照尤）；金居西=晚境佳但婚无好。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Mercury is in the ascendent, he will be bent over in everything and for everyone, and he will have many children, be reasonable, well known to everyone, desirous of instruction and words. If Mercury is in midheaven or in what follows the cardine of midheaven, in a tropical sign, he will be well known, praiseworthy among tribes. If the sign possesses two bodies, then he will be a trainer, a teacher or the leader of others' children. If Mercury is in the West, then there is no good in his brothers or his children, and quarrels and slander will be stirred up against him.
rules.translation: 水星入宫判则（II.27）：水居升点=诸事委曲、多子、明理、人尽知、好学问；水居天顶/其后（二体座）=知名可赞、为教师或育人之首；水居西=兄弟子女无好、起争诽。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn is in the house of Jupiter, it indicates a good condition and honor, and he will raise the children of others, and he will be a steward, and he will love his wife; it indicates similarly if it is in Jupiter's term. If Saturn is in Venus' house, then there is no good in the matter of marriage because he will marry a young girl or an old woman or a whore. If Jupiter is in Saturn's house, he will be wealthy and for this no praise or honor for him will be known. If Jupiter is in Mars' house, he will be one of the chiefs, a leader or a calculator for the stars.
rules.translation: 行星入他宫（II.28-29）：土入木庙=善况有荣、育他人子、为管家、爱妻（土入木界同）；土入金庙=婚无好、娶幼女老妇娼妓；木入土庙=富而无名无荣；木入火庙=为头领/领袖/星学之算者。
rules.notes: II.28-33 全章：行星互入他宫/界判词

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Mars is in Venus' house or its term, then he will be a master of fornication, he will love the women of others, and he will harm his relatives, and he will rejoice in an evil sexual intercourse, and most of them will be men who murder their wives with their own hand. If Venus is in Mars' house or its term, then greed and evil quarrels are stirred up and injury, and this misery will reach him from women. If Mercury is in Mars' term or its house, then he will be a fool, insignificant, a liar with no shame, and he will love adultery. If Mercury is in Venus' house or its term, he will be welcome, pleasant, rejoicing, and he will do all his work and will hurry it up.
rules.translation: 火星金星水星互入判（II.30-32）：火入金庙/界=淫乱好他人之妇、害亲族、多手刃己妻；金入火庙/界=因女人起贪争与伤；水入火庙/界=愚贱无羞之骗子好通奸；水入金庙/界=受欢迎令人悦、行事迅速。

rules.book: Carmen Astrologicum Book II（婚姻子女卷）
rules.author: Dorotheus of Sidon（公元1世纪）；英译 David Pingree 1976（Teubner 版）
rules.original_text: If Saturn is in the Moon's house, then he will destroy his mother's property and rob it in her lifetime, and his mother will be sick, and her limbs will complain of the cold and the black bile. If Saturn stays in the Sun's house, his father will be praiseworthy and will increase in his livelihood, but besides this his father will complain of dampness or will die a terrible death. If Mars is in the Moon's house, he will be sharp in his reasoning, a seeker for work and property except that his work and his livelihood will weaken and he will be chronically ill; it is worse for one who is born in the daytime. If Mars is in the Sun's house, he will spoil his father's property and rob it, and he will be one of those who do difficult and unpleasant work in fire or iron. If the Sun and the Moon are in Jupiter's house or its term and they are thus together, then he will be honest in his properties, but will have intercourse with his brothers' women.
rules.translation: 日月互入判（II.33）：土入月庙=毁母之产生时夺之、母病肢冷黑胆汁疾；土入日庙=父可赞生计增但患湿气或死非命；火入月庙=思锐求业产然事业生计弱、久病（昼生尤）；火入日庙=败夺父产、操火铁之艰业；日月俱入木庙/界=于产诚实然通奸于兄弟之妇。
rules.notes: II.33 末：'庙与界相合则断判更稳'——互容与界之综合

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 征象星=月、水星、7宫及其主（兽类另论）
rules.original_text: The Moon and Mercury are naturally the Significators of Fugitives and strays: But the seventh House and his Lord particularly are Significators thereof; unless the thing strayed be a Beast.
rules.translation: 第一章·逃亡/走失者能否寻回：月与水星天然主逃亡与走失者；但第7宫及其主星尤为征象（除非走失者为兽类）。
rules.notes: Gadbury《Doctrine of Horary Questions》1658 第9章第3部分

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 逃亡者自行返回（未走远）
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Seventh thereof shall be Retrograde, the fugitive shall return again of his own accord, before he goeth very far from the Querent's House, or from the place whence he went.
rules.translation: 7宫主逆行——逃亡者未远离问者之宅（或初去之处）即自行返回。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 上升主或月与7宫主吉相位+7宫主趋合/不趋合
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Ascendant or Moon, in good Aspect with the Lord of the seventh, and the Lord of the seventh apply, it declares the fugitive to be coming home again. If he do not apply, the Querent may find him by enquiry.
rules.translation: 上升主或月与7宫主成吉相位，且7宫主趋合——逃亡者将归家；若不趋合——问者经查询可寻得。
rules.notes: 注1：7宫主为较快星且趋合上升主吉相位则自归；否则可寻

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 征象星互以四分/冲照或无相位；7宫主在3/9宫
rules.result: 不愿归、难复得；远行未归、不速寻得
rules.original_text: But if the aforesaid Significators behold each other by square or opposition, or shall be in no Aspect at all; it denotes the Fugitive unwilling to return again, and an unlikelihood of the Querent's having him again: If the Lord of the seventh be in the Third or Ninth, you may say the Fugitive is gone a journey, and will not suddenly be found again.
rules.translation: 上述征象星互以四分/冲相照，或全无相位——逃亡者不愿返回，问者难再得之；若7宫主在3宫或9宫——逃亡者已远行，不速寻得。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 观12宫主（逆行则自归）；余同前法
rules.original_text: If a Horse, Ox or Cow, be strayed, observe the Lord of the Twelfth; and if he be found Retrograde, you may judge the stray will return of its own accord; and observe the same rules as before, only with the change of the Lord of your House.
rules.translation: 马、牛等走失——观12宫主；若其逆行，断走失之兽自行返回；余同前法，仅换宫主。
rules.notes: 注2：12宫=大家畜（马牛等）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月将逃亡/走失者主星之光（或水星之光）传送给上升主
rules.original_text: If the Moon shall transfer the Light of the Lord of the Fugitive or Stray to the Lord of the Ascendant, it argues hopes of recovering them again. If she transfer Mercury's Light or virtue, it signifies the same.
rules.translation: 月将逃亡/走失者主星之光传送给上升主——有复得之望；传送水星之光或德亦然。
rules.notes: 光之传送（translation of light）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月与木/金吉配置，或木金自图中吉宫照上升或其主
rules.original_text: The Moon in Good configuration with Jupiter or Venus, or either of them casting a good aspect to the Ascendant or his Lord, from good Houses of the Figure, shows hopes of a recovery.
rules.translation: 月与木星或金星吉配置，或木金自图中吉宫照上升或其主——示复得之望。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 走失者被拘束，或囚于牢
rules.original_text: The Lord of the seventh in the twelfth House of the Figure or Question, denotes the Fugitive to be under the Bonds of restraint, perhaps in a Prison: Mercury posited so, argues the same.
rules.translation: 7宫主在图中（或问题之）12宫——走失者受拘束，或囚于牢狱；水星如此亦同。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 有星自月亮之宫主（或2宫主）分离
rules.original_text: When in the Figure you find any Planet separating from the Lord of the House of the Moon, the Beast strayed is taken into custody and driven away and sold: if any planet shall be found to separate from the Lord of the second, the same.
rules.translation: 图中见任何星自月亮之宫主分离——走失之兽被收管、驱走并变卖；自2宫主分离——同。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月/走失者征象星趋合8宫主或入8宫；或月之dispositor/兽征象星在8宫趋合4宫凶星之四分/冲
rules.original_text: If the Moon or Significator of the Stray shall apply to the Lord of the Eighth from his Ascendant, or shall be in the Eighth, it is then dead. If the Dispositor of the Moon, or Significator of the Beast shall be posited in the Eighth House, applying to the square or opposition of an Infortune in the Fourth, the same.
rules.translation: 月或走失者之征象星趋合自上升计之第8宫主，或入8宫——已死。月之dispositor或兽之征象星在8宫、趋合4宫凶星之四分/冲——同。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 兽在牲畜栏或被官员控制
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Sixth or Twelfth, in the Sixth or Twelfth, or in the Ninth or Tenth, argues the Beasts strayed to be either in the Pound, or under the Command of some Officer.
rules.translation: 6宫主或12宫主在6宫/12宫，或在9宫/10宫——走失之兽或在牲畜栏，或在某官员之管下。
rules.notes: 注3：此条与下条适用于走失之兽或仆役

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 7/12/6宫主受木金吉照于2/5/11宫，或日于其中三合
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Seventh, Twelfth, or Sixth, fortunated by the good Beams of Jupiter or Venus in the second, fifth or eleventh houses, or the Sun casting a trine unto them there, they are very likely to be found again.
rules.translation: 7宫主、12宫主或6宫主，受木星或金星在2/5/11宫之吉照，或太阳于其中三合照之——很可寻回。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.original_text: The Moon or Significator of the Fugitive or stray, is in the Tenth House, they are South; in the seventh, West; in the fourth North, in the Ascendant, East.
rules.translation: 第二章·去向与距离：月/走失者征象星所在宫位定方位——10宫=南；7宫=西；4宫=北；上升=东。
rules.notes: 方位-宫位映射（可编码）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 北（湿沼地）/西（山高地）/南（荒林）/东（旷野新翻地）；星座优先于方位
rules.original_text: If the Significator of the strays be in watery signs, they are Northward, and in some moist Moorish places. If in Airy signs, they are westward, and in Mountainous and high places. If in Earthy Signs, they are Southward, and in Melancholy Desert places, as Woods. If in Fiery Signs, they are Eastward; and in open Places, where ground hath been newly digged up: you must always prefer the Sign before the Quarter.
rules.translation: 走失者征象星在水象星座——北向，且在湿沼之地；风象——西向，山高之地；土象——南向，忧郁荒处（如林地）；火象——东向，旷野新翻之地；恒以星座优先于方位。
rules.notes: 元素-方位-地形映射（可编码）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月与上升主同方位且距≤1星座/距>90°
rules.original_text: The Moon in the same Quarter with the Lord of the Ascendant, there being not above one sign distance between them, they are then near the place whence they went at first. But if they are distant above ninety Degrees, then they are gone far from the Querent.
rules.translation: 月与上升主同方位且其间距不超一星座——近其初去之处；若距超90度——已远离问者。
rules.notes: 距离判断阈值：≤1星座近、>90°远

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月与征象星之度距+走失者在启动/双体/固定星座
rules.result: 度距按动势换算距离（启动=17弗隆/双体=5/固定=1，弗隆≈220码）
rules.original_text: If the Moon be distant from the Significator of the Fugitive or Stray, either seventeen furlongs from the Owner; if in Common Signs, they are five furlongs distant from the Owner, if in fixed signs they are one furlong distant from the Owner: when there is a greater distance in Degrees, proportion your distance or place according to this Rule.
rules.translation: 月与走失者征象星之距：自问者起十七弗隆等；若走失者在双体星座——距五弗隆；固定星座——距一弗隆；度距更大时按此规则比例推算。
rules.notes: 距离比例规则（原文数值按星座动势，度距越大比例放大）；编码需归一化

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 吉星六/三照上升主或2宫主+福点dispositor在1/2宫
rules.original_text: Fortunate Planets in sextile or trine to the Lords of the Ascendant or second house, and dispositor of the Part of Fortune posited in the Ascendant or second House, declares recovery of the goods lost.
rules.translation: 第三章·失物能否复得：吉星六分/三分照上升主或2宫主，且福点之dispositor在上升或2宫——失物复得。
rules.notes: 复得判据

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 二吉星（木金）在上升且于2宫有尊贵；或月在7宫六/三照上升主
rules.original_text: Either of the fortunes in the Ascendant, having Dignities in the second house, or the Moon in the seventh, in sextile or trine to the Lord of the Ascendant; both these are very certain Arguments of a recovery.
rules.translation: 二吉星（木金）在上升、于2宫有尊贵；或月在7宫、六分/三分照上升主——皆为复得之极确之证。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 月在10宫三照2宫之星/2宫主/福点dispositor；上升主在2宫；光体互三合或三合2宫尖；2宫主在11/4宫
rules.original_text: The Moon in the Tenth, in trine to a Planet in the second, or in the second in trine to the Lord of the second or the Dispositor of the part of Fortune, the Lord of the Ascendant in the Second; the lights in trine to each other or in trine to the Cusp of the second House, or the Lord of the second in the eleventh or fourth Houses; all these are Arguments of recovery.
rules.translation: 月在10宫、三分照2宫之星；或2宫之星三分照2宫主或福点之dispositor；上升主在2宫；光体互成三合或三合2宫之尖轴；或2宫主在11宫或4宫——皆为复得之证。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 8宫主在上升或与上升主相合；木/金/北交在11宫
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Eighth in the Ascendant, or with the Lord of the Ascendant, denotes a recovery of the Goods lost: Jupiter, Venus or North Node in the eleventh house, give great hopes of the same also, and this I have often proved true.
rules.translation: 8宫主在上升，或与上升主相合——失物复得；木星、金星或北交在11宫——亦给大望，此余常验之。
rules.notes: Gadbury 经验验证声明

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.original_text: The Moon, part of Fortune or his Dispositors, or Lord of the second in the eighth House, is a great Argument that the Goods lost cannot be recovered.
rules.translation: 月、福点或其dispositor、或2宫主在8宫——大证失物不可复得。
rules.notes: 不可复得判据

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 双光体在地下；或2宫/其主受阻
rules.original_text: When both Luminaries are under the Earth, the Thing lost is hard to be recovered: If the second House or his Lord be any way hindered, it denotes the same.
rules.translation: 双光体皆在地下——失物难复得；2宫或其主受任何妨碍——同。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 土/火/南交在2宫离其本然尊贵；2宫主灼伤或在8宫；2宫主与8宫主四分/冲
rules.original_text: But the greatest argument of an irrecovery, are the position of Saturn, Mars or South Node out of their essential Dignities in the second house; or the Lord of the second being either in Combustion, or in the eighth House; or if the Lord of the second be in square or opposition with the Lord of the eighth.
rules.translation: 不可复得之最大证：土星、火星或南交在2宫而离其本然尊贵；或2宫主灼伤、或在8宫；或2宫主与8宫主成四分/冲。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 7宫主合8宫主；或2宫主不照1宫/其主；日月不相照或不照福点；双光体在地下
rules.original_text: Mr. Lilly saith, If the Lord of the seventh shall be in conjunction with the Lord of the Eighth; or if the Lord of the second behold not the first house, or Lord thereof; or the Sun and Moon are not aspecting each other or Part of Fortune; or when they are both under the Earth; there can be no restitution of the goods lost.
rules.translation: Lilly 言：7宫主与8宫主相合；或2宫主不照1宫或其主；或日月不相照、亦不照福点；或双光体皆在地下——失物无归还。
rules.notes: 引 Lilly（学派引用）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 流浪星在角宫（传统贼征）；但未损财及其主/福点及其主
rules.result: Gadbury 修正：非贼征，为贫而诚之人
rules.original_text: Astrologers account a Peregrine Planet in an angle the significator of the Thief; chiefly, if the Peregrine Planet have Dignities in the seventh House, or be Lord thereof: Because he being out of all his essential Dignities, may he well supposed to be in a condition necessitous and consequently shall prove the Thief. The inference doth not naturally follow the premises; for a man may be poor and honest; and although the Planet in an angle be peregrine; yet, if he neither afflict the substance, or his Lord; the part of fortune, or his Lord, I shall take him to signifie a poor honest man in his place; but cannot admit him as significator of a Thief.
rules.translation: 第四章·谁是窃贼、年龄与性别：传统以角宫之流浪星（无本然尊贵）为贼征，尤若其在7宫有尊贵或为7宫主（贫困故为贼）。Gadbury 驳：贫困不等于为贼——流浪星在角宫若不损财/财主/福点/福点主——当为贫而诚之人，不作贼征。
rules.notes: Gadbury 对传统的重要修正；注4：不以尊贵为道德符号

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 以7宫主为贼征（本然主偷窃与贼）
rules.original_text: When no Planet maliciously Aspects the aforesaid Significators, you may admit the Lord of the Seventh to signifie the Thief because he hath natural signification of theft and Thieves.
rules.translation: 无星恶意照上述（财）征象星——可纳7宫主为贼征，因其本然主偷窃与窃贼。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 损财/福点或其主之星（不论流浪或得尊贵）
rules.result: 为贼征（得尊贵之星亦为贼——因其强能行最大恶）
rules.original_text: Let the planet afflicting the substance, or part of Fortune, or their Lords, be Peregrine, or essentially dignified, he shall signifie the Thief. And whereas some exempt a Planet essentially dignified, from participating in any thing of this nature, I do not; for such a planet, as he is strong, he is able to do the most mischief.
rules.translation: 损财、损福点或其主之星，不论流浪或得本然尊贵——为贼征。有人免去得尊贵之星参与此类事，余不然：星强故能行最大之恶。
rules.notes: Gadbury 核心方法：贼=损财征象星之星；注4

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 贼征为阳星+阳星座阳方位/阴星+图中吉位
rules.original_text: If the planet afflicting the substance be masculine, and in a masculine sign and Quarter, it denotes the Thief to be a man. If the Planet be feminine, and in fortunate parts of the figure, you may conclude that the Thief is feminine, or a woman.
rules.translation: 损财之星为阳星、且在阳星座阳方位——贼为男；若星为阴星、且在图中吉位——贼为女。
rules.notes: 性别判据

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 贼征为土/日火木/金水/月（按月相象限）
rules.original_text: Saturn significator of the Thief, shows the Thief to be old, except in the beginning of Signs: The Sun, Mars and Jupiter, about thirty, or somewhat more; Venus and Mercury, youthful; the Moon, according to her age; in the first quarter, she signifies young; in her second quarter, between twenty and thirty; in her third, between thirty and forty five; in her fourth, between forty five and sixty.
rules.translation: 土星为贼征——贼年老（星座初度除外）；日、火、木——约三十余；金、水——年少；月——依其月龄：一象限=年轻；二象限=20-30；三象限=30-45；四象限=45-60。
rules.notes: 年龄-行星映射（可编码）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.original_text: A planet being in his Orientality, denotes the Thief more young; but in his Occidentality, the Thief is more aged.
rules.translation: 行星东出——贼较年轻；西没——贼较老。
rules.notes: 东出西没修正

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.original_text: Many Planets afflicting the Significators of substance, (it matters not whether they be Peregrine or not) show many Thieves, or more Thieves than one.
rules.translation: 第五章·是否多贼：多星损财征象星（不论流浪与否）——多贼。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 贼征与其他星六分/三分（尤在双体星座）
rules.result: 多贼（即使仅一星损财征）
rules.original_text: If the Significator of the Thief be in sextile or trine with other Planets, chiefly in double-bodied Signs, there are more Thieves than one, although but one be found to afflict the Significators of substance.
rules.translation: 贼征与诸行星六分/三分相（尤在双体星座）——贼多于一（即使仅一星损财征象星）。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 图中角宫固定+贼征固定，除财主/福点dispositor外无任何相位
rules.original_text: The Angles of the Figure fixed, and the Significator of the Thief fixed, in no Aspect with any planet save the Lord of Substance, or Dispositor of the Part of Fortune, whom he afflicts; these denote but one Thief only in the theft committed.
rules.translation: 图中角宫固定、贼征固定，除财主或福点dispositor（其所损者）外不与任何星成相位——仅一贼。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 光体照上升/其主；或1宫主在1宫合7宫主
rules.original_text: The Luminaries beholding the Ascendant (or his Lord) or the Lord of the First in the first, in conjunction with the Lord of the Seventh; denotes the Thief to be a familiar, or one known to the Loser.
rules.translation: 第六章·陌生或熟人：光体照上升（或其主）；或1宫主在1宫合7宫主——贼为失主所识之熟人。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 光体在己庙/上升主之庙/上升主之三分组
rules.original_text: When the Lights are in their proper Houses [signs], or in the Houses of the Lord of the Ascendant, or in the Triplicity of the Lord of the Ascendant, it denotes the Thief well known to the Querent or Loser.
rules.translation: 光体在己庙，或在上升主之庙，或在上升主之三分组——贼为问者/失主所熟知。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 贼征强在上升（尤若为3宫主）；7宫主在7宫
rules.original_text: The signification of the Thief strong in the Ascendant; noteth a Brother or Kinsman, chiefly if he chance to be the Lord of the Third: The Lord of the seventh in the seventh, he is of the household.
rules.translation: 贼征强在上升——兄弟或亲属（尤若恰为3宫主）；7宫主在7宫——家中人。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 指控自家仆从（Lilly 经验言屡验）
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Ascendant in the third or fourth house (saith Mr. Lilly) accuseth thine own household servant, And this (saith he) I have oft proved true by experience.
rules.translation: 上升主在3宫或4宫（Lilly 言）——指控自家仆从；余（Lilly）屡验于经验。
rules.notes: 引 Lilly

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 贼征自其宫位之3/9宫；或上升主与7宫主/贼征不同三分组
rules.original_text: The Significator of the Thief, in the Third or Ninth from his own House shews the Thief to be a stranger. If the Lord of the Ascendant, and the seventh, or significator of the Thief, be not of one Triplicity, it denotes the same.
rules.translation: 贼征自其本宫之3宫或9宫——贼为陌生人；若上升主与7宫主（或贼征）不同属一三分组——亦同。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 惯窃（除非掌亲属宫——则指认其人）
rules.original_text: Mars or Mercury significator of the Thief, presages him to be a common knave; unless they govern a House of relation: which if they do, then they tell you who it is.
rules.translation: 火星或水星为贼征——预兆其为惯窃；除非其掌亲属之宫——则指认其人。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 日=父/母；月=母/女主人；金=妻/女；土=仆或寄宿陌生人；火=子/兄弟/亲属；水=少年/熟人/友
rules.original_text: If the Thief be Domestical, Mr. Lilly teacheth us to know him thus: the Sun signifies Father or Mother; Moon the Mother or Mistress; Venus the Wife or a woman; Saturn a servant, or a stranger lying there by chance; Mars a Son, Brother, or Kinsman; Mercury a youth, Familiar or Friend.
rules.translation: 若贼为家中人，Lilly 教法：日=父或母；月=母或女主人；金=妻或女子；土=仆人或偶然寄宿之陌生人；火=子、兄弟或亲属；水=少年、熟人或友。
rules.notes: 家贼识别映射（可编码）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.original_text: Seeing testimonies of recovery in your Figure, you may also discover the time thus: Observe the application of the two Planets signifying recovery, and consider the Degrees of distance between their body or Aspect, and so turn the distance into time.
rules.translation: 第七章·何时复得：图中有复得之证——观示复得之二星之趋合，以其身体/相位间之度距换算为时间。
rules.notes: 应期换算基础规则

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.result: 启动=周/天、双体=月/周、固定=年/月（按度距数）
rules.original_text: If they happen to be in moveable [cardinal] signs, then give so many weeks or days as you have Degrees of distance, for the space, or time in which it may be recovered. If in common signs, give monthes or weeks: If fixed signs, Years or Monthes.
rules.translation: 若（度距所在）为启动星座——以度距之数给周或天；双体星座——给月或周；固定星座——给年或月。
rules.notes: 应期换算-动势映射（可编码）

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 日月同照上升；兼2宫主在上升
rules.original_text: When the Sun and Moon together behold the Ascendant, the Thing lost shall suddenly be recovered; for they suffer nothing to lie long hid, or obscured: And if at the same time, the Lord of the Second be in the Ascendant, it will be had again very speedily.
rules.translation: 日月同照上升——失物骤复（日月不容物久藏晦）；同时2宫主在上升——速得之。

rules.book: John Gadbury《Of Thefts, Fugitives, and Strays》——《Doctrine of Horary Questions》第9章第3部分（1658）
rules.condition: 征象星增光增行且在图中吉位
rules.original_text: The Significators increasing in light and motion, and posited in fortunate places of the Figure, presage a sudden recovery of the Goods lost or missing.
rules.translation: 征象星增光增行、且在图中吉位——预兆失物骤复。

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: 星位/宫位/日月主全可核验
rules.original_text: The chart records the ascendant as 2°12 Aquarius and the midheaven as 19°22 Scorpio. To obtain the closest match to the house cusps given, I have computerised the ascendant to 2°09 Aquarius and 19°28 Scorpio... This chart is drawn for Alexandria, Egypt, 12:35PM (LMT), 28th October 497 AD (Julian calendar). The computerised chart shows the day of Mars and the hour of Jupiter, corresponding to the 7th seasonal hour of the day reported in the text.
rules.translation: 验证用例·L497：497 AD 10月28日 12:35（当地平太阳时），亚历山大（经30E/纬31N）；上升 2°12′ 宝瓶、天顶 19°22′ 天蝎；日主=火星、时主=木星（文本所报第7季节时）。现代计算吻合（升 2°09′/MC 19°28′）。
rules.notes: Houlding 2007 研究文章；Neugebauer & Van Hoesen《Greek Horoscopes》pp.144-145；Eutocius 唯一署名星图

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: the Porphyry system of division is so simple to calculate, (requiring knowledge of only the ascendant and midheaven and the ability to divide the intervening longitude by three), that the need to write the position of each house cusp is superfluous.
rules.translation: Porphyry 分宫算法：仅需上升与天顶，将其间黄道距三等分即得各宫尖（故文本无需逐一记宫位）。
rules.notes: 第3层宫位计算；Porphyry《Introduction to Tetrabiblos》；Antiochus 2世纪同段

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: 497 AD 已用 Porphyry 分宫
rules.original_text: There is no reference in the text to the positions of house cusps, but the diagram clearly demonstrates the use of the Porphyry system of division... Eutocius has been convincingly argued to be a student of Ammonius, who studied under Proclus, who followed and developed the teachings of Porphyry; so it is very likely that these are original details.
rules.translation: L497 图中宫尖明确显示 Porphyry 分宫；Eutocius（Ammonius 弟子、Proclus 再传）师承 Porphyry 传统——图非后世风格化。
rules.notes: 分宫制系谱：Porphyry→Proclus→Ammonius→Eutocius

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: Of the three types of chart diagrams... it is this older chart style that really drives home the ancient view of the angular houses as 'centres', whose importance dominates the chart and grabs the attention of the eye. If the central area and outer rim were to be enclosed by a box, we would then have the typical chart form that becomes common in Latin and Islamic texts.
rules.translation: 星图史：早期图表形式以角宫为『中心』居图中央——显示古占以角宫为主导之观念；加外框即后世拉丁/伊斯兰通行图式。
rules.notes: 角宫 pivotal 观念；17世纪星图仍有此签名

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: the name for the midheaven is written in Greek as mesouranema... Just as we abbreviate Medium Coeli to MC, the Greek word mesouranema is abbreviated to mr, which is worked into a symbol.
rules.translation: 符号史·天顶：希腊 mesouranema（'天空之中央'）缩写 mr 组符号=后世 MC 之前身。
rules.notes: ηρ 组字（μ 截 ρ 竖笔）

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: The Greek word horoskopos... is easily recognised as meaning 'hour-marker' or 'hour-watcher'. Here the abbreviated characters are combined so that the down stroke of rho cuts across omega, and rests on top of kappa.
rules.translation: 符号史·上升：希腊 horoskopos（'时之标记/观时者'）缩写组字（ρ 截 ω 落于 κ）。
rules.notes: 仅古希腊星图四符号之一；182年 Karanis 纸草已有（无 κ 底）

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: The name of the descendant shown here is not so much a symbol as an abbreviation with a raised character at the end. This presents the first four letters of the Greek word dunon, which transliterates as dunon and translates as 'setting' or 'western' or 'evening'.
rules.translation: 符号史·下降：希腊 dunon（'没落/西方/傍晚'）缩写，与 oriens（东方/上升/早晨）同根相对。

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: The symbol that we see under the 4th house comprises the first two characters of the Greek word ypogeion, with pi resting on top of upsilon. The transliteration of this word is ypogeon and its translation 'under-earth' (or 'underground' or 'underworld')... this older term seems to do a better job of conveying the underworld mythology that is anciently associated with the 4th house, and its interpretative role in describing what lies beneath the surface of the ground.
rules.translation: 符号史·4宫：希腊 ypogeon（'地下/冥界'）——较后世 IC（Immum Coeli 下天）更能传达4宫地下神话与地表之下之解读义。
rules.notes: IC=Immum Coeli 为拉丁后世术语

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: The meaning of the 2nd house is listed as 'livelihood' although the term vios from which it is derived translates as 'life'; generally speaking to mean mode of life, manner of living, lifetime, livelihood, or caste... The sense of vitality connected with this word has left its mark in the polarisation of growth and gain associated with the active essence of the 2nd house, and the decay and loss associated with the passive essence of the 8th.
rules.translation: 宫名语义·2宫：希腊 vios（'生命/生计'）——生机之义留存于2宫之增益增长与8宫之衰败损失的对极结构。
rules.notes: 2宫增益-8宫衰败极化

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: The name of the 8th house, argos, also seems unusual. It is simply 'idle' (or empty, unused, unoccupied or barren). The connection with death does not seem obvious, but a state of decline is implicit in its weakness and inactive virtue.
rules.translation: 宫名语义·8宫：希腊 argos（'闲置/空/无用处/荒芜'）——其与死亡之关联隐于其弱与不活动之德（衰败态）。

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: 与上升 aversion+示死成+吉星自死得利
rules.original_text: Paulus Alexandrinus writes: The eighth from the Horoskopos is called idle, because it is in aversion and disjunct from the Horoskopic zoidion. It is also the post-descension of the setting zoidion, and signifies the accomplishment of death. This place is set down as dysfunctional, and when the benefics happen to be on this place, they make profits from deaths.
rules.translation: Paulus Alexandrinus 4世纪定义·8宫：称'闲置'——因与上升星座相悖且不相连（aversion/disjunct）；为没落星座之后没（post-descension）；示死亡之成；此宫为失能之宫——吉星在其上反自死亡得利。
rules.notes: 《Introductory Matters》Paulus Alexandrinus；Antiochus《Thesaurus》I.27 亦谓2/3/6/8/12宫'无交易之地'

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: 星座符号演变的可核验事实
rules.original_text: The signs, Aries, Gemini, Cancer, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius and Pisces are easily matched to the glyphs of modern astrology, although Pisces is interesting for its use of dots instead of a binding stroke. Taurus, Leo, Virgo, Scorpio and Capricorn would be virtually unrecognisable outside the context of this chart, and the symbol for Capricorn is curious in presenting a glyph which, if turned upside down, would bear a close resemblance to that currently used for Saturn.
rules.translation: 符号史·星座符号：7 星座符号与现代接近（双鱼以点代连笔）；金牛/狮/处/蝎/摩羯几乎不可辨；摩羯符号倒置近似后世土星符号。
rules.notes: 符号学注记（第4层无关，引擎显示层可参考）

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: Most of the planetary symbols are similar to our familiar, modern glyphs. The exceptions are those of the Sun, (which could be mistaken for the modern glyph for Mars), and Jupiter (which would look familiar if the horizontal stroke across the middle was re-arranged as a vertical stroke through the bottom). Of these symbols only that of the Sun and Moon are found (together with the ascendant and midheaven ligatures) in diagrams recovered from before the Byzantine period. By the 10th century we start to see a full range of symbols put to frequent use, as in this chart, although the modern glyph for the Sun does not appear to be in evidence before the Renaissance.
rules.translation: 符号史·行星符号：多数接近现代（日符号似现代火星、木星横竖异位）；拜占庭前仅见日月+升/顶组字四符号；10世纪始见全套；现代日符号不早于文艺复兴（1558 Fracastoro《Homocentrica》）。
rules.notes: 符号史时间线（引擎显示层可参考）

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: 前满月/灵点之位置在图中的可核验事实
rules.original_text: Saturn was known to be retrograde, a point referred to in the text, and yet no retrograde symbol appears in this chart. On the other hand two symbols appear which have not survived into modern awareness. One is the part of Spirit in the 6th house... The other is the symbol for the preceding Full Moon which is placed between Saturn and the Moon in the 3rd house.
rules.translation: L497 细节：土星逆行但图中无逆行符号；有后世失传二符号——6宫之灵点（Part of Spirit）、3宫土月间之前满月符号（panselenos）。
rules.notes: 前满月位置=古典 hyleg 等技术依赖之细节

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: Finally, the symbols for the north and south nodes appear to be inversions of those used later, and could easily be mistaken for each other by modern eyes. These earlier representations make sense, however, if we think of the underlying semi-circle of the north node denoting ascension rather than descension (and vice versa).
rules.translation: 符号史·月交点：早期南北交符号互为后世之反转（北交之半圆示升而非降）——现代视角易混。
rules.notes: 引擎显示层若复刻古代图式需注意

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.result: L497 固定星位与 497 AD 吻合（岁差260年）
rules.original_text: Using Ptolemy's value of one degree per century for the constant rate of precession we obtain a time interval of 260 years. Since Ptolemy's catalogue refers to the beginning of the reign of Antonius Pius in A.D. 137, we find that the positions in our text correspond to the year 137+360=497 which is exactly the year of the horoscope.
rules.translation: 岁差验证：以托勒密 1°/百年 之岁差率，自 137 AD（Antoninus Pius 朝初，托勒密星表历元）推 260 年=497 AD——与星图年份精确吻合，证星位真实。
rules.notes: Neugebauer & Van Hoesen GH p.153；预算法（precession）

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究
rules.author: Deborah Houlding 研究文章（Skyscript，2007-10）
rules.original_text: Alexandria has a longitude of exactly 30E and a latitude of exactly 31N, and it was such an important centre for astrology that it was well catered for by contemporary tables. Eutocius states that he recorded 'the stars and the centres' accurately according to the tables of Ptolemy. The planetary positions also show closer alignment with true values than the computer reproduction demonstrates, with Neugebauer and Van-Hoesen assuming a 2½° correction for precession, which shows deviations of 'about 1° only for Venus and Mercury in longitude'.
rules.translation: 校算事实：亚历山大经30E纬31N 整，托勒密表精备——Eutocius 自述按托勒密表录『星与中心』；行星位加 2.5° 岁差修正后与真值仅金水黄经差约1°。
rules.notes: GH p.153；古星图罕见之高精度例

rules.book: Greek Horoscope L 497（Eutocius，497 AD）——星图史、Porphyry 分宫与符号研究

All of the house cusps are numbered around the exterior edge, apart from the 3rd house... The other double notations, for houses 4, 6, 9 and 10, indicate where sign boundaries occur within the quadrant divisions. We use a similar method of differentiation around the exterior of quadrant charts drawn with equally-spaced houses today.

rules.translation: 图表有效·月亮：月在星座首度或尾度——勿断（问者来试探）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.translation: 是否被窃·证6/7：贼星四分/合月亮——被窃；任何行星在上升给贼星力量——被窃。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.translation: 是否被窃·证8/9：游走星在上升或2宫——被窃；福点或其主失势——被窃。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If none of thefe aforefaid Teftimonies be it is not ftolen. But neverthelefs in your Figure exactly obferve and compare the teftimonies, for not ftolen, and thefe teftimonies for ftolen and fee which is moft weightieft and according give Judgement.
rules.translation: 是否被窃·总则：以上证词皆无——未被窃；仍须比较'被窃'与'未被窃'两组证词孰重，按多数证词断。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon be in the feventh, in the fign of the eight, at a Sextile or Trine to the Moon then the thing enquired after is not ftolen, but taken away in Jeft.
rules.translation: 未被窃·证1：月在7宫/8宫星座，六合或三合月亮——未窃，系玩笑拿走。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If neither the Lord of the Houfe of the Moon, Or the Lord of the Houfe of the Second feperate not themfelves from another, nor any Planet from them, then the thing enquired after is not taken away: but over lookt and miftaken.
rules.translation: 未被窃·证2：月宫主与2宫主互不分离、亦无行星离之——未窃，系看漏/错放。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.translation: 未被窃·证3：上升主与日/时主合相——未窃，物在问者家。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Lord of the Hour be in the Afcendant, the thing wanting is not ftolen but in the Querents houfe.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Firft conider the fign Afcending and the fign the Lord of the Afcendant is in and in what quarter, fecondly the fign the Lord of the fecond is in, thirdly the fign of the fourth, and the fign the Lord of the fourth is in, and the Planet in the fourth, fourthly the fign the Moon is in, fifthly the fign where the part of fortune is, fixtly the fign the Lord of the hour is in, and Collect all thefe teftimonies together, and according to the Major teftimony fo Judge.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册

rules.translation: 贼之记号·部位：月四分/冲贼星——按宫位断记号部位：2宫=颈、3宫=臂肩，依序类推。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon have any dignities where a Perigrine Planet is, then there is a Mark where the Moon is, or where that Perigrine Planet is.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If Saturn be infortunate in the Afcendant, gives a bruife or the like in the head or face. Mars infortunate in the Afcendant fignifies a cut in the head or face, or elfe damnified by Iron.
rules.translation: 贼之记号·上升：土星在上升失势=头面瘀伤；火星失势在上升=头面刀伤/铁伤。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 记号在6宫主星座/6宫尖星座
rules.original_text: If that the Lord of the fixth be infortunate there is a Mark in the fign where he is, and likewife in the fign of the cufpe of the fixth.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be in the fecond or fixth, it is one of the houfhold Servants.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If a Planet be in the firft houfe, and that Planets fign be on the third houfe, and that fign be feminine, fay he was robbed by his fifter or fome Kin-woman or fome neighbour near him.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·亲属：行星在1宫而其星座落3宫且星座阴性——姐妹/女亲/近邻。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the feventh be in the fixth or eight from his own houfe, it is a fervant, but if in his own houfe, then fome Jolly fellow of great name and fame in the houfe.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·7宫主：7宫主在6/8宫（自其庙）——仆役；在其庙——家中名望之人。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that both the Luminaries behold the Afcendant, the Thief is one of the family.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Sun and Moon be both in their own houfes, it is one of the family: But if only one of the lights doth behold the Afcendant, the Thief is one that is a familiar in the houfe but doth not dwell there.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·日月庙：日月各在其庙——家贼；仅一光体照上升——家中熟人（非住家）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Sun be fignificator it fignifies the Father, Uncle, Grand-father or Mafter. The Moon the Mother, Sifter or Nurfe, or otherwife fome Tankerd-bearer, or a Water-woman, a Chirurgeon-woman or the like. If Venus, the Wife or Miftrefs chiefly in the houfe.

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 7宫主三六合升；日月在三分主位
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the feventh behold the Afcendant by Trine or Sextile, it is a neighbour. If the Sun and Moon be both in their Triplicities it is a neighbour.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·邻人：7宫主三/六合上升——邻人；日月皆在其三分主位——邻人。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Jupiter fignificator accufeth fome Gentleman of a good family that hath ftained the reputation of his kindred, a great wanderer, and is not fufpected and probably may be a gueft in the houfe, and of a Sanguine complexion.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·木星：木星为贼星——有家世之绅士（玷污门第）、大游荡者、不被人疑、或为家中宾客、多血质。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 兄弟学徒子女（火）/密友跑腿（水）
rules.original_text: Mars Significator denotes a Brother or a Prentice, a Son or a Daughter of the Querent. If Mercury it is fome familiar friend, if he be in the eleventh houfe, otherwife fome runner of Errands, or fome byfervant of the houfe.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·火/水：火星=兄弟/学徒/问者子女；水星=密友（在11宫）或跑腿/家仆。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Thief be in the houfe or exaltation of the Lord of the Afcendant, the Thief is of the kindred of the Querent. The Lord of the Afcendant being in the houfe or exaltation of the Thief, denotes Kindred.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·庙旺互置：贼星在升主之庙/旺——贼为问者亲族；升主在贼星之庙/旺——亦亲族。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: The Sun and Moon beholding each other by a Trine Afpect denotes kindred. The Lord of the third or fifth in the Afcendant, or applying to the Lord of the Afcendant denotes kindred.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·亲族：日月三合互照——亲族；3/5宫主在上升或应用升主——亲族。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 日冲升=恶邻；贼星在9宫=生人
rules.original_text: If the Sun be in Oppofition to the Afcendant, it is an overthwart neighbour. The fignificator of the Thief in the ninth houfe it is a ftranger.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·陌生人：日冲上升——凶蛮邻人；贼星在9宫——陌生人。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 贼星启动/双体星座+月水照
rules.original_text: The fignificator of the Thief in a moveable fign Afpected of the Moon or Mercury, or in their houfes, or in any of their dignities it is a ftranger. The fignificator of the Thief in a double bodied fign the fame.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·陌生人：贼星在启动星座受月/水照，或在其庙旺——生人；在双体星座——亦生人。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator be in an Angle in the terms of Jupiter, or in the terms of Jupiter, the Thief is more noble then the Querent.
rules.translation: 贼之身份·身份高下：贼星在角宫且落木星界——贼比问者高贵。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: The fignificator of the Thief in a fruitfull fign it notes more then one Thief. The fignificator of the Thief in a fign, where there is more then one Perigrine Planet, it notes more Theeves then one.
rules.translation: 贼数·多贼：贼星在丰饶星座——不止一贼；贼星所在星座有多个游走星——多贼。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月4宫双体；月水等力星座
rules.original_text: The Moon being in the fourth houfe in a common fign, there is more then one Thief. If that the Moon and Mercury be in equall figns it notes more Theeves then one.
rules.translation: 贼数·多贼：月在4宫双体星座——多贼；月与水星在等力星座——多贼。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Two Perigrine Planets that are fignificators in Quartile or Oppofition of one another, epecially from the firft to the feventh houfe it fignifies that one Thief will accufe another, probatum eft.
rules.translation: 贼数·互告：两游走贼星四分/冲（尤自1宫对7宫）——一贼告发另一贼（经验证）。
rules.notes: P.21-22；probatum est=已验证

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Thief be in a fixed fign it fignifies but one Thief and no more. If that the Moon be in any Angle in a fixed fign, it notes onely one Thief.
rules.translation: 贼数·单贼：贼星固定星座——仅一贼；月在角宫固定星座——仅一贼。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Afcendant be a Mafculine fign and the Lord of the hour a Mafculine Planet the Thief is a man. If otherwise they be feminine it notes a woman.
rules.translation: 贼之性别：上升阳星座+时主阳行星=男贼；皆阴=女贼。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 升/时主一阳一阴；月星座阴阳
rules.result: 两贼（一男一女）/按月定性别
rules.original_text: If that one be Mafculine and the other feminine, it fhews two Theeves viz. a man and a woman. If that the Moon be in a Mafculine fign it denotes a man. If in faeminine figns then a woman.
rules.translation: 贼之性别·混合：一阳一阴——男女两贼；月阳星座=男、阴星座=女。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Sun be fignificator of the Thief and he betwixt the Afcendant and the tenth houfe but cheifly in Aries, Taurus Or Gemini, it notes the Thief very young almoft in Childhood. From the tenth houfe to the feventh houfe, but cheifly in Cancer, Leo Or Virgo, it fignifieth youthfull years.
rules.translation: 贼之年龄·日征象：日（贼星）在上升至10宫间（尤白羊金牛双子）——童稚；10至7宫间（尤巨蟹狮子处女）——少年。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: From the feventh to the fourth houfe, cheifly in Libra, Scorpio Or Sagitarius it fignifies the Thief is of a middle age. If the fignificator of the Theif be between the fourth houfe and the Afcendant it fignifies old age.
rules.translation: 贼之年龄·象限：7至4宫间（尤天秤天蝎射手）——中年；4宫至上升间——老年。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月盈/亏；贼星土星系/尾度
rules.result: 年轻（月盈）/年老（月亏/土星系）
rules.original_text: The Moon increafing the Thief is young, the Moon decreafing the Thief is old. If the fignificator of the Thief be in the houfe of Saturn, or Afpected of him or in the latter degrees of a fign it fignifies old age.
rules.translation: 贼之年龄·月相与土星：月盈=贼年轻、月亏=贼老；贼星在土星庙/受土照/星座尾度——老。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 月初年轻/月中中年/月末老年
rules.original_text: The Moon in the beginning of the moneth notes young, in the middle of the moneth middle age, in the end of the moneth it fignifies old age.
rules.translation: 贼之年龄·月龄：月历月初=年轻、月中=中年、月末=老。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Thief be direct and a heavy planet, or joyned with a heavy Planet, it fignifies good Age, but if Retrograde then old.
rules.translation: 贼之年龄·顺逆：贼星顺行+重行星（土木）——壮年；逆行——老。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 贼星尾度/顺/离灼/应果宫
rules.original_text: If that you find him in the end of a fign direct or feperating from combuftion, or applying to a Planet in a Cadent houfe, fay that he is gone or going out of town.
rules.translation: 在城与否·离城：贼星星座尾度/顺行/脱离灼伤/应用果宫行星——已离城或将离。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Alfo if the Lord of the Afcendant or one of them be in Angles, he is not gone out of Town as yet but is near the Querent.
rules.translation: 在城与否·近：升主在角宫——未离城，近问者。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Ifthe fignificator of the Theif be in a Cadent houfe then he is gone far, epecially if that the Lord of the Afcendant and the Moon be more then 90 degrees afunder.
rules.translation: 在城与否·远：贼星果宫——已远去（尤升主与月距>90°）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that you find the fignificator of the Thief going out of one fign into another, the Thief is either gone or going out of town.
rules.translation: 在城与否·换座：贼星正离一座入另一座——已离城或将离。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 门破黑（硬相位）/门修好（软相位）
rules.original_text: If that the Moon be in Conjunction Quartile Or Oppofition of Saturn, the door or gate of the Thief is broken or black. In Trine or Sextile to Saturn mended again.
rules.translation: 贼门特征·土星：月合/四分/冲土星——贼门破或黑；三/六合土星——门修好。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: The Moon in Oppofition Quartile or Oppofition of Mars, the door or gate of the Thieves houfe is burnt or damnified by Iron. In Trine or Sextile to Mars, mended again.
rules.translation: 贼门特征·火星：月合/四分/冲火星——贼门烧损或铁伤；三/六合火星——修好。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon be increafing in light or in a fixed fign, his gate or door is part under the earth, or the houfe ftandeth under a banck fide. The Moon in fixed or moveable figns he hath but one door. The Moon in common figns more then one door.
rules.translation: 贼门特征·门数/位置：月盈或在固定星座——门半在地下/屋在坡下；固定/启动星座——一扇门；双体星座——多扇门。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 固定=1英里/度、启动=杆、双体=10英里/度
rules.original_text: Behold how many degrees are betwixt the fignificator of the Thief and the Moon... If in fixed figns account for every degree a mile, if in moveable figns fo many Rods. If in Common figns fo many tens of miles.
rules.translation: 距离·贼月：贼星与月之度数差——固定星座每度=1英里；启动星座=杆（rod）；双体星座=每度10英里。
rules.notes: P.25；跨书分歧：Gadbury 固定=1弗隆/双体=5/启动=17——学派开关

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Or look what distance there is betwixt the Afcendant and his Lord, fuch is the distance between the thing loft and the place.
rules.translation: 距离·升主：上升与其主之距=失物与失主处之距。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 双体=5步 启动=17步 固定=1000步/度
rules.original_text: And for one degree in a Common fign give five paces, and for one degree in a moveable fign give feventeen paces. And for one degree in a fixed fign give 1000 paces. Note that one mile gives 1000 paces.
rules.translation: 距离·逃犯换算：双体星座每度=5步；启动星座每度=17步；固定星座每度=1000步=1英里。
rules.notes: P.47；与 Gadbury 判例一致（17/5/1英里）

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon behold the fignificator of the Thief by Trine or fextile, the goods are in the Thiefes hands. If the Lord of the houfe of the Moon doth behold the fignificator of the Thief by Quartile or Oppofition then the Thief fhall loofe them again.
rules.translation: 货物在贼手：月三/六合贼星——货在贼手；月宫主四分/冲贼星——贼将再失货。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Ifthe fignificator of the Fhief gives virtue to no Planet, then he hath the goods ftill in his own keeping. If that the fignificator of the Thief keep his own vertue to himfelf, he hath the goods in his own hand.
rules.translation: 货物在贼手·力量：贼星不给任何行星力量——货仍自持；贼星自守其力——货在自己手。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 货已脱手/将归还（给升主力时）
rules.original_text: But if the fignificator of the Thief part with his vertue to any other Planet he hath delivered them out of his poffeffion. If that the fignificator of the Thief give his vertue to the Lord of the Afcendant he will give them again to the owner either in part or the whole.
rules.translation: 货物在贼手·脱手：贼星交力与他行星——货已脱手；贼星给力升主——将还问者（部分或全部）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Ifto the Lord of the third, to a brother kindred or neighbour of the owner. And fo of all the twelve houfes you may eafily know to whom he hath delivered them.
rules.translation: 货物在贼手·交付对象：贼星给力3宫主——交给问者兄弟/亲族/邻人；十二宫依此类推。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 升主追贼星；贼星受火损
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant follow after the fignificator of the Thief he fhall be taken. If the fignificator of the Thief be unfortunate by Mars he fhall be taken.
rules.translation: 是否被擒：升主追赶贼星——贼被擒；贼星受火星损害——被擒。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 被擒/入狱（失势久囚或死）
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be in his owne houfe the Thief fhall be taken. If the fignificator of the Thief be in the twelfth houfe he fhall be Comitted to prifon. If unfortunate lye long, or dye there.
rules.translation: 是否被擒·入狱：升主在其庙——被擒；贼星在12宫——入狱（失势则久囚或死狱中）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Thief be unfortunate, the Thief fhall be taken.
rules.translation: 是否被擒：贼星失势——被擒。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Thief be in Quartile or Oppofition, to the Lord of the Afcendant the querent doth fufpect evil report undeferved.
rules.translation: 被疑者·冤屈：贼星四分/冲升主——问者冤枉被疑者（恶名不实）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the eighth be in the fifth or the eleventh houfe. or if the Moon be void of courfe, the party fufpected is not guilty. If the Moon be joyned to Jupiter, Venus or the Part of Fortune, the party fufpected is not guilty.
rules.translation: 被疑者·无罪：8宫主在5/11宫；月空亡；月合木星/金星/福点——被疑者无罪。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be in a Cadent houfe, and not joyned to a Planet in an Angle that receiveth him, the fufpected is not guilty.
rules.translation: 被疑者·无罪：升主在果宫且未合角宫接纳行星——被疑者无罪。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 上升启动星座+土火照/南交在升
rules.original_text: If that the Afcendant be a moveable fign as Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricornus and fo much the more if that Saturn or Mars have any Afpect to the Afcendant, or if that the Dragons-tail be in the Afcendant, the party fufpected is not guilty and the report is falfe.
rules.translation: 被疑者·无罪：上升启动星座（白羊巨蟹天秤摩羯）；尤土/火照上升或南交在上升——无罪且传闻为假。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon be joyned to a Planet in a Cadent houfe, the party is not guilty.
rules.translation: 被疑者·无罪：月合果宫行星——被疑者无罪。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 四角固定；月合凶星/凶座
rules.original_text: If the Cufp of the 4 Angles be all fixt it fignifies that the Party fufpected is guilty. If the Moon be joyned to an evill Planet or in an evill fign the party fufpected is guilty.
rules.translation: 被疑者·有罪：四角宫尖皆固定星座——被疑者有罪；月合凶星或在凶星座——有罪。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月凶照/时主冲蝎摩羯/时主南座夜宫
rules.original_text: If the Moon be evilly afpected the party fufpected is guilty. If the Lord of the hour be in Oppofition to Scorpio, or Capricornus the fufpected party is guilty. If that the Lord of the hour be in a South fign, and a night houfe the fufpected is guilty.
rules.translation: 被疑者·有罪：月受凶照；时主冲天蝎/摩羯；时主在南星座夜宫——被疑者有罪。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Thief, do apply to the Lord of the Afcendant, by Trine or Sextile they fhallbe had again.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证1：贼星三/六合应用升主——可找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月软相应用2宫主；升主在庙
rules.original_text: If the Moon apply to the Lord of the fecond houfe by Trine or Sextile, the goods ftolen fhall be recoveret. If the Lord of the Afcendant be in his own houfe, the owner fhall recover the goods himfelf.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证2/3：月三/六合应用2宫主——可找回；升主在其庙——问者自找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 2宫主应升主；月软相+启动星座
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fecond apply to the Lord of the Afcendant it denotes recovery. If the Moon apply to any Planet by Trine or Sextile, and the application be in moveable figns, look how many degrees it is till they come to their perfect Afpect, and in fo many days it fhall be recovered.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证4+应期：2宫主应用升主——可找回；月软相应用他星且应用在启动星座——距成相位之度数=找回天数。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be fortunate in the Diameter of the firmanent, then the Thief fhall bring again the thing from whence he ftole it.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证5：升主吉照（直径=对宫/冲位）——贼将把赃物送回原处。
rules.notes: P.30；'Diamiter of the firmanent' 疑指对宫（冲位）

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon behold the Sun by Oppofition, the Thief fhall be found, but the goods not to be had by any means.
rules.translation: 能否找回·人货分离：月冲日——贼可寻，货不可得。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon Jupiter or Venus, be fortunate in the fecond or firft, it fhews good hopes of recovery, if the Moon applies to her difpofer, or to the Lord of the terme fhe is in by Conjunction Trine or Sextile, it notes recovery.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证6：月/木/金吉在1/2宫——找回有望；月合/三/六合其定位星或界主——可找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon doth apply to the Lord of the eighth houfe dead... the beaft dead or will be fpeedily.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·死活：月应用8宫主——牲畜已死或将死。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fixth be unfortunate by Saturn or Mars, then the beafts are loft. Chiefly if the Lord of a Cadent houfe.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·是否丢失：6宫主受土/火损害——牲畜丢失（尤果宫主时）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 水=北低地 火=东林地
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fixth be in watry figns North, in a low place. If that the Lord of the fixth be in fery fignes they are Eaftward in woods where are bufhes or brambles or where fire hath been.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·方位：6宫主水象——北向低地；火象——东向林地灌木/曾失火处。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 土=南场地 风=西沼泽
rules.original_text: If in earthly fignes then fouth in Grounds. If in Aiery fignes then are weftward in marfhy Grounds.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·方位：6宫主土象——南向场地；风象——西向沼泽地。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 丘陵/新建沼泽/沟水芦草
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fixth be in moveable figns, they are in hilly grounds. If in fixed figns, they are in marfhy grounds where new buildings are. If in Common figns, then they are in grounds where ditches and water is, and where Rufhes grow.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·地形：6宫主启动星座——丘陵地；固定星座——新建处沼泽地；双体星座——有沟水芦草地。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon doth apply to the Lord of the eighth houfe, from the place where fhe is, then dead.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·死活：月自其位应用8宫主——已死。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the twelfth do apply to the Lord of the Afcendant, or the Afcendant unto the Lord of the twelfth, and they or either of them be in the fecond fifth or eleventh houfes, the beafts fhall be had again.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·找回：12宫主与升主互应用，且其一在2/5/11宫——可寻回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 升内行星→升主处行星→月亮
rules.original_text: If that a queftion be propofed concerning one that dwelt in the houfe with the Querent, then take the Planet in the Afcendant not being the Lord thereof. But if none be there then take the Planet that is in the fign or houfe where the Lord of the Afcendant is, if that none be there, then take the Moon, fhe fhall be the fignificator of the Fugitive.
rules.translation: 逃犯·征象星：问同住者——取上升之行星（非升主）；无则取升主所在星座/宫位之星；再无不取月亮。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 按与问者关系取宫主为征象星
rules.result: 6宫仆/3宫兄弟/5宫子女/7宫相识/11宫朋友
rules.original_text: But if he enguires for his fervant then take the fixtn houfe and his Lord, if for his brother or fifter then the third houfe, if for his child then the ffth houfe. If for his acquaintance his publique then take the feventh houfe, if for his friend, then take the cleventh houfe and fo be fure to take the right fignificator.
rules.translation: 逃犯·按关系取宫：仆人=6宫；兄弟姊妹=3宫；子女=5宫；相识=7宫；朋友=11宫。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 逃犯星在升；月分离→应用逃犯星
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Fugitive be in the Afcendant he comes of his own accord. If the Moon be feparated from the Lord of the Afcendant, and then immediately doth apply to the fignificator of the Fugitive, you fhall hear news of the party fled.
rules.translation: 逃犯·归来/消息：逃犯星在上升——自归；月自升主分离随即应用逃犯星——将闻逃者消息。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Fugitive be Combuft, or entring into combuftion, the Fugitive fhall be found though he hide himfelfe ferretly, this hath been often proved.
rules.translation: 逃犯·灼伤：逃犯星被灼或将入灼——逃者必被发现（纵隐匿，屡验）。
rules.notes: P.43-44；probatum

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon doth behold her owne houfe by Sextile or Trine, the Fugitive fhall return in three days. The Moon being in Virgo, he that flyeth fhall foon return.
rules.translation: 逃犯·归期：月三/六合其庙——三日归；月在处女——逃者速归。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon be joyned to ill Planets, as Saturn or Mars, or the Dragons tail, or to a Planet Retrograde he fhall be found, or come again of his own accord.
rules.translation: 逃犯·归来：月合凶星（土/火/南交）或逆行星——逃者被寻回或自归。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be joyned to the fignificator of the Fugitive or applying to them, the Fugitive is taken.
rules.translation: 逃犯·被擒：升主合或应用逃犯星——逃者被擒。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon be in the Afcendant with Jupiter or Venus he comes again.
rules.translation: 逃犯·归来：月与木星/金星在上升——逃者自归。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 7宫=知情者家 角宫=屋内 上升=巷街
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Fugitive be in the feventh houfe, he is hid in the houfe of him that knowes him. If his fignificator be in an Angle, he is in a houfe, if in Afcendant he is in a clofe or ftreet.
rules.translation: 逃犯·藏身处：逃犯星在7宫——藏在知情者家；在角宫——在屋内；在上升——在巷/街。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Fugitive be within three degrees of the Afcendant or his Lord, it notes the Fugitive to be in the Town or Parifh of the querent and very near him. If that he be within feventy degrees of the Afcendant or his Lord, he is yet in Town.
rules.translation: 逃犯·距离：逃犯星距上升或其主<3°——逃者在问者本镇/教区极近；<70°——仍在镇内。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon give virtue to Saturn or Mars, or be in any of their houfes, then he is with fome kinfman as evill as himfelf.
rules.translation: 逃犯·同伴：月给力土/火或在土火庙——逃者在同类恶亲族处。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 固定=3英里/度 双体=1英里/度
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Fugitive be in fixed figns, account for every degree betwixt him and the Lord of the Afcendant three miles. If in common figns one mile. If in moveable figns...
rules.translation: 逃犯·距离换算：逃犯星固定星座——每度=3英里；双体星座——每度=1英里；（启动星座=17步，见GF-067）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the Fugitive be in the fourth, fixth or tenth houfes, he is gone but a little way. If in the third or nineth houfes he is gone far.
rules.translation: 逃犯·远近：逃犯星在4/6/10宫——去不远；在3/9宫——已远。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 逃犯星分离升主+应用他星
rules.original_text: If that the fignificator of the Fugitive feparate from the Lord of the Afcendant, epecially if he have any dignities in the place where the fignificator of the Fugitive is, and he applying to any Planet... he is out of Town.
rules.translation: 逃犯·离城：逃犯星分离升主（尤其在该处有尊贵）且应用他星——已离城。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Ifthe fignificator of the Thief or the Moon be within 30 degrees of the Lord of the Afcendant the Thief is near the loofer of the goods. If within 70 degrees then he is within the town or Parifh of him that loft the goods.
rules.translation: 贼之远近：贼星/月距升主<30°——贼近失主；<70°——在失主之镇/教区内。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the feventh be in a ftrong Angle, he is not out of the town where the Theft was done.
rules.translation: 贼之远近·7宫主：7宫主在强角宫——未离作案之镇。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon be in the Afcendant with any of the fortunes, it notes recovery.
rules.translation: 能否找回·证7：月与吉星（木/金）在上升——可找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 启动=天数 固定=月年
rules.original_text: The application of the Moon to any Planet by Trine or Sextile, if the application be in moveable figns: look how many degrees they want of their Afpect, and fo many days it fhall be before it fhall be recovered. If in fixed figns, then moneths or years.
rules.translation: 找回应期·总则：月软相应用他星——启动星座：距成相度数=天数；固定星座：月或年。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 继宫=周月 果宫=月年
rules.original_text: If the part of fortune be in a fuccedant houfe, then fo many weeks or moneths. If the part of fortune be in a Cadent houfe then fo many moneths or years.
rules.translation: 找回应期·福点：福点在继宫——周或月；在果宫——月或年。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: Look to the Sun and Moon; and if that they be parted from the part of fortune, or be both or either of them joyned to the part of fortune... he that is nighest the part of fortune, either by application or feparation, fhall fignifie the time.
rules.translation: 找回应期·日月：日月离福点或合福点——距福点最近者（应用或分离）示时间尺度（度数=天数/周/月）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the two fignificators be in Cadent houfes, then it doth fignifie they will quickly be recovered.
rules.translation: 找回应期·果宫：两征象星皆果宫——快速找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Afcendant be in Quartile or Oppofition to the Lord of the feventh, then the goods will be ftopt from the owner. If the Moon be in Quartile or Oppofition to the Lord of the feventh, it fignifies the fame.
rules.translation: 不可找回·证1：升主/月四分/冲7宫主——货被扣于问者外。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 凶星在2/8宫；2宫主逆/灼/在8宫
rules.original_text: If that Saturn, Mars or the Dragons-tail be in the eighth or fecond houfes it fhows fmall hopes of recovery. If the Lord of the fecond be Retrograde or Combuft. Idem. Alfo the Lord of the fecond in the eighth houfe no recovery.
rules.translation: 不可找回·证2：土/火/南交在2/8宫——希望渺茫；2宫主逆行或灼伤——同；2宫主在8宫——不可找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon be Combuft or under the beams of the Sun the fame.
rules.translation: 不可找回·证3：月灼伤或在日光下——不可找回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
