rules.original_text: If the Sun and Moon be going to a Conjunction under the earth at the time of the Loofing the goods, neither goods nor Thief fhall ever be heard of.
rules.translation: 不可找回·证4：失物时日月将合于地下——货与贼永无音讯。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 三六合=友 四分冲=仇
rules.original_text: If that the Lord of the Afcendant and fignificator of the Thief, do behold each other by Trine or Sextile, then is friendfhip between them, and fo much the more if there be reception. But if they do behold each other by Quartile or Oppofition, then do they hate one another.
rules.translation: 问者-贼关系：升主与贼星三/六合互照——有友谊（有接纳更甚）；四分/冲——彼此仇恨。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that there be no Afpect between them, then they do neither love nor hate one another.
rules.translation: 问者-贼关系·无相位：升主与贼星无相位——无爱无恨。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 火贼星在10宫；贼星在上升
rules.original_text: If that Mars be fignificator and in the tenth houfe the querent is the Thief himfelf. If that the fignificator of the Thief be in the Afcendant the Querent is Thief, the more fure it is if the fign Afcending and the fignificator of the Thief be in Conjunction or reception.
rules.translation: 问者即贼：火星为贼星且在10宫——问者本人是贼；贼星在上升——问者是贼（升座与贼星合相/接纳更确）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 角=已婚 继=将婚 果=未婚
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the feventh houfe be in an Angle he is married, if in a fuccedant houfe towards marraige, If in a Cadent then nether married nor like to be.
rules.translation: 贼之婚姻：7宫主在角宫——已婚；继宫——将婚；果宫——未婚亦难婚。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 判例断方：星座与象限分列
rules.result: 按星座/象限交叉综合断方
rules.original_text: This figure is more difficult then ordinary in giving Judgment by reafon that all the four quarters are concerned in it... Firft I find the fign of the feventh houfe a weftern fign. Secondly Mercury Lord of the feventh houfe and Lord of the hour in a northen fign, but in the fouth quarter. Thirdly the part of fortune in a eafterly fign, yet in a northern quarter.
rules.translation: 判例·四象限交叉（1663-9-29 盗窃案）：7宫=西象；水星（7宫主+时主）北象南象限；福点东象北象限——多象限互见，需按各证分别断方。
rules.notes: P.36-37；30英镑衣物案

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: I found the Moon in the firft houfe, and fhe applying to Venus, fhe having exaltation in the third, and entring the fign afcending... I told the querent that the goods would be dicovered, and that by a fifter of hers, or fome kinfwoman that dwelt that way, and fo it was for it was difcovered by her own fifter.
rules.translation: 判例·应验（1663案）：月升1宫应用金星（金在3宫旺）→断'由姐妹/女亲发现'——果由其亲姐妹发现（转卖者上门卖衣）。
rules.notes: P.38-39；probatum

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 判例：征象星阴阳断性别
rules.original_text: Likewife I found three theeves by the figure, two women and one man. Firft I find Mercury Lord of the feventh, in the tenth a fign feminine and likewife the houfe feminine, which doth fignifie one woman. Secondly, the Moon in Capricorn a feminine fign perigrine, and applying to Venus a feminine Planet, I did difcover another woman. Alfo finding the Sun in Oppofition to the part of fortune, I did difcover another which was a man.
rules.translation: 判例·贼数与性别（1663案）：断三贼（两女一男）——水星7宫主在10宫阴座阴宫=一女；月落摩羯（阴座）游走应用金星（阴星）=又女；日冲福点=一男。果验：男逃、两女入 Newgate，一缓一绞。
rules.notes: P.38-39；probatum

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 判例：日月近成相+启动星座
rules.original_text: Concerning the diftance I thus judged. Finding the Sun and Moon cafting their Afpects to the part of fortune, and within 5 degrees of the true Afpect and both of them newly feparated and in moveable figns, I did judge it to be fome five or fix furlongs North-weft, and fo it was.
rules.translation: 判例·距离方向（1663案）：日月照福点且距成相5°内、新分离、启动星座——断'西北 5-6 弗隆'；果验（Cow-Cross 附近小巷）。
rules.notes: P.37-38；probatum

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月给力土火/8宫主/果宫星
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the feventh houfe be in the Afcendant the fame... If that the Moon give virtue to Saturn or Mars, or to the Lord of the eighth, or to any Planet in a Cadent houfe, epecially by Trine or Sextile, the beaft are ftrayed of themfelves.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·走失非窃：月给力土/火/8宫主/果宫行星（尤三六合）——牲畜自走失（非被窃）。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 固定=被窃 启动=自走失
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the houfe of the Moon, or the Lord of the fecond, do feperate from any Planet, or from their own houfes, if the figns be fixt then ftolen, but if moveable of themfelves.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·窃/走失：月宫主/2宫主分离行星——固定星座=被窃；启动星座=自走失。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.result: 被窃/被赶走；否则近原处
rules.original_text: If that any Planet doth feperate from the Lord of the fecond houfe they are ftolen or driven away. If that none of thefe things be the beaft are not far from the place they firft went away.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·总则：行星分离2宫主——被窃或被赶走；皆无——牲畜离原处不远。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fixth or twelfth be in the tenth or nineth, they are in the cuftody of fome Juftice or Officer, or under lock.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·扣留：6/12宫主在10/9宫——牲畜在官差/长官处或上锁。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 牲畜星8宫失势；火照12宫月
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the beaft be unfortunate in the eighth houfe the beaft will die in the pound. If Mars doth Afpect the Moon in the twelfth by Conjunction Quartile or Oppofition, they will be killed in the pound.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·围栏致死：牲畜星在8宫失势——死栏中；火星合/四分/冲12宫之月——栏中被杀。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the fixth be in the twelfth houfe, then are the Beaft in the pound.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·在栏：6宫主在12宫——牲畜在围栏中。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the fignificator of the fixth houfe be fortunated by Jupiter or Venus, and they or either of them be in the fecond fifth or eleventh houfes, the beafts fhall be had again.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·找回：6宫征象受木/金吉照且其一在2/5/11宫——可寻回。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月界主/4宫主与升主同处
rules.original_text: If that the Lord of the Terme of the Moon, or the Lord of the fourth houfe be with the Lord of the Afcendant, or with his Almuten, the owner fhall have his goods again.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·找回2：月界主或4宫主与升主或其 Almuten 同处——可寻回。
rules.notes: P.42；Almuten=宫之最强尊贵主

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.condition: 月三六合升主/日；日在升
rules.original_text: The Moon in Trine or Sextile to the Lord of the Afcendant they will be found. The Moon in Trine or Sextile to the Sun, then they may be found. The sun in the Afcendant except in Libra or Aquaries the goods will be found.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·可寻：月三六合升主——可寻；月三六合日——可寻；日在上升（天秤/宝瓶除外）——可寻。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon doth apply to the Lord of the eighth houfe, from the place where fhe is, then dead.
rules.translation: 走失牲畜·死活2：月自其位应用8宫主——已死。
rules.notes: P.41；与GF-088同义重复出现，保留原文双记

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If the Moon be evill termes and with Saturn or Mars, or either of them be in the houfe where the Moon is, he is with fome poor ftrange people who will bring him again.
rules.translation: 逃犯·处境：月在恶界且与土/火同处或其一在月所在宫——逃者在穷困陌生人间，彼等将引其归。

rules.book: Anthony Griffin《An Astrological Judgement Touching Theft》（1665）——盗窃/失物/逃犯/走失牲畜卜卦全手册
rules.original_text: If that the Moon doth feperate from Jupiter or Venus, he fhall come back again, or a thing loft fhall be quickly found.
rules.translation: 逃犯/失物·归返：月分离木星或金星——逃者将归；或失物速寻回。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: Moon in ascendancy(力量位)且境况有利
rules.result: 开始之事成功；不利则反
rules.original_text: Because the Moon is near the Earth and accelerated in its course, it increases the conjunction of planets by communicating its force to them without ever receiving any force from them; it transfers brilliancy from one to the other; it corresponds to the new-born in that its beams develop gradually until they are full, and afterwards it declines gradually until it is no longer visible and disappears from the world. That is why the ancients said that it influences every deliberation and the beginning of any task. If it is in its ascendancy and its circumstances are favourable, anything which one may start at that moment will meet with success, and contrariwise if it is in the unfavourable circumstances. They added that, for the asker, you should observe the ascending sign with its rulers, and for the request, the 7th sign with its rulers, and always put the Moon in contact with it.
rules.translation: 月亮近地而运行加速，通过向诸行星传递其力而不受其力，增强行星的合相；它在两者间传递光辉；如新生者，其光芒渐满而后渐衰至隐没。故古人言其影响一切谋划与事务之开端。若月亮在其力量位且境况有利，则当下开始之事必成；境况不利则反之。又问者当观上升星座及其主星，所问之事当观第7宫及其主星，且常使月亮与之接触。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the Moon is moving by itself, [ void of course ] that indicates any futile thing, and it signifies that any thing which the asker requests cannot possibly occur.
rules.translation: 若月亮独行（出界，void of course），则兆一切徒劳之事，所问之事不可能实现。
rules.notes: void of course 为编者注

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 行星与月亮成合相或相位
rules.original_text: The planet which enters into conjunction or into aspect with the Moon prognosticates every future thing and anything which the asker will expect; if the planet is favourable, it will be a boon; if the planet is unfavourable, it will bring harm.
rules.translation: 与月亮成合相或相位的行星，预示一切未来之事及问者所望；行星吉则为福，凶则为害。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 吉星则曾有益、凶星则曾有损
rules.original_text: The separation from the Moon denotes things which have passed; if it separated in conjunction or in aspect with a helpful planet, it was beneficial, and with a harmful planet, it was sinister [ harmful ].
rules.translation: 与月亮的分离表示已过之事；若与吉星以合相或相位分离，则曾有益；与凶星分离则曾有损。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 从月亮受力的行星在力量位
rules.original_text: If the asterism which receives its force from the Moon is in its ascendancy, then the thing will be done properly; just the opposite if it should be weak.
rules.translation: 若从月亮接收其力的行星在其力量位，则事将妥善成就；若其弱则适得其反。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 一星座传递力量给另一星座
rules.result: 按接收者力量决定事件
rules.original_text: Likewise, in the case of any constellation which communicates force to another one, the event will take place according to the power of the recipient.
rules.translation: 同理，凡一星座向另一星座传递其力，事件将按接收者之力而定。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 月亮与凶星会合；上升有行星；月亮在极/果宫
rules.result: 事不能圆满完成；极位兆恐与病；果宫只兆恐
rules.original_text: On the day when the Moon is with the baleful planets, nothing which one may ask will be completed properly if there is a planet in the ascending sign; if the Moon should be in one of the poles of the meridian, then it is worse, because it forecasts fear in mind and sickness in body; if it should be in the falling [ cadent ] houses, it indicates fear but not sickness.
rules.translation: 月亮与凶星会合之日，若上升星座内有行星，所问之事不能圆满完成；若月亮在子午两极之一，则更糟——预示心中恐惧与身体疾病；若月亮在落陷（果）宫，则只兆恐惧而无疾病。
rules.notes: poles of the meridian=上升/天顶轴线；cadent=果宫

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The planets move in two faces, one helpful, the other harmful; wherever you find the planet to be favourable, predict good; for the opposite position, predict the opposite.
rules.translation: 行星运行有两面：一助一害。凡见行星处于有利之势则断吉，处相反之势则断相反。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 吉星被接纳更佳；凶星被接纳则害减
rules.original_text: The favourable direct planets are useful whether they receive or not. If they receive, so much the better. The unfavourable planets are destructive by their very nature, but if a planet should be received by it, its malignant influence will be attenuated. The same holds true whether the visual angle formed with it is a sextile or a trine aspect
rules.translation: 吉星直行则有用，无论是否被接纳；若被接纳则更佳。凶星本性破坏，但若被某星接纳，其恶性减弱。无论与之形成的视角为六分或三分相位均同此理。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星之光支配比例；相位离开上升点1°外；预兆星不与上升成相位
rules.result: 轻害或徒然恐惧；预兆星不触上升则所求不实现
rules.original_text: A planet should not be considered harmful until the rays of the harmful planet dominate it in proportion to the force of its body; if it is less than that, then it will forecast only slight harm; after it departs in aspect one degree from the new-born, and relatively more if it goes further away, it will provoke fear which will not have any practical consequence. That is [ also ] the procedure of the favourable planet. If the planet, which prognosticates all that which is to happen, does not form a visual angle with the ascending sign, the hope of the petitioner will not materialize.
rules.translation: 行星在凶星之光按其体之比例支配它之前，不应视为有害；若未达此程度，则只兆轻微之害。凶星之光离新生者（上升点）1° 之外，越远越只引起无实际后果的恐惧。吉星亦同此理。若预兆一切将发生之事的行星不与上升星座成视角，求者之望不能实现。
rules.notes: rays/combustion 阈值，1° 规则；new-born=上升点

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the beneficial planets are in aspect with the baleful planets, the influence of the latter will be less harmful.
rules.translation: 若吉星与凶星成相位，凶星之害较轻。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 其效为吉但伴痛苦悲伤
rules.original_text: The favourable always prognosticate a boon, and the unfavourable prognosticate harm. Nevertheless if the unfavourable one should be in its exaltation, the effect will be good, although it will involve pain and sorrow.
rules.translation: 吉星恒兆福，凶星恒兆害。但凶星若在其旺位（exaltation），其效虽吉，却伴痛苦与悲伤。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 吉星在失势/落陷/果宫且与上升无相位
rules.original_text: If the helpful planets should be in a position opposite to their character, in the house of their dishonour [ detriment ], in the house of their hatred [ fall ], or in the falling [ cadent ] houses, and if no aspect lies between them and the ascending sign, then it will exert absolutely no influence.
rules.translation: 若吉星处于与其本性相反之位：失势（detriment）宫、落陷（fall）宫，或果（cadent）宫，且与上升星座无相位，则毫无影响。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: Likewise if the unfavourable are in that position, their harm will be slight.
rules.translation: 凶星处此等位置，其害亦轻微。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 吉星在力量位且独主命盘
rules.original_text: If the favourable asterism is in its ascendancy and if it alone exerts an influence over the new-born, then its good influence will increase.
rules.translation: 若吉星在其力量位且独自对新生者（命主）施以影响，其吉益增。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 木星与吉星相位/金星制土星/木星制土星/金星制火星
rules.result: 木星令星性转吉；金星须借木星方能改土星；木星消土星之害，金星消火星之害更甚
rules.original_text: If Jupiter is in aspect with the favourable planet, it will make its nature favourable. Venus cannot modify the nature of Saturn except with the aid of Jupiter. Jupiter nullifies the harm of Saturn, but Venus nullifies the harm of Mars even more than does Jupiter.
rules.translation: 木星与吉星成相位，则使其性吉。金星不能改变土星之性，除非得木星之助。木星消除土星之害；金星消除火星之害，甚至胜过木星。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 兆卑劣之事但无力致吉凶
rules.original_text: If both the favourable and unfavourable planets are in a bad position, or if they scintillate, they prognosticate something vile; yet they cannot cause good or harm because of their weakness.
rules.translation: 若吉凶二星皆处劣位，或闪烁（scintillate），则兆卑劣之事；然因其弱，不能致吉或致害。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星在日东、有力星座、无凶星相位
rules.result: 优于闪烁或逆行之吉星
rules.original_text: If a baleful planet should be east of the Sun, in a sign wherein it exerts an influence, and if no other unfavourable planet is in aspect with it, then it is better than the favourable one which scintillates or is retrograde.
rules.translation: 若凶星在太阳之东，处于其有力之星座，且无其他凶星与其成相位，则此凶星胜于闪烁或逆行的吉星。
rules.notes: east of Sun=晨星，日东出之前可见

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星掌事+上升主星与之合+月亮四分/冲
rules.original_text: If the baleful are in control of the thing requested, and if the ruler of the ascending sign joins in conjunction with them, and if the Moon is in square aspect or in opposition, then, should the request be granted, its end will be detrimental.
rules.translation: 若凶星掌管所问之事，且上升主星与之合相，月亮成四分或冲相，则即使所求获准，其终有害。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星在上升星座有力量
rules.original_text: If the baleful is in an ascending sign and has within it any power, its influence will be less harmful; if it is retrograde, it will heap evil on evil.
rules.translation: 若凶星在上升星座且其中有其力，其害较轻；若逆行，则祸上加祸。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the baleful is in square aspect or in opposition, it will lose its favourable influence.
rules.translation: 若凶星处于四分或冲相，则失去其有利影响。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星在力量位且角宫/续宫
rules.original_text: If the baleful should be in the position of its power and in one of the poles or one of the supports, its force is to be considered equivalent to the force of the favourable planets.
rules.translation: 若凶星在其力量位，且在（角）极或支撑（续宫）之一，其力当视为与吉星之力等同。
rules.notes: poles=角宫（1/4/7/10），supports=续宫（2/5/8/11）

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the baleful is estranged in its position, then its influence will become more harmful.
rules.translation: 若凶星处于疏远之位，其害更甚。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 凶星在角宫/加害四分冲之星/成三分六分
rules.result: 四分冲则恶全，三分六分则恶减
rules.original_text: If the baleful is in one of the poles, or if it harms the star of the square aspect or opposition then its evil influence will be complete; all the more so of it is more powerful than the star. If, however, it is in a trine or sextile aspect, the evil influence will be attenuated.
rules.translation: 若凶星在角极之一，或加害于成四分/冲之星，则其恶完全；若其力强于该星则更甚。若凶星在三分或六分相位，其恶减弱。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 事有延迟，须经忧烦而成
rules.original_text: If the baleful should be in control of the thing requested, it indicates delay in the matter, and it means that it will not materialize but by grief and worry.
rules.translation: 若凶星掌管所问之事，则兆事之延迟，且须经忧烦方能实现。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 祸上加祸/福上加福/祸转福
rules.original_text: If the baleful should communicate its force to another ominous one, then it will heap evil upon evil; if a favourable one gives its force to another favourable one, then it will result in more luck: if a baleful gives its force to a favourable, then the fate will change from evil to good; the opposite will have an opposite effect.
rules.translation: 若凶星传力于另一凶星，则祸上加祸；吉星传力于吉星，则福上加福；凶星传力于吉星，则命运由祸转福；反之则有相反之效。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If any beneficial or injurious constellation is in its house or in the house of its honour, it will always result in a boon.
rules.translation: 任何吉凶星座，若在其庙（house）或旺位（house of its honour），恒为吉。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 行星在星座起始5°内/距宫界5°内
rules.original_text: Any planet at the beginning of a sign is considered weak until it is 5° away. Likewise, if the planet should be less than 5° away from one of the houses, it will be considered to be in the force of the house; if it is further away, then it falls beyond the force of the house.
rules.translation: 行星在星座起始处视为弱，直至距 5°。同理，行星距某宫界 5° 以内，视为处于该宫之力内；更远则超出该宫之力。
rules.notes: 5° 强度规则

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: Any asterism between the beginning of the house and 15° possesses great power.
rules.translation: 凡行星处于宫起始至 15° 之间，具大力量。
rules.notes: 15° 力量规则

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 行星与凶星极位相合且相位离开1°
rules.original_text: If the planet is with one of the poles of the baleful and it departs from its aspect by 1°, it will cause fear but it will not have any practical result.
rules.translation: 若行星与凶星之角极相合，且离其相位 1°，则只引起恐惧而无实际结果。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the constellation is in the house of its dishonour, it prognosticates grief, anguish, and distress.
rules.translation: 行星在其失势宫，则兆悲伤、焦虑与苦恼。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The planet which retrogrades denotes rebellion and the destruction of any project.
rules.translation: 逆行之星兆反叛与任何计划之毁灭。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 第一驻留果坏；第二驻留望不落空
rules.original_text: The planet, which is in its first station, is like a man who does not know what he will do, and its result is bad: if it is in its second station, it is like a man who expects something and whose hope will not be in vain.
rules.translation: 行星在第一驻留，如人不知所为，其果坏；在第二驻留，如人有所期待而其望不落空。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 星迟行；木/土在基本星座
rules.result: 事迟延；木土在基本星座则事加速
rules.original_text: If a star should be delayed in its course, it will delay the thing either fortunately or unfortunately; if Jupiter or Saturn should be in the variable [ cardinal ] signs, they will hasten the thing.
rules.translation: 若星运行迟滞，将迟延其事，或吉或凶；木星或土星在变动（基本）星座，则加速其事。
rules.notes: variable=cardinal 基本星座

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the planet is at the end of the sign, its force will be lost for the first sign, and all its force will pass to the sign into which it is to enter. If the planet is in the 29th degree of the sign, its force stays in the sign where it is, because the planet exerts force in 3 degrees: in the degree in which it is, in the preceding degree, and in the subsequent degree.
rules.translation: 行星在星座之末，其对原星座之力将失，全力转入将入之星座。行星在 29° 时其力仍在原星座，因行星之力作用于 3°：所在度、前一度、后一度。
rules.notes: 3° 作用规则；29° 规则

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 合相被中断后追及，追及前无他星介入
rules.original_text: If a star is about to enter into conjunction with a second star but, before the conjunction is consummated, the second star leaves for a different sign, and the first star pursues it and overtakes it, and if, before overtaking it, no other star unites with it, then the thing requested will be accomplished after the despair.
rules.translation: 若一星将与他星合相，然合相未成前他星入他星座，前星追及之；追及前无他星与之相合，则所问之事于绝望之后实现。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If a star is in aspect with another star, which then moves from its position before the lighter star reaches it, no harm will result, because the aspect does not interfere with the conjunction of celestial bodies.
rules.translation: 若一星与他星成相位，而他星在较轻之星到达前移离其位，则无碍——因相位不妨碍天体之合相。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If an asterism is in a sign which corresponds to its nature, its power will increase; if it is in a sign contrary to its nature, its power will weaken as, for example, Saturn in a house that is cold and dry.
rules.translation: 行星在与本性相符之星座，其力增；在与其本性相违之星座，其力减——例如土星在冷干之宫。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 吉星被接纳/凶星被接纳
rules.original_text: If the planet, which is received, is favourable, then its force increases: if it is detrimental, then its harm is lessened.
rules.translation: 被接纳之星若吉，其力增；若凶，其害减。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the planet is not in one of the places of its influence but is in the 6th or 12th house, it will not result in a boon.
rules.translation: 行星不在其有力之位而在第 6 或第 12 宫，则不吉。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If a planet is beneath the brilliancy and is one of the superior, it will exert no influence: the same is true of the inferior. If they retrograde, their influence is worse than any.
rules.translation: 行星在日辉之下（灼伤），上行星（外行星）无效，下行星（内行星）亦然；若逆行则其影响比任何情形更坏。
rules.notes: superior=火木土，inferior=金水

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 预兆星逆行转顺行/脱离日辉
rules.original_text: If the star, which serves for the prognostic, is retrograde, but later its motion follows the order of the signs, that indicates that the thing will be fulfilled partly. Likewise if it is beneath the rays of the Sun and then departs from there.
rules.translation: 预兆之星逆行而后转为顺行，则兆其事只部分实现；星在日光之下而后离开，亦同此理。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If a constellation, assuming that it is favourable, is in one of the censers, it will lose its good influence; if it is unfavourable, its influence will become worse.
rules.translation: 吉星在香炉位（cazimi，即与太阳极近之合相），失其吉性；凶星在其位则其影响更坏。
rules.notes: censers 为译者对 cazimi 之译；与通行 cazimi(17′内吉) 说法相反，Ibn Ezra 此处以凶论——版本分歧，如实标注

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 吉星不好不坏/凶星全害
rules.original_text: If the favourable planet is in the 8th house, it indicates neither good nor bad; if one of the unfavourable is there, that prognosticates complete harm.
rules.translation: 吉星在第 8 宫，不好不坏；凶星在 8 宫，兆完全之害。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 逆行兆不顺困难；直行则转吉
rules.original_text: If the planet is about to reverse its motion, it forecasts unsuccessful consultation, difficulty, and destruction: if its motion becomes direct, it will better the luck in the matter, its strength, and its uprightness.
rules.translation: 行星将逆行，则兆咨询不顺、困难与毁灭；若转为直行，则其事之运、力、正皆转佳。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the power of the planet should be 12 ° in an auspicious position, that will exert a better influence.
rules.translation: 行星之力为 12° 且在吉位，将施以更佳之影响。
rules.notes: 12° 规则

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 行星在固定/变动/双体星座
rules.result: 恒常/变化/部分恒或改两次
rules.original_text: If the planet is in a fixed sign, it forecasts anything which will be constant and firm; if it is in a variable sign, the thing will vary; if it is in a sign with a double body, it augurs that one part of the thing will remain constant or that the thing will be modified twice.
rules.translation: 行星在固定星座，兆事恒常坚固；在变动星座，事将变化；在双体星座，兆事之部分保持恒定，或事将改两次。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the receiving star is in an unfavourable position, it portends evil.
rules.translation: 接纳之星若在不利之位，则兆凶。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the ruler of the ascending sign is in the house of its hatred, it cannot control completely the thing requested.
rules.translation: 上升主星在其失势宫，则不能完全掌控所问之事。
rules.notes: house of its hatred=fall 落陷

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the planet enters into conjunction with the favourable or unfavourable, the nature of the stronger of them is to be considered.
rules.translation: 行星与吉星或凶星合相，当论其中较强一方之性。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 上升主星传力给事主星/事主星传力给上升主星
rules.original_text: If the ruler of the ascending sign communicates force to the ruler of the consulted house, the thing will be desired very strongly; but if the ruler of the thing sought communicates force to the ruler of the ascending sign, then the thing will materialize without any difficulty.
rules.translation: 若上升主星传力给所问宫之主星，则所求甚为迫切；若所问事之主星传力给上升主星，则事无难而成。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If there is an obstructing planet between them, it prognosticates an individual who will put an obstacle between it and the thing sought.
rules.translation: 若两者之间有碍星，则兆有人将设障碍于其与所求之事之间。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 上升主星与事主星分离
rules.original_text: If the master of the ascending sign separates from the master of the thing sought, his desire will disappear.
rules.translation: 上升主星与所问事之主星分离，则其愿望将消失。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If no planet is in aspect with the Moon, that indicates indolence.
rules.translation: 无行星与月亮成相位，则兆怠惰。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If many stars are in aspect with the Moon,, those which assist in fulfilling the object will be numerous.
rules.translation: 多星与月亮成相位，则助成其目标者众多。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 星从上升主星传递至事主星
rules.original_text: If an asterism transfers from the ruler of the ascending sign to the ruler of the thing requested, then the thing will be accomplished through an intermediary.
rules.translation: 若有星从上升主星传递至所问事之主星，则事经中介而成。
rules.notes: translation of light 传递

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.condition: 上升主星在三分宫且三分主星相位
rules.original_text: If the ruler of the ascendant is in the house of its triplicity, and if the rulers of the signs of the triplicity are in aspect with it, those near to it will help it.
rules.translation: 上升主星在其三分宫，且三分之各星座主星与其成相位，则近者助之。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the planet moves in the path, to which we referred for the return of brilliancy, the thing will take place after despair.
rules.translation: 行星沿回光之道而行（传递返回之光），则事于绝望后实现。
rules.notes: return of brilliancy=光之回归，即合相后回归相位

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the prognosticator is in a position to communicate force, that means that the thing will be accomplished exactly as he wishes.
rules.translation: 预兆星处于可传力之位，则事将如其所愿而成就。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the prognosticator is about to communicate influence, that augurs that the thing will reveal another.
rules.translation: 预兆星将传递其影响，则兆此事将揭示另一事。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in the act of communicating the nature, that denotes great joy in the affair.
rules.translation: 预兆星之证言正处于传递本性之时，则兆其事大悦。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognostication is in the act of communicating two natures, that points to the joy of the petitioner and of the one consulted.
rules.translation: 证言传递两种本性，则指求者与被问者皆悦。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in a direct manner, that indicates a good outcome in anything desired.
rules.translation: 证言以直行方式呈现，则兆所求诸事皆吉果。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in an oblique manner, it means that he will abandon the project.
rules.translation: 证言以斜行方式呈现，则其人将弃其计划。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in the position of prohibition, it augurs that the affair will be destroyed after having been expected.
rules.translation: 证言处于禁止之位，则兆其事于被期待之后遭毁。
rules.notes: prohibition=禁止（相位未成而被截断）

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in the manner of the return of light to evil, it shows that the asker will repent his request.
rules.translation: 证言以回光向恶之方式呈现，则示问者将悔其所求。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator corresponds to interference, it portends that events will arise which will destroy the thing.
rules.translation: 证言对应于干扰，则兆将有事件兴起而毁其事。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is in the phenomenon of the accident, something will happen to it which will put an end to the consultation.
rules.translation: 证言处于意外现象之中，则将有事故使其咨询终止。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator coincides with ruin, the petitioner will seek other counsel.
rules.translation: 证言逢毁灭，则求者将另寻他策。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is analogous to the culmination of brilliancy, it points to an individual who will destroy his own consultation.
rules.translation: 证言类比于光辉之极点（光之完成），则指有人将自毁其咨询。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator refers to pleasantness, it marks a man to whom it has done some good.
rules.translation: 证言指愉悦，则标记一曾受其惠之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator falls in the phenomenon of recompense, it forecasts that it will do good to others also.
rules.translation: 证言落在报偿之现象，则兆其亦将惠及他人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The testimony of the mutual reception of the prognosticators predicts things which are preparing something that has not yet come to mind.
rules.translation: 预兆星互容之证言，预示正酝酿而尚未显现于心之事。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator corresponds to liberality, it augurs that the solicitor and the adviser will love one another.
rules.translation: 证言对应于慷慨，则兆求者与顾问彼此相爱。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator is taken at the time of similarity, it marks every good which is in the process of formation.
rules.translation: 证言在相似之时取得，则标记一切正在形成之善。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 指囚者不幸者/最大之益
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator occurs in the evil mediation, it refers to the prisoners and the unfortunate, but if it occurs in a good one, it refers to the maximum benefit.
rules.translation: 证言在恶之中介，则指囚者与不幸者；在善之中介，则指最大之益。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: If the testimony of the prognosticator coincides with the dignity, it is an omen of every high rank.
rules.translation: 证言逢尊贵，则兆一切高位。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The seven planets in their respective positions in the ecliptic offer prognostics. If a star is in its house, it is an example of a man in his home.
rules.translation: 七星在黄道之各位置各作预兆。星在其庙（house），如人在其家。
rules.notes: 78-108 为行星状态之人像比喻（simile）

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the house of its honour is like a man in the pinnacle of his rank.
rules.translation: 星在其旺位（house of its honour），如人处其位阶之巅。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star at its limit [ terms ] is like a man in his seat.
rules.translation: 星在其界（terms），如人坐于其座。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the house of its triplicity is like a man with his relatives.
rules.translation: 星在其三分宫，如人与亲戚同处。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in its face corresponds to a man with his ornaments and clothing.
rules.translation: 星在其面（face），如人佩其饰、著其衣。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in its aphelion is similar to a man astride his horse.
rules.translation: 星在其远日点（aphelion），如人乘骑其马。
rules.notes: aphelion 译法存疑，可能指特定尊贵位置

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in its form is like a man in a situation suitable to himself.
rules.translation: 星在其形（相称之位），如人处适己之境。
rules.notes: form 具体所指不明，Houlding 亦未注

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star, which is in the reverse of its form, is like a man in a situation unsuitable to himself.
rules.translation: 星在其形之反，如人处不适己之境。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the house of its hatred is like a man dissatisfied with himself.
rules.translation: 星在其失势（憎恶）之宫，如人自厌。
rules.notes: house of its hatred=fall 落陷

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in a position over which it does not predominate corresponds to a man who is not in his country.
rules.translation: 星在不为其所支配之位，如人不在其国。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the house of its perihelion is similar to a man who falls from his greatness.
rules.translation: 星在其近日点（perihelion）之宫，如人自其高位坠落。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The Star which moves beneath the rays of the Sun is like a man in prison.
rules.translation: 在日辉之下运行之星（灼伤），如人入狱。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star which scintillates is analogous to a man who is on the verge of death.
rules.translation: 闪烁之星，如人濒临死亡。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star, which is about to assume a retrograde motion, is like a man bewildered and trembling at the misfortunes which will befall him.
rules.translation: 将逆行之星，如人因将临之祸而惶惑战栗。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star which retrogrades is like a twitching and rebellious person.
rules.translation: 逆行之星，如抽搐而反叛之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in its second station is like a man who expects good luck.
rules.translation: 星在第二驻留，如人期待好运。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star, which is delayed in its course, corresponds to a man exhausted and lacking strength to go on.
rules.translation: 迟行之星，如人疲惫而无力前行。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star accelerated in its course is like a young man running.
rules.translation: 加速运行之星，如奔跑之少年。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The eastern star is kindred to a person happy to fulfill his desire.
rules.translation: 东升之星，如乐于遂其愿之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The western star is like an indolent man.
rules.translation: 西落之星，如怠惰之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in conjunction with the Sun is like a person who sits with the king on his throne.
rules.translation: 与太阳合相之星，如伴君王坐其王座之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in aspect is similar to an individual who seeks what he desires.
rules.translation: 成相位之星，如追求其所欲之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The departing star is like a man who is repentant about the thing.
rules.translation: 分离之星，如悔其已事之人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star at a pole of the meridian resembles a man who stays at his post.
rules.translation: 星在子午之极（角宫轴线），如人坚守其岗位。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star at a support is like a man who is hopeful.
rules.translation: 星在支撑位（续宫），如人怀有希望。
rules.notes: support=succedent 续宫

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in a falling house is like a man who changes his position.
rules.translation: 星在落陷（果）宫，如人改变其处境。
rules.notes: falling house=cadent 果宫

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The stars in conjunction correspond to two companions.
rules.translation: 合相之星，如两位同伴。
rules.notes: 104-108 为相位之人像比喻

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The stars in a sextile aspect are like two individuals who seek each other's love.
rules.translation: 六分相位之星，如两人彼此寻求爱意。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The stars in a trine aspect resemble two persons of similar temperament.
rules.translation: 三分相位之星，如性情相似之两人。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The stars in a square aspect are similar to two people each one of whom seeks control for himself.
rules.translation: 四分相位之星，如两人各求自控。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The stars in opposition are kindred to two men fighting each other fiercely.
rules.translation: 冲相之星，如两人激烈相斗。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.result: 如新生儿/如正合时之事
rules.original_text: The star in the ascending sign is like the new-born child that comes out of the womb of its mother or like a thing which occurs at the right time.
rules.translation: 星在上升星座，如自母胎而出之新生儿，或如正合其时之事。
rules.notes: 109-120 为 12 宫之人像比喻

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 2nd house is the same as the person who is in the house of his assistants.
rules.translation: 星在第 2 宫，如人在其助从者之宅。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 3rd house harmonizes with the man who visits his brothers.
rules.translation: 星在第 3 宫，如人访其兄弟。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 4th house corresponds to a man in the house of his forbears or in his land.
rules.translation: 星在第 4 宫，如人在其祖宅或其故土。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 5th house is in affinity with a person in his business and in his pleasure.
rules.translation: 星在第 5 宫，如人从事其事业与其欢乐。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 6th house is equivalent to a weak man running away.
rules.translation: 星在第 6 宫，如弱者逃遁。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 7th house is the same as a man prepared for battle.
rules.translation: 星在第 7 宫，如人备战。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 8th house is related to a person beset with fear and terror.
rules.translation: 星在第 8 宫，如人遭恐惧与惊骇。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 9th house refers to a man leaving his place to go into exile or a man who has lost his high rank.
rules.translation: 星在第 9 宫，如人离乡流亡，或如人失其高位。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 10th house stands for a person in his power, in his dignity, and in his profession.
rules.translation: 星在第 10 宫，如人处于其权、其尊、其业之中。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 11th house is in conformity with a man at the home of his friends.
rules.translation: 星在第 11 宫，如人在友人之家。

rules.book: Ibn Ezra《120 Aphorisms for Astrologers》
rules.original_text: The star in the 12th house is akin to a person in prison.
rules.translation: 星在第 12 宫，如人入狱。

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: Ptolemy taught that their significance was derived by analogy with the ratios of the musical scale. The conjunction is equivalent to the same two notes played in unison. The opposition divides the circle in the ratio 1:2, which corresponds to the octave. The sextile (5:6) corresponds to a minor third, the square (3:4) to a perfect fourth and the trine (2:3) to a perfect fifth.
rules.translation: 相位-音乐比（Ptolemy 传统）：合=齐奏（1:1）；冲=八度（1:2）；六合=小三度（5:6）；四分=纯四度（3:4）；三合=纯五度（2:3）。
rules.notes: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Loeb p.73-5；David Plant《Music of the Spheres》1995

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: In addition to the Ptolemaic aspects, Kepler proposed the quintile (72°), bi-quintile (144°) and sesqui-quadrate (135°). Extending the analogy of the musical scale, the quintile is equivalent to an interval of a major third (4:5), the sesqui-quadrate to a minor sixth (5:8) and the bi-quintile to a major sixth (3:5).
rules.translation: Kepler 新相位（《Harmonices Mundi》1618）：五倍相位 quintile=72°（大三度 4:5）；倍五倍 bi-quintile=144°（大六度 3:5）；倍四分 sesqui-quadrate=135°（小六度 5:8）。
rules.notes: 基于谐和理论+800 本命图+天气研究实证；Ken Negus 编译 Kepler's Astrology 1987

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 仅协和音程比入相位体系
rules.original_text: Kepler realised that many more aspect configurations are possible, but rejected them on aesthetic grounds. The Ptolemaic aspects and his three new ones gave a pleasing correspondence with the consonances of the musical scale, other aspect ratios produced only discord.
rules.translation: 相位筛选原则：其余比值仅生不谐——Kepler 以音程协和为准取舍，拒斥仅凭可能性的相位。
rules.notes: 和谐论核心判据

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 不可尺规作图之相位被拒
rules.original_text: Kepler rejected aspects based upon geometric figures like the 7-sided septagon and 9-sided nonagon because they cannot be constructed with straight-edge and compasses... He regarded such figures as 'unknowable' and declared that 'God did not employ the septagon and other figures of this species to embellish the world'.
rules.translation: 相位拒斥·尺规作图：七边形/九边形（即七分相 51.4° 等）不可尺规作图——Kepler 视为'不可知'而拒用。
rules.notes: Koestler《The Sleepwalkers》p.396

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: Lilly gives instructions for finding not only the quintile, bi-quintile and sesqui-quadrate, but also the semi-sextile (30°), semi-quintile (36°), semi-quadrate (45°) and sesqui-quintile (108°).
rules.translation: Lilly 1647《Christian Astrology》扩展相位：除 Kepler 三新相位外，另收半六合 30°、半五合 36°、半四分 45°、倍五倍之半 sesqui-quintile 108°。
rules.notes: Lilly《Christian Astrology》1647 p.785 起（'Effects of Directions' 章）

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 五倍系=稍吉 四分系=稍凶
rules.original_text: The direction of the Midheaven to sesqui-quadrate Mars, for instance, 'may endanger, in some small measure, our Native's repute with false aspersions'. The Ascendant to quintile Mercury suggests that he 'should now have rectified his books of accounts and receive much benefit from Mercurial men'. The quintile-based aspects emerge as 'mildly beneficial' in their effects; the quadrate-based as 'slightly harmful'.
rules.translation: 次级相位解读基调（Lilly 判例）：倍四分 135°——'稍有害'（如 MC 倍四分火星=名誉受损）；五倍 72°——'稍有益'（如上升五倍水星=理账得利）。自 Lilly 起成为教科书定式。
rules.notes: Lilly《Christian Astrology》案例：'an English merchant'

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 否常规 12 宫分宫（仅重角宫）
rules.original_text: he dismissed the use of the 12 houses as 'Arabic sorcery'. While accepting that the angles were important, he could see no justification for conventional house division.
rules.translation: Kepler 对 12 宫制之批判：斥为'阿拉伯巫术'；认角宫重要，但否常规分宫之理由（'Demonstrate the old houses to me... prove that there can be neither fewer nor more'）。
rules.notes: 致 David Fabricius 信；Gauquelin《Neo-Astrology》p.92 引

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.condition: 星座体系批判（Kepler 立场）
rules.result: 星座/庙旺/吉凶均无自然根据
rules.original_text: He even went so far as to question the validity of the signs of the zodiac, arguing that they were derived from human reasoning and arithmetical convenience rather than any natural division of the heavens. He had no time for elaborate schemes of planetary sign rulership and saw no reason why some planets should be classed as benefic and others as malefic.
rules.translation: Kepler 对星座/庙旺/吉凶之批判：星座为人为推理与算术便利之产物；否行星庙旺体系；否吉凶星分类。
rules.notes: 后自限：'人类自古巴比伦起即构想此分法——上帝或不以其语言向人言说'

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 区隔通俗占星与神圣占星
rules.original_text: Kepler's famous metaphor comparing astrology to the 'foolish daughter' of the 'wise mother' (astronomy)... the foolish daughter represents a particular style of astrology — popular astrology... 'the mother would starve if the daughter did not earn anything'.
rules.translation: Kepler 对占星之立场：'愚女与智母'之喻——否的是通俗占星（almanac 制作者），非占星本身；'母将饿死若无女供养'（靠编历书维生之自嘲）。
rules.notes: Kepler 视占星为'神工之证'；帝国欠俸 20000 florins

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: From his long-term study of weather conditions correlated with planetary angles, and from detailed analysis of his collection of 800 birth charts, Kepler concluded that when planets formed angles equivalent to particular harmonic ratios a resonance was set up... He considered this 'celestial imprint' more important than the traditional emphasis on signs and houses.
rules.translation: Kepler 实证方法：天气-行星角度长期研究 + 800 本命图分析——相位=谐和比共振（'天印'），重要性高于星座宫位。
rules.notes: 先例：近代天气占星研究之祖

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: Saturn, for instance, moves at a rate of 106" per day at aphelion and 135" at perihelion. Cancelled down, the ratio 106:135 differs by only two seconds from 4:5 — equivalent to the interval of a major third.
rules.translation: 行星角速度-音乐比实证：土星远日点 106″/日、近日点 135″/日——比值 106:135 与 4:5（大三度）仅差 2″。
rules.notes: Kepler 测得所有行星角速度皆近音程比；Hoyle 评'frighteningly good'

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: When he compared the extremes for combined pairs of planets the results were even more marvellous, yielding the intervals of a complete scale. Thus, the ratio between Jupiter's maximum and Mars' minimum speed corresponds, to a minor third; the interval between Earth and Venus to a minor sixth.
rules.translation: 行星对组合音程：木星最大-火星最小速=小三度；地球-金星=小六度——行星对得完整音阶。
rules.notes: Warrain 延展：天王/海王/冥王星角速度亦合谐和比

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 多体系并存（非单一映射）
rules.original_text: The music of the spheres was never a fixed system of correspondences. Many variant schemes existed because each philosopher would necessarily approach it from a slightly different perspective.
rules.translation: 天体音乐非固定对应体系：各家方案各异（Pythagoras/Plato/Pliny/Cicero/Ptolemy/Fludd/Copernicus 各有所本）。
rules.notes: Godwin《Harmonies of Heaven and Earth》1987 p.130

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 12 星座↔音程映射（Ptolemy 首创）
rules.original_text: In Ptolemy's unfinished Harmonics, he proposed the earliest known 'tone-zodiac', linking the 12 signs to musical intervals.
rules.translation: 音程-黄道带（tone-zodiac）：Ptolemy 未完成之《Harmonics》首倡 12 星座-音程对应。
rules.notes: Steiner 等继之

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.result: 汉堡学派/谐波占星承其绪
rules.original_text: Witte's system of 'planetary pictures', based upon midpoint combinations, was developed by Rheinhold Ebertin... The spirit of Kepler can also be glimpsed in harmonic astrology as developed by John Addey (1920-82).
rules.translation: Kepler 谱系之现代继者：Witte 汉堡学派（1913，中点/行星图）+ Ebertin《Combination of Stellar Influences》；Addey 谐波占星（波形=节奏/拍子，异于 Kepler 之音阶）。
rules.notes: Harding & Harvey《Working with Astrology》1990 p.11

rules.book: Johannes Kepler 相位与和谐理论——选自 David Plant《Music of the Spheres》(1995, Traditional Astrologer 杂志 9 期)
rules.original_text: In his first almanac he predicted an exceptionally cold winter and a Turkish incursion into Austria. When both predictions proved correct, he unexpectedly gained a reputation as a prophet.
rules.translation: Kepler 历书之验：首部历书预言酷冬+土耳其入侵奥地利——皆应，得'先知'名（本人自认意外）。
rules.notes: 任职 Graz 'mathematicus' 须年编历书

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Principles of Art are three, Reason, Sense, and Experience, but the Principles of Operations four, viz: The Planets, The Parts of Heaven, The Fixed Stars, and the Site or Position of all those in respect of one another.
rules.translation: 艺术三原理=理性/感官/经验；操作四原理=行星/黄道诸部/恒星/彼此方位（与卷一 CARD-113 同源，此为 Lilly 英译）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-113

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: There are some things perfectly known, as the Circle of Ascension, some in a competent measure, as the Revolution of the Sun; some may be known although they yet are not, as the Revolution of the Superiors; some things fall under knowledge, yet cannot be exactly known, as the precise Ingress of the Sun into the Equinoctial Point; some are neither known, nor can be known, as the complete commixtures and distinct virtues of all the Stars.
rules.translation: 知识五层：全知（升圈）/近似（日回归）/未知可知（外行星回归）/界内永不可确知（日入春分点）/不可知（星之混合与力）——同 CARD-121。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-121

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: An Astrologer is so far only true and honest, as he depends in his conjectures on principles of natural philosophy, and since those Arts which are inherent in their proper subjects, cannot promise any certainty concerning matters to come, the Astrologer ought never to pronounce anything absolutely or peremptorily of future contingencies.
rules.translation: 占星家之真与诚=其猜测依自然哲学之原理；凡来事不可许诺确定——绝不可对未定之事绝对断言（同 CARD-103）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-103

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Men may be said almost to be compelled by the Stars, even in voluntary actions, by means of their corrupt affections and ignorance.
rules.translation: 人虽自愿之行动亦几乎为星所迫——经其败坏之情与无知（自由意志为幻象，同 CARD-174 卷一对应）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Always deliver judgements from the Stars in general terms, or if thou dost otherwise let it be when thou hast very evident testimonies and in great and weighty matters.
rules.translation: 星断常以一般性措辞；除非证据确凿且事体重大方可断定。
rules.notes: 引擎置信度输出参考

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When true genitures exactly taken in accidents prove false or absurd, and not agreeable to the things signified, they are to be accounted monstrous, and are to be avoided as anatomists do monstrous bodies in their dissections; for they overthrow Art.
rules.translation: 精校之本命若与事实不合、成荒谬，当视为'怪胎'弃之（如解剖家弃畸形体）——此类反例推翻艺术（异常值剔除原则）。
rules.notes: 验证集清洗依据

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Generals are to be gathered from Singulars, and Singulars from Generals, and an Artist ought always to learn to distinguish between that which is by itself, and that which is only by accident.
rules.translation: 一般由个别归纳、个别由一般推演；须辨'自性'与'偶性'之分。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The strength and efficacy of Fixed Stars is to be considered from their magnitude, their splendours, their natures or properties, their nearness to the Ecliptic, their place in the World, their multitude, their first oriental appearance, the purity of their place, the similitude or agreement of the body or rays of a Planet with them and their circle of position.
rules.translation: 恒星力之九要素：星等/光度/性质/离黄道之近/世中之位/众寡/首次东出/其位之纯/与行星体或光线之似合及其位圈。
rules.notes: 引擎恒星模块评分维度

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Light of the time is the Sun in the day, and morning twilight; and the Moon in the night when she is above the Earth, and in her morning rising: so that sometimes there may be two lights of the time, sometimes it so happens that there is none.
rules.translation: 时之光体：昼=日、晨昏=日；夜=月（在地上时及其晨升）——有时二光体、有时无一（同 CARD-141）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-141

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When a Planet is within five degrees of the cusp of any house, it shall be accounted to have virtue in that house though actually posited behind the cusp in another house.
rules.translation: 行星距某宫宫头 5°内=计入该宫有作用（即便实居前宫近界）——宫界 5° 宽容则。
rules.notes: 可编码常量：cusp±5°

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Not only Trines and Sextiles may be counted friendly aspects, but even Squares and Oppositions too, if there happen a Reception.
rules.translation: 不独三分六分为吉相：若有'互容'（reception），四分冲亦作吉相计。
rules.notes: reception 逻辑=相互入庙/擢升

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A Child is then said to be born when first it breathes in air at its mouth, when outside its mother's womb.
rules.translation: 出生定义=出母胎后首吸空气之时（同 CARD-126）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-126

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Those that have the Luminaries unfortunate in Angles will be apt to commit suicide.
rules.translation: 光体在角宫受克=易自尽。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Those that have Saturn in Opposition to Jupiter, will never enjoy peace, and those that have the Dragon's Tail with Jupiter, will seldom be rich.
rules.translation: 土冲木=终身无宁日；月尾（南交点）合木=少富。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Those that have Saturn and Mars in the same part of the Zodiac will be liable, in the course of their lives, to many misfortunes; and if they shall both be in Taurus, and posited in the fourth house; when the Ascendant, by direction, comes to their rays, the Natives will have some severe falls, or be in danger by reason of some ruinous buildings falling on them.
rules.translation: 土火同宫=命多灾；若俱在金牛第四宫，升点方向入其光=重跌或塌屋之危。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Fixed Signs give learning; with the exception of Scorpio; Common Signs, manners and conversation, with the exception of Virgo, and Moveable Signs, riches; with the exception of Capricorn; whence it appears that those are bad nativities that have all the Planets in Virgo, Scorpio or Capricorn.
rules.translation: 固定星座=学问（天蝎除外）；双体（变动）星座=举止言谈（处女除外）；基本（移动）星座=财富（摩羯除外）——行星全在处女/天蝎/摩羯=恶盘。
rules.notes: 三性分类映射

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 哑升+水非人性+土性恒星
rules.original_text: If the Ascendant be one of those Signs called "Mute," and Mercury in one that is not humane, with any fixed Star of the nature of Saturn, the Native will never speak well, but bring forth his words with difficulty.
rules.translation: 升点属'哑'星座、水星居非人性星座、且合土性恒星=言语困难、不善辞令。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 月金牛2宫离木向日三分
rules.original_text: He that hath the Moon in Taurus in the second separating from the Square or Opposition of Jupiter, and applying to Trine of the Sun shall obtain very considerable riches.
rules.translation: 月金牛第二宫、离木之四分/冲、而向日之三分应用=得巨额财富。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Abscissor, cutter off of life, or killing Planet is on the Ecliptic, and an Infortune in an Angle, the Native will die a violent death.
rules.translation: 寿限切断星（Anaereta）在黄道上+凶星在角宫=暴死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When an Infortune is posited on the cusp of the seventh house, the Native will be liable to great calamities, and if an Infortune be in Aspect with the Sun or Moon afflicted in the same place, the Native, though a Prince, shall suffer a world of troubles.
rules.translation: 凶星居第七宫宫头=大难；凶星相克同处受克之日/月=虽王侯亦多灾。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Aries ascending, signifies the Natives to be handsome, and of a grave composed temper, but Scorpio on the horoscope, notes them to be great liars.
rules.translation: 白羊升=貌美庄重；天蝎升=大说谎者。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon is in Scorpio in Square of Saturn in Leo, or in Opposition to him when he is partially in Taurus, the Native rarely has either wife or children. If Saturn be in Aquarius, he will be a mere woman-hater.
rules.translation: 月天蝎四分土狮子、或土偏居金牛时冲=罕见婚配子嗣；土水瓶=厌女。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If the Dragon's Tail be with Saturn in Square of the Moon, and she Cadent, the Native will be consumptive, especially if from an Angle; but if besides it be in Square to the Lord of the Ascendant, he will be sickly and infirm all the days of his life, and if such Aspect happen in or from the sixth house, so much the worse.
rules.translation: 月尾合土、四分月而月落陷=痨病（尤自角宫）；再四分升主=终身病弱；若发自第六宫=更甚。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Jupiter is in the Sixth house, Retrograde, and the Lord of the Second Peregrine, and no benevolent fixed star to help, the Native will be very poor and necessitous.
rules.translation: 木星第六宫逆行+二宫主'游走'（peregrine）+无吉恒星相助=赤贫。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: He that has Mars in his Ascendant shall be exposed to many dangers, and commonly receives, at some time, a great scar or cut, on his face.
rules.translation: 火星在升点=多险、常面有伤疤。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mercury mixing his beams with Mars, is a great argument of a violent death.
rules.translation: 水星合火星光线=暴死之强征。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If Jupiter and the Moon in any nativity shall be very weak and afflicted though other positions seem never so promising, yet the Native shall be exceedingly unhappy.
rules.translation: 木与月俱弱受克=他位虽佳、命主仍极不幸。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Venus is with Saturn and beholds the Lord of the Ascendant, the Native is inclined to Sodomy, or at least shall love old hard favoured women, or poor dirty wenches.
rules.translation: 金合土而照升主=倾向同性之欲/好年老丑女/贫贱女子。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现'

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Venus and Jupiter shall be in the Seventh, the Moon beholding them in her own dignities, and the Dragon's Head joined with them or with Mercury, the Native shall get a great Estate by means of his wives.
rules.translation: 金木在第七宫、月以己之尊严照之、月头合之或合水星=因妻得巨产。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Moon full of light in Conjunction with Mars, makes the Native to be counted a fool; but if she be void of light and with Saturn, he is so indeed.
rules.translation: 月满光合火=被视愚；月无光合土=真愚。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Venus in the heart of the Sun gives vast honours and dignities, the same may be hoped for, if a Planet with the Fixed Star called "Cor Leonis," behold the Moon.
rules.translation: 金入日心（cazimi）=大荣尊；行星合'狮心'（Regulus）照月=同。
rules.notes: 恒星 Regulus 数据

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Moon in the Seventh house renders Natives subject to the Falling-sickness, and sometimes when she is in the Ascendant, but generally she makes them fools if she be afflicted.
rules.translation: 月第七宫=癫痫；有时在升点；月受克=愚。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Bastards and supposititious children have frequently the Ascendant in aspect with the Moon, and not the significator of the Father; and for the most part attended with indications of some great misfortunes, and either there is no agreement between the Lord of the fourth, the Lord of the second and the Moon, or else Venus is joined with Mars or Mercury.
rules.translation: 私生子/假子之盘：升点常照月而非父征象星；多伴大凶征；四宫主/二宫主与月不协，或金合火/水。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 木10宫强三分火+日合月头+月合Regulus
rules.original_text: When Jupiter shall be in the tenth in Trine of Mars, and strong; and the Sun with the Dragon's Head, and the Moon with Cor Leonis; such Native, though the son of the meanest peasant, shall be wonderfully exalted.
rules.translation: 木星第十宫三分火星而强+日合月头+月合Regulus=虽农夫之子亦大贵。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When any Planet shall be partly on the cusp of the Seventh in his own house, the Native's death will be of the nature of that Planet and Place.
rules.translation: 行星入己宫、部分居第七宫宫头=死之性质随该星与该位。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Infortunes in Angles denote a public death or a sudden one; the Sun there, afflicted, it shall be by some weapon, or burning; the Moon, by hanging, or drowning, according to circumstances.
rules.translation: 凶星在角宫=公开之死或暴死：日受克=刀兵/焚；月=缢/溺。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Sol and Mars peregrine or the Dragon's Tail in the Second, signifies that the Native shall squander away his substance or Estate foolishly.
rules.translation: 日火'游走'或月尾在第二宫=挥霍家产。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 月冲日合雾星/月7宫受二凶
rules.original_text: When the Moon in Opposition to the Sun is joined with nebulous stars, the Native will have some defect in his sight; if the Moon in the Seventh be afflicted by both the Infortunes, and if their rays are very strong he will be blind.
rules.translation: 月冲日合雾状星=目疾；月第七宫受二凶克且光强=盲。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The compound rays of Jove, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, give the greatest grace and sweetness of speech, and therefore when Jupiter shall be in Virgo, and the Moon in Pisces, it is an opportune time for the birth of a Poet.
rules.translation: 木金水月合光=言辞优雅；木处女+月双鱼=诗人诞生之时。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The fifth sign from the Ascendant signifies the Native's children, because it is of the same nature as the sign on the Ascendant, and if two signs shall be in the Ascendant, the children will be of humours and manners exceedingly different, the one from the other; for the same reason the ninth house, signifies grand-children.
rules.translation: 升点起第五个星座=子女（与升点同性）；升点双星座=子女性情迥异；第九宫=孙辈。
rules.notes: 第五宫=子女、第九=孙辈的'同性情'法

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Moon with the Dragon's Tail in a Nativity gives suspicion of the mother's honesty, and hints that the child is none of the reputed father's begetting; however, it will prove ill-mannered, and for the most part unfortunate.
rules.translation: 月合月尾=疑母之贞、疑非父出；其人失教、多不幸。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Whoever has Jupiter in aspect with the Sun, will be proud and haughty, and yet shall have little cause for it, unless they happen to be in reception.
rules.translation: 木照日=骄傲自大（无实因，除非互容）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Nativities of women in matters appertaining to life, are like those of men, but as to fortune, wholly unlike, and touching manners, after a middle kind, neither wholly agreeable, nor wholly contrary.
rules.translation: 女盘：生命事类同男；财类全异；举止中等（不全同不全反）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In complete Nativities the Moon returns to the sign ascending at conception, or its opposite, or to the body or aspect of some Planet with whom she was at the conception, or to her own sign, and generally the Ascendant at birth is the Moon's place at conception, or its opposite, or the place of the Lord of the New Moon foregoing the conception, yet there are sober genitures too, when the Sun comes to the place of the Ascendant or its Lord, etc.
rules.translation: 完整盘法：生时月归受孕时升点之宫或其冲、或归受孕时与之合/相之星或己宫；生时升点=受孕时月位或其冲、或受孕前新月主之位；亦有日入升点或其主之位者（受孕-出生盘互证法）。
rules.notes: trutine of Hermes 同源；盘校正引擎参考

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mars or the Moon shall be with the Dragon's Head or Tail in the twelfth, and Sol and Jupiter in the fourth house, the Native will be hunch-backed.
rules.translation: 火/月合交点于第十二宫+日木第四宫=驼背。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mars is Lord of a Woman's Ascendant, and Venus posited in it, or Venus is Lady of it, and Mars in it, or Mars Lord of the Ascendant in the mid-heaven; it is more than probable she will Cuckold her husband.
rules.translation: 火为女盘升主而金在升点（或金为升主火在升点、或火升主在中天）=极可能出轨其夫。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Ascendant in the combust way, shows that the Native will be much entangled and pestered with business.
rules.translation: 升主在'灼途'（combust way）=为事务缠身。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If Infortunes be in the tenth house, peregrine, and not friendly to the Ascendant, the Native will be always full of suspicions and jealousies.
rules.translation: 凶星第十宫'游走'、不与升点友善=常怀疑忌。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: All Planets above the Earth, make a man illustrious and generally known far and near, and being all swift in motion, render him dexterous and nimble in the dispatch of affairs.
rules.translation: 诸星俱在地上=名声远播；俱快行=干练敏捷。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mercury in Pisces lays an impediment on the tongue, making a man absurd in his speech and uttering unawares what he does not conceive in his mind; so if that sign ascend.
rules.translation: 水星双鱼=言语障碍、出口不假思索而荒谬；升点为双鱼亦同。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Whoever is born on the day of the Vernal Equinox at noon, shall by that testimony alone, become great in the world.
rules.translation: 春分日正午出生者=单凭此证即成大器。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Women that have their Ascendant, Moon, Mars, Venus, and Mercury in double-bodied signs, have generally very evil qualities.
rules.translation: 女盘升点/月/火/金/水俱在双体星座=性恶。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Jupiter very potent in a geniture always promises some extraordinary happiness; and if he be in the Mid-heaven near the cusp in Capricorn he gives a great deal of good fortune by means of violence and power under pretence of justice, but the same will have an unfortunate issue.
rules.translation: 木极强=非常之幸；木在中天近宫头于摩羯=假公义行强权而得财，终局不幸。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Sol and Jupiter rule in the ninth, and over the places of Mercury, the Moon, and Ascendant, and do behold each other, such a Native's words will be regarded as oracles.
rules.translation: 日木司第九宫、且掌水/月/升点之位、相互照见=其言如神谕。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Jupiter and the Sun in the second house, give a gallant, noble, free spirit; but Saturn and Mars, or Saturn with Mercury in the seventh, render men sordidly covetous.
rules.translation: 木日第二宫=豪爽高尚；土火或土水在第七宫=鄙吝贪婪。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the figure of a Nativity shall be Retrograde, and both ways Cadent; the Native will be a weak poor-spirited, dejected fellow, bringing nothing to perfection.
rules.translation: 盘主星逆行且两重落陷（cadent）=懦弱消沉、一事无成。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Sol in Leo alone raises a man, at least scarce ever suffers him to want or beg; and if the same sign ascend, it buoys up his spirit with hopes, and makes him master of more than ordinary reason.
rules.translation: 日独居狮子=使人振起、不贫不乞；狮子升=志气高涨、超常理性。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
