rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If Cancer ascend, and the Moon be in Moveable or Common signs, especially remote from an Angle, the Native is credulous, light, and inconstant.
rules.translation: 巨蟹升+月居基本/双体星座（尤远角宫）=轻信、轻浮、无常。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Venus in the house or exaltation of Mars is always a sign of filthy lust.
rules.translation: 金居火星之宫或擢升=污秽之欲。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Moon in Aquarius or Pisces makes the Native to be disliked by Princes, Grandees and the upper ten.
rules.translation: 月水瓶/双鱼=为王公贵人上层所不喜。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 中天主逆行离升主/反向
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the Mid-heaven separates by Retrogradation from the Lord of the Ascendant, the Prince, King, or Ruler, shall be averse to the Native, but if on the other side the Lord of the Ascendant being Retrograde forsakes the Lord of the tenth, then the Native shall hate his Prince, King, or Governors; the like is to be understood of other houses according to their respective significations.
rules.translation: 中天主逆行离升主=君王厌此人；反其道=此人恨君王；他宫类推。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the second applies to the Lord of the Ascendant; especially if that Lord of the Ascendant be Jupiter; the Native shall, all his lifetime, be happy in acquiring riches even to admiration.
rules.translation: 二宫主应用升主（尤升主为木）=一生聚财可羡。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 升主照日/东出/合十宫主
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the Ascendant beholds the Sun with a friendly aspect or is Oriental next to the Sun, or joined with the Lord of the tenth, the Native will be much beloved by Kings and great people; for the cause of which favour consider the nature of the said Lord of the Ascendant and his place.
rules.translation: 升主吉相照日/东出近日/合十宫主=为王公所爱；其因观升主之性与位。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars in moveable Signs makes people hasty and choleric, but nowhere more than in Cancer, nor less than in Virgo, but in the former he generally makes the tongue more foolish and impertinent.
rules.translation: 火在基本星座=急躁易怒（巨蟹最甚、处女最轻）；巨蟹尤使口舌愚蠢失礼。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn in the Twelfth threatens the gout; in the Sixth some lasting disease or tedious imprisonments.
rules.translation: 土第十二宫=痛风；土第六宫=久病或长年囚禁。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If the Moon be between Mars and Sol or with them, the Native will almost exchange his cradle for a grave, being very short-lived.
rules.translation: 月居火与日之间或与之俱=夭折。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If the Moon separates from an Infortune, the Native will suffer many diseases in nursing, and afflictions afterwards.
rules.translation: 月离凶星=哺乳期多病、后多磨。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Watery Signs; but especially, and above all others, Scorpio, make traitors; and therefore if the Moon Lady of the Ascendant be in that viperous sign; the Native will betray, or prove a traitor to, his master; and if the same position happen in the radix of a city, its inhabitants will be rebellious against their Princes or Governors.
rules.translation: 水相星座（尤天蝎）=叛徒；月为升主居天蝎=叛主；此位见于城盘=居民叛其主。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars is seldom joined with Mercury for good, for he makes people naughty and impudent, yet industrious in Art, whence it comes to pass that the best Artists are too often the worst men.
rules.translation: 火水相合鲜吉：使人顽劣无礼、然于技艺勤勉——最善之匠常为最坏之人。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars unfortunate in the Ninth, signifies liars and atheists.
rules.translation: 火星第九宫受克=说谎者与无神论者。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: He that has Mercury well posited but the Moon afflicted shall understand well, but deliberate ill, and therefore such, though they may advise others excellently, yet shall manage their own affairs foolishly.
rules.translation: 水佳月伤=理解善而决断恶；善谋人而拙谋己。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Saturn and Mars behold each other, and the Luminaries be posited in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, the Native shall labour under some incurable disease and lead a life wholly miserable.
rules.translation: 土火互照+光体在第六/八/十二宫=不治之疾、一生悲惨。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon is in the Mid-heaven in Capricorn, and Saturn or Mars in the fourth, the Native will be infamous, and so much the worse if Mars be in Taurus, and the Moon in Scorpio, for then many troubles will attend him during his whole life.
rules.translation: 月摩羯中天+土/火第四宫=恶名（火金牛+月天蝎更甚=一生多难）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: For the profession or Art of the Native we must consider the Planet which being Oriental first makes its egress from under the Sun beams, and if with this there be another in the Mid-heaven that beholds the Moon, take him for an Assistant, but if there be no such Planet coming from under the Sun beams take him that is in the mid-heaven, and if there be none therein posited then the Lord of it, and the places of Mars, Venus, and Mercury, but when these happen to be many, the Native will practise several Arts; now the Art a Native practises is much affected by the series of revolutions, which if they agree with his Nativity, he will be delighted with it; otherwise he will do it against his will.
rules.translation: 职业法：取最先东出（出于日光）之星为职业主星；另有中天星照月者为助；无东出星则取中天之星、无则取中天主及火金水之位；多星=多艺；其艺随革命序列而变（与 Tetrabiblos IV.4 行为主星二法同源）。
rules.notes: 同 TTB-4xx 行为主星法；引擎职业模块核心

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars and Mercury evilly disposed, and in conjunction with the Moon, signifies Thieves and Robbers, but if Saturn behold them, or be in the Seventh, they will suffer according to their deserts, and therefore whenever you see indications of grievous crimes, consider whether the Infortunes are strong or not, and oppress the Sun, Moon, or Lord of the Ascendant; or if the Lord of the Ascendant be combust, or in an enemy to the Moon, for then undoubtedly the Native will suffer for his Villainy.
rules.translation: 火水失位合月=窃贼强盗；土照之或土在第七宫=按罪受罚。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon is joined to Saturn in an Angle, the Native though a grandee will be reduced to poverty.
rules.translation: 月合土于角宫=贵人亦致贫。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Let him that has Mars in the second house beware of concerning himself in merchandise.
rules.translation: 火在第二宫=慎入商贾。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Venus is in the eleventh, Mercury in the twelfth, the Sun in the horoscope, Jupiter in the second, Saturn in the sixth and the Moon in the ninth, so many and great accidents will happen to the Native that his life may justly be esteemed prodigious.
rules.translation: 金11宫+水12宫+日升点+木2宫+土6宫+月9宫=奇命、多大事（六宫全景式组合判例）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn, Mars and the Dragon's Head in the fourth, betokens sudden death.
rules.translation: 土火月头（北交点）在第四宫=暴死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Those persons are like to prove very learned in whose Nativities Saturn, Venus, Jupiter and the Moon, do exactly behold Mercury, provided that neither Saturn nor the moon be posited in the Ascendant, and that there be no planet in an angle, for any planet strong in an Angle is an impediment to wisdom.
rules.translation: 土金木月四星精确照水星=极有学问（须土月不居升点、无星在角宫——角宫强星碍智慧）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In all Nativities examine exactly all the Moon's conditions in relation to the three ways whereby she is exalted for 'tis very necessary.
rules.translation: 凡盘须精查月之三途擢升条件（方位/光度/尊严）——极必要。
rules.notes: 引擎月状态子模块

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Infortunes are in Angles and Fortunes in Succedent houses, or the Moon combust, and the Lord of her place strong and happy, or Jupiter Cadent and his disposition well dignified: the Native from a sad mean condition and great misery shall rise to a considerable grandeur and felicity, and so on the contrary.
rules.translation: 凶星角宫+吉星续宫（或月灼而其宫主强吉、或木落陷而其守护尊严良好）=自困厄起至大贵；反之亦然（升降互转判则）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon Venus and Mars are altogether in conjunction, 'tis a fit time to bring Neros and such cursed monsters of mankind into the world: the Native's manners are prodigiously wicked.
rules.translation: 月金火三者合=产暴君恶徒之时、性极恶。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Jupiter elevated and a little infortunated, destroys the natives children but preserves his estate: if he be descending and low and not unfortunate, he gives children but not an estate.
rules.translation: 木高而微受克=伤子女而保产；木低而不受克=得子女而无产。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Saturn does not threaten a violent death, yet if he be in, or lord of the seventh or eighth houses he signifies the Native shall die from Grief of the mind.
rules.translation: 土不在七/八宫主暴死之位时，若居七/八宫或为其主=忧伤心死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: It is next to impossible that they that have never a planet above the earth, nor in the Ascendant of their nativities should either live long or accomplish any great matters in the world.
rules.translation: 诸星尽在地下且无星升点=几不可能长寿或成大事。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mars or Mercury afflict the Lord of the Seventh, being elevated above him, the Native will kill his wife or his enemy, even though it be with poison, especially if either of them have power in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 火/水高凌克七宫主=杀妻或杀敌（虽毒亦然），尤当二者有升点之力。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Infortunes afflicting the place of children, if they be but a little weak, the Native may have children, if much debilitated, the children he has will die, if they be very weak he be wholly barren.
rules.translation: 凶星克子女位：微弱=可有子女；重损=子女夭；极弱=绝育。
rules.notes: 可编码分级判则

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mercury is under the earth he has greater efficacy in relation to giving Arts and Sciences, but in respect of eloquence he is best when he is above the earth.
rules.translation: 水星地下=长于技艺学问；地上=长于辞令。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mars is exactly on the cusp of the Mid-heaven and has no dominion in the Ascendant if the Native live to any considerable age, 'tis much to be feared that he will be killed.
rules.translation: 火星正中天宫头、于升点无主权=活至相当年龄后恐被杀。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Nativities that can never be good, are such as have both the Infortunes in the same place joined to one of the Luminaries, or when infortunes single are singly joined to the Luminaries, or when the Moon is under sun beams with Saturn or Mars, or where all the planets are in the third, sixth, eighth and twelfth houses; or when the Infortunes are in Angles, and the Luminaries and Fortunes cadent, or when the Luminaries only are cadent and all the other planets Retrograde, or when both Luminaries and both Fortunes are afflicted, or when only Mars is above the earth the other planets not being mutually joined nor in Angles.
rules.translation: 永不可吉之盘八式：①二凶同处合一光体②单凶合单光体③月灼且合土/火④诸星尽在3/6/8/12宫⑤凶星角宫+光体吉星落陷⑥仅光体落陷+他星尽逆行⑦光体吉星俱受克⑧仅火地上而诸星不相连、不居角。
rules.notes: 引擎'不可吉盘'筛选器——验证集负例

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Revolutions may be said to be accomplished five ways, first by the return of the Sun to the same point, which is most valid. Secondly the return of the centre of a planet to the same place of the Ecliptic, of which kind that of the Moon first and then those of Saturn and Jupiter are chief. Thirdly the return of the centre of some smaller Circle to the same place. Fifthly the return of a planet wherewith he was in the beginning joined as it is the place of another Planet.
rules.translation: 革命五式：①日归同点（最有力=solar return）②行星心归黄道同位（月/土/木为要）③小圆之心归同位④（原文略）⑤行星归初合他星之位。
rules.notes: solar return 定义；引擎 revolution 模块

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 月尾照升主+革命月合+8宫主照
rules.original_text: When the Dragon's Tail in a Nativity unfortunately beholds the Lord of the Ascendant and in a revolution the Moon shall be joined therewith, and the Lord of the House of Death being then in the place of an Infortune in the radix, shall likewise behold it, the Party that year will die.
rules.translation: 本命月尾凶照升主+年革命月合之+八宫主居本命凶星之位亦照之=该年死（三重证）。
rules.notes: 三重盘呼应同 CARD-181

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Infortunes are strong in the Radix, and the Moon applies to a powerful fixed star of the nature of Mars in a Revolution, the Party will be apt to commit manslaughter that year or be in danger about it.
rules.translation: 本命凶星强+年革命月应用火性大恒星=该年易杀人或遭其险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Revolutions may produce effects happening in the years following, either because one's year is preparative to another, or because the Nativity decrees what the Revolution perfects, or by reason of greatness of the event as death, or of the causes, as when the Sun is exactly in opposition to Jupiter.
rules.translation: 革命之效可延后数年：一年备一年/本命所命革命所成/事大如死/因巨如日冲木。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Ascendant of a Revolution is the same with that of the Person's Nativity, something promised in the geniture happens, but more certainly if the Moon shall be also in her place of the geniture, or the Lord of the Ascendant in a place partially behold the same house of the Radix.
rules.translation: 年革命升点=本命升点=本命所许之事应验；月亦在本命之位或升主照本命同宫=更确。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If in a Revolution the Lord of the Geniture Retrograde (if he be one of the Inferiors) begins to be under the sun's beams, or (if he be one of the Superiors) if he be afflicted by an Infortune, you may expect some danger of your life that year.
rules.translation: 年革命盘主星：内行星逆行始入日光下、或外行星受凶星克=该年生命之险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 木照月金/木角居本命位
rules.original_text: When Jupiter in a Revolution beholds the Moon or Venus, or be in an angle in either of their places in the Radix, it inclines the Party, if of fit age that year, to marry.
rules.translation: 年革命木照月/金、或木居角在本命月/金之位=适龄者该年成婚。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When in a person's Revolution whose only significator of life was debilitated in the Radix, the Fortunes shall be combust in any house but the Ascendant, and the Infortunes being above the earth, shall behold the Sun Ascendant and Moon, or the Moon be under the earth, such person without any ill direction may die that year.
rules.translation: 本命唯一寿征星弱+年革命吉星俱灼（升点除外）+凶星地上照日/升/月（或月地下）=无恶方向亦该年死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If a Geniture was weak as to life, and three planets be joined in a Revolution, there is imminent danger of some eminent disease, especially if they happen in the 6th house.
rules.translation: 本命寿弱+年革命三星会=重病之危（尤在第六宫）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When in the hour of a Revolution the Superior Planets or others shall be joined in the place of a Radical Significator, expect from thence some notable matter to happen of that kind which is thereby naturally promised.
rules.translation: 年革命时外行星等居本命示义星之位=该类要事发生（radical position 触发）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon is joined with Saturn in a Revolution, and he casts a square to the Ascendant, such person shall that year suffer in his body by reason of a disease of his mind.
rules.translation: 年革命月合土、土四分升点=该年因心病而身病。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The additions that are made by the procession of the sun in an annual Revolution, transfer the significations for near upon so many days after the Revolution as there are years past.
rules.translation: 年革命日之岁差所增之度=革命后每岁约当若干日（1年≈1日之应期换算）。
rules.notes: 可编码：岁差度→日

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 本命月土协+40后革命月合/冲土
rules.original_text: When the Moon agreeing with Saturn in the Radix, or being with any other Planet in his dignities, if she happen in a Revolution (after the age of forty years) to be corporally joined with Saturn in the same latitude, or being full of light shall be in opposition to him and in contrary latitude from the sixth house to the eighth, the Native will undoubtedly fall into some strange disease and die thereof.
rules.translation: 本命月合土（或在星之尊严）+40岁后年革命月体合土同纬度、或月满光冲土而反纬度（自6宫至8宫）=必患奇疾而死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the houses of the Ascendant or Moon in the Radix shall be in square or opposition to the Infortunes in a Revolution, the Native will suffer much trouble, but if the Moon be in conjunction with them, then he shall do much mischief to other people, but if besides this the Infortunes are Lords of inimical places, He shall both do damage to others and suffer much himself.
rules.translation: 本命升点/月之宫位受年革命凶星四分/冲=多磨难；月合凶=害人；凶又为敌宫主=害人且自伤。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The particular times of accidents happening are to be found out from annual and monthly revolutions and transits.
rules.translation: 事件之应期由年革命/月革命/行运求得。
rules.notes: 引擎 timing 模块

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Fatal will that year be to the Native's health, when in the Revolution many of the Hylegicals come to bad places of the Figure, or to the Aspects of the Infortunes.
rules.translation: 年革命多寿征星（hylegicals）入盘之坏位/凶星相位=该年健康致命。
rules.notes: hyleg 概念

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Diseases are for the most part of the nature of the Lord of the sixth house, or the Planet therein posited as well in Revolutions as Nativities.
rules.translation: 疾病之性大率随第六宫主或其内行星（年革命与本命同）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Revolution of a year is one thing in time, which is the return of the Sun to the same point from the Equinoctial; another thing in the World, which is its return to the same fixed star, and yet another thing in Nativities, which is its return to its former place, but with the addition of so much of the Ecliptic as he passes through in one natural day.
rules.translation: 年革命三义：时（日归春分点）/世（归同恒星）/本命（归原位+一日所过黄道之度）。
rules.notes: tropical/sidereal 区别说明

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In sickness, the Ascendant shall signify the Patient, the seventh house the disease, the Luminaries the Patient's strength, the Infortunes the strength of the disease, but the eighth house has always a share in the signification.
rules.translation: 疾病盘：升点=病人、第七宫=病、光体=病人之力、凶星=病之力、第八宫恒有份（同 CARD-180）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-180

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon applies to Planets of a nature contrary to that of the distemper, especially if they be Fortunes, the disease will be changed for the better.
rules.translation: 月应用与病相反性质之星（尤吉星）=病转愈（同 CARD-152）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-152

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon in the beginning of a sickness (which is called the Decumbiture of the Patient) shall be either under the Sun beams or with the Dragon's Tail, Saturn or Mars, it threatens extraordinary danger, and if the party be old, even her conjunction with Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus, is not without peril; the same but nothing so grievous may be feared when she is in square or opposition to any of them but if besides all this she shall happen to have been in their places in the Patient's geniture, he will certainly die.
rules.translation: 病初月灼/合月尾/土/火=大险；老人月合金木水亦险；冲四分较轻；若月在本命同处=必死（同 CARD-187/188）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars, Jupiter, and Venus rule the blood; Mars and Sol, choler; the Moon and Venus, phlegm; Saturn and Mercury melancholy; and Mars and Mercury with the Sun, black choler.
rules.translation: 体液行星：血=火木金、黄胆=火日、痰=月金、忧郁=土水、黑胆=火水日（同 CARD-191 映射E）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-191

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn causes long diseases; Venus indifferent, Mercury various ones; the Moon such as return after a certain time, as Vertigos, Falling-sickness, etc. Jupiter and Sol give short diseases, but Mars the most acute of all.
rules.translation: 病时长短：土=久病、金=中、水=杂、月=间歇（眩/癫痫）、木日=短、火=最急（同 CARD-193 映射F）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-193

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When you find the Figure at the beginning of a grievous distemper to appear much more mild and favourable than the distemper, you may conclude the disease contracts its malignity from the Nativity, the principal places falling upon some disastrous configurations.
rules.translation: 病初盘较病势柔和=病之恶性本于本命（主位落本命灾格）（同 CARD-197）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-197

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: It is necessary to consider the Lunations preceding the disease and thence likewise to take indications of the Patient's condition.
rules.translation: 须观病前之朔望以取病人状况之征（同 CARD-198）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-198

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If you find a Person after the age of 50 years labour under strong and frequent diseases, you may conclude the significator of life in his Radix to be sorely afflicted by the body or aspects of one of the Infortunes.
rules.translation: 50岁后频患重病=本命寿征星为凶星之体或相位重克。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the Moon is in a fixed sign physic works the less, and if in Aries, Taurus, or Capricorn it will be apt to prove nauseous and very distasteful to the Patient.
rules.translation: 月固定星座=药效差；月白羊/金牛/摩羯=药令病人恶心难服。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In Purging, 'tis best that both the Moon and Lord of the Ascendant descend and be under the Earth: in vomiting that they ascend.
rules.translation: 泻法宜月与升主俱落地下；吐法则宜其上升。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Purging, Vomiting, Bleeding, Making use of issues, etc., ought to be done while the Moon is in moist signs, the chief of which is Pisces, the next Cancer.
rules.translation: 泻/吐/放血/引流等宜在月居湿星座时（最湿双鱼、次巨蟹）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If a disease begin when the Moon is in opposition to the Sun, 'tis by reason of superfluity of humours; if she suffer an eclipse, the same time 'tis for weakness of the Spirits and Vital power.
rules.translation: 病始于月冲日=体液过剩；病时月遭蚀=精气与生机力弱。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Infortunes being Oriental, cause Diseases; Occidental, defects.
rules.translation: 凶星东出=致病；西没=致缺陷。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Venus with Saturn in the seventh and Mars elevated above them both, causes barrenness in men, and Abortions in women.
rules.translation: 金土在第七宫+火高凌二者=男子不育、女子流产。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Sagittary and Gemini signify Diseases that come with falling, as Swooning, Falling-sickness, Suffocations of the womb, etc.
rules.translation: 人马与双子=跌仆之疾（晕厥/癫痫/子宫窒息等）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When at the beginning of a disease the Luminaries are both with the Infortunes, or in opposition to them, the sick will very hardly escape.
rules.translation: 病初光体俱合凶星或冲凶星=病者极难脱险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: From the Moon's applications to the Fortunes or good aspect of the Sun, the same being neither contrary to the disease, nor afflicted, nor in the power of the Infortunes: health may be expected, but by her going to the Infortunes of like nature with the disease, or ill beams of the Sun, death is to be feared.
rules.translation: 月应用吉星/日吉相（不与病反、不受克、不在凶力下）=可望愈；月行向与病同性之凶星/日恶光=恐死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Cold and dry diseases, such as are naturally long, are increased by Saturn; but those that are short, hot and dry, from Mars.
rules.translation: 冷干久病=土增之；短热干病=火增之。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A conjunction of the Luminaries in Aries, causes alteration and death, if Venus and Mercury be there retrograde; the like if it happen in Scorpio or Virgo or in any humane sign; so likewise if such conjunction fall in the sixth, seventh, or eighth house of the figure of the Decumbiture within the Aspect of an Infortune, the Patient will be in great danger.
rules.translation: 朔望在白羊（金水逆时）=病变致死；天蝎/处女/人性星座同；朔望落疾病盘6/7/8宫且凶星相位=大险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mars in the Ascendant at the Decumbiture, makes the disease, swift, violent, afflicting the upper parts and disturbing the mind; and if besides this, the dispositors of the Luminaries and Ascendant happen to be afflicted, death will follow; the like if both the Luminaries be Cadent from Angles, and not assisted by the Fortunes; but if in such a position, the Fortunes strong shall have dominion in two places, the disease will be changed from Acute to Chronic, and the Patient at last will escape beyond hope.
rules.translation: 病盘火在升点=病急暴、伤上体乱心神；光体与升主之守护受克=死；光体俱落陷且无吉助=同；若吉星强主二处=急转慢性、终出险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn in Fiery Signs when the Sun is weak causes hectic fevers; Jupiter sanguinary ones, and if Mars behold him Putrid ones; Mars in such signs gives burning fevers of all sorts; Venus ephemeral fevers, and if the rays of Mars be mixed, putrid ones from phlegm; Mercury mixed ones, but if the Moon be joined with him she makes pituitous fevers from the corruption of the humours; Saturn mixing signification with Mars, causes Melancholy fevers, and if Mars be under the Sun in the sixth or twelfth house in fiery Signs, or being so posited shall cast his beams on the Significator of life, or the Lord of the Ascendant of the Revolution, or if the Lord of the Ascendant or Significator of life apply to his aspects by direction, it occasions burning pernicious fevers and like to venomous ones; but if to these, Saturn or the Dragon's Head or Tail, or Venus Combust be added, or if these Planets shall be posed in Scorpio or Leo, the fever will be altogether pestilential.
rules.translation: 发热分型：日弱+土火相=消耗热（hectic）；木=血热（火照之=腐热）；火=灼热诸热；金=日发微热（杂火光=痰腐热）；水=杂热（月合之=体液腐痰热）；土火相混=忧郁热；火灼于6/12宫火相或光照寿征/年革命升主、或方向应用=毒灼热；再加土/交点/金灼或居天蝎狮子=疫热。
rules.notes: 可编码：发热类型映射

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: It will be a fatal time to suffer amputation or lose any member when the moon is in an oblique sign under the Sun beams and opposed by Mars.
rules.translation: 月居斜升星座+灼+火冲=断肢截肢之致命时。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A tedious travail and delivery in child-birth is to be expected, when the Moon is aspected by the Infortunes, and in an oblique sign, and a Planet retrograde or slow of Motion is in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 月受凶星照+居斜升星座+升点行星逆行或行缓=产难拖延。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Venus is cold in the second degree, and moist in the third; the Moon cold in the third, and moist in the fourth; Jupiter hot in the second, and moist in the first; the Sun hot in the third, and dry in the second; Mars dry in the third, and hot in the fourth; and Saturn both cold and dry in the fourth.
rules.translation: 星体质性分级：金二度冷三度湿；月三度冷四度湿；木二度热一度湿；日三度热二度干；火三度干四度热；土四度冷干——（体液医学质度表）。
rules.notes: 四体液医学模型量化

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The special Significator of a disease is that unfortunate Planet from whom the Significator separates by a bad aspect; and the Lord of the Ascendant shows the cause of the grief if he be found anywhere unfortunate.
rules.translation: 病之特指星=示义星以恶相离之凶星；升主若受克=示病痛之因。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If the Lord of the Ascendant be an Infortune the sick will be unruly, but if he be a Fortune he will readily take what is prescribed.
rules.translation: 升主为凶星=病者不驯；为吉星=乐于遵医嘱。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The fifth house and its Lord, show the medicines, and their nature whether good or evil, proper or improper.
rules.translation: 第五宫及其主=药物及其善恶当否。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: As the Revolution of a year as to its ill significations, happens according to the directions from the geniture, so the decumbiture as to its worse significations is regulated by the revolution according to Lunar directions.
rules.translation: 年革命之恶征随本命方向；疾病盘之恶征随月方向之革命（三重呼应同 CARD-181）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-181

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Several Planets being Significators show that the distemper is complicated of several diseases.
rules.translation: 多示义星=复合数病。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Significator of the disease in double-bodied signs signifies a relapse, or that it will change into some other distemper.
rules.translation: 病示义星居双体星座=复发或转为他病。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The disease is desperate, when the Significator of the sick either in his Nativity or the decumbiture, has dominion in the fourth house.
rules.translation: 病人示义星（本命或病盘）主第四宫=病危绝。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: That sign in which the Significator of the disease is posited, and that to which he casts any aspect, show the members or parts of the body principally afflicted.
rules.translation: 病示义星之宫及其相位所向=主患之身体部位。
rules.notes: 可编码：星座-身体部位映射

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mercury is unfortunate he prejudices the phantasy and inward faculties, and thence threatens madness, but so much the worse if Mars be the Planet that afflicteth him, for then if he be in an earthy sign it threatens the Patient will make away with himself.
rules.translation: 水星受克=伤想象与内官、致狂；火星克水且居土相星座=病者自尽。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: It is a very bad sign when the Significator of the sickness is in the sixth, or the Lord of the sixth in the eighth, or the Lord of the eighth, in the sixth house.
rules.translation: 病示义星在第六宫、或六宫主在第八宫、或八宫主在第六宫=极恶之征。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mercury significator of a disease in aspect with Saturn, or Saturn significator in aspect of Mercury, gives suspicion of witchcraft and enchantment.
rules.translation: 水星为病示义而照土、或土示义照水=疑巫术蛊惑（病因非自然）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A chronical disease (that is a disease which usually continues above a month) is ruled by the motion of the Sun; acute diseases (which are more sharp and violent but less lasting) by the motion of the Moon, according to whose swifter or slower motion the critical times are either hastened or retarded; the same being when the Moon comes to a sign contrary in both qualities to that in which she was in the beginning of the disease.
rules.translation: 慢性病（逾月）随日行；急性病随月行——月之疾缓应期提前/推后；月入病初之宫两质相反之星座=危急期。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: For curing a member, the Moon and Lord of the Ascendant should be free from Impediment, the sign that governs the part ascending and the Moon posited in it, and when you think to do any good to your eyes, let the Moon be fortunate, increasing in light and by no means in a sign of the Earthly Triplicity.
rules.translation: 治肢：月与升主无碍、月居司该部上升之星座；治目：月吉、增光、绝勿居土相三分之星座。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Even the Fortunes in diseases may become Infortunes, viz., when the disease itself is of their nature, or of the nature of things by them signified, and in such case the infortunes may be said to be fortunes, for contraries are to be cured by contraries.
rules.translation: 吉星在病中可转凶（病性即其性时）；凶星亦可转吉——以相反治相反（同 CARD-152 体液平衡）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: An Election signifies nothing or very little unless it correspond with the Nativity, and time wherein you Elect.
rules.translation: 择时若无与本命相应则无甚意义（择时须合本命）。
rules.notes: 引擎择时模块前提

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If you would have anything kept secret let the Moon be under the Sun beams when you do it.
rules.translation: 欲保密行事：月居日光下（combust）时为之。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Make no new clothes, nor first put them on when the Moon is in Scorpio, especially if she be full of light and beheld of Mars, for they will be apt to be torn and quickly worn out.
rules.translation: 月天蝎勿制新衣（尤月满光被火照）——易破速旧。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When in an Election you cannot fit the Moon to two Planets that you have occasion for, at once, join her to some fixed star that is of the nature of them both.
rules.translation: 择时月不能同时应二星时，可令月合兼具二者性质之恒星。
rules.notes: 恒星中性替代法

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When you would suddenly finish a thing, place the Moon and significator in Moveable Signs, but if you would have your work last long, let them be in fixed ones, and for this reason it becomes so difficult for a man to attain to do both.
rules.translation: 欲速成：月与示义星居基本（移动）星座；欲持久：居固定星座——二者难兼。
rules.notes: 可编码：cardinal=速/fixed=久

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The best election a man can make is the place of his habitation: for if the Ascendant of the City he dwells in be the place of his Ascendant, he will have his health well, if the Mid-Heaven, he will come to preferment, if it be the place of the Sun in the Nativity, he will undoubtedly obtain honour and dignities, if of Jupiter he will grow rich; if of the Moon he will be very happy in most respects there.
rules.translation: 最佳择时=择居：城之升点=本命升点=健康佳；=中天=得迁升；=本命日位=得荣尊；=木位=致富；=月位=诸般顺遂。
rules.notes: 城市盘-本命对应引擎

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Every man's geniture in some things agrees with, and in some differs from another's, we should therefore deal with people (as to important matters) only in things wherein their Nativities sympathize with ours, but in other things to forbear, and indeed we ought generally to avoid the society of a person the Lord of whose Ascendant is an infortune and joined with the Dragon's Tail or any malevolent Fixed Star, for unless there be a great agreement between our Nativities they will do us some mischief, though perhaps against their will.
rules.translation: 人际择宜：只与本命相契者论要事；升主为凶星且合月尾/恶恒星者应远避（虽非其愿亦或为害）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When the significators of journies are in watery signs and the Infortunes (or the Fortunes themselves unfriendly posited) be elevated above them, the querent will be much troubled in his journies with bad weather and tempests, and note that the causes or business of journies is to be discovered from the dispositors of the significators.
rules.translation: 旅程示义星居水相+凶星（或失位吉星）高凌其上=途多风雨；旅程之事由其守护星推。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: You may sometimes use the Infortunes as Physicians do poisons, for they produce strong effects; but use them like those, sparingly and with caution.
rules.translation: 凶星亦可如医者用毒——效强而须慎用。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 月天蝎摩羯初/月木阳座
rules.original_text: News or reports raised and spread abroad whilst the Moon is in the beginning of Scorpio or Capricorn are generally false, but if she be with Jupiter in a masculine sign they are like to prove true.
rules.translation: 月居天蝎/摩羯初度时之传闻多伪；月合木居阳性星座=其言近真。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Begin not to build whilst the Moon is in Scorpio or Pisces or when a southern sign ascends, nor let the Moon or Lord of the fourth apply to a Retrograde Planet, for it threatens that such edifice shall soon fall or be ruined.
rules.translation: 月天蝎/双鱼或南向星座升时勿动工；月/四宫主勿应用逆行星——否则建筑速毁。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In every Election let the Moon and Lord of the Ascendant be free from impediment or affliction.
rules.translation: 凡择时：月与升主须无碍无克（总则）。
rules.notes: 引擎择时校验项

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: It is best to undertake journies when the significators are in moveable signs, for they signify celerity and return with dispatch of business, but fixed signs in such cases are very bad, so also it is if the Lord of the Ascendant or Moon happen to be in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses.
rules.translation: 行旅宜示义星居基本星座（疾速办成）；固定星座恶；升主/月在6/8/12宫亦恶。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.condition: 月应用木+木合月头中天
rules.original_text: It is an undeniable thing (in general) to deliver a petition or request to a great person when the Moon applies to Jupiter, and he is joined with the Dragon's Head in the Mid-heaven.
rules.translation: 月应用木星、木合月头（北交点）于中天时=向贵人呈请必达（通则）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In an Eclipse it is necessary to consider the strength of the Planet then ruling, for his significations will chiefly appear.
rules.translation: 蚀时须观当时主星之强弱——其示义主现。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Eclipses of the sun have powerful effects, and therefore if they fall upon a very flourishing and promising crop they generally damnify it, so that it scarce comes to any thing near what might have been expected.
rules.translation: 日蚀效强：若落于丰盛将熟之庄稼=常损之，收成远逊预期。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When at the time of an eclipse the significator of life in any person's Radix shall be within the Beams of the Anereta or killing Planet, or of an Infortune not friendly disposed, such native will incur extraordinary hazard of his life.
rules.translation: 蚀时本命寿征星在杀伤星（Anaereta）或凶星之光内=命之大险。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: In general some Eclipses of the luminaries at the time or even before they happen raise showers and rain, others great droughts, some violent winds, others earthquakes, some scarcity of the fruits of the earth, others terrible fires.
rules.translation: 光体之蚀（临期或期前）各致：雨霖/大旱/暴风/地震/果歉/大火——按蚀况分。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A Comet usually foreshows the birth of famous persons in some time after to happen, for he is not said to be born under it (in this sense) who is born during the time of its appearance, but he that is born in that region or country subject to such an Angle or Figure, and hath his Sun and Moon in its place, or the Luminaries and the Lord of his Ascendant in cardinal signs, when the Comet rises, sets or culminates, and the like.
rules.translation: 彗星预示后世名人之生：非指其现时生者，而指生于其角/盘所属地域、日月光临其位、或光体与升主居基本星座者（当其升/没/中天时）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A Comet in the East, signifies the rise of some eminent lawgiver, in the Mid-heaven, of some very powerful King, but seldom such illustrious matter when 'tis in the West or Succedent houses.
rules.translation: 彗星东方=立法者兴；中天=强王出；西没/续宫=少显赫之事。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Comets when they are immoveable, signify seditions, but when moveable they denote Foreign Wars, and one Nation invading another; in Cardinal Signs the death of Princes or great men; in the ninth house, Scandal or detriment to Religion; in the tenth or twelfth houses, the pestilence or scarcity of corn; and in the eleventh house, great slaughter and destruction of Noblemen.
rules.translation: 彗星：不动=内乱；行=外战入侵；基本星座=王公之死；第九宫=宗教受损；第十/十二宫=瘟疫谷歉；第十一宫=贵族大戮。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If a Comet appear whilst a woman goes with child, if it be either in the fourth, sixth, or eighth month, such child will prove very prone to anger and quarrels, and if he be of quality, to sedition.
rules.translation: 孕妇孕第4/6/8月时现彗星=其子性暴好斗（贵者好乱）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Eclipses in the fourth house are more strong and efficacious than in the eighth or twelfth houses, and in the Ascendant more than in the ninth or eleventh.
rules.translation: 蚀力依宫：第四宫强于第八/十二；升点强于第九/十一。
rules.notes: 可编码：宫位权重

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: An Eclipse of the Moon extends its effects as many months, and of the Sun so many years, as it continues hours.
rules.translation: 月蚀效期=蚀持续小时数月；日蚀=年（1小时=1月/1年）。
rules.notes: 可编码公式

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: An Eclipse has a threefold effect, first powerful by reason of the conjunction or opposition on which it happens; second general, because it slowly cools, in which respect it is extended for a long time. Thirdly power which it has from the Lord of the place wherein it happens and other positions at that time.
rules.translation: 蚀三效：①因其所依之合/冲而强②因缓'冷却'而广延历时③其位主星与当时他位之力。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Eclipses operate more forcibly on Cities, Provinces, and Kingdoms than on Particular persons of private condition, or even upon Kings and Princes, for their effects rather respect the multitude.
rules.translation: 蚀对城/省/王国之作用强于个人（虽王侯亦然）——其效属大众。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Eclipses happen or Comets appear in Earthly Signs they portend barrenness and scarcity by reason of excessive droughts; when in Watery Signs by reason of too much rain, in Airy Signs they signify mighty winds, seditions and the pestilence, in Fiery Signs terrible Wars and slaughters.
rules.translation: 蚀/彗星分相：土相=旱荒歉收；水相=淫雨；风相=大风/内乱/瘟疫；火相=恶战大戮。
rules.notes: 可编码：四元素映射

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Saturn passes out of one sign into another, you may expect for several days together strange Meteors and splendid sights or apparitions in the heavens.
rules.translation: 土星换宫=其后数日多异象/天现奇观。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: The Lord of the Interlunary Figure signifies very much as to the quality of the Air, and also the Planet that beholds him, especially if they be in Cardinal Signs.
rules.translation: 月间图（朔望间）之主星主大气之质，照其之星亦然（尤居基本星座）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn and Mars, and Mars and the Sun, and Mars and Mercury, cause hail; Saturn most in summer, Sol and Mercury most in autumn, and those that cause hail in these two quarters cause snow in the winter and spring.
rules.translation: 土火/火日/火水合=冰雹（土主夏雹、日水主秋雹；致雹之合于冬春则致雪）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn with the Luminaries, Jupiter with Mercury and Mars with Venus, make an Apertio portarum or an opening of the gates, and usually cause some notable change of weather.
rules.translation: 土合光体/木合水/火合金=开阖之门（天变之兆）、常致显著天气变化。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Whenever Saturn is joined to the Sun the heat is remitted and the cold increased, which alone may be a sufficient testimony of the truth of Astrology.
rules.translation: 土合日=热退寒增（单此足证占星之真）。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Mars and Mercury are joined and behold the Moon or Lord of the Ascendant in the sixth or seventh house, they portend great drought to ensue.
rules.translation: 火水合而照月/升主于第六/七宫=大旱将临。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: That Star has a great efficacy on the air, to which the Moon shall be first joined after her conjunction, opposition or square with the Sun.
rules.translation: 月与日合/冲/四分后首合之恒星=对大气有大力。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Jupiter naturally raises North Winds, Saturn Easterly, Mars Western, Venus Southern, and Mercury Mixed Winds, according as he applies to other Planets.
rules.translation: 风向行星：木=北风、土=东风、火=西风、金=南风、水=随其所应之他星而变风。
rules.notes: 可编码映射

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If you prune your vines when the Moon is at full in Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Sagittarius, neither worms nor birds will infest your grapes.
rules.translation: 月满于金牛/狮子/天蝎/人马时修葡萄=不生虫鸟之害。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Graft not Trees, the Moon waning, or not to be seen, and if you shear sheep in her increase their wool will grow again the better.
rules.translation: 月亏或不见时勿嫁接；月盈时剪羊毛=再生更佳。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Fruits and Wood for use should be cut in the decrease of the Moon, but if you would have Timber to keep long, fell it towards the latter end of the winter, the Moon being under the earth, and beheld by Saturn, for that will prevent its rotting, and render it exceedingly hard and durable.
rules.translation: 果与柴薪月亏时采伐；欲木材耐久：冬末伐、月地下被土照——防朽而坚硬。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: But fire wood and what you would have grow quickly again, cut when the Moon is above the Earth in the first quarter joined either to Venus or Jupiter.
rules.translation: 柴薪与速生之木：月上弦、地上、合金/木时采。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Sow or Plant when the Moon is in Taurus, Virgo or Scorpio in good Aspect of Saturn, but when she is in Cancer set or sow all kinds of pulse, and in Libra or Capricorn dress your gardens and trim your small trees and shrubs.
rules.translation: 月金牛/处女/天蝎且土吉相=播种栽植；月巨蟹=种豆类；月天秤/摩羯=理园修木。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn in fixed signs causes scarcity of corn, dear years, and the death of many men.
rules.translation: 土居固定星座=谷歉、年荒、多死。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A Malevolent Planet being Lord of the year, though fortunate, generally hurts all fruits of the earth, but those particularly signified by himself.
rules.translation: 凶星为年主（虽'得时'）=伤诸果，尤伤其所司之类。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Saturn obtains Kingdoms or Supremacy of power by labour, fraud, and infamy; Mars by valour, rapine and cruelty; but Jupiter by Justice and great opinion of goodness and honesty.
rules.translation: 得国之道按星：土=勤苦/欺诈/恶名；火=勇武/劫掠/残暴；木=公义/善誉。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When Saturn is in Libra and Jupiter in Cancer, great changes and alterations shall happen in the world.
rules.translation: 土天秤+木巨蟹=世之大变。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: For discovering such grand mutations we should well consider the great, mean, and lesser conjunctions of the Planets in the several Trigons, the removes of the Superiors from one sign to another, as also their applications to the fixed Stars.
rules.translation: 察大世变：观诸三分之大会/中会/小会、外行星换宫、及其与恒星之应用（同 CARD-165）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-165

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Likewise the changes of the Absides of the Planets cause mutations in governments and laws, which is a point very much to be regarded.
rules.translation: 行星远地点（absides）之变=政制法律之变——极须重视（同 CARD-137）。
rules.notes: 同 CARD-137

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: Mercury with an unfortunate Planet in the eleventh, denotes the establishment of some severe or unjust laws in the world.
rules.translation: 水星合凶星于第十一宫=世间立苛法/不义之法。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: A Conjunction of Mars and Saturn in the sixth or eighth house, especially in a humane sign, signifies a great Pestilence.
rules.translation: 火土合于第六/八宫（尤人性星座）=大瘟疫。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: When in the Radix of any City Mars shall be in the Mid-heaven, the Inhabitants will be inclined to Sedition: If Saturn be there they will be very mischievous, yet very laborious.
rules.translation: 城盘火在中天=居民好乱；土在中天=居民顽劣而勤苦。

rules.source: 规则库-Lilly卡丹诺箴言选编.xlsx
rules.book: William Lilly《Choice Aphorisms from the Seven Segments of Cardan》(1675)——卡丹诺《Aphorismorum Astronomicorum Segmenta Septem》(1547) 之 Lilly 英译选编
rules.original_text: If Wars be signified note the Angle of the figure wherein Mars is posited, for from that Part the Enemies shall come.
rules.translation: 有战之征时观火所在之角——敌自其方来。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: There are seven planets, so called and charactered: Saturn L, Jupiter K, Sun 0, Venus C, Mercury B, Moon 5. There is also the Head of the Dragon, thus noted P; and the Tail Q. P and Q are not planets but nodes.
rules.translation: 七星：土 L、木 K、日 0、金 C、水 B、月 5；另有龙头 P 与龙尾 Q——二者非行星而是（月）交点。龙头为增益吉点、龙尾主损为凶（Lilly 观念）。
rules.notes: P=北交点 Caput、Q=南交点 Cauda

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: Every sign contains in longitude 30°, and every degree 60 minutes. The beginning is from Aries, and so in order; so the whole zodiac contains 360°. The 2nd degree of Taurus is the two and thirtieth degree of the zodiac, the 10th of Taurus is the 40th. Yet you must ever account the aspects from that degree of the zodiac wherein the planet is: as if Saturn be in 10° of Gemini, and I would know to what degree of the ecliptic he casts his sinister sextile; reckoning from Aries to the 10th degree of Gemini, I find Saturn to be in the 70th degree of the zodiac. If I add 60° more to 70, they make 130, which answers to the 10th degree of the sign Leo, to which Saturn casts his sextile aspect.
rules.translation: 黄经制：每座 30°、每度 60 分、全周 360°，自白羊起算。绝对黄经=星座序号×30+座内度数（金牛 2°=黄道 32°）。相位投射：以行星绝对黄经±相位角求得目标绝对黄经再换算回座内（例：双子 10°=70°，+60°=130°=狮子 10°）。
rules.notes: 引擎：abs = sign_index*30 + deg_in_sign；aspect target = abs ± angle

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: Signs opposite to one another are: a b c d e f over g h i j k l. That is, Aries is opposite to Libra, and Libra to Aries; Taurus to Scorpio; and so in order.
rules.translation: 对冲座表：白羊↔天秤、金牛↔天蝎、双子↔射手、巨蟹↔摩羯、狮子↔水瓶、处女↔双鱼。
rules.notes: 起盘必需

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: If you find Saturn in the first degree of Aries, and the Moon or any other planet in the first degree of Gemini, you shall say they are in a sextile aspect, for they are distant one from another sixty degrees, and this aspect is indifferent good. If Saturn be in the first degree of Aries, and another planet in the first degree of Cancer, they are in a quartile aspect: this aspect is of enmity and not good. If any planet in the 1st degree of Leo, they behold each other with a trine aspect; this doth denote unity, concord and friendship. If any planet in the first degree of Libra, they are in opposition: a bad aspect. When Saturn is in the first degree of Aries, and any planet is in the same degree, they are then said to be in conjunction: and this aspect is good or ill, according to the nature of the question demanded.
rules.translation: 相位吉凶基础判语：六合=中等偏吉；四分=敌意不吉；三合=统一和谐友善；对冲=凶；合相=随问事性质定吉凶。
rules.notes: 与相位卷 LIL-PHA-03/04 一致

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: An Ephemeris is no other thing than a book containing the true places of the planets, in degrees and minutes, in every of the twelve signs both in longitude and latitude, every day of the year at noon, and every hour of the day, by correction and equation.
rules.translation: 星历表（Ephemeris）：载行星每日午正（noon）之黄经纬度真位置，供按日查取。
rules.notes: 现代替代：pyswisseph 直接算任意时刻，无需星历表

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: In the second line you find the daily motions of the planets and the Dragon's Head. In the third line and over the character of L you have M.D. - M signifying Meridional, D, Descending; that is, Saturn has meridional latitude and is descending. If over any of the planets you find S.A. or S.D. it tells you that planet has Septentrional or north latitude, and is either ascending or descending. The Sun has never any latitude.
rules.translation: 星历表纬度标注：M=南纬、S=北纬、A=纬度递增（ascending）、D=纬度递减（descending）。太阳永无纬度（恒在黄道上）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The Q is in the opposite sign and degree to the P, though he is never placed in the Ephemeris. In the sixth line you have the day of the month; next to the figure you have the letter of the day of the week; and if you run down under that column you see the great letter, which is the Sunday or Dominical letter of the year.
rules.translation: 龙尾 Q 恒为龙头 P 的对宫对度（星历表不另载）。表中字母栏=星期字母（A=金曜/星期4 至 G=水曜，按 1646 年示例）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: We and they ever begin our day at noon, and so reckon 24 hours from the noon of one day to the noon of the next, and after this manner you must reckon in the aspects. Over against Friday the second of January, you find under the column of Venus: U 6, and over against the same day under Mercury: & 9; which is no more than this, viz. the second day of January at six o'clock after noon, the Moon comes to the U of Venus; and at nine of clock she meets with the sextile of Mercury.
rules.translation: 计时法：占星日自午正起算（noon 至次午 = 24 小时）。星历表右页记载月亮入相各行星的时刻（例：某日午后 6 时月四分金星、午后 9 时月六合水星）。
rules.notes: 校注：1646 年英国用儒略历，与格历差 10 天；17 世纪占星家亦有用日落起日的（Cardan）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: Under F you find Orient.; that is, Mars is oriental, or rises before the Sun. Under L you find Occid.; that is, Saturn is occidental of the Sun, or sets after him.
rules.translation: 星历表右页标记：Orient.=行星东出（日先升）；Occid.=行星西入（日后没）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: In erecting or setting your figure, whether of a question or nativity, you are to consider these three things: First, the year, month, day of the week, hour or part of the hour of that day. Secondly, to observe in the Ephemeris of that year and day the true place of the Sun in sign, degree and minute at noon. Thirdly, what hours and minutes in the Table of Houses do answer or stand on the left hand against the degree of that sign the Sun is in the day of the question; for by adding the hour of the day, and hours and minutes answering to the place of the Sun, your figure is made.
rules.translation: 起盘三要素：①问事时刻（年月日时）②星历表查该日太阳午正位置③宫位表查太阳位置对应的恒星时（H.M.）。起盘算法：恒星时 + 问事时刻（>24 减 24）→ 入宫位表 Time from Noon 栏 → 对出 10/11/12/1/2/3/4 宫 cusp。
rules.notes: 传统算法：ST = RA(MC) at noon + time；现代引擎直接以 pyswisseph 计算宫位 cusps，本规则保留历史算法作交叉验证；52° 宫位表为英格兰所用

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: If he be within five degrees of the cusp of any house, his virtue shall be assigned to that house whose cusp he is nearest.
rules.translation: 宫缘归属：行星若距某宫 cusp 5° 以内，其力归入最近之宫。
rules.notes: 引擎：cusp proximity 判定

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: If any minutes adhere to the place of the Sun, as always there does, if those minutes exceed thirty, take the hours and minutes adhering to the next greater degree the Sun is in; if less minutes than thirty belong to the Sun, take the same you find him with, for you must know it breeds no error in an horary question.
rules.translation: 起盘取整法：太阳度数含分时——分>30 用下一整度查表、分<30 用本度查表（卜卦允许取整）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: You must set down the place of your planet in sign, degree and minute as you find him at noon; and if your planet be direct, you must subtract him in degree and minute from the place he is in the day subsequent: but when a planet is retrograde, you must do the contrary. Example: January 7 at noon, L is 28 00 a; January 6 at noon, L is 27 58; Daily motion is 2 min.
rules.translation: 每日运动计算：顺行=次日午位置−当日午位置；逆行=当日−次日（取绝对值）。例：土星 1/7 午 28°00′ 白羊 − 1/6 午 27°58′ = 每日 2′。
rules.notes: 引擎：daily_motion = pos(next_noon) - pos(noon)（顺行）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: Although in horary questions it occasions no error (except in the motion of the Moon), yet I thought fit to instruct the learner herewith: how to take their diurnal or daily motion, that thereby you may have a proportion to add to the place of your planets according to the hour of the day or night when you set your figure.
rules.translation: 任意时刻归化：按小时比例折算每日运动加到午正位置（卜卦除月亮外误差可忽略）。
rules.notes: 引擎：pos(t) = pos(noon) + daily_motion × (t−noon)/24；现代引擎用 pyswisseph 精确计算

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The whole sphere of heaven is divided into four equal parts by the meridian and horizon, and again into four quadrants, and every quadrant again into three parts; so the whole heaven is divided into twelve equal parts, which the astrologers call houses or mansions, taking their beginning from the east.
rules.translation: 十二宫划分：天球由子午线与地平线分四象限，每象限再分三份，得十二宫，自东方（上升）起算。
rules.notes: 本卷采用等宫/象限宫制（与后世 Placidus 不同），52° 宫位表

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The first quadrant contains the twelfth, eleventh and tenth houses, called the oriental, vernal, masculine, sanguine, infant quarter. The second quadrant contains the ninth, eighth and seventh, called meridian, estival, feminine, youthful, choleric. The third quadrant contains the sixth, fifth and fourth, called occidental, autumnal, masculine, melancholic, manhood. The fourth quadrant contains the third, second and first, called northern, feminine, old age, phlegmatic.
rules.translation: 四象限性质：东象限（12/11/10）=春、阳性、多血、幼年；南（9/8/7）=夏、阴性、胆质、青年；西（6/5/4）=秋、阳性、忧郁、壮年；北（3/2/1）=冬、阴性、痰质、老年。
rules.notes: 生命轮：升=生、MC=成年、降=壮年、IC=老年

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The first, tenth, seventh and fourth houses hereof are called angles; the eleventh, second, eighth and fifth are called succedents; the third, twelfth, ninth and sixth, are termed cadents. The angles are most powerful, the succedents are next in virtue, the cadents poor, and of little efficacy. In force and virtue they stand so in order: 1 10 7 4 11 5 9 3 2 8 6 12.
rules.notes: 引擎：house strength 权重；9/3 果宫优于 2/8 续宫（不对升点出相位故特弱）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
