rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: When we name the lord of the ascendant, or significator of the querent, or thing quesited; we mean no other thing than that planet who is lord of that sign which ascends, or lord of that sign from which house the thing demanded is required; as if from the seventh house, the lord of that sign descending on the cusp is significator. Cosignificator is when you find another planet in aspect or conjunction with that planet who is the principal significator. Almuten of any house is that planet who has most dignities in the sign ascending or descending upon the cusp of any house. Almuten of a figure is that planet who in essential and accidental dignities is most powerful in the whole scheme of heaven.
rules.translation: 术语：示义星（significator）=所问之宫 cusp 星座的宫主星；共示义星（cosignificator）=与主示义星成相或合相之星；宫之 Almuten=宫头星座尊贵最多之星；盘之 Almuten=全盘尊贵最强者。
rules.notes: 引擎：significator lookup + almuten 计分

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The longitude of a planet is his distance from the beginning of Aries, numbered according to the succession of signs, unto the place of the planet. Latitude is the distance of a planet from the ecliptic, either towards the north or south. Declination of a planet is his distance from the equator, and as he declines from thence either northward or southward, so is his declination nominated either north or south.
rules.translation: 术语：黄经=自白羊首度按序至行星之距（绝对黄经）；纬度=行星距黄道之南北距（日恒无纬）；赤纬=行星距赤道之南北距。
rules.notes: 引擎坐标体系：ecliptic longitude/latitude、declination

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The first house has signification of the life of man, of the stature, colour, complexion, form and shape of him that propounds the question, or is born. In eclipses and great conjunctions, and upon the Sun his annual ingress into Aries; it signifies the common people. It represents the head and face of man; if either Saturn, Mars or Q be in this house, you shall observe some blemish in the face, or in that member appropriate to the sign that then is upon the cusp. Of colours, it has the white. The consignificators are Aries and Saturn; Mercury doth also joy in this house. It is called the ascendant.
rules.translation: 第一宫：命主之生命、体貌；日蚀大合与年入白羊时=庶民。主人头面——土/火/龙尾居此=面部瑕疵（据宫头星座部位定）。色白。共示义星：白羊与土星；水星乐居此宫。称 Ascendant。
rules.notes: 瑕疵定位：宫头星座升序度=头上/中=面中/末度=下巴颈

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: From the second house is required judgement concerning the estate or fortune of him that asks, of his wealth or poverty, of all removable goods, money lent, of profit or gain, loss or damage; in suits of law it signifies a man's friends or assistants; in private duels, the querent's second. It represents in man the neck, and hinder parts of it towards the shoulders; of colours the green. Its consignificators are Jupiter and Taurus; for if Jupiter be placed in this house, or be lord hereof, it's an argument of an estate or fortune. The Sun and Mars are never well placed in this house, either of them show dispersion of substance.
rules.translation: 第二宫：问者之财、贫富、动产、借贷、损益；讼中=友与助者、决斗中=副手。主人颈肩。色绿。共示义星：木星与金牛——木居此或为主=有产之征；日火居此皆主散财。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The third house has signification of brethren, sisters, cousins or kindred, neighbours, small journeys, or inland-journeys, oft removing from one place to another, epistles, letters, rumours, messengers. It doth rule the shoulders, arms, hands and fingers. Of colours, it governs the red and yellow, or croceal or sorrel colour. It has consignificators, of the signs Gemini, of the planets Mars; which is one reason why Mars in this house, unless joined with Saturn, is not very unfortunate. It is a cadent house, and is the joy of the Moon.
rules.translation: 第三宫：兄弟姊妹亲族、邻里、短途内陆旅行、书信、消息、使者。主肩臂手指。色红黄（藏红花色）。共示义星：双子与火星——火居此除非合土不凶；月乐居此宫（主常迁徙）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The fourth house gives judgement of fathers in general and ever of his father that enquires, or that is born; of lands, houses, tenements, inheritances, tillage of the earth, treasures hidden, the determination or end of anything; towns, cities or castles; all ancient dwellings, gardens, fields, pastures, orchards. The sign of the fourth denotes the town, the lord thereof, the governor. It rules the breast, and lungs. Of colours, the red. Its consignificator is Cancer and of planets, the Sun. We call it the Angle of the Earth, or Imum Coeli.
rules.translation: 第四宫：父、土地房产继承、耕作、埋藏之宝、事物之终结；城镇城池（宫头星座=城、其主星=执政者）。主胸肺。色红。共示义星：巨蟹与太阳。称天底（IC）。
rules.notes: 白昼以太阳表父、夜间以土星表父（另一系）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: By the fifth house we judge of children, of embassadors, of the state of a woman with child, of banquets, of ale-houses, taverns, plays, messengers or agents for republics; of the wealth of the father, the ammunition of a town besieged; if the woman with child shall bring forth male or female; of the health or sickness of his son or daughter. It rules the stomach, liver, heart, sides and back, and is masculine. Of colours, black and white, or honey-colour. Its consignificators are Leo and Venus, who doth joy in this house. It's wholly unfortunate by Mars or Saturn, and they therein show disobedient children and untoward.
rules.translation: 第五宫：子女、大使、孕妇、宴饮、酒馆、戏剧、共和国使者；父之财富、围城之弹药；胎儿男女、子女之健康。主胃肝心侧背。色黑白（蜜色）。共示义星：狮子与金星——金乐居此宫；火土居此主子女忤逆。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The sixth house concerns men and maid-servants, galley-slaves, hogs, sheep, goats, hares, coneys, all manner of lesser cattle, and profit and loss got thereby. Sickness, its quality and cause, principal humour offending, curable or not curable, whether the disease be short or long. Day-labourers, tenants, farmers, shepherds, hog-herds, neatherds, warreners; and it signifies uncles, or the father's brothers and sisters. It rules the inferior part of the belly, and intestines. This house is a feminine and cadent house, unfortunate, as having no aspect to the Ascendant. Of colours, black. Mars rejoices in this house, but his consignificator is of the signs Virgo, of planets Mercury. Mars and Venus in conjunction in this house are arguments of a good Physician.
rules.translation: 第六宫：仆役、小牲畜（猪羊兔等）与损益；疾病之性质成因、主犯体液、可治与否、久暂；短工佃户农夫牧者；叔伯姑姨。主下腹肠。阴性果宫、无相照升点故弱。色黑。火星乐居；共示义星：处女与水星——火金合于此宫主良医。
rules.notes: 医学占星：6宫=病宫

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The seventh house gives judgement of marriage, and describes the person inquired after, whether it be man or woman; and all manner of love questions. Our public enemies, the defendant in a law-suit, in war the opposing party; all quarrels, duels, law-suits. In astrology, the artist himself; in physic the physician. Thieves and thefts; the person stealing, whether man or woman. Wives, sweethearts; their shape, description, condition. It has consignificators Libra and Moon. Saturn or Mars unfortunate herein show ill fortune in marriage. Of colour, a dark black colour. It rules the haunches, and the navel to the buttocks; and is called the Angle of the West; and is masculine.
rules.translation: 第七宫：婚姻与配偶（所问之人）、一切情爱事；公开之敌、诉讼被告、战争敌对方、口角决斗诉讼；占星师自身、医师；盗贼与盗窃。色暗黑。主臀腰胯。称西角。共示义星：天秤与月亮——土火失势居此主婚姻不顺。
rules.notes: 7宫主配偶/敌人/盗贼三方示义

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The eighth house: the estate of men deceased, death, its quality and nature; the wills, legacies and testaments of men deceased. Dowry of the wife, portion of the maid, whether much or little, easy to be obtained or with difficulty. In duels it represents the adversary's second; in lawsuits the defendant's friends. What kind of death a man shall die. It signifies fear and anguish of mind. Who shall enjoy or be heir to the deceased. It rules the privy-parts. Of colours, the green and black. Of signs it has Scorpio for consignificator, and Saturn. The haemorrhoids, the stone, strangury, poisons, and bladder are ruled by this house; and this is a succedent house, and feminine.
rules.translation: 第八宫：死者之财、死亡之性、遗嘱遗赠；妻之嫁妆；决斗中=对方副手、讼中=被告之友；死法；心中忧惧；继承人。主私处。色绿黑。共示义星：天蝎与土星。主痔、结石、淋涩、毒、膀胱。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: By the ninth house we give judgement of voyages or long journeys beyond seas; of religious men, or clergy of any kind, whether bishops or inferior ministers. Dreams, visions, foreign countries; of books, learning, church livings, or benefices, advowsons; of the kindred of one's wife. Of colours it has the green and white. Of man's body it rules the fundament, the hips and thighs. Sagittarius and Jupiter are consignificators of this house; for if Jupiter be herein placed it naturally signifies a devout man in his religion. I have oft observed when the Dragon's Tail, or Mars or Saturn have been unfortunately placed in this house; the querent has either been little better than an atheist or a desperate sectarist. The Sun rejoices to be in this house, which is masculine, and cadent.
rules.translation: 第九宫：远洋航行、宗教与教士、梦与异象、外国、书籍学问、教职俸禄；妻之亲族。色绿白。主臀髋股。共示义星：射手与木星——木居此主虔诚；龙尾/火/土失势居此主无神或偏执。太阳乐居此宫。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The tenth house commonly personifies kings, princes, dukes, earls, judges, prime officers, commanders in chief, whether in armies or towns; all sorts of magistracy and officers in authority. Mothers, honour, preferment, dignity, office, lawyers; the profession or trade any one uses. It signifies kingdoms, empires, dukedoms, countries. It has of colours red and white, and rules the knees and hams. Its called the Medium coeli or Midheaven, and is feminine. Its consignificators are Capricorn and Mars. Either Jupiter or the Sun do much fortunate this house when they are posited therein, Saturn or Q usually deny honour.
rules.translation: 第十宫：君主贵族、法官、将帅、一切权柄官职；母、荣誉、晋升、事业职业；王国帝国。色红白。主膝腿弯。称天顶（MC）。共示义星：摩羯与火星——木或日居此大吉；土或龙尾居此夺荣。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The eleventh house doth naturally represent friends and friendship, hope, trust, confidence, the praise or dispraise of anyone; the fidelity or falseness of friends. As to kings, it personates their favourites, councillors, servants, their associates or allies, their money, exchequer or treasure; in war their ammunition and soldiery. It represents courtiers. Of members it rules the legs to the ankles. Of colours, it rules the saffron or yellow. It has of the signs Aquarius, and Sun of the planets for consignificators; Jupiter does especially rejoice in this house; it's a succedent house, and masculine, and in virtue is equivalent either to the seventh or fourth houses.
rules.translation: 第十一宫：朋友情谊、希望信任、誉毁、友之忠奸；王之王侯宠臣谋士、国库军资。主腿至踝。色橙黄。共示义星：水瓶与太阳——木星特乐居此宫。续宫，力等 7/4 宫。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（基础教程卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partII）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2011
rules.original_text: The twelfth house has signification of private enemies, of witches, great cattle — as horses, oxen, elephants; sorrow, tribulation, imprisonments, all manner of affliction, self-undoing, and of such men as maliciously undermine their neighbours, or inform secretly against them. It has consignificators Pisces and Venus; Saturn does joy in that house, for naturally Saturn is author of mischief; and it ruleth in man's body the feet. In colour it presents the green. It's a cadent house, feminine.
rules.translation: 第十二宫：私敌、巫者、大牲畜（马牛象）、忧苦、囚禁、一切困厄自毁；暗算告密之人。共示义星：双鱼与金星——土星乐居此宫。主足。色绿。果宫阴性。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: These signs are divided many ways; as first, into four quadrants or quarters, answering to the four quarters of the year. The vernal or spring quarter, is sanguine, hot and moist, and contains the first three signs, viz. a b c. The aestival or summer quarter is hot, dry and choleric, and contains d e f. The autumnal quarter is cold, dry and melancholy, g h i. The hyemnal or winter quarter is cold, moist and phlegmatic, j k l.
rules.translation: 星座分四季象限：春（a b c）多血质热而湿；夏（d e f）热而干胆质；秋（g h i）冷而干忧郁质；冬（j k l）冷而湿痰质。
rules.notes: 体液医学四象限

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Some signs in nature are fiery, hot and dry, viz., a e i, and these three signs constitute the fiery triplicity. Others are dry, cold and earthly, viz. b f j. Others are airy, hot and moist, viz. c g k. Others are watery, cold and moist, viz. d h l.
rules.translation: 四元素三分：火相 a/e/i（热干）、土相 b/f/j（干冷）、风相 c/g/k（热湿）、水相 d/h/l（冷湿）。
rules.notes: 引擎基础表

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Some signs are masculine, diurnal, and therefore hot, as a c e g i k. Some are feminine, nocturnal, therefore cold, viz., b d f h j l. The use whereof is this, that if you have a masculine planet in a masculine sign, it imports him or her more manly; and so if a masculine planet be in a feminine sign, the man or woman is less courageous.
rules.translation: 阴阳性：阳性昼热 a/c/e/g/i/k；阴性夜冷 b/d/f/h/j/l。用法：阳星居阳座=更阳刚；阳星居阴座=欠勇敢（性格修正）。
rules.notes: 可编码 gender×sign 修正

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Some signs again are called boreal, septentrional or northern, because they decline from the equinoctial northward; and these are a b c d e f. Some signs are called austral, meridional or southern, for they decline southward, and these are g h i j k l.
rules.translation: 南北半球：北向 a/b/c/d/e/f（赤道以北），南向 g/h/i/j/k/l。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: a d g j are called moveable and cardinal: moveable, because when the Sun enters into a and g the weather and season of the year quickly varies; they are called cardinal, because when the Sun enters into any of those signs from that time we denominate the quarters of the year. The equinoctial signs are a g, solstitial and tropics: d j. The fixed signs are b e h k. The common signs are c f i l, called bi-corporeal or double bodied because they represent two bodies.
rules.translation: 基本（cardinal）座 a/d/g/j——春分 a、秋分 g、夏至 d、冬至 j；固定座 b/e/h/k；变动（common）座 c/f/i/l（双体座）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If the planet who is lord of the ascendant be in a moveable sign, and the sign ascending be also one, it denotes the person to be unstable, and of no resolution, easily mutable, perverted, a wavering inconstant man. If the ascendant be fixed, and the lord of that sign also in a fixed sign, judge the party to be of firm resolution, no changeling. If the sign ascending be common, and the lord of that sign also in a common sign, judge the person to be neither very wilful or easily variable but between both.
rules.translation: 宫性判定人：升点与其主同属基本座=人无定性善变；同属固定座=坚定不渝；同属变动座=介乎两者。
rules.notes: 解读引擎判则

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Bestial or quadrupedian, viz. a b e i j; these have representation of four-footed creatures. Fruitful or prolifical, viz. d h l. Barren signs, c e f. Manly or humane, courteous signs, c f g k. Feral signs are e and last part of i. Mute signs or of slow voice, d h l.
rules.translation: 星座特性分类：兽性座 a/b/e/i/j（四足兽）；丰饶座 d/h/l；不育座 c/e/f；人形文雅座 c/f/g/k；野性座 e 与射手后段；无声座 d/h/l。
rules.notes: 问子女：月与主示义星居丰饶座且强=有子；升点/5宫为不育座=少子或无子

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: There are also many other divisions of the signs, as into signs commanding, viz. a b c d e f and signs obeying; g h i j k l. And into signs of right or long ascension, viz. d e f g h i. And into signs of short or oblique ascension, viz. j k l a b c. Signs of long ascension continue two hours and more in the ascendant: and signs of short ascensions do arise in little more than an hour.
rules.translation: 另分：指挥座 a/b/c/d/e/f、服从座 g/h/i/j/k/l；长升座 d/e/f/g/h/i（升点持续 2 小时余）、短升座 j/k/l/a/b/c（约 1 小时余）。
rules.notes: 由 52° 宫位表实测：狮子 2h48m、水瓶 1h4m

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: a is a masculine, diurnal sign, moveable, cardinal, equinoctial; in nature fiery, hot and dry, choleric, bestial, luxurious, intemperate and violent: the diurnal house of F, of the fiery triplicity, and of the east.
rules.translation: 白羊：阳性昼行、基本春分、火性热干胆质、兽性、放纵无度而暴烈；火星昼宫、火相、东方。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: All pushes, whelks, pimples in the face; small pox, hare lips, polypus, ring-worms, falling-sickness, apoplexies, migraines, toothache, headache and baldness. Places: where sheep and small cattle do feed; sandy and hilly grounds; a place of refuge for thieves; in houses, the covering, ceiling or plastering; lands newly taken in or newly ploughed, or where bricks have been burned.
rules.translation: 白羊疾病：面疱疹痘、天花、兔唇、鼻息肉、金钱癣、癫痫、中风、偏头痛、牙痛头痛秃头。白羊之地：羊群牧地、沙丘山地、贼巢、屋顶天花粉刷、新垦地、烧砖石灰处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A dry body, not exceeding in height; lean or spare, but lusty bones, and the party in his limbs strong; the visage long; black eyebrows, a long neck, thick shoulders, the complexion dusky brown or swartish. Kingdoms: Germany, Sweden, Poland, Burgundy, France, England, Denmark, Silesia the higher, Judea, Syria. Cities: Florence, Capua, Naples, Ferrara, Verona, Utrecht, Marseilles, Augusta, Casarea, Padua, Bergamo.
rules.translation: 白羊体型：干瘦不矮、骨健肢强、长脸、黑眉、长颈厚肩、面色灰褐。属国：德、瑞典、波兰、勃艮第、法、英、丹麦、上西里西亚、犹大、叙利亚。属城：佛罗伦萨、卡普阿、那不勒斯、费拉拉、维罗纳、乌得勒支、马赛、奥古斯塔、凯撒利亚、帕多瓦、贝加莫。
rules.notes: 地理映射表（世俗/择居引擎）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: b is an earthly, cold, dry, melancholy, feminine, nocturnal, fixed, domestical or bestial sign, of the earthly triplicity, and south; the night-house of Venus.
rules.translation: 金牛：土性冷干忧郁、阴性夜行、固定、家宅兽性、土相、南方；金星夜宫。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: The king's evil, sore throats, wens, fluxes or rheums falling into the throat, quinzies; impostumes in those parts. Places: stables where horses are, low houses, places where the implements of cattle are laid up, pasture grounds where no houses are near, plain grounds, cellars, low rooms.
rules.translation: 金牛疾病：瘰疬、喉痛、囊肿、喉部风湿、扁桃腺脓肿。金牛之地：马厩、矮屋、农具房、无屋牧场、平地、地窖低室。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It presents one of a short, but of a full, strong and well-set stature, a broad forehead, great eyes, big face; large, strong shoulders; great mouth, and thick lips; gross hands; black rugged hair. Kingdoms: Polonia the Great, North Part of Sweathland, Russia, Ireland, Switzerland, Lorraine, Campania, Persia, Cyprus, Parthia. Cities: Novgorod, Parma, Bologna, Palermo, Mantua, Sienna, Brescia, Karlstad, Nantes, Leipzig.
rules.translation: 金牛体型：矮而丰满强健、宽额大眼大脸、肩阔口大唇厚、手粗、黑硬发。属国：大波兰、瑞典北部、俄国、爱尔兰、瑞士、洛林、坎帕尼亚、波斯、塞浦路斯、帕提亚。属城：诺夫哥罗德、帕尔马、博洛尼亚、巴勒莫、曼图亚、锡耶纳、布雷西亚、卡尔斯塔德、南特、莱比锡。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: c is an aerial, hot, moist, sanguine, diurnal, common or double-bodied humane sign; the diurnal house of B of the airy triplicity, western, masculine.
rules.translation: 双子：风性热湿多血质、昼行、变动双体人形座；水星昼宫、风相、西方、阳性。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: He signifies all diseases or infirmities in the arms, shoulders, hands; corrupted blood, windiness in the veins, distempered fancies. Places: wainscot rooms, plastering and walls of houses, the halls, or where play is used. Hills and mountains, barns, storehouses for corn; coffers, chests; high places.
rules.translation: 双子疾病：臂肩手诸疾、血腐、静脉风气、神思错乱。双子之地：护壁房间、墙壁灰泥、厅堂游戏处、丘陵山峦、谷仓粮仓、箱柜、高处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: An upright, tall, straight body either in man or woman; the complexion sanguine, not clear, but obscure and dark; long arms, but many times the hands and feet short and very fleshy; a dark hair, almost black; a strong, active body, a good piercing hazel eye, and wanton, and of perfect sight, of excellent understanding. Kingdoms: Lombardy, Brabant, Flanders, the West and Southwest of England, Armenia. Cities: London, Louvain, Bruges, Nuremburg, Cordova, Hassfurt, Mont, Bamberg, Cesena.
rules.translation: 双子体型：男女皆挺直高身材、面色多血而晦暗、臂长手足短而丰、发黑近墨、体强健、目锐榛色而多情。属国：伦巴第、布拉班特、佛兰德斯、英格兰西南、亚美尼亚。属城：伦敦、鲁汶、布鲁日、纽伦堡、科尔多瓦、哈斯富特、美因茨、班贝格、切塞纳。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: d is the only house of the Moon, and is the first sign of the watery or northern triplicity; is watery, cold, moist, phlegmatic, feminine, nocturnal, moveable, a solstice sign, mute and slow of voice, fruitful, northern.
rules.translation: 巨蟹：月亮独宫、水相之首、冷湿痰质、阴性夜行、基本夏至座、无声、丰饶、北方。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It signifies imperfections all over, or in the breast, stomach and paps; weak digestion, cold stomach, phthisis, salt[y] phlegms, rotten coughs, dropsical humours, impostumations in the stomach, cancers which ever are in the breast. Places: the sea, great rivers, navigational waters; places near rivers, brooks, springs, wells; cellars, wash-houses; marsh grounds, ditches with rushes, sea banks, trenches, cisterns.
rules.translation: 巨蟹疾病：胸胃乳诸疾、消化不良、胃寒、痨病、咸痰、腐咳、水肿液、胃脓肿、乳癌。巨蟹之地：海、大河、水域；近河溪泉井处；地窖洗衣房、沼泽、灯心草沟渠、海堤、壕沟水槽。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Generally a low and small stature, the upper parts of more bigness than the lower; a round visage; sickly pale, a whitely complexion, the hair a sad brown, little eyes, prone to have many children if a woman. Kingdoms: Scotland, Zealand, Holland, Prussia, Tunisia, Algeria, Constantinople. Cities: Venice, Milan, Genoa, Amsterdam, York, Magdeberg, Wittenberg, Cadiz.
rules.translation: 巨蟹体型：矮小、上大下小、圆脸、病态苍白、发暗褐、小眼、女子多产。属国：苏格兰、泽兰、荷兰、普鲁士、突尼斯、阿尔及利亚、君士坦丁堡。属城：威尼斯、米兰、热那亚、阿姆斯特丹、约克、马格德堡、维滕贝格、加的斯。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: e is the only house of the Sun, by nature fiery, hot, dry, choleric, diurnal, commanding, bestial, barren, of the east and fiery triplicity, masculine.
rules.translation: 狮子：太阳独宫、火性热干胆质、昼行、指挥、兽性、不育、东方火相、阳性。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: All sicknesses in the ribs and sides, as pleurisy, convulsions, pains in the back, trembling or passion of the heart, violent burning-fevers, all weakness or diseases in the heart, sore eyes, the plague, the pestilence, the yellow-jaundice. Places: a place where wild beasts frequent, woods, forests, desert places, steep rocky places, inaccessible places, king's palaces, castles, forts, parks; in houses where fire is kept, near a chimney.
rules.translation: 狮子疾病：肋骨胁部诸疾、胸膜炎、抽搐、背痛、心悸、暴热、心弱、目疾、瘟疫、黄疽。狮子之地：野兽出没处、树林森林荒野、峭壁险地、王宫城堡堡垒园林；室内近火炉烟囱处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Great round head, big eyes starting or staring out, or goggle-eyes, quick-sighted, a full and large body and is more than of middle stature, broad shoulders, narrow sides, yellow or dark flaxen hair and it much curling; a fierce countenance, but ruddy, high sanguine complexion; strong, valiant and active. Kingdoms: Italy, Bohemia, the Alps, Turkey, Sicily, Apulia. Cities: Rome, Syracuse, Cremona, Ravenna, Damascus, Prague, Linz, Bristol.
rules.translation: 狮子体型：大圆头、大而凸目、体丰逾中、肩宽肋窄、黄褐卷发、貌猛面赤、体强勇健。属国：意大利、波西米亚、阿尔卑斯、土耳其、西西里、阿普利亚。属城：罗马、叙拉古、克雷莫纳、拉文纳、大马士革、布拉格、林茨、布里斯托。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: f is an earthly, cold, melancholy, barren, feminine, nocturnal, southern sign; the house and exaltation of B, of the earthly triplicity.
rules.translation: 处女：土性冷干忧郁、不育、阴性夜行、南方；水星之宫与擢升、土相。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: The worms, wind, colic, all obstructions in the bowels and miseraicks, croaking of the guts, infirmness in the stones, and disease in the belly. Places: a study where books are, a closet, a dairy-house, corn-fields, granaries, malt-houses, hayricks, or of barley, wheat or peas, or a place where cheese and butter is preserved.
rules.translation: 处女疾病：虫积、风气、绞痛、肠梗阻、肠鸣、结石、腹疾。处女之地：书房、密室、乳品房、麦田、谷仓、麦芽房、干草垛、大麦小麦豌豆处、藏奶酪黄油处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A slender body of mean height, but decently composed; a ruddy brown complexion, black hair, well-favoured or lovely, but no beautiful creature, a small shrill voice, all members inclining to brevity; a witty discreet soul, judicious and excellently well spoken, studious and given to history. Kingdoms: Greece, the south part thereof, Croatia, the Athenian territory, Mesopotamia, Africa, the south-west of France. Cities: Paris, Jerusalem, Rhodes, Lyons, Toulouse, Basle, Heidelberg.
rules.translation: 处女体型：中等身材纤细、棕红面色、黑发、清秀不艳、细尖声、肢体偏短；机智审慎、善言辞、好学好史。属国：希腊南部、克罗地亚、雅典领地、美索不达米亚、非洲、法国西南。属城：巴黎、耶路撒冷、罗德岛、里昂、图卢兹、巴塞尔、海德堡。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: g is a sign aerial, hot and moist, sanguine, masculine, moveable, equinoctial, cardinal, humane, diurnal, of the aerial triplicity, and western, the chief house of C.
rules.translation: 天秤：风性热湿多血质、阳性、基本秋分、人形、昼行、风相、西方；金星主宫。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: All disease of the stone or gravel in the reins of the back, kidneys, heats and diseases in the loins or haunches, impostumes or ulcers in the reins, kidneys or bladder, weakness in the back, corruption of blood. Places: ground near windmills, or some straggling barn or out-house, or saw-pits, or where coopers work or wood is cut, sides of hills, tops of mountains, grounds where hawking and hunting is used, sandy and gravelly fields, pure clear air; the upper rooms, chambers, garrets.
rules.translation: 天秤疾病：腰肾结石砂淋、腰胯热疾、肾膀胱脓肿溃疡、背弱、血腐。天秤之地：风车旁地、散落仓房、锯木坑、桶匠木工处、山侧山顶、鹰猎处、沙砾地、清朗空气处；楼上房间阁楼。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It personates a well-framed body, straight, tall and more subtle or slender than gross; a round, lovely and beautiful visage, a pure sanguine colour; in youth, no abundance or excess in either white or red, but in age usually some pimples, or a very high colour; the hair yellowish, smooth and long. Kingdoms: the higher Austria, Savoy, Alsatia, Livonia. Cities: Lisbon, Frankfort, Vienna, Placentia, Arles, Fribourg, Spires.
rules.translation: 天秤体型：身材端正、直而高、偏纤细；圆美面容、纯多血色；少时面色平和、老时面疱或高红；发黄滑长。属国：上奥地利、萨伏依、阿尔萨斯、利沃尼亚。属城：里斯本、法兰克福、维也纳、皮亚琴察、阿尔勒、弗里堡、施派尔。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: h is a cold, watery, nocturnal, phlegmatic, feminine sign, of the watery triplicity, fixed and north, the house and joy of F, feminine; usually it doth represent subtle, deceitful men.
rules.translation: 天蝎：冷湿痰质、阴性夜行、固定、水相、北方；火星之宫与乐处；恒示机巧诡诈之人。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Gravel, the stone in the secret parts, bladder, ruptures, fistulas, or the piles in Ano, gonorrhoea, priapismes, all afflicting the privy parts either in man or woman; defects in the matrix. Places: places where all sorts of creeping beasts use, as beetles, or such as be without wings, and are poisonous; gardens, orchards, vineyards, ruinous houses near waters; muddy, moorish grounds, stinking lakes, quagmires, sinks, the kitchen or larder, wash-house.
rules.translation: 天蝎疾病：砂淋、隐部结石、膀胱、疝、瘘、痔、淋病、阳强、男女私处诸疾、子宫缺陷。天蝎之地：爬虫毒虫处、园圃果园葡萄园、水边废屋、泥沼臭湖烂泥坑、厨房储藏室洗衣房。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A corpulent, strong, able body, somewhat a broad or square face, a dusky muddy complexion, and sad, dark hair, much and crisping; a hairy body, somewhat bow-legged, short necked, a squat, well-trussed fellow. Kingdoms: North part of Bavaria, the woody part of Norway, Barbary, the Kingdom of Fez, Catalonia, Valencia. Cities: Urbino, Vienne, Messina, Gaunt, Frankfurt on the Oder.
rules.translation: 天蝎体型：壮实能干、方面微阔、面色灰暗、暗黑卷发、体毛多、微罗圈、短颈、矮壮。属国：巴伐利亚北部、挪威林地、巴巴里、非斯王国、加泰罗尼亚、瓦伦西亚。属城：乌尔比诺、维埃纳、墨西拿、根特、奥得河畔法兰克福。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: i is of the fiery triplicity, east, in nature fiery, hot, dry, masculine, choleric, diurnal, common, bi-corporeal or double bodied, the house and joy of K.
rules.translation: 射手：火相东方、热干、阳性、胆质、昼行、变动双体；木星之宫与乐处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It ruleth the thighs and buttocks in the parts of man's body, and all fistulas or hurts falling in those members, and generally denoteth blood heated, fevers pestilential, falls from horses, or hurts from them or four-footed beasts; also prejudice by fire, heat and intemperateness in sports. Places: a stable of great horses, or horses for the wars, or a house where usually great four-footed beasts are kept; hills, and the highest places of lands; upper rooms, near the fire.
rules.translation: 射手疾病：股臀诸疾、瘘、血热、瘟疫热、坠马及四足兽之伤、火与热之害、运动过度。射手之地：战马大畜之厩、山丘高地、上层房间近火处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It represents a well-favoured countenance, somewhat long visage, but full and ruddy, or almost like sun-burnt; the hair light chestnut colour, the stature somewhat above the middle size; a conformity in the members, and a strong able body. Kingdoms: Spain, Hungary, Slavonia, Moravia, Dalmatia. Cities: Budapest, Toledo, Narbonne, Cologne, Stargrad.
rules.translation: 射手体型：面容清秀稍长而丰红、类日晒色；发浅栗色、身高中上、肢体匀称强健。属国：西班牙、匈牙利、斯拉沃尼亚、摩拉维亚、达尔马提亚。属城：布达佩斯、托莱多、纳博讷、科隆、斯塔格拉德。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It's the house of L, and is nocturnal, cold, dry, melancholy, earthly, feminine, solstitial, cardinal, moveable, domestical, four-footed, southern; the exaltation of F.
rules.translation: 摩羯：土星之宫、夜行冷干忧郁、土性阴性、冬至基本、家宅四足、南方；火星擢升处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It hath government of the knees, and all diseases incident to those places, either by strains or fractures; it notes leprosy, the itch, the scab. Places: an ox-house, or cow-house, or where calves are kept, or tools for husbandry, or old wood is laid up; sheep-pens and grounds where sheep-feed, fallow-grounds, barren fields, bushy and thorny; dunghills, or where soil is laid; low, dark places, near the ground or threshold.
rules.translation: 摩羯疾病：膝部诸疾、扭伤骨折、麻风、疥疮。摩羯之地：牛棚犊舍、农具房、陈木堆、羊圈牧地、休耕地、荒地、荆棘丛、粪堆肥土处；低暗近地处。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: Usually dry bodies, not high of stature, long, lean and slender visage, thin beard, black hair, a narrow chin, long small neck and narrow breast. Kingdoms: Thrace, Macedon, Albania, Bulgaria, Saxony the South-west part, West-Indies, Styria, the Isles Orcades, Hessia, Oxford, Mecklenburg, Cleves, Brandenburg.
rules.translation: 摩羯体型：干瘦不高、长瘦面容、须稀、黑发、窄颏、细长颈、窄胸。属国：色雷斯、马其顿、阿尔巴尼亚、保加利亚、萨克森西南、西印度、施蒂利亚、奥克尼群岛、黑森、牛津、梅克伦堡、克莱沃、勃兰登堡。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: k is an aerial, hot and moist sign, of the airy triplicity, diurnal, sanguine, fixed, rational, humane, masculine, the principal house of L, and house wherein he most rejoices; western.
rules.translation: 水瓶：风性热湿多血质、昼行、固定、理性人形、阳性；土星主宫与最乐处；西方。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: k Governeth the legs, ankles, and all manner of infirmities incident to those members, all melancholy winds coagulated in the veins, or disturbing the blood, cramps. Places: hilly and uneven places, places new digged, or where quarries of stone are, or any minerals have been digged up. In houses, the roofs, eaves or upper parts; vineyards, or near some little spring or conduit-head.
rules.translation: 水瓶疾病：腿踝诸疾、静脉郁气凝血、痉挛。水瓶之地：丘陵崎岖处、新掘之地、采石场、矿坑；屋顶檐口高处、葡萄园、泉源水头旁。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: It presents a squat, thick corporature, or one of a strong, well composed body, not tall; a long visage, sanguine complexion. If L, who is lord of this house, be in j or k, the party is black in hair, and in complexion sanguine, with distorted teeth; otherways, I have observed the party is of clear, white or fair complexion, and of sandy coloured hair, or very flaxen, and a very pure skin. Kingdoms: Tartary, Croatia, Walachia, Moscovia, Westphalia, Piedmont, Media, Arabia. Cities: Hamburg, Bremen, Montserrat, Pisaurum, Trent, Ingolstadt.
rules.translation: 水瓶体型：矮胖厚实或强健匀称不高、长脸多血色。土星居摩羯/水瓶时：发黑、面多血、齿歪；否则肤净白、发沙金或亚麻色、肤极纯。属国：鞑靼、克罗地亚、瓦拉几亚、莫斯科公国、威斯特法伦、皮埃蒙特、米底、阿拉伯。属城：汉堡、不来梅、蒙特塞拉特、佩萨罗、特伦托、因戈尔施塔特。
rules.notes: 肤色发色条件判据

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: l is of the watery triplicity, northern, cold sign, moist, phlegmatic, feminine, nocturnal, the house of K, and exaltation of C, a bicorporeal, common or double-bodied sign; an idle, effeminate, sickly sign, or representing a party of no action.
rules.translation: 双鱼：水相北方、冷湿痰质、阴性夜行；木星之宫、金星擢升；双体变动座；懒散柔弱多病、无为之象。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: All diseases in the feet, as the gout, and all lameness and aches incident to those members, and so generally salt phlegms, scabs, itch, botches, breakings out, boils and ulcers proceeding from blood putrifacted, colds and moist diseases. Places: grounds full of water, or where many springs and much fowl are, also fish-ponds or rivers full of fish, places where hermitages have been, moats about houses, water-mills; in houses near the water, as to some well or pump.
rules.translation: 双鱼疾病：足部诸疾、痛风、跛行、咸痰、疮疥、肿疱、血腐溃疡、寒湿诸疾。双鱼之地：多水之地、多泉多禽处、鱼塘鱼河、隐修处、宅沟、水磨坊；室内近水处如井泵旁。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A short stature, ill composed, not very decent, a good large face, palish complexion, the body fleshy or swelling, not very straight, but incurvating somewhat with the head. Kingdoms: Calabria in Sicily, Portugal, Normandy, the North of Egypt. Cities: Alexandria, Rheims, Worms, Ratisbon, Compostella.
rules.translation: 双鱼体型：矮而不匀、大面苍白、体丰或肿、不直而微前曲。属国：西西里卡拉布里亚、葡萄牙、诺曼底、埃及北部。属城：亚历山大、兰斯、沃尔姆斯、雷根斯堡、孔波斯特拉。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If one demand of the artist, of what condition, quality or stature the person quesited is, then observe the sign of that house whereby he is signified, the sign wherein the lord of that house is, and wherein the Moon is; mix one with another, and by the greater testimonies judge. For if the sign be humane, aerial, and the lord of that sign or the 5 in any sign of the same triplicity or nature, you may judge the body to be handsome, and the conditions of the party to be sociable.
rules.translation: 问人状貌法：察所司宫之星座、其宫主所在星座、月亮所在星座，三者混参以多证为断；若人形风相座且宫主/月同属同三分同性=貌美而善交际。
rules.notes: 解读引擎综合判则

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If the Quere be concerning a disease, and a be either on the cusp of the ascendant, or descending in the sixth, you may judge he hath something in his disease of the nature of a, but what it is you must know by the concurrence of the other significators.
rules.translation: 问病法：白羊（或任何座）在升点或第六宫降下=病含该座之性；具体病由诸示义星会参而定。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If a country man or citizen hath lost or missed any cattle, or any material thing in his house, let him observe in what sign the significator of the thing is in; if in a, and it be a beast strayed, let him see what manner of places that sign directs unto, and let him repair thither to search, considering the quarter of the heaven the sign signifies. If it be an immovable piece of goods, then let him look into such parts of his house as a signifies.
rules.translation: 失物寻踪法：观示义星所在星座；若牲畜走失按该座之地形方位搜寻；若不动产失物按该座在屋内所司之处寻找。
rules.notes: 地理定位引擎：星座-地点-方位映射

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If one asks concerning travel, whether such a country, city or kingdom will be healthful or prosperous unto him; see in the figure in what sign the lord of the ascendant is in. If the significator be fortunate in a, or if K or C be therein, he may safely travel in such cities as the sign of a represents. Those countries subject to the sign wherein the infortunes are posited, unless themselves be significators, are ever unfortunate.
rules.translation: 行旅择地法：观升主所在星座——示义星得时（或吉星居其座）=该座所辖之地可安行旅；凶星所居座之属地恒不利（除非凶星本身为示义星）。商人择地另察二宫/福点/二宫主最强处。
rules.notes: 商人取第二宫方/福点/二宫主所最强处

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A planet is then said to be really strong when he hath many essential dignities, which are known by his being either in his house, exaltation, triplicity, term or face. In any scheme, if you find a planet in any of those signs we call his house, he is then essentially strong, and we allow for that five dignities.
rules.translation: 尊贵强度：居庙=5 分、擢升=4 分、三分=3 分、界=2 分、面=1 分；无任何尊贵=peregrine 游离（-5 分）。
rules.notes: 引擎第3层计分：庙5/擢4/三分3/界2/面1/游离-5

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: If the significator be in his exaltation, and no ways impedited, but angular; it presents a person of haughty condition, arrogant, assuming more unto him than his due; for it's observed, the planets in some part of the zodiac do more evidently declare their effects than in others; and I conceive this to be in those signs and degrees where fixed stars of the same nature with the planets are more in number, and nearer the ecliptic.
rules.translation: 擢升释义：示义星擢升且无碍居角=心高气傲、自视过高之人；行星效果在恒星同性质密集近黄道处更显。
rules.notes: 解读引擎

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: A planet in his triplicity shows a man modestly indued with the goods and fortune of this world, one prettily descended, and the condition of his life at the present time of the question to be good; but not so good as if in either of the two former dignities. A planet fortified only as being in his own terms, rather shows a man more of the corporature and temper of the planet than any extraordinary abundance in fortune. A planet having little or no dignity, but by being in his decanate or face, is almost like a man ready to be turned out of doors, having much ado to maintain himself in credit.
rules.translation: 三级尊贵判语：三分=中产小福家世尚可；仅居界=更显行星体型气质而非大富；仅居面=近乎将败之户、勉强维持声誉。
rules.notes: 解读引擎

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: The planets may be strong another manner of way, viz. accidentally; as when direct, swift in motion, angular, in V or & aspect with K or C, &c. or in R with certain notable fixed Stars.
rules.translation: 偶然强势（accidental）：行星顺行、速行、居角、与木/金成三合或六合、或合特定著名恒星。
rules.notes: 引擎第3层偶然尊贵模块

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: There hath been much difference between the Arabians, Greeks and Indians concerning the essential dignities of the planets; since Ptolemy his time, the Grecians unanimously followed the method he left, and which ever since the other Christians of Europe to this day retain as most rational; but the Moors of Barbary and those astrologians of their nation who lived in Spain do somewhat at this day vary from us; however I present thee with a table according to Ptolemy.
rules.translation: 界表流派：希腊自托勒密后一统其法、欧洲基督教沿用至今；北非摩尔与西班牙系阿拉伯占星家稍异；Lilly 采用托勒密表。
rules.notes: 校注：所谓 Ptolemaic terms 实为托勒密所录另一残损旧稿，非其自创；Lilly 表与 Camerarius/Cardan/Junctinus/AlBiruni 一致

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: The antiscion signs are those which are of the same virtue and are equally distant from the first degree of the two tropic signs, d j. A general table of the antiscions in signs: c ———— d; e ———— b; f ———— a; g ———— l; h ———— k; i ———— j. Any planet in c sends his antiscion into d, or being in e into b.
rules.translation: 反照（antiscion）：两座与两至点（巨蟹/摩羯）首度等距而同性——配表：双子↔巨蟹、狮子↔金牛、处女↔白羊、天秤↔双鱼、天蝎↔水瓶、射手↔摩羯。
rules.notes: 引擎可编码：antiscion 坐标映射

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: To know the degree and minute the planet is in, work thus: see what degree and minute the planet is in, subtract that from 30 degrees, and the remainder tells you both the degree and minute. As L being in 20 degrees and 35 minutes of e, I subtracted from 30 00, and find my Antiscion of L falls to be in 9 degr. and 25 min. of b.
rules.translation: 反照计度法：取行星之度数分钟，自 30° 减去，余即反照之度数分钟（例：狮子 20°35′ → 金牛 9°25′）。
rules.notes: engine: antiscion = 30 - longitude_in_sign

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（十二星座与尊贵卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partV）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2012
rules.original_text: And as there are antiscions which of the good planets we think are equal to a & or V; so are there contrantiscions which we find to be of the nature of a U or X; and to know where it is you do no more than observe in what sign and degree the antiscion is, in the sign and degree opposite to that place the contrantiscion is.
rules.translation: 反照等六合/三合之吉（&/V）；反照之对宫=反向照（contrantiscion），性如四分/对冲（U/X）。
rules.notes: 引擎相位模块：antiscion≈sextile/trine，contrantiscion≈square/opposition

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: The most forcible or strongest rays, configurations or aspects, are only these: the sextile &, quadrate U, trine V, opposition X. We used to call the conjunction R, an aspect, but very improperly.
rules.translation: 主要相位仅四种：六合 &、四分 U、三合 V、对冲 X；合相 R 被称作 aspect 并不恰当（合相为天体直接相接、非光线投射）。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A sextile aspect is the distance of one planet from another by the sixth part of the zodiac or circle; for six times sixty degrees do make 360 degrees. A quadrate aspect is the distance by a fourth part of the circle; for four times ninety do contain 360. The trine aspect consists of 120 degrees, or a third part of the circle. An opposition is when two planets are equally distant 180 degrees, or half the circle. A conjunction is when two planets are in one and the same degree and minute of a sign.
rules.translation: 相位度数：六合 60°（圆周六分之一）、四分 90°（四分之一）、三合 120°（三分之一）、对冲 180°（半圆）、合相=同宫同度同分。
rules.notes: 引擎第3层相位角计算参数

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: The quadrate aspect is a sign of imperfect enmity; and the opposition is an aspect or argument of perfect hatred. If the two significators be in U aspect, the matter is not yet so far gone but there may be hopes of reconciliation; but if the main significators be in opposition, it's then in nature impossible to expect a peace between them till the suit is ended, or until they have fought.
rules.translation: 四分=不完全之仇（尚有和解希望）；对冲=完全之恨（讼必至终、斗必至战）。
rules.notes: 解读引擎

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: The sextile and trine aspects are arguments of love, unity and friendship; but the V is more forcible. If the two significators are in & or V, no doubt but peace may be easily concluded. Conjunctions are good or bad, as the planets in R are friends or enemies to one another.
rules.translation: 六合三合=爱、和、友之征（三合更强）；合相吉凶随合相两星为友为敌而定。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Partile aspect is when two planets are exactly so many degrees from each other as make a perfect aspect: as if C be in nine degrees of a, and K in nine degrees of e, this is a partile V aspect. This is a strong sign or argument for performance of anything or that the matter is near hand concluded when the aspect is so partile, and signifies good; and it's as much a sign of present evil when mischief is threatened.
rules.translation: 入相位（partile）：两星度数恰成完美相位（同度同位）。入相位=事近成就之强征；若所兆为恶则恶事将至。
rules.notes: 古典判法：同度数格（7°01-7°59 同属第8度）比更近但跨度数更重要；Lilly 别处亦作 3° 内

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.condition: 距完美相位 < 双方半容许度和
rules.original_text: A platick aspect is that which admits of the orbs or rays of two planets that signify any matter: As if C be in the tenth degree of b, and L in eighteen degrees of f, here C hath a platick trine to L, because she is within the moiety of both their orbs; for the moiety of L his rays or orbs is five, and of C four, and the distance between them and their perfect aspect is eight degrees.
rules.translation: 泛相位（platick）：两星距完美相位之弧在双方容许度半值之和内。例：金 10°金牛、土 18°处女——三合差距 8°，土半容许 5°+金半容许 4°=9°，故成泛三合。
rules.notes: 引擎可编码：|Δ-相位角| ≤ (orbA+orbB)/2

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: There is also a table of the quality of their orbs: L 10 00 (According to others 09 00); K 12 00 (As some have wrote 09 00); F 07 30 (All consent 07 00); 0 17 00 (Most say 15 00); C 18 00 (Many write but 07 00); B 17 00 (All consent only 07 00); 5 12 30 (Generally but 12 00).
rules.translation: 容许度两套：第一套（本表）土10/木12/火7.5/日17/金18/水17/月12.5；第二套（Lilly 正文惯用、亦为历史主流）土9/木9/火8/日15/金7/水7/月12。
rules.notes: 第二套见于 Porphyry/Abu Ma'shar/Sahl/Alcabitius/AlBiruni/IbnEzra/Bonatti/Schoener/Dariot；木星 AlBiruni/IbnEzra 用 12°

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Application of planets is three several ways: First, when a planet of more swift motion applies to one more slow and ponderous, they being both direct; as F in ten degrees of a, B five: here B applies to R of F. Secondly, when both planets are retrograde, as B in ten degrees of a and F in nine of a; B being not direct until he hath made R with F: this is an ill application and an argument either suddenly perfecting, or breaking off the business. Thirdly, when a planet is direct, and in fewer degrees, and a retrograde planet being in more degrees, this is an ill application, and in the air shows great change; in a question sudden alteration.
rules.translation: 应用（application）三式：①快星顺行向慢星（如 5°双子水星向 10°白羊火星合相）；②两星皆逆行=恶应用，主事突变或破裂；③快星顺行在少度数、另星逆行在更多度数=恶应用，主骤变。
rules.notes: 引擎运动模块：比较黄经差与速度

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: The superior planets do not apply to the inferior (unless they be retrograde), but ever the lighter to the more ponderous; as if L be in the 10th degree of a, and F be in the seventh degree of a, here F being in fewer degrees, and a more light planet than L, applies to his R.
rules.translation: 上行星（土木火）不向下行星应用（除非逆行）；恒轻星向重星应用。例：土 10°白羊、火 7°白羊——火度少而轻，向土合相。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: If L be in a and casts his &, U or V to any planet in the like degrees of c or d or e, this aspect is called a sinister &, U or V, and it is an aspect according to the succession of the signs. Now if L be in a, he also casts his &, U, or V to any planet that is in k, j or i, and this is called a dexter aspect, and is against the order of signs. The dexter aspect is more forcible than the Sinister.
rules.translation: 左右向相位：顺星座序（如白羊向双子/巨蟹/狮子）=sinister 左向；逆序（白羊向水瓶/摩羯/射手）=dexter 右向。dexter 顺日转更强，sinister 较弱。
rules.notes: 强度排序（AlBiruni）：合>对>dexter四分>sinister四分>dexter三合>sinister三合>dexter六合>sinister六合

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A table of the aspects of the signs amongst one another: over against a, dexter: k &, j U, i V, g X; sinister: c &, d U, e V.
rules.translation: 相位座间表示例（白羊起）：白羊 dexter 六合水瓶/四分摩羯/三合射手/对冲天秤；sinister 六合双子/四分巨蟹/三合狮子。全表见映射表。
rules.notes: 引擎可生成 12×4 相位矩阵

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: These are called signs inconjunct, or such as if a planet be in one of them, he cannot have any aspect to another in the sign underneath: as one in a can have no aspect to another in b or h, or one in b to one in a, c, g or i.
rules.translation: 不相照（inconjunct）：相邻座（30°）与 150° 座对不成任何主相位。表：白羊不相照金牛/天蝎；金牛不相照白羊/双子/天秤/射手，余类推（映射表见几何重建全表）。
rules.notes: 几何重建：相邻+150°对；经反照/反向照可连的座对除外（校注原则）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Separation, it is in the first place, when two planets are departed but six minutes distance from each other. When K shall get into 10th degree and 31st or 32nd minute of a, he shall be said to be separating from L; yet K cannot be said to be totally separated or clear from the rays of L, until he hath got 9 whole degrees further into a; for the half of K his orb is 4 degree 30 minutes and the half of L his orb is 4 degrees 30 minutes, added together they make 9 whole degrees. For every planet that applies is allowed half his own orbs and half the orbs of that planet from which he separates.
rules.translation: 分离（separation）：两星相距过 6 分起算分离；完全分离=双方容许度半值之和（例：土月各 9° 半值为 4°30′+4°30′=9°）。
rules.notes: 引擎：separation_arc = (orbA+orbB)/2；校注：6′来源不明，AlBiruni 谓过 1 分即起

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Admit two planets, significators in marriage at the time of the question, are lately separated but a few minutes. I would then judge there had been a few days before great probability of effecting the marriage, but now it hung in suspense, and there seemed some dislike or rupture in it; and as the significators do more separate, so will the matter and affection of the parties more alienate and vary. The two significators in moveable signs, angular and swift in motion, doth hasten the times; in common signs, the time will be more long; in fixed, a longer space of time will be required.
rules.translation: 分离判语：示义星方离数分=事方有变、悬而未决；离愈远则情事愈疏。应期：基本座/角宫/速行=速；变动座=迟；固定座=更久。
rules.notes: 解读引擎应期模块

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Prohibition is when two planets that signify the effecting of anything demanded, are applying to an aspect, and before they can come to a true aspect another planet interposes either his body or aspect, so that thereby the matter propounded is hindered and retarded. The combustion of any planet is the greatest misfortune that can be. The second manner of prohibition is by aspect, either &, U, V, X.
rules.translation: 禁制（prohibition）：两示义星趋相之前第三方以合相或相位插入阻隔，事被阻延。合相禁制（bodily）最重——被日灼为最大之凶；相位禁制同理按 &/U/V/X 判。
rules.notes: 校注：Sahl 不认相位禁制可止合相（合相强于相位）；Schoener/Bonatti 仅认插入方在容许度内更近时

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Refranation: L in the 12th degree of a, F in the 7th degree, here F hastens to a conjunction of L, but before he comes to the tenth or eleventh degree of a he becomes retrograde, and by that means refrains to come to a conjunction of L; nothing signified by the former conjunction will ever be effected.
rules.translation: 退缩（refranation）：快星趋合途中先逆行，事永不成。
rules.notes: 引擎运动模块状态机

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Translation of light and nature is, when a light planet separates from a more weighty one, and presently joins to another more heavy; and it's in this manner: Let L be in the 20th degree of a; F in the 15th of a, and B in the 16th of a; here B, being a swift planet, separates from F, and translates the virtue of F unto L. It's done also as well by any aspect as by conjunction.
rules.translation: 传递（translation）：轻星离一重星、随即合另一重星，传递前者之性于后者（合相或任何相位皆可）。婚姻、诉讼及一切俗问大用。
rules.notes: 引擎运动模块状态机

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Reception is when two planets that are significators in any question or matter are in each other's dignity; as 0 in a, and F in e; here is reception by houses; and certainly this is the strongest and best of all receptions. It may be by triplicity, term or face, or any essential dignity. The use of this is much; for many times when the effecting of the matter is denied by the aspects, or when the significators have no aspect to each other, or when it seems very doubtful what is promised by U or X of the significators, yet if mutual reception happen between the principal significators, the thing is brought to pass, and that without any great trouble, and suddenly to the content of both parties.
rules.translation: 互容（reception）：两示义星各在对方尊贵之内（庙=最强，三分/界/面亦可）。即使相位否定、或无相位、或四分对冲可疑，若主示义星互容，事仍可成、无阻而速。
rules.notes: 引擎：dignity lookup 双向；校注：历史主流谓无相位之互容价值有限，需庙/擢等强尊贵或两项弱尊贵

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A planet is then said to be peregrine, when he is in the degrees of any sign where he hath no essential dignity: As L in the tenth degree of a, that sign being not his house, exaltation, or of his triplicity, or he having in that degree neither term or faces, he is then said to be peregrine. This is very much material in all Questions, especially in questions of theft; for ever almost the significator of the thief is known by the peregrine planet posited in an angle, or the second house.
rules.translation: 游离（peregrine）：居处无任何尊贵（非庙擢三分界面）。盗贼示义恒为角宫或二宫之游离星。
rules.notes: 引擎：尊贵总分=0 → peregrine；盗窃问事判则

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A planet is void of course, when he is separated from a planet, nor doth forthwith, during his being in that sign, apply to any other. This is most usually in the 5; in judgements do you carefully observe whether she be void of course yea or no; you shall seldom see a business go handsomely forward when she is so.
rules.translation: 空虚（void of course）：星分离后在本座余程内不入任何相位。多应于月——月空虚则事难顺利前行。
rules.notes: 引擎：月运动状态机；Schoener 定义：按容许度与光线判

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Frustration is, when a swift planet would corporally join with a more ponderous, but before they can come to a conjunction, the more weighty planet is joined to another, and so the R of the first is frustrated; as B in ten degrees of a, F twelve, K in thirteen of a; here B strives to come to R with F, but F first gets to R with K; in questions it signifies as much as our common proverb, two dogs quarrel a third gets the bone.
rules.translation: 挫败（frustration）：轻星欲合重星，重星先与第三方合相，轻星之合被挫——两狗相争第三得骨。

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Hayz is when a masculine and diurnal planet is in the day time above the earth, and in a masculine sign, and so when a feminine, nocturnal planet in the night is in a feminine sign and under the earth. In questions it usually shows the content of the querent at time of the question, when his significator is so found.
rules.translation: 适位（hayz）：阳昼星白昼在地平上居阳座；阴夜星夜间在地平下居阴座。示义星得适位=问者安泰。
rules.notes: 引擎：sect+hemisphere+sign gender 与运算

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Saturn, Jupiter and Mars, being placed above the orb of the Sun, are called the superior, ponderous and more weighty planets; Venus, Mercury and Luna are called the inferior planets, being under the orb of the Sun.
rules.translation: 上行星：土、木、火（日轨道外、重而缓）；下行星：金、水、月（日轨道内、轻而速）。
rules.notes: 引擎运动参数基础

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A planet is said to be combust of the 0, when in the same sign where the 0 is in, he is not distant from the 0 eight degrees and thirty minutes, either before or after the 0. And you must observe a planet is more afflicted when the 0 hastens to conjunction of him, than when the 0 recedes from him. I allow the moiety of his own orbs to show the time of combustion, and not of K; I know many are against this opinion. The significator of the querent combust, shows him or her in great fear, and overpowered by some great person.
rules.translation: 燃烧（combust）：行星与日同座相距 ≤8°30′（前后皆算）。日趋合其星时比日离去时更凶。Lilly 以日半容许为限（多数作者用 7°30′ 或按各星自身半容许）。示义星被灼=问者深惧、为强权所压。
rules.notes: 引擎：与日黄经差；校注：AlBiruni 谓灼至 6°、此后称日芒下；Schoener/Ganivetus 按各星自身半容许（土木9/火8/金水7/月12）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A planet is said to be still under the Sun-beams, until he is fully elongated or distant from his body 17 degrees either before or after him.
rules.translation: 日芒下（under beams）：距日 ≤17°（Lilly 值；多数作者 15°）。
rules.notes: 引擎：17°>距日>8.5°=日芒下；AlBiruni 体系：灼至6°、6-15°日芒下

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: A planet is in the heart of the 0 or in cazimi, when he is not removed from him 17 minutes, or is within 17 minutes forward or backward; and all authors do hold a planet in cazimi to be fortified thereby. All planets may be in combustion of the 0, but he with none, and that combustion can only be by personal conjunction in one sign, not by any aspect; his U or X aspects are afflicting, but do not combure.
rules.translation: 日心（cazimi）：距日 ≤17′ 之内（Lilly 另处作 16′），大吉、星得增强。燃烧仅能因同座合相，相位（含四分对冲）只克不灼。
rules.notes: 引擎：三层状态机 cazimi/combust/under beams；IbnEzra：日直径约31′，距心<16′ 为日心

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: L, K and F, are oriental of the 0, from the time of their conjunction with him, until they come to his X: from whence until again they come to R, they are said to be occidental. To be oriental is to rise before the 0: to be occidental is to be seen above the horizon, or to set after the 0 is down. B and C can make no &, U, V or X to the 0: their orientality is when they are in fewer degrees of the sign the 0 is, or in the sign preceding; their occidentality, when they are in more degrees of the sign the 0 is in, or in the next subsequent: for you must know B cannot be more degrees removed from the 0 than 28, nor C more than 48. The 5 is oriental of the 0 from the time of her X to the conjunction, and occidental from the time of her conjunction to opposition.
rules.translation: 东西出（oriental/occidental）：外行星（土木火）自合日至对冲=东出（日先升）、自对冲至合=西入（日后没）。内行星（金水）不出相位：较日少度数或在前座=东出、较多度数或在后座=西入（水星距日不逾 28°、金星不逾 48°）。月相反：自对冲至合=东出、自合至对=西入。
rules.notes: 引擎：按黄经差区间；内行星东西出另法（正教书中详）

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Besieging is, when any planet is placed betwixt the bodies of the two malevolent planets L and F: as L in 15 a, F in 10 of a, C in 13 a: here C is besieged by the two infortunes, and it represents in questions, a man going out of God's blessing into the warm 0.
rules.translation: 围攻（besieging）：行星夹于土、火两凶星体之间，主问者处境困窘（出福入难）。
rules.notes: 引擎：黄经排序检查

rules.book: Christian Astrology Volume I（相位与行星状态卷，Houlding 注释版连载之 partVI）
rules.author: William Lilly（1647 原文，公有领域）；注释 D. Houlding ©2013
rules.original_text: Direction is when a planet moves forward in the sign, as going out of the 13th degree into the 14th and so along. Retrograde is when a planet goes backward, as out of the 10th degree into 9, 8, 7, &c. Stationary is when he moves not at all, as the superiors do not 2, 3, or 4 days before retrogradation.
rules.translation: 顺行（direction）：黄经递增；逆行（retrograde）：黄经递减；留（stationary）：不动——上行星逆行前 2-4 日留。
rules.notes: 引擎运动状态机基础

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He is a diurnal planet, cold and dry (being far removed from the heat of the Sun and moist vapours); melancholic, earthly, masculine, the Greater Infortune, author of solitariness, malevolent.
rules.translation: 土星：昼行星，冷而干；忧郁质、土性、阳性、大凶星（Greater Infortune），主孤寂、恶毒。
rules.notes: 要素表：earthly/cold&dry/melancholic

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well dignified: profound in imagination, in his acts severe, in words reserved, in speaking and giving very spare, in labour patient, in arguing or disputing grave, in obtaining the goods of this life studious and solicitous, in all manner of actions austere.
rules.translation: 土星得时：想象深沉、行事严峻、言语保留、寡言少予、劳作有耐心、论辩庄重、谋财勤勉、诸行俭朴。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill: envious, covetous, jealous and mistrustful, timorous, sordid, outwardly dissembling, sluggish, suspicious, stubborn, a condemner of women, a close liar, malicious, murmuring, never contented, ever repining.
rules.translation: 土星失时：嫉妒、贪婪、多疑、怯懦、卑琐、外饰、迟钝、固执、贬斥女性、隐秘撒谎、怨怼不止。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His body more cold and dry, of a middle stature; complexion pale, swartish or muddy, his eyes little and black, looking downward; a broad forehead, black or sad hair, and it hard or rugged; great ears, hanging; lowering eye-brows, thick lips and nose, a rare or thin beard; a lumpish, unpleasant countenance, either holding his head forward or stooping; his shoulders broad and large; his belly somewhat short and lank. If Saturn be oriental of the Sun, the stature is more short, but decent and well composed. Occidental: the man is more black and lean, and fewer hairs.
rules.translation: 土星体型：中身材、冷干；面色苍白/灰黑/污浊，小眼黑而俯视，宽额、黑粗发、垂大耳、浓眉厚唇鼻、须疏；容貌笨拙，头前倾或驼背，宽肩，腹短瘪。日东出（oriental）：身更矮但匀称；日西没（occidental）：更黑更瘦毛更少。
rules.notes: oriental/occidental=相对太阳的相位（非宫位）

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: In general he signifies husbandmen, clowns, beggars, day-labourers, old-men, fathers, grand-fathers, monks, Jesuits, sectarists. Profession: curriers, night-farmers, miners under ground, tinners, potters, broom-men, plumbers, brick-makers, malsters, chimney-sweepers, sextons of churches, bearers of dead corpses, scavengers, hostlers, colliers, carters, gardeners, ditchers, chandlers, dyers of black cloth, an herdsman, shepherd or cow-keeper.
rules.translation: 土星司人群：农夫、乡愚、乞丐、日工、老人、父亲、祖父、修士、耶稣会士、宗派徒。司职业：制革匠、掏粪者、地下矿工、锡匠、陶工、扫帚匠、铅管工、砖匠、麦芽工、扫烟囱者、教堂司事、抬尸者、清道夫、马夫、煤夫、车夫、园丁、沟渠工、烛匠、染黑布匠、牧人。
rules.notes: 解读引擎职业模块

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: All impediments in the right ear, teeth, all quartan agues proceeding of cold, dry and melancholy distempers, leprosies, rheums, consumptions, black jaundice, palsies, tremblings, vain fears, fantasies, dropsy, the hand and foot-gout, apoplexies, dog-hunger, too much flux of the haemorrhoids. Ruptures if in Scorpio or Leo, in any ill aspect with Venus.
rules.translation: 土星疾病：右耳、牙齿诸疾，冷干忧郁之四日疟，麻风、风湿、痨病、黑黄疸、瘫痪、震颤、虚惊、幻想、水肿、手足痛风、中风、贪食、痔漏。若在蝎/狮被金恶相=疝气。
rules.notes: 体液医学映射

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His orb is 9° before and after; that is, his influence begins to work when either he applies, or any planet applies to him, and is within nine degrees of his aspect.
rules.translation: 土星容许度（orb）：前后各 9°。
rules.notes: 引擎 orb 表：土9 木9 火7 日15 金7 水7 月12

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: The greatest years he signifies - 465. His greater - 57. His mean years - 43 and a half. His least - 30. In generation he rules the first and eighth month after conception.
rules.translation: 土星年数：最大 465 / 大 57 / 中 43.5 / 小 30。孕中司第一、八月。
rules.notes: 年数表；465 系 Al-Qabisi 传误（应为 265，见校注）；寿限引擎

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: In the zodiac he has two of the twelve signs for his houses. He is placed betwixt Jupiter and the Moon. His friends are Jupiter, the Sun and Mercury; his enemies Mars and Venus. We call Saturday his day, for then he begins to rule at Sun rise, and ruleth the first hour and eighth of that day.
rules.translation: 土星庙宫二：摩羯（夜）与水瓶（昼）；友=木星、太阳、水星；敌=火星、金星；司星期六（日升后第一、八时）。
rules.notes: 擢升天秤/陷白羊落狮（CA p.83 前段，本分册缺页未直读）；天使 Cassiel

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He is a diurnal, masculine planet, temperately hot and moist, airy, sanguine, the Greater Fortune, author of temperance, modesty, sobriety, justice.
rules.translation: 木星：昼行阳性、温而湿、风性、多血质、大吉星（Greater Fortune），主节制、谦逊、清醒、公正。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well placed: magnanimous, faithful, bashful, aspiring in an honourable way at high matters, in all his actions a lover of fair dealing, desiring to benefit all men, doing glorious things, honourable and religious, of sweet and affable conversation, wonderfully indulgent to his wife and children, reverencing aged men, a great reliever of the poor, full of charity and godliness, liberal, hating all sordid actions, just, wise, prudent, thankful, virtuous.
rules.translation: 木星得位：宽宏、忠实、谦逊、好高志、爱公平、愿益人、行光荣事、虔敬、言辞和蔼、善待妻儿老人、济贫、慈善、慷慨、厌恶卑琐、公正智慧感恩。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When unfortunate: wastes his patrimony, suffers every one to cozen him, is hypocritically religious, tenacious and stiff in maintaining false tenets in religion; ignorant, careless, nothing delightful in the love of his friends; of a gross, dull capacity, schismatical, abasing himself in all companies, crouching and stooping where no necessity is.
rules.translation: 木星失势：败祖产、易受欺、伪善宗教、固执谬说、无知疏忽、不念友谊、资质粗钝、好分裂、处处自卑屈膝。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He signifies an upright, straight and tall stature; brown, ruddy and lovely complexion; of an oval or long visage and it full or fleshy; high forehead; large grey eyes; his hair soft, and a kind of auburn brown; much beard; a large, deep belly; strong proportioned thighs and legs; his feet long. Oriental: the skin more clear, his complexion honey-colour... great eyes, the body more fleshy, usually some mole or scar in the right foot. Occidental: a pure and lovely complexion, the stature more short, the hair a light brown... smooth, bald about the temple or forehead.
rules.translation: 木星体型：直挺高身材，棕红可爱面色，长圆丰满脸，高额，大灰眼，软棕发，须多，腹大深，腿股匀称，脚长。东出：肤更明净蜜色、体更丰满、右足常有痣或疤。西没：肤纯美、身较矮、发淡褐、额鬓秃。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He signifies judges, senators, councillors, ecclesiastical men, bishops, priests, ministers, cardinals, chancellors, doctors of the civil law, young scholars and students in a university or college, lawyers, clothiers, woollen-drapers.
rules.translation: 木星司人群职业：法官、元老、议员、教士、主教、祭司、红衣主教、大臣、民法博士、学者学生、律师、布商呢绒商。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Pleurisy, all infirmities in the liver, left ear, apoplexies, inflammation of the lungs, palpitations and trembling of the heart, cramps, pain in the back-bone, all diseases lying in the veins or ribs, and proceeding from corruption of blood, squinzies, windiness, all putrefaction in the blood, or fevers proceeding from too great abundance thereof.
rules.translation: 木星疾病：胸膜炎、肝疾、左耳、中风、肺炎、心悸、痉挛、脊椎痛、血败之脉肋诸疾、咽喉肿、风气、血腐、血多之热。
rules.notes: 肝=木星之座（要素表）

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His radiation or orb is nine degrees before and after any of his aspect. His greatest years are 428, his greater 79, his mean 45, least 12.
rules.translation: 木星容许度 9°；年数：最大 428 / 大 79 / 中 45 / 小 12。
rules.notes: 校注：最大应为 427、中 45.5

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He has two of the twelve signs of the zodiac for his houses, viz. i his day-house, and l his night-house. He receives detriment in c and f. He is exalted in d, has his fall in j. He rules the fiery triplicity by night, viz, a, e i.
rules.translation: 木星庙：射手（昼）、双鱼（夜）；陷：双子/处女；擢升：巨蟹；落：摩羯；三分：火相之夜主（白羊/狮/射）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: All planets except Mars are friends to Jupiter. Angel: Zadkiel. Thursday, and rules the 1st hour after sun rise, and the 8th. Countries: Babylon, Persia, Hungary, Spain, Cologne. The number of three is attributed to him.
rules.translation: 木星友=除火星外诸星；天使 Zadkiel；司星期四（首、八时）；国家：巴比伦/波斯/匈牙利/西班牙/科隆；数三。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He is a masculine, nocturnal planet, in nature hot and dry, choleric and fiery; the Lesser Infortune, author of quarrels, strifes, contentions.
rules.translation: 火星：阳性夜行星、热而干、胆质火性、小凶星（Lesser Infortune），主争吵、斗争、冲突。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well dignified: In feats of war and courage invincible, scorning any should exceed him, subject to no reason; bold, confident, immovable, contentious; challenging all honour to themselves; valiant, lovers of war and things pertaining thereto, hazarding himself to all perils, willingly will obey nobody or submit to any; a large reporter of his own acts.
rules.translation: 火星得时：战功无敌、蔑视胜过己者、不受理制；勇毅果断、好争胜、自揽荣誉、尚武冒险、不肯服人、自夸功业。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill placed: prattler without modesty or honesty, a lover of slaughter and quarrels, murder, thievery, a promoter of sedition, frays and commotions; an highway-thief, as wavering as the wind, a traitor, of turbulent spirit, perjured, obscene, rash, inhumane; neither fearing God or caring for man; unthankful, treacherous, oppressors, ravenous, cheaters, furious, violent.
rules.translation: 火星失位：无耻饶舌、好杀斗、行窃、倡乱、劫道、风般无定、叛逆、暴烈、伪誓、淫秽、鲁莽、残忍、不敬神不恤人、忘恩、暴虐、贪婪、欺诈、狂暴。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Generally martialists have this form: middle stature; bodies strong and bones big, rather lean than fat; complexion brown, ruddy colour, or of an high colour; visage round, hair red or sandy flaxen, many times crisping or curling; sharp hazel eyes, piercing; a bold confident countenance, active and fearless. Oriental: valiant men, some white mixed with the redness, a decent tallness of body; hairy of his body. Occidental: very ruddy complexioned, mean in stature; little head, smooth body not hairy; yellow hair stiff.
rules.translation: 火星体型：中身材，骨大体强偏瘦；面色棕红，圆脸，红/沙色卷发，锐利榛色眼，貌勇无畏。东出：勇者、红中带白、身颀、体毛多。西没：面色甚红、身材矮、小头、体滑少毛、黄硬发。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Princes ruling by tyranny and oppression, or tyrants, usurpers, new conquerors. Generals of armies, colonels, captains, or any soldiers having command in armies, all manner of soldiers, physicians, apothecaries, chirurgeons, alchemists, gunners, butchers, marshals, sergeants, bailiffs, hangmen, thieves, smiths, bakers, armourers, watch-makers, botchers, tailors, cutlers of swords and knives, barbers, dyers, cooks, carpenters, gamesters, bear-wards, tanners, curriers.
rules.translation: 火星司人群职业：暴君、篡位者、新征服者、将军、上校、军官、士兵、医生、药剂师、外科医、炼金士、炮手、屠户、元帅、军士、法警、刽子手、盗贼、铁匠、面包师、军械匠、钟表匠、补匠、裁缝、刀剑匠、理发师、染匠、厨师、木匠、赌徒、驯熊者、鞣革匠。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: The gall, the left ear, tertian fevers, pestilent burning fevers, migraines in the head, carbuncles, the plague and all plague-sores, burnings, ringworm, blisters, frenzies, mad sudden distempers in the head, yellow-jaundice, bloody-flux, fistulas, all wounds and diseases in men's genitals, the stone both in the reins and bladder; scars or small pox in the face, all hurts by iron, the shingles.
