rules.translation: 火星疾病：胆、左耳、三日疟、瘟疫热、偏头痛、痈、疫疮、灼伤、癣、水疱、狂乱、黄疽、血痢、瘘、生殖器伤疾、肾与膀胱结石、面部疮疤、铁器之伤、带状疱疹。
rules.notes: 胆=火星之座

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His orb is only seven degrees before and after any of his aspects. His greatest years are 264, greater 66, mean 40, lesser 15. In man he governs the flourishing time of youth, and from 41 to 56.
rules.translation: 火星容许度 7°；年数：最大 264 / 大 66 / 中 40 / 小 15；司人生 41-56 岁（第五纪）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He has a for his day-house, and h for his night-house. He is exalted in 28 deg. of j, and is depressed in 28 d. He receives detriment in g and b. He governs wholly the watery triplicity, viz, d, h, l.
rules.translation: 火星庙：白羊（昼）、天蝎（夜）；擢升：摩羯 28°；落：巨蟹 28°；陷：天秤/金牛；三分：水相三座全主（蟹/蝎/鱼）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His friends are only Venus; enemies: all the other planets. He governs Tuesday, and therein the first hour and eighth from sunrise, and in conception the third month. Angel: Samael. Countries: Sarmatia, Lombardy, Batavia, Ferrara, Gotland, and the third Climate.
rules.translation: 火星友=仅金星；敌=其余诸星；司星期二（首、八时）；孕中第三月；天使 Samael；国家：萨尔马提亚、伦巴第、荷兰、费拉拉、哥特兰。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He is naturally hot, dry, but more temperate than Mars; is a masculine, diurnal planet, equivalent if well dignified to a fortune.
rules.translation: 太阳：热而干（较火温和）、阳性昼行星；得位时等同于吉星。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well dignified: very faithful, keeping their promises with all punctuality; a kind of itching desire to rule and sway where he comes; prudent, and of incomparable judgement; of great majesty and stateliness, industrious to acquire honour and a large patrimony; full of thought, secret, trusty, speaks deliberately; affable, tractable and very humane to all people; one loving sumptuousness and magnificence.
rules.translation: 太阳得位：极守信、好掌权、明智断、威严庄重、勤求荣誉与家业；深思缜密、言语从容；和蔼可亲、仁厚；爱奢华堂皇。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill dignified: arrogant and proud, disdaining all men, cracking of his pedigree, purblind in sight and judgement, restless, troublesome, domineering; a mere vapour; expensive, foolish, endued with no gravity in words or soberness in actions, a spendthrift, wasting his patrimony, and hanging on other men's charity; yet thinks all men are bound to him, because a gentleman born.
rules.translation: 太阳失势：傲慢自大、蔑视众人、夸耀门第、目光判断俱盲、躁动专横、虚浮、挥霍愚蠢、无庄重、败家产、赖人施舍，却以出身自矜。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Usually the Sun presents a man of a good, large and strong corporature; a yellow, saffron complexion; a round, large forehead; goggle-eyes or large, sharp and piercing; a body strong and well composed; their hair yellowish and therefore quickly bald, much hair on their beard, and usually a high ruddy complexion, their bodies fleshy. In [regard to] the Sun, we can only say he is oriental in the figure, or in the oriental quarter of the figure, or occidental.
rules.translation: 太阳体型：高大健壮，面色黄藏红花色，圆阔额，大而锐目，体强匀称，发黄易秃，须多，面常赤红，体丰满。太阳不论东西出，只论在盘中东方位/西方位（图内）。
rules.notes: 太阳无晨昏东西出概念

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He signifies kings, princes, emperors, dukes, marquises, earls, barons, lieutenants, deputy-lieutenants of counties, magistrates, gentlemen in general, courtiers, desirers of honour and preferment; justices of peace, majors, high-sheriffs, high-constables, great huntsmen, stewards of noblemen's houses, the principal magistrate of any city; goldsmiths, braziers, pewterers, coppersmiths, minters of money.
rules.translation: 太阳司人群职业：国王、王子、皇帝、公爵、侯爵、伯爵、男爵、郡尉、治安官、绅士、廷臣、求荣者、太平绅士、市长、郡长、总管、大猎手、贵家总管、城邑首长、金匠、黄铜匠、锡匠、铜匠、铸币匠。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Pimples in the face, palpitation or trembling, or any diseases of the brain or heart, tympanies, infirmities of the eyes, cramps, sudden swoonings, diseases of the mouth and stinking breaths, catarrhs, rotten fevers; principally in man he governs the heart, the brain and right eye, and vital spirit, in women the left eye.
rules.translation: 太阳疾病：面疱、心悸、脑/心病、鼓胀、目疾、痉挛、昏厥、口疾口臭、卡他、腐败热；主男之心、脑、右眼与生命精，女之左眼。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His orb is 15 degrees before any aspect; and so many after separation. In age he rules youth, or when one is at the strongest; his greatest years are 1460, greater 120, mean 69, least 19.
rules.translation: 太阳容许度 15°；年数：最大 1460 / 大 120 / 中 69 / 小 19；司青春盛年。
rules.notes: 1460=四年日数（苏提克年基）

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He has only the sign of e for his house, and k for his detriment. He is exalted in the first decanate of Aries. He has no degrees of the twelve signs admitted him for his terms, though some affirm. He governs the fiery triplicity, viz., a, e, i by day.
rules.translation: 太阳庙：狮子；陷：水瓶；擢升：白羊（初旬/19°）；无界（terms）；三分：火相昼主（白羊/狮/射）。
rules.notes: 落天秤；太阳日行近 1°/日，无逆行

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He rules Sunday, the first hour thereof and the eighth; and in numbers the first and fourth; and in conceptions the fourth month. His friends are all the planets except Saturn, who is his enemy. Angel: Michael. Countries: Italy, Sicily, Bohemia; and the fourth climate, Phoenicia, Chaldea.
rules.translation: 太阳司星期日（首、八时）；数一与四；孕中第四月；友=除土星外诸星；天使 Michael；国家：意大利、西西里、波西米亚、腓尼基、迦勒底。
rules.notes: 风向东；金=其金属

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She is a feminine planet, temperately cold and moist, nocturnal, the lesser fortune, author of mirth and jollity; [of] the elements, the air and water are venereal; in the humours, phlegm with blood, with the spirit and genital seed.
rules.translation: 金星：阴性、温和而湿、夜行星、小吉星（Lesser Fortune），主欢笑喜乐；气与水属之；体液=痰与血；主精气与生殖之精。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well placed: a quiet man, not given to law, quarrel or wrangling, not vitious, pleasant, neat and spruce, loving mirth in his words and actions, cleanly in apparel; rather drinking much than gluttonous; prone to venery, oft entangled in love-matters, zealous in their affections, musical, delighting in baths and all honest merry-meetings, or masks and stage-plays; easy of belief, and not given to labour; a company-keeper, cheerful, nothing mistrustful, a right virtuous man or woman.
rules.translation: 金星得位：安静不好争讼、品行端、愉悦整洁、言行喜乐、衣饰干净、好饮不甚贪食、好色多情、情专、好乐、喜沐浴欢会戏舞；易信、不劳苦、爱群、愉快少疑、贞淑之人。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill: riotous, expensive, wholly given to looseness and lewd companies of women, nothing regarding his reputation, coveting unlawful beds, incestuous, an adulterer; fantastical, a mere skip-jack, of no faith, no repute, no credit; spending his means in ale-houses, taverns, and amongst scandalous, loose people; a mean lazy companion, nothing careful of the things of this life or anything religious; a mere atheist and natural man.
rules.translation: 金星失位：放荡挥霍、纵欲淫秽、不顾名誉、贪非法之床、乱伦通奸；妄诞轻浮、无信无誉无信义、耗资于酒馆娼寮；懒惰卑劣、不务生计不敬神、纯自然主义之徒。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: A man of fair, but not tall stature, his complexion being white, tending to a little darkness, which makes him more lovely. Very fair lovely eyes, and a little black; a round face and not large, fair hair, smooth, and plenty of it, and it usually of a light brown colour; a lovely mouth and cherry lips, the face pretty fleshy, a rolling wandering eye, a body very delightful, lovely and exceedingly well shaped, one desirous of trimming and making himself neat, a love dimple in his cheeks, a steadfast eye, and full of amorous enticements. Oriental: the body inclines to tallness. Occidental: the man is of more short stature, yet very decent and comely.
rules.translation: 金星体型：俊美而不高，面色白中微暗更显可爱；眼美微黑，圆小脸，柔滑浅棕秀发，可爱口唇樱桃，脸微丰，眸流盼，体态极佳，爱修饰，颊有笑靥，目含媚情。东出：身偏颀长。西没：更矮而端正清秀。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Musicians, gamesters, silk-men, mercers, linen-drapers, painters, jewellers, players, lapidaries, embroiderers, women-tailors, wives, mothers, virgins, choristers, fiddlers, pipers; when joined with the Moon: singers, perfumers, semsters, picture-drawers, gravers, upholsterers, limners, glovers, all such as sell those commodities which adorn women either in body (as clothes) or in face, (as complexion-waters).
rules.translation: 金星司人群职业：乐师、赌徒、绸缎商、织物商、麻布商、画家、珠宝商、演员、宝石匠、刺绣匠、女裁缝、妻、母、处女、唱诗者、提琴手、笛手；合金星（月）：歌手、香贩、缝纫、画像、刻工、家具商、细密画家、手套商、卖女饰者。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Diseases principally in the matrix and members of generation; in the reins, belly, back, navel and those parts; the gonorrhoea or running of the reins, French or Spanish pox; any disease arising by inordinate lust. Priapismes, impotency in generation, hernias, the diabetes or pissing disease.
rules.translation: 金星疾病：子宫与生殖器、腰、腹、背、脐诸疾；淋病、花柳病、淫欲之疾；阴茎异常勃起、不孕、疝、糖尿病。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Her orb is 7° before and after any aspect of hers. Her greatest years are 151, her greater 82, her mean 45, her least 8. In man she governs youth from 14 to 28.

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She has b and g for her houses, she is exalted in 27 l; she receives detriment in a and h, and has her fall in 27 f. She governs the earthly triplicity by day viz. b, f, j.
rules.translation: 金星庙：金牛（昼）、天秤（夜）；擢升：双鱼 27°；陷：白羊/天蝎；落：处女 27°；三分：土相昼主（金牛/处女/摩羯）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Her day of the week is Friday, of which she rules the first and eighth hour; and in conception the first month. Her friends are all the planets except Saturn. Her Angel is Anael. Countries: Arabia, Austria, Campagna, Vienna, Polonia the Greater, Turing, Parthia, Media, Cyprus, and the sixth climate.
rules.translation: 金星司星期五（首、八时）；孕中第一月；友=除土星外诸星；天使 Anael；国家：阿拉伯、奥地利、坎帕尼亚、维也纳、大波兰、图林根、帕提亚、米底、塞浦路斯。
rules.notes: 南风；铜为其金属

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: We may not call him either masculine or feminine, for he is either the one or other as joined to any planet; for if in conjunction with a masculine planet, he becomes masculine; if with a feminine, then feminine; but of his own nature he is cold and dry, and therefore melancholy; with the good he is good, with the evil planets ill.
rules.translation: 水星性别不定：合阳性星则阳、合阴性星则阴；本性质冷而干故属忧郁质；与吉星吉、与凶星凶（变色龙法则）。
rules.notes: 引擎关键：水星语义随合相星改变

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Being well dignified he represents a man of a subtle and political brain, intellect, and cogitation; an excellent disputant or logician, arguing with learning and discretion, and using much eloquence in his speech; a searcher into all kinds of mysteries and learning; sharp and witty, learning almost anything without a teacher; ambitious of being exquisite in every science, desirous naturally of travel and seeing foreign parts; a man of an unwearied fancy, curious in the search of any occult knowledge; able by his own genius to produce wonders; given to divination and the more secret knowledge; if he turn merchant, no man exceeds him in a way of trade.
rules.translation: 水星得位：头脑机敏精明、善辩精于逻辑、言辞雄辩；探求一切奥秘学问、聪慧过人不待师授；志于精通诸学、好游历；想象不竭、好奇玄学、能自天才创奇；好占卜秘知；为商则无敌于贸易。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill placed: a troublesome wit, a kind of phrenetic man, his tongue and pen against every man, wholly bent to spoil his estate and time in prating and trying nice conclusions to no purpose; a great liar, boaster, prattler, busybody, false, a tale-carrier, given to wicked arts, as necromancy; easy of belief, an ass or very idiot, constant in no place or opinion, cheating and thieving everywhere; a newsmonger, pretending all manner of knowledge, but guilty of no true or solid learning; a trifler; a mere frantic fellow.
rules.translation: 水星失位：烦扰之才、类狂人、口笔皆攻人、空谈耗财耗时；大谎、夸口、饶舌、好事、虚伪、传谣、好邪术如巫术；轻信如愚、居无定所见异思迁、到处欺诈偷盗；假充博学实无实学、轻浮狂乱。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He denotes one of an high stature and straight thin spare body, an high forehead and somewhat narrow long face, long nose; fair eyes, neither perfectly black or grey, thin lips and nose, little hair on the chin, but much on his head, and it a sad brown inclining to blackness; long arms, fingers and hands; his complexion like an olive or chestnut colour. You must more observe B than all the planets; for having any aspect to a planet, he does more usually partake of the influence of that planet than any other does: if with L then heavy, with K more temperate, with F more rash, with 0 more genteel, with C more jesting, with 5 more shiftier.
rules.translation: 水星体型：高瘦挺拔，高额窄长脸、长鼻；目清（不纯黑不纯灰）、唇鼻薄、下颔须少而头发生（深褐近黑）；臂指手皆长；面色橄榄/栗色。观水星重于诸星：其受任何行星影响皆强——合土沉重、合木温和、合火鲁莽、合日文雅、合金诙谐、合月善变。
rules.notes: 相合变容规则（解读引擎）

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He generally signifies all literary men, philosophers, mathematicians, astrologians, merchants, secretaries, scriveners, diviners, sculptors, poets, orators, advocates, schoolmasters, stationers, printers, exchangers of money, attorneys, emperors' embassadors, commissioners, clerks, artificers, generally accomptants, solicitors, sometimes thieves, prattling muddy ministers, busy sectaries, and they unlearned; grammarians, tailors, carriers, messengers, footmen, usurers.
rules.translation: 水星司人群职业：文人、哲人、数学家、占星家、商人、秘书、代书人、占卜者、雕刻家、诗人、演说家、律师、塾师、书商、印工、钱商、代理人、大使、专员、文员、工匠、会计、讼师、偶为盗贼、饶舌牧师、好事宗派徒、文法家、裁缝、搬运、信使、仆役、放贷者。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: All vertigos, lethargies or giddiness in the head; madness, either lightness, or any disease of the brain; phthisis, all stammering and imperfection in the tongue; vain and fond imaginations, all defects in the memory; hoarseness, dry coughs, too much abundance of spittle, all snaffling and snuffling in the head or nose; the hand and feet gout, dumbness, tongue-evil, all evils in the fancy and intellectual parts.
rules.translation: 水星疾病：眩晕、嗜睡、脑部诸疾、癫狂、痨病、口吃舌疾、虚妄想象、记忆缺陷、声嘶、干咳、多涎、鼻塞、手足痛风、哑、舌症、心智诸疾。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: His orb is seven degrees before and after any aspect. His greatest years are 450; his greater 76; his mean 48; his little or least 20: in conceptions he governs the sixth month.
rules.translation: 水星容许度 7°；年数：最大 450 / 大 76 / 中 48 / 小 20；孕中第六月。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He has c and f for his houses, and is exalted in the 15 of f; he receives detriment in i and l, his fall is in l. He rules the airy triplicity by night, viz. c g k.
rules.translation: 水星庙：双子（昼）、处女（夜）；擢升：处女 15°；陷：射手/双鱼；落：双鱼；三分：风相夜主（双/秤/瓶）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He governs Wednesday, the first hour thereof, and the eighth. His friends are Jupiter, Venus, Saturn; his enemies all the other planets. His Angel is named Raphael. Countries: Greece, Flanders, Egypt, Paris. He delights in windy, stormy and violent, boisterous weather, and stirs up that wind which the planet signifies to which he applies.
rules.translation: 水星司星期三（首、八时）；友=木、金、土；敌=其余诸星；天使 Raphael；国家：希腊、佛兰德斯、埃及、巴黎；好狂风暴雨天气，其风随所应之星。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: He is stationary one day, and retrograde 24 days. He is never distant from the Sun above 27 degrees.
rules.translation: 水星留一日、逆行 24 日；距日不离 27°（最大距角）。
rules.notes: 运动表：平均日行1°23'；留1日/逆24日

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She is a feminine, nocturnal planet, cold, moist and phlegmatic.
rules.translation: 月亮：阴性夜行星、冷、湿、痰质。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When well placed: one of composed manners; a soft, tender creature; a lover of all honest and ingenious sciences; a searcher of, and delighter in novelties, naturally propense to flit and shift his habitation; unsteadfast, wholly caring for the present times, timorous, prodigal, and easily frightened; however loving peace, and to live free from the cares of this life: if a mechanic, the man learns many occupations.
rules.translation: 月亮得位：举止温和、柔顺之人；爱一切诚实灵巧之学、好新奇、天然喜迁居；不安定、只重眼前、怯懦、浪费易惊；然爱和平、乐无牵累；若为匠则多学数业。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: When ill: a mere vagabond, idle person, hating labour; a drunkard, a sot, one of no spirit or forecast, delighting to live beggarly and carelessly, one content in no condition of life, either good or ill.
rules.translation: 月亮失位：流浪汉、懒人、憎劳作；酒鬼、愚钝、无精神远虑、喜乞讨苟活、无论贫富皆不安。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She generally presents a man of fair stature, whitely coloured, the face round, grey eyes, and a little louring; much hair both on the head, face, and other parts; usually one eye a little larger than the other; short hands and fleshy, the whole body inclining to be fleshy, plump, corpulent and phlegmatic: if she be impedited of the 0 in a nativity or question, she usually signifies some blemish in or near the eye; if she be impedited in succedent houses; in the sight if she be unfortunate in angles and with fixed stars, called nebulosae.
rules.translation: 月亮体型：俊美白皙，圆脸灰眼微蹙；发多，一眼略大于另一眼，手短而丰，体偏胖圆痰质。若被日克（impedited of the Sun）：目或其旁有瑕疵；被克于续宫：视力之伤；落于角宫与云雾恒星（nebulosae）同处：目疾。
rules.notes: Praesepe 鬼宿、Pleiades 昴宿为云雾恒星；目疾对应可编码

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She signifies queens, countesses, ladies, all manner of women; as also the common people, travellers, pilgrims, sailors, fishermen, fishmongers, brewers, tapsters, vintners, letter-carriers, coachmen, huntsmen, messengers, mariners, millers, alewives, malsters, drunkards, oisterwives, fisherwomen, charwomen, tripewomen, and generally such women as carry commodities in the streets; as also, midwives, nurses, hackneymen, watermen, waterbearers.
rules.translation: 月亮司人群职业：王后、伯爵夫人、贵妇、一切女性；平民、旅客、朝圣者、水手、渔人、鱼贩、酿酒者、酒保、酒商、信差、车夫、猎人、信使、海员、磨坊主、麦酒妇、麦芽工、醉汉、牡蛎妇、女渔、女佣、杂货妇、街头贩女、接生婆、乳母、马车夫、船夫、挑水夫。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Apoplexies, palsy, the colic, the bellyache, diseases in the left side, stones, the bladder and members of generation, the menstrues and liver in women, dropsies, fluxes of the belly, all cold rheumatic diseases, cold stomach, the gout in the wrists and feet, sciatica, colic, worms in children and men, rheums or hurts in the eyes, viz., in the left of men, and right of women: surfeits, rotten coughs, convulsion fits, the falling sickness, kings-evil, apostems, small pox and measles.
rules.translation: 月亮疾病：中风、瘫痪、绞痛、腹痛、左胁疾、结石、膀胱与生殖器疾、妇人月经与肝疾、水肿、泄泻、一切寒湿风疾、胃寒、手足痛风、坐骨神经痛、虫积、目疾（男左女右）、伤食、腐咳、抽搐、癫痫、瘰疬、脓肿、痘疹麻疹。
rules.notes: 男左女右目疾判据

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Her orb is 12 degrees before and after any aspect. Her greatest years are 320, greater 108, mean 66, least 25. In conceptions she rules the seventh month.
rules.translation: 月亮容许度 12°；年数：最大 320 / 大 108 / 中 66 / 小 25；孕中第七月。
rules.notes: 320 为 Lilly 值（Al-Qabisi 520 之争见校注）

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She has the sign d for her house, and j for her detriment; she is exalted in 3 b and has her fall in 3 h. She governs the earthly triplicity by night, viz. b, f, j. The Sun and she have no terms assigned them.
rules.translation: 月亮庙：巨蟹；陷：摩羯；擢升：金牛 3°；落：天蝎 3°；三分：土相夜主（金牛/处女/摩羯）；日与月皆无界（terms）。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Her day is Monday; the first hour and the eighth after the rise of the Sun are hers. Her enemy is L, and also F. Angel: Gabriel. Countries: Holland, Zealand, Denmark, Nuremberg, Flanders. Weather: with L cold air; with K serene; with F winds and red clouds; with the 0 according to the season; with C and B showers and winds.
rules.translation: 月亮司星期一（首、八时）；敌=土与火；天使 Gabriel；国家：荷兰、泽兰、丹麦、纽伦堡、佛兰德斯；天气随所合之星：合土=寒、合木=晴、合火=风与红云、合日=依季节、合金水=阵雨与风。
rules.notes: 天气判据可编码

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: The head of the dragon is masculine, of the nature of Jupiter and Venus, and of himself a fortune; yet the ancients do say, that being in conjunction with the good he is good, and in conjunction with the evil planets they account him evil. I ever found the P equivalent to either of the fortunes, and when joined with the evil planets to lessen their malevolent signification; when joined with the good to increase the good promised by them.
rules.translation: 月头（北交点 P）：阳性，具木金之性，本身为吉点；古人谓与吉合则吉、与凶合则凶。Lilly 自身实践：P 恒等于吉星，合凶星则减其凶、合吉星则增其吉。
rules.notes: Lilly 实践经验 vs 古人说（Albumasar/Qabisi 持相反意见）；引擎交点模块

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: The tail is feminine by nature, and clean contrary to the head; for he is evil when joined with good planets, and good when in conjunction with the malignant planets. For the Tail of the Dragon, I always in my practise found when he was joined with the evil planets; their malice or the evil intended thereby was doubled and trebled, or extremely augmented; and when he chanced to be in conjunction with any of the fortunes who were significators in the question, though the matter by the principal significator was fairly promised, yet did there ever fall out many rubs and disturbances.
rules.translation: 月尾（南交点 Q）：阴性，与月头相反——合吉星则恶、合凶星则善（古人说）。Lilly 实践：Q 合凶星使其恶加倍三倍极增；Q 合吉示义星则所许之事多生阻碍纷扰，终或不成。
rules.notes: Lilly 实践判据：Q 增凶减吉——与古人相反

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: L Signifies one of a swart colour, palish like lead, or of a black earthly brown; one of rough skin, thick and very hairy on the body, not great eyes; he is lean, crooked, or beetle-browed, a thin whay beard, great lips, like the black Moors; he looks to the ground, is slow in motion, either is bowlegged, or hits one leg or knee against another; most part a stinking breath, seldom free from a cough. Where he is peregrine or unfortunate: crafty for his own ends, seducing people to his opinion, full of revenge and malice, little caring for the church or religion; a foul nasty, slovenly knave, or a whore; a great eater, brawling fellow, big great shoulders, covetous, and yet seldom rich.
rules.translation: 土星速写：铅灰/黑土褐面色，肤粗体毛密，目不大；瘦驼、浓眉、须稀、唇厚；俯视地面、行动迟缓、罗圈腿或膝相击；口臭常咳。失势/游离时：自利狡诈、惑人从己、充满报复与恶意、不顾宗教；污秽邋遢之恶徒或娼妇；大食、好争吵、肩宽、贪婪而罕富。
rules.notes: Ch15 速写章

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: A Jovialist is one of a comely stature, full faced, full eyed, a sanguine complexion, or mixed with white and red, a large space betwixt his eyebrows, usually his beard of a flaxen or sandy-flaxen colour; sometimes also when Jupiter is combust very sad or black. His hair thick, his eyes not black, his teeth well set, good broad teeth, but usually some mark of difference in the two foreteeth. His hair gently curls (if he be in a fiery sign). A man well spoken, religious, or at least a good moral honest man; comely and somewhat fat (if Jupiter be in moist signs) fleshy; if in airy signs, big and strong; if in earthly signs, usually well descended.
rules.translation: 木星速写：端正身材、满月脸、眼圆、多血面色（白红相间）、眉距宽、须亚麻/沙金色（日灼时深黑）；发厚、眼不黑、齿好而阔、门齿常有异；居火相则发微卷。善言、虔敬或至少端正；居湿相则胖、风相则高大强壮、土相则出身良好。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: A martial man is many times full-faced with a lively high colour, like sun-burnt, or like raw tanned leather, a fierce countenance, his eyes being sparkling or sharp and darting, and of yellow colour; his hair both of head and beard being reddish (vary according to the sign: in fiery and airy signs, with fixed stars of his own nature, a deep sandy red; in watery signs, flaxenish or whitish bright hair; in earthly signs, sad brown or chestnut). He has a mark or scar in his face, broad-shouldered, a sturdy strong body, bold and proud, given to mock, scorn, quarrel, drink, game, and wench: if in the house of Venus he wenches, if in B he steals, but if he be in his own house he quarrels, in L's house is dogged; in the 0's is lordly; in the 5's is a drunkard.
rules.translation: 火星速写：满月脸、日晒/生皮之色、相貌凶、目闪锐而黄、发须赤（随宫：火风相深沙红、水相浅金白、土相暗褐栗）。面有疤痣、肩宽体壮、勇傲，好嘲弄、争吵、饮博渔色：居金之宫好色、居水宫行窃、居己宫好斗、居土宫顽固、居日宫傲、居月宫酗酒。
rules.notes: 行为修正可编码：宫主星决定恶行方向

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: The Sun does generally denote one of an obscure white colour mixed with red; a round face, and short chin, a fair stature, and one of a comely body; his colour sometimes betwixt yellow and black, but for the most part more sanguine than otherways: a bold man and resolute, his hair curling; he has a white and tender skin, one desirous of praise, fame and estimation amongst men; he has a clear voice and great head, his teeth somewhat distorted or obliquely set; of slow speech but of a composed judgement; using outwardly a great decorum in his actions, but privately he is lascivious and inclinable to many vices.
rules.translation: 太阳速写：白红相混之色、圆脸短颏、身材俊美；面色或黄黑相间、多血质；勇敢果决、卷发、肤白嫩、好名声与众人敬仰；声清头大、齿稍歪斜；语缓而判断沉着；外行端庄、私下淫逸多恶习。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: Who is signified by Venus, whether man or woman, has a goodly and fair round visage, a full eye, usually we say goggle-eyed, red ruddy lips, the nether more thick or bigger than the upper, the eye-lids black, however lovely and graceful; the hair of lovely colour (most part according to the sign) in some it's coal-black, in others a light brown; a soft smooth hair, and the body extremely well shaped, ever rather inclining to shortness than tallness.
rules.translation: 金星速写：俊美圆脸、满目（常称鼓目）、红唇下厚、黑睫、容色可爱；发色随宫（或乌黑或浅棕）、柔滑；身段极佳、宁矮不高。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: We describe B to be a man neither white or black but betwixt both, of a sad brown or dark yellowish colour, long visaged, high-forehead, black or grey eyes, a thin-long sharp nose, a thin spare beard (many times none at all) of an auburn sad colour next to black, slender of body, small legs, a prattling busy fellow, and in walking he goes nimbly, and always would be thought to be full of action.
rules.translation: 水星速写：不白不黑介乎其间、暗褐或暗黄色、长脸高额、黑或灰目、尖长鼻、须疏（常无）褐近黑；身瘦腿细、饶舌好动、行走敏捷、总欲显忙碌。

rules.book: William Lilly《Christian Astrology》(1647) Volume I: An Introduction to Astrology——行星/星座/相位释义总论（Houlding 注释版连载，Lilly 原文公有领域）
rules.original_text: She by reason of her swiftness varies her shape very often, but in the general she personates one having a round visage and full faced, in whose complexion you may perceive a mixture of white and red, but paleness overcomes; if she be in fiery signs, the man or woman speaks hastily; in watery signs, has some freckles in his or her face, or is blub cheeked; not a very handsome body, but a muddling creature; and unless very well dignified, she ever signifies an ordinary vulgar person.
rules.translation: 月亮速写：因其迅疾而形多变；一般为圆脸满颊、面色白红相混而苍白胜；居火相言语急促；居水相面有雀斑或颊肿；体不甚美、优柔之人；若非大得位则恒为凡俗之人。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: The Most High Lord made the Earth in the likeness of a sphere, and made a higher circle revolving around it... He established the four mutable elements and caused them to be moved through the motion of the seven planets. The Head of the Dragon, the signs and all the stars participate with the seven planets in their operations and natures. The operation of the planets in this world is therefore like that of a lodestone upon iron.
rules.translation: 第壹章·天球与星性：地如球居中，七行星之运动推动四元素；龙头、星座与诸星皆参与七行星之运作与性。行星在世之运作如磁石吸铁——地上一切受其运动影响。
rules.notes: 理论前提，非判断规则

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: The fortune or impediment, proper ordering or destruction, of everything upon the earth, both the elements and living creatures, arises from the motions and operations of the planets. The clearest indication of this is the diversity found among people in their conditions, fortunes and misfortunes. We see some intelligent people deprived of good things, while some foolish people enjoy them.
rules.translation: 地上万物（元素与众生）之吉凶顺逆源于行星之运动运作——人之境遇吉凶之差异即最明之证（智者失其好、愚者享其福）。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 行星兆象+地区气候基准
rules.result: 吉凶依地区气候之偏离而定
rules.original_text: Know that the planets operate differently according to the diversity of climates. In some climates certain planets are fortunate, while in another climate they may be malefic, according to different arrangements... the region of the Ethiopians is always hot, while the land of the Slavs is always cold. When the planets signify an excess of cold for the inhabitants of Ethiopia, their air becomes temperate. But when they signify the same for the Slavs, their air becomes corrupted and their habitation may perish.
rules.translation: 第贰章·星之地区差异：行星随气候地区而异其吉凶。埃塞俄比亚恒热、斯拉夫之地恒冷：行星兆埃之过冷则其气转温（利）；兆斯拉夫之过冷则其气败坏、居所或毁（害）。
rules.notes: 地区气候基准判断（编码：以当地常态为基线判偏离）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 年盘与蚀为星占最有价值之部分
rules.original_text: Know also that the science of the stars is extremely difficult. The most valuable part of it is the knowledge of universal and collective matters, such as annual revolutions and eclipses, together with an understanding of all their significations.
rules.translation: 星占之难；其最有价值者为普遍/集体之事——年盘、蚀及其一切征象。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 须先知星座与地区关联
rules.original_text: This cannot be achieved without knowing the natures of the signs, what each of them signifies, and the regions, provinces and other matters associated with them.
rules.translation: 须知星座之性与各星座所征，及其所关联之地区、行省等。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: There are twelve signs. In each sign there are 30 degrees, in each degree 60 minutes, and in each minute 60 seconds, continuing in this way down to the magnitude of a point, that is, indefinitely.
rules.translation: 第叁章·星座之性：十二星座，每座 30 度、每度 60 分、每分 60 秒，可无限细分至点。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 火风热阳性昼；土水冷阴性夜
rules.original_text: Three of them are fiery, namely Aries, Leo and Sagittarius; three are earthy: Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn; three are airy: Gemini, Libra and Aquarius; three are watery: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces. The fiery signs are hot, the watery signs cold, the earthy signs likewise cold, and the airy signs hot. Know that all the hot signs are masculine and the cold signs feminine. All the masculine signs are diurnal and the feminine signs nocturnal.
rules.translation: 四元素三分组：火=牡羊/狮/射（热）；土=金牛/处/摩羯（冷）；风=双子/秤/瓶（热）；水=巨蟹/蝎/鱼（冷）。热=阳=昼；冷=阴=夜。
rules.notes: 星座性表（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: There are also four movable signs, in which the seasons change: Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn. There are four fixed signs, in which the season is established: Taurus, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius. There are also four bicorporeal or common signs, in which two seasons are joined: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces.
rules.translation: 三类动势：启动（季节变）=牡羊/巨蟹/天秤/摩羯；固定（季节定）=金牛/狮/蝎/瓶；双体/共通（二季相合）=双子/处/射/鱼。
rules.notes: 星座动势表（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 日入牡羊首度立盘，主盘星吉/凶
rules.original_text: When you wish to know what will occur in the world concerning rain and winds, set the ascendant for the time when the Sun enters the first point of Aries, and place the seven planets for that same hour. Having erected the figure, consider which of them presides over it. If it is a benefic, the weather will be favourable; but if it is malefic or impedited, the condition of the world will be corrupted. Proceed in the same way for the quarters of the year and their months.
rules.translation: 第肆章·年盘：日入牡羊首度之刻立上升、安七行星——察何星主盘：吉星主则天气佳；凶星/受碍主则世运坏。四季与各月同法。
rules.notes: 年盘起盘法（春分盘）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 年盘诸星合于水/火/风/土象
rules.result: 多雨/酷热干旱/多风/霜雪
rules.original_text: Know that when several planets are conjoined in watery signs in the annual revolution, they signify an abundance of rain. In fiery signs they signify excessive heat and drought, or barrenness of the earth. In airy signs they signify an abundance of winds, and in earthy signs frost and snow.
rules.translation: 年盘诸星合于水象——示多雨；合于火象——酷热与干旱、或地荒；风象——多风；土象——霜雪。
rules.notes: 合相元素-天气映射（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 土火主盘且吉星不照=多战毁；火星主年盘4宫且在水星庙=多雨瘟疫
rules.original_text: Likewise, in the quarters of the year, when the planets are in cold places, they signify severe cold and a reduction of heat. Know also that when Mars and Saturn preside over the figure, and the benefics do not aspect them, they signify many wars and destruction in the world. Likewise, when Mars is lord of the fourth of the annual figure and is in one of Mercury's houses, he signifies an abundance of rain and pestilence.
rules.translation: 四季之中行星在冷位——示酷寒与热之减少。火星土星主盘且吉星不照——示世上多战与毁坏。火星主年盘第4宫且在水星之庙——示多雨与瘟疫。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: Know that severe drought, barrenness of the Earth or scarcity of grain does not occur except through a conjunction of planets in fiery signs.
rules.translation: 大旱、地荒或粮缺，唯由行星合于火象而来。试之必验。
rules.notes: 唯一成因规则

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: You should consider the eclipses of the year, both lunar and solar, and determine the ascendant at the middle of the eclipse, together with the planet that rules that ascendant and the figure. If that planet is malefic, it signifies obstruction and destruction; if it is benefic, it signifies favourable conditions.
rules.translation: 第伍章·月蚀：察一年之日月蚀——取蚀中时刻之上升及其主星（及全盘）：凶星主=障碍与毁坏；吉星主=顺利。
rules.notes: 蚀断法（取蚀中时刻）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 月蚀在冷星座/水象+季节
rules.original_text: Know that when a lunar eclipse occurs in cold signs, it signifies severe cold. In watery signs it signifies a superabundance of rain, provided the appropriate season has arrived, that is, if it is winter. If it is summer, it signifies temperate weather.
rules.translation: 月蚀在冷星座——酷寒；在水象——多雨（当季节已至，即冬）；在夏——温和天气。
rules.notes: 季节修正

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: Know also that when the benefics aspect the Moon and receive her, her significations will incline towards what is good and beneficial.
rules.translation: 吉星照月且接纳月——其征象向好而有利。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: When you wish to foresee variations in the weather across the different regions of the corruptible world, consider whether the signs occupied by the ponderous planets are hot or cold. If they are hot, they signify heat in summer and temperate air in winter. If they are in cold signs, they signify cold in winter and temperate conditions in summer.
rules.translation: 第陆章·天气之变：重行星（土木火+日）所在星座之冷热：热星座=夏热冬温；冷星座=冬冷夏温。
rules.notes: 重行星定义：土火木+日

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 冬大雨腐气/夏温和多露
rules.original_text: Likewise, when planets are conjoined in watery signs, they signify excessive rain and corruption of the air because of that rain in winter, but temperate air and an abundance of dew in summer.
rules.translation: 诸星合于水象——冬示大雨与空气之败坏，夏示温和之气与丰露。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 重行星受碍+在北/南星座（直照/远离地区）
rules.original_text: Know that when the ponderous planets are debilitated and directly over a particular region, they signify drought and barrenness of the earth. When they are distant away from it, they signify an abundance of rain. By proximity I mean when they are in northern signs, and by distance away when they are in southern signs.
rules.translation: 重行星受碍且直照某地区——示旱荒；远离之——多雨。近=在北星座，远=在南星座。
rules.notes: 北=近直照、南=远离（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 重行星皆东出/西没/上升
rules.result: 旱/冬雨夏温/冬佳夏大旱
rules.original_text: Know also that when all the ponderous planets are oriental, they signify drought. When they are occidental, they signify an abundance of rain in winter and temperate air in summer. Likewise, when rising, they signify favourable conditions of the air in winter and excessive drought in summer.
rules.translation: 重行星皆东出——旱；皆西没——冬多雨、夏温和；上升——冬天气佳、夏大旱。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: Know that a solar eclipse cannot occur without signifying some great event, according to the magnitude of the eclipse itself; that is, according to the extent to which the body of the Sun is obscured.
rules.translation: 第柒章·日蚀：日蚀必兆大事，其大视遮蔽之量。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 蚀中上升+照蚀位之星吉/凶
rules.result: 凶=恶/损/王死/国毁；吉=吉运
rules.original_text: To know what a solar eclipse signifies, establish the ascendant for the middle of the eclipse and consider the planets that aspect the joining of the eclipse. If they are malefic, they signify evil, damage, the death of kings, and the destruction of kingdoms. If they are benefic, they signify good fortune and favourable conditions.
rules.translation: 察日蚀：立蚀中上升，观照蚀位之星——凶星照=恶、损、王死、国毁；吉星照=吉运与顺境。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 王死分裂旱荒饥馑/多雨之损
rules.original_text: Know that when a solar eclipse occurs in Aries, it signifies the death of kings and divisions among them, drought or barrenness of the earth, and famine. The same applies in the other fiery signs. In watery signs it signifies an abundance of rain and damage arising from it.
rules.translation: 日蚀在牡羊——王死、王间分裂、地旱荒、饥馑；他火象同；水象——多雨及其损。
rules.notes: 蚀在星座之征（火=王/旱、水=雨损）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 吉照蚀减恶；凶照蚀增恶；日月为hyleg/alcochoden而蚀
rules.original_text: Understand also that when the benefics aspect the eclipse, they lessen the evil, but when the malefics aspect it, they increase the evil and diminish the good. Know also that when the Sun or Moon is the hyleg or alcochoden of someone and is eclipsed, it signifies great danger or severe illness for the person whose hyleg or alcochoden it is, unless the benefics aspect it.
rules.translation: 吉星照蚀减其恶，凶星照蚀增其恶减其吉。日月为某人之 hyleg 或 alcochoden 而蚀——其人危病，除非吉星照之。
rules.notes: hyleg/alcochoden 个人层面蚀断

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: A conjunction of the planets signifies the events of this world and its affairs. These are to be judged at the time of the conjunction of the superior and inferior planets. If the benefics prevail over the form of the conjunction, they signify good fortune and a beneficial outcome. If the malefics prevail, they signify evil and an evil outcome.
rules.translation: 第捌章·诸星合相：合相主世界之事。吉星胜于合相之形——吉运吉果；凶星胜——恶果。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 按星座之质毁多事（水=雨损…）
rules.original_text: Know also that when the planets are conjoined in one of the signs, they signify destruction affecting many matters according to the substance or nature of that sign. Thus, if the conjunction occurs in watery signs, it signifies damage from rain, and similarly in the other signs.
rules.translation: 诸星合于某星座——按该星座之质毁及多事；水象=雨损，余类推。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: If the planets are conjoined in feminine signs, they signify pestilence and death among female animals, and the same is to be understood of masculine signs.
rules.translation: 行星合于阴性星座——雌畜之瘟疫与死；阳性星座同理。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 合相/蚀在固定/启动/双体星座
rules.original_text: Know that conjunctions and eclipses of the luminaries, when they occur in fixed signs, signify that the evil and its damage will endure. If they occur in movable signs, they signify that the evil and its damage will be of short duration. If they occur in common signs, they signify a moderate evil. The same principle should be applied to good.
rules.translation: 光体之合相与蚀在固定星座——恶与其损持久；启动星座——短；双体——中。吉亦同此理。
rules.notes: 持久性规则（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 火木土合于同一界/面+日照
rules.result: 宗教/王国之最大事件（依最强星）
rules.original_text: Know that the greatest and most remarkable events arise from the conjunction of the superior planets, and this is because of the slowness of their motion. When those three are conjoined within one term or face, and the Sun aspects them, they signify the destruction and alteration of religious sects and kingdoms, and the greatest events, according to the power of whichever of them is strongest and prevails over their signs.
rules.translation: 第玖章·上行星之合相：上行星（火木土）合相主最大事件（因其行迟）。三者合于同一界/面且日照之——宗教与王国之毁变及最大事件，依其中最强主星断。
rules.notes: 界=terms、面=face（尊贵细分）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 最大合相（得上行星之助）+最强星吉/凶
rules.result: 预言/地区之毁/大事；吉吉凶凶
rules.original_text: This is their greatest conjunction, which signifies prophecy, the destruction of certain regions, and very great matters, especially if it is aided by one of the inferior planets. Know that whichever planet is stronger than the others will be the significator. If it is fortunate, it will signify good fortune; if it is malefic, it will signify evil and tribulation.
rules.translation: 此为其最大合相——示预言、某地区之毁与非常大事，尤得上行星之助时。其中强者为征象星：吉则吉运，凶则恶与忧。
rules.notes: 强者为征象星

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 上行星合于旺位/落陷位
rules.result: 吉+战乱奇事/损旱荒饥（受制除外）
rules.original_text: Understand also that when these planets are conjoined in their exaltations, they signify good, favourable conditions, numerous disturbances of war, and the appearance of wonders. If they are conjoined in their falls, they signify damage, drought, barrenness of the earth and famine, unless they are fortified.
rules.translation: 此等行星合于旺位——吉、顺境、多战乱与奇事之现；合于落陷位——损、旱、地荒与饥馑（受制者除外）。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 上行星合于火/水/风/土象、阳/阴星座
rules.result: 地荒/多雨/暴风/酷寒；雄/雌畜伤
rules.original_text: Know that when they are joined in a fiery sign, they likewise signify barrenness of the earth; in a watery sign, an abundance of rain; in an airy sign, violent winds; and in an earthy sign, excessive cold and damage. When they are conjoined in masculine signs, they signify injury to male animals, and similarly with feminine signs.
rules.translation: 合于火象——地荒；水象——多雨；风象——暴风；土象——酷寒与损。合于阳星座——雄畜之伤，阴星座亦然。
rules.notes: 与 ME-010/025 同映射

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: The conjunction of Saturn and Jupiter is the greatest conjunction, and it signifies events and religious sects. Knowledge of the events it signifies is obtained by examining the ascendant, the planets at the hour of their conjunction, and which of them dominates the figure. If that planet is fortunate, it signifies good and favourable conditions. If it is malefic, it signifies damage, drought, barrenness of the earth and wars.
rules.translation: 第拾章·大合相：土木合相为最大合相，主事件与宗教宗派。观合相时上升、诸星与主盘者之吉凶断之。
rules.notes: 大合相定义：土木

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: Know, therefore, that when Jupiter is stronger than Saturn, it signifies good in that conjunction. But if Saturn has precedence, it signifies damage and tribulation.
rules.translation: 木星强于土星——该合相示吉；土星居先——示损与忧。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 土木合于火风/土/水象（受碍/受制）
rules.result: 旱荒/毁谷饥/多雨瘟疫；受制则增吉减恶
rules.original_text: Know also that their conjunction in fiery and airy signs signifies drought and barrenness of the earth, as well as severe conditions; in earthy signs, the destruction of crops and famine. In watery signs it signifies an excess of rain and pestilence, provided that the planets are impedited. If, however, they are fortified, they signify an increase of good in all the matters they signify and a reduction of evil.
rules.translation: 土木合于火象风象——旱荒与酷烈之境；土象——毁谷与饥馑；水象——多雨与瘟疫（行星受碍时）；行星受制——其所征之事增吉减恶。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 大合相在角宫（尤天顶）+星座/主星吉凶
rules.result: 自该地区出王/先知；胜统或毁覆
rules.original_text: Know also that when the greater conjunction occurs in one of the angles, and especially at the angle of the midheaven, it signifies the appearance of a king or prophet from the region associated with that sign. If the sign itself is fortunate and its ruler is benefic, it signifies his triumph and dominion. But if the sign and its ruler are impedited, it signifies his destruction and overthrow. The conjunction will then be feared after the known number of years belonging to that conjunction.
rules.translation: 大合相在角宫（尤天顶）——自该星座所关联之地区出王或先知；星座吉而其主吉——其胜与其统御；星座与主受碍——其毁与覆。合相于其所知之年数后为可畏。
rules.notes: 应期=该合相所知之年数（土木合相周期）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: The mean conjunction is the conjunction of Mars and Saturn, and it signifies the events of battles and the adversities of wars. When you wish to know the nature of those events, consider the planet ruling the figure of their conjunction. If it is a benefic, it will signify a good outcome and settlement; but if it is a malefic, it signifies evil and obstruction.
rules.translation: 第拾壹章·中合相：中合相=火土合相，主战斗与战祸。察合相图之主星吉凶断之。
rules.notes: 中合相定义：火土

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 火土合于人形星座/年盘角宫
rules.result: 人众多病/权贵之争多战（持续至再合）
rules.original_text: Know also that their conjunction in human signs signifies a multitude of illnesses among men. Their conjunction in one of the angles of the annual figure signifies opposition among powerful men or kings, and a multitude of wars; and the matter will continue until they are joined together again.
rules.translation: 火土合于人形星座——人多病；合于年盘之角——权贵/王之争与多战；事持续至再合之时。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: Their conjunction in fiery signs signifies drought and sterility of the earth; in airy signs, winds; in watery signs, an abundance of rain; and in earthy signs, frost, snow and an abundance of cold.
rules.translation: 火土合于火象——旱荒；风象——风；水象——多雨；土象——霜雪与酷寒。
rules.notes: 同元素映射

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 吉照火土减恶/凶照增恶
rules.original_text: Know also that when the benefics aspect them, they lessen the evil, while the malefics increase it.
rules.translation: 吉星照火土——减其恶；凶星照——增之。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.original_text: The lesser conjunction is the conjunction of Jupiter and Mars, and it signifies events arising from rain and snow, corruption of the air and war. If a benefic prevails in their conjunction, it will signify good fortune; but if a malefic prevails, evil.
rules.translation: 第拾贰章·小合相：小合相=木火合相，主雨雪、腐气、战争。吉星胜则吉运，凶星胜则凶。
rules.notes: 小合相定义：木火

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.condition: 木火合于年盘上升/角宫
rules.result: 王之争与不和（吉照则免）
rules.original_text: Know that when Jupiter and Mars are joined on the ascendant of the annual figure, or on one of its angles, they signify disturbances and disagreements among kings, unless the benefics aspect them.
rules.translation: 木火合于年盘上升或一角——王之争与不和（吉星照则免）。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions》(Epistola de rebus eclipsium)
rules.result: 强者之性显/恶过度（主星吉则免）
rules.original_text: Know also that whenever a benefic is present with a malefic in this conjunction, the nature of the stronger of them will become apparent. When a malefic is joined with a malefic, the evil will become excessive, unless the planet presiding over the conjunction is a benefic.
rules.translation: 吉星伴凶星于该合相——强者之性显；凶伴凶——恶过度，除非主合相之星为吉星。
rules.notes: 合相吉凶组合原则

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 行星在彼之旺/庙+以相位或身体合之
rules.original_text: Know that reception comes to be from the exaltations and the domiciles, in the causing of matters, whether they are or not: this is, that some planet of the seven is in the exaltation of another planet, or in its domicile, and it is joined to it from the seven known aspects; or, were both in one sign, and some one of them is in the exaltation [or domicile] of its associate, joined to it.
rules.translation: 第一章·何谓接纳：接纳由旺位与庙位而来——一行星在另一行星之旺/庙，且以七相位之一（或同星座中其一合于对之）与其相合，即接纳。
rules.notes: 接纳定义（核心编码规则）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 火合土且土在火庙（火不在土庙/旺）
rules.result: 火纳土、土不纳火（单向接纳）
rules.original_text: if Saturn is in Aries, in the twentieth degree, and Mars in the fifteenth degree of the same. Then Mars is being joined to Saturn by his own body, and Mars receives Saturn in his own domicile, but Saturn does not receive Mars.
rules.translation: 例一：土星牡羊20°、火星牡羊15°——火星以身体合土星；火星于己庙接纳土星，土星不接纳火星（火星不在土星庙/旺）。
rules.notes: 单向接纳判例

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 趋合目标星前有更近之星
rules.result: 更近者优先得合（逐度为真合）
rules.original_text: This comes to be if some planet were not in the known aspects, who is closer to the conjunction of Saturn (namely degree by degree), in front of Mars. Which if there were a planet in the known aspects (or in Aries) who is closer to the conjunction of Saturn, that one will be more worthy for the conjunction of Saturn than Mars is, for a true conjunction is degree by degree (both for a [corporal] conjunction and an aspect).
rules.translation: 趋合优先：若有他星在七相位中（或在同星座）较火星更近土星之合（逐度）——该星更配与土星之合；真合=逐度（身体合与相位皆然）。
rules.notes: 趋合优先级（编码：按度数距离取最近者）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 火（摩羯）逐度合土（牡羊）且皆在己庙
rules.original_text: if Saturn were in Aries, the twentieth degree, and Mars in the tenth degree of Capricorn, and none of the planets is closer than Mars to the conjunction of Saturn (namely, degree by degree). And when Mars would be joined to Saturn degree by degree, then they receive each other mutually in their domiciles.
rules.translation: 例二（互纳）：土星牡羊20°、火星摩羯10°，无星较火星更近土合——火星逐度合土星；二者于各自庙位互纳。
rules.notes: 互纳判例

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: Likewise the exaltations are just like the domiciles, but the exaltations are of greater authority in a kingdom—namely if [something] is done concerning a king, the Lord of the exaltation is stronger than the Lord of the domicile.
rules.translation: 旺位如同庙位，然旺位之王权更高：关王者之事，旺主强于庙主。
rules.notes: 旺/庙权重差异

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 日合火且日在火庙（火不在日庙/旺）
rules.original_text: if the Sun were in Aries in the tenth degree, and Mars in Capricorn in the tenth degree, then the Sun is being joined to Mars, and Mars receives the Sun because [the Sun] is in [Mars's] domicile; but the Sun does not receive Mars, because [Mars] is not in the domicile of [the Sun].
rules.translation: 例三：太阳牡羊10°、火星摩羯10°——日合火星；火星纳日（日在火星庙），日不纳火（火不在日庙/旺）。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: Likewise the rest of the seven planets, whichever one of them were joined to its associate from its domicile or exaltation in the known aspects, or in one of the signs, and it projected or committed its disposition, [then] if the one to whom it is committed receives [the disposition], it will perfect the matter.
rules.translation: 其余诸星同理：任一行星自其庙/旺以七相位或同星座向同伴投射/交付其 disposition（委任）；被交付者接纳之——事成。
rules.notes: disposition 交付机制（Dykes 注：此与严格接纳有别）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 日（天秤1°）逐度合土（牡羊30°）且各在己旺
rules.original_text: And if the Sun were in Libra in the first degree, and Saturn in Aries in the thirtieth degree, and no planet were in Aries, nor [one] in all of the aspects closer than the Sun to the conjunction of Saturn, nor did Saturn go out from Aries until the Sun is joined to him degree by degree, [then] the Sun receives Saturn, and Saturn the Sun: each one receives his associate in this place by exaltations.
rules.translation: 例四（互纳于旺位）：太阳天秤1°、土星牡羊30°，无星较日更近土合，土星不出牡羊至日逐度合之——日纳土、土纳日：各以旺位互纳。
rules.notes: Dykes 注：旺位互纳之歧义（合相成就时方纳/或早已纳）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 接纳以四分/冲 vs 三分/六分/合
rules.result: 劳苦错误焦虑违逆 vs 平顺虔敬崇高
rules.original_text: And if it were in the square aspect or the opposition, it signifies labor and error, and anxiety, and contrariety; and in the trine and sextile aspect, and in the conjunction, smoothness and piety and loftiness.
rules.translation: 若以四分/冲相接纳——劳苦、错误、焦虑、违逆；以三分/六分/合相——平顺、虔敬、崇高。
rules.notes: 相位质-接纳效果映射（可编码）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: And if the Sun were joined to Saturn, and [Saturn] received the Sun, with [Saturn] even being received in turn by the Sun, from their own domiciles or exaltations, they will make peace and perfect the matter.
rules.translation: 日合土且土纳日、日亦纳土（各以己庙/旺）——彼此和解、事成。
rules.notes: pacifico/pacem 术语（Dykes 注）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: Likewise, all of the benefic planets with benefics increase the good.
rules.translation: 吉星与吉星相合——增吉。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.result: 因退避成吉（恶与碍退去）
rules.original_text: And the malefics with malefics come to be good on account of withdrawal—that is, they make good, and their evil and impediment withdraws.
rules.translation: 凶星与凶星相合——因退避而成吉：其恶与碍退去。
rules.notes: Dykes 注 5：与火土合巨蟹为凶之传统说法难调和（Abu Ma'shar）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.result: 成协议、恶退、事成（除非四分/冲）
rules.original_text: And the benefics with malefics make an agreement, and their evil recedes, and the matter is perfected—unless they were in the square aspect or opposition, because there is a certain labor and error in this.
rules.translation: 吉星与凶星相合——成协议、恶退、事成；除非四分/冲——有劳苦与错误。

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 日牡羊、土天秤（各在己旺，互不接纳）
rules.original_text: But if the Sun were in Aries, and Saturn in Libra (just as I told you before about the conjunction), there will be enmities and contrarieties, ignorances, and refusals, because [neither] of them receives its associate.
rules.translation: 若太阳在牡羊、土星在天秤（如前述合相之例）——互不接纳，有敌意、违逆、无知与拒绝；诸星皆然。
rules.notes: Dykes 注：各在己旺而自满——无接纳更恶

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.condition: 相距<两星座/一星先入下星座
rules.original_text: For a conjunction comes to be from the known aspects (namely from the opposition, trine, square and sextile aspect) and from the [corporal] conjunction. And this comes to be in the noted domiciles. And whatever would be less than two signs, is being separated from conjunction. This comes to be if a planet entered the following sign before a planet who is going toward it, would be joined to it—nor is it [then] joined to it.
rules.translation: 合相由七相位（冲/三/四/六/身体合）而成，且发生注于庙位；距小于两星座（一星先入下一星座而彼未合）——离开合相（不复相合）。
rules.notes: 两星座距离规则（可编码：>60°不构成合相）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.result: 轻合重（重不合轻）；轻交付disposition后分离
rules.original_text: And know that the conjunction comes to be in this way, whichever of the seven planets it was: a light one is joined to a heavy one, and a heavy one is not joined to a light one, because a light one overtakes a heavy one, and a heavy one does not overtake a light one. For a conjunction comes to be from degree by degree when they are conjoined (namely the light to the heavy): then they are joined from degree by degree, and [the light one] commits its own disposition to [the heavy one]. After this, [the light one] is separated from [the heavy one], and does not stop aspecting him until he is separated from it.
rules.translation: 轻重合相规则：轻（快）星合重（慢）星，重不逆合轻（轻追重、重不追轻）。逐度相合时轻星向重星交付其 disposition，随后分离而仍照之直至离。
rules.notes: 追及规则（编码：按日行速度判追及）

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: But a conjunction is an aspect, because however long a planet were going to another planet, it will aspect it with its own light and own nature, until it projects its own light upon it, from degree by degree: than it will be a true conjunction, and [the light one] will commit its own matter to the other. After that, it is being separated from it, and the end of its aspect is in this way.
rules.translation: 合相即相位之一种：行星向彼行去，以其光与性照之，直至逐度投光——真合相，交付己事；此后分离，其照止于此。
rules.notes: 合相-相位连续论

rules.book: Masha'allah《On Reception》(论接纳) — 第 1 章
rules.original_text: And a planet, if it were going to the conjunction of another, will indicate what does not yet exist. And the one who is being separated from [the conjunction] will indicate what is past and is already done. Namely, a star will indicate what is past from the star from which it is being separated; but what is going to be will be indicated by the star to which it is being joined.
rules.translation: 趋合示未成/未来之事；分离示已过/已成之事：星自所离之星示过去，向所合之星示未来。
rules.notes: 趋合-分离时间语义（编码：apply=未来、separate=过去）

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: 宇宙论前提（传统/哥白尼两说皆可）
rules.result: 最高天必为第一物理之因
rules.original_text: I shall not dispute how much Astronomers differ among themselves concerning the Number, Site, Motions, and Nature of the Heavens... That there is one supream Heaven and First Moveable, which by its own motion from East to West, accomplisheth its Revolution about the Earth, in the space of 24 hours... 'Tis true, Kepler... makes the Starry Heaven to be supream, and immoveable: And maintaineth, that the Earth... performs by its own motion from West to East an entire rotation about its Axis... the Sun being placed in the Center of the World. Which supposed to (as indeed it is by the most Learned of this Age) yet I this doth the Starry Heavens perform the Office of the First Moveable...
rules.translation: 第〇一单元：天界运动之两说。传统说：有一最高天/第一推动者，自东向西 24 小时绕地一周，带动其下诸天。Kepler（循哥白尼）否认第一推动者：恒星天为最高而不动，地球自西向东绕轴自转，太阳居世界中心；纵如此，恒星天仍行第一推动者之职（地球各部因整体运动不断转入恒星天新的部分之照临）。
rules.notes: 理论性论证，非判断规则；Morin 兼容两说

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: 效果之四阶段各有天上之因
rules.result: 判断须按阶段区分天上之因
rules.original_text: The First Cause, therefore, of all things can be no other than the Supream Heaven... Therefore every Sublunary Effect, so far as it may be considered secundum se totum, to wit, in its Beginning, Vigour, Declination, and Destruction, must be referred to the whole Heaven; yet not confusedly, but distinctly and orderly.
rules.translation: 第〇二单元：最高天为一切月下效果之第一因。每一月下效果按其整体（beginning/旺盛/衰落/毁灭四阶段）须归于整个天界，非混乱地而是有区分有秩序地。天界诸部分各司其职：司事物之始者、司其盛者、司其衰者、司其毁者。
rules.notes: 因果分层论

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 上升司始、天顶司盛、西落司衰、底天司毁
rules.original_text: What part of Heaven then shall we call the First Cause of the Natural Beginning of every thing? Surely that which in the very Beginning of the thing, ariseth above the Horizon thereof... the East is more powerful than the rest... the stronger and more difficult Effect of things must be attributed to the Ascendant Part of Heaven... successively, that Part of Heaven, which is more elevated above the Horizon, and possesseth the Mid Heaven, in the rise or Beginning of the thing, shall have the Government of the vigour... That which setteth at the same time, the Declination of it... And lastly, That which obtains the Bottom of Heaven, shall be taken for the Cause of Corruption.
rules.translation: 第〇三单元：四角司四阶段。东方（上升）=一切自然之始之因（东比其他方位更有力）；天顶=旺盛与运作力之主；西落=自圆满之衰落；底天=腐败/毁灭之因。此为古人常用的最简天界划分（Haly 之彗星图即证）。
rules.notes: 四角与四阶段对应表

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: 十二宫之来源与命名传统
rules.result: 第一宫=生命，余宫依序（2财/3兄弟/4父母…）
rules.original_text: But when once some Astrologer had observed, that Heaven was both made and moved, rather for the sake of Man... He supposed, that for Man's own sake also the whole Circle of Heaven was rationally Divided into Twelve parts (by great Circles drawn through the intersections of the Horizon and Meridian, and cutting the Aequator in so many equal parts) which he called Houses, the first whereof he placed in the East, and delivered to Posterity, That it governed the Life of Man.
rules.translation: 第〇四单元：十二宫之由来。古人察天为人之故而作而运，遂为人之故将天理地分为十二部分（以通过地平与子午线交点之大圆、等分赤道），称之宫位：第一宫居东、主人生，第二主财富、第三兄弟、第四父母，余类推。此分法自上古典籍至今未变。
rules.notes: 十二宫传统命名起源

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: Ptolemy 系以对宫断子女/母/仆役
rules.result: Morin 判为错误（per se 当归本宫）
rules.original_text: Howbeit Ptolemy and his Followers do dissent from this Ancient Tradition, seeming to pervert the Division in many places: As when (concerning Children) they principally judge, not from the 5. House, but the 11. which is opposite thereunto: When (concerning the Mother) not from 4. but from 10. opposite unto it: So (when of Servants, and animals) not from 6. but the 12. (the house opposing it) which apparent error shall hereafter be Corrected.
rules.translation: 第〇五单元：对 Ptolemy 一系的批评。Ptolemy 及其追随者多处偏离古传：论子女不以 5 宫而以对宫 11；论母亲不以 4 宫而以对宫 10；论仆役与动物不以 6 宫而以对宫 12——Morin 指此为 pervert（颠倒），下文将校正。
rules.notes: 与主流实践相左的立场，标注学派分歧

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 十二宫划分为自然且完满（1/2/3/4/6 对合/六/四/三/冲）
rules.original_text: First then I say, That the former, first and simple division of heaven into four Cardinal parts, is not feigned, but natural... And that is every one of these parts in heaven of the same Nature, viz those with whome it makes an Aequilateral Triangle in the Aequator (the principal Circle of the Worlds first Motion) or which it beholds by a partile Trine in the Aequator. For, the Eternal Trinity is of infinite Love... therefore may every Trine be called Perfect...
rules.translation: 第〇六单元：十二宫之数的原理。四卡迪纳角宫各以赤道上的三分相（分照）照临两个同性之部位：3×4=12，不多不少。三分相为最完满之相位（永恒三一体=无限之爱：爱者/被爱者/自两者流出之爱三位一体，故一切三分皆完满）。12 之数含一切相位：合/六分/四分/三分/冲——「万物皆依数、重量与度量而造」。
rules.notes: 形上论证：三一论；12=1,2,3,4,6 之约数对应五相位

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 1=童年生命(东)、10=青年行动(天顶)、7=壮年婚姻(西)、4=老年激情(底)
rules.original_text: Thus much premised, I say that the Life of Man consists of 4. Ages; Child-hood, Youth, Man-hood, and Old-age: And, that in Man there are four different thing observable... Namely, Life, Action, Marriage, and Passion. And these agree with the Beginning (or rise) Vigour, Declination, and End or Death... viz. Life to the East, Action to the Mid-heaven, Marriage to the West-angle; and Passion to the Angle of the Earth.
rules.translation: 第〇七单元：人生四阶段与四角。人生四阶段：童年/青年/壮年/老年；四事：生命/行动/婚姻/激情；对应自然四阶段：始/盛/衰/死。对应关系：生命=东（上升）、行动=天顶、婚姻=西角、激情=底角（地角）。
rules.notes: 人生阶段-宫位对应（核心映射）

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 1=生命在己、9=生命在上帝（宗教）、5=生命在后代；9→8 即时进入
rules.original_text: The First Triplicity is of the Angle of the East, (which they name the First House, and belongeth to Child-hood) called the Triplicity of Being and Life: the other houses of this Triplicity are the Ninth and Fifth, both which do behold the first house by a Partile Trine... Man liveth on a three-fold respect, in himself, in God, and in his Posterity... Life in itself... the principal House... The Angle of the East. Life in God... exists in the house of religion viz. the Ninth... Life in his Posterity, bestowed on the house of Children, which is the fifth... by the motion of the Aequator there is made an immediate ingress, from the 9. house, into the 8. which is the house of Temporary Death: whereby man is to understand That he must live to himself in God, until his Temporal Death: so that betwixt this, and the Life in God, no part of time intercede.
rules.translation: 第〇八单元：生命三位一体组（1/9/5）。东方角=第一宫，属童年，为「存有与生命之三位一体」之首。人生三重存有：1）生命在自身——居主宫东方角（1 宫）；2）生命在上帝——居宗教之宫（9 宫）；3）生命在后代——居子女之宫（5 宫）。此组皆关乎生命。要义：按赤道运动（时间的尺度），由 9 宫直接进入 8 宫（暂时之死之宫）——人须知当活于上帝之中直至暂时之死，此间与「在上帝之生命」无时间间隔。
rules.notes: 三位一体组1；9入8之神秘义

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 10=非物质之善（官职荣誉）、6=物质有生（臣仆）、2=物质无生（财富）
rules.original_text: The second is the Triplicity of the Angle of the Mid-heaven, which they name the 10. house and appertaineth unto youth. This is also called the Triplicity of Action and of Gain... Gain, or the Physicall good arising to man from his Actions, is threefold. 1. The first (in order of dignity) is Immaterial: as are Arts, Magistracy, Dignities, and honours... the Angle of the mid-heaven. 2. The second, is the Material and Animated; as are subjects, servants, and all other living creatures; and is placed in the 6. house... 3. The last is Materiall-inanimated, as are gold, silver, house-hold-stuff, and even all other Immoveable Goods, gotten by our own labour: which are attributed to the second house, under the name of Riches.
rules.translation: 第〇九单元：行动与财富三位一体组（10/6/2）。天顶角=第十宫，属青年，为「行动与其所生之利」之组。行动所得之善三层：1）非物质之善（尊位序首）——艺术、官职、尊贵、荣誉、权力与威严，居主宫天顶角（10 宫）；2）物质而有生者——臣民、仆役、一切活物，居 6 宫（按赤道运动继之）；3）物质而无生者——金银、家什、一切不动之财，由己之劳而得，归 2 宫之名「财富」。此组皆属行动与其所生之利。
rules.notes: 三位一体组2

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.original_text: The third is the Triplicity of the West Angle, named the 7. House and belonging to man-hood: This is called the Triplicity of Marriage or Love... man is joined to another in a threefold respect. 1. The First Conjunction (in order of dignity) is that of the body, which we call Matrimony, and therefore the principal house of this Triplicity, viz. the West Angle is thereunto dedicated. 2. The second, is that of the Blood, which constitutes Brethren and Kindred, in the Third House... 3. The last, is that of simple Benevolence, or favor, whence do arise friends, in the 11. house.
rules.translation: 第一〇单元：婚姻与爱三位一体组（7/3/11）。西角=第七宫，属壮年，为「婚姻/爱」之组。人与他者三重结合：1）身体之结合（尊位序首）——婚姻，主宫为西角（7 宫）；2）血之结合——兄弟与亲族，居 3 宫；3）单纯善意/恩惠之结合——朋友，居 11 宫。此组皆属婚姻与爱。
rules.notes: 三位一体组3

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 4=父母/遗产/死亡、12=敌/狱/奴/贫（苦难之谷）、8=自身之死→永生
rules.original_text: The fourth Triplicity, is that of the dark angle... called the fourth house, and the Cave or Den of the Planets; attributed to old-age, and the Triplicity of Passion, Affliction, and Death... 1. The first Affliction of Man... is a sorrowful expectation of the Natural Death of his parents... And therefore the Parents and their Condition... as also Death, and heritages... do possess the principal house of this Triplicity, viz. The Angle of the fourth house. 2. The second Affliction consists in hatred deceipts, Machinations... of Enemies, especially the Secret ones; So likewise in Prisons, Servitude, Poverty... in the 12. house, which is truly called the valley of miseries. 3. The last Affliction, inhabiting the 8. house, is the Death of Man himself, which is an End of this Temporal, and the Beginning of an Eternal Life: wherefore according to the second motion, or the motion of the Planets... there is an entrance made from the 8. house into the 9. which is the house of Life in God.
rules.translation: 第一一单元：激情与死亡三位一体组（4/12/8）。暗角（夜中/天底）=第四宫，行星之穴/窟，属老年，为「激情、苦难与死亡」之组——人因亚当之罪而皆受之。三重苦难：1）序首——对父母自然之死的悲凄期待（卡巴拉语：父母所印于我们之原罪，使我们自出生即罹一切不幸终至死）；父母与其状况、死亡及所遗遗产居主宫（4 宫）；2）第二——敌人（尤秘密者）之恨、欺、谋、叛、伤，以及监禁、奴役、贫穷与一生诸苦——皆归于敌之一念，居 12 宫，真名「苦难之谷」；3）最后——人自身之死，居 8 宫：为暂时生命之终、永恒生命之始；按第二运动（行星自西向东）由 8 宫进入 9 宫（在上帝之生命之宫）——人以灵魂之第二运动（理性，第一快速运动属身体/感性欲）由暂时之死入于永生在上帝。
rules.notes: 三位一体组4；8→9 永恒之进入

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: 组内三位一体：首=角、次=续、末=果
rules.result: 宫位数字顺序为类比序（非物理序）
rules.original_text: Therefore, in these Triplicities, that which is First in the order of nature, or dignity possesseth always the more noble houses, viz the Angular: That which is second, succedent houses, according to the motion of the Aequator: And that which is last, Cadent, which are also succedent according to the motion of the Ecliptick, or Planets... so Physically the House Enemies is the second in order; the House of Friends the third; the House of Magistracy, the fourth, and so forth. But mystically, or Analogically, the Numerical order begins from the East by the North Angle to the West.
rules.translation: 第一二单元：组内尊卑与两种顺序。每组中：序首（自然序/尊贵序）居角宫；第二居续宫（按赤道运动）；末居果宫（果宫亦为按黄道/行星运动的续宫）。物理顺序（按第一推动者运动）自东经南至西：敌宫物理序第二、友宫第三、官职宫第四……而神秘/类比顺序（按行星直接运动，自东经北至西）方为数字顺序 1→2→3。
rules.notes: 两种运动→两种顺序

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.condition: per se 判断归上升；per accidens 依行星推运
rules.result: 健康疾病=1宫per se；推运至凶星=发作时机（per accidens）
rules.original_text: Moreover, this light of the Triplicites doth very clearly distinguish the things which belong to every House per se... For example; In a manner all Astrologers do suppose (but erroneously) that health and sickness belong to 7. and 6. Houses per se: whereas indeed they depend upon the Temperament, which is the Seat of Life; and therefore ought judgment to be given concerning them, from the First House, per se: but the judgment deduced from the other Houses is only per accident... if Saturn and Mars, shall at the Moment of his Birth, be found in the 2. or 6. House, from these Houses shall judgment be given (per accident) of a Saturnine or Material disease; to happen when the horoscope comes by Direction to Saturn or Mars, in the 2. Or when Saturn or Mars shall come by Direction to the opposite of the horoscope in the 7. Therefore, judgment per se is always referred to the horoscope.
rules.translation: 第一三单元：per se 与 per accidens 判断之分。三一体之光照使每宫「本然所属」（per se）之事昭然：如众占星家（误）以为健康疾病属 6/7 宫 per se——实则疾病系于体质（生命之座），当自第一宫 per se 断之；自他宫所断仅属「偶然」（per accidens）：如生时土星火星在 2 或 6 宫，可自其宫（per accidens）断土性/物质之病，应于上升推运至该凶星之位时发作；或土火推运至 7 宫（上升之对）亦然。故 per se 之断总归于上升宫。
rules.notes: per se/per accidens 核心原则（解读层重要）

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.original_text: For example, Seeing Man, by the force of natural light, knoweth, that there is one God... (as the Trine aspect made from the first house... to the 9. which is the house of Religion, by the first principles of nature, insinuateth) from the Stars and Planets, (or their Aspects) resident in the 1. and especially in the 9. may judgment be given, whether the native shall be inclined to the worship of God, and to Religion, or the contrary... In like manner, conjecture is made from the 7. house, whether he shall lead a married or a single life. From the 5. whether he be fruitful, and to have issue, or the contrary: and so of the rest of the other houses.
rules.translation: 第一四单元：各宫判断示例。由 1 宫（尤其 9 宫）之星或其相位，断命主是否倾向敬神与宗教；由 7 宫断婚否；由 5 宫断是否多产有后；余宫类推。「相反之知即同一之知」，任何宫皆可就其主题作肯定/否定之问。
rules.notes: 宫位判断示例

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.original_text: Therefore to the first Question I say, that heaven is divided into 12 Houses no more; because every one of the 4 Cardinal parts of Heaven, which govern the beginning, vigour, Declination, and Death of things do by a Trine Aspect, behold two other Coelstial parts, which be of its own Nature: whence shall arise three places out of each of the 4. Cardinal, of he same nature, for three times 4 doth make neither more nor less than 12.
rules.translation: 第一五单元：答四问之一——为何恰为 12 宫。四卡迪纳部位各以三分相照临两个同性部位：自每角生三处同性之地，3×4=12，不多不少。
rules.notes: 四问之一

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.original_text: To the second, I say, that the first House is called the House of Life, because a man is said first to Rise upon this Scene of the world, when first he draws the Breath of this Life: and therefore seeing that the first breathing of this Life is the beginning thereof, it must be placed in the East, as the beginning of every other Physical thing.
rules.translation: 第一六单元：答四问之二——为何第一宫称生命宫、居东方。人首度「上升」于世界舞台即初吸此生命之气；生命之初吸即其始，故须居东方（一切物理事物之始位）。
rules.notes: 四问之二

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 数字序=类比序（非物理序）
rules.original_text: To the third, I answer, that it matters not... what number any House be called by... Yet the Physical order of the Houses is from the East to the South, into the West, agreeable to the Motion of the first and most universal Physical cause... But mystically, or Analogically, the Numerical order begins from the East by the North Angle to the West: the reason whereof is this. There are two Motions in the heavens; the first is of the first Moveable, termed the Rapt-motion: the second of the Planets... There are also two Motions in Man... one of the sensitive Appetite... the other is the Rational appetite... the first of these Motions of a man, hath a greater Analogy with the Motion of the first moveable; and the second with the Motion of the Planets.
rules.translation: 第一七单元：答四问之三——为何数字序自东而西。数字命名不影响天界影响/预测（只要分四组三一体、宫性不变即可）。物理序（依第一因之运动）自东经南入西；数字序为神秘/类比序（依行星直接运动，自东经北入西）。理据：天有双运动（第一推动者之 rapt 运动=急掣；行星之适度反向运动），人亦有双运动（感性欲=人作为生物之运动，先于自然、急速，类比第一推动者；理性欲=人作为人之运动，反向、适度，类比行星）。
rules.notes: 四问之三；类比义详 CA-019

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 各宫之名称得证（非虚构）
rules.original_text: Lastly, to the 4 Questions I say, that the reason why every House must be called by its own, and not another Name; appears more clear than the Sun-shine it self, in the Constitution, Distinction, and Explication, of the Triplicities before posited.
rules.translation: 第一八单元：答四问之四——为何各宫称其名。四组三一体之构成、区分与解释中，各宫当称其名之理已昭然如日。
rules.notes: 四问之四

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.result: 感性欲→12宫苦难；理性欲→2宫德财
rules.original_text: Nevertheless, there are many things to be perceived in that mystical Analogy... that there are two ways which presently occur to a man at his Birth... One is of the Sensitive Appetite, whereby he is brought... into the valley of miseries, viz. the 12. House, which contains all the miseries of this Life, and also the House of the secret Enemies, of the World, the Flesh, and the Devil... tending first and forthwith on high to the Angle of Honour and Majesty; which House issueth from the Triplicity of Parents and Death, and threateneth continual Imprisonments in the dark den of sorrow and horror.
