But the other way is that of the Rational Appetite, whereby a man is carried by the Motion of the Planets in the way of Decension and humility to the House of Riches... viz. the second, which springs from the Triplicity of the Supreme Angle or mid-heaven, wherein Goodness, Power, and Majesty are seated.
rules.translation: 第一九单元：人生两路（神秘类比）。人初生居第一宫时有二路当前：1）感性欲之路——被第一推动者之运动引入苦难之谷（12 宫）：含此生一切苦难、秘密之敌（世界/肉体/魔鬼），其径先直趋尊荣之角却终致永囚于忧怖之暗窟；2）理性欲之路——被行星之运动引入谦降之路至财富之宫（2 宫）：源于至尊角（天顶）之三一体，善/权/威严居焉——由此昭示二路孰优，当循理性欲之路。
rules.notes: 神秘类比（神学义）；非判断规则

rules.book: Morin《Cabal of the 12 Houses Astrological》— Astrologia Gallica 第17书 十二宫之卡巴拉
rules.original_text: Wherefore I will put an end to this my discourse of the Coelestial Houses, which although it be indeed new, and hitherto unheard of, yet it is firmly established upon Physical Reasons, and taking its Original from the most Glorious things...
rules.translation: 第二〇单元：结语。此论虽新而前所未闻，然立于物理之理由，源自最荣耀之事——「自创世以来上帝不可见之事，借其所造之物而可见」。

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: A folio volume, containing four MSS... I. Two hundred and seven Select Figures set on Horary Questions, with the astrological judgement given on each, and the actual event or consequence; by William Lilly. f. 1-104b... Clearly, anything produced by such a well-known figure of the seventeenth century as William Lilly is worthy of attention. However, it is something of a surprise to find that the manuscript is not the work of the great astrologer at all, but of a much lesser astrologer, Jeffrey Le Neve.)
rules.translation: 手稿身份考据：MS Ashmole 209=207 个卜卦问题之选图+逐图判词+实际结果（1635-1642）。目录学者 Lhuyd 误归 William Lilly 名下，经 Ward 2023 考据（外部+内部证据）确证作者为 Jeffrey Le Neve。
rules.notes: 209 收录于 Black 1845 目录 p.170；作者误归系 Lhuyd 目录错误

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward quoting ODNB: Jeffrey Le Neve (1579-1653) was an astrologer and medical practitioner. He began life in Great Yarmouth, Norfolk and became a merchant and alderman. He was a civic worthy of some standing until conflict with the corporation forced him to leave in 1626. For the thirteen years prior to this he had continued his uncle's astrological almanac. He left for Belgium and obtained his M.D. at Franecker, returning to set up at London as astrologer and physician.)
rules.translation: 作者生平：Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）英格兰占星家兼医者。大雅茅斯商人/市议员；承继叔父占星年历 13 年；1626 年与市政当局冲突离城，赴比利时 Franecker 获医学博士，返伦敦执业占星与医学。
rules.notes: Lilly 亦证：'he had formerly been a merchant in Yarmouth and Mayor of the town'

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Lilly's autobiography, MS Ashm. 421 f.191: There was also one Jeffery Neve at this tyme student in Phisick and Astrology... hee had some little smattering in Astrology, could resolve a question of Theft, or love question, something of sickness; a very grave person, laborious, and honest; of tall stature and comely featured; hee died of late yeares almost in the very street, near Tower Hill.)
rules.translation: 同时代人评价（Lilly 自传）：Neve 占星术'略知一二'，能解偷窃问、爱情问、疾病问；'庄重勤勉诚实之人'；晚年近 Tower Hill 街头去世。
rules.notes: Lilly 评价为'能解 Theft/love/sickness 之问'——可作其卜卦专长记录

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Lilly, MS Ashm. 421 f.191: Doctor Neve had intention of printing 200 verified questions, desired my approbation of them ere they went to the press, I first would see them, and then give testimony, when I had perused the first forty, I corrected 30 of them, would read over no more, I showed him how erronious they wear, desired his emendation of the rest, which he performed not.)
rules.translation: Lilly 校勘记录：Neve 拟印 200 个验证问题，请 Lilly 审阅；Lilly 读前 40 个即纠正 30 个，拒绝续读，建议 Neve 修订其余而未果——判词质量在当时已被同行质疑。
rules.notes: 手稿后被 R. Saunders 购得，Saunders 死后其子售予 Ashmole（20 先令）

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: Manuscript 209 is of 207 figures written up in much the same way as described at manuscript 418 and that can be seen in the UCLA complete version. This plus the UCLA manuscript suggest that there were at least three copies in English, 209 and 418 being partial. It is possible that there was a fourth since John Gadbury reports having seen a manuscript of 400 figures.)
rules.translation: 手稿谱系：至少 3 份英文抄本——209（207 图）、418（500 图）、UCLA 完整版（600 图）；Gadbury 称见过 400 图版本（或为工作稿）。418 另有 Beveridge 拉丁译本（MS Ashmole 400）。
rules.notes: UCLA=William Andrews Clark Memorial Library《Vindicia astrologiae iudiciariae》

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: A comparison of manuscript 209 with that of UCLA revealed that every figure in 209 was accounted for in the UCLA manuscript of the full 600 figures, although with different numbering which produced a chronological order. Folio 1 presents a question raised by one Lancelot Gun about his oxen; the figure is numbered 17. The margin note states that it is the 'Last figure', and the same figure and judgement can be found in the UCLA manuscript numbered 599.)
rules.translation: 抄本对应关系：209 中每一图均可对应到 UCLA 600 图完整版（编号不同、UCLA 按时间序）；209 首页 Lancelot Gun 问牛图（编号 17，批注'Last figure'）对应 UCLA 599。
rules.notes: 结论：209/400 均非 Lilly 作品；UCLA 为最终印前版

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: They are dated from 1635 to 1642 each giving the name and address of the client (a feature that is completely absent in all of Lilly's known work except sometimes in the broadest of terms), which is always in London.)
rules.translation: 案例文档特征：每图记客户姓名+住址（全在伦敦）+日期（1635-1642）——此特征在 Lilly 已知作品中完全缺失，为作者归属之关键内部证据。
rules.notes: ODNB：客户社会地位/职业/住址细节为稀有史料

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: To find an astrologer noting the time in such broad terms as, 'inter 4 et 5 p.m.' and 'apud 5 p.m.' is surprising. These kinds of approximations with the time are not to be found anywhere in William Lilly's work.)
rules.translation: 时间记法特征：Neve 记时粗略——'inter 4 et 5 p.m.'（午后 4-5 时之间）、'apud 5 p.m.'（约 5 时）；此近似记时不见于 Lilly 作品。
rules.notes: 计时误差对排盘有影响——机器复刻此类判例须注意时间不确定度

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: the figures in manuscript 209 are numbered consecutively to 115, when the numbering reverts to 1 and continues to 98.)
rules.translation: 编号结构：209 中图号 1-115 连续，随后重置为 1 续至 98（共 207 图两段编号）。

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: This manuscript appears to be a working copy in some ways with marginalia such as, 'This figure must be entered in the place of the 4 figure before.' and 'This figure must stand in the next side following.')
rules.translation: 工作副本性质：边缘批注如'此图须置于前第 4 图之位'、'此图须置于下一页'——209 为编集工作稿（非终稿）。

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023 quoting MS 209 folio 1: a question raised by one Lancelot Gun about his oxen; the figure is numbered 17... A sample judgement in the UCLA version: 'Money Conceal'd of a Kinsman's deceased. Nov: 23. 1682. 3h. 45' PM.'... concludes that there was gold hidden in the house and that the questioner should immediately seek a warrant to allow him to search the upper rooms.)
rules.translation: 判例示例：①Lancelot Gun 问牛（209 首页，对应 UCLA 599）②1682/11/23 15:45'亲戚藏匿遗产'问——判词：屋内藏金，建议立即申请搜查令搜上层房间（月相/相位判据原文在手稿中）。
rules.notes: 1682 案例为后续持有者 Peter Le Neve 所添（非 1635-42 主集）

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: Aside from the evidence provided by the catalogue, in a first examination it becomes clear very quickly that this is not Lilly's work. When compared to some of Lilly's published and unpublished work, there are some differences in handwriting, phrasing, vocabulary, and astrological glyphs.)
rules.translation: 内部证据：笔迹、措辞、词汇、占星符号（如日符号装饰）与 Lilly 已知作品均异——排 Lilly 作者资格。
rules.notes: UCLA 版末约 30 图判词有修改痕迹（疑 Lilly 校勘）

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Ward 2023: As noted on the inserted page... Peter Le Neve writes that he owned the manuscript in 1725... Armorial bookplate of William Constable... 'Bought at Peter Le Neve sale'... transferred in 1860 to the Bodleian Library.)
rules.translation: 收藏传承链：Peter Le Neve（纹章官，1725 年持有时标注）→Constable 家族购于其拍卖→Ashmole 收藏→1860 移交 Bodleian（博德利图书馆，今 Digital Bodleian 数字化）。

rules.source: 规则库-Neve卜卦手稿背景档案.xlsx
rules.book: Neve's Horary Casenotes（MS Ashmole 209，207 卜卦案例手稿影印本）
rules.author: Jeffrey Le Neve（1579-1653）；误归 William Lilly 考据：Susan Ward 2023（Astra Papers TN01, Zenodo 7655129）
rules.original_text: (Skyscript: A handwritten collection of 207 horary case studies recorded by the English astrologer Jeffery Neve, dated 1635-1642. The facsimile is made from photographs taken by Dr Chris Mitchell of Ashmole Manuscript 209.)
rules.translation: 档案限制声明：Skyscript 提供的是手稿照片影印本；本机 OCR 结果（102KB txt）为手写体识别乱码，207 案例逐条判词内容无法从此 OCR 可靠提取——本卷仅为背景档案，判例正文需人工抄录或另取 UCLA 完整版。
rules.notes: 不将无法确认的判词写入规则库（实事求是红线）

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 昼/时主（土火）在上升+月趋合土星+金月受木照
rules.original_text: Finding that the lords of the day and hour, Saturn and Mars, were both in the Ascendant, and observing that the Moon was applying to an aspect of Saturn, I said the ship had encountered a violent storm, but had escaped because Venus and the Moon were beheld by Jupiter.
rules.translation: 判例起盘：昼主/时主土星与火星俱在上升，月趋合土星相位——断船遇暴风；因金星与月受木星照——已脱险。
rules.notes: 479 AD katarche（希腊问卜起盘）；Garnett 1899 译；昼/时主概念

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 问题未告知：福点在射手座（Argo 星群随之升）+福点主在极水象星座
rules.result: 断其为失联之船（航海事）
rules.original_text: The nature of the question not having been disclosed to me, I said it concerned a ship out of sight because the Part of Fortune was in Sagittarius, with which Argo rises, and its ruler was in a very watery sign.
rules.translation: 问题之性质未向我明示：福点在射手座（Argo 随之升），其主在极水象星座——断其涉失联之船。
rules.notes: 注2/3：paranatellonta 关系——黄道度与星座同时升于角；Argo=船星座；宝瓶古以洪水征

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 上升双体+上升主逆行+天顶主（金星）双体+福点双体+月dispositor双体
rules.original_text: Having observed that the Ascendant was in a bicorporeal sign, that the ruler of the Ascendant was retrograde, and the ruler of the Midheaven, Venus, was in a bicorporeal sign and the Part of Fortune was in a bicorporeal sign and the dispositor of the Moon was in a bicorporeal sign, I said that the ship's company would change from one vessel to another.
rules.translation: 上升在双体星座、上升主逆行、天顶主（金星）在双体星座、福点在双体星座、月之dispositor在双体星座——断船中之人将自一船换乘他船。
rules.notes: 注4/5：双体=双体星座（变动星座）；上升主逆行=船归或近泊之经典征

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 上升主在处女座（有翼星座）
rules.original_text: And because Virgo is a winged sign I said they were bringing some birds with them.
rules.translation: 因处女为有翼星座——断其携鸟而来。
rules.notes: 有翼星座=处女（注4）；象征推理

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 月在火星之庙（天蝎）+水星terms（天蝎12-19°）
rules.result: 船货有书/纸（水星terms）与铜器（火星管铜）
rules.original_text: And because the Moon was in the house of Mars and terms of Mercury, I said they would probably bring some books or papers, and some brazen vessels on account of the Moon being in Scorpio.
rules.translation: 因月在火星之庙（天蝎）与水星之界——断其或携书/纸与铜器而来（因月在天蝎）。
rules.notes: 注6/7/8：埃及界表天蝎12-19°=水星界；铜器归火星（引 Lilly CA p.216）

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.original_text: Having noted that Asclepius was rising with the Moon, I said they were bringing medical implements.
rules.translation: Asclepius（蛇夫座）随月上升——断其携医疗器具。
rules.notes: 注8：Asclepius=蛇夫座，医神、治愈再生之征

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 应期推断：月将入宝瓶（7日之位+福点趋木星）或双鱼（福点趋己庙主木星）
rules.result: 到达时月在宝瓶或双鱼
rules.original_text: Being asked the time of their arrival, I said the Moon would be in Aquarius or Pisces: in Aquarius because of its position on the 7th day and because the Part of Fortune was moving towards Jupiter; in Pisces because of the Part of Fortune's movement towards its own house ruler.
rules.translation: 被问到达之时：断月将在宝瓶或双鱼——宝瓶因（月）第7日之位且福点趋木星；双鱼因福点趋其庙主（木星）。
rules.notes: 注9/10/11/12：第7日观月之法；福点随月离日增距而趋木星；双鱼=木星之庙

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.result: 迟因暴风、触礁断船首、颠簸；入港后转船（换船之断应验）
rules.original_text: They arrived on the 8th day, and being questioned about their delay, replied that it was due to a violent tempest, and that, the sea being cloven their prow struck against a rock and was broken. They were mightily tossed to and fro. But having made an harbour, they transferred their cargo to another vessel in which they came.
rules.translation: 第8日到达；问其迟因，答：暴风，海分（开），船首触礁而断，颠簸甚剧；既入港，转货于他船而来（换船之断应验）。
rules.notes: 应验记录（历史事实）：换船断应验；应期断宝瓶/双鱼应验（8日）

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 应验对照：货=鸟+空白纸（水星aphaeretic）+炊具（天蝎）+满药箱（Asclepius）
rules.original_text: Their cargo consisted of birds and blank writing paper on account of Mercury being aphaeretic, cooking vessels on account of Scorpio, and a full medicine chest by reason of Asclepius.
rules.translation: 其货为鸟与空白纸（因水星aphaeretic）、炊具（因天蝎）、满药箱（因Asclepius）。
rules.notes: 注14：aphaeretic=示生而非死（新空白纸vs旧写满之纸）

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 起盘元数据：公元479年7月14日约8:10（当地平太阳时），Smyrna（今土耳其伊兹密尔）
rules.original_text: The chart was cast at Smyrna, Turkey, for approximately 8:10 am LMT on 14 July 479 AD.
rules.translation: 起盘：公元479年7月14日约8:10（当地平太阳时），Smyrna（今土耳其伊兹密尔）。
rules.notes: Neugebauer & Van Hoesen《Greek Horoscopes》pp.144-145 天文参数；现代计算复核吻合

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.condition: 方法学注记：起盘前不要求问者明示问题意图
rules.result: katarche（开端）传统：判断中揭示问题之性质
rules.original_text: It is worth noting the phrase 'the nature of the question not having been disclosed to me', which suggests the astrologer did not demand a clear understanding of the intention of the question when casting the chart, but expected that understanding to arise as a result of judging it. These early inquiry charts were known by the Greeks as katarche, which literally means 'beginning'.
rules.translation: 值得注意'问题之性质未向我明示'之语：占者起盘时不要求问者明示意图，而期判断本身揭示之。此类早期问卜盘希腊人谓之 katarche（'开端'）。
rules.notes: 现存最早 katarche 断例之一（474 AD 亦涉航船，同为 Palchus 集）

rules.book: ‘Palchus’ Inquiry Chart (479 AD): The Safety of a Ship at Sea（海船安全问卜判例）
rules.result: Palchus 非人名，指巴尔赫（今阿富汗境内，古 Khorasan 地区）——藏品保存地
rules.original_text: The collection includes much material on travelling by ship, illustrating doctrines which were, even then, quite ancient. The name 'Palchus' (formerly read by Neugebauer as 'Palchus') is now understood to relate to Balkh, an ancient city in the region of Khorasan (modern-day Afghanistan), where the material was preserved.
rules.translation: 此藏品含大量航船行旅材料，所示学说在当时已甚古。'Palchus'（Neugebauer 旧读）今解为巴尔赫（Balkh）——今阿富汗境内古 Khorasan 地区之城，藏品保存之地。
rules.notes: 原文见 Catalogus Codicum Astrologorum Graecorum Vol.1 pp.103-4

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 个别之事唯神启可断，余用推测
rules.original_text: A Te & Sceintia; from thyself and learning: for it cannot be, that he who is skilful should pronounce particular forms of things; nor can the fancy undertake a particular, but general notion of the sensible matter; in such things we must use conjecture. None but those endued with Divine Inspiration predict particulars.
rules.translation: 自知与学识：精通者不能断言个别之形相；想象亦只能把握事物之一般概念而非个别——此等须用推测；唯受神启者能断个别。
rules.notes: 总则；非可编码规则

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 天象与所问之事相共鸣（判断有效之基础）
rules.original_text: When he that consults shall better consider of it; he shall find there will be small difference between the thing propounded, and the form thereof. [The meaning of Ptolemy is no more than this; viz. the sympathy any one shall observe that propounds his Question, betwixt the matter intended, and the position of the Heavens at the time of its proposition].
rules.translation: 问者深思之后，将见所问之事与其「形式」（天象）差别甚小。Coley 注：真诚提出之问，其意图与当时天界位置之间有共鸣（sympathy）。
rules.notes: 卜卦前提条

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 命主倾心该星所主之技艺
rules.original_text: He that is inclinable to any art, without doubt in his nativity had some star of the same nature very well fortified.
rules.translation: 倾心某术之人，其本命必有同性之星甚强。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 天赋倾向 vs 苦学
rules.original_text: A natural inclination to any knowledge; attains more perfection therein, than one that shall rake hard pains by learning to obtain it.
rules.translation: 天赋之性向胜于苦学所得：生而倾向某知者，其成就更完满。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: He that is skilful may divert many effects of the stars when he knows their natures, and will prepare himself before their event or coming.
rules.translation: 智者知星之性，可于其事未来之前预为准备，而转移其许多效验。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 择时基于本命 vs 独立择时
rules.result: 基于本命=有益；独立择时=无利
rules.original_text: The election either of day or hour shall then advantage when it is constituted from the nativity; otherwise, though the election be well made, it will not profit.
rules.translation: 择时（日/时）惟自本命构成时方有益；否则虽择时佳亦无利。
rules.notes: 择时核心原则

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: None can discern the mixture of the stars, unless he first knows their natural differences and mixtures one amongst another.
rules.translation: 不知星之自然差异与其相互混合，则不能辨别星之混合。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: A judicious man helps forwards the celestial operations, even as the discreet husband-man assists nature in his ploughing and preparing the ground.
rules.translation: 智者助天界之运作，如精明之农夫以耕犁备地助自然。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 行星入相应星座时造像
rules.result: 像得天上之力（护符/造像择时）
rules.original_text: In generation and corruption earthly forms are subordinate to the celestials; wherefore they that frame images, do then make use of them, by observing when the planets do enter into those constellations or forms.
rules.translation: 生成与腐坏中，地上之形相从于天上；故造像者观察行星入相应星座/形相之时而用之（造像择时）。
rules.notes: 护符造像；时代性实践

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 凶星亦可助成其性之事
rules.original_text: In election of days and hours, make use of the two malevolent planets Saturn and Mars; for even so doth the expert physician use poison moderately for cure of man.
rules.translation: 择日择时可用二凶星（土星火星）——如良医适量用毒以疗人。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Make no election either of day or hour, before you know the quality of the thing intended.
rules.translation: 未知所择之事之性质前，勿作日/时之择。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Love and hatred cause error in judgement; for affection magnifies even trifles, and envy as much depresses weighty things.
rules.translation: 爱与恨致判断之误：情爱夸大琐事，嫉妒压抑重事。
rules.notes: 判断者心态条

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 凶星可为助（不须其友善）
rules.original_text: When the position of heaven shall signify anything to come to pass, make use in the business as assistants the malevolent planets, though in the question they were not friendly.
rules.translation: 天象示某事将成——虽问盘中凶星不友善，仍可用凶星为事之助者。
rules.notes: 与 CE-010 同旨

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The astrologer plunges himself into many errors, when the cusp of the seventh house, and lord thereof are unfortunate or afflicted.
rules.translation: 第 7 宫尖与其主受碍——占星家陷于多误（判断前之考虑事项之一）。
rules.notes: traditional considerations before judgement 早期文献

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 王国/团体之上升与对宫
rules.result: 敌上升=对宫方向；友上升=角与续角
rules.original_text: The ascendants of a kingdom's enemies are those signs which decline from the ascendant of the kingdom: the ascendant of the kingdom's friends are the signs of the angles, and of the signs succeeding those angles. The same is considerable in the rising or beginnings of sects and schisms.
rules.translation: 王国之敌的上升=自王国上升而下降之星座（对宫方向）；王国之友的上升=角宫及续角之星座。宗派/异端之起亦然。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When benevolent planets have dominion in the eighth house & are ill dignified, he that is then born shall receive damage from honest men; but if those planets be well affected, the contrary shall happen.
rules.translation: 吉星主 8 宫而尊贵弱——生者受正直之人之损；吉星状态佳则反。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 先按本命测自然寿命再断
rules.original_text: Being demanded of the length of an old man's life, be not rash to give your judgment before you have considered or measured according to his nativity how long he may live according to nature.
rules.translation: 问老人之寿命——先按其本命测其自然可活之年，勿轻断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 日月合相（同度分）或相冲（1/7宫）+吉星主升
rules.original_text: When the sun and Moon are in one and the self same degree and minute at the time of anyone's birth, and a benevolent planet is lord of the ascendant, the native that time born shall be fortunate in all his actions; the same shall happen if the two lights be in opposition, the one in the ascendant, the other in the seventh house, so qualified as before. But if an infortune be placed in the ascendant, you may well judge the contrary.
rules.translation: 生时日、月同度同分，且吉星主上升——命主诸事皆吉；日月相冲、一在上升一在 7 宫，亦同（吉星主升为前提）。凶星在上升——断其反。
rules.notes: 日月位置吉凶条

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: A purging medicine shall not operate so effectually when the Moon is conjoined with Jupiter.
rules.translation: 月亮合金星（Jupiter）时，泻药效不显。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 月在身体部位对应星座（受恶照）
rules.original_text: Draw not blood from that member, whilst the Moon is in a sign representing the same. [The meaning whereof is this, that if you find at any time the Moon in Gemini (which signifies the arms) to be unfortunately afflicted of Saturn or Mars in Sagittarius, Virgo or Pisces, it's not then, says he, so good to let blood at that time...].
rules.translation: 月亮居代表某身体部位之星座时，勿于该部放血。Coley 注：如月在双子（主臂）而受射手/处女/双鱼之土火恶照——不宜当时放血。
rules.notes: 月亮-星座-身体部位映射

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 月蝎/双鱼+升主照地下之星
rules.result: 宜泻药；照地上之星则呕药
rules.original_text: When the Moon is in Scorpio or Pisces, and the lord of the ascendant in aspect to a planet under the earth, it's good to give purging medicines: but if the lord of the ascendant apply to a planet above the earth, it's probable the sick shall vomit up his potion.
rules.translation: 月在蝎/双鱼且升主照地下之星——宜予泻药；升主趋合地上之星——病者或呕出其药。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Neither cut out, or first put on a new garment whilst the Moon is in the sign Leo: if she then be unfortunate it be so much the worse: [this aphorism smells of the superstition of the Arabians... Mr. Lilly saith, once casually... he put on a new suit, the Moon being in Leo and ill dignified, and tore many holes in the suit...].
rules.translation: 月入狮子勿裁/初穿新衣；月受碍则更坏。Coley 注：此条有阿拉伯迷信气味，属择时；Lilly 曾于月狮子失尊贵时穿新衣，两周内衣破数洞。
rules.notes: Houlding 引 Antiochus《Thesaurus》同类规则（月固体星座尤狮子勿穿新衣，衣致衣者之病）；属择时迷信，现代降级使用

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 月与行星成相位/合相（星强/弱）
rules.original_text: The aspect of the Moon, or her conjunction with the planets, inclines the native to be moveable in his disposition; if the planets be strong, they show him to be active or full of spirits; but if they be ill fortified, they incline to sluggishness.
rules.translation: 月之相位/合相使命主性情易动；星强则活跃有神，星弱则懒。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 蚀在角宫+蚀距上升之度数
rules.result: 凶；日蚀1小时=1年、月蚀1小时=1月
rules.original_text: An eclipse of the sun or Moon in the angles of a nativity or yearly revolution is obnoxious; but we take the time thereof from the distance which is between the degree ascending and place eclipsed: and as in a solar eclipse we give or allow for each hour one year; so for every hour in a lunar eclipse, we admit one month for the effect's continuance.
rules.translation: 日/月蚀在本命或年盘之角宫为凶。效期取法：自上升度至蚀位之距离（化为时数）——日蚀每小时=一年、月蚀每小时=一月，为效应持续之期。
rules.notes: 蚀效期编码规则（可直接实现）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 天顶=赤经；上升=斜升（出生纬度）
rules.original_text: Direct the Medium Coeli of a nativity by the table of right ascensions, but the ascendant by the oblique ascensions under the elevation of the pole where the native was born, &c.
rules.translation: 推进（Direction）：天顶用赤经表推进；上升用出生地极高（纬度）之斜升推进。
rules.notes: 推运方法（primaries）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 征象星地下/合日暗宫 vs 升入本位
rules.original_text: The matter of any question is obscured, when the planet signifying it is either under the earth, or joined to the sun in an obscure house: but is manifested when a planet is brought out of his depression into his altitude, and posited in his proper sphere or element.
rules.translation: 事之征象星在地下、或合日于暗宫——事隐晦不明；行星自落陷升入其高位、居其本球/本元素——事显。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 该部位成形佳/次（按星性）
rules.original_text: Venus demonstrates that member to be neatly formed or shaped in which she is posited at time of birth; the like do the other planets.
rules.translation: 金星所在之身体部位生时成形俊美；他星亦然。
rules.notes: 行星-身体部位映射（医学占星）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: In elections, if you cannot fortify the Moon by her joining to or aspecting of planets, see that she be near some fixed stars of that nature your planet ought to have been, &c.
rules.translation: 择时：若不能以行星之合/照强月，则令其近所宜行星之性的恒星。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 恒星主事（无行星同断/合相）
rules.original_text: The fixed stars do design immeasurable and admirable preferments, which notwithstanding determine in unusual calamities, unless the planets concur in judgment, or be in conjunction with them.
rules.translation: 恒星示不可量之高升，然终以非常之灾告终——除非行星同断或与之合相。
rules.notes: 与 Morin 142 恒星/行星持久性论同旨

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the principal significator of a kingdom shall come to his climacterical year, either then the king of that kingdom shall die, or some of the most eminent heroes of that nation.
rules.translation: 王国之主征象星至其 climacterical（节气/临界）之年——国王死，或国中豪杰死。
rules.notes: Coley 例：英王查理一世（1649 被斩）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: An amicable aspect of the stars doth conduce much to the friendship of two persons; but if you will know the quality of the thing wherein they shall agree, you must observe that from both their nativities.
rules.translation: 星之友善相位助两人之谊；二人相合之事之性质，须自两本命观之。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 日月与彼此上升之吉凶布置
rules.original_text: From the benevolent or malevolent positure of the sun and Moon, and each other's ascending sign at time of birth, is discerned the love or hatred betwixt any two: those signs which we call obedient do increase unity and friendship.
rules.translation: 两人之爱恨，自日、月与彼此上升之吉凶位断之：顺从星座（天秤/天蝎/射手/摩羯/水瓶/双鱼）增团结与友谊。
rules.notes: 顺从星座表：天秤-双鱼（supportative）；其余为 commanding

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 新月度尊贵最多之星在角宫
rules.original_text: That planet who hath most dignities in the degree wherein the Moon changes, if he be cardinal, viz, in an angle, he doth demonstrate the principal actions of that month: [this is of most force in the change of weather, &c].
rules.translation: 月变（新月）所在度中尊贵最多之星，若在角宫——示该月之主要事件（尤验于天气变化）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the sun by transit shall come to the degree of the zodiac wherein any principal significator, viz, planet is, he makes that planet more active in such things as concern change of air or weather.
rules.translation: 太阳行运至某行星之度数——该星于天气变化之事上更活跃。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: In the new construction of any city, make use of the adjuvant fixed stars; in building houses take the planets: those cities that in the time of their foundation have Mars culminating, their princes usually die by the sword.
rules.translation: 建新城用助成之恒星；建屋用行星。城基之时火星在天顶——其君多死于刀剑。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 141/142 建城用恒星建屋用行星同旨

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 处女/双鱼上升 vs 牡羊/天秤上升
rules.result: 勤勉得升迁 vs 自致其死
rules.original_text: Who hath the sign of Virgo or Pisces in their horoscope they shall attain preferment by their own industry and worth; but they who have Aries or Libra their ascendants shall willfully or innocently be the cause of their own deaths.
rules.translation: 处女/双鱼上升者以己之勤勉与价值得升迁；牡羊/天秤上升者将自愿或无辜地成为己死之因。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When Mercury shall be well fortified or placed in either of the houses of Saturn in any one's nativity, the native hath a divining soul, and is capable of prying far into matters; if he be placed in the house of Mars, especially in Aries, he inclines to eloquence.
rules.translation: 水星强或在土星之庙（摩羯/水瓶）——命主有预言/洞察之魂，能深入事物；在火星之庙（牡羊，天蝎）——倾向雄辩。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 126 同旨（水星摩羯水瓶）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: If the eleventh house be unfortunate at what time a king is crowned, it's an argument his domestic servants shall thrive little by him, nor will that king grow rich; but if the second house of the figure be afflicted, it shows his subjects shall be impoverished under his government.
rules.translation: 王加冕时 11 宫凶——其家臣难因之得利，王亦不富；2 宫受碍——其民在其治下贫困。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the sign ascending is besieged or infortunated by the malignant planets, he who is then born will delight in coarse actions, and in his sense of smelling shall take pleasure in filthy odours.
rules.translation: 上升被凶星围困/恶照——生者好粗鄙之行、其嗅觉乐秽臭。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 127 同旨（凶星主盘→异于常人之嗅觉）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When thou settest forth upon any journey, beware that the eighth house and lord thereof be not unfortunate; when you return, in the same manner have regard to the second house and his lord.
rules.translation: 出行防 8 宫与其主凶；归来防 2 宫与其主凶。
rules.notes: 出行/归途宫位规则

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 病起时月位 vs 本命凶星位（同座/冲/四分+恶照）
rules.original_text: A disease or sickness first beginning whilst the Moon is in a sign wherein a malevolent was in the nativity or in square or opposition thereunto, will prove very grievous; and if at that time she is in ill aspect of an infortune, it will be very dangerous; but if at the first decumbiture she do possess the degree where a fortune was, there's little danger.
rules.translation: 病初起时月亮在生时凶星所在之星座或其冲/四分——病甚重；此时月复受凶星恶照——极险；病初月占生时吉星之度——少险。
rules.notes: 病盘核心规则（月位对照本命凶吉星度）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 凶星碍自然之事（婚姻）；吉星毁非自然/非法之事
rules.result: 凶星损自然之事、吉星毁非自然之事
rules.original_text: The infortunate planets do impedit those matters which they performed according to natural existence, as matrimony: but what things are acted according to nature, and not unto laws or customs; or those affairs which neither are performed naturally, or according to laws; such things receive destruction from the fortunes.
rules.translation: 凶星碍「依自然存在而行」之事（如婚姻）；而「依自然而行但不依法律/习俗」、或「既不自然亦不合法」之事——受吉星之毁。
rules.notes: Coley 承认各拉丁本（Pontanus/Trapezuntius）不明，从 Haly；Houlding 引 Ashmand：nation 之恶图被时之逆图增强

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 病盘与本命相背+无吉象
rules.original_text: When the figure erected at the beginning of any sickness is contrary to that of the nativity; if no propitious thing be then in force, the sick party is like to be in great peril.
rules.translation: 病初之图与本命相背，且无吉象当令——病者大危。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Whosoever hath not the predominant planets of his nativity in humane signs, will be little sociable, and not very humane.
rules.translation: 命主主要行星不在人形星座——少社交、不近人情。
rules.notes: 人形星座：双子/处女/天秤/射手前半/水瓶

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 上升与恒星/前月相之角/幸运点之度相合
rules.original_text: Excellent prosperity is designed in men's geniture from the fixed stars, and from the angles of the preceding lunations, and from the degree of the Part of Fortune, when the degree ascending at the birth chances to be the same.
rules.translation: 极大之福：恒星 + 前一次月相之角 + 幸运点之度——若生时上升恰居其中之一。
rules.notes: Houlding 注：Ashmand 作 kingdom's Part of Fortune；Coley 以「前一次月相」（full/new 皆可）为是

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When in any one's nativity a malignant planet is placed where a fortune was in another's geniture, he who hath the fortune so placed, shall receive prejudice from him that had the infortune so posited.
rules.translation: 一人之凶星居另一人之吉星之位——吉者受凶者之损。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 君臣/主仆盘之天顶-上升对应或吉照
rules.original_text: When the Medium Coeli of a king's nativity is the horoscope of a subject, or the principal dominators are in benevolent configuration, they shall continue inseparable: judge the like when a servant's sixth house is the ascendant of his master.
rules.translation: 王之天顶=臣之上升，或主要支配星吉照——君臣不可分；仆之 6 宫=主之上升亦然。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the ascendant of a subject shall culminate in his prince's nativity, his lord shall so entrust him, that he will be ruled by him.
rules.translation: 臣之上升在王之本命天顶——其君将信任之至为其所制。
rules.notes: 须指王公贵族之有官职权柄者

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 观 120 合相（土木系列为主）
rules.original_text: [N.B.] Forget not in general judgments the one hundred and nineteen conjunctions: in well considering these, you shall understand what will be done in the world both of generation and corruption.
rules.translation: 总判勿忘 120 合相（土木大合相系列）：细察之，可知世上生成与腐坏之事。Lilly 注：120 合相=七行星一切可能之两两合相（7×6/2×组合=120），土木合相最要（最上行星）。
rules.notes: Coley 作 119，Lilly 引 Ptolemy 原文作 120；组合数 21/35/35/21/7/1

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 生时/受胎时月亮所在星座
rules.result: 反推受胎/出生上升（校正法）
rules.original_text: In what sign the Moon is at the time of birth, make that sign the ascendant in conception; and in what sign she is found at the conception, make that or its opposite the sign ascending at the birth.
rules.translation: 受胎时上升=生时月亮所在之星座；生时上升=受胎时月亮所在之星座或其对宫（时辰校正/推定时用）。
rules.notes: rectification 用；Houlding 引 Al-Biruni 521 章 animodar 详细法（见原注19）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 主星在旺/落陷+上升在星座初/否
rules.original_text: The lords of the genitures of men of tall stature are in their sublimities, and their horoscopes in the beginnings of signs: but the lords of their nativities who are of short stature, are found in their falls: together with this, enquire whether the signs be of right or oblique ascension.
rules.translation: 高身材者：命主主星在旺位（sublimities=exaltations），上升在星座之初；矮身材者：主星在落陷位（falls）。并察星座为长升（右升）或短升（斜升）。
rules.notes: 长升星座（长出没）：巨蟹-射手；短升：摩羯-双子（原注22）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The lords of the genitures of lean men have no latitude, but of fat men they have: if the latitude be south the native will be nimble; if north, more sluggish.
rules.translation: 瘦者命主星无黄纬；胖者有之。黄纬南——身轻捷；北——较迟重。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the principal lords in buildings are joined unto a planet under the earth, they hinder the erection of the building.
rules.translation: 建屋之主要主星与地下之星相合——碍屋之建立。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 火星在10/11宫；上升受火性恒星照
rules.original_text: The malicious influence of Mars against ships is lessened when he is neither placed in the tenth or eleventh house of heaven; in either of those places he destroys the ship, thieves surprising and possessing her by force; but the ship will be fired if the ascendant be afflicted by any fixed star of the mixture of Mars.
rules.translation: 火星不在 10/11 宫则其害船之性减；居二宫之一则毁船（盗贼突袭强占之）；上升受火性恒星之照则船被焚。
rules.notes: 海运/船运条

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the Moon is in her first quarter, that is, from the time she is receded from the Sun's conjunction, the moistures of bodies do flow, until her second quarter, at other times they decrease.
rules.translation: 月上弦（自日合相退离）至下弦——体内湿液流动；余时减少。
rules.notes: 月相-体液医学条

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Change your physician when you shall see the seventh house and his lord afflicted in any sickness.
rules.translation: 病中见 7 宫与其主受碍——更换医者。
rules.notes: 7宫=医者（疾病盘语境）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 推进至合相位时事件显现
rules.original_text: Consider the place of the conjunction, in which part of heaven it falls to be from the ascendant of the year; for when the profection shall arise unto that part of heaven, then shall the event appear.
rules.translation: 察合相之位落于年盘上升之何部位；年推进（profection）至该部位之时——事件显现。
rules.notes: 合相-推进定时规则

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 征象相似之事（死/伤/宝 vs 醉/放血/典当）
rules.result: 须先排除相似情由再断
rules.original_text: Pronounce not rashly that the absent person shall die, before thou considerest whether he be not drunken; nor say that he hath received a wound, before you have enquired whether he were not letting blood; nor do you judge that he shall find treasure, before you have searched out whether perchance he took nothing to pledge of late, seeing the figures of all these demands are alike.
rules.translation: 勿轻断远人将死——先察其是否酩酊；勿断其受伤——先问其是否放血；勿断其将获宝——先查其是否近来典当：此诸问之图皆相类。
rules.notes: 判断防误条（相似盘形）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: In consideration of the sick, behold the critical days, and the peragration of the Moon by the angles of a figure of sixteen sides; for where you shall find those angles well affected, it will fall out well to the sick party: On the contrary, it will fall out ill if you find them afflicted.
rules.translation: 察病者：看危险日（critical days：月与本命/病盘位置成四分/冲/合之日）及月经过十六边形图之角；角受吉照则病者安，受碍则危。
rules.notes: critical days=月冲/四分/合其病盘位；16 边形图为判间隔日之法（Culpeper 有简法，原注26）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The Moon signifieth those things which appertain unto the body, as what have resemblance unto her in regard of her motion.
rules.translation: 月亮主身体之事——凡与其运动相类者。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 合相根图+角宫主星+季节
rules.original_text: When you shall make the minute of a conjunction your basis or radix, you may give judgment of the change of weather in that month; for your judgment shall be framed according to the principal dominator of the angle of every figure, for that planet overcomes in the nature of the air; assuming together with these things the quality of the present time, viz., the season of the year.
rules.translation: 以合相之刻为根（radix）断该月天气之变：按每图角宫之主支配星断之——该星胜于空气之性；并参当令季节。
rules.notes: 天气占（astrometeorology）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When Saturn and Jupiter make their conjunction, see which of them is most elevated, and pronounce judgment according unto his nature; do the like upon all the conjunctions of the other planets.
rules.translation: 土木合相时看何者更隆起（高度）——依其性断之；一切行星合相皆然。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 问主星在年盘/新月盘的尊贵
rules.original_text: When thou hast considered the lord of the question, see what essential dignity he hath in the querent's annual revolution, or in the ascendant of the new Moon preceding, give judgment accordingly.
rules.translation: 察问事之主星在所问者之年盘（annual revolution）、或前一次新月之上升中有何尊贵——据此下断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: In minima conjunctione differentia media conjunctionis, & in media maximae conjunctionis differentia.
rules.translation: （原文保留拉丁文未译）Coley/Partridge 皆不能解。Ashmand 译：「在最小的合相中，与中合相之差；在中合相中，与最大合相之差」。
rules.notes: Coley 自认无把握而保留拉丁文；Partridge 亦不译；含义不明

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 推进+夺命星/吉星相位契合
rules.original_text: Use not profection alone, but also the agreement of the interficient and benevolent planets and their aspects. [This aphorism hath relation unto nativities, and is for discovery of the true time of the native's death].
rules.translation: 勿只用推进（profection）——须并看夺命星（interficient/anareta）与吉星及其相位之契合（断命主真死期）。
rules.notes: interficient=anareta（夺命星）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The years of the native are diminished and made much shorter, by reason of the imbecility of the giver of life.
rules.translation: 赐生者（hyleg）受碍——命主之年减损、寿促。
rules.notes: hyleg=giver of life

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 凶星东出 vs 西没
rules.result: 坠落/意外 vs 疾病
rules.original_text: A malevolent planet when he is matutine, signifies a fall; when vespertine, a disease.
rules.translation: 凶星东出（matutine/oriental）——示坠落/意外（Ashmand 作 accident）；西没（vespertine/occidental）——示疾病。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 月冲日+云雾星；月7宫+土火在上升；+日角宫
rules.original_text: There will be a blemish in the native's sight when the Moon is in opposition to the Sun, and is near to nebulous or cloudy fixed stars; or when the Moon is in the seventh house, and both Saturn and Mars in the horoscope: but if together with this the Sun be angular, the native will quite lose his sight.
rules.translation: 月亮冲日且近云雾星——目有瑕疵；或月在 7 宫而土星火星皆在上升——目疾；若兼太阳在角宫——全盲。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 129 同旨（云雾星眼疾）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 月不合水星+不在上升（狂热预言）；夜土/日火占角于巨蟹处女双鱼（附身）
rules.original_text: Mercury is not in conjunction with the Moon in their nativities, who divine by a kind of fury of things to come, nor is either of them in the ascendant of those who are daemoniack, in such a kind of a figure in the night time Saturn shall possess that angle, but in the day time Mars, especially in Cancer, Virgo or Pisces.
rules.translation: 以狂热预言未来者，其本命月不与水星相合，且二者不在上升；魔鬼附身（daemoniack）者：夜盘土星占角、日盘火星占角（尤在巨蟹/处女/双鱼）。
rules.notes: Ashmand 强调：月与水星无连接+皆不与上升连接→疯癫；附身=夜土/日火占角（巨蟹处女双鱼尤甚）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 日月/火金在阳性星座、东出/西没
rules.original_text: In men's nativities, when both the Sun and Moon shall be in masculine signs, their actions shall appear according to the nature thereof: but in the nativities of women, these very actions are augmented. Judge the fame thing of Mars and Venus, for being matutine, they incline to be more manly; but vespertine they are effeminate.
rules.translation: 男子本命日月皆在阳性星座——其行合其性；女子本命——此等行径更甚。火金同理：东出偏男子气，西没偏阴柔。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 131 同旨

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 教育=升三分主；寿命=当值光体三分主
rules.original_text: Require such things as concern the native's education from the lords of the triplicity of the ascendant: what may concern life must be derived from the lords of the triangularity of the conditional luminary.
rules.translation: 教养/教育之事取上升之三分主星；寿命之事取自「当值光体」（日主日盘/月主夜盘）之三分主星。
rules.notes: conditional luminary=当值光体（日/夜）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 日合Algol+无吉照+支配星冲/四分火星
rules.result: 斩首；光体在10宫=身伤；合在双子双鱼=断手足
rules.original_text: Where the Sun is found to be with Caput Algol if then he is neither aspected by a benevolent planet, or that a benign planet doth govern the eighth house, and the disposer of the temporal light shall be in opposition to Mars, or afflicts him with a square aspect, he that then is born shall be beheaded: But if the light shall culminate, or be in the tenth house, his body shall be wounded: If this copulation be in Gemini or Pisces, his hands and feet shall be cut off.
rules.translation: 太阳与大陵五（Algol）同在，且无吉星照之、无吉星主 8 宫，又当值光体之支配星冲/四分火星——生者被斩首。光体在天顶/10 宫——身被伤。此合在双子/双鱼——手足被断。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 132 同旨（Algol 死亡判据）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Who hath Mars in the ascendant of his nativity will not fail to have a scar in his face.
rules.translation: 火星在本命上升——面必有疤。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 日合升主在狮子/火星在升无尊贵/无吉星8宫
rules.original_text: When the Sun is joined unto the lord of the ascendant in Leo, or that Mars hath no prerogative in the ascendant, or no benevolent planet is placed in the eighth house, he that is born under such a constellation shall be burned, viz, shall die by fire.
rules.translation: 太阳与升主合于狮子；或火星在上升无尊贵；或无吉星在 8 宫——生者被焚死。
rules.notes: prerogative=尊贵（dignities）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 土星10宫+光体冲+4宫星座性（土/水/人形）
rules.result: 屋塌死/溺死/人手死；8宫吉星则免
rules.original_text: When Saturn possesseth the tenth house, viz, is positioned therein, and the temporal light of the time is in his opposition, and an earthly sign is in the fourth, he who is then born shall perish by the ruin or fall of houses or buildings: If the sign of the fourth be a watery sign, he will die in the water or by water, viz, he will be drowned: If the sign of the fourth he humane, he will die by the hands of man; viz, he will either be hanged or strangled, &c., but if a benevolent planet is posited in the eighth, he will be near to death by such accidents or casualties as aforesaid, but shall evade and not die thereby.
rules.translation: 土星在 10 宫且当值光体冲之：4 宫为土象——死于屋宇倾颓；4 宫为水象——溺死；4 宫为人形——死于人手（绞/勒）。8 宫有吉星——虽近此等灾险而免死。
rules.notes: 与 Bonatti 132 死亡方式条同族

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 按所问之事选推进征象
rules.result: 身=上升、外=幸运点、身心=月、职业=天顶
rules.original_text: Make use of, or direct the profection of the ascendant for such things as concern the body; direct the part of fortune for external or outward things; the Moon for such things as concern both the body and the mind; the MC for the actions, magistery or professions, &c.
rules.translation: 推运取用：身体之事推进上升；外物之事推进幸运点；身心之事推月亮；行为/官职/职业推天顶。
rules.notes: 推进征象分配表

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.result: 意外之财（无尊贵之位亦施影响）
rules.original_text: A planet doth many times exercise his influence in that part of the heaven wherein he hath no essential dignity, bringing unto the native unlooked for wealth. [This hath relation unto the antiscions of the planets].
rules.translation: 行星常在其无尊贵之位施展影响，为命主带来意外之财——此与行星之映点（antiscion）相关。
rules.notes: antiscion=映点（以巨蟹/摩羯轴反射）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When Mars is in the eleventh house of heaven, he that hath him so posited, shall not have dominion over his master or lord.
rules.translation: 火星在 11 宫——命主不能统御其主/君。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When Venus is joined unto Saturn, and he hath any dominion in the seventh house, he that is then born will be sordidi coitus.
rules.translation: 金星合土星，且土星在 7 宫有支配力——生者情事污秽（Ashmand 译：私生/非正）。
rules.notes: sordidi coitus；与 Bonatti 131 引 Ptolemy 同旨（金土合+7宫尊贵）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The times of the events of things are discovered seven manner of ways: first, from the interval or distance of the two lords or rulers; secondly, from the distance of their configuration each unto other; thirdly by their access each unto other; fourthly, from the interval betwixt themselves, or the one of them, from the place signifying the thing desired or looked after; fifthly, from the setting of that star which gives assistance or impediment; sixthly, from the mutation of the principal significant planet; seventhly, from the access of a planet unto his own proper place.
rules.translation: 事件之时七法：1）两主星黄经之距；2）其彼此构象（相位）之距；3）其彼此趋合（何时成准相位）；4）主星之一与所问事之位之距；5）施助/碍之星之没（入陷/不利位）；6）主征象星之变宫；7）行星入其本位/尊贵。
rules.notes: 七定时法（核心编码：距/相位距/趋合/与事位之距/没/变宫/入本位）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 新月/满月盘证言相等+上升亦等
rules.original_text: When the figures of the new and full Moon are equal, behold the ascendant, which if that be also equal, then defer your judgment for that time.
rules.translation: 新月与满月之图证言相等——看上升；若上升亦相等——暂缓判断（Lilly：吉凶证言相等时无法知天秤将倾何方，延至再问）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The time of craving any thing at the king's hands, doth show the affection betwixt the king and the petitioner; viz., the time when the petitioner receives the dignity granted him, shall show the quality of action depending upon the preferment, &c.
rules.translation: 向王求事之时示王与求者之情；受赐尊位之时示该升迁所系行为之性质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 火星主升+主7宫或合2宫主
rules.original_text: When Mars is lord of the ascendant at the time of taking any possession, and doth also govern the seventh house, or is in conjunction with the lord of the second, he brings much damage or loss.
rules.translation: 占取某物（进产/即位）时火星主上升，又主 7 宫或与 2 宫主相合——大损大失。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When the lord of the ascendant is in configuration with the lord of the second, the prince or lord shall willingly consume much treasure.
rules.translation: 升主与 2 宫主成构象（相位）——王/君将自愿耗费大量财宝。
rules.notes: 与 84 条相关

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The Sun is the fountain of vital power, the Moon of natural.
rules.translation: 太阳为生命力之泉，月亮为自然力（肉体生理）之泉。
rules.notes: hyleg 理论基石

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Monthly conversions consist of twenty eight days, two hours, and about eighteen minutes; but some there are who judge them from the peragration of the Sun when he is equated partilely unto the degree and minute he was at the beginning of the month.
rules.translation: 月转（monthly conversions=月返）为 28 日 2 时约 18 分；亦有以太阳回归至月初之度分为准者（太阳月返）。
rules.notes: monthly revolutions/returns 两种算法

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: When we direct the profection of the part of fortune for the whole year of a revolution, we take it from the Sun to the Moon, and project it only from the ascendant.
rules.translation: 年盘中推进幸运点：自太阳至月亮之距，只自上升投射。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Require what concerns the grandfather from the seventh house, but the uncle from the sixth house.
rules.translation: 祖父之事取 7 宫（4 之 4），叔伯之事取 6 宫（4 之 3）。
rules.notes: 转宫（derivative houses）规则；Houlding 注：祖父=父之父（4之4）、叔=父之兄弟（4之3）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 升主照/不照上升；时辰主/月位/幸运点/界主
rules.result: 断隐事之性/色/新旧/量/质
rules.original_text: When the lord of the ascendant doth behold the ascendant, the thing which lies undiscovered is of the nature of the ascendant: if he behold not the ascendant, its quality shall be according to the nature of the place where the lord of the ascendant is; the lord of the hour demonstrates the colours, but the place of the Moon the times: if that place of the Moon be above the earth, the thing or matter is new; if under the earth, old: the part of fortune shows its quantity, whether it be long or short; the lords of the terms of the fourth and tenth houses, and of the Moon, show its substance.
rules.translation: 失物/隐事之断：升主照上升——其物属上升之性；升主不照上升——属升主所在之位之性。时辰主示其颜色，月亮之位示其时（月在地上一新、地下=旧），幸运点示其量（长短），4/10 宫之界主与月之界主示其质料。
rules.notes: 失物/隐匿物判断纲要（可编码）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 病主星灼伤（+幸运点受碍）
rules.original_text: It's an ill sign when the lord of the sick party is combust, especially if the part of fortune be afflicted.
rules.translation: 病者主星灼伤——凶兆；尤当幸运点亦受碍。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Saturn being oriental doth not so much oppress the sick body, nor doth Mars when he is occidental.
rules.translation: 土星东出时不太压病体；火星西没时亦然。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: In questions do not pronounce judgment before you confider the next subsequent new Moon; for the first beginnings are varied in every conjunction; wherefore mix both together, and you shall not err.
rules.translation: 卜卦勿在察下次新月之前下断——每合相初起皆变；合二者（问盘+新月盘）而断则不误。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The place of heaven wherein the principal and most powerful significator is posited, doth declare such things as are in the thoughts of the querent to be demanded.
rules.translation: 主而最强之征象星所在之位——示问者心中欲问之事。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Those images which do arise with the several decanates, they declare the inclination of the native to that profession he handles.
rules.translation: 随各十度（decanate）上升之图像——示命主对其所操职业之倾向。
rules.notes: decans 图像法；见 Manilius（Scaliger 编）/Johannes Angelus

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 蚀近角宫+诸星构象+上升图像
rules.original_text: The significations of an eclipse shall be most apparent when the eclipse is near unto an angle; consider also the nature of the stars in configuration to one another, as well of the erratical planets, as of the fixed stars, so also the images co-arising with the sign ascending, and pronounce judgment accordingly.
rules.translation: 蚀近角宫时其征验最显。参星之相互构象（行星与恒星）、与上升星座同升之图像而下断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: The matter or thing in question which is demanded, will be performed in a short time, when either the lord of the new or full Moon is cardinal.
rules.translation: 新月或满月之主星在角宫——所问之事将速成。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Blazing stars and shootings of the stars in the air (or prodigious apparitions therein) have a second signification in mundane affairs; viz., eclipses are in the heavens, but apparitions in the air, therefore events portended by eclipses are first preferred.
rules.translation: 彗星与空中星象（异象）在世界之事上有次等征验：蚀在天界、异象在气界——故蚀所兆之事件居首。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.original_text: Fiery apparitions show want of rain, or a dry air, which if they are carried or moved unto one part of heaven, they declare wind to come from that quarter of heaven: but if those apparitions are carried diversely, or into sundry parts, they show scarcity of rain or waters, the elements often troubled, and the incursions of armies.
rules.translation: 火象（火流星等）示缺雨/空气干燥：其行向天之一方——示风自该方来；行散多方——示雨水缺乏、元素常乱、兵灾侵掠。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Centiloquium》（托勒密百言）— Henry Coley 英译本
rules.condition: 彗星距日11宫+现于角/续/果宫+行向
rules.result: 君死/库利易主/疾疫/外敌
rules.original_text: Comets, whose distance is eleven signs from the Sun, if they appear in angles, the king of some kingdom or one of the principal men of the kingdom will die; but if they appear in a succedent house, his treasures are like to do well; yet shall the king or kingdom change their governor. If they appear in a cadent or obscure house, diseases, and sudden deaths will succeed. If they move from the west toward the east, a foreign enemy shall invade several kingdoms and countries: if the comet move not the enemy shall be provincial.
rules.translation: 彗星距日 11 宫：现于角宫——某国之君或要人死；现于续宫——其国库得利，然君/国将易主；现于果/暗宫——疾病与暴卒。彗星自西向东行——外敌侵入多国；不动——敌止于一省。
rules.notes: 彗星占（世界）

rules.result: 灼伤→顺逆→尊贵→相位→宫位
rules.original_text: Johannes Hispalensis observes only the generalities of these, which novices commonly follow. He considers first whether a planet is combust or not. Second, whether it is direct or not, or fast or slow. Third, whether it is in some of its own dignities, as domicile, exaltation, triplicity, terms, or face. Fourth, whether it is in bad aspect of Infortunes, or good aspect of the Fortunes, or not. Fifth and last, how it is placed in the celestial figure, whether it is angular, succedent or cadent.
rules.translation: Johannes Hispalensis 五步简化法（初学者通行）：一察是否灼伤；二察顺逆/快慢；三察本然尊贵（庙旺三界面）；四察凶星恶相/吉星吉相；五察图中宫位（角/续/果）。
rules.notes: 简法五步（可编码为判定顺序）

rules.book: Johannes Schoener《Opusculum Astrologicum》Part II, Canon xxxix——行星强弱数值表（de Montulmo 体系）
rules.result: 顺行+庙旺+角续+免灼+东出+无凶阻=强
rules.original_text: Therefore planets are said to be powerful and strong when they are direct, in domicile or exaltation, in angles or succedents, free from combustion, oriental, and not impeded by malefics. But they increase their power and fortitude if aspected by or conjoined to Fortunes, and when they are in their hayz; the superiors oriental, inferiors occidental.
rules.translation: 综合判据·强：行星顺行、在庙/旺、在角/续宫、免灼伤、东出、不受凶星阻——为强；更增其力：受吉星照/合、在其 Hayz（上行星东出、内行星西没）。
rules.notes: 强弱综合（引擎输出层可直接用）

rules.book: Johannes Schoener《Opusculum Astrologicum》Part II, Canon xxxix——行星强弱数值表（de Montulmo 体系）
rules.condition: 弱之综合判据+证词计数
rules.result: 逆行+灼伤+弱位+果宫+凶相阻+违Hayz+南行=极凶；证词累积；均衡=平
rules.original_text: They are said to be supremely damned and unfortunate when they are retrograde, combust, in fall, cadent, impedited by the square or opposition of Malefics, in contrariety of hayz, and southerly. And the more testimonies from malefics there are, that much more are they unfortunate, but when partly in dignities and fortitudes, partly in debilities and depressions, they are said to be indifferent or mediocre.
rules.translation: 综合判据·弱：逆行、灼伤、弱位、果宫、受凶星四分/冲阻、违逆 Hayz、南行——为极凶；凶星证词越多越凶；尊贵与弱点相当则平（indifferent/mediocre）。
rules.notes: 证词计数（testimonies）——可编码为加减分聚合

rules.result: 普遍（世俗）先于个别（本命）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 预知学两分：一为普遍的（general，涉全民族国家城市），一为个别的（genethlialogical，涉个人本命）。先论普遍者——强因压倒弱因、个别服从普遍，故论个人须先掌握普遍。
rules.notes: 管线分层：世俗/蚀兆引擎为第一层输出

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 普遍之事再分：大者=战争、饥荒、瘟疫、地震、洪水等周期性大事；小者=季温之变、风暴强度、热风、丰歉等偶发小况。皆先考大国与大况。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 普遍之问有两考据：①黄道诸宫与恒星对各气候地域的相熟；②特定时刻天体中在自身区域的意义——由日月蚀之黄道合相、行星出没与留展现。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 黑卷矮、蛮野（埃塞俄比亚型）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 赤道至夏至圈（南向之地）：人黑肤、毛卷、形缩体矮、血质旺盛，习性蛮野（家宅常被热困），统称埃塞俄比亚人；其地动物植物亦然被日烤灼。
rules.notes: 民族气候人类学（古代框架，仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 白直高大、冷性蛮野（斯基泰型）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 北纬熊星之下（远于黄道日热）：人白肤、直发、高大肥壮、性稍冷，习性亦蛮野（居处常冷）；其地冬寒、植物巨、动物野，统称斯基泰人。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 中纬度文明；南=智巧、东=阳刚、西=阴柔
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 夏至圈与熊星之间（中纬度）：日非当头亦非远，气候均温少暴变——人色中、身材中、性均和、聚处而文明。其最南者（近黄道与行星）更机敏多发明、通神明，长于数学；其中东方组更阳刚果决坦白（东方属日：昼、阳、右），西方组更阴柔隐密（西方属月：夜、阴、左）。
rules.notes: 东西阴阳=日月性可编码

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 四三分组×方位×主星（可编码）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 四三分组方位主星：第一组（白羊/狮子/射手）=西北，主木（北风）兼火（西南风）；第二组（金牛/处女/摩羯）=东南，主金（南风）兼土（东风）；第三组（双子/天秤/水瓶）=东北，主土（东风）兼木（北风）；第四组（巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼）=西南，主火（西风）兼金（南风）。
rules.notes: 与 Book I 三分主表同构；此处加方位（风）属性

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 四大洲方位对应四三分组
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 人居世界分四区，与四三角对应：第一区居西北=欧洲（凯尔特高卢等）；对向东南区=大亚细亚南部（东埃塞俄比亚）；东北区=斯基泰（大亚细亚北部）；西南区=利比亚（西埃塞俄比亚）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 中心区兼受对向三角主+水星
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 每区近世界中心之部与外围方向相反：各与外区相对之三角相熟；本区他处仅本三角主星治之，中心之部另加对向组主星与水星（居两派中间故兼）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 欧洲各族归属宫星（见映射A）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 第一区（欧洲西北，白羊狮射组）各国：英、外高卢、德、Bastarnia 近白羊+火星（更猛悍野性）；意大利、Apulia、内高卢、西西里近狮子+太阳（更主事仁慈协作）；Tyrrhenia、Celtica、西班牙近射手+木星（独立简朴洁净）。中心部（色雷斯、马其顿、Illyria、Hellas、Achaia、克里特、Cyclades、小亚海岸、塞浦路斯）兼金牛处摩羯组：金水土共治（乐学竞洁、好神秘）。
rules.notes: 民族性格论断——仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.condition: 城初建时刻或时主中天
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 都市相熟：以城初建时日月与四角（尤升点）所过黄道区域定其交感（如本命盘）；若建城时未明，则以当时在位君主/执政之本命盘中天所临区域为准。
rules.notes: 城市盘（chart of cities）概念——第4层可做数据表

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 预测四分：地域/时间/种类/性质
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 世俗事件首要原因=日月蚀之合相及当时诸星行为。预测分四部：①地域（何国何城应验）②时间（何时发生、持续多久）③种类（关涉何类）④性质（事件本身好坏）。
rules.notes: 关键框架：蚀判流程四阶段可编码

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.condition: 蚀位+可见性（蚀在地平上）
rules.result: 应验地域=相熟国+可见地
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 地域考法（国级）：考蚀发生之黄道区域及其三角相熟之国。凡相熟之地皆应同验——尤以蚀位直接所临、且蚀升于地平以上可见者为重。
rules.notes: 蚀可见性=地理可见区计算（可编码）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.condition: 城市盘（建城或时主中天）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 地域考法（城级）：考城市与蚀位之相熟——由建城时升点与光体位、或当时时主之本命盘（若建城时未明）中天定其交感宫位。
rules.notes: 与 TTB-211 城市盘定义衔接

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 日蚀时辰数=年数、月蚀=月数
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 时间考法：先按各地时区定蚀时刻之四角与极高，再计蚀持续之昼夜平分时数；日蚀=事件持续数年（=时辰数），月蚀=数月。
rules.notes: 可编码：蚀时长→年/月；与 Clavis 世俗蚀兆卷'时→年/月'同规互证

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 事件开始与加剧之时序由蚀位对四角而定：蚀落东升点=事件始于蚀后首4个月、加剧在总时程首1/3；落中天=第2个四月、中1/3；落西没点=第3个四月、末1/3。
rules.notes: 可编码：蚀黄道位→ASC/MC/DSC 相对宫位

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 事件消长细节由中途合相（落于应验区或与其成相者）与其他行星动态判：行星升或留=加剧事件；设/被日光所灼/晚升=缓和。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 蚀主=最多相熟者（角>显>同宗）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 蚀主择定：对蚀位及蚀前之角两者具备最多相熟关系（最近可见之应用/退离+相关相位+宫/三分/擢升/界之支配）者独主；若无一星兼主二者，则并取对任一区域相熟最多之二星，以蚀主为优先；并列者取近角、更显、或更同宗（sect）者。
rules.notes: 核心算法：与 Clavis CHAP XVIII 蚀主择定（升+天顶+蚀位尊贵最高）同构；此处另加'应用/退离+相位'计分

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 受影响种类由蚀位及主星所在星座之形状断：人形星座（黄道与恒星）=人类；四足兽形=四足畜；爬行形=蛇类；兽形=野害之兽，驯形=有用家畜（马牛羊）；鸟形（处女/射手/天鹅/鹰等）=飞禽（食者）；游泳形=水族鱼；海属（巨蟹/摩羯/海豚）=海族与舰队；河属（水瓶/双鱼）=河泉族；Argo 兼两者。
rules.notes: 可编码：星座形状→种类映射

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 星座属性定对象：二分座=祭礼与神祇崇拜；至点座=空气政治习俗之变；固定座=地基与房屋营造；双体座=人与君王。蚀时近东之部=作物、青年、地基；近中天（地上）=祭礼、国王、中年；近西=习俗之变、老年、已逝者。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 受影响比例：主星对日蚀为西向、或对月蚀为东向=影响少数；对日蚀东向/对月蚀西向=影响多数；居冲=半数。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 性质考法：以主星之性质活动及其相互/与所在处之组合判事件好坏。日月为其余星之统帅（总力之源、主星强弱之因）；合观主星即得事件性质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 五域征象（人身/畜/气/海/谷）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土星独主：人身=久病、消耗、枯萎、体液扰、风湿、日疟、流放、贫、囚、哀、惧、死（尤老人）；畜=损稀病亡；气=酷寒冰冻、霾雾疫腐、云晦、暴雪、生害人爬虫；海=风暴船毁、航灾、鱼稀死、潮洪河滥；谷=歉荒（虫蝗洪水雹）。
rules.notes: 与 Clavis 映射X/蚀兆卷映射Y 土星行同构互证；'仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木星独主：人身=名望、丰足、安宁、生活所需之增、身心康健、贵人恩赐、君主之伟大宽厚、幸福；畜=益畜多而害畜灭；气=温健、湿风、利生长；海=船利、河涨适中；谷=丰饶。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 火星独主：人身=战乱、内讧、俘虏、奴役、起事、领袖之怒、暴死、三日疟、血涌、壮年暴死、暴行、无律、焚掠盗劫；气=热疫、焦枯风、雷电、旱；海=船覆（变风雷电）、河竭泉干、饮水污毒；谷=畜禾损（旱/蝗/风/储焚）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金星独主：似木而加悦人之质——人身=名望、荣、乐、丰足、佳婚、多子、诸关系和顺、产业增、体健、贵人盟好、君主雅致；气=温和湿风、清晴、丰泽之雨；海=船利、河涨；谷=丰饶利市。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水星独主：性随伴星（混则同质）；独自=敏锐实用、随机应变；但主盗劫海盗袭击、恶相时航败、干病（日疟、咳、呕、消耗）；主祭司律法、神祇崇拜、王税、风俗法律之变（随伴星而异）；气=干速、乱暴变风、雷、地裂、地震、闪电、毁畜植；设=减水，升=满水。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 混合不可枚举，交由数学家按当时组合区分（exchanges of signs、相位、对日位相之相调）。主星与应验地之相熟：吉星且与地相熟、未被异宗星克=益更显；凶星且与地相熟或被克=害更轻；凶星既非地主又未被地主星克=害更烈。
rules.notes: 可编码：相熟加成、异宗克制

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.condition: 本命日月/角位与蚀位合或冲
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 个人应普遍祸：其本命之最要处（日月或四角）恰与致祸处（蚀位或其对冲）相合者受之；其中日月正居蚀位本度或其冲度者最险难避。
rules.notes: 可编码：本命盘与蚀位交叠检测

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 蚀色断主：黑或青=土性之效；白=木；红=火；黄=金；杂色=水。蚀色覆全体（或全周）=应验国之大部；色偏一部=仅所倾之部应验。
rules.notes: 可编码颜色映射

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 彗星（'光束'、'号角'、'瓶'等形）：主火与水之效——战乱、热、扰；其头所现黄道之部与尾所指方向=祸临之区；头之形状=事件种类与受害之阶；其存续之期=事件持续；对日之位=开始之时（东现=速至，西现=缓至）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: '岁首新月'定义：各家取二分二至四点为岁首（春分=昼始长于夜且属湿季、夏至=最长昼且埃及主尼罗河泛滥与天狼星升、秋分=收获毕新种始、冬至=昼始复长）；各派各自立论。
rules.notes: 版本分歧记录

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 季判：白羊春/巨蟹夏/天秤秋/摩羯冬
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: Ptolemy 法：四起点并取，各察其前最近之朔望（尤其其中之蚀合相）：白羊起点断春季、巨蟹=夏、天秤=秋、摩羯=冬。
rules.notes: 可编码：二分至前朔望月→季节

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月度查法：各宫之朔与望及其行星运行示该月风候之变；四季与更普遍之性质由各起点之合相及行星对其相位定，特别处由各宫朔望与行星行度定——是为'月查'。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.result: 十二宫整体天气表（映射B）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 十二宫整体天气：白羊=雷或雹；金牛=温和微热；双子=均温；巨蟹=晴暖；狮子=热闷；处女=湿雷；天秤=多变；天蝎=雷火；射手=风；摩羯=湿；水瓶=冷水；双鱼=冷风。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 每宫三段（首/中/末）与南北部各有细分天气（如白羊首=雨风、中=温、末=热疫、北=热毁、南=霜寒；金牛首近昴=地震风雾、中=湿冷、末近毕=火雷电、北=温、南=不稳等）——详表见映射B。
rules.notes: 映射B 完整收录；可编码分段气候参数

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 季度法：察二分至点前最近之新月或满月，按其落度在各纬设四角（如本命），依蚀法定朔望位及后角之主，按其性与所产之天气断该季总况与增减度。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月法：察各宫之朔望（近已过之二分至点象限者用至次象限之朔望），设角定两处之主，尤重行星最近之现、应用与退离、行星与宫位之性、所起之风，并月纬斜向之风向，按'主导原则'断月之风候。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 三日法：更细之增减察日月之弦相（非仅朔望），其变始于月行与日同步前三天、有时后三天；并察此时日月对行星之相位（含三分六分）断变之性质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.condition: 恒星星晨昏出没/光体过角
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 日级与时级：较亮恒星之晨昏出没（对日）调每日之况；二光体过角时最显（时级）；风向随月纬倾侧。总原则：普遍主因先于个别主因，普遍主星与个别主星成相位则力最实。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 太阳象：出没清朗无云=晴；盘杂红、赤芒直射或回射、一侧幻日云、黄云长芒=大风（风向=所指之角）；出没暗青、带云、单侧晕、双侧幻日云、青灰芒=风暴雨。
rules.notes: 天气占候规则（气象占星——仅规则引擎研究与复现）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月亮象（朔望弦前后三天察）：薄而清、周无物=晴；薄而赤、暗部全显微扰=风（风向其倾侧）；暗或青灰而厚=风暴雨。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 晕象：月晕一而清、渐消=晴；二三重=风暴；黄而碎=狂风；厚而雾=雪暴；青灰而碎=风雪交加；晕越多暴越甚。绕行星及亮星之晕按其色与所绕光体性断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 恒星象：星较常更亮大（任何方位）=其本方之风；星群（如 Præsepe）：晴夜星群昏暗若隐=大雨，清晰常闪=大风；Præsepe 之'双驴'（Asini）：北者隐=北风、南者隐=南风。
rules.notes: 天文观测占候

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book II（世俗占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 流星彗星云虹：彗星=旱或风（头大部多=风愈烈）；流星自一角=该向风、自对向二角=风乱、自四角=全风暴（雷电）；羊毛状云=暴；虹=雨后晴或晴后雨。总则：凡显异之色象皆主与其色性相应之果。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 本命论框架：单一起点+后续天象
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 本命论（genethlialogical）：普遍与个别同源——同由日月行星运动为因；别在普遍起点多（蚀与行星行度）、个别有单一起点=气质之始（受孕）。由单一起点断气质总质，由后续天象推特定事件与人生各龄。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 受孕优先、出生为实用起点
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 本命时间起点：受孕时刻为自然起点（能知则用之，断形体心智之细质——种子受 Ambient 赋性）；出生时刻为潜在/偶起点（实用，重要性略次但完满）；两者分别称'种子之生'与'人之生'。
rules.notes: 起点选择=引擎参数（conception vs birth）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 弃古人全星混合法（繁复近无限、赖经验者直觉）；用自然简明法：先述所问人生事件对应之天宫位置（准星），次述主星之效力（放箭），综合断果则委于'熟练射手'（查者计算）。
rules.notes: 管线设计哲学：规则表+计算综合，不依赖玄直觉

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 支配五式：三分（triplicity）、宫（house）、擢升（exaltation）、界（term）、相位（aspect/phase）。判法：查所问之宫（如问行为=中天、问父=日位）→五式之主（一主独断、二三主取多者）→以主星性与所居宫性断质、以主星力量（对宇宙=自家/相熟/升/数增；对本命=角/后升宫尤升与中天；最弱=外位/西落/退行/离角）断量、以晨昏对日与对升点/角续断时序（东出或角=速、西落续宫=迟）。
rules.notes: 五式=尊贵评分基础（可编码加权）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 出生时分之难：科学观察仅天文占星仪（astrolabe）能得真分钟；日晷与水钟皆常有误（晷位/指针移、水钟停流）。须以自然推理校正所欠升度。
rules.notes: 生时校正（rectification）原理：Ptolemy 法为按朔望主星定位升度

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 校正法：取出生前最近之朔望（新月=两光体、满月=地上者）→以五式断其主星→该主星按升时法所落之精确度数=出生时上升之度数（在升时法最合之宫）。
rules.notes: 可编码：rectification=朔望主星黄经→ASC

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 多主并列：取生时过较近于升时法上升度之度数者；若仍并列取最近四角且最同宗者。若主星度数距中天近于距上升点，则以此度数立中天（MC）再定其余诸角。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 本命学全科结构（判盘顺序）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 本命学分科序：产前=父母；前后兼=兄弟；产时=性别/双生/怪胎/不育；产后=寿命（首）、体型、伤病、心智、心智病、财富、官位、行为、婚姻、子女、友敌、旅行、死亡（末）。
rules.notes: 引擎模块划分：本卷覆盖寿命/体型/伤病/心智/心智病，财富官位婚姻等在 Book IV

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 不用无据之'份'（Lots）与数字（无法合理解释者）；只用星与所熟之位相的科学——以普遍可用之通则免重复。
rules.notes: Ptolemy 对阿拉伯点（Lots）的立场：福点例外（见 TTB-337，续命法中采用）；引擎默认不依赖任意 Lots

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 父母星：太阳与土星=父、月亮与金星=母；其相互配置及与他星之关系=父母之事务。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 光体被同宗吉星伴/土金东出正面角位
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 父母荣华：光体被同宗吉星环绕（同宫或次宫）＝父母处境显耀——尤以晨星侍日、昏星侍月且光体自身佳位；又土金皆东出且在其正面或角位=父母显赫幸福。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 光体孤行无伴=父母低微寒微（尤土金无佳位）；伴以异宗星（如火星随日升、土星随月升）或吉星而位不佳不同宗=父母中等、命运多变。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 遗产：福点与侍日月之吉星合=子得完整遗产；福点与之相冲或不合、无星侍或凶星侍=父母产业于子无用甚至有害。
rules.notes: 福点算法见 TTB-337

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 父寿：木或金以任何相位照日与土、或土与日成吉相（合/六分/三分）且有力=父寿长；力弱则非寿长之象（亦非短寿）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 父短寿伤：无上述条件而火克日或土、或火随升、或土与日四分冲：离角=父弱；在角（东/中天）或其续宫=短寿（东角中天）或伤病（西角下天）。火照日=暴卒或伤目；火照土=死或寒热病或刀灼伤；土凶照日=父死于体液聚集之疾。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 母寿伤：木以任何相位照月与金、或金与月合/六分/三分且有力=母寿长；火照月或金（随升/四分/冲）或土独照月，减力=母遭祸病、增力角位=短寿受伤（东角=短寿、西角=受伤）。火照盈月=母暴卒伤目、照亏月=流产死、刀灼伤；火照金=热病暴疾；土照月=东向寒热病、西向子宫溃疡癌。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 察星选择：昼日金/夜土月
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伤病之种类由致因行星所在星座之形状部位定（详见本命卷伤病章）；昼夜察别：昼观日与金、夜观土与月。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 兄弟宫=中天（母位：昼金夜月所居宫）及其续宫=母之子女位=本人之兄弟位。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 兄弟数：吉星照兄弟宫=兄弟多（依星数与单/双体宫形）；凶星克或冲（尤其中有日）=兄弟寡；冲在角尤在升、土在升=长兄/先育者；火在升=兄弟因夭而少。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 兄弟品质/生死/长幼：给兄弟之星位置佳=兄弟雅显、位不佳=卑微；凶星克或后随=兄弟短寿；阳星=兄弟为男、阴星=女；更东者=长、更西者=幼。兄弟和睦=给兄弟星与兄弟宫主吉相；共居=与福点吉相；无涉或冲=兄弟不和、猜忌多谋。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 兄弟细节可再以'给兄弟之星'为升点作转盘（如同独立本命）详查。
rules.notes: 转盘（derived houses）原理：Ptolemy 已用——引擎可实现任意转盘

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 性别判据（无单一理论）：合观二光体、升点及其相关星（尤受孕时，次出生时）——三者或其主星全阳/多阳=男、全阴/多阴=女。阴阳辨：行星本性、所居宫性、东西位（东阳西阴）、对日晨昏（晨见阳昏见阴）。
rules.notes: 可编码：性别=阳/阴计数投票

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 双生：二光体与升点（或其主星）居双体宫=双生；主星部分双体或成对/成组配置亦主多生。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 多胞胎数与性别：由致数之星断数、由对日月升之相位断性别。三男=土木火居双体宫照上述诸处（'诸王盘'）；三女=金月+水阴化（'美惠盘'）；二男一女=土木金（'双生神盘'）；二女一男=金月火（'德墨忒尔-科瑞盘'）。此等婴多发育不全带体痕。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 若双体配置不含升点而含中天，其母亦常生双胎或更多。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 光体离升+凶星分角+朔望无涉
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 怪胎：光体尽量远离升点或与其无涉、角被凶星分隔；察出生前最近朔望及其主、与出生光体——若出生位、月位、升点大部与朔望位无涉=婴形无定。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 光体在四足/兽形宫+二凶居中（无吉照）=非人类：凶见证=全野恶兽；木金见证=神圣动物（犬猫等）；水星见证=有用禽畜（鸟猪牛羊）。光体在人形宫=畸形人类：吉照=可敬怪胎（阴阳人等）；水星独照=无齿聋哑而巧黠。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 怪类定级总则：凶星见证=非人/全恶之兽或无理之怪；木金见证=可敬之怪（阴阳人、Harpocratiacs 等）；水星见证=有用之畜或聪黠之畸形人。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 寿命问=能存活感知时长（满太阳一周=年，或月日时）；不育问=未达'时'而夭（凶力过甚）。前者问复杂、此问简单。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 光体角位+凶合/冲等距+主在凶处
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 不育判据：一光体居角且一凶星与之合或冲（度等距）、无吉星照、且光体主在凶星之处=婴不育即夭。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 二凶后随/对冲光体（火随日、土随月；冲则土照日、火照月；尤居光体或升点之宫）亦不育——凶数之扰尽除寿缘。双冲等角（等边配置）=死胎半死。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 若光体离吉星合/照但凶星之芒先及=活数月日时（数=续命位至凶芒间度数，按凶势与主星力比例）；凶芒在光体前、吉芒在后=弃婴获养而活。
rules.notes: 度=存活数：可编码（与寿命法同构）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 凶星克给吉星=活而受苦役；吉星克凶=活而为他人之子；一吉星升或应用月而一凶星设=亲父母养之。多胞胎同法；双星之一设=半死肉团不完善。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 寿命体系=续命主+破坏点
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 寿命问为本命诸问之首（古人言：对活不到其时之人附会特定事件为可笑）。全法系于：续命宫（prorogative places）与司续命之星（续命主）、破坏之处（destructive places）或星。
rules.notes: hyleg 系统 Ptolemy 原版；与 Valens 寿命时主卷可互证

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 续命宫七处：①升点所在之十二分（地平上5°至后25°共30°）②其右六分（六合）处=善灵宫（11宫）③四分处=中天④三分处=神宫（9宫）⑤对宫=西没点。支配力优先序：中天＞东升＞中天续宫（11）＞西没＞中天前升之宫（9宫前）；地下全弃（仅升宫将出地之部可）。
rules.notes: 映射A：七处+优先序；弃12宫（恶灵宫）因浊气蔽星

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 续命主候选：四个最有权之位=日、月、升点、福点及其各自主星。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 福点（Lot of Fortune）算法：昼夜皆取日月距（从日到月的度数），自升点按后随宫序量同等距——使月对福点之关系相位如日对升点；福点即'月之升点'。
rules.notes: 可编码：ASC + (Moon - Sun) 黄经差；Ptolemy 原式（后世分昼夜变体见 Valens 卷）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 续命主择定：昼=日居续命宫者优先→次月→次对日/前合相/升点五式支配最多者（≥3式）→终取升点；夜=月→日→对月/前满月/福点支配最多者→（前朔望为新=升点、满=福点）。日月皆在续命宫取位高者；主星优于两光体仅当其位更高且对两宗皆支配。
rules.notes: 映射B：昼夜决策树；五式计数=尊贵评分

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 续命二法：①顺宫序（following signs）=投射芒（projection of rays）——续命主在东升至中天之间（东出）时用；②逆宫序（leading signs）=horimaea——续命主在中天西落诸处（离中天而降）时用。
rules.notes: 可编码：hyleg 在东半球用顺序、西半球用逆序

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 西没=破坏度；行星接近加减年
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
