rules.translation: 逆序（leading）破坏：唯西没点（西方地平）为破坏度——使命主消没；行星接近或照仅加减年（吉加凶减、水星随所相之组）不毁命（因非移向续命位而是续命位移向彼）。加减之数按度数算：每度=一时数（昼度=昼时、夜度=夜时）；东出时满值、随其西落递减至设处为零。
rules.notes: 可编码：逆序算法+加减年

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 顺序（following）破坏：土火之体临或自任意处以四分/冲/有时六分照续命宫（'听视'等力之位）即毁；续命宫后四分之位亦毁；缓升宫中六分受克毁、急升宫中三分受克毁；月为续命主时日之位亦毁。吉星照破坏度（木照不逾120°、金不逾80°）或二星同纬可免；日灼之星不参毁助。
rules.notes: 可编码：破坏点=凶星照度+四/冲/六分+后四分宫

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 年数算法（勿简单按各度升时——仅东升或其续命主可用）：通用唯一法=二分时法（equinoctial periods）：算续命位至相遇位经多少二分时（每二分时=一太阳年）；东升=用升时、中天=用赤道升时、西落=用落时（对宫升时）；中间位按对中天与地平时数比例内插（算例：Aries升Gemini至=46、Aries中天=58、Aries落=70、中间三时=64——示于正文）。破坏/气候/过渡按相遇时之吉凶照与岁入（ingresses）定生死（双凶照=死、一吉=大危、双吉=小厄）。
rules.notes: 核心算法：primary direction 的 Ptolemy 原版（后续 Kepler 方向法体系源头）；可编码：二分时内插

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 体型观：东升地平+其上或其主星+月亮；经此两处及其主与两者之混、及同时上升之恒星形状断体型（主星力最大、其宫之特形助之）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 七曜出没体型表：土出=黝黑壮健黑卷发毛胸中眼中等身高、湿冷质；土没=黝黑瘦小直发少毛优美黑眼、冷干质。木出=白皙润色微卷发大眼高伟、湿热质；木没=白皙不润直发或前顶秃、均高、湿质。火出=红白高大灰眼厚卷发、温干质；火没=红中矮小眼小少毛黄直发、干质。金=似木而更匀美秀气女性化丰腴、眼明丽。水出=苍黄中等优美小眼微卷发、温质；水没=白而不润直发橄榄色瘦削亮眸微红、干质。
rules.notes: 映射D：行星×出没×外观×体质

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 光体助相：日照=更壮伟坚实；月照（尤分离时）=更匀细瘦、湿质；月之细则按其照度特质按混法比例。行星运动段体型：晨见=体大、初留=强健肌肉、顺行=不匀、次留=较弱、设=无华而耐劳。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 四象限体型：春分至夏至=貌秀身高健目、湿温质；夏至至秋分=中等貌高健大眼厚卷发、温干质；秋分至冬至=苍黄瘦削病容微卷发好目、干冷质；冬至至春分=黝黑均高直发少毛优美、冷湿质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 星座形状体型：人形星座（黄道内外）=匀称协调；异形=仿其形（部件大小强弱妍丑）。狮/处女/射=体大；鱼/蟹/摩羯=体小；白羊/牛/狮前部强后部弱；射/蝎/双前弱后强；处女/秤/射=匀美；蝎/鱼/牛=拙不匀。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 体型综合：以升点、月亮、其主星、同时上升恒星、行星运动段、太阳象限、星座形状诸因合参混成，断形体与气质之总质（无单一决定因）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伤病观：二地平角（东升+西没，尤西没与其前宫——离东角之宫）；凶星对其相位（体临/四分/冲）＝伤病（尤二光体亦同法角位或冲时；凶星无论后随先升，居角即致伤）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 行星-人体部位映射（映射C）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 行星人体部位表：土=右耳、脾、膀胱、痰、骨；木=触觉、肺、动脉、精；火=左耳、肾、静脉、生殖器；日=视力、脑、心、筋与右身；金=嗅觉、肝、肉；水=言语思想、舌、胆、臀；月=味觉、胃、腹、子宫与左身。
rules.notes: 映射C；医药占星基础表（仅规则引擎研究与复现）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伤与病之别：致因凶星东出=伤（一次性、不持久痛）；西落=病（持续或突发）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 一目盲：月独在角/合/满/照日相关之位，且近黄道星团（蟹内星团、昴、射箭尖、蝎尾针、狮发座、瓶水罐）——火或土向角上亏月且升、或晨先日升而居角。双目盲：二凶同时照二光体（同宫或冲；火=击伤铁灼（水照=角斗场）、土=翳障青光）。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 不孕/流产：金在角（尤西没）与土合/照/换宫、且弱于火或冲火=男不育、女流产早产（尤蟹/处女/摩羯）。阉/阴阳/无导管：月升应用火、月对水如土、火高或冲=阉人阴阳人（日亦照、光体金阳化、月亏、凶入续度=男失生殖器女不育，尤白羊/狮/蝎/摩羯/水瓶）。口吃舌碍：土水与日合于角（水设、皆照月）；火与之为伴月遇后解舌碍。畸形：光体同/冲向角上凶星（尤月交点/弯道/伤宫白羊牛蟹蝎摩羯）=先天驼跛瘫；凶居中天=坠危（火=火伤盗抢、土=屋崩船难痉挛）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 月近二分二至/凶星反照
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 节气伤：月近二分二至（春分=白斑、夏至=苔藓、秋分=麻风、冬至=痣）。病（反式照：昏星对日晨星对月）：土=冷腹痰多风湿羸弱黄疸痢咳呕绞痛象皮病、女子宫病；火=咯血忧郁肺弱瘙痒、瘘痔肿灼疮、女流产腐蚀病。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水星助延：与水土=冷风湿聚（胸喉胃）；与水火=干（目疮痂肿丹毒恶癣黑胆癫狂圣病）。星座病类：蟹摩羯鱼及土生鱼形宫=蚀疮癣鳞瘰瘘象皮；射双=癫痫跌倒。行星居宫末度=肢端病（损/风湿、象皮/足手痛风）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 吉星救济：无吉照或吉被凶克=伤病不可治；吉星居权位克凶=伤不毁容病可疗，吉星升=易愈。木=以财荣掩伤缓病；木+水=药与良医；金=神谕美化、神圣疗愈（土在=以展示忏悔方式疗、水在=以伤病得利）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 心智观：理性/智识=水星之状况；感官/非理性=月亮（较具形体之光体）及其应用分离所及之星。观非简法——须合观水月所居宫性、其主、对日对角的相位、及各行星天然之心灵质性。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 三类星座心性：二分座（白羊秤蟹摩羯）=亲民、好扰动、政治活动、求名、敬神、高贵、好动、好究、善创、善猜度、宜占星与占卜；双体座（双处射鱼）=复杂多变、难测、轻浮、善变、多情、喜乐、懒惰、易得、易改意；固定座（牛狮蝎瓶）=公正、不受谄、坚忍、勤勉、严正、自制、记仇、贪求、好争、野心、顽固。
rules.notes: 映射F：三分形/双体形/固定形

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 相位位置心性：东升与升点（尤正面）=开明、单纯、自主、强壮、高贵、敏锐、坦荡；晨留与中天=计算、忍耐、好记、坚毅、明智、宽宏、达愿、严峻、难欺、批判、实干、好罚、有悟；顺行与设=易变、不稳、软弱、不任劳、情绪化、谦卑、怯懦、诈伪、愚钝、难醒；晚留/地下中天（水金：昼昏没夜晨没）=贵智而记性中、不勤不劳、究隐索玄——术士、秘仪师、气象家、器械师、幻术家、占星家、哲人、占兆者、解梦者。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 主星在自家/相熟宫/同宗=心性开放无碍自发有效（尤同星司二处：照水星且持月之应用分离）；在异地=其性暗昧不显无效。凶星主权=助恶（权位=行恶易且荣、被异宗克=懒散易罚）；吉星不被克=福善受誉、被克=因仁弱受辱易欺。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土独主心智：贵位=爱身、强志、深虑、严正、专一、勤劳、专断、好罚、爱财、贪吝、暴烈、积财、好妒；贱位=卑劣、小气、猥琐、冷酷、恶言、独居、多泪、无耻、迷信、好劳、无情、谋友、阴郁、不修身。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土木合=贵位：善、敬老、端严、贵气、济人、批判、好财、宽宏、善意、爱友、温和、明智、忍、哲思；贱位=粗野、痴狂、易惧、迷信、敬庙、讼疾、猜疑、憎子、无友、闭门、无断、无信、伪诈、阴毒。土木火合（贵）=非善非恶、勤、直、扰、怯勇、苛刻、无悯、争强、躁、乱、诈、伏机、记怒、媚众、暴虐、贪、仇民、好争、恶毒、活跃、浮夸、实利、不可轻、仇人、不挠、好管闲事、达愿；贱位=盗、海盗、诈、辱受、昧利、无神、无情、侮慢、狡、偷、伪誓、杀、食禁、恶行、毒杀、渎神、盗墓、全恶。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土金合：贵=厌女、复古、孤僻、不悦、无争、憎美、善妒、社交严、执见、预言、行祭、爱秘仪、献祭、神秘、敬神、庄重、贞于婚、自持、算、慎、速怒、疑妻；贱=放荡、淫、污行、乱伦、污、欺女、不健、苛、坏、憎美、恶言、醉、奴、伪誓、不法淫（主动被动、自然非自然、及幼/异位/兽）、渎神、嘲秘仪、全无信、诽谤、毒杀、无行不极。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土水合：贵=多管闲事、好究律俗、爱医、神秘、预秘仪、行奇、欺、度日、巧、刻、准、醒、友、务实、达愿；贱=轻浮饶舌、恶、无悯、好劳、憎亲、好虐、阴郁、夜行、伏机、叛、无情、盗、术士、毒、伪、无忌、不幸常败。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木独主：贵=宽宏、慷慨、敬神、荣、悦、善、伟、自由、公正、高洁、庄、自守、慈、好辩、济、爱、领导质；贱=类同而卑：侈代宏、迷信代敬神、怯代谦、骄代庄、痴善代仁、乐代美、愚代高、漠代惠。木火合（贵）=粗、好斗、军事、管理、不静、烈、勇、放、实、直、批、效、争、令、谋、敬、雄、好胜、宽宏、野心、激情、智断、成；贱=傲、无择、野、不释、煽乱、争、顽、谤、骄、贪、夺、易变、轻、改意、不稳、强项、无信、拙断、无情、易激、闹、怨、奢、多言、不平易激。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木金合：贵=纯净、悦、爱美、爱童、爱观、爱艺、歌、孝、善、慈、无诈、敬神、好练、好竞、智、爱、雅庄、宽宏、公平、施、好学、善断、爱节制、亲、孝亲、虔、义、名、士绅质；贱=奢、软、柔、好舞、女心、费、淫、欲、荡、谤、奸、饰、软、惰、纵、苛、激、饰身、女心、迷祭、掮客、秘仪常客、可信不邪、雅易近、悦、厄中仍惠。木水合（贵）=博学、好辩、几何、数学、圣职、辩士、才、醒、善智、善谋、政治家、恩、管、善、宽、爱众、巧、成、领袖、虔、宗教、善贾、爱、孝亲、教养、哲、庄；贱=简、饶舌、易错、贱、狂热、宗教狂、愚言、苦、假智、愚、夸、学、术、微狂、博闻、好记、师、欲纯。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.result: 火独主/火金/火水合心性
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 火独主：贵=贵、令、气、军、多能、力、冒险、鲁、不静、漠、顽、锐、强头、傲、暴、动、易怒、领导；贱=野、傲、嗜血、闹、费、喧、快拳、急、醉、夺、恶、无悯、不安、狂、憎亲、渎神。火金合：贵=悦、乐、友、软、乐、戏、朴、雅、舞、欲、艺、仿、乐、得产、雄、淫行仍成、慎、敏、难究、谨、恋少男女、奢、急、妒；贱=睨、淫、纵、漠、谤、奸、傲、谎、诈、诱（家内外）、锐且贪乐、败女、勇、烈、乱、叛、伪誓、易动、狂、奢、饰、敢、贱行、无耻。火水合（贵）=军首、巧、力、活、不轻、机、创、诡、勤、恶术、谈、斗、狡、不稳、系统工、行邪艺、锐、诈、伪、险、恶名、好事、成、守约、伤敌助友；贱=奢、贪、野、勇、胆、易变、激、易激、谎、偷、渎、伪誓、攻、煽、纵火、剧场扰、傲、海盗、盗、杀、伪、恶、巫、术、杀。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金独主：贵=悦、善、奢、辞、洁、乐、舞、慕美、恶恶、爱艺、爱观、庄、健、好梦、爱、恩、慈、苛择、易和、成、雅；贱=忽、欲、柔、女、怯、漠、堕、苛、微、辱。金水合：贵=艺、哲、悟、才、诗、爱艺、爱美、善性、求乐、奢、乐、友、虔、敏、机、智、成、速学、自修、求善、仿美、辞、悦、爱、序、勤、正、善断、宏、情中节（对女慎对男痴）、妒；贱=悍、机、恶言、不稳、恶意、欺、煽、谎、谤、伪誓、全恶、谋、无信、奸、败女童、饰身、女柔、恶诋、饶舌、恶徒、饰伪行实恶、贱行尽受。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水独主：贵=智、敏、思、博、创、历、善算、究自然、思辨、才、争、惠、慎、善猜、数学、秘仪、达愿；贱=全恶棍、急、忘、急、轻、变、愚贼、无智、罪、谎、无择、不稳、不可靠、贪、不义、断不坚、向恶。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月亮状态助心：月居南北限之弯道=多能、机、善变；居交点=敏锐、活跃、易激；升且光增=天赋、名、坚、直；光减或晦=迟钝、滞、慎、名减。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 太阳助：与水星相熟贵位=公、成、荣、庄、敬神；异位=卑、勤、隐、野、顽、苛、苦、少成。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 心智病观：水月彼此相对、对角、对致伤之星——若其自相无涉或对东升无涉，被不熟之星以伤相克/围/冲=心智病。解义以行星质类推（前述性格之极端即为'病'）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 土昼火夜/土夜火昼/凶控月相
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 癫痫：月水无涉（彼此或对东升）+土昼/火夜居角照前述=多数癫痫。狂躁：同条件下土夜/火昼司位（尤蟹/处女/鱼）。魔附/脑积水：凶星控月之相（土=合、火=满，尤射/鱼）。部位：日火位助狂躁、木水位=癫痫、金位=神附忏悔、土月位=积水魔附。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 可治性：凶星自东角吉星西没=病不治而显（癫痫连击危、狂躁失友毁衣骂詈）；吉星东角（木=医药饮食药物、金=神谕神助）=可治而显。凶西吉东=病隐而不可治。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book III（本命占星）
rules.condition: 光体阴阳宫+火金阴阳化
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 被动部性之变（以日月代水星、观火金与之关系）：光体居阳宫无伴=男愈阳、女愈阴（仅增阳刚活跃）；火或金亦阳化=男淫（奸、无厌、不法淫）、女好非法交/同性（tribades）；金星独阳=隐秘为之、火亦阳=无讳（甚至称同性为'妻'）。光体居阴宫无伴=女愈阴、男变柔；金阴化=女淫（无拒任何性行）、男柔（暗中被动）；火亦阴化=无忌无耻（娼妓之姿）。火金晨升=愈雄愈显、西没=愈柔愈庄；土在=更淫秽、木=更庄重节制、水=声名多变。
rules.notes: Ptolemy 古典文本记录（仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途/判断）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 预知学的对象=星体位形对地上事物的影响
rules.original_text: The studies preliminary to astronomical prognostication, O Syrus! are two: the one, first alike in order and in power, leads to the knowledge of the figurations of the Sun, the Moon, and the stars... the other takes into consideration the changes which their aspects create...
rules.translation: 天文预知学有两个预备学科：其一（天文计算，Almagest 已述）认知日月星辰的形位与相互相位；其二研究这些相位借星体自然属性在受作用物上造成的变迁——本书专论第二科。
rules.notes: 两个学科的分工：计算层 vs 解读层，即本管线第2/3层与第4层的分野

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 预知对象为受作用物的弱质
rules.result: 规则为概然性而非必然性
rules.original_text: no positive or infallible rules... can be here set forth: while, on the other hand, a due observation of most of those general events, which evidently trace their causes to the Ambient, shall not be omitted.
rules.translation: 本书不设绝对无误的规则（因物质质料柔弱多变），但多数可溯源于天界的普遍事件仍应予以观察记录。
rules.notes: Ptolemy 自认方法论边界：解读层是概率判断（engine 输出应带置信度）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 天体影响以物质传导贯穿月下世界
rules.original_text: That a certain power, derived from the aethereal nature, is diffused over and pervades the whole atmosphere of the earth... Fire and air, the first of the sublunary elements, are encompassed and altered by the motions of the aether.
rules.translation: 以太本性发出的一种力量弥漫于整个地球大气；月下四元素中火与气最先被以太运动包围改变，进而改变水土与动植物。
rules.notes: 物理基础：以太→气火→水土（占星因果模型的古代物理框架）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 日月为影响地上的两个主因
rules.original_text: The Sun, always acting in connection with the Ambient, contributes to the regulation of all earthly things... The Moon... rivers swell and are reduced; the tides of the sea are ruled by her risings and settings...
rules.translation: 太阳主导四季与昼夜的温热燥湿；月亮因其近地而施影响最大——河流随其光增损、潮汐随其升降、动植物随其盈亏。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 相位合成效应：太阳主导、混合配置
rules.original_text: And, further, the mutual configurations of all these heavenly bodies, by commingling the influence... The power of the Sun however predominates... the others either co-operate with his power or diminish its effect.
rules.translation: 诸天体的相互相位混合各自影响力产生多重变化；太阳力量居主导，余星或助或减；月亮在合、上下弦、冲时作用最显，恒星作用更慢更隐。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 后代/收成被授精时天象塑造
rules.original_text: the impregnation and growth of the seeds from which all bodies proceed, are framed and moulded by the quality existing in the Ambient at the time...
rules.translation: 一切物体的种子受孕与成长被当时 Ambient 的性质塑造——农夫牧人据此在播种配种时观风向断收成。
rules.notes: 受孕时刻重要性的依据（本命应以出生或受孕时起算的争论源头）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 可推断季节气候与个人气质命途
rules.original_text: When, therefore, a thorough knowledge of the motions of the stars... shall have been acquired... there seems no obstacle to deprive him of the insight... into the effects arising out of the quality of all the various influences compounded together.
rules.translation: 当人精确掌握星体运动（位置、时间、相位）又通晓各星效力（如日热月湿），则可推断混合配置产生的效应：季节之气与个人气质皆可预知。
rules.notes: 管线前提：第2层精确计算+第4层星性规则表

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: by the constitution of the Ambient, even at the time of any individual's primary conformation, the general quality of that individual's temperament may be perceived...
rules.translation: 依个体初成时 Ambient 的构成可察其气质总质：形貌心智与吉凶事件皆可判断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 从业者水平影响可靠性
rules.original_text: these mistakes arise, not from any deficiency or want of power in the science itself, but from the incompetency of unqualified persons who pretend to exercise it.
rules.translation: 预知的谬误多出于不合格从业者的无能，而非科学本身的缺陷；更因有人借占星之名行其他占卜之实而污其名。
rules.notes: 辨伪与从业者质量警告

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 事件永不精确重演→预知有误差
rules.original_text: an entire return of all the heavenly bodies to the exact situation... will never take place... The examples referred to for guidance being therefore not exactly similar to the existing cases... predictions are sometimes not borne out by the events.
rules.translation: 诸天体不可能完全复归同一位置（宇宙大年不可测），故过去的例证与现在情形绝不完全相似，预知偶有不应验。
rules.notes: 误差的形而上根源：配置不可精确重复

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 同天象不同命（物种/地域/教养差异）
rules.original_text: the variety in seed has the chief influence in supplying the peculiar quality of each species... considerable variations are caused in all creatures by the respective places... different modes of nurture, and the variety of ranks, manners, and customs, contribute to render the course of life... greatly different
rules.translation: 除天象外须合并考虑三共同因：种子（物种）、出生地（地域）、教养与身份习俗；否则预判不完备。
rules.notes: 反驳'同时同地生必同命'论；引擎需环境因子输入

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: if such events should have been foreknown, the mind will have been previously prepared for their reception, and will preserve an equable calmness...
rules.translation: 预知的价值之一：使心灵预作准备，临事保持平静——如见未来如见眼前。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 事件减弱或不发生（非宿命论）
rules.original_text: it must not be imagined that all things happen to mankind, as though every individual circumstance were ordained by divine decree... nor is it to be thought that all events are shown to proceed from one single inevitable fate...
rules.translation: 并非一切事件都由宿命注定：除天象外须观地上事物的多样性与可阻止性——强大的主因必应验，遭相反作用者则被阻止或减弱。
rules.notes: 非决定论框架：预知=概然判断，可被阻止（管线输出应为条件概率式表述）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 预知类比医学诊断（强/可防两分）
rules.original_text: experienced physicians, accustomed to the observation of diseases, foresee that some will be inevitably mortal, and that others are susceptible of cure.
rules.translation: 如经验医师断某些病必死、某些可愈——占星家论断亦类比：强因事件必至，可阻因事件可防。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 预防与治疗（占星医学一体）
rules.original_text: the Ægyptians... have in all cases combined the medical art with astronomical prognostication... by means of the science called by them Medical Mathematics
rules.translation: 埃及人将医术与天文预知结合，称为'医药数学'（Medical Mathematics）：依天文知气质与事件，依医药知适宜与不宜，以预防疗治。
rules.notes: 西方占星医学传统源头

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Sun is found to produce heat and moderate dryness.
rules.translation: 太阳生热与中度干燥（其热为主，干为次）。
rules.notes: 温度性表：可编码为 {hot:1, dry:0.5} 权重

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Moon principally generates moisture; her proximity to the earth renders her highly capable of exciting damp vapours... She has, however, also a moderate share in the production of heat.
rules.translation: 月亮主生湿气（近地故能激起湿雾、作用于动物体的松弛与腐化）；因受日照亦中度生热。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Saturn produces cold and dryness, for he is most remote both from the Sun's heat and from the earth's vapours. But he is more effective in the production of cold than of dryness.
rules.translation: 土星生冷与干燥（离日热与地气皆最远）；冷强于干。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Mars chiefly causes dryness, and is also strongly heating, by means of his own fiery nature...
rules.translation: 火星主干燥且强热（因自身火性、色赤、贴近太阳）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Jupiter revolves in an intermediate sphere between the extreme cold of Saturn and the burning heat of Mars, and has consequently a temperate influence: he therefore at once promotes both warmth and moisture.
rules.translation: 木星居中于土之极冷与火之极热之间，气质温和：兼生温热与湿润，主生滋养之风气。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: To Venus also the same temperate quality belongs, although it exists conversely; since the heat she produces... is not so great as the moisture which she generates by the magnitude of her light...
rules.translation: 金星亦属温和但方向相反：其热（近日所致）不及湿（光大并取地之湿气，如月所为）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Mercury sometimes produces dryness, and at other times moisture, and each with equal vigour...
rules.translation: 水星时而干燥时而湿润，二者等力：吸湿造干因其近日，生湿因其近月界；随太阳疾行故迅速交替两种性质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: two of the planets... are considered by the ancients as benefic, or causers of good: these are Jupiter and Venus. And the Moon also is so considered for the same reasons.
rules.translation: 古人以温热湿润为滋养繁育之性、干燥寒冷为毁败消耗之性；故木星、金星因温和且热湿为主被视为吉星，月亮亦然。
rules.notes: 吉凶分类可编码

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: But Saturn and Mars are esteemed of a contrary nature, and malefic, or causers of evil: the first from his excess of cold, the other from his excess of dryness.
rules.translation: 土星与火星为凶星：土因过冷、火因过干。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Sun and Mercury are deemed of common influence, and productive either of good or evil in unison with whatever planets they may be connected with.
rules.translation: 太阳与水星为中性（common）：随所连之星而为吉或凶。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: the female sex partakes chiefly of moisture. The Moon and Venus are therefore said to be feminine, since their qualities are principally moist.
rules.translation: 阴性主湿：月亮与金星以湿为主故为阴性。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Sun, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars are called masculine. Mercury is common to both genders...
rules.translation: 太阳、土星、木星、火星为阳性；水星中性（时干时湿、等比）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 晨见(东出于日) vs 昏见(日落后)
rules.original_text: the stars... are also said to be masculine and feminine, by their positions with regard to the Sun. While they are matutine and preceding the Sun, they are masculine; when vespertine and following the Sun, they become feminine.
rules.translation: 行星依对日之位亦分阴阳：晨见先于日（东出于日）=阳性；昏见后于日=阴性。
rules.notes: 可编码：elongation 方向

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: From the ascendant to the mid-heaven, or from the angle of the west to the lower heaven, they are considered to be masculine, being then oriental: and in the other two quadrants, feminine, being then occidental.
rules.translation: 依地平两象限：自上升至中天、自西角至下天两象限为东向阳性；另两象限为西向阴性。
rules.notes: 可编码：黄道度相对 ASC/MC 位置

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 昼夜星划分：月金夜/日木昼/水中性
rules.original_text: The day... is masculine:--the night... feminine. Hence, again, the Moon and Venus are esteemed to be nocturnal; the Sun and Jupiter, diurnal; and Mercury, common; since in his matutine position he is diurnal, but nocturnal when vespertine.
rules.translation: 昼阳夜阴：月金为夜星，日木为昼星，水星中性（晨见昼、昏见夜）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 土=昼星、火=夜星（反性相配）
rules.original_text: the coldness of Saturn is allotted to the day, to counterbalance its heat; and the dryness of Mars to the night, to counterbalance its moisture.
rules.translation: 凶星按相反原则分配：土星之冷配昼以衡其热，火星之干配夜以衡其湿——凶性因异质相混而缓和。
rules.notes: 昼夜划分的调和原理（sect 概念雏形）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Moon, during her increase, from her first emerging to her first quarter, produces chiefly moisture; on continuing her increase from her first quarter to her full state of illumination, she causes heat; from her full state to her third quarter she causes dryness; and from her third quarter to her occultation she causes cold.
rules.translation: 月亮四阶段温度序：新月至上弦=湿；上弦至满月=热；满月至下弦=干；下弦至月晦=冷。
rules.notes: 可编码：月龄区间映射四质

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The planets, when matutine, and from their first emerging until they arrive at their first station, are chiefly productive of moisture; from their first station until they rise at night, of heat; from their rising at night until their second station, of dryness; and from their second station until their occultation, they produce cold.
rules.translation: 行星晨见后四段温度序：初现至第一留=湿；第一留至夜升（冲日）=热；夜升至第二留=干；第二留至伏=冷。
rules.notes: 第一留=逆行始、第二留=顺行复；'夜升'=冲日；可编码：由与日黄经差阶段映射

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 相位混合改变个体效力
rules.original_text: they must likewise cause, by their intermixture with each other, many varieties of quality in the Ambient...
rules.translation: 行星相互混合亦生多种气性变化：各星本力虽主，仍受所相合之星力增减。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: the spring partakes chiefly of moisture... the summer is principally hot... the autumn is principally dry... the winter is chiefly cold.
rules.translation: 四季四质：春主湿、夏主热、秋主干、冬主冷。
rules.notes: 与人生四龄对应：春=幼（湿）、夏=壮（热）、秋=衰（干）、冬=老（冷）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The beginning of the whole zodiacal circle... is therefore assumed to be the sign of Aries, which commences at the vernal equinox...
rules.translation: 黄道起点定为白羊（春分点）：因春湿如动物生命之初，故白羊为岁首，余季依次相随。
rules.notes: '岁差攻击'反驳依据：Ptolemy 实指春分后30度之性质，非恒星位置（注释42）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: the eastern point, or angle of the ascendant, is chiefly dry in its nature... the southern point, or angle of the mid-heaven, is the most hot... the western point, or occidental angle, is moist... the northern point, or angle of the lower heaven, is the most cold.
rules.translation: 四角四质：东（上升点）=干；南（中天）=最热；西（西没点）=湿；北（下天）=最冷。由此定四方风之性质。
rules.notes: 可编码：四角温度权重

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 星性 vs 体质同/异质
rules.original_text: the stars have a much stronger influence on any constitution, when there may not be in it any tendency contrary to their own... stars effecting heat operate more vigorously in constitutions of heat; and those effecting moisture in constitutions of moisture.
rules.translation: 星力在同质性体质上更强（热星遇热体质、湿星遇湿体质其力全纯）；遇相反倾向体质则被调和而减弱。
rules.notes: 可编码：性质权重相乘/相加的调和逻辑

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The tropical signs are two: viz. the first thirty degrees after the summer solstice, which compose the sign of Cancer; and the first thirty degrees after the winter solstice, composing the sign of Capricorn.
rules.translation: 回归星座（tropical）有二：夏至后30度=巨蟹、冬至后30度=摩羯——日至此而转向（至点）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: There are also two equinoctial signs: Aries, the first after the vernal equinox; and Libra, the first after the autumnal equinox.
rules.translation: 二分星座（equinoctial）有二：春分后白羊、秋分后天秤——日至其首则昼夜平分。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Those signs, which severally follow immediately after the two tropical and the two equinoctial signs, are termed fixed... The bicorporeal signs severally follow the fixed signs; and, being thus intermediately placed between the fixed and the tropical signs, they participate in the constitutional properties of both.
rules.translation: 紧随二分/回归座之后的四星座=固定座（金牛/狮子/天蝎/水瓶，季质确立）；固定座之后四星座=双体座（双子/处女/射手/双鱼，兼有二质）。
rules.notes: 可编码：{tropical:[Cancer,Capricorn], equinoctial:[Aries,Libra], fixed:[Taurus,Leo,Scorpio,Aquarius], bicorporeal:[Gemini,Virgo,Sagittarius,Pisces]}

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 白羊/天秤=阳宫起首，阴阳交替
rules.original_text: six are called masculine and diurnal, and six feminine and nocturnal. They are arranged in alternate order... The signs of Aries and Libra are consequently considered to be masculine and diurnal.
rules.translation: 十二宫六阳六阴交替排列：白羊与天秤起首为阳（处二分圈，主最大变化）；其后者为阴，余依序交替。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Masculine or feminine qualities are, however, by some persons, attributed to the signs by means of a different arrangement, and by making the sign ascending... the first of the masculine signs...
rules.translation: 他派另定阴阳：或以升座（horoscope）为第一阳宫，或以月亮所在之首座为第一，或按象限（升-中天/西角-下天为阳，余为阴）分。
rules.notes: 版本分歧如实记录（选型须声明用哪派）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: This mutual configuration attaches to all parts diametrically distant from each other, containing... a hundred and eighty degrees: it also exists in all parts at the triangular distance... a hundred and twenty degrees; also, in all parts at the quadrate distance... ninety degrees; and, also, in all parts at the hexagonal distance... sixty degrees.
rules.translation: 星座间相位：冲=180°（6宫距）、三分=120°（4宫距）、四分=90°（3宫距）、六分=60°（2宫距）；各距由圆之等分推演（六分=半圆的1/3等分、四分=1/2、三分=2/3）。
rules.notes: 可编码：|Δlon|∈{60,90,120,180}；不含合（自身不能与自身成相——注释44）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: the trine and the sextile are each called harmonious, because they are constituted between signs of the same kind... The opposition and quartile are considered to be discordant, because they are configurations made between signs not of the same kind.
rules.translation: 吉凶相位分派：三分与六分=和谐（成于同性宫：皆阳或皆阴）；冲与四分=不和谐（成于异性宫）。
rules.notes: 可编码：aspect_type 吉凶标

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 黄道相位之外另有宫位（mundane）相位
rules.original_text: the ascendant and the eleventh house are in sextile to each other; the ascendant and the mid-heaven in quartile; the ascendant and the ninth house in trine; and the ascendant and the occidental angle in opposition
rules.translation: 宫位间亦成相位（mundane aspects，注释45引 Placidus）：上升与第11宫=六分、与中天=四分、与第9宫=三分、与西角=冲。
rules.notes: Placidus 引 Almagest VIII.4 证 Ptolemy 知两种相位；12宫六分于第11、三分于第9、四分于第10、冲于第7

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Any two signs configurated with each other at an equal distance from the same, or from either equinoctial point, are termed commanding and obeying... The signs in the summer semicircle are commanding; those in the winter semicircle, obeying.
rules.translation: 命令与服从座：距同一二分点等远的二宫成'命令/服从'关系（升落时间相等）；夏半圈之宫=命令，冬半圈之宫=服从（日在其时昼长于夜与否）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Any two signs, equally distant from either tropical sign, are equal to each other in power... Such signs are also said to behold each other... because each of them rises from one and the same part of the horizon, and sets in one and the same part.
rules.translation: 等力相视座：距同一至点等远的二宫权力相等（日在其间昼夜时长同）；且同升于地平同段、同没于同段。
rules.notes: 黄道平行（parallels of declination）概念雏形——注释46

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: All signs, between which there does not exist any familiarity in any of the modes above specified, are inconjunct and separated... all signs which contain between them the space of one sign only, or the space of five signs...
rules.translation: 无联系座（inconjunct）：相距1宫或5宫之宫与任何四相位皆无涉（1宫距=相背、5宫距=圆之不等分），故为'相分离'。
rules.notes: 150°/30°不在四相之内；Kepler 新相位（半四分/五分等）违反此章禁令——注释47（占星界长期争议）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Cancer and Leo are... appropriated as houses for the two principal and greater luminaries; Leo for the Sun... and Cancer for the Moon...
rules.translation: 宫（house）制：巨蟹与狮子为二光体之宫——狮子=太阳（阳）、巨蟹=月亮（阴）；自狮子至摩羯半圈=日圈、自水瓶至巨蟹半圈=月圈。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Saturn... occupies the signs opposite to Cancer and Leo: these are Aquarius and Capricorn... Jupiter... takes the next two signs, Sagittarius and Pisces... Mars... takes... Aries and Scorpio... Venus... takes the next two signs, Taurus and Libra... Mercury... the remaining two signs, Gemini and Virgo
rules.translation: 七曜宫位序：土=水瓶+摩羯（对日月宫）；木=射手+双鱼（三分距）；火=白羊+天蝎；金=金牛+天秤（六分距）；水=双子+处女（最近二光体）。
rules.notes: 行星有两宫：一昼一夜（注释49 Whalley 表）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 第一三分组昼夜主：日/木
rules.original_text: The first triangle, or triplicity, is formed by three masculine signs, Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius... By day, therefore, the Sun claims the principal co-regency of it, and Jupiter by night.
rules.translation: 三分主（triplicities）：黄道十二宫分四等边三角。第一三分组=白羊/狮子/射手（阳宫），日主昼、木主夜；以北方风为主（兼西北）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 第二三分组昼夜主：金/月
rules.original_text: The second triplicity, formed by Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn... The Moon rules it by night, and Venus by day.
rules.translation: 第二三分组=金牛/处女/摩羯（阴宫），月主夜、金主昼；以南风为主（兼东）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 第三三分组昼夜主：土/水
rules.original_text: The third triplicity is composed of Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius... Saturn rules it by day, owing to his condition, and Mercury by night.
rules.translation: 第三三分组=双子/天秤/水瓶（阳宫），土主昼、水主夜；以东风为主（兼东北）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The fourth triplicity, formed by Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces... the Moon by night and Venus by day, through their feminine condition, govern it, together with Mars.
rules.translation: 第四三分组=巨蟹/天蝎/双鱼（阴宫），火（因天蝎宫）为主，昼夜又合月（夜）/金（昼）；以西风为主（兼西南）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Sun on his entrance into Aries... his exaltation, therefore, is determined to be in Aries... His fall is placed in Libra.
rules.translation: 擢升（exaltation）：日擢升于白羊（入北半球、昼渐长、热力增），落于天秤。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Saturn on the contrary... obtains his exaltation in Libra, and his fall in Aries.
rules.translation: 土擢升于天秤、落于白羊（对日保持相反位置）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The Moon... makes her first appearance, and begins to augment her light in Taurus... her exaltation; while Scorpio, the opposite sign, is her fall. Jupiter... obtains his exaltation in that sign [Cancer], and his fall in Capricorn. Mars... his exaltation is therefore placed in Capricorn... and his fall in Cancer. Venus... her exaltation is consequently placed therein [Pisces], and her fall in Virgo. Mercury... takes his exaltation in Virgo... and he receives his fall in Pisces.
rules.translation: 诸曜擢升落陷：月擢升金牛（日于白羊擢升后月初见光增于其三分首座）、落天蝎；木擢升巨蟹、落摩羯；火擢升摩羯、落巨蟹；金擢升双鱼、落处女；水擢升处女、落双鱼。
rules.notes: 可编码 exaltation 权重

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 两界制并存，埃及制无序
rules.original_text: There are two methods of disposing the terms of the planets... one is Egyptian, the other Chaldaic. But the Egyptian method preserves no regular distribution, neither in point of successive order nor in point of quantity.
rules.translation: 界（terms/bounds）有两制：埃及制与迦勒底制。埃及制无论次序或度数皆无规律可循（举例证其先后与量度均不规则）。
rules.notes: 界=行星在每宫内掌管的具体度数区间

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Thus, by the Egyptian distribution, it appears that the total numbers of the degrees for each planet, added together, make 360:--viz. for Saturn 57, Jupiter 79, Mars 66, Venus 82, and Mercury 76.
rules.translation: 埃及界制总量：各行星界度数合计=360（黄道全度）：土57、木79、火66、金82、水76。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The quantity of degrees allotted to each planet is also simply regulated in the Chaldaic method; it diminishes in graduation... Thus the first planet takes eight degrees, the second seven, the third six, the fourth five, and the fifth four. By this arrangement the degrees of Saturn amount by day to 78, and by night to 66; the degrees of Jupiter to 72, of Mars to 69, of Venus to 75, and of Mercury by day to 66, and by night to 78--the whole amounting to 360.
rules.translation: 迦勒底界制：每宫五主依次取 8/7/6/5/4 度（递减1度）；总量：土昼78夜66、木72、火69、金75、水昼66夜78，合计360。
rules.notes: 迦勒底法：宫距序按三分主次序（第1组木、第2组金、第3组土木、第4组火）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: Of these two distributions of the terms, that of the Egyptians seems more to be relied on... since it has been handed down and recommended in the writings of the Egyptian authors, and also because the degrees of the terms, in nativities rectified by them as examples, are universally in accordance with this distribution.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 取舍：埃及界制更可信（埃及作者传述且其校定本命实例普遍符合）；迦勒底制次序数量皆无可稽考，故可疑。
rules.notes: 引擎选型：埃及界表（映射E）为默认界制

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: whatever planet, whether benefic or malefic, may possess two rights of dominion in one and the same sign, such planet is universally placed first in order in that sign. In other cases... it is always placed last.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 界序规则：某星在同一宫内兼具两种支配权（如庙+三分等）则居首；凶星仅一种权时居末。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: The lord of the exaltation is placed first; then the lord of the triplicity; and then the lord of the house; in regular succession... In Cancer and Leo, however, the malefics occupy the first degrees; as those signs are the houses of the Moon and the Sun, which take no terms.
rules.translation: Ptolemy 界序排法：擢升主居首、次三分主、再次宫主；巨蟹与狮子二宫（日月之宫、日月不取界）凶星居首。
rules.notes: 可编码：按此序生成 Ptolemy 界表（本 Gutenberg 文本 XXIV 章表格未转录完整——实际界表以映射E埃及界表收录；Ptolemy 自拟界表另见 Robbins 版权版不可摘录，留待后续补全）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 位（2.5°）/度（逐度）两法被 Ptolemy 弃用
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节'Of Places and Degrees'；原文不摘录，本条为基于原文的规则转述]
rules.translation: 位与度（Places and Degrees）：有人更细分支配——'位'=宫之十二分之一（2.5°），按宫序轮流支配；'度'按迦勒底界序逐度分配。Ptolemy 以二者仅有似是而非之论、无自然依据，弃之不用。
rules.notes: 占星界存在废弃的细分尊贵法——实现可忽略

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.result: 黄道起点=二分至点（回归制）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 星座起点应从二分点与至点起算（白羊=春分起）：因星座性质、力量与相熟关系皆源于二分至点；若另取起点（如恒星黄道），则星座性质将错位失效。
rules.notes: Ptolemy 明确支持回归黄道；引擎黄道制选型依据（可编码：tropical）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 金星与日月成六分且西于日东于月
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节'Of Faces, Chariots, and the Like'；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 行星'正面'（proper face）：行星对日月保持其宫位对日月宫位之同相即称在本正面——例如金星与二光体成六分、且对日为西向（昏见）、对月为东向（晨见），即依其宫位原构。
rules.notes: face 定义的 Ptolemy 版本（非后世俗用的 5°面表）——版本分歧记录

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 双重以上相熟/同宗相熟/异宗
rules.result: 车=力大增、喜=间接感应、异宗=力麻痹
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: '车'与'王座'（chariots/thrones）：行星于所在处兼具两种以上上述相熟关系（宫/三分/擢升/界等）时称在车中，其力因同性合作而大增；'喜'（rejoice）：所在宫虽与本星无相熟、却与其同宗（昼夜派系）之星相熟时称喜（感应较间接）；反之居于异宗之地则其力大半被麻痹。
rules.notes: 可编码：多重尊贵叠加增强、sect 异宗削弱

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节'Of Applications and Separations'；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 应用与分离：在前之星（度数较小）'应用'（apply）于在后之星，在后之星'分离'（separate）于在前之星（相距不远时）；无论以体合（合相）或传统相位发生皆然。
rules.notes: 可编码：|Δlon| 单调递减=应用、递增=分离

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 合相需同侧纬度；相位无需
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 体合之应用/分离须观察二星黄纬同侧（同在南或北纬）方计入；相位之应用/分离则无须——因一切光线自各方向射向地心同一点。
rules.notes: 可编码：合相应用加纬向校验

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》（四书/Quadripartite）Book I
rules.condition: 东出/西落、中天/地平/续宫/东出位/地下
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 星力强弱总判（方位与运动）：①东出且本速加快者最有力，西落且减速者力弱；②依对地平位置：中天或近中天最有力，其次正处地平或续宫（succedent），再次在东出位；地下中天或其他方位更弱；对上升无任何相位者全无力。
rules.notes: 关键算法：行星力量=东出加速+角/续宫位置+对ASC相位；直接支撑尊贵评分与'相位优先'判定

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 意外之事（external accidentals）序：先论财富与荣名——物质财富系于身体之性、荣名系于灵魂之性。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 财富观'福点'（Lot of Fortune，昼夜同式：自升点量日月距，理由见寿命章）——察其宫主星之权位与相熟。
rules.notes: 福点式同 TTB-337；财富与寿命共用一法

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 福点主星有力（尤得光体见证）=富。各星致富径：土=建筑/农业/航运；木=信托/监护/祭司；火=军事与统率；金=友馈/女赠；水=辞令与贸易。
rules.notes: 映射A

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土司财而与木相=遗产（尤在上角且木居双体宫或持月之应用=收养承嗣他人之产）。同宗行星见证主星=保产无损；异宗星克或后随主位=损财。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 财富损益之时=致因行星近角与续宫之时（以其推进至角续定应期）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 荣显观二光体与伴星之相熟：两光体皆居阳宫、其一或二者角位、尤宗光体（昼日/夜月）被五星伴（晨星伴日、昏星伴月）=为王。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.condition: 伴星角/照上角；日阳月阴
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伴星自角或照上角=大而有权、统世之君（右相位照上角=更幸）。若仅日阳宫月阴宫、一光体角位=仅为将军（有生杀权）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伴星不角不照角=仅大而享部分荣显（冠冕/监督/军职，非首列之位）。光体不角而多数伴星角/照角=不得显赫之荣、仅为民间领袖与中升迁。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.condition: 伴星不涉角/光体无吉伴
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 伴星不涉角=行为卑隐、无晋升；两光体皆不角/非阳宫/无吉星伴=全微贱困厄。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 荣显之种类依伴星质：土主=基于财富与积财之权；木金=恩赐/馈赠/荣名/宽宏；火=军功/胜利/下属之惧；水=智识/教育/事务管理。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 行为主星（lord of action）二法：①最近太阳晨见之星；②中天之星（尤持月之应用者）。同一星兼二处=独用；无星居其一=用居另一处之星。
rules.notes: 映射B

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 一星最近晨见、另一星在中天且与月=并用，取五式支配力多者；皆无晨见亦无中天=取中天宫之主（此等盘主大多惰怠）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 行为之质观火金水三星及其所行之宫。水主行为=文书/商人/会计/教师/商贾/银行/卜者/占星/祭司——以文献、诠释、给与取为业；土证=管他人之产/解梦/庙中预言灵感；木证=立法者/演说家/辩士/近贵人。
rules.notes: 映射C 独主段

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金主行为=香花/香油/酒/色/染料/香料/装饰业（油商/花冠织/旅店/酒商/药商/织工/香料商/画师/染匠/衣商）；土证=悦物商人/术士/毒师/掮客；木证=运动员/冠冕/受荣者/因女得进。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 火照日=用火之工（厨/铸/烙/铁匠/矿工）；火不照日=用铁之工（造船/木匠/农/采石/琢石/珠宝/劈木）；土证=水手/汲水/隧道/画师/猎场看守/厨/防腐师；木证=士兵/仆役/税吏/旅店/渡夫/祭助。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水金共主=缪斯艺（乐/诗/节奏，尤互换位）：剧场/演员/奴隶商/乐器匠/合唱/琴弦/画师/舞者/织工/蜡塑；土证=上述+女饰商；木证=律师/账房监/公职/童师/民首。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水火共主=雕刻/甲匠/圣碑/模型/角力/医师/外科/告发/奸/恶/伪造；土证=杀/小偷/破门盗/海盗/盗牛/恶棍；木证=武夫/决斗/能者/好管闲事以谋生。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金火共主=染/香/锡铅金银工/农/铠舞/药商/以药治病之医；土证=圣畜侍/葬人/哭丧/丧笛/狂热秘仪者；木证=庙客/占兆/圣器持/妇监/媒婚为业、纵乐放浪。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 行为主星所居宫性助行为种类：人形宫=科学/利人之业；四足宫=矿/商/建/木工；二分二至宫=解译/物物交换/量/农/宗教；土水形宫=液体业/植/造船/葬/腌渍。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月居行为位特例：月离合+水，居金牛/摩羯/巨蟹=卜者/祭师/盆卜（lekanomancy）；居射/鱼=招魂/唤魔（necromancy）；居处女/蝎=术士/占星家/先知/通灵；居秤/白羊/狮=神启者/解梦/驱邪。行为大小=主星力（升/角=独立、设/离角=从属；吉星克=大荣利无谬惠、凶星克=卑贱失利可谬；土冲=冷杂色、火冲=胆大名闻、双凶俱=行为全毁）。增减时=致效星对东西角之位。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 男婚观月：月在东象限=早婚/娶幼；西象限=晚婚/娶长；月被日灼且照土=不婚。
rules.notes: 东象限定义见 TTB-424

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 男婚数：月居单形宫或应用一星=一婚；双体多形宫/同宫应用多星=多婚。妻质：月应用之行星吉=妻好、凶=反；应用土=妻勤严；木=庄善管家；火=勇悍；金=悦美；水=智敏。金与木土水=妻节俭爱夫爱子；金与火=易怒不稳无情。
rules.notes: 映射D

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 女婚观日：日东象限=早婚/嫁幼；西象限=晚婚/嫁长；单形宫/应用东星=一婚；双体宫/照东多星=多婚。夫质：日相土=庄有用勤；木=庄宏；火=行动寡情悍；金=整洁俊；水=节俭务实；金土=性迟弱；金火=热烈冲动淫；金水=恋少男。
rules.notes: 映射D

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 象限定义：日之东象限=升宫前诸宫与设宫前诸宫；月之东象限=自朔望至弦月间诸宫；西象限=其对冲诸宫。
rules.notes: 日月象限定义不同——引擎实现须分判

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 婚久暂（合婚）：两盘光体成吉相（三分/六分，尤互换位）=婚持久；尤夫月与妻日吉相。光体无涉/冲/四分=轻离决裂。
rules.notes: 合婚（synastry）判则 Ptolemy 原版

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 吉星照吉相光体=婚悦益；凶星照=争吵不悦无利。凶位时吉星照=不绝婚而复合念旧（存慈爱）；凶星=虐离。水独伴=名闻互责；水金=奸/毒。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 他式婚观金火土：金火土与光体相熟=家内合法婚。金对火=同龄之婚（其擢升宫互成三分）；金对土=年长之婚（其宫位互成三分）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金火=恋情；加水=名闻亦加。金水土居双体宫（摩羯双鱼）=亲族婚。男金+月=娶二姊妹/亲族；女金+木=嫁二兄弟/亲族。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金土=悦固之婚、加水=益、加火=不稳害妒。金与之同相=同龄、东=娶幼、西=娶长。金土居双体宫（摩羯/天秤）=亲属婚。月与此组合在升/中天=男娶母/姨/继母、女嫁子/侄/婿。日（尤星设）=男嫁女/侄女/儿媳、女嫁父/叔/继父。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 阴阳位变态（相位由异性宫成=全秽，如白羊前后部/毕宿/水瓶/狮后/摩羯面）：角位之东与中天=公然展露、西与下天=阉人/不育无道；火在=失阳器/女性同性。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 男情欲观火：火离金土+木证=洁正自然之欲；火+土独=慎滞冷；火+金木=易激而有节制；火+金（木在、土不在）=纵欲多方取乐；一昏一晨=双性中度；双昏=偏女（阴宫=被动）；双晨=恋少男（阳宫=任意年龄男）。金更西=与贱女/奴/外邦；火更西=与贵人/已婚妇/贵妇。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 女观金：金木或金水=温和纯洁；无土而金水=易激多欲而慎避污；金火独合/照=淫荡放逸；金火木（火日灼）=与奴/贱/外邦；金位=与贵主为情妇/奸妇；行星阴化=仅被动、阳化=主动同女；土入=阴化则淫、阳化升=受责/好此者；木=遮掩、水=更名闻不安。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 子女观中天+其相位/续宫（善灵宫11）；无则观对冲处。给子星=月木金；夺子星=日火土；水=从所相之组（晨见=给、昏见=夺）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 给子星独处=单胎；居双体阴宫/多产宫（鱼蝎蟹）=双胎或多胎；阳化（阳宫/照日）=男、阴化=女。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 凶星克给子星或居不育位（狮/处女）=得子而不久。日火土主权（阳宫/不育宫+不被吉克）=全无子；阴/多产宫或有吉证=得子而伤夭。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 两宗皆涉致子之宫=子损（全损或少数损，依同宗星数/力：更东/近角/高/续）。给子星升且居自宫=子显赫；设且居异宗宫=子卑隐。给子星与升与福点吉相=子孝爱、得承产；无涉/冲=争吵为害、不继产。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 给子星互吉相=诸子相爱互敬；无涉/冲=争吵多谋。细节可以'给子之星'为升点作转盘（如独立本命）断。
rules.notes: 转盘法同 TTB-321

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 深交深仇（合盘）：观两盘至要之位=日/月/升点/福点。同位或互换（全或多数，尤升区约17°内）=牢固同情不可破；无涉/冲=深仇久争。
rules.notes: 合盘同情/敌意 Ptolemy 原版

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 三分/六分=同情较少；四分=敌意较少。凶星行经此等配置=友谊间冷淡贬谈；吉星入=敌意间休战复和。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 友敌三类（择/需/乐痛）：四至位相熟全=三类兼有；仅光体位相熟=出于选择之友（最稳最善；敌则最恶无信）；仅福点位=出于需要；仅升点位=出于乐/痛。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 观相位诸宫之升（转盘）与行星顾盼：升于其续宫或最近宫之一方=主友谊/敌意之权与向；行星顾盼更利仁与力=益多成多。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 偶交偶争：观两盘行星续命（prorogation）至对方之位——最短至续命完成、最长至他星至位。土木互近=引介/农/遗产之友；土火=故意争吵谋算；土金=亲族之交而速冷；土水=婚姻/合伙（给与取）/贸易/秘仪；木火=荣名/财产管理之交；木金=因女/宗教/神谕之友；木水=哲学学论之交；火金=爱/奸/非法之交而不稳短；火水=敌/喧争/讼（商务/毒）；金水=同艺/缪斯/书信或女引之交。
rules.notes: 行星对组合=10 组表

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 交争强度=其所居位与四至要位（角/福点/光体宫）之关系（近=显、远=微）；利害=顾位星之善恶。奴隶主仆=观恶灵宫（12宫）与顾位星之性（含入相位与冲）。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 旅外观二光体对二角（尤月）：月设/离角=旅外迁居；火设/离中天+冲克光体=同效；福点落致旅星座=终身旅外、诸关系事务皆在异邦。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 吉星照/续上述之位=旅显利归速；凶星照=旅劳险危归难。混效按顾位星之主从断。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 方向：光体居东象限下部=东南；居西象限/西没=西北。致旅星座单形（或主星单形）=旅稀且偶发；双体/双形=连续久远。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木金主旅=安悦（贵民/友资送行、天气佳供给足；加水=利得荣赠）；土火制=危（水宫=船难、固宫=坠高风暴、二分二至=乏食病、人形宫=盗谋劫、土形宫=兽攻地震、加水=天气毒咬）。事之利害质按行为/财/体/荣诸要位之主分判；应期=五星入相位之时。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 死质观：先由寿命法定毁法（射芒会遇 or 降至西没）；射芒会遇则观会遇处、降至西没则观西没本身——其上之星（或首近之星）之质=死之质；相位星之性与其处宫性与界增复杂。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土主死=久病/痨（phthisis）/风湿/虚脱/寒热/脾疾/水肿/肠疾/子宫疾/过冷之疾。
rules.notes: 映射E 土行

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木主死=缢/肺炎/中风/痉挛/头痛/心病/气息不匀或秽浊之疾。
rules.notes: 映射E 木行

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 火主死=热病（持续或隔一日半间日）/卒中/肾病/咯血/出血/流产/产难/丹毒/瘟疫/过热致死之疾。
rules.notes: 映射E 火行

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金主死=胃/肝/肠疾、癌/瘘/苔藓、服毒、湿过或湿不足之祸。
rules.notes: 映射E 金行

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水主死=狂/疯/忧郁/癫痫/咳喘之疾/干过或干不足之疾。
rules.notes: 映射E 水行

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 自然死=死主居自家/相熟性且无致伤星克；暴死/显死=二凶星主破坏位（合/四分/冲/占光体）；凶合=祸之质、光体证=量、他星照与凶位=质之细。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 暴死细分：土四/冲日（异宗+固形宫）=乱踩/缢/硬结死（月近土设同）；兽形宫=野兽死（木证且木受克=公场斗兽）；土在升冲光体=狱死；土照水（近天蛇区/土形宫）=毒虫咬死（金在=毒杀/女谋）；处女/双鱼水相+月照=溺/水窒死；近Argo=船难；二分二至四足宫土与日/火=屋崩压死；中天=坠高死。火四/冲日月（异宗+人形宫）=党争/敌杀/自杀/因女死（金证）或杀女死；水照=海盗/盗/罪犯手死；残缺宫/Perseus戈尔贡=斩首肢解；蝎/牛=医灼割截/痉挛死；中天对点（尤Cepheus/Andromeda）=钉刑；西没冲升=焚死；四足宫=屋崩/折/压死（木证且木受克=公判/王怒显死）。双凶共处=祸倍（无吉照下天=无葬、兽鸟食）；外乡死=破坏位之星居降位（尤月居/四/冲上述之区）。
rules.notes: '仅规则引擎研究与复现，不作现实用途'；恒星区（Argo/Cepheus/Andromeda/Gorgon）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 判时总则：普遍命运（出生地/人种形貌风俗）先于特殊；各预测须与年龄相配（不判婴孩婚嫁、不判老人育子）。七曜序=七龄：月始、土终。
rules.notes: 映射F；与 Valens 大限/小限体系之 Ptolemy 源头

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 月=婴儿期（约至4岁，四年数）：身柔韧速长、食湿、境多变、心智未成无语——应月之质。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 水=童年期（次10年，二十年之半）：启智构理性、植学问种子、显个性才具、以训导体操唤醒灵魂。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 金=青春期（次8年，应己数）：激生殖之欲、种爱欲之冲动——狂迷/不节/求偶/炽情/巧诈/情痴。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 日=青年期（次19年，中天星）：授行事之主导、求财/荣/位，由嬉戏无知转庄重严肃野心。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 火=壮年期（次15年，应己数）：入严酷忧劳、身心皆苦，感暮年将临、以勤成事。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 木=初老年（次12年，应己数）：脱手工劳役、得庄重远虑退隐、通盘议劝慰；重名重独立、谦而有庄。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 土=老年（末段，余年）：身心冷却、动止迟缓、欲乐速皆阻；衰耗、萎顿、弱、易怒、难悦——应土之迟滞。

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 特殊判时：诸续命分派——升点续命=体与旅外、福点=财产、月=心与婚、日=荣名、中天=行为/友谊/育子；诸续命分列（一吉一凶星不统一切：可同时丧亲而承产/病倒而升迁/厄中得子）；会遇取一切星（不限破坏星）+三分六分。
rules.notes: 引擎模块：各续命独立成事件流

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 时主分配：续命度上或照其度之星领时，至次一照续度之星，依序相传；界主分其治。年数=升续命=该纬升时数、中天续命=中天时数、余续命=依离角近升/落/中天之比（同寿命法）。
rules.notes: 可编码：时主序列=续命度顺行遇星

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 年时主（annual chronocrators）：自各续命宫顺宫序从生年起数，一岁一宫，取末宫之主；月=自生月数28日一宫；日=自生日数2⅓日一宫。
rules.notes: 可编码：年=宫一年、月=宫28日、日=宫2.33日（profection 系 Ptolemy 源头）

rules.book: Ptolemy《Tetrabiblos》Book IV（意外之事：财/官/婚/子/友/旅/死/时）
rules.original_text: [Robbins 1940 版权译本章节；原文不摘录，本条为规则转述]
rules.translation: 入相位（ingresses）观：土入总时位、木入年位、日月火金水入月位、月过日位；总时主主成、分时主助/阻（依本性相熟/不熟）；应期=年月宫与致因位及入宫相位；同时主时与入=事极（原司者更极）；全幸全不幸=诸续命同位或同时遇合皆吉/皆凶。
rules.notes: 可编码：行星入相位（transit/solar return 系源头）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.result: 宫主（角位）→星座序/度数序
rules.original_text: If the houseruler is found to be at an angle or operative, it will begin the chronocratorship; the rule will then pass to the stars next in order in the order of signs. If these stars are in the same sign, their positions in degrees must be calculated, since the one in the leading position will rule first.
rules.translation: 时主分配总则：宫主在角/operative=起始时主，随后按星座序传递；同座之星按度数先后——领先度数先主。
rules.notes: Book VII 1K：以上升为纲

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: It is of primary importance to inspect the Ascending angle and to see how its houseruler is configured: if they happen to be together or appropriately configured in different signs, the houseruler will have a good effect on the length of life and on mental activities. They have a bad effect when setting, in opposition to each other or inappropriately configured, because when the houseruler completes the rising time of the sign in the Ascendant... it will abdicate from the chronocratorship; in so doing, it will make the native short-lived, or it will allot months instead of years, days instead of months.
rules.translation: 升宫主配置：与上升同座/善配=利寿与心智；沉/对冲/劣配=短寿——退位时以月代年、以日代月。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.result: 合升之星起主/角前=不足额
rules.original_text: If the ruler of the Ascendant is not in conjunction, but another star is, then the latter star will begin the chronocratorships. If several are in conjunction, they all will share <in the chronocratorship>, with the star closest to rising or most related to the <Ascendant> sign ruling first. If they are not found at the angles but are just preceding them, they will rule the chronocratorships briefly, or for as long as they transit a part of the sign (in degrees), and they will fall short of their own numbers and rising times.
rules.translation: 无合相之星时：合上升之星起始时主（多星合相=共享，最近上升/最亲升座者先主）；角前之星=短暂主（按度数行经之限，不足额）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: After examining the Ascendant, it is necessary to investigate MC and to determine its ruler; then examine the Descendant and IC in the same way. If <their rulers> are not found at the angles, the rulerships which follow the angles must be examined; if the stars are not in those signs either, the signs which precede the angles must be inspected.
rules.translation: 四角逐一查主：角主不在角→查角后星座→再查角前星座（效力弱但活跃）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: It is also necessary to take into account the contacts and aspects of the moon and the ruler of its sign, because if it is found at an angle and has the configuration of a distributor, it will be the first chronocrator. Following it, the stars closer to the angles or passing through a phase will rule.
rules.translation: 月之接触与相位：月/其座主在角且具分配配置=首时主；其后角近之星或临相位者主。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.result: max(上升时数,周期) 或 合计
rules.original_text: If the stars are at or following the angles, they allot the total rising time and period of each star. If the period of the star is found to be greater than the rising time of the sign, the star which has the chronocratorship allots its period. If the rising time is greater than the period, we allot the rising time. Occasionally they allot their total years <rising time+period>. If many stars are together, and if the periods of all exceed the length of the rising time, they allot the periods. If the periods are less than the rising time, they allot the rising time.
rules.translation: 时主年数分配：星在角/角后=足额（上升时数与星周期取大者；或二者合计）；多星共处=诸周期俱超上升时数则取周期、否则取上升时数。
rules.notes: 与升/星无关系者（角前）=最少周期；正位/恰当星座=仅其星座上升时数

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: It is necessary to be aware in advance that malefics are not always harmful; they can be helpful and the cause of life and rank. In the same way benefics can bring dangers and harm—all of which can be foreseen through the appropriateness of their configurations or their oppositions.
rules.translation: 吉凶非恒：凶星可为生与位之因、吉星可致危害——按配置适当与否/对冲与否判（基础论总纲）。
rules.notes: 凶星对中下命=实凶（吉助暂得即失）；对高命=烈而显（暴死/败亡，名传后世）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: With respect to lofty nativities, malefics make men active, renowned, successful. Still, even then these stars do not cast off their own nature: these men have a bold, terrifying, dictatorial, greedy, and destructive nature... While they are in office, plagues, famines, crop failures, cataclysms, earthquakes occur—depending on the configuration of each malefic.
rules.translation: 凶星-高命效应：凶星使高命者活跃成名，但本性不改——悍/怖/专/贪/毁；在位时灾疫饥荒地震随之（随各凶配置）；暴死偿罪、名传后世。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: those stars which are in superior aspect or which are opposed to each other are most powerful; those which are in their own or in opportune signs and which rule the chronocratorship are most vigorous and active in producing results. Let the opposition of Saturn and Jupiter be considered productive and beneficial, particularly when these stars are in their own signs, provided that this configuration is not harmed by another afflicting influence. Likewise, the mutual configuration of Jupiter and Mars is good, if it happens to be in appropriate signs.
rules.translation: 强势配置：右照/对冲=最强；本座/恰当座=最活跃。土冲木=有益（本座尤，除非另受克）；木火互配=吉（恰当座）。
rules.notes: 一星入他星之座且有关系=其时主期有益

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: often a star which is in a given sign, which is completing its own period or the time-interval <=rising time> of the sign, and which is apparently passing out of its time as chronocrator, combines with another star and becomes the cause of a different outcome or continues to keep the nativity in the same condition. In addition, the sextile aspects must be taken into consideration, because they are powerful and beneficial, particularly when they alone are operative. For infant nativities, it is necessary to calculate the chronocratorships of the stars in aspect using first the days, then the years.
rules.translation: 周期交接：星将出期时与它星合流=改果或持状；六合相位=有力而益（独作时尤验）；婴孩盘=先算日再算年。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: The stars allot the mean length of the periods which they rule: The sun has half of 120 years and hence receives 60; its minimum period is 19. The total is 79, half of which is 39 years, 6 months. The moon... 39 years, 6 months. Mars... 40 years 6 months. Venus... 46. Mercury... 48. Jupiter... 45 years 6 months.
rules.notes: Valens 自评'最科学'（映射C）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: calculate the periods of the stars and the rising times of the signs from the Lot of Fortune and its ruler, first by hours, then by days, months, and years; or calculate hours for some, days for others, months for others, and years for still others... For men who are already in the prime of life it is possible to allot periods and rising times; for infant nativities begin with the shortest units.
rules.translation: 福点子分布法（寿命精细法）：自福点及其主按上升时数+星周期分配——先时→日→月→年（成人可径给年；婴孩自最短单位起）。
rules.notes: 三因子 min/mean/max；例：升天蝎福点天秤（klima6）→金8日8时+天秤上升43时+土57时+火15时=13日3时

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: If the chronocratorships of the aspects are combined, the results will come to pass in one-half, one-third, or two-thirds of the time, provided each one does not hold <the chronocratorship> alone... as for my statement about one-half, one-third, or two-thirds of the time: the cut will come at the Place of Injuries if you calculate the distance in degrees.
rules.translation: 分数法：组合时主（多星共管）应验于全期的 1/2、1/3 或 2/3——依各星是否独主而定；切割位在伤位（按度数距离）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.result: 上升时数+对冲凶星=应验
rules.original_text: An example: sun, moon, Mercury in Sagittarius, Saturn in Cancer, Jupiter, Ascendant in Scorpio, Mars in Capricorn, Venus in Aquarius, Lot of Fortune in Scorpio, klima 2. In his 33rd year he was exiled: the rising time <33> of Cancer in which Saturn was located with Mars in opposition. The moon sextile to Venus indicated treachery from female individuals during the 33rd year. He was also in danger in his 27th year because of Capricorn and in his 30th and 40th years because of bodily illnesses of the eyes and feet.
rules.translation: 判例1（流亡）：日月水射手/土巨蟹/升天蝎/火摩羯/金宝瓶/福点天蝎/klima2——33岁流亡（土所在巨蟹上升时数33+火冲）；月六合金=女性之叛；27岁摩羯之险、30/40岁目足之疾（巨蟹25+火15=40）。
rules.notes: 引擎回测基准（映射A）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Venus in Libra, Saturn in Aries, Jupiter in Taurus, Mars <in Libra>, Mercury in Virgo, moon in Sagittarius, Ascendant in Libra, klima 3. In his 39th year he was exiled: the rising time of Aries is 20, and Saturn is there with the sun (19) in opposition. Both were in opposition to their own exaltations.
rules.translation: 判例2（流亡）：日金天秤/土白羊/木金牛/火天秤/水处女/月射手/升天秤/klima3——39岁流亡（白羊上升时数20+日19冲；双双对冲自身旺点）。
rules.notes: 与兄（判例1）异 klima 同时应——'自然法则'

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury, Ascendant in Sagittarius, moon in Cancer, Saturn in Leo, Jupiter in Capricorn, Mars in Aquarius, Venus in Scorpio, klima 2. In his 34th year his wife died because of the 19 of Leo <=sun> and the 15 of Scorpio <=Mars>, or the 15 of Mars itself, since both malefics hemmed in Venus. In his 36th year he was about to go on trial, being accused before the king on a charge arising from the death of his wife... but he fled into exile. For 36 is the rising time of Leo and of Scorpio as well, the location of Venus, in inferior aspect with Saturn.
rules.translation: 判例3（妻亡/讼）：日水升射手/月巨蟹/土狮子/木摩羯/火宝瓶/金天蝎/klima2——34岁妻亡（狮子19+天蝎15=34，双凶夹金）；36岁被控杀妻出奔（36=狮子与天蝎上升时数，金位天蝎对土下照）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mars, Venus in Sagittarius, moon in Libra, Saturn in Gemini, Jupiter in Virgo, Mercury in Scorpio, Ascendant in Capricorn. In his 19th year his father died violently and he himself was blinded by eye trouble. In the same year he travelled abroad and was in danger at sea, because the sun's period <19> was operative, with Mars in conjunction and Saturn in opposition.
rules.translation: 判例4（父暴亡/目盲）：日月火金射手/月天秤/土双子/木处女/水天蝎/升摩羯——19岁父暴亡+目盲+海外海险（日周期19运作、火合土冲）。
rules.notes: 20岁神谕药膏复明；土双子仍运作+水20=多厄

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Jupiter, Ascendant in Cancer, moon in Sagittarius, Saturn in Gemini, Mars in Taurus, Venus, Mercury in Leo, klima 3. After serving in a distinguished military post, he was involved in an accusation in his 38th year and lost his rank: the rising time of Taurus, 23, and the period of Mars, 15 were operative for a total of 38. In addition, the sextile configuration of Saturn and Venus totalled 38.
rules.translation: 判例5（讼失位）：日木升巨蟹/月射手/土双子/火金牛/金水狮子/klima3——38岁军职遭讼失位（金牛上升23+火15=38；土六合金=38）。
rules.notes: 37岁月25+射手12=37（土冲）结怨；39岁系狱（水20+狮子19=39，对土六合弱）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury in Sagittarius, moon in Cancer, Mars in Virgo, Venus, Ascendant in Libra, klima 1. In his 69th year he was judged worthy of the governorship and became feared and spectacularly respected... He was overtaken by painful illnesses and death. Operative at the time were the rising time of Libra <Ascendant>, 38;20, and that of Cancer <MC>, 31;40, for a total of 69. The malefics happened to total the same length of time: 30 for Saturn, 19 for the sun, plus 20 for Mercury total 69.
rules.translation: 判例6（总督任上死）：日月土木水射手/月巨蟹/火处女/金升天秤/klima1——69岁拜总督、惧而敬、众谤乱政、未满任病亡（升天秤上升38;20+巨蟹MC31;40=69；土30+日19+水20=69）。
rules.notes: '众星可同时运作'之证（映射A）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: For example: sun, Mercury in Gemini, moon in Aquarius, Saturn, Venus in Leo, Jupiter in Sagittarius, Mars, Ascendant in Libra, klima 1. Assume we are investigating the 42nd year. I took the rising time of Libra, 38;20... plus the same number of months, 38... The total is 41 years 6 months. In that year while fleeing from battle, he fell from his horse as the enemy were approaching... pretended to be dead, and escaped the danger.
rules.translation: 判例7（坠马脱险）：日水双子/月宝瓶/土金狮子/木射手/火升天秤/klima1——42岁败逃坠马装死脱险（天秤上升38;20+38月=41.5岁；金8月+火15月续至44岁留敌国领军）。
rules.notes: 狮子35+土57月+金8月+月25月+狮子19月=44年1月

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: For example: sun, moon in Leo, Saturn in Virgo, Jupiter in Pisces, Mars in Sagittarius, Venus in Gemini, Mercury in Cancer, Ascendant in Libra, klima 7. In his 37th year he suffered a lawsuit about an inheritance on account of his wife... He lost the case at the king's court. The moon trine with Mars indicated the 37th year: 25 for the moon plus 12 for Sagittarius <=Jupiter> total 37.
rules.translation: 判例8（遗产讼败）：日月狮子/土处女/木双鱼/火射手/金双子/水巨蟹/升天秤/klima7——37岁因妻争遗产败于王廷（月三合火=25+射手12=37）；35岁曾胜诉（双鱼15+双子20+双子27+金8=35）上诉败。
rules.notes: 妻盘（升摩羯）：25岁似胜（月25）/27岁败（双子上升27）；'时主=吉凶互动'引 Petosiris

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury, Jupiter in Scorpio, moon in Taurus, Saturn in Aquarius, Mars in Virgo, Venus in Libra, Ascendant in Leo, klima 2. In his 52nd year he had a very great quarrel and a lawsuit with his sister about property and an inheritance, and he won at the king's court. The configuration of opposition was operative: 25 for the moon, 12 for Jupiter, 15 for Scorpio <=Mars>, for a total of 52.
rules.translation: 判例9（兄妹争产胜诉）：日水木天蝎/月金牛/土宝瓶/火处女/金天秤/升狮子/klima2——52岁与妹争产胜（月25+木12+天蝎15=52；天蝎36+木12+土30=78→2/3=52）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury in Capricorn, moon, Mars, Ascendant in Taurus, Saturn in Scorpio, Jupiter in Cancer, Venus in Pisces, klima 6. In his 30th year he escaped slavery, committed many robberies, avoided capture for a short time, but was caught in the same year. Both sets <of signs> in opposition were operative <Taurus/Scorpio, Cancer/Capricorn>: they both total 60, one-half of which is 30.
rules.translation: 判例10（奴逃劫盗）：日水摩羯/月火升金牛/土天蝎/木巨蟹/金双鱼/klima6——30岁脱奴籍行劫暂脱终被擒（对冲两组各60→1/2=30；土30+火15→2/3=30）。
rules.notes: 吉星暂佑脱险/凶星终败

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Saturn, Mercury in Sagittarius, moon in Cancer, Jupiter in Taurus, Mars in Leo, Venus in Capricorn, Ascendant in Virgo, klima 2. The native, although of governing rank, fell into the governor's disfavor and was condemned to the mines/quarries in his 34th year. Mars, together with the sun, controlled the chronocratorship: 19 for the sun plus 15 for Mars total 34. In his 36th year, through the help of the great, he was released from confinement as disabled.
rules.translation: 判例11（矿役/岛流）：日土水射手/月巨蟹/木金牛/火狮子/金摩羯/升处女/klima2——34岁失宠判矿役（日19+火15=34）；36岁贵人释（狮子上升36）；39岁再流放岛（日19+水20=39）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury in Capricorn, moon, Saturn in Sagittarius, Jupiter in Cancer, Mars in Virgo, Venus in Aquarius, Ascendant in Libra, klima 2. In his 48th year he saw the death of his beloved son, a very great sorrow, and in the same year the death of his mother. Virgo and Libra indicated this because of their equal rising times <40>: 8 years for Libra <=Venus> plus 40 for Virgo total 48.
rules.translation: 判例12（丧子丧母）：日水摩羯/月土射手/木巨蟹/火处女/金宝瓶/升天秤/klima2——48岁丧爱子+丧母（处女与天秤等升时40：天秤金8+处女40=48；处女40+射手32=72→2/3=48）。
rules.notes: 火星伴升=情感之悲

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury, Venus in Leo, moon in Virgo, Saturn in Libra, Jupiter in Capricorn, Mars in Aries, Ascendant in Cancer, klima 6. From observation... since the nativity was that of an infant, I calculated them as months, not years. At the completion of his eighth month and for part of his ninth, he was subject to convulsions and was almost in danger of dying... In his 33rd month he died: the rising time of Cancer equalled this figure.
rules.translation: 判例13（婴孩月算）：日水金狮子/月处女/土天秤/木摩羯/火白羊/升巨蟹/klima6——婴孩按'月'计：8月惊厥危（天秤金+土）；32月危（火15+白羊上升17）；33月死（巨蟹上升33；月25+天秤8=33）。
rules.notes: 关键：婴孩盘单位换算=月而非年（分数法同）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Another example: sun, Mercury in Libra, moon in Aquarius, Saturn in Pisces, Jupiter in Capricorn, Mars in Aries, Venus in Leo, Ascendant in Cancer, klima 6. The native was rich, but in his 47th year he was exiled, for Saturn was operative at MC, the IX Place, as was the rising time of Pisces: 30 for Saturn plus 17 for Pisces total 47.
rules.translation: 判例14（富者流亡）：日水天秤/月宝瓶/土双鱼/木摩羯/火白羊/金狮子/升巨蟹/klima6——47岁流亡（土在MC/IX=流亡判据+双鱼上升17：土30+17=47；日火冲组合71→2/3=47）。
rules.notes: 土MC夜生=流亡/火随MC昼生=流亡（VD-029）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: An example: sun, Mercury in Libra, moon in Taurus, Saturn in Cancer, Jupiter in Sagittarius, Mars, Venus, Ascendant in Scorpio, klima 2. During his 40th year he was condemned to exile. The 40th year was indicated by the superior aspect of Saturn to Libra: 32 degrees for Cancer plus 8 for Libra <=Venus> total 40. Also the opposition of the moon to Venus <was operative>: 25 for Taurus <=moon> plus 15 for Scorpio <=Mars> total 40.
rules.translation: 判例15（流亡40）：日水天秤/月金牛/土巨蟹/木射手/火金升天蝎/klima2——40岁判流（土上照天秤：巨蟹32+天秤金8=40；月冲金：金牛月25+天蝎火15=40）。
rules.notes: '因女获利而行之果'——月接触火（25+15=40）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.result: 土MC(夜)/火MC(昼)/月相+土火相位
rules.original_text: Saturn at MC for night births is indicative of exile <as in the previous nativity>. Mars following MC for day births forecasts the same. If the ruler of MC is in aspect to the right with MC or is operative, then after the exile, there will be recovery and restoration... New or quarter moons with Saturn in square, opposition, or conjunction are indicative of exile. Likewise full or first quarter moons with Mars in opposition, square, or conjunction indicate great ruins and disaster.
rules.translation: 流亡判据表：夜生土在MC=流亡；昼生火随MC=流亡；MC主右照MC=流亡后复权；新月/上下弦+土四分冲合=流亡；满月/一弦+火冲分合=大毁难。
rules.notes: 凶星在角=一蹶不振/角后=屡变/角前=坠亡绑掠暴终

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: If they are in solid signs and degrees, the native is laid low once and for all; if they are in bicorporeal signs, often; if in tropic signs, they defame men far and wide; if they are at the angles, the native goes from the greatest good fortune to the greatest bad fortune; if they follow the angles, they make the native suffer and expect changes, one after the other; if they precede the angles, they involve him in downfall, kidnapping or banditry, violence, tortures, and a miserable death.
rules.translation: 凶星月相位置效应：固定座=一败涂地；双体座=屡败；启动座=毁誉远播；角位=极福转极祸；角后=连番变故；角前=坠亡/绑掠/暴死。
rules.notes: 昼生月角前/夜生日角前=艰；凶星四分日月=大战争叛乱见杀

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: In general, Saturn opposed to Mars is not good for either a free man or a slave: ill fortune will extend far. When in square or opposition, these stars make toilsome and troubled men. It is best if such configurations of these stars precede the angles, because if they occur at the angles, they bring death to <good> fortune and danger to occupations and to the whole basis <of the nativity>. If they follow the angles, they cause expected good to turn to the worse... If, however, benefics are in aspect with the above-mentioned configuration, the bad will be less or can be alleviated.
rules.translation: 土火对冲=不利（自由人或奴皆然）；四分冲=劳苦忧患之人——最佳角前（角位=死福害业、角后=善转恶抑业）；吉星照=减轻。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: <The King says> 'Let the moon be in any sign or at an angle, and let the star of Mars be just preceding or just following the moon in the contiguous sign; then the moon has 'contact' with it. And so, even if the star is not in the same sign as the moon, but is found in the adjoining sign, or in the sign in square or in opposition, then consider the contact to be solid. Sum up their periods or the rising times of the signs to forecast the chronocratorship.'
rules.translation: 月接触判据（王引文）：火星在月之邻座/四分/冲=月与其'接触'成立——并其周期或星座上升时数以断时主。
rules.notes: 例证：'月在天蝎而火在邻座'→月火接触

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: Carefully examine the motion of the moon, because whenever it is rising, beheld by Mars or Saturn square to the right or left, one must beware of the transmission—which will be in no way beneficial. If this happens in the chronocratorship of a malefic, e.g. in the chronocratorship of the star of Mars, the native will come into close confinement or be involved with wounds. If the star of Mercury is associated... it indicates that the assault or imprisonment will occur because of documents. Saturn in aspect or in conjunction <shows it occurs> because of old matters, ancestral matters or the like, or because of an older person. If the star of Venus is chronocrator, and if the star of Mars happens to be in the houses of the star of Venus, <the attack occurs> because of a female person. If the star of Jupiter is chronocrator and if the star of Mars is in the houses of Jupiter, <it occurs> because of royalty or magnates.
rules.translation: 月升被火土四分照=传递必不善：火星时主期=系狱或创伤；事因分类——水星参=文书；土星照=旧事祖业/长者；金星时主+火在金之庙=因女；木星时主+火在木之庙=因王公。
rules.notes: 第4层解读：时主星+凶星位置→事件归因

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: The native obtains great advancement if the star of Jupiter, while being chronocrator, is at MC or in the Place of Accomplishment with the star of Mars. When Jupiter and Mars are providing the active impulse, it will be necessary to see if the star of Saturn is coming into a transit or opposition, with the result that the chronocratorship of occupations becomes contrary. If the star of Mercury is the ruler, and if the star of Jupiter receives the chronocratorship from Mercury, the native will advance in business and will fare well at those times.
rules.translation: 升进判据：木星时主在MC/成位（与火同）→大进；木火运作时土星行运/冲=职业时主逆转；水星时主传木=业进得利。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: The star of Saturn coming into the place brings reversals and the chilling of affairs; if it comes into a place of <several> stars in conjunction and if the star of Mars has the Place of Accomplishment while the star of Saturn has the Place of Employments, it brings mortal danger. In every case the star of Saturn in the Sign of Accomplishment must be considered harmful. <It is also harmful> when in opposition to this Place and to the places of the stars of Mars, Venus, and Mercury.
rules.translation: 土星入位=反转与事冷；火有成位+土有业位=命危；土在成位=恒有害；土冲成位/火金水之位=亦害。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book VII——判例集（时主应验实证）
rules.original_text: In every case the phases of the moon waxing from new to the quarter must be observed, particularly in the X Sign <=MC> (as was mentioned) and when aspected by malefics... The moon is helpful when it is in the place of benefics, if indeed it is discovered to be in the places which are opportune for the nativity.
rules.translation: 月相监查：新月至上弦之盈月（尤在MC）被凶星照=须防；月在吉星位=有益（恰当位）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The primary period is one-fourth of the minimum period, as follows: Saturn 30→7 1/2; Jupiter 12→3; Mars 15→3 years 9 months; Venus 8→2; Mercury 20→5; Sun 19→4 years 9 months; Moon 25→6 years 3 months. Altogether, the 'fourths' total 32 years 3 months.
rules.translation: 四分之一周期法：每星主期=其最小周期之 1/4（土7.5年/木3/火3年9月/金2/水5/日4年9月/月6年3月）——合计 32 年 3 月为一整轮。
rules.notes: 第3层直接数据

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.result: 新月/满月后之星起 vital sector
rules.original_text: For new-moon nativities, the <star> located first after the new moon begins the vital sector, then the other stars as they come in the order of signs. For full-moon nativities, the <star> following the full moon serves the same capacity.
rules.translation: vital sector 起算：新月生=新月后首星起、按星座序；满月生=满月后之星起。
rules.notes: 32年3月一轮毕→次轮自下一位 1/4 期星起

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Make the distribution of days as follows: if Saturn is found to be the overall apheta, it assigns 7 1/2 years... multiply the 85 days of Saturn by 7 1/2 to get a total of 637 1/2. This is the amount Saturn will allot to itself... To Find the Days of Each Star: double the star's period, then take one-half, then one-third of the period. After adding all these figures together, we will find the days.
rules.translation: 日分配法：总 apheta 之 1/4 期 × 各星日数=该星所得日数（土 85×7.5=637.5）；星之日数求法=周期×2+周期÷2+周期÷3（土 30→60+15+10=85 日）。
rules.notes: 528 日整轮毕→自对冲星座续

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: if we are investigating the chronocratorships with respect to bodily existence, such as critical points of illnesses, hemorrhages, falls, injuries, diseases, and whatever affects the body... then we must begin the vital sector with the Lot of Fortune.
rules.translation: 身体/健康/恋情类时主：vital sector 从福点起算（疾病、出血、坠落、伤害、魅力、恋爱）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: If on the other hand we are investigating employment or rank, then we will begin the chronocratorships with Daimon as the apheta.
rules.translation: 职业/地位类时主：从 Daimon（精灵点）起算。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: if the Lot of Fortune or its ruler are badly situated, the Lot of Daimon will distribute both the bodily and the active qualities. Likewise Fortune will make the distribution of both qualities if the Lot of Daimon or its ruler is unfavorably situated.
rules.translation: 互换：福点/其主不利→Daimon 兼管身体与活动；Daimon/其主不利→福点兼管。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Whenever Daimon and Fortune are found in the same sign, we will derive forecasts of bodily constitution from that very sign, but the forecasts of activity from the sign immediately following.
rules.translation: 福点/Daimon 同座：身体看本座、活动看次座（新月满月盘尤然）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: for male nativities, the vital sector is usually found to begin at Daimon, since these nativities share in activities... For female nativities it begins at the Lot of Fortune because of their bodily functions.
rules.translation: 性别起点：男命时主自 Daimon 起（活动/言谈/信托）；女命自福点起（身体机能）。
rules.notes: 手工艺/体育等身体活动之男亦自福点；婴孩未及活动年龄前亦自福点

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.result: 角-角=贵/角-角前=波折/全角前=凶
rules.original_text: If the distribution, when calculated by sign, is from a place at an angle to another place at an angle, and if at the same time, the houserulers of these places are at angles, in the same sect, and have benefics in aspect, they bring a noble and distinguished chronocratorship. If the places are at angles, but their rulers precede angles or have malefics in aspect, they indicate that the chronocratorship will be disturbed, subject to ups and downs. If every relevant point is found to be preceding an angle, the chronocratorship will be terrible, bringing charges and penalties.
rules.translation: 传递（transmission）质量判定：角→角+宫主在角/同派/吉照=贵显时主；角位但主星角前/凶照=波折；全在角前=凶险（诉讼刑罚、远行变更）。
rules.notes: 角前诸点=外邦/奴隶之象征
