rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: If a star which is controlling the chronocratorship relevant to health is passing through a sign which is not at an angle... the native will be sickly, subject to bleeding and dangers. If a star which is controlling the chronocratorship <of the matters> governed by Daimon is not at an angle and has a malefic in conjunction or in aspect with the houseruler of its sign, the native will act ineffectively, will be unfortunate, and will be mentally unstable and ruined in his activities and enterprises.
rules.translation: 健康时主星不在角/其主不利→病弱出血之危；职业时主星不在角且其座宫主逢凶→行事无效、时运不济、心神不宁、事业败毁。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.result: 火=崩溃/风=散乱/土=坚忍/水=善成
rules.original_text: If the star controlling such a chronocratorship is found in a fiery sign with malefics in conjunction or in aspect, he will suffer a great nervous breakdown... If the star is in an airy sign or if the sign or its ruler are afflicted, the native will be distracted and troubled... If the star is in an earthy sign, he will bear the blows of fortune nobly... If the star is in a watery sign, the native will have a mind which can be easily reassured.
rules.translation: 星座元素定心神：火座+凶照=精神崩溃、违愿而行；风座或受损=心神散乱、自欺所成；土座=坚忍承厄、哲学涵养；水座=易安抚、多变却善成。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: In many cases predictions about specific activities are to be derived from Daimon and its houseruler. Some men are involved in bodily activities (e.g. handicrafts) or in physical toil (e.g. as porters or in training). Others have activities involving speech, knowledge, or mental effort. To whichever place, Fortune or Daimon, the majority of stars incline, in that place the type of activity will be revealed.
rules.translation: 活动类型定法：观福点/Daimon 何者得众星倾向——体劳动（手工艺/搬运/训练）vs 言语知识型；土星主个人才艺/湿质/劳役/遗产，火金水主活动类。
rules.notes: 土/火时主无木星照=卑下；日月+吉星右照=贵显

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The sun rules a maximum period of 120 years, half of which is 60. Half of this, 30, is assigned to Aquarius, the sign in opposition <to Leo, the sun's sign>. The moon rules a maximum period of 108 years, half of which is 54. Half of this, 27, is assigned to Capricorn... The total for these two signs is 57, which is the maximum period of Saturn.
rules.translation: 最大年数：日120（半60、再半30→宝瓶30年）；月108（半54、再半27→摩羯27年）；宝瓶+摩羯=57=土星最大年。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Aquarius allots 30 years, Capricorn 27... By taking one-twelfth of the year (or of each period) we can discover how many days each star/sign allots. For example: Aries allots 15 years. One-twelfth of 15 years is 15 months. Next one-twelfth of 15 months is 37 1/2 days. Next one-twelfth of 37 1/2 days is 3 1/3 hours.
rules.translation: 星座年数细分法：每年期÷12 递降（白羊15年→15月→37.5日→3⅓时）——得年/月/日/时四层时主。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Since the universal year has 365 1/4 days, while the year with respect to the distribution has 360, we subtract the 5 intercalary days and the one-fourth of a day, then we find the number of years. Only then will we make the distribution.
rules.translation: 普世年换算：365.25-5.25=360 日/年——时主分布按 360 日年计（实足年×5.25 闰日另加）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: when investigating the current year of a nativity, we divide by 12. Count the remainder from a star which is able <to transmit> to a star which is able to receive. In this way we will discover to what sign the year transmits... Whenever there are many transmissions, it is necessary to take into account whether benefics or malefics predominate. Award the prize to whichever group does predominate. If neither does, the year should be judged as varied and changeable.
rules.translation: 传递年法（mod 12）：实足年÷12 余数——自可传递之星向可接收之星计数（11 座距=传递）；多传递时看吉凶星孰占多者胜，均势=多变之年。
rules.notes: 日月升亦可传递/接收；传至空位=空位行运星接收

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: To find the overall influence in any nativity, it will be necessary to count the years from the sun, the moon, and the Ascendant, and if the count ends at an empty place, then they <sun moon Ascendant> will be transmitting to the rulers of these <empty> signs. These three figures have great influence...
rules.translation: 三命源（日/月/升）各自计年传递——三源皆吉=年佳；三源互异=年复杂；日主心智、月主身体与母、福点主运势。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: if the sun is at an angle, it is necessary to count from it; for night births count from the moon, if it is at an angle to the degree. If these are inapplicable, count from the Ascendant. If the Lot of Fortune is at an angle, providing the luminaries are inapplicable, make it the beginning of the year.
rules.translation: 年主起算（Seuthos/Hermeios 法）：日处角→从日数；夜生月准合角→从月数；皆不可→从上升；光俱不适用且福点处角→从福点。
rules.notes: 昼生从日（若在升/MC）、否则从升；夜生从月（升且增光更佳）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: <for day births> determine the distance from the sun at the moment in question to the sun at the nativity, then count that distance from the sign which has been allotted the year. For night births, determine the distance from the moon at the moment in question to the moon at the nativity...
rules.translation: 月位法：昼生=现时太阳→本命太阳距从年主座数；夜生=现时月→本命月距；新月/满月盘按其月相座数。
rules.notes: 本命月距新月/满月之日数=月之起点

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: You will find the days as follows: multiply the completed full years from the nativity by 5 1/4. Then add to the result of this multiplication the days from the birth date to the day you are investigating. If the date is in the Alexandrian calendar, add the intercalary days (i.e. one-fourth of the total years). Then divide this sum by 12. Count the remainder from the sign which has been given control of the month... Find the hours as follows: count from the sign which has been given control of the day, giving two to each sign, from the hour of birth.
rules.translation: 日/时算法：日=(实足年×5.25+出生至当日天数+闰日)÷12 余数自月主座数（观止点界主与照星）；时=自日主座每小时给2座从生时数（择时起事极佳）。
rules.notes: 病危/复发时看升与光及他角关系

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: I the Ascendant, life, steering-oar, body, breath. II Life, the Gate of Hades... IV Rank, children, one's own wife and older individuals... VIII Death, benefits from the deceased, the Inactive Place, law, sickness. XII Foreign lands, hostility, slaves, injuries, dangers, tribunals, disease, death, sickness.
rules.translation: 十二宫名义表（Valens 版）：I命身、II生计/冥门、III兄弟/远行/王权/奴、IV地位/子女/妻/家宅/死/困、V子女/友/奴、VI奴/伤/敌/疾、VII婚/成功/女事、VIII死/遗产/法/疾、IX友/远行/神/占星/玄秘、X业/位/子女/变更、XI友/望/赐/子女、XII外邦/敌/奴/危/法/疾。
rules.notes: 对冲宫协同作用；II/VIII=无生/致死位

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: when we investigate the length of life and bodily or mental activities, we count from the Ascendant. On the other hand, when we investigate rank, preeminence, magnificence, the father... we will start the year-count with the sun. For forecasts of dangers to health, diseases, bleeding, or the mother, we will start with the moon. For forecasts of occupations, livelihood, and work, we will start with MC. For forecasts of good fortune and success in life, we will start with the Lot of Fortune. For forecasts of mortality, change, or trouble, we will start with the Descendant. For forecasts of estates, possessions, secret matters, legacies, we will start with IC. For forecasts of women, love affairs... we will start with Venus. For forecasts of military or public matters, we will start with Mars. For forecasts of bankruptcy, money or property, secret diseases, or family inheritance, we will start with Saturn. For forecasts of rank, friendship, alliances, and possessions, we will start with Jupiter. For forecasts of associations, slave matters, servile matters, giving and receiving, or written matters, we will start with Mercury.
rules.translation: 事项-起算点对照表：寿/身心=升；位/父=日；母/疾=月；业=MC；吉运=福点；死变=降；遗产=IC；女性/恋爱=金；军事=火；破产/遗产=土；位望=木；文书/奴=水。
rules.notes: 第4层解读核心：事项→命源→传递链

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: If the transmission is from an angle to an angle, or from <the XI Place of the> Good Daimon to the Lot of Fortune or to an operative place. If so, the forecast will be for success or fame... The operative and effective signs are the Ascendant, MC, <the XI Place of the> Good Daimon, <the V Place of> Good Fortune, the Lot of Fortune, Daimon, Love, Necessity. Signs of moderate activity are <the IX Place of> the God, <the III Place of> the Goddess, and the other two angles.
rules.translation: 有效位清单：operative=升/MC/XI吉神/V吉福/福点/Daimon/爱点/必需点；中度=IX神/III女神/余两角；其余平庸或凶——VI凶福似优于XII凶神（其与MC三合）。
rules.notes: 宫位效力随照星吉凶增减

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The Lot of Love (for day births) is found by determining the distance from the Lot of Fortune to the Lot of Daimon, then counting that distance from the Ascendant; for night births, the reverse. To find <Necessity>: take the distance from Daimon to Fortune; for night births, the reverse.
rules.translation: 爱点（Love）/必需点（Necessity）公式：爱点=福点→Daimon 距从上升数（夜生反向）；必需点=Daimon→福点距从上升数（夜生反向）。
rules.notes: 第3层直接数据（原文边注）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: <The Lot of> Love transmitting or receiving in operative signs, with benefics in conjunction or aspect, brings about moral desires and makes men lovers of the good... If malefics are in conjunction or aspect, desires will result in torment, penalties, and danger. Specifically, if Saturn is in conjunction or aspect with Venus and the moon, men will have shameful and unnatural loves... If Mars and Mercury are in conjunction or aspect... men will love wicked, criminal deeds: they become forgers, robbers, burglars, gamblers...
rules.translation: 爱点时主效应：吉照=向善之欲（学问/技艺/恋爱）；凶照=折磨刑险；土金月=丑秽之爱；火水=为恶之欲（伪造/劫盗/赌）；金=女色。
rules.notes: '此位多方强效，须多留意'

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: <The Lot of> Necessity transmitting or receiving in operative signs, with benefics in conjunction or aspect, brings family ties, associations with the great, and the downfall or deaths of enemies. If malefics are in conjunction, it brings lawsuits, judgements, and expenses... If the configuration is afflicted, men are condemned or ruined.
rules.translation: 必需点传递：吉照=亲缘/贵人/敌败亡；凶照=诉讼/判罚/破费；受损=定罪败毁。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Moon - 1, Year - 1, Mercury - 2, Year - 2, Venus - 3, Year - 3, Sun - 4, Year - 4, Mars - 5, Year - 5, Jupiter - 6, Year - 6, Saturn - 7, Year - 7. The total is 28 years. The degree-assignment <monomoiria> is done as follows: whatever <star> rules the sign in which the moon is located, that <star> is taken as the first chronocrator, then the rest in the order of their spheres.
rules.translation: Critodemus 球序法：月1年→水2→金3→日4→火5→木6→土7（合计28年）——度分配（monomoiria）：月所在星座之主管星为首时主，按球序轮转。
rules.notes: 例：月天秤6°→金（主管）先、水二、月三、土四、木五、火六→该度属火星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The II and the VIII Places from the Ascendant will be considered inactive and fatal. Whenever the transmission or reception is in these Places, the native will benefit from aspects relating to death... Greater benefics will accrue when benefics are in conjunction or aspect. If malefics are in conjunction or aspect, disputatious lawsuits will arise because of a legacy.
rules.translation: II/VIII 宫=无生致死位：传递入此=死亡相关受益（遗产）；吉照=大利；凶照=争产诉讼、年凶危。
rules.notes: 土位=死与遗产；土→木之传递=遗产继承

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: in any nativity Gemini and Sagittarius have the same general effect as the Place of Slaves because of their zodiacal position: when Cancer is in the Ascendant, the Place of Slaves falls in these signs. So even when a native has the Place of Slaves in another sign, but has malefics in these <Gemini Sagittarius>, he will experience disturbances and injuries from slaves.
rules.translation: 双子/射手=奴位（巨蟹上升时 VI 落此）——纵 VI 在他座，凶星在双子/射手仍主奴扰（尤其土星）；吉星则主善待奴仆、受益。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: In horoscopes for paired nativities—brothers, man and wife, relatives, other persons linked by friendship—it is necessary to make the forecast for the individual whom the horoscope best fits at the applicable time, and to say that such and such will happen first or second to this individual; then assign the outcome to the other individual in the second place.
rules.translation: 孪生/配偶/亲属盘：应验先归于最切合者（从MC判定），其余延后——因出行/诉讼/危机而或速或迟。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Assume, for instance, the nativity of a child is presented for interpretation, a child to whom a forecast for the beginning of an occupation cannot apply. When the transmissions of the stars are found, the results will apply to the father and mother, occasionally to his master, until the time when the native, attaining the age of full development, is subject to the indications.
rules.translation: 童子盘：未及立业之龄，传递应验归于父母/师长；只断适用童子之事（赐/遗产/收养/脱臼/疮）。
rules.notes: 应与年龄及邦国风俗法律调和

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The sun transmitting to Saturn brings a bad year. It indicates unemployment, setbacks, hostility and rejection, damage from superiors or elders, rebellions of the lower classes, diseases and eye infirmities... the deaths of fathers. The sun transmitting the year to Jupiter indicates a brilliant year: the father's high rank... gifts, prominent occupations, offices. It brings the begetting of children and marriage...
rules.translation: 日之传递代表：日→土=凶年（失业/挫折/长辈之害/目疾/父亡）；日→木=辉年（父贵/赠/职/得子婚嫁）。
rules.notes: 各星传递效应全表在映射B~I（第4层解读规则核心）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The moon distributing to Saturn brings a complicated and fluctuating year: the sickness or death of the mother... hostility, disarray in business, changes of place... bodily dangers, troubles of the hidden parts or of the sensory faculties—especially if the moon is waning. If it is waxing, the damage will be less.
rules.translation: 月之传递代表：月→土=母病/亡（犹验于亏月；盈月损轻）、乱业/迁移/体危。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: The Ascendant transmitting to a malefic brings a very bad period, especially if the transmission is to Saturn (for night births) or to Mars (for day births). It brings bodily dangers, ups and downs of livelihood, anxiety, disturbing crises, falls, and injuries.
rules.translation: 上升之传递代表：升→凶星=凶期（夜生尤土、昼生尤火）：体危/生计波折/坠伤。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Saturn distributing to itself points to trouble and unemployment, hostility from elders or the great, and disgrace... Saturn distributing to Mars indicates a terrible and dangerous year: illnesses, plots, troubles, dangers, the deaths of family members... hazardous and profitless travel... If the stars are unfavorably situated, they bring about shipwreck and ruin, diseases and injuries.
rules.translation: 土星之传递代表：土→自身=困顿失业/长者之敌/蒙羞；土→火=凶年（病/谋/亲丧/险旅/沉船败毁）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Jupiter distributing to itself brings a good and effective period: help from friends, gifts, successful activities, trusts, stewardships, associations with the great, and the begetting of children. If it is beheld by Mars, it brings ups and downs and untimely expenses.
rules.translation: 木星之传递代表：木→自身=吉期（友助/赐/信托/贵人/得子）；火星照=波折破费。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: For day births, Mars distributing to itself will be unpleasant and disturbing: it brings hostility, harm, abuse connected with public business... For night births Mars is not bad: it promotes success and becomes helpful, especially if it is in operative signs, particularly for those who participate in martial affairs or in public or official life.
rules.translation: 火星之传递代表：火→自身=昼生凶（公事之害/官富所辱）、夜生不凶（成功得力，军事/公职尤宜）。
rules.notes: 昼夜之别=派别规则在时主上的应用

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Venus distributing to itself when favorably situated brings friendships and associations, agreements between men and women, gifts, enjoyable intimacies, marriage, family harmony, pleasures, and profits. If the star is found with Saturn or Mars... it brings criticism, denunciation, whoring, penalties, breaches of faith, treachery from women, trials, and disorder.
rules.translation: 金星之传递代表：金→自身吉位=婚恋友盟之吉；土/火同座或照=诋毁/淫乱/刑/背信/妇人之诈/讼乱。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Mercury distributing to itself is effective and helpful in enterprises and trusts: it causes men who achieve their goals... who gain prosperity from words or accounts. Especially if Mercury is rising, is in operative signs, or is beheld by Jupiter and Venus, it indicates greater trusts and profits. If it is beheld by malefics, it is indicative of anxieties and reversals.
rules.translation: 水星之传递代表：水→自身=成事得力（言辞账目致富）；升/operative/木金照=更大信托；凶照=忧患反复。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: If the sun, moon, and the Ascendant are <the apheta>... whenever we find a transmission in one cycle... we examine the horoscope recast for that year, particularly the transits of the stars, to see if they have a configuration similar to their configuration at the nativity with respect to the transmitters and receivers, and if they have the same phases with respect to the sun. If this is found to be true, we say that the results are certain.
rules.translation: 传递-行运验算法：现年行运星与本命传递/接收之配置相同、对日相位相同→应验确定；配置不同则部分应验。
rules.notes: 12年周期重复但效应不同（依年盘/行运/相位）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Every 12 years the same transmissions are indicated. They will, however, not have the same causative influence, but different... if either Jupiter or Saturn holds the overall chronocratorship and is favorably situated, and if the same star happens to control the chronocratorship in this current period, the native will inherit or will benefit from legacies.
rules.translation: 12 年周期效应示例：木/土主总时主且吉、当前又主时主→得遗产；二三周期同星主年而未主总时主→只得部分利益。
rules.notes: 婚/孕/升迁/系狱等皆随 12 年传递重现而变异

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book IV——时主分布/七曜传递/四福点（宫位事项判法）
rules.original_text: Whenever the year stops, the ruler of the sign gives its period first: Saturn 85 days; Sun 53 days 20 hours; Mercury 56 days 16 hours; Venus 22 days 16 hours; Jupiter 34 days; Moon 70 days 20 hours; Mars 42 days 12 hours.
rules.translation: 年止点日数表：土85日/日53日20时/水56日16时/金22日16时/木34日/月70日20时/火42日12时（止点星座之主管星先给其日数）。
rules.notes: 另法：星在12座之界数=其年数（例：升天秤28年→摩羯土57→水76→金82→木79→火65→月70→日6时）

rules.original_text: The first table from 1° to 6° is constructed as follows: the figure 2 is entered next to Libra 1°... There is a progressive increase of 2. At Libra 7° this sequence is broken and a factor of 14 is added for a total of 26... So every 6° the sequence will be broken, 14 will be added, then 2 will be added <per degree> in each sign. Therefore Libra will have 2 next to Libra 1° and 18 next to Libra 30°. Leo and Pisces have the same arrangement as Libra.

Next in order Scorpio will have 14 next to Scorpio 1°... Aries and Virgo will have the same numbers. Calculate the increments: 2 is entered next to Libra 1°. To this I add 12 (for the circle of signs) for a total of 14. Scorpio has this entered next to Scorpio 1°. Add 12 again to this 14 for a total of 26. Sagittarius has this... Sagittarius 1° will be the same as Taurus 1°; Aquarius 1° the same as Cancer 1°; Capricorn 1° the same as Gemini 1°.
rules.translation: 星座 1° 序列值：Libra 1°=2，逐座+12（天蝎1°=14、射手1°=26…）；同值配对：射手=金牛、宝瓶=巨蟹、摩羯=双子（狮子/天秤/双鱼同序、白羊/处女/天蝎同序）。
rules.notes: 引擎可直接编码 12 星座首值表

rules.original_text: The additional factor in the sequence, 14, indicates the 'illumination' of the moon, while the progressive increase of 12 <from sign to sign> indicates the 'fingers' of the sun. Two times 14 equals 28, the moon's period. Since 2 is entered next to Libra 1°, we subtract 1;40 from it for a result of 0;20... This 3 becomes 60, which is equivalent to one year. We bring the remaining years into the calculation as follows, adding 2;20 to each <degree>.
rules.translation: 第二表（科学构造）：Libra 1°=0;20 起，每度+2;40（=增量 2;20+首值修正 1;40）；断点再减 1;40。14=月照明（28 之半）、12=日手指。60 分制：'3 变 60=一年'。

rules.original_text: First of all, it is necessary to determine the precise position of the sun in degrees, then to examine the previous new moon. Find when the new moon occurred—at what hour and what degree. Then add the total number of days and hours from the new moon to the birth and calculate what fraction this period is of the total time between new and full moon (i.e. 15 days). Then subtract this from the magnitude of the sun's degree-position. (This procedure is for day births; for night births subtract from the degree in opposition to the sun.)
rules.translation: 上升度定法（新月分数法）：新月→出生日时数 ÷15 周期分数；昼生自日度减、夜生自日对宫减，余=时之分数。

rules.original_text: Alternatively, count from the position of the sun to that of the moon and take 1/12 of that figure. See what fraction of the 15 days this is. Then subtract this from the magnitude <of the sun's position>, and consider the remainder to be a fraction of an hour.
rules.translation: 上升度定法（日月距 1/12 法）：日月距取 1/12 → 15 日之分数 → 自日度（或其量）减。

rules.original_text: If the moon is past full, it is necessary to calculate and find the fraction in the same way. When the sun and moon are in syzygy, or if the moon is in the sign of the full moon and is no more than 2° or 3° from opposition, the hour will be considered full. Its fraction will be the number of degrees the moon is from either new or full, whichever is the case.
rules.translation: 月过满月算法：与新月法同构；日月合相或月距冲 2-3° 内=整时；分数=月距新/满月度数。例：日金牛3°月白羊2°（距329°=27月日）→新月距29日→满月后14日×12°=168 vs 冲距149，差19°=1.5月日→取12.5。
rules.notes: 会合周期29日/恒星27⅓/近点27½

rules.original_text: The following will be the method for twins: if the first twin is said to have been born at the first hour, assume that both were born in the same one-half, one of them in the ... quarter, the other in the other quarter... If the first is said to have been born at hour 2, the second at hour 3, assume that he was born at hour 2 1/2.
rules.translation: 双子校准法：首胎报第1时→同年半内分两刻；报2时/3时→实为2.5时；报5时→4.5；7→6.5；8→7.5；10→9.5；11→10.5；12=准。相距 1 时的相邻报时多不可能（实际差半小时+）。

rules.original_text: The first table is designed for finding the length of life... The length <of the seasonal hour> entered next to the degree found to be in the Ascendant is multiplied by 12. We then take 1/30th of this amount, and we say that the degrees entered there allot that same number years and that the hour of death is that number of years away.
rules.translation: 表 I 用法（1/30 法）：升度旁数值×12 取 1/30=年数（该度=死亡时距）。例：Libra 1°=2=60 之 1/30→总时数 180 之 1/30=6/度。

rules.original_text: In the same way, we can take 1/60th of the result of the multiplication by 12 and calculate that each degree of the sign will allot that many years. If the degree in the Ascendant is at a connection/node, the native will be short-lived.
rules.translation: 表 I 用法（1/60 法）：表值×12 取 1/60=每度年数。例：Libra 总 180 取 1/60=3/度→30°=90 年（Libra 最大寿命）。升度在交点=短命。
rules.notes: 表值 2→取与之关联时之半（klima/星座差）

rules.original_text: Entering the table at the degree of the sign in the Ascendant, we see which number is placed next to it. We determine what fraction of 60 this number is; we take the same fraction of the result of the multiplication by 12; and we consider the answer to be the years of life. It is necessary to calculate the figure entered in the table first as hours, then as days, as months, and as years.
rules.translation: 数字分数法：表值=60 之分数→同分×（12×时数）。先按时、日、月、年换算。断点（如巨蟹27°=104年 vs 28°=6年）剧变。

rules.original_text: All of the previously outlined methods are accurate... including the proven and amazing 'three-sign' method. It comprises the following: I accurately determine the degree-positions of the sun and the moon relative to the Ascendant. I enter the table below and determine the ending point of the three signs, starting with the sun's position. Then I go to the sign in the Ascendant and determine in which degree it is located, and I make this the solar gnomon.
rules.translation: 三星法（三因子）第1步：日度入表→得星座→在升座中定位其度数=太阳 gnomon。例：日蝎10°→（蝎列）双鱼→双鱼10°→天秤→升射手14/15°。

rules.original_text: Next do likewise <for the number> entered at the moon's sign: apply the degrees of the solar gnomon to it and again see which sign this place belongs to. Looking for that sign in the Ascendant sign, I consider the resulting degree-position to be the lunar gnomon. Next I determine whether the lunar or the solar gnomon is greater: if the sun's gnomon is greater, the hour requires the addition of the number of signs between them <in the table>; if the moon's, the subtraction. This position will be the required, scientifically established Ascendant.
rules.translation: 三星法第2步：月度+太阳 gnomon 度数→表→升座定位=月 gnomon；比较两 gnomon 行数差：日大=加行数、月大=减行数→精确上升→入表按 klima 查年数。
rules.notes: 日月升任一偏 1-2°=结果不谐（判据）

rules.original_text: The computation of the rising times and of the three factors is done as follows: the rising time of Aries in klima 2 is 20. I double this figure and get 40. I assign to Aries 1° 0;40... adding 0;40 to total the 20 years. Next the second factor: since Taurus rises in 24, I double that figure and get 48, which I add to the 20 of Aries: Taurus 1° 20;48... The first degree of the third factor is Gemini 1° 44;56... by successively adding 0;56 we get a total of 72;0.
rules.translation: 三因子构造：第1因子=白羊（k2 上升时数20）每度 0;40；第2因子起点金牛1°=20;48（白羊20+金牛48分）每度+0;48→44;0；第3因子双子1°=44;56 每度+0;56→72;0。各座按 klim a上升时数同构。
rules.notes: 映射E；第3层预计算表

rules.original_text: For example, consider the following nativity: Nero year 1, Athyr 2, the third hour of the day. The sun in Scorpio 10°, the moon in Aquarius 30°, the Ascendant in Sagittarius... the solar gnomon is at Sagittarius 14° and 15°. The lunar gnomon is in the first row, the solar in the sixth. Since the solar gnomon is greater, and since there are 4 rows intervening, I add this amount to the 14°... So now the Ascendant is at Sagittarius 18°. I enter the <table of> apogonia at Sagittarius 18°, and I find (under klima 6) in the third factor, 73 years. The native died in his 73rd year.
rules.translation: 判例1（Nero 1 Athyr 2 昼3时）：日蝎10°月宝瓶30°升射手。日 gnomon 射手14-15°、月 gnomon 射手1-3°（第1行）、日 gnomon 第6行→差4行+4→升射手18°→k6 第3因子 73 年。
rules.notes: 若月 gnomon 大则减 4→射手10°

rules.original_text: Another example: klima 4, Titus year 1, Phamenoth 20/21, sun in Pisces 29°, moon in Capricorn 27°, Ascendant in Scorpio... the solar and the lunar gnomons agree... the Ascendant needs no addition or subtraction. I enter the <table of> rising times at 4°, and I find (for klima 4) for the Ascendant, Scorpio, in the third factor, 72;33 years. The native died at age 72 1/2.
rules.translation: 判例2（Titus 1 k4）：日双鱼29°月摩羯27°升天蝎。双 gnomon 同（蝎4-5°第2行）→无加减→k4 第3因子 72;33→72.5 岁。

rules.original_text: Another example: Trajan year 17, klima 2, <Mesore> 17/18, the fourth hour of the night. The sun in Leo 22°, the moon in Taurus 14°, the Ascendant in Aries... the lunar gnomon is at Aries 21°... Between it and the solar gnomon is one row, which means 1°. I add this to the previously determined 26°, for a total of 27°. The Ascendant will be at Aries 27°. I enter the <table of> rising times for Aries in klima 2... in the second factor, 42;36 years. The native died in his 42nd year.
rules.translation: 判例3（Trajan 17 k2 夜4时）：日狮子22°月金牛14°升白羊。日 gnomon 白羊26°、月 gnomon 白羊21°、差1行+1→升白羊27°→k2 第2因子 42;36→42 岁。

rules.original_text: Another example: Trajan year 18, Payni 14, the fifth hour of the day, klima 1. The sun in Gemini 20°, the moon in Taurus 27°, the Ascendant in Virgo... There are no intervening rows, and so the Ascendant is Virgo 1°. I enter <the table of> rising times for klima 1, and I find at Virgo 1°, in the second factor, 39;36 years. The native died in his 40th year.
rules.translation: 判例4（Trajan 18 k1 昼5时）：日双子20°月金牛27°升处女。日 gnomon 处女1-3°、月 gnomon 处女4-5°、无行差→升处女1°→k1 第2因子 39;36→40 岁。

rules.original_text: Another example: Hadrian year 12, Athyr 1, the ninth hour of the day, klima 1. The sun in Scorpio 8°, the moon in Capricorn 17°, the Ascendant in Pisces... There are two intervening rows, which equal 2°. I subtract this from the solar gnomon, 9°, since the lunar gnomon is greater... This is the Ascendant in Pisces 7°, and next to it is entered (for klima 1) in the second factor, 26;43 years. The native lived 27 years.
rules.translation: 判例5（Hadrian 12 k1 昼9时）：日蝎8°月摩羯17°升双鱼。日 gnomon 双鱼9°、月 gnomon 双鱼15°、差2行月大→减2→升双鱼7°→k1 第2因子 26;43→27 岁。

rules.original_text: Another example: Vespasian year 1, Epiphi 22, the fifth hour of the day, klima 6. The sun in Cancer 28°, the moon in Scorpio 3°, the Ascendant in Libra... Seven rows are found to be intervening between the lunar and the solar gnomons, and I subtract this figure from Libra 4°, for a result of Virgo 27° as the Ascendant. At this position for klima 6, in the second factor, is entered 81 years. The native died in his 81st year.
rules.translation: 判例6（Vespasian 1 k6 昼5时）：日巨蟹28°月蝎3°升天秤。日 gnomon 天秤4-6°、月 gnomon 天秤22°、差7行月大→减7→升处女27°→k6 第2因子 81 年。

rules.original_text: Another example: Trajan year 18, Thoth 14/15, the ninth hour of the night... So Leo 1° is the Ascendant, next to which is entered (for klima 1) one year. The native died in his first year. Another example: Antoninus year 5... For klima …, in the first factor, is entered 30+. <These are months.> The native died in his third year. Another example: Antoninus year 15... For klima 6, 0;44 years is entered at Aquarius 1°. The native died in his first year.
rules.translation: 判例7-9：Trajan 18 Thoth（日处女22°月宝瓶4°升狮子→双 gnomon 同狮子1-3°→k1=1年）；Antoninus 5（日宝瓶6°月金牛28°→升射手28°第1因子30+月→3岁）；Antoninus 15（日摩羯20°月双子28°→日大2行+2→升宝瓶1°→k6 0;44→1岁）。

rules.original_text: Another example: Antoninus year 21, Athyr 28/29, the third hour of the night... There are five intervening rows, and so I subtract 5° from Cancer 6°, for a result of Cancer 1° as the Ascendant. Next to it is entered 1;2. The native lived 1 year. Another example: klima 6, Trajan year 8, Pharmouthi 26. Most of the sources report the Ascendant as Cancer... but we have found from our calculations that the Ascendant was in Gemini... Entering the table at klima 6, I found 21;55. The native lived 22 years 45 days.
rules.translation: 判例10-11：Antoninus 21（日射手6°月宝瓶3°→升巨蟹1°→1;2→1岁）；Trajan 8（日金牛3°月射手21°，他人报升巨蟹、实算升双子24°→k6 21;55→22年45日）。
rules.notes: '给定的上升不可全信，尤其夜生与冬季'

rules.original_text: There is also the following 'further analysis' researched by us with great labor... I take the remaining degrees of the sign in the Ascendant, 8°, plus the degrees of the sun, 6°, plus those of the moon, 30°, for a total of 44°. I count this off from the moon's sign and the count stops at Taurus 14°, the place of Gemini. I look for this sign <Gemini> in Scorpio, the Ascendant, and I find it at 12°. There are three rows between <Scorpio> 12° and 22°, and so I add 3° to 22°. Scorpio 25° is definitely the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 进一步分析（补法）：(升座余度+日度+月度) 自月座计数→得座与度→在升座定位→行差修正（日 gnomon 参照）。例：余8+日6+月30=44→月座→金牛14°（双子位）→蝎12°→3行差+3→升蝎25°→k6 第1因子 31;28→31 岁。

rules.original_text: Another example: Hadrian year 15, Epiphi 16, the third hour of the day. The sun in Cancer 20°, the moon in Gemini 25°, the Ascendant in Virgo... For klima 2, the figure 21;20 is entered at Virgo 16°. The native died in his 21st year. Another example: Nero year 14... I find (for klima 1) in the third factor, the years 86. The native died at that age.

Another example: Trajan year 12, Payni 8, the second hour of the day... Entering the table for klima 6, I find 30;25 for the first factor, 67;55 for the second, and 110;28 for the third. We calculate the first factor to be the years, the second and third to be the months; these total approximately 181 months, or 15 years, plus the 30 years of the first factor. Together they total 45 years. The native died in his 45th year.
rules.notes: 第1因子=年、第2/3因子=月的合成判例

rules.original_text: Another example: Domitian year 2, Pachon 20, the first hour... For klima 4, I find 71 years for the third factor—and this was his length of life. Another example: Domitian year 5, Athyr 24, 5€ hours... a total of 65. He died in his 65th year. Another example: Titus year 2, Choiak 1, 91/2 hours... I added the three factors to get 78;48. He lived 77;42 years.
rules.translation: 判例16-18：Domitian 2（日金牛27°月处女20°→升巨蟹1°→k4 第3因子71年）；Domitian 5（日射手3°月双子4°→升宝瓶29°→k4 第1 22;33+第2 42;27=65年）；Titus 2（日射手8°月金牛27°→升金牛1°→k巴比伦 0;48+24;56+53;4=78;48→77;42）。

rules.original_text: Another example: Antoninus year 14, Mechir 23, the ninth hour of the day... 5;30 is entered there. He died in his sixth year. Another example: Hadrian year 5, Pachon 23/24, the tenth hour of the night... At this position (for klima 2) is entered 31;25 in the second factor. He died at the end of his 32nd year. Another example: Hadrian year 3, Phamenoth 29/30, 11/2 hours of the night... For klima 2 <at Scorpio 28°> is entered as the first factor 33;<36>. He died at the end of his 33rd year.
rules.translation: 判例19-21：Antoninus 14（日双鱼3°月狮子13°→升巨蟹5°→5;30→6岁）；Hadrian 5（日金牛29°月蝎15°，报升摩羯实算宝瓶11°→k2 第2因子 31;25→32岁末）；Hadrian 3（日白羊7°月双鱼2°→升蝎28°→k2 第1因子33;36→33岁末）。

rules.original_text: The following is a new-moon nativity... I take the time from the day and hour of the new moon to the day and hour of the nativity, which is 7 days 14 hours. This amount is one-half of the period between new and full moon (15 days). I take one-half of the hourly magnitude entered at Sagittarius 8°, which is 12, for a result of 6. I consider this the 'fraction of the hour' figure. I calculate the hours, 9, <for a result of 9×12=108>, and I add this result, plus the fraction of the hour, plus 259;20 for the total rising time. I find the total to be 376;20, from which I subtract 360°... I consult the table under the total rising time, and I find entered there at Aries 29°, the hourly magnitude 16;24... I add to the 29° another 8°... and Taurus 7° becomes the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 表 II 用法（新月盘）：新月→出生 7日14时=15 日之半→时数表值之半=时分数；时×12+分数+总上升时→超360减→查表得升（表值处）→+8°→升度→入表 I 取 1/3（20=60 之 1/3）×12=年。例：Trajan 6 升金牛7°→16;24×12×1/3=65.5 年。
rules.notes: 8° 修正为日度之差（'为何减8°加8°下文解释'）

rules.original_text: The following is a new-moon nativity, known to me by hearsay... Vespasian year 7... From the day and hour of the full moon to the day and hour of the birth was 3 days 12 hours. This amount is 7/30 of the period from full to new moon (15 days). I subtract these days from the magnitude entered at Capricorn 20°, which is 12;20, and the result is 9;12. This will be the 'fraction of the hour' figure... I find this magnitude in the table of total rising times at Aquarius 29°. I add the 8°, and the Ascendant becomes Pisces 7°... I take 13/30 of this and get 68. He died halfway through his 69th year.

rules.result: 冲位界主+同上升时数座
rules.original_text: It is necessary to examine the hostile places and stars, not only with respect to the other stars, but also with respect to the Ascendant, the sun, and the moon. When these come into opposition during their transmissions, they indicate critical points and deaths. Take, for example, Saturn: it is necessary to examine the degrees in opposition to see to which god's term they belong (as entered in the table). The native will die when Saturn is in those degrees, is square <with the Ascendant>, or is in signs of the same rising time... because the rulers of the terms of the degrees in opposition are hostile.
rules.translation: 敌位与敌星：冲位度数之界主=敌星；行星行至冲位/四分/与升同上升时数之座=死期（按时主）。例：土巨蟹21°=金界→对宫摩羯21°=火界→土至摩羯21°死；另判例 木蝎14°（土界）→狮子14°（日界）同上升时数→毁。
rules.notes: 映射F 判例表附；'星不敌自身'（同主不害）

rules.result: 按界主/同上升时数/四分断死期
rules.original_text: An example: Saturn in Cancer 21°, the terms of Venus. The point in opposition is Capricorn 21°, terms of Mars, which was at Taurus 27°. When Saturn is there, the native will die. He died in Virgo because it was square, when calculated by degrees... Mars in Taurus 27°, the terms of the sun... Gemini 27° is in the terms of Venus. The native will die when Mars is in Scorpio or <Aquarius>, the signs of equal rising time, or when it is in signs square with these. If anyone calculates Leo 27°, he will find it to be in the terms of Saturn. Saturn was in Cancer; so the native will die when Mars is in Cancer, in Sagittarius, or in the signs square with them.
rules.translation: 敌位判例：土巨蟹21°（金界）→对宫摩羯21°（火界，火在金牛27°）→土至摩羯死、至处女（四分）亦死；火金牛27°（日界）→同上升时数座蝎/宝瓶、四分座死（蝎27°=水界?、狮子27°=土界）；金蝎27°（日界）→对宫金牛27°（日界）→查同座蝎27°=水界→金至处女（水之座）或四分座死。

rules.original_text: You will find the structure of the table line by line as follows: multiply 1/60 of the magnitude given for each day by 30, and the result will be the span of life. No star will either add to or subtract from it... The numbers associated with the 30° segments in the summer hemisphere should be closely observed... It is not possible for Libra<?> to allot more than 91 years, nor Capricorn more than 75. If some conscienceless <astrologer>... says someone lived more than 91 years, right then one can know that he is lying.
rules.translation: 表结构复述+寿命上限：表值=每日时数之 1/60×30=寿命；断点剧变（巨蟹27°=104年/28°=6年）；冬半球上限：Libra≤91、Capricorn≤75——超限即造假。
rules.notes: 从昼夜平分点（白羊/天秤）算加减

rules.original_text: If the factor for the length-of-life is imprecise by <only> a fraction of an hour... then an almost fatal critical point and a dangerous crisis will happen, but death will not ensue... if someone is born at the third hour, it will also be necessary to examine the second and the fourth hour, and their length-of-life factors... It is necessary to calculate one-half of the years for the degrees following <in the table>, since each degree in the table increases its number by a factor of two.
rules.translation: 精确时辰法：报 3 时需查 2/4 时之寿命因子（近时校准）；表内每度+2——断点前后各取半；升度在序列断点=年数剧变（加/减修正）。

rules.original_text: The Lot of Fortune and Daimon have been explained by us in the preceding. Now again we will return to them to confirm that these places are powerful and controlling... if these Lots are in operative signs with benefics in aspect, they make nativities propitious, distinguished, and profitable. Particularly if the Lots occur in masculine signs and their rulers are operative in masculine houses and behold the place from the right, they cause the greatest and most glorious nativities.
rules.translation: 福点/命主点双点强权论：吉照+operative=吉显利；双点在阳座+主在阳位右照=最贵命；阳座主在阴座失位+凶照=衰败贫困终恶。

rules.original_text: Make special note if the Lots are located in Cancer, Leo, Capricorn, or Aquarius, and are aspected by benefics or by their own stars in operative signs. If the nativity has an illustrious basis, then governors, kings, and rulers arise... Such men are ineffective at first, endure a downtrend... but later their fortunes change, and they attain unexpected support... Those who are assigned a moderate basis are trusted with royal business, are stewards and superintendents—but are subject to ups and downs and hatred.
rules.translation: 双点在巨蟹/狮子/摩羯/宝瓶+吉照=贵命判据：基业贵者=王侯生杀权；先困后达；基业中者=王室政务管家/超监，起落被忌。

rules.original_text: The Places starting from the Ascendant are as follows: I. Life, the basis of years, the psychic spirit—i.e. the Ascendant itself... II. Livelihood, income from property... If the ruler of the new or full moon is found in this Place or in the Place in opposition, it indicates exile... III. Concerning the life of brothers... IV. Concerning the life of parents, religious and secret matters, estates, property, and treasure-troves... XII. Concerning enemies, slaves, and afflicting crises.
rules.translation: 十二宫完整事项系统（Book IX 扩充版，含各宫相对其他宫之视角）：I=命/年基/魂；II=生计/财/新月满月主落此或对宫=流放；III=兄弟（对IV=敌奴/对VII=九宫）；IV=父母/宗教秘密/地产宝藏；V=子女/好运；VI=伤/病/危机；VII=婚使/女命；VIII=死；IX=异邦/神/王/预言/钱；X=业/位；XI=好神/友/欲/得；XII=敌/奴/危机。
rules.notes: 映射G；Asclepius 起始、埃及与迦勒底继之

rules.original_text: First of all, it is necessary to calculate the positions of the Places in degrees: count from whatever point has been determined to be the Ascendant until you have completed the 30° of the first Place; this will be the Place of Life. Then proceed until you have completed another 30°, the Place of Livelihood. Continue in the order of signs. Often two Places will fall in one sign and will indicate both qualities according to the number of degrees each one occupies.
rules.translation: 宫位度数计算法：自升点每 30° 一宫；两宫可落同一座（按度数比例各占）；若每宫恰=星座（罕见）=系狱暴力纠缠之命。

rules.original_text: Be aware of the transits of the stars and their changes of sign at the various chronocratorships... add a number of days to the birth date equivalent to the age (in years) of the native. Then... cast a horoscope for that day. <See> which star, if any, is in the Ascendant or is coming into conjunction with another star... You may consider these to be the periodic forecasts.
rules.translation: 行运年加日法：出生日+岁数=该年行运日→起盘看升点/合相/相位；'年加法'（木土火移动慢位置少变）与'当前星盘法'（可得四分三合冲）两法并陈。

rules.original_text: Through experience I have discovered another aphetic method which uses the zones of the stars. Zoroaster spoke of this method in riddles. Beginning with the moon we count upwards, giving 9 to the moon, 9 to Mars, 9 to Mercury, 9 to Jupiter, 9 to Venus, 9 to Saturn, 9 to the sun. Now we count in the order of signs until 108 years are completed, the maximum period of the moon... I propose to make the following allotment: count off the number of completed years, beginning with the moon's sign and subtracting first the amount which the moon controls. Allot the remainder until 9 years are completed. Then give 9 to each sign, proceeding in the order of signs.
rules.translation: 月命法（Zoroaster 谜语）：自月位起 9 年/星（月火水木金土日）→12 宫 9 年/宫=108 年（月最大周期）；自月座扣除月控年数后按 9 年分配；108 年内 12 命点同力=命长寿。
rules.notes: 同刻出生者命主各异——月位变化所致（Valens 批评 7 区制千篇一律）

rules.original_text: It is necessary to examine the star of Jupiter to see if it is in aspect from the right with the Ascendant (to the degree)... If Jupiter is ahead <of the Ascendant> and is found to have a retrograde configuration, its beneficial effect will be strong... If it is behind <the Ascendant>, it will be naturally better. If it is turned away from the Ascendant, it is bad.
rules.translation: 木星右照升点判益：木在升前（逆行向升）=益强；在升后=自然更善；背转升点=凶。对命点/星/宫位之照=吉。

rules.original_text: The period of Saturn is 30 years. I am investigating at what other numbers this 30-year period is operative. I proceed as follows: I begin with 4 and I factor in the next numbers in order: 4 and 5 make 9; then 6 and 7, for a total of 22; next 8, for a total of 30. So the 30-year period is completed by starting with 4. There will be a Saturnian critical point every 4 years, then every 30, its own period. Jupiter... brings rank every 3 years: 3 plus 4 plus 5 total 12. Mars every 4: 4 plus 5 plus 6 total 15. Venus is found to be unassociated; it will act every 8 years. Mercury acts every 2 years: 2 plus 3 plus 4 plus 5 plus 6 total 20. The moon fills three-year-periods: 3 plus 4 plus 5 plus 6 plus 7 total 25. The sun fills 9-year-periods: 9 plus 10 total 19. The sun also controls 20-year-periods: this period comprises the unit and the 19 year period... the sun allots 120 years as its maximum period (one-half of which is 60).
rules.notes: 映射D；第3层时主关键参数

rules.original_text: The determination of forecasts when a patient takes to his bed must be made in the following way: determine the number of days from the new moon <preceding> the nativity to the birth date; divide this by 4. Make a note of the remainder. Now we take the days from the new moon of the current year to the birth date, and we divide that figure by 4... As the third step, it is necessary to take the days from the new moon preceding the illness to the day when the patient took to his bed. Divide this by 4, and compare the remainder with the previous remainders. If the three figures are the same, the time must be judged fatal. If they are different, the danger... will be escaped.
rules.translation: 疾病盘三余数法：①本命前新月→生日数÷4 余；②当年新月→生日数÷4 余；③病前新月→卧床日数÷4 余——三余相同=致命，不同=脱险。
rules.notes: 映射H；第4层疾病判据

rules.original_text: Through experience we have decided to consider as operative Initiatives not only for the onset of illnesses, but also for the beginning of each and every activity... e.g. the beginnings of buildings and dedications, expeditions, governorships and commands... the horoscope will be cast only for the time of the beginning of the enterprise (i.e. the hour), and for the type of enterprise only.
rules.translation: 择时盘（Initiatives）总则：任何事务起始（建屋/远征/执政/奠基）皆起盘；只按起始时+事务类型（吉凶/持久/损益）判；'反对从一次起始断一切，包括寿命'（Valens 批江湖术士）。

rules.original_text: The sign in the Ascendant is found (for day births) by counting the number of the sun's degree-position from the sun's sign, giving 1° to each sign. The sign where the count stops is in the Ascendant for the nativity—or the sign corresponding to it, in both the diurnal and nocturnal hemispheres. If the degree is located in the nocturnal hemisphere or if the nativity is diurnal, the sign in opposition or the sign square with it will be in the Ascendant. For night births, count in the same way the degree-position of the moon from the moon's sign.
rules.translation: 上升星座法1：昼生=日度数自日座每度一宫计数（夜生用月度自月座）；停点=升或对/四分等效座（按昼夜半球）。

rules.original_text: Alternatively: it is necessary to start counting the sun's dodekatemorion from the sign trine to the left. The sign where the count stops will be the Ascendant—or the corresponding sign.
rules.translation: 上升星座法2：日之十二分位自左三合座计数=升（或等效座）。（=Book I 法1 复述）

rules.original_text: Alternatively, using a compelling method: in the cases when the sun is in the sign of the new moon while the moon is traversing the sign just following the new-moon sign, the Ascendant will be in the sign of the new moon, or in the sign sextile, trine, or opposition, the inclination of the moon determining which one. When the moon is with the sun and at an angle... the Ascendant will be found in the sign square with the moon or in a sign which is unaspected by the moon. If <an astrologer> knows whether the birth was day or night, but does not know the hour, he must draw up <a horoscope> with two signs in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 上升星座法3（新月法）：日在新月座而月行新月后第一座=升在新月座/六合/三合/冲（按月倾度）；月近日且在角=升在月之四分或无关座；不知时辰=两升座法。

rules.original_text: For any nativity it is necessary to see where the dodekatemorion of the moon is located. If it and its ruler are in female signs, forecast a female nativity as a rule... Examine the point in opposition to the dodekatemorion as well: if the dodekatemorion, the point in opposition, or their rulers, fall in a theriomorphic sign, predict a monster or an inviable creature.
rules.translation: 男女命与兽形命：月十二分位及其主在阴座=女命（男命则调上升使十二分位入升）；十二分位/对宫/其主落兽形座（theriomorphic）=怪物或不成活。例：月双鱼19°→十二分位天秤（阳人形）→男命→升狮子15°。

rules.original_text: I take then the rulers of Libra and Aries, Venus and Mars. Mars was in Virgo, Venus in Sagittarius. After <re->calculating the Ascendant from the table of rising times using the reported Ascendant, I find it to be in Leo 15°. I start counting the dodekatemorion from this point to Mars and Venus, and I will consider the one nearest the degree in the Ascendant to be the ruler of that monomoirion: from Leo 15° to Mars in Virgo is a distance of 50. From 15°, I count two additional dodekatemoria to Scorpio; the result is 56. Venus is in Sagittarius... the result will be 12. Therefore this degree-position will be closer to Leo 15°. Since Venus has the closest dodekatemorion, it is necessary to investigate the monomoirion of Venus at Leo 11°, 12°, and 13°.
rules.translation: monomoirion 法（逐度命定）：自升度向行星数十二分位，最近者=该度之 ruler；例：升狮子15°→火在处女（距50=2×25?）→金在射手（12）更近→金星 monomoirion 狮子11-13°=升。
rules.notes: '不是每个命都有同一东点，也不是同等寿命'——horimaia 论

rules.original_text: It is thus necessary to determine the sun's and the moon's hourly motion, expressed in minutes... Then count from the sun to the moon or from the moon to the sun: the same position will be mystically arrived at. Having summed up the total number, divide by 30. Determine what fraction of 30 the remainder is, and take this fraction of the equinoctial times. This fraction of the remainder must also be added to the sun's degree-position. The result will show the apogonion, i.e. the degree in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 寿命法-apogonia（简化版）：日月每小时运动（分）；日月距合计÷30 之余=30 之分数→昼夜平分时之同分→加日度=apogonion（升度）。','每命两 gnomon；昼夜平分点=宇宙 gnomon。
rules.notes: Valens 自评早年复杂乘法版'不佳弃之'——只保留日月运动法

rules.original_text: When the sun and the moon come together, the star which controls (to the degree) their separation will intercept the span of life and the amount <of years>, depending on the ratio of the klima. Whenever one star by itself encircles them (the sun for day births, the moon for night births) and destroys the zodiacal interval <between them>, calculate the remaining part of its sign and subtract it from the equinoctial times. Add the solar or lunar degrees to the remaining fraction; then the investigator will find what he seeks.
rules.translation: 日月接触法：控制日月分离度之星=寿命拦截者（按 klima 比）；昼日/夜月单星围住日月距时：升座余度-昼夜平分时+日月度=所求。

rules.original_text: For day births, the moon is operative from the third hour <of the night> to the third hour of the day, then the sun from the third hour of the day to the third hour of the following night, and again during the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth hour of the same night. Similarly the moon controls the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth hours of the day.
rules.translation: 日月值班表：月掌夜3时至昼3时；日掌昼3时至次夜3时+当夜10/11/12时；月掌昼10/11/12时。
rules.notes: 引擎第3层可编码小时主

rules.original_text: In every case it is necessary to take the distance from the sun's degree-position to the moon's in the order of the signs using the rising times, and to mark the resulting number of degrees as the solar gnomon. Next consult the table of rising times under the klima of the nativity and see what fraction is entered at the sun's degree-position. (This is for day births; for night births, look at the point in opposition to the sun.) Multiply this by 12; then multiply the result by the hour of the day at the delivery. If the result exceeds 360°, subtract 360° and see if the remainder corresponds to the previously determined gnomon. If it does, the hour which was reported will be accurate... If the remainder greatly exceeds the solar gnomon, subtract from the <reported> Ascendant an amount equal to the excess... Thrasyllus used this method, made a scientific beginning, and fashioned a forecast of the end.
rules.translation: Thrasyllus 上升度法：日月距（上升时数）=太阳 gnomon；日（夜用对宫）时数×12×小时→超360减→与 gnomon 比对：等=报时准确；超=减、不足=加→真实上升。

rules.original_text: Even the length of the year has been fixed at different values: Meton the Athenian, Euctemon, and Philip fixed it at 365 1/5 1/19; Aristarchus of Samos at <365> 1/4 1/162; the Chaldeans at 365 1/4 1/207; the Babylonians at 365 1/4 1/144... I thought it best to use Hipparchus for the sun, Soudines, Kidynas, and Apollonius for the moon, in addition to Apollinarius for both bodies (if one applies the addition-factor of 8°, which I believe to be correct)... For the rising times they used the proenklima, and they calculated the 14 klimata.
rules.translation: 年长诸说+用表建议：Meton/Euctemon/Philip=365 1/5 1/19；Aristarchus=365 1/4 1/162；Chaldean=365 1/4 1/207；Babylonian=365 1/4 1/144。日用 Hipparchus、月用 Soudines/Kidynas/Apollonius、双用 Apollinarius（+8° 修正）；上升时数=proenklima、14 klimata。
rules.notes: 映射H；'绝对精确只属神'（Apollinarius 自承偏1-2°）

rules.original_text: One must be sure to make an addition or subtraction of the years to be assigned according to the zodiacal tables, whenever it is located exactly at the node or within the 6° arc <around the node>. With respect to distinguishing the two systems or methods: if they result in the same number of years, or very nearly the same, then observe if the degrees fall in the same sign. If they are in adjoining signs, they will strengthen the basis of years, <if> the sacred gnomon shifts from day to night or from night to day.
rules.translation: 交点加减年：日月升落交点或其 6° 弧内=加减年（'造成事业失败/暴死/不寻常之死'——Book VIII 尾）；两法同年数且同座=坚实、邻座=强弱转移判据。

rules.original_text: For infant nativities calculate as follows: make the moon the aphetic point and assign 2 months 15 days to each sign. Proceed to the contact of the moon or to the signs in trine or square, then to the ray-casting of the malefics. When the sun is the aphetic point, assign 30 months to each sign.
rules.translation: 婴儿寿命法：月为命点=每宫 2 月 15 日（月至合相/三合/四分/凶星光线停）；日为命点=每宫 30 月。

rules.original_text: The procedure which we explained previously in the discourse on conception <VI 9> must be applied: consider the moon's degree-position at the delivery to be the Ascendant at the conception and the Ascendant at the delivery to be the moon's position at the conception. Determine the length in days of the conception, and calculate with reference to the new and full moons and the remaining phases.
rules.translation: 受孕与寿命互证：出生月位=受孕升、出生升=受孕月位；以新/满月与相位算受孕日数→出生升与之相符。

rules.original_text: Take the distance in degrees from the <preceding> new or full moon to the moon's position at the delivery. Subtract the distance in signs. Treat the remainder as the 'fraction' of the Ascendant. Therefore <make> the precise degree-position of the moon evident... Alternatively, take the distance in degrees from the new moon to the moon's position <at the delivery> according to the rising times. Subtract the distance in signs. Then consider the resulting degree to be the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 精确时辰法（新/满月分数）：新或满月→出生月位之度数距-星座距=上升之'分数'；或按上升时数算距-星座距=升度。日按 klima/季节校准昼夜时。

rules.original_text: This method seems scientifically appropriate: combine the remaining degrees of the sun and moon, subtract the distance between them in signs, and treat the remaining degree position as powerful and as the complement of the Ascendant. Consider the remaining <number> in the 30 as the lunar gnomon, using an addition/subtraction factor derived from the equinoctial times. Add the lunar gnomon to the solar, divide by two, and treat the answer as the length of life.
rules.translation: 日月 gnomon 平均法：日月余度合并-星座距=升之补；余数（30 之内）=月 gnomon（平分时修正）；(月+日 gnomon)/2=寿命。

rules.original_text: The appended table is constructed so as to give the sign in the Ascendant and the required, scientific hour of birth. It resembles the roughly accurate table which was constructed (in a puzzling manner) by the King, and which begins with the sun's position at the conception. I have constructed a precise table, starting with the month Thoth (which is odd because it is month #1), then with Phaophi (which is even because it is #2)... Enter the appended table at the day in question and at the operative month, and we will find for day or night nativities the hour of the birth on that same line.
rules.translation: 升座与科学出生时表（王表改进版）：自 Thoth 起奇偶月交替；按日/月入表=昼夜出生时（原表以受孕时日起算，Valens 改进为逐月表）。
rules.notes: 原表在王处'谜样'粗糙；此表未载于传本

rules.original_text: The first sheet is the daily motion of the moon, from the minimum factor of 11 <hours>, going from one square to another in the first row. The same series of intervals is in the bottom row, extending to the 15 hours/squares of the maximum factor. From the top to the bottom are 48 rows. So there is an increase of 5 minutes <per row> from the 11 hours to row 48 <15 hours>, i.e. 4 full hours, the excess <of 15 over 11>. When 60 minutes are completed, there is a red mark to indicate the beginning of another cycle.
rules.translation: 月每小时运动表：11-15 时/48 行/每行+5 分；每 60 分一红标（循环起点）。例：Hadrian 3 Athyr 30 昼4时，月处女30°（运动14;15）→天秤11°。
rules.notes: 罗盘两脚法：klima 表量时数→月表量度数

rules.original_text: The second rectangular table shows the length of the hours for each of the 7 klimata. This one has the numbers for <every> klima arranged from least to greatest, i.e. from 10;30 entered in the first row to 19;30 entered in the outside row. I write each entry in order from 0;30 in the first row to the blank/zero in the bottom row. Therefore, the increase is 5 minutes <per row>. I find the bottom row ending with 15, which indicates one equinoctial hour... The ratio that night length has to day length is the same as that between the lengths of the night-hour and the day-hour: for example 17 to 13. 12 times 17 is 204; 12 times 13 is 156. The total is 360°.
rules.notes: 夜生用月之对宫

rules.original_text: Example 2: Diocletian year 147, Tybi 14/15, the third hour of the night, klima 4; the sun in Capricorn 19° 2'; moon in Taurus 23° 30'; the <preceding> new moon in Capricorn 9° 29'. From the new moon to the day and hour of birth are 10 days, i.e. two-thirds of one hour... the hourly magnitude of the point in opposition to the sun, Cancer 19°, is 17;53. I multiply this figure by 12 and find 215. I multiply these 215 time degrees by the 3 hours of the nativity for a total of 645. I subtract a 360° circle for a remainder of 285 time degrees. I record this as the horoscopic gnomon. Now since the horoscopic gnomon exceeds the solar gnomon, the third hour requires subtraction. So I subtract two-thirds of an hour... using 2 1/3 hours. Proceed as follows: the hourly magnitude of Cancer <19°> is 17;55. Multiply by 2 1/3 hours for a total of 41;48. Add the rising time of Cancer (93;7) for a grand total of 134;55. With this figure I enter the table for klima 4, and I find the Ascendant to be Leo 23° 0'. With this 23° I enter the table for Leo and I find written there 22 sixtieths, which is 1/3 1/30 and which equals 73 years 11 months.
rules.notes: 太阳 gnomon=日月距90时度；'受月之运动分数影响'

rules.original_text: Example 3: the reign of Valentinianus, klima of Spain <=4>. The native was killed in his 36th year. Year 135 of Diocletian, Epiphi 8, the beginning of the first hour. The sun in Cancer 7° 11'; the moon in Aries 22° 30'; the Ascendant in Cancer 7° 20'. The <preceding> full moon was at Gemini 18° 40', at the seventh hour of the day on Payni 29. From the full moon to the day of birth were 71/2 days, which is one-half of 15. Since the solar gnomon exceeds the horoscopic gnomon, I add this fraction, 1/2, to the initial hour of birth, the first hour... the hourly magnitude of the sun <in Cancer 7°> is 18;5, half of which is 9. The rising time of the sun is 79;7, for a total of 88 time degrees. With this figure I enter the table and I find the Ascendant very nearly at Cancer 14°. I enter the table at this figure, 14°, and I find 34 years 10 months written there, next to the figure 10, which is 1/6 of 60. I now take the hourly magnitude of Cancer 14°, and I find it to be 18;0. Multiplying this figure by 12, I find 216;0 time degrees. One-sixth of this is 36 years, his length of life.

6P. The Terms: Aries: Jup 6, Ven 6, Mer 8, Mars 5, Sat 5. Taurus: Ven 8, Mer 6, Jup 8, Sat 6, Mars 2. Gemini: Mer 6, Jup 6, Ven 5, Mars 7, Sat 6. Cancer: Mars 7, Ven 6, Mer 6, Jup 7, Sat 4. Leo: Jup 5, Ven 6, Sat 7, Mer 6, Mars 6. Virgo: Mer 7, Ven 10, Jup 4, Mars 7, Sat 2. Libra: Sat 6, Mer 8, Jup 8, Ven 6, Mars 2. Scorpio: Mars 7, Ven 4, Mer 8, Jup 5, Sat 6. Sagittarius: Jup 12, Ven 5, Mer 4, Sat 5, Mars 4. Capricorn: Mer 7, Jup 7, Ven 8, Sat 4, Mars 4. Aquarius: Mer 7, Ven 6, Jup 7, Mars 4, Sat 6. Pisces: Ven 12, Jup 4, Mer 3, Mars 9, Sat 2.
rules.translation: 五十界全表（埃及制界/Valens 传本）：12 座各 5 界（星+度数，见映射A 60 行全表）。与迦勒底界（Chaldean terms）不同——如白羊：埃及制 木6金6水8火5土5、迦勒底制 木6金8水8火5土5（金界度数不同）。
rules.notes: 映射A；第3层尊贵表核心——Book IX 6P 补 Book I+II 缺项

rules.original_text: A handy way of making the allotment is as follows: reduce the months of each ruler of the 10-year-period <=129 months> to days, and divide them by 129... Saturn rules 30 months. Make the distribution to it and to the other stars: take the 900 days and divide it by 129. You will find the result very nearly 7 <10-year-periods>. Now multiply <by 7> the number of months of each star and find the days which Saturn will give to itself and to the others: 210 to Saturn, 56 to Venus, 84 to Jupiter, 140 to Mercury, 105 to Mars, 175 to the moon, 133 to the sun.

Now if we investigate the distribution of these very 210 days, again we apply the factor 129. There will be the ratio 129 days to 210 days, and so for Saturn the 210 days will be 1 2/3 of 129. So if we calculate 1 2/3 of 30, we will have 50 days for Saturn. 1 2/3 of Jupiter's 12 will give us 20 days for Jupiter... Next let us make a distribution of Saturn's 50 days: as 129 is to 50, so Saturn's 30 will be to some figure, Jupiter's 12 will be <to some figure>...
rules.translation: 129 日再分布（递归）：土 210 日÷129=1⅔→土自50日/木20/火25…；土 50 日再按 129 比例分——无限递归至时/分（'细分至分数变难'，Valens 改用月比法）。
rules.notes: Valens 判：按月数比例逐级分配更简

rules.original_text: The other method, which distributes the days and the hours to each star according to the ratios of months, is easy and has logic behind it. Take for example Saturn: in the 129 months of the 10-year-period, Saturn is ruler of 30 months. Similarly in any given 129-day-period during the 30 months which it rules, Saturn will be the ruler of 30 days. Again in the 30 days which it rules, Saturn will be the ruler of 30 hours. As 129 months are to 30 months, so 129 days are to 30 days, and 129 hours are to 30 hours.
rules.translation: 月比分布法（129 日/时三级同构）：各星在 129 日内掌=其月数之日数；30 日内掌=其月数之时数。例：月命点 40 日婴：月25日→土至55日→木至67日→火至82日→日至101日→金至109日→水至129日→月复掌（760 日/月25月之期）。
rules.notes: 映射C；引擎第3层可编码递归时主

rules.original_text: For it is necessary, if we should wish to subsume everything under the same ratio, to take 1/5, 1/30, and 1/360 of the period of each of the stars, and having done so, to transform the fraction to a fraction appropriate to the second distribution of each star... For Saturn, 6 times 30 <months> gives 180 days. For Jupiter 6 times 12 gives 72. For Mars 6 times 15 gives 90. For the sun 6 times 19 gives 114. For Venus 6 times 8 gives 48. For Mercury 6 times 20 gives 120. For the moon, 6 times 25 gives 150.

For example: the lifespan of a nativity is 45 years, 9 months, 25 days. Assume the sun receives the first 10-year-period, with the moon following next, then Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and finally Saturn. 43 years are four 10-year-periods. The remaining 2 years, 9 months, 25 days belong to the fifth 10-year-period, which is ruled by Jupiter, following the sun in the fifth place. From its monthly period, Jupiter gives 12 months to itself and 8 months to Venus. 13 months and 25 days remain... Saturn, the next star after Venus, has 30 months, of which 13 months, 25 days remain, i.e. 420 days... let us subtract three daily periods of 129 days each (totalling 387 days) from this amount. There now remain 33 of the 420. Saturn gives the first 30 days to itself, the final 3 days to the next star, the sun... So Jupiter is the ruler of the fifth 10-year-period; Saturn is the ruler of the months; the sun is the ruler of the three days.
rules.translation: 分布示例（45年9月25日）：日首 10 年（月/火/水/木/金/土序）→43 年=四周期→余 2年9月25日属第五周期（木）；木自12月+金8月→余13月25日→土掌（30月中之13月25日=420日）→减3×129=387→余33→土自30+日3日。三级：十年主=木、月主=土、日主=日。
rules.notes: '一些占星家做第四级时分配'（24 倍）

rules.original_text: Some <astrologers> make a fourth type, an hourly distribution, by multiplying the days of each star by the 24 hours of the day-and-night period: for example, the 19 days of the sun become 456 hours. From this amount the sun assigns: 19 hours to itself, 12 to Jupiter, 25 to the moon, 8 to Venus, 15 to Mars, 30 to Saturn, <20> to Mercury... Mercury grants the first period, 19 hours to the sun, until the seventh hour of the night. After the sun, it assigns 25 hours to the moon, from the eighth hour of the night to the eighth hour of the next night. After the moon, Mars is ruler of 15 hours... Mercury receives a 13 hour period... to the first hour of the <next> day.
rules.translation: 时分配示例：日 19 日=456 时；日自19/木12/月25/金8/火15/土30/水20；水尾 72 时再分：日19时（至夜7时）→月25时（至次夜8时）→火15时（至昼11时）→水13时（至次日1时）。
rules.notes: '主星与后继星之影响即日常事务变化之由'

rules.original_text: It is necessary to examine the rulers of the 10-year-period, of the months, and of the days, to see the nature of their transits and configurations. When they are beheld by benefic places and stars, they indicate that the <period> is also benefic; when beheld by malefics, it is malefic.
rules.translation: 十年-月-日-时四级判定法：各级主星（10年/月/日/时）被吉位吉星照=当期吉、凶照=凶；主星与后继星定每日变化。
rules.notes: Valens 系时主与法达(Firdaria)并列的第二套系统（129 月制）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.condition: 昼生：土→火距离；夜生：火→土距离；从上升量
rules.original_text: this is the Crisis-Producing Place, the place causative of terrors, dangers, and chains. Consequently this place is strong; for day births it is found by determining the distance from Saturn to Mars (for night births, from Mars to Saturn), then measuring the same distance from the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 危机产生位（Crisis-Producing Place）：昼生=土星到火星距离、夜生=火星到土星距离，从上升点量同样距离——此位致恐惧/危险/枷锁。
rules.notes: Riley 译 p.95；注：另有从水星量的变体（原书边注）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: It will be necessary to examine the location of this place to see if the sign of a malefic, or malefics themselves, are in conjunction or aspect. If they are, the nativities will be precarious, endangered, and easily destroyed.
rules.translation: 危机位效应：凶星或凶星星座合/照此位——命主命途危殆、易毁。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Benefics in conjunction or aspect will cause a lessening of the evil or an escape from crises.
rules.translation: 吉星合/照危机位——减轻凶厄或脱险。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: if the sun or moon is found to be sextile to Saturn or Mars (calculating by signs), the nativity will be at risk and subject to crises, particularly in the similar degrees/within 70° and in the listening signs.
rules.translation: 日月六合土/火（按星座计）——命危；尤在 70° 内与'倾听'星座。
rules.notes: 配合日月受土火冲/照更验；吉星合照则喘息

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 新月/满月座±四分冲之年=凶
rules.original_text: In all cases, it is necessary to count off the years from the sign in the Ascendant. If the current year is found to be in the sign of the new or full moon, or in the sign in square or opposition to the <new or full moon> sign, the year will be critical and troublesome.
rules.translation: 凶年（Critical Year）：从上升起数年；当年落新月/满月星座或与其四分/冲之星座=凶年。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: especially if (under these circumstances) Saturn is found to be passing through the four places which just preceded the angles at the nativity. If the basis of the nativity is in accord, death will follow, bodily weakness, bleeding, dangerous diseases, hidden troubles, falls, sudden dangers.
rules.translation: 凶年加强：土星行运过本命四角前之四宫——死/体弱/出血/危疾/暗患/坠/骤险。
rules.notes: 若吉星护体则仅损名利

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: determine the distance from Saturn's position at the nativity to the ruler of the new or full moon, then count that distance from the Ascendant. When Saturn transits that position or is in opposition or square with that position, death will occur, or a grave crisis to health or business.
rules.translation: 凶年判据2：本命土星→新月/满月主星距离，从上升量；土星行运过此位或冲/照之=死亡或重疾/重创。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Likewise the critical year will occur if Saturn is at the ascending or the descending node, or at the points square with these.
rules.translation: 凶年判据3：土星在升/降交点或其四分点=凶年。
rules.notes: 日月过交点+凶星照=病危

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: if the moon is passing through the current position of the ascending node, or through the points in square or opposition, particularly if it is at the same degree-position, beware of starting anything: do not sail, do not marry, do not have meetings, do not begin anything, do not plant...
rules.translation: 起事禁忌（Initiatives）：月过上升交点（或其四分/冲点，同度尤甚）——禁航海/婚姻/会面/动土/任何开端；所起之事不牢、遭罚、不终。
rules.notes: 吉星在位亦不全吉；不看本命盘亦可依行运避凶

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: The following signs are critical: Aries, Taurus, Cancer, <Leo, Libra,> Scorpio, <Capricorn,> Aquarius. When the years are in these signs, they are dangerous; the month will be evident when the sun is in them at the transmissions.
rules.translation: 凶险星座：白羊、金牛、巨蟹、狮子、天秤、天蝎、摩羯、宝瓶——年落其中则险；月之显验看太阳行运入其星座时。
rules.notes: 与 6460 行重复句一致

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 年度重排盘（影响年主交接）
rules.original_text: We consider the recasting of horoscopes to be essential because the recasting contributes greatly to the temporal interchange of the chronocrators. Sometimes the recasting increases the strength of the results, sometimes it is indicative of delays in the results.
rules.translation: 重排盘（Recasting）：按当年生日重算行星位；升点取法——太阳仍在本命星座时，查月何时回本命原度，以该时为升。
rules.notes: 若升点落昼时虽夜生亦用昼宫主/界主/升主

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: determine the distance from the sun's current position to the moon's position at birth, then count that distance from the Ascendant. It will be necessary to examine the ruler of the sign where the count stops... (For day births, determine the distance from the moon's current position to the sun's position at birth; count that from the Ascendant.)
rules.translation: 操作月（Operative Month）：昼生=太阳当前位置→本命月位置之距离从上升量（夜生反之：月当前→本命日）；查止点星座主星之吉凶照会。
rules.notes: 亦法：新月/满月度位主星定月；或查本命月与日之相位何时重现

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: multiply the full years of the nativity by 5 1/4. Determine the days from the birth date to the day in question. Add this figure to the previous result and divide by 12. Count the remainder from the Ascendant, giving one to each sign.
rules.translation: 操作日算法：实足年×5.25 + 生日至当日天数，÷12 取余，从上升起每星座记一数——止点星座定日之吉凶。
rules.notes: 例：36×5.25=189，+243=432，−360=72→从处女升数止于狮子=险日；少数从月后一星座起数

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 倾斜-止点座配置定吉凶
rules.original_text: We examine the sign where the count stops to see if it is operative or not. It is necessary to note how the moon and its inclination are configured with respect to the sign. If on the day in question the moon is in aspect with the sign of its inclination, and if they are in operative signs, the day will be fine, noteworthy, profitable.
rules.translation: 操作日判定：止点星座+月之倾斜配置——月照倾斜座且皆在操作座=吉日；同座更吉；月背离倾斜则平；他座=凶险日。
rules.notes: 另查日主星配置与行运星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 盈/亏各12座→倾斜方向（映射A）
rules.original_text: when the moon is in conjunction with the sun in Cancer and has its first visibility in Leo, it inclines towards <Taurus>. Then in Virgo it inclines towards <Aries>... Six signs are towards the East, six towards the West.
rules.translation: 月之倾斜（Inclinations）：新月于巨蟹、初见在狮子时倾斜向金牛；处女→白羊、天秤→双鱼、天蝎→宝瓶、射手→摩羯；亏后摩羯→射手、宝瓶→天蝎、双鱼→天秤、白羊→处女、金牛→狮子、双子→巨蟹。六座向东六座向西。
rules.notes: 全表见映射A

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: consequently it is necessary to note <it the year of the cycle> first, then divide by 12 and investigate the remainder <=find the number modulo 12>. If it is found to have a transmission, use it even more.
rules.translation: 年主循环：岁数÷12 取余查传递（transmission）；有传递用之。
rules.notes: 12 因黄道 12 座、7 因 7 星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: An example: if we are investigating year 20, we subtract 12 and investigate the remainder 8, to see if a transmission is there. If none is found, we investigate the places 4 signs apart and use them just like the 8... for the factors 8 are 2 and 4.
rules.translation: 因子分解：年20→减12余8→查8座距传递；无则用因数（8=2×4）——2/4 座距亦可。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 转用星座主星位置续数
rules.original_text: If the sign where the count stops happens to be empty, then count from the position (at the nativity) of the ruler of the sign, and examine in the same way the place found, whether using the nativity or the transiting stars. Then forecast the results of all the places and stars.
rules.translation: 空星座处理：止点星座无星——从该星座主星本命位置续数同数；星传星用星断、星传空座用座主断。
rules.notes: 例：月传白羊/天蝎空——从火星本命位续数

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 昼日/夜月/次升/再次诸星
rules.original_text: The aphetic points of the years are operative when starting from any star, but the following aphetic points are most effective: for day births the sun, for night births the moon, especially when they are at the angles. Next <in effectiveness> is the Ascendant.
rules.translation: aphetic 点（命源点）效力排序：昼生=太阳、夜生=月（在角宫最强）；次为上升；再次任何星。
rules.notes: vital sector 由此发起

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 接收>传递；吉吉>凶吉>吉凶>凶凶
rules.original_text: The receivers are considered more influential than the transmitters: it is better if a benefic transmits to a benefic than if a malefic transmits to a benefic; it is the worst if a malefic transmits to a malefic.
rules.translation: 传递方向优劣：接收者>传递者；吉传吉最佳、凶传吉次之、凶传凶最坏（吉传凶不佳）。
rules.notes: VI 亦谓：火传木优于木传火（周期数异）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Now if two stars are active in one year, <both transmissions will be effective>, but especially those from the angles, next those from signs which follow the angles, next those from signs which precede the angles... When transmitting or receiving from <signs> in opposition, they are damaging and troublesome.
rules.translation: 宫位效力：角宫>角后星座>角前星座；对冲位置=损碍。吉星角宫=大吉高位、继宫=中吉、果宫=弱；凶星角宫=最凶、继宫=缓、果宫=稍轻、对冲=逆转危险。
rules.notes: 凶星 superior aspect 接 inferior aspect 之星=坏上加坏；三合则缓和

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: <Year # Critical Points and Results> 1 He will be sickly and anxious... 7 The first critical point of Mars: dangerous, involving fevers, bleeding, wounds... 12 The fourth critical point of Saturn... 45 ...called Stilbon... 63 ...the 'Man-killer,' grievous and fatal...
rules.translation: 凶点年表（1-120 岁）：每年对应星点与效应——如 1 岁病弱焦虑、7 岁火星第一点（热病/出血/伤）、12 岁土星第四点（暴卒或湿病）、45 岁 Stilbon（足疾）、63 岁'屠人者'（凶死）、108 岁致命。
rules.notes: 全表 60+ 行入映射B；行星年数：土3/木10/金5/月13/火7/日18/水8

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: The transmissions or receptions from signs of equal rising time must be considered active: from Aries to Pisces, from Taurus to Aquarius, from Gemini to Capricorn, from Cancer to Sagittarius, from Leo to Scorpio, and from Virgo to Libra. The same is true in reverse order.
rules.translation: 等升时星座对（active 传递）：白羊-双鱼、金牛-宝瓶、双子-摩羯、巨蟹-射手、狮子-天蝎、处女-天秤（及反向）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: The transits of the stars are considered vigorous when the masters of the chronocratorships transit the Places, or are in opposition or square with them.
rules.translation: 行运强度：时主星行运过相关宫位、或与其冲/照=行运强效（时主在位时无人可阻其吉凶）。
rules.notes: 时主任满即传位他星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: The settings and retrograde periods of the stars will be weak, the risings and stationary points will be vigorous, blending their influences in complex ways.
rules.translation: 星之状态强弱：沉没/逆行=弱；上升/驻留=强。
rules.notes: V 亦谓逆行星 vital sector 反黄道序而上（日转方向）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: For any nativity it is necessary to determine precisely the stellar chronocrator to the degree... It is necessary to take the distance in degrees from each star to its point of contact (a position expressed in degrees) with another star... Add the number of degrees and allocate them using the hours, days, months, and years of the star's period.
rules.translation: 度数年主（degree-intervals）：按行星周期参数把度数换算为时间单位（时/日/月/年）——例：月 21°30′处女→土星 4°天秤距 12.5°，×月周期25=312.5→312.5 日后月传土星。
rules.notes: Marc.gr.334 边注例证；《Perpetual Tables》求精确度

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: The sun assigns 19 months per sign, 19 days per degree. The monthly cycle is owned by the moon, and the moon by nature assigns 2 years 1 month per sign, 25 days per degree. Saturn assigns 2 years 6 months per sign, 30 days per degree. Jupiter assigns 1 year per sign, 12 days per degree. Mars assigns 15 months per sign, 15 days per degree. Venus assigns 8 months per sign, 8 days per degree. Mercury assigns 20 months per sign, 20 days per degree.
rules.translation: 行星周期参数表：太阳 19月/座+19天/度；月 2年1月/座+25天/度；土 2年6月/座+30天/度；木 1年/座+12天/度；火 15月/座+15天/度；金 8月/座+8天/度；水 20月/座+20天/度。
rules.notes: 第3层直接数据

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: It is necessary to take into account not only the degree-position at which the contact occurs, but the 3° on each side of the contact (as we made clear previously), because it will be obvious from these degrees whether the stars' effects will occur early or late.
rules.translation: 接触位容差：接触度±3°——判定效应早发/迟发（类日月蚀见食期/分离期）。
rules.notes: 发者须以适当操作方式照收者

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Let our method be this: for day births make the sun the apheta (for night births, the moon), if it is well situated... For instance, let the sun be the apheta for the distribution of 10 years, 9 months: it will take 10 years, 9 months, and after it the next star in the zodiacal circle at the nativity will take 10 years, 9 months.
rules.translation: 十年期法（10年9月分布）：昼生太阳/夜生月（良好时）为 apheta；各星按黄道次序每星轮值 10年9月；年内再按时/日/月周期细分，另察月主/日主/时主。
rules.notes: 两光俱劣时从上升后之星起轮；例：52岁4月3日推法见原文

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: 全表见映射D（7×7 月日时）
rules.original_text: I. Saturn rules 2 years 6 months. It will transmit a. to itself 6 months, 29 days, 6 1/4 hours. b. to Jupiter 2 months, 23 days, 17 1/3 hours...
rules.translation: 亚分布（Subdistributions）：每星主期再按 7 星细分（月-日-时精度）——土2年6月分传自身6月29日6.25时/木2月23日17.33时/火3月14日15.67时/日4月12日13.42时/金1月25日19.5时/水4月19日12.67时/月5月24日10时；木1年、火1年3月、日1年7月、金8月、水1年8月、月2年1月各有细分。
rules.notes: 第3层数据：十年期内亚期精确到时分

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: multiply the years which have passed since birth by 3651/4. Get the number of days from the birth date to the date in question, and add it to the previous result. Divide by 129, and note how many cycles there have been. From the answer we cast out the weekly cycles <=divide by 7>, and the remainder of this division (which will be less than seven!) will show which star controls the days.
rules.translation: 日主判定（129 法）：(岁×365.25+天数)÷129 得周期数，再 ÷7 取余定日主星——余 1 给 apheta，按黄道序轮。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Alternatively, the attempt could be made to equate the weekly cycles to 49-day periods and to count these from the apheta, giving one to each star. The star at which the count stops will rule the 49-day period and the first cycle of the weeks.
rules.translation: 49 天周期法：周循环折为 49 天期，从 apheta 起每星一期；止点星主 49 天期及其首周。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: Valens 立场：aphetic 起轮（非固定七区）
rules.original_text: Most <astrologers> distribute the chronocrators for each nativity using the seven-zone system beginning with Saturn; they put Jupiter, Mars, the sun, Venus, Mercury, and the moon following in that order...
