Such a procedure does not satisfy me, because those who use it find the same chronocrators for most nativities. I prefer to put the aphetic point at the sun and moon, or at the star found to be following the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 七区周主制（土星起序）批判：Valens 斥固定七区序（土→木→火→日→金→水→月）致多数盘时主雷同——主张以日月或上升后之星为 aphetic 点按本命实际星序轮。
rules.notes: 学派开关：固定七区 vs aphetic 序

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.result: apheta-anaereta 度距+上升时数=寿数
rules.original_text: Let our method be this: we will use the Light-bringing moon and the Ascendant. These two... make the aphetic point and indicate the beginning and the end... when the moon is found to be the apheta, it is necessary to observe closely its contacts and its sextile, square, and opposition aspects with respect to the Ascendant, particularly when they are in signs of the same or equal rising time...
rules.translation: 寿命法：以月+上升为 aphetic 对——月为 apheta 时察其与上升的接触/六合/四分/冲（尤在等升时星座/同力座/倾听座/antiscia 中）；此二光月-升互照的四方与对冲在角宫特强。
rules.notes: 大区间/长升时座取半；火星土星不单作毁灭者/吉星不单作救者

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: the degree-positions of the moon's phases in each sign, when calculated with reference to the aphetic points and correlated with the time periods corresponding to each interval, indicate the anaeretic point—particularly when the moon is the apheta. When the moon is the apheta, it is destroyed by itself. The relevant phases are those of new moon, full moon, and the two quarters, each being effective when moving toward the Descendant.
rules.translation: anaereta（夺命点）：月为 apheta 时，月相（新月/满月/两弦）之度位近下中天移动=anaereta——月为 apheta 者自毁。
rules.notes: 察 aphetic/anaeretic 位所在星座或界（terms）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: In every nativity the moon's position is figured by longitude and latitude. Note where the latitude of the moon is located at the nativity. The moon's position at the conception will be the position we have found... Count back the days, and set the moon at that <correct> degree, then see where the previous new moon occurred. Add the days from that point, and you will know at what day and hour the conception occurred and whether the native was an 8- or a 10-month child.
rules.translation: 受孕期判定：本命月纬度=受孕时月纬度（'guidepost'）；回推月回该度之时刻并查前新月——得受孕日时与 8/10 月产。
rules.notes: 太阳在白羊+月距新月120°=足月270日10月产

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Malefics seem stronger than benefics. Just as a drop of black or brown, falling into a container of brightly colored paint, dims the color's beauty... so it is with malefics, stars which can attack men and rob them of the things in which they seem to be fortunate.
rules.translation: 凶星为何更显：一滴黑落入亮彩即污其美——凶星如墨点，抢走家业/健康/名誉/美质，污染命盘；吉星之量难掩其斑。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: Saturn's color is black, since it is the symbol of time. The god is slow, and therefore the Babylonians called it Phainon <Illuminator>... Jupiter's color is brilliant... Mars' color is orange... The sun's color is translucent... Venus' color is changeable in hue... Mercury's color pale yellowish-green, like bile... The moon's color is like that of the air.
rules.translation: 行星颜色象征：土=黑（时间之象征，巴比伦称 Phainon 照明者）；木=辉亮（生命之因）；火=橙（灼割）；日=透光（纯净）；金=多变之色（欲望）；水=淡黄绿（胆汁，智识苦涩）；月=空气色（无常）。
rules.notes: 星色交融喻星性混合

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》（希腊占星百科全书）Book V+VI——推运与年主卷
rules.original_text: the chronocrators for twins will be the same, since the same stars are located at the same degree-positions! I answer that in such nativities, the shift of just the Ascendant alone alters the angles and the fortune and condition of the native, and it occasionally brings his end.
rules.translation: 双子盘差异：即使行星同度，仅上升移动即改四角与命途——须按角度与星照关系分布。
rules.notes: 星在角距（升-MC 距等）间之 superior aspect 特强

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 日/月择优为控制点，其界主为宫主
rules.original_text: Some give day births to the sun, night births to the moon, but I say that the sun controls night births and the moon day births, if they happen to be configured advantageously. If both are, assign control to the one which is more appropriately configured in its own sect or triangle. Then the houseruler is found from the terms of the controlling star.
rules.translation: 控制点（Control，即 hyleg）判定：Valens 反通行——日可主夜生、月可主昼生（视配置）；若两皆可，取在其派别/三角中配置更佳者；界主=宫主星（houseruler）。
rules.notes: 通行说（昼日/夜月）Valens 明确修正；术语：horimaea=控制、houseruler=宫主、apheta=命源

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If both <the sun and the moon> are unfavorably situated, then the term of the degree in the Ascendant or at MC will fix the houserulership, usually that <star> whose ruler is in an appropriate configuration with the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 两光俱劣：上升/MC 度之界主定宫主——通常取其主星与上升配置适当者。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If the sun is found to be in its own depression <Libra>, it will not be the apheta, unless it is exactly in the Ascendant (to the degree). The same is true for the moon in Scorpio <its depression>. If the moon is found to be new and to be under the rays of the sun, it will not be the apheta, unless it too is exactly in the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 控制点例外：日入天秤（落陷）不作 apheta（除非准合上升同度）；月入天蝎同理；新月被日光灼（12°内）不作 apheta（除非准合上升）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If the moon is nearing full and passes out of this phase within the term in the Ascendant, it will be both the apheta and the anaereta, if it passes out of the full-moon phase on that same day. It will be necessary to examine the number of degrees between this day and the full moon; having found this number, <you can> forecast the number of years.
rules.translation: 月近满月且在上升界内当日出满月相——同时为 apheta 与 anaereta：当月位至满月度数=寿年。
rules.notes: 例：月白羊22°、当日27°出满月相——距5°≈4年，其人寿4年

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: take the distance in degrees from the Ascendant to IC (moving in the order of the signs), to consider one-third of that total distance to be the 'operative' degrees in the configuration of the angles, and to consider the stars in these degrees, whether benefics or malefics, to be powerful.
rules.translation: 角宫有效度数：升-IC 距离三等分，首段（从上升起 1/3）为'operative'——其中之星（无论吉凶）强效；其余至 IC 为 inoperative。
rules.notes: 例：升双鱼13°-IC双子22°距99°→1/3=33°止于白羊16°；对冲点同效；MC 同法

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: take the distance from the degree in the Ascendant to IC, calculate one-third..., and consider these degrees and those in opposition to be powerful. Now consider the other <one-third> portion of the degrees to be average... the first third from the Ascendant will be operative and powerful, the second third will be average, the third third will be crisis-producing and bad.
rules.translation: 有效度数改进法（更科学）：升-IC 三等分——首段operative强力、中段平均（III宫'女神'/对IX'神'）、末段危机凶恶；MC 同法（末段至上升=损害）。
rules.notes: Orion 之书所传

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: if the sun or moon are in the aphetic place, then it will be necessary to figure the total rising times (in the klima of the nativity) from the position of the apheta to the point square with it. Having found the total time, you can forecast that the native will live as many years.
rules.translation: vital sector 寿命法：apheta 至其四分点的上升时数（按本命 klima）=寿年——宫主在其界内或与 apheta 照会、无 anaereta 减损则准。
rules.notes: Valens 明批'90°弧'上限说：短升时座可逾90°

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If the years of the houseruler are less than those of the apheta, he will live the years of the houseruler... If the years of the apheta are less than the years of the houseruler, the native will live the number of years allotted by the apheta and the nativity will be judged to lack a houseruler.
rules.translation: 寿命取数：宫主年数<apheta年数→寿=宫主年数；apheta年数<宫主年数→寿=apheta年数（判为无宫主）。
rules.notes: 宫主在角/上升/operative 度则足额；他角按比例扣减

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If neither the sun nor the moon are in the aphetic place, but the Ascendant or MC are, one should not figure the number of years from the aphetic place to the point square with it. <Instead> determine the number of degrees <from the apheta> to the next angle, then forecast the years—unless some anaereta embezzles from the number of years by applying its rays.
rules.translation: 升/MC 为 apheta：不算至四分点，改算至下一角之度数=寿年（除非 anaereta 照减）。
rules.notes: 例：升双子8°→IC狮子22°（非四分处女8°）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: The anaeretic stars are Saturn, Mars, the sun, and the moon coming to a phase. The anaeretic places of each sign are the aphetic terms and the terms of malefics. The anaeretic degrees are considered to be the 3° on each side of the apheta... the degree itself <of the apheta> plus the two segments total 7° in all. Malefics projecting rays into this area become anaeretic, while benefics prevent the destruction.
rules.translation: anaereta 定义：土/火/日/月（临相位时）为夺命星；夺命度=apheta 两侧各3°+本身=共7°——凶星照入=夺命，吉星阻之。
rules.notes: 夺命星在角或角后更烈；角前则弱

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: First it is necessary to examine the degree in which each star is exalted: Sun Aries 19°, Moon Taurus 3°, Jupiter Cancer 15°, Mars Capricorn 28°, Saturn Libra 21°, Mercury Virgo 15°, Venus Pisces 27°. Each star has its depression at the point in opposition to its exaltation.
rules.translation: 旺点精确度数：日白羊19°、月金牛3°、木巨蟹15°、火摩羯28°、土天秤21°、水处女15°、金双鱼27°——落陷=对冲点。
rules.notes: 第3层直接数据；与通行（日白羊19°等）一致

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: The point square with the exaltation and preceding it is called northern; the point square and following it is called southern... since each step has 15°, we find the distance of the star from each degree <listed above>, then divide it by 15.
rules.translation: 风（Winds）与步（Steps）：旺点前四分点=北、后四分点=南；每 15°=一步——星距旺点度数÷15 得步位。
rules.notes: 例：日宝瓶22°距摩羯19°（北起点）33°→2步余3°=北风第三步

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: For each nativity it is necessary to note whether the sun, the moon, or the Ascendant is the apheta, and which wind it has. Then examine the other stars. If any have the same wind as the apheta, they will be related and associated... If any star has a wind opposite to that of the apheta, it will oppose the apheta and will be malefic, especially at the transmission of the chronocratorship.
rules.translation: 风之应用：同风之星与 apheta 关联（角宫/顺行/本派更强）；对风之星敌对（行运时尤凶，逆/沉更险）；半关半不关=变数。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: for day births the sun, Jupiter, and Saturn rejoice above the earth; for night births, below the earth. For night births the moon, Mars, and Venus rejoice above the earth; for day births below the earth. Mercury rejoices according to the sect of the houseruler in whose terms the star is located.
rules.translation: 派别（Sects）：昼生日木土喜在上半球、夜生喜下半球；夜生月火金喜在上、昼生喜在下；水星随其界主之派别。
rules.notes: 派别内之星在上=优于在下

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: Venus particularly rejoices when in the Ascendant or at MC; the rest rejoice in the Ascendant or Descendant.
rules.translation: 金星尤喜上升/MC；余星喜上升或下降。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 对冲界主=敌对星（临界死期）
rules.original_text: It is necessary to investigate the hostile places and stars, not only with respect to the other stars, but also for the Ascendant, the sun, and the moon. When they come into opposition, they indicate critical periods and death. Take Saturn for example: note which god controls the degrees in opposition to the position of Saturn, as given in the table. The native will die when Saturn is there, is square with the Ascendant, or in signs with the same rising time.
rules.translation: 敌对位法（Critodemus）：查星对冲度之界主（表）——星行至该处、与上升成四分、或在等升时星座=临界死期（待时主同期）。
rules.notes: 例：土巨蟹21°界主金星→对冲摩羯21°界主火星；火星在金牛27°→土入处女（四分）时死

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 等升时星座界主=敌对星
rules.original_text: Jupiter in Scorpio 14°, terms of Saturn. Taurus 14° <the point in opposition> is also in the terms of Saturn, and this star does not become hostile to itself. Leo has the same rising time as Scorpio, and Leo 14° is in the terms of the sun. So Jupiter is the anaereta when it comes to the places of the sun.
rules.translation: 敌对判例法：对冲度界主若=自身则查等升时星座同度之界主——木在天蝎14°（土界）→对冲金牛14°亦土界（不敌对）→查等升时狮子14°在日界→木入日界时死。
rules.notes: 病者盘中亦查对冲位/敌对星/月日时临界

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: Leo is the house of the sun, Aries is its exaltation, Sagittarius is the <other member if its> triangle. The total is 3, and so in each sign the sun has 3 terms... Cancer is the house of the moon, Taurus is its exaltation, Virgo and Capricorn are the <other members if its> triangle. The total is 4... Capricorn and Aquarius are houses of Saturn, Libra is its exaltation, Gemini... 4 terms... Sagittarius and Pisces are houses of Jupiter, Cancer is its exaltation, Aries and Leo... 5 terms... Aries and Scorpio are houses of Mars, Capricorn is its exaltation, Pisces and Cancer... 5 terms... Taurus and Libra are houses of Venus, Pisces is its exaltation, Virgo and Capricorn... 5 terms... Gemini is a house of Mercury, Virgo is its exaltation, Aquarius and Libra... 4 terms.
rules.translation: 界制（Terms）Valens 布置法：每星座按庙/旺/三角成员计数——日3界、月4界、土4界、木5界、火5界、金5界、水4界（合计30）。
rules.notes: Valens 明斥七区制（8,7,6,5,4）不对；此为庙旺三角推界数（映射B）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: <The Order of the Terms.> Aries Leo Sagittarius by day: sun-3, Jupiter-5, Venus-5, moon-4, Saturn-4, Mercury-4, Mars-5. Total 30. by night: Jupiter-5, sun-3, moon-4, Venus-5, Mercury-4, Saturn-4, Mars-5... Taurus Virgo Capricorn by day: Venus moon Saturn Mercury Mars sun Jupiter; by night: moon Venus Mercury Saturn Mars Jupiter sun...
rules.translation: 界序表（昼夜两组）：白羊组昼=日3/木5/金5/月4/土4/水4/火5、夜=木5/日3/月4/金5/水4/土4/火5；金牛组昼=金月土水火日木、夜=月金水土火木日；双子组昼=土水火日木金月、夜=水土火木日月金；巨蟹组昼=火日木金月土水、夜=火木日月金水土。
rules.notes: 第3层直接数据：界分配表

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 各星界中行→风向（第4层天气）
rules.original_text: If the sun is transiting its own terms, with the moon or the ruler of the moon's terms in aspect, the physical nature of the star will manifest itself in the wind. For instance: if the sun traverses its own terms with the moon in aspect, it will blow westerly. If Venus traverses its own terms, it will blow southerly and dry...
rules.translation: 风-天气映射：星过自身界+月照——日=西风；金=南风干燥；土=西风带湿；木=北风湿润；月=东北风；金=东南风变风云；水=西北风暴雨雷闪。
rules.notes: 另察月之盈缺相位与界主

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 月-新月距从上升数=命主
rules.original_text: If it happened at new moon, determine the number of degrees from the new moon to the position of the moon at the delivery itself, then count this distance from the Ascendant in the order of the signs. The ruler of the term where the count stops will be the houseruler of Life and of the vital sector. If the nativity is at full moon, determine the degrees from the moon's position at the delivery to its position at the next new moon. Then count this distance from the Ascendant... in the direction of diurnal motion (towards MC).
rules.translation: Petosiris 福点寿命法：新月生=新月→出生月位度数从上升顺数（止点界主=生命宫主）；满月生=出生月位→下次新月度数从上升向 MC 方向数。
rules.notes: 阳星座属日、阴星座属月——止点星座关联之光主控最大年

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: If it is found to be in its own sign or in operative signs, the length of life will reach its maximum. If it is found to be favorably configured with respect to one, but unsuitably configured with respect to the other, it will allot the mean number of years... then the nativity will lack a houseruler.
rules.translation: 寿数三档：界主在自身星座/operative 座=最大年；一方有利一方不利=平均年；俱不利/背离/在凶宫=无宫主。
rules.notes: 判短寿/长寿/孪生差（一、二胎界主改位）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: (天狼升→生日天数÷52⅐)商×余=临界数
rules.original_text: take the number of days from the rising of Seth to the date of birth. Divide the total number of days by 52 1/7. Now multiply the <integer> answer of this division by the remainder, and examine the result of this multiplication to see if it is less than the particular number of the critical point.
rules.translation: 7 日周期法：天狼星升（埃及历岁首）至出生日数 ÷52又1/7，商×余——得'临界7日数'（<基础寿年则彼年亡）。
rules.notes: 7日=火星周；9日=土星周；昼生查9日/夜生查7日（一说互易）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: The 9-day week is found as follows: I multiply the full years by 5 1/4, since each year contains forty 9-day weeks with 5 1/4 days left over. For each month I add 3... I total the remaining days until the day in question and I divide by 9.
rules.translation: 9 日周期法：实足年×5.25（每岁40个9日周余5.25日）+每月3日+至当日余日，÷9 取余=临界日数。
rules.notes: 7日临界座：白羊/天秤/巨蟹/摩羯；9日临界座：金牛/狮子/天蝎/宝瓶；双鱼/双子/处女/射手共通

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 按升/降交点与新满月关系数
rules.original_text: If the Ascendant, the ascending node, or the descending node is found in the sign of the new or full moon, or in the signs in opposition or square with them, then for day births count the total distance from the Ascendant, for night births from the Descendant in the order of the signs.
rules.translation: 新月/满月法：升/升降交点在新月或满月星座或其冲/照座——昼生从上升顺数、夜生从下降顺数；交点四分点具 anaereta 力。
rules.notes: 无宫主/控制时用之；交点度数法昼夜异向（升交点在各角时另有方向表）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 日四分（/三合/六合）座=受孕座
rules.original_text: For every nativity, the sign square with the sun is the sign of the conception. (Occasionally the sign of conception will be trine when the sun happens to be at the end of its sign, especially in a sign of short rising time; the sign of conception may be sextile for signs of long rising time.) Assume the position of the moon at the conception to be the same as the position of the Ascendant at the time of the delivery.
rules.translation: 受孕星座：日之四分星座=受孕星座（日近座尾/短升时座可三合；长升时座可六合）；受孕时月位=出生时上升位。
rules.notes: 例：日宝瓶、月天蝎、升处女→受孕时日金牛、月处女（新月受孕）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 新月受孕→满月死（反之亦然）
rules.original_text: In most cases a native whose conception was at new moon will die at full moon; one whose conception was at full moon will die at new moon.
rules.translation: 生死月相：新月受孕者死于满月；满月受孕者死于新月。
rules.notes: 验算从受孕与出生双推得同年=必死

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 昼：日→月从升；夜：月→日（未落）/日→月（落后）
rules.original_text: To me it seems best to locate the Lot by determining the distance from the sun to the moon, then counting that distance from the Ascendant—for day births. For night births <1> if the moon is above the earth, i.e. until the time it sets, determine the distance from it to the sun, then count that distance from the Ascendant. <2> After the moon has set, determine the distance from the sun to it.
rules.translation: 福点公式（Valens 版）：昼生=日→月距从上升数；夜生且月在地平上（未落）=月→日距从上升数；夜生月落后=日→月距。
rules.notes: 与通行福点公式（昼=升+月-日）等价；'全圈托付与日'——王（Nechepso）之论

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: Each star controls its own period: Saturn 30 years; Jupiter 12; Mars 15; Sun 19; Venus 8; Mercury 20; Moon 25.
rules.translation: 行星最小周期：土30/木12/火15/日19/金8/水20/月25 年。
rules.notes: 寿命三因子：福点宫主周期+星座上升时数+星座宫主周期（映射D/E/F）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: Following are the critical point with respect to the Lots, especially if malefics are in conjunction or in aspect with Fortune: <Position of Malefic...The Critical Years> in opposition every 7 years; trine on the right 9; trine on the left 5; square on the right 10; square on the left 4; sextile on the right 11; sextile on the left 3; in the sign preceding the Lot 12; in contact with the Lot 2. <Position of the Lot of Fortune...The Critical Years> Aries 9; Taurus 22; Gemini 20; Cancer 25; Leo 12; Virgo 8; Libra 30; Scorpio 15; Sagittarius 12; Capricorn 8; Aquarius 30; Pisces 15.
rules.translation: 临界年表：凶星对福点之位置→临界年周期（冲=每7年、右三合=9、左三合=5、右四分=10、左四分=4、右六合=11、左六合=3、前座=12、合=2）；福点所在星座→临界年（白羊9/金牛22/双子20/巨蟹25/狮子12/处女8/天秤30/天蝎15/射手12/摩羯8/宝瓶30/双鱼15）。
rules.notes: 凶星合/照福点时尤验

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: Following are the mean years of the stars: Saturn 45; Jupiter 49; Mars 42; Venus 46; Mercury 48; Sun 64; Moon 67.
rules.translation: 行星平均年数：土45/木49/火42/金46/水48/日64/月67——星之 operative 时按此加其周期或星座上升时数。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.result: 依界主/宫主位变判寿差
rules.original_text: it is necessary to consider all of this in order to calculate short- or long-lived nativities—or even the nativities of twins, because often if a malefic term rules the vital sector or if the houseruler is unfavorably situated, the first-born becomes short-lived, but the next-born, if the term or the houseruler changes, becomes long-lived... Consequently, a change of one or two degrees often has a very great effect.
rules.translation: 孪生寿命差异：首生若逢凶星界主 vital sector 或宫主不利=短寿；次生界主/宫主改位=长寿——一二度之差常有巨大效应。
rules.notes: 一、二度变位之效（同 VL-039 上升位移论）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book III——本命判断：控制点/寿命/旺点/界制/福点
rules.original_text: <Position of Malefic...> in opposition every 7 years... in contact with the Lot 2.
rules.translation: （同 VL-022 凶点年表之福点版本：以福点而非命源起算的临界年周期——见映射E）
rules.notes: V 之凶点年表以行星互回计；此处以凶星-福点相位计

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The sun indicates kingship, rule, intellect, intelligence, beauty, motion, loftiness of fortune, the ordinance of the gods, judgement, public reputation, action, authority over the masses, the father... Of the parts of the body, the sun rules the head, the right eye, the heart, the nerves. Of materials, gold; of fruits, wheat and barley. It is of the day sect, yellowish, bitter in taste.
rules.translation: 日（本质）：王权/统治/智慧/美/高运/神谕/审判/声名/行动/大众权/父。身体=头/右眼/心/神经；材质=黄金/麦类。昼派、黄、苦。
rules.notes: 映射A；第4层释义基元

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The moon indicates man's life, body, the mother, conception, beauty, sight, legitimate marriage, nurture, the older brother, housekeeping, the queen, possessions, fortune, the city, gains, expenses, voyages, travel and wanderings. The moon rules the left eye, the stomach, the breasts, the breath, the spleen, the dura mater, the marrow. Of materials silver and glass. Night sect, green, salty.
rules.translation: 月（本质）：生命/身体/母/受孕/婚/抚养/长兄/家政/后/财/城/益/费/旅行漂泊。身体=左眼/胃/胸/呼吸/脾/硬脑膜/髓；材质=银/玻璃。夜派、绿、咸。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Saturn makes those born under him petty, malignant, care-worn, self-depreciating, solitary, deceitful, secretive... humblings, sluggishness, unemployment, obstacles in business, interminable lawsuits, imprisonment, chains, griefs, accusations, tears, bereavement, capture, exposures of children. Saturn makes serfs and farmers... great ranks, distinguished positions, supervisions. Rules the legs, knees, tendons, lymph, phlegm, bladder, kidneys. Lead, wood, stone. Day sect. Star of Nemesis.
rules.translation: 土（本质）：卑琐/恶毒/愁苦/孤僻/奸诈/隐秘——屈辱/迟滞/失业/讼累/系狱/丧亲/弃儿。亦予高位/监督/管理他人财产。身体=腿/膝/腱/淋巴/痰/膀胱/肾；材质=铅/木/石。昼派。复仇之星。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Jupiter indicates childbearing, engendering, desire, loves, political ties, friendships with great men, prosperity, salaries, great gifts, an abundance of crops, justice, offices, authority over temples, arbitrations, trusts, inheritance, brotherhood, fellowship, beneficence, release from bonds, freedom, money. Rules the thighs, feet, sperm, uterus, liver, right side. Tin. Day sect. Grey-white, sweet.
rules.translation: 木（本质）：生育/欲望/爱/政交/贵人/繁荣/俸禄/大礼/丰收/正义/官职/神庙权/仲裁/信托/遗产/兄弟/自由/金钱。身体=大腿/足/精/子宫/肝/右侧；材质=锡。昼派、灰白、甜。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Mars indicates force, wars, plunderings, screams, violence, whoring, loss of property, banishment, exile, alienation from parents, capture, deaths of wives, abortions, love affairs, lies, vain hopes, strong-armed robbery, banditry, anger, fighting, hatreds, lawsuits... violent murders, slashings, bloodshed, fever, ulceration, boils, burns, chains, torture. Commands, campaigns, leadership, governorships, hunting. Rules the head, seat, genitals; blood, sperm ducts, bile. Iron. Night sect, red, acid.
rules.translation: 火（本质）：强力/战争/掠夺/暴力/嫖/失财/流放/离亲/被俘/妻死/堕胎/情事/谎言/强盗/愤怒/斗殴/讼。暴杀/刀伤/血/热病/溃疡/灼伤/锁链/酷刑。统兵/征伐/执政/狩猎。身体=头/臀/生殖器；血/精管/胆汁。铁。夜派、红、酸。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Venus is desire and love. It indicates the mother and nurture. It makes priesthoods, high offices, cheerfulness, friendship, companionship, acquisition of property, marriages, pure trades, fine voices, music, beauty, painting, dyeing, unguent making... emeralds, precious stones, ivory. Rules the neck, face, lips, smell, front parts, parts of intercourse; lungs. Night sect, white, greasy.
rules.translation: 金（本质）：欲望/爱/母/养育。祭司/高位/欢愉/友/得财/婚/技艺/音乐/美/绘画/染织。珠宝/象牙。身体=颈/面/唇/嗅觉/前部/交合部；肺。夜派、白、腻。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Mercury indicates education, letters, disputation, reasoning, brotherhood, interpretation, embassies, number, accounts, geometry, markets, youth, games, theft, gain, discoveries, obedience, weighing, testing of coinage, hearing, versatility... temple builders, sculptors, doctors, secretaries, orators, philosophers, architects, musicians, prophets, diviners, augurs, dream interpreters. Rules the hands, shoulders, fingers, joints, belly, hearing, arteries, intestines, tongue. Copper, coins.
rules.translation: 水（本质）：教育/文书/论辩/推理/兄弟/口译/使节/数学/账目/几何/市场/青年/游戏/盗窃/获利/发现/称量/验币/多才。建筑师/雕塑/医/秘书/演说家/哲人/乐师/先知/占卜/解梦。身体=手/肩/指/关节/腹/听觉/动脉/肠/舌。铜/钱币。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The benefic stars which are appropriately and favorably situated bring about their proper effects according to their own nature and the nature of their sign... If however they are unfavorably situated, they are indicative of reversals. In the same way even the malefic stars, when operative in appropriate places in their own sect, are bestowers of good and indicative of the greatest positions; when inoperative, disasters and accusations.
rules.translation: 吉凶相对论总纲：吉星劣位=反转；凶星在本派善位=大位大功、否则灾祸指控（Book I 开篇总则）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: To find the Ascendant: having determined the sun's degree-position, note where the dodekatemorion falls. The sign in trine to the left of this position will be the Ascendant, or the equivalent sign, providing you take into account the distinction between night and day births. For example: sun in Aquarius 22°, dodekatemorion in Scorpio; the sign in trine to the left is Pisces.
rules.translation: 上升算法1（十二宫位法）：取太阳度数之位，定其 dodekatemorion（十二分位），其左三分相之星座=上升（或等效阴阳星座，分昼夜）。例：日宝瓶22°→dodekatemorion 天蝎→左三合=双鱼（昼生）。
rules.notes: 映射J；昼夜等效/对宫法

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Having determined the degree-position of the sun, for day births add to this position the rising time of the sign in which the sun is; then begin to count from the moon's position, giving each sign one degree. The Ascendant will be where the count stops. For night births add the rising time of the moon's sign and count from the sun's position.
rules.translation: 上升算法2：昼生=日位+日座上升时数，从月位逐宫计数；夜生=加月座上升时数，从日位计数——停点即上升。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Multiply the hour/time of birth by the motion of the moon. For day births count from the sun's degree-position; for night births count from the point in opposition. The degree where the count stops will be considered the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 上升算法3（精确到度）：时×月运动；昼生日位起数、夜生对宫起数——精确上升。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: For those born during the day, add the remaining degrees in the sun's sign to the moon's degree-position and divide by 30. The remainder will be the Ascendant. For night births: add the remaining degrees in the moon's sign to the sun's degree-position...
rules.translation: 上升算法4（除法）：昼生=(月位+日座余度数)/30 之余数；夜生相反。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Midheaven: using the rising times for the appropriate klima, add the rising times from the Descendant to the point in opposition, then take half of the sum. Count this off from the Descendant. MC will be where the count stops.
rules.translation: 中天算法：klima 上升时数——自下降至对宫（点对点）合计，取半，自下降起数=MC。例：升摩羯15°klima2→214→半107→自巨蟹15°数→天蝎2°=MC。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The length of the hours of the day: add the rising times from the sun's degree-position to the point in opposition. Take 1/15 of that and you will know the length of the hour.
rules.translation: 昼时长度：日位至对宫上升时数÷15=小时长。例：巨蟹15°总214→1/15=14又4/15时。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Aries rises in 20; Libra in 40, for a total of 60. The rising time of a sign plus that of the sign in opposition will total 60. The hours total 4. By however much one sign exceeds the half, by so much the sign in opposition falls short. The addition/subtraction factor is 4 per sign in the second klima: Aries 20, Taurus 24, Gemini 28, Cancer 32, Leo 36, Virgo 40, Libra 40, then subtract from Scorpio to Pisces.
rules.translation: 上升时数递推法（klima2 基准）：对宫上升时数合计恒=60；每宫增量/减量 4——白羊20/金牛24/双子28/巨蟹32/狮子36/处女40/天秤40/天蝎36/射手32/摩羯28/宝瓶24/双鱼20。
rules.notes: 映射J；klima 递推：从巨蟹到射手，klima1=210、klima2=214...klima7=234，每 klima 增4

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: In the first klima the rising times from Cancer to Sagittarius total 210; in the seventh, 234. If you subtract the 210 of the first from 234, 24 are left. One-sixth of this is 4. Thus 4 is the increase needed for each klima.
rules.translation: klima 递推：巨蟹-射手段上升时数总和：klima1=210→klima7=234，每 klima 增 4（7 气候区表构造法）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The listening and beholding signs (the sextile signs): Pisces beholds Taurus; in the second klima the rising times of the six signs from Pisces to Leo total 160 and from Taurus to Libra total 200. Pisces is less than Taurus and therefore listens to it... Gemini and Leo are of equal rising time and listen to each other.
rules.translation: 听视星座（六合 sympatheia）：两六合宫上升时数总和相等=互听；不等=轻者听重者。例：双子212=狮子212 互听。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: To find new and full moons handily: take the distance from the sun to the moon, determine how many dodekatemoria there are between. Count this amount off from the sun's degree-position and you will find the new moon there. For full-moon nativities, take the distance from the point opposite the sun to the moon... Add 15° to the full moon to find the next new moon; add 15° to the new moon to find the next full moon.
rules.translation: 新月满月快速法：日月距=若干 dodekatemoria（每30°=2.5日近似）；新月=日位回数该距；满月=日对宫回数。新+15°=下满月；满+15°=下新月。
rules.notes: 例：日狮子5°月天秤26°距81°≈7个十二分位=7日龄

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: For the week: take the full years of the Augustan era and the leap years, add the days from Thoth 1 to the birth date, subtract as many 7's as possible. Count the result off from the sun's day. The order of the stars with respect to the days is Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn. The arrangement of their spheres is Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon.
rules.translation: 星期（七区系统）：奥古斯都纪元整年+闰年+自岁首日数，÷7 余数自太阳日计数——得日主星。日序：日月火水木金土；天球序（时主）：土木火日金水月。
rules.notes: 小时命名按天球序；下日首时=下一星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The houseruler of the year: calculate in the same way (full years + leap years + days from Thoth 1), divide by 7, count the remainder from the sun's day. The year goes to that star. The ruler of the month: applying the arrangement of the spheres in ascending order... It is more scientific to take it from the rising of Sirius.
rules.translation: 年主：奥古斯都纪元年+闰+岁首日，÷7 余数自太阳日数——得年主。月主按天球序递推。Valens 认为从天狼星升起起算更科学。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The masculine and feminine degrees: the first 2 1/2 degrees of the masculine signs are masculine, the next 2 1/2 feminine. The first 2 1/2 degrees of feminine signs are feminine, the next masculine. The degree of the new moon will be indicative for new-moon births.
rules.translation: 阴阳度数：阳座前2.5°阳/次2.5°阴；阴座反。新月生人看新月度、满月生人看满月度。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The visibility periods of the moon: in its first day it appears 4/5 of an hour... multiply the days since new moon by 4, then dividing by 5. For example: 15 days since new moon: 4×15=60, 1/5=12; the moon, being full, will be visible 12 hours. The month is 29 1/2 days; the year 354 days.
rules.translation: 月可见期：日龄×4/5=可见小时。第15日=满月可见12时。月=29.5日、年=354日。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The moon becomes invisible as it approaches conjunction: take one-half of the rising time of the sign in which the sun is located, and at that point the moon will be invisible.
rules.translation: 月不可见期：日座上升时数之半=合相前隐没点（自30°回数）。例：日白羊20→半10→双鱼20°隐。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The third, seventh, and fortieth days of the moon: assume the moon in Scorpio 7°; the third day will be in Sagittarius 7°. The seventh will be found in square, at Aquarius 7°. The fortieth will be at Taurus 7°. Note the fortunate/unfortunate nativities according to these three locations: three beheld by benefics = exceedingly great good fortune; two benefics one malefic = average; three malefics = misfortune.
rules.translation: 月三日/七日/四十日点：月位+1宫=三日、+4宫（四分）=七日、+7宫=四十日。三处皆吉星照=大福；两吉一凶=中；三凶=祸。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The ascending node: take the full years of the Augustan era and multiply by 19 1/3. Add for each Egyptian month 1° 35' and for each day 3'. Divide by 360. Count off the remainder from Cancer in the direction of diurnal motion, giving 30 to each sign. The ascending node will be where the count stops.
rules.translation: 升交点算法：纪元年×19⅓+每月1°35'+每日3'，÷360 余数自巨蟹顺日行计数=升交点（对宫=降交点）。
rules.notes: 吉星照升交=命旺上升

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The sun's degree-position: to a birth date in the months from Thoth to Phamenoth add 8°; to Pharmouthi add 7°, to Pachon 6°, to Payni 5°, to Epiphi 4°, to Mesore 3°.
rules.translation: 太阳位置简算法（埃及历）：岁首至 Phamenoth 加8°、逐月递减1°（Pharmouthi7/Pachon6/Payni5/Epiphi4/Mesore3）。
rules.notes: 手算核对法（真实排盘仍用星历表）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Saturn: take the full years since Augustus and divide by 30. Multiply the remainder by 12°. Multiply the result of the division by 30 (synodic period) by 5°. For each month add 1°, for each day 2'. Count from Cancer in proper motion.
rules.translation: 土星位置简算法：纪元年÷30 余×12°+整周期×5°+月1°/日2'，自巨蟹顺行计数。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Jupiter: divide the full years from Caesar by 12. Multiply the remainder by 12° and add this to the result of the previous division by 12 (synodic period). Add 1° for each month and 2' for each day. Count from Taurus, giving 12 to each sign.
rules.translation: 木星位置简算法：纪元年÷12 余×12°+周期1°/12年+月1°/日2'，自金牛计数。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Mars: divide the years from Augustus by 30. If the remainder is even, start from Aries; if odd, from Libra. Double it and add 2 1/2 for each month. If more than 60, count off the amount over 60 from Libra or Aries, giving 5 to each sign. If the sun is west of the star, the star will be behind its calculated position.
rules.translation: 火星位置简算法：纪元年÷30 余偶=Aries起/奇=Libra起；加倍+月2.5°；>60 溢出自起座以5°/宫计。日偏西=星在算位之后（近日修正）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Venus: divide the years from Augustus by 8. Examine the remainder to see if Venus is at a point of maximum eastern elongation during that year. If it is, use this point and add the days from that point to the day in question... subtract 120°, count the remaining degrees from the adjoining sign, giving each sign 25°. Remainders 1,3,4,6,7 = at max eastern elongation; 2,5 = in motion.
rules.translation: 金星位置简算法：纪元年÷8 余数查表定东大距点（余1,3,4,6,7=大距年；2,5=行运年）；加日至日数、减120°、自邻宫以25°/宫计数。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Mercury: take the days from Thoth to the birth date and add 162. If the sum is more than 360, divide by 360 and count the remainder off from Aries, giving 30 to each sign. In every case make it very near the sun.
rules.translation: 水星位置简算法：岁首日数+162，>360 减之，自白羊以30°/宫数；恒令其近日（日初=星在座末、日末=星在次座）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Transits: The sun: the 2nd, 6th, 12th are good; 7th and 4th rotten. The moon: 3rd, 8th, 9th rotten; 5th, 11th, 12th good. Saturn: 4th, 10th rotten; 6th, 8th, 12th good. Jupiter: 3rd, 9th, 10th, 11th good; 4th, 7th rotten. Mars: 3rd, 4th, 9th good; 7th, 10th rotten. Venus: 3rd, 7th, 8th good; 5th rotten. Mercury: 2nd, 5th, 11th rotten; 7th, 8th, 9th good.
rules.notes: 第4层解读：行星行运应验判据（映射A附）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Triangles: The sun's triangle is Aries, Leo, Sagittarius (day-sect), with Jupiter and Saturn as co-workers; sun rules for day births, Jupiter for night, Saturn works with both. The moon's triangle: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn, with Venus and Mars; moon rules night births, Venus second, Mars third (day births: Venus first, moon second, Mars third). Airy triangle: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius: day Saturn, Mercury, Jupiter; night Mercury, Saturn, Jupiter. Moist triangle: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces: night Mars, Venus, moon; day Venus, Mars, moon. Mercury is common to both sects.
rules.translation: 三角宫主表（四组）：火三角（白羊狮射）=日派，昼日/夜木、土共助；土三角（金牛处摩羯）=月派，夜月/次金/三火（昼金星先）；风三角（双子天秤宝瓶）昼土水木/夜水土木；水三角（巨蟹蝎鱼）夜火金月/昼金火月。水星两派通用。
rules.notes: 映射D；第3层判断命主与年主

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: For day nativities examine the sun: in which triangle it lies; its predominant houseruler and helper—whether at, following, or preceding an angle... If the houseruler is in the Ascendant or at MC or in operative signs, forecast a fortunate nativity; if it follows an angle, moderate fortune; if it precedes an angle, base and unfortunate.
rules.translation: 日/夜生主星判断：昼生日所在三角主+助星的位置——角位=贵命；角后=中；角前=贱。夜生按同法查月。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: If the predominant houseruler is unfavorably located, but its successor is at an angle, the native will experience ups and downs during his early years until the rising time of the sign or the cyclical return of the chronocrator, but will afterwards be vigorous. If the preceding is favorable and the succeeding unfavorable, the native will fulfill his promise well at first, but afterwards will be brought low.
rules.translation: 主星交接判命：前主劣后主优=先苦后甜（至上升时数/时主回归）；前优后劣=先甜后苦（自后主劣位之上升时数起）。
rules.notes: 时主分配之预演（Book VII 详细化）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Lot of Fortune: just as the King has mystically revealed: for day nativities count accurately the distance from the sun to the moon, then measure off in the opposite direction an equal distance from the Ascendant, and inspect the resulting place: which star is its ruler and which stars are at this point and all the square or trine asterisms of this place.
rules.translation: 福点公式（王引文）：昼生=自日向月之距，自上升反向等距=福点。查其主星/所落星/四分三合。
rules.notes: 夜生反向（Book IV 映射已记）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Lot itself will be equivalent to the Ascendant and will mean Life; the tenth place from it will be equivalent to MC and will mean Rank; the seventh will be the Descendant; the fourth IC. The other places will have the same effects as the original XII Places.
rules.translation: 福点为轴：以福点为上升重排十二宫（福点=命、十位=业、七位=降、四位=底）——'本命角'体系。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Lot of Daimon: for day births, the distance from the moon to the sun; for night births, from the sun to the moon, then counting this distance from the Ascendant. The Lot of Basis: the distance from Fortune to Daimon (day) or from Daimon to Fortune (night), counted from the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 命主点（Daimon）公式：昼=自月→日距自上升计；夜=自日→月。基点（Basis）=昼自福→命主距/夜自命主→福距，自上升计。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: If the houserulers exchange places—the ruler of the Lot of Fortune is in the Lot of Basis, the ruler of Basis is in the Lot of Daimon, and the ruler of Daimon is in the place of Fortune—the native is fortunate, royal, noted.
rules.translation: 三点互换判贵：福点主入基点、基点主入命主点、命主点主入福点——王命贵命。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The 11th Place relative to the Lot of Fortune is the Place of Accomplishment, the bestower of property and goods, especially if benefics are in this Place or in aspect. The sun, Jupiter, Venus provide gold, silver, jewelry, gifts from the great. The moon and Mercury bring ups and downs. Mars takes away what was gained—reductions, thefts, burning, trials, confiscations. Saturn in its proper places makes rulers of estates; out of place and wrong sect brings disaster, ruin, shipwreck, poverty, debt.
rules.translation: 成位（福点第11宫）=产业授予位：日木金=金银珠宝大礼；月水=生计起伏；火=夺产/盗/讼/抄没；土本座=地主、失位错派=灾破产债。
rules.notes: 第4层解读：财运查询表

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The XII Place of the Bad Daimon: if malefics are in this place, they cause great wounds and traumas, especially if in their proper face. If the Lot of Fortune is present and some star rules it, there will be no help, not even during transits. Benefics in this Place will not bestow their benefits. Whenever the rulers of the Ascendant, of the Lot, and of Daimon fall in this sign, they make men unfortunate and disgraced, lacking their daily bread.
rules.translation: 十二宫（坏Daimon）：凶星落=重伤创（本界尤）；福点在此=无助；吉星不施益；升/福/命主三主同落=卑贱乞食。
rules.notes: 映射E：十二宫释义之一

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The XI Place of the Good Daimon: if benefics are in their proper places and faces, they make men illustrious and rich from youth—even more so if trine from the right with the Lot of Fortune or sextile with the Ascendant. If malefics are in conjunction with the Good Daimon, they cannot do any evil.
rules.translation: 十一宫（好Daimon）：吉星本位本界=少壮显贵（福点右三合/升六合尤）；凶星合此宫=不能为恶。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The X Place (Midheaven): both benefics and malefics rejoice in this place if they have been assigned the Lot, the Ascendant, or Daimon. If any of the benefics are in it when rising, or have contact with the moon, tyrants and kings are born. The ruler of this Place, if favorably situated, makes vigorous men; if unfavorably, feeble men. If setting and a malefic is in conjunction or opposition, it makes failures, sterile or childless men.
rules.translation: 十宫（MC）：吉凶星若辖福/升/命主点皆悦此宫；吉星升此或触月=暴君王侯；主优=健、劣=弱；主沉+凶合冲=败/无嗣。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The IX Place of the God, just before MC: if benefics happen to be in this Place and have been assigned the Ascendant or Fortune, the native will be blessed, reverent, a prophet of the great god. If Mercury alone is in aspect, the native will be involved in soothsaying. But if malefics are in conjunction and rule the Ascendant and Fortune, the native will be a tyrant: he will found some cities; he will sack others.
rules.translation: 九宫（神宫）：吉星辖升/福=福慧先知；水星独照=预言术士；凶星辖升福=暴君——建城与屠城。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The VIII Place of Death: benefics in this place are ineffectual and weak. If malefics are in conjunction and rule the Lot, the native is a vagrant, losing whatever he may have gained. If the Lot falls here and malefics rule it, the native will be poor, unable to clothe himself. If Mercury alone is here and is ruler of Intelligence, it makes fools, dullards, illiterates. Only the moon, when its light is waxing, seems to rejoice in this Place.
rules.translation: 八宫（死亡宫）：吉星无力；凶辖福点=流浪失产；福点落此+凶主=赤贫；水独落=愚钝；唯盈月悦此宫。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The VII Place of the Descendant: benefics here ruling the Ascendant or the Lot of Fortune indicate inheritances, sudden acquisition of property, benefits from a death. If malefics rule the Lots but are not in their proper face or sect, the native will lead a wretched old age. Malefics setting while out of their own signs cause suicides.
rules.translation: 七宫（下降）：吉星辖升/福=遗产/骤得/因丧获益；凶辖点而失位错派=悲惨晚年；凶星落位沉落（非本座）=自戕。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The VI Place of Mars: if benefics happen to be in this Place, the native will lose whatever he possesses. If the sun is here and rules the Lot or the Ascendant, the native is condemned by the highest authority. If Saturn rules, he will be a wanderer and flee his homeland. If Mars rules, it causes wounds and diseases in the limb indicated by the sign, and makes naked beggars. If the moon is in this Place, the native will be a slave—unless the rest are in conjunction with the moon.
rules.translation: 六宫（火星宫）：吉星落=失产；日辖点=受最高当局定罪；土辖=流浪背井；火辖=伤疾+裸丐；月落=为奴（他星吉合则脱）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The V Place: if benefics hold the Ascendant or the Lot, the native will be great, will lead the masses, and will make laws for them. If Mars is situated as specified, men will be rulers of all sorts of places: governors, tyrants, masters of life and death. If Saturn is here, men will be masters of estates, flocks, and herds. The benefics help greatly while passing through this Place; the malefics cannot do harm.
rules.translation: 五宫（吉福）：吉星辖升/福=伟人领众立法；火=总督/暴君/生死主；土=地主牧主；吉星过此大助、凶星不能害。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The IV Place (Lower Midheaven): if benefics rule the Ascendant or Fortune, the native will make his living in temples. If Mars is here with them and assigned Fortune and the Ascendant, the native will live a troubled, disgraced life, suffering a violent/self-inflicted death. This Place implies good repute after death and bequests to heirs. If malefics are here, the native will bequeath his property to whomever he wishes.
rules.translation: 四宫（下中天）：吉星辖升/福=庙宇谋生；火同落辖=困顿受辱暴亡；此宫主身后令名与遗赠；凶落=遗产随意处置。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The III Place of the Goddess Moon: if the moon is here, assigned the Ascendant or the Lot, in its proper face, the native will be great, rule a city, be master of treasuries. If Jupiter is with the moon, he will be a prophet, fortunate, rich, famous. If Mars is in conjunction, he will be successful but wicked, embezzling deposits. If Venus in her own places rules this Place and the Lot (especially for night births), the native will be rich and well liked by women.
rules.translation: 三宫（月女神宫）：月辖升/福+本界=伟人城主宝库主；木伴月=先知福贵；火合月=能而奸（吞没存款）；金本座辖此+福点（夜生尤）=富而女爱。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The II Place, called the Gate of Hades: the benefics do no good, the malefics make men sluggish and injured. If the Lot is here and malefics rule it or the Ascendant, the native becomes a cemetery guard. Saturn ruling the Lot here makes dead-souled men, weak in body, chained/imprisoned until the completion of the chronocratorship. Mercury under the rays of the sun here makes stupid, illiterate men. If the moon is here with Saturn in the Ascendant, the native suffers from cataracts and glaucoma.
rules.translation: 二宫（冥府门）：吉星无益、凶星钝伤；福点+凶辖=守墓人；土辖福点落此=魂死身弱系狱（至时主完）；水被日灼=愚钝文盲；月在此+土升=白内障青光眼。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Nine Names of the Places: The God (IX)=father; The Goddess (III)=mother; The Good Daimon (XI)=children; The Good Fortune (V)=marriage; The Bad Daimon (XII)=diseases; The Bad Fortune (VI)=injuries; The Lot of Fortune and the Ascendant (I)=life and livelihood; Daimon=mental activity; Midheaven (X)=action/occupation; Love=desire; Necessity=enemies.
rules.translation: 十二宫名义表（九名+增补）：IX神=父；III女神=母；XI好神=子女；V好福=婚姻；XII坏神=疾病；VI坏福=伤；I升/福=生命与生计；命主点=心智；X=业；爱点=欲；必然点=敌。
rules.notes: 映射E；第4层事项定位

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.result: 福点/命主点 双 12 宫表
rules.original_text: The twelve-sign injury/disease table: from the Lot of Fortune: breast (Lot), flanks (2), belly (3), groin (4), genitals (5), thighs (6), knees (7), calves (8), feet (9), head (10), face/neck (11), arms/shoulders (12). From Daimon: heart (Daimon), stomach (2), kidneys/sperm ducts (3), colon (4), liver (5), intestines (6), bladder (7), bowels (8), brain/teeth/ears (9), gullet (10), tongue (11), stomach (12).
rules.translation: 伤病部位双表：自福点起12宫=胸/肋/腹/腹股沟/生殖器/大腿/膝/小腿/足/头/面颈/臂肩；自命主点起=心/胃/肾精管/结肠/肝/肠/膀胱/肠道/脑齿耳/食管/舌/胃。
rules.notes: 映射G；结合凶星照断伤病

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Signs and their injuries: Aries=head, sensory faculties, eyesight—headaches, dimming of vision, strokes, deafness, blindness, leprosy... Taurus=neck, face, gullet—hunchback, lameness, eye pains, blindness because of the Pleiades... Gemini=shoulders, arms, hands—injuries, attacks of bandits, jaundice, falls... Cancer=chest, stomach, breasts, spleen—leprosy, dropsy, jaundice, pleurisy... Leo=flanks, loin, heart—lunacy, convulsions, loss of limbs, bites from wild beasts... Virgo=belly, internal organs—orthopnoea, hernia... Libra=hips, buttocks, colon, genitals—paralysis, hernia, dysentery, dropsy, kidney stones... Scorpio=genitals, rump—blindness, kidney stones, strangury, fistula... Sagittarius=thighs, groin—piebald skin, baldness, gout, falls... Capricorn=knees, sinews—weak vision, insanity, delirium... Aquarius=legs, calves—elephantiasis, jaundice, lameness, dropsy, insanity, castration... Pisces=feet, toes—arthritis, leprosy, births with extra limbs, deafness.
rules.translation: 星座伤病表（12座）：白羊=头/感官/目——头痛目翳中风聋盲麻风；金牛=颈面喉——驼背跛足目疾（昴宿）；双子=肩臂手——伤/匪袭/黄疸/坠落；巨蟹=胸胃乳脾——麻风水肿黄疸胸膜炎；狮子=胁腰心——疯癫抽搐失肢兽咬；处女=腹内脏——气喘疝气；天秤=臀结肠生殖器——麻痹疝气痢疾水肿结石；天蝎=生殖器尾——目翳结石尿闭瘘管；射手=大腿腹股沟——斑皮秃头痛风坠落；摩羯=膝腱——弱视疯癫谵妄；宝瓶=腿胫——象皮病黄疸跛足水肿疯癫阉割；双鱼=足趾——关节炎麻风多肢聋哑。
rules.notes: 映射H；第4层断伤病

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Lot of Fortune and its ruler: the nature of the sign will indicate the injury. The ruler of the Lot will be particularly indicative. Likewise examine Daimon and its ruler. The stars in the Place of Occupation must be examined in the same way. Injuries will be violent if malefics are in conjunction or aspect with these places or their houserulers. If a malefic is in a Potent Place and beheld by a malefic, the disease will be incurable; if a benefic is in conjunction, cured by medicine or the help of a god.
rules.translation: 伤病判断法：查福点/命主点/业宫所在座与其主——座性定部位、主星定病症；凶星合照=重创；'强力位'（角与角后）+凶照=不治、吉合=药愈神助。
rules.notes: '强力位'=角及角后二位（与 Book VII 角位时主呼应）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Marriage: the Place of Marriage is the VII Sign from the Ascendant. It is also necessary to look at the location of Venus, the other stars in Venus' sign, its aspects and rulers. If Venus is operative in a tropic or bicorporeal sign (especially for night births), it makes men oft-married and promiscuous. If a malefic nullifies Venus or its houseruler by being in aspect, it causes deaths, injuries, or other problems to wives. If Saturn beholds the setting Venus, in most cases it makes unmarried, unsociable men. In all cases Saturn in opposition to Venus brings sickly or barren wives.
rules.translation: 婚姻总则：婚位=VII宫；查金星星座/相位/主星。金在启动/双体座（夜生尤）=多婚淫乱；凶星克金或其主=妻死伤祸；土照沉金=不婚孤僻；土冲金=妻病或不育。
rules.notes: 映射F两星组合亦有土金条目

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Calculate the Marriage Lot: for day births, determine the distance from Jupiter to Venus (for night births, from Venus to Jupiter), then count this distance from the Ascendant. The point in opposition to this Lot is indicative of Adultery. Also: for men determine the distance from the sun to Venus (for women from the moon to Mars), then count from the Ascendant. Venus will be the Marriage-bringer for men, Mars the Marriage-bringer for women.
rules.translation: 婚点公式（两种）：法一=昼木→金距自上升（夜反向）；法二=男日→金距（女月→火距）自上升。男婚使=金、女婚使=火；婚点对宫=奸情点。
rules.notes: 婚点主晨升=早婚、暮升=晚婚

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Place of Children is figured from Mercury and Venus... The Lot of Children: for male nativities, determine the distance from Jupiter to Mercury (for female, from Jupiter to Venus), then count from the Ascendant. If the ruler has malefics in aspect, it destroys children; if it has the Givers of Children (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury unafflicted) in aspect, fine offspring. Bicorporeal signs double the number. Feminine stars in aspect grant female children; masculine stars male children.
rules.translation: 子女点公式：男=木→水距自上升（女=木→金）。吉照=佳嗣；凶照=损子。双体座=数目翻倍；阴性星照=女、阳性=男。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Brothers: the sun in the Ascendant causes few brothers. Saturn in the Descendant causes few brothers. Jupiter, Mercury, Venus at the angles are the bestowers of brothers, but Saturn in opposition kills the oldest brother. Venus and the moon domiciled in the III Place grant sisters, especially if feminine sign. The Place of Brothers: for day births, the distance from Saturn to Jupiter (for night births the reverse), counted from the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 兄弟判断：日升/土降=兄弟少；木水金在角=赐兄弟、土冲=杀长兄；金月在三宫（阴座）=姊妹；兄弟点=昼土→木距自上升（夜反）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Predecease of Parents: since the sun indicates the father (Saturn in the second rank), examine which of these is associated with the moon—beheld, conjunct, in its house or triangle. That star assumes the Father's Place. Venus and the moon assume the Mother's Place. If the sun assumes the Father's Place and is beheld by Mars or Saturn with no benefics in aspect, the father will predecease. If the same is true of the moon or Venus, the mother will predecease.
rules.translation: 父母先死判据：父位=日月土（土次位）中与月关联者；母位=金/月。日得父位被火土照（无吉）=父先亡；月或金同理=母先亡。
rules.notes: 另法：天狼星升至生日天数÷12 余数自月位计——阴座=母先死/阳座=父先死

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Lot of the Father: for day births determine the distance from the sun to Saturn and count from the Ascendant. (Some determine the sun to Jupiter.) For night births, the distance from Venus to the moon counted from the Ascendant.
rules.translation: 父点公式：昼=日→土距自上升（或日→木）；夜=金→月距自上升。母点类推（原文断）。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Separation of Parents: Mars and Saturn, when intercepting the luminaries or situated between the signs which contain the luminaries, or between their rays, separate parents. Saturn in conjunction with the sun, if the moon is estranged, separates parents. Parents will be in harmony whenever the luminaries and their houserulers are in harmony with each other.
rules.translation: 父母分离判据：火土介入日月之间/光线之间=离异；土合日而月疏=离；日月及其主相谐=父母和睦。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Free and Slave Nativities: determined from the phases of the nativity. If the sign of the phase or its ruler is unfavorably situated or beheld by malefics, the native will be base. If the phase is at an angle and its ruler has benefics in aspect, the native will become noble and famous. If the place is guarded by malefics but its ruler by benefics, the native of servile birth will be raised as free-born. If the place is guarded by benefics and the ruler by malefics, the free-born will be reduced to slavery.
rules.translation: 自由/奴役判据（相位）：相位座或其主劣位/凶照=卑贱；相位角位+吉照=贵；位凶主吉=奴籍养为自由人；位吉主凶=自由人沦为奴。

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The Eleven Phases of the Moon: 1 New moon; 2 First visibility; 3 Crescent 45°; 4 Quarter 90°; 5 Gibbous 135°; 6 Full 180°; 7 Second gibbous 225°; 8 Second quarter 270°; 9 Second crescent 315°; 10 Final visibility 360°; 11 Beginning of waning. The new moon indicates rank, power, kingly dispositions, all public business, parents, marriages, religion. First visibility indicates life, occupation, future wealth. Crescent indicates nurture and expectations, wives and mothers. Quarter indicates injuries, diseases, violent accidents, children, status. Gibbous indicates prosperity, travel, affinity of relatives. Full moon indicates fame and infamy, travel and violent events. Waning ruler indicates diminishing of resources, chilling of occupations, sudden falls.
rules.translation: 月之十一相及涵义：新月=位/权/王性/公事/父母/婚/宗教；初见=命/业/未来财；娥眉=养育与期望/妻母；四分=伤/病/暴故/子女/位；凸月=繁荣/旅/亲缘；满月=名与毁/旅/暴事；亏月首主=财源减缩/业冷/骤落。
rules.notes: 映射I；各相配星：水至4日、至8、金至12、日至14、火至21、木至25、土至30

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Violent Deaths: when the ruler of the new or full moon at the nativity is turned away from its sign or unfavorably situated, with a malefic in aspect, it indicates violent death. If Mercury is in opposition to the full moon with malefics in aspect, a bad cause of death. If Saturn, Mars, or Mercury are in the sign of the moon on the fortieth day, violent death. Malefics in the Descendant or in the sign preceding it bring violent deaths or miserable deaths. The VIII Place from the Ascendant and the 8th Place from the Lot of Fortune have the same influence on the cause of death.
rules.translation: 暴死判据：新月/满月主失位或劣位+凶照=暴死；水冲满月+凶照=恶死因；土火水在月之四十日座=暴死；凶在降/降前=暴死或惨死；升之八宫与福点八宫同断死因。
rules.notes: 判死因：查死宫（VIII）所在星座与主

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The destruction of the signs: Aries is destroyed by Scorpio (Mars destroys itself)—suicides, falls from heights, accomplices in crime, bandits, fires, animal attacks. Taurus by Sagittarius (Venus by Jupiter)—peaceful death from luxury, strokes while relaxing. Gemini by Capricorn (Mercury by Saturn)—black bile, cramps, condemnation, suffocation, poison. Cancer by Aquarius (Moon by Saturn)—dampness, spleen/stomach pains, sea deaths, elephantiasis, lunacy. Leo by Pisces (Sun by Jupiter)—heart attacks, liver complaints, wet places, treachery of women. Virgo by Aries (Mercury by Mars)—treachery, crime, burns, blindness, captivity. Libra by Taurus (Venus by itself)—suicides by poison, snakebite, self-starvation, drowning. Scorpio by Gemini (Mars by Mercury)—knife cuts to genitals, war, pirates, fire. Sagittarius by Cancer (Jupiter by the Moon)—spleen/liver/stomach disorders, falls, shipwreck, lunacy. Capricorn by Leo (Saturn by the Sun)—heart attacks, burns, wrath of kings, impaling. Aquarius by Virgo (Saturn by Mercury)—wasting of vitals, dropsy, sword slashes, treachery of women. Pisces by Libra (Jupiter by Venus)—moist complaints, poisoning, cramps, sciatica.
rules.translation: 星座被毁表（暴死死因）：白羊被蝎毁（火自毁）——坠亡/火/兽攻/盗党；金牛被射毁（金被木）——奢华安逸死；双子被摩羯毁（水被土）——黑胆汁/绞/毒；巨蟹被宝瓶毁（月被土）——水湿/海难/象皮病；狮子被双鱼毁（日被木）——心脏病/湿处/女叛；处女被白羊毁（水被火）——背叛/火焚/目盲/俘；天秤被金牛毁（金自毁）——毒/蛇咬/绝食/溺；天蝎被双子毁（火被水）——生殖器刀伤/战争/海盗；射手被巨蟹毁（木被月）——脾肝胃病/坠落/海难；摩羯被狮子毁（土被日）——心脏病/焚/王怒/穿刺；宝瓶被处女毁（土被水）——虚劳/水肿/刀剑/女叛；双鱼被天秤毁（木被金）——湿症/毒/痉挛/坐骨神经痛。
rules.notes: 映射J；死因断法=查死宫星座与凶星

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Conception: there are three factors: minimum, mean, maximum, and the difference between each factor is 15 days. The minimum factor is 258, which applies when the moon just follows the Descendant. The mean factor is 273, when the moon is in the Ascendant. The maximum factor is 288, when the moon is in the Descendant. If we measure the 15 days of difference from the Ascendant to the Descendant, we find that 2 1/2 fall to each sign.
rules.translation: 受孕三因子：最小258日（月随降位）、均273（月在升）、最大288（月在降）；级差15日、每宫2.5日。例：升巨蟹月天秤（IC角位）=280日12时（260.5+？→表值）。
rules.notes: 映射L：月位→妊娠天数全表（自降后258至降288）

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Seven-month children: I note the date of birth in the year prior to the nativity and calculate the moon; then the date in the year following and calculate the moon again. If in both years the moons are trine with the moon at the nativity, the conception will be carried to term. If both are square, gestation will be the minimum factor 258 days. If the prior year is trine and the following is square, he will be 269 days in the womb. If the prior is square and the following is turned away, an eight-month gestation and stillborn. If in the two years the moons are in no aspect, still-born or aborted with danger to the mother. If the moons are in opposition and in harmony, seven-month term.
rules.translation: 七个月婴判据：前后两年之月相对本命月之相位——双三合=足月；双四分=258日；前三合后四分=269日；前四分后离=八月死胎；无相位=死胎/堕胎危母；双冲相谐=七月产。
rules.notes: '古人暗写此事，我予以阐明'——Valens 自评

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: The opposition of sun and moon is not always bad. Only if an approaching malefic beholds the phase or casts its rays while having some relationship with the luminaries does the opposition become bad. Petosiris: 'The beginning, the end, the controller, and the measurement standard of the whole is the houseruling star of each nativity: it makes clear what kind of person the native will be, what kind of basis his livelihood will have, what his character will be, what sort of body he will have, and all the things that will accompany him in life. Without this star nothing, neither occupation nor rank, will come to anyone.' One star is the Life-giver, another is the ruler of property and of death.
rules.translation: 对冲非恒凶：仅当逼近凶星照相位或投射光线且与光体有关联时为凶（Petosiris 宫主论引文：'宫主星为一切之本——无此星则无业无位'）。命主星/财产与死亡主星可不同星。
rules.notes: Book II 收尾总纲：'一星主业位、一星主寿命、一星主伤病死'——多主星体系

rules.book: Vettius Valens《Anthologies》Book I + Book II——本命总论卷（第4层释义基石+第3层算法）
rules.original_text: Travel, from Abraham: the Lot of Foreign Lands is found by determining the distance from Saturn to Mars, then counting that same distance from the Ascendant. When Mars beholds the setting luminaries or the Lot of Fortune (if that Lot just precedes MC), or the moon or most of the stars at IC, it causes nativities to travel. If the ruler of Fortune is in the Lot or Place of Foreign Lands or in opposition to it, and if Mars is in conjunction with the Lot or beholds that Place, this too causes travel.
rules.translation: 旅行判据（Abraham）：异地点=土→火距自上升。火照沉落光体/福点（福点近MC前）/月在IC之众星=出行；福主在异地点/冲之+火合点或照其位=亦行。
rules.notes: 水火（金水）不行远旅只速返；旅行点与福点同IC=多旅

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 四大体系（事件盘/关系盘同法）
rules.original_text: There are four main predictive methods: Solar returns and Lunar returns, progressions, horary, and transits.
rules.translation: 预测四大法：日返/月返、推运、卜卦、行运。
rules.notes: 来源：astrology.com.tr《Predictive Methods》2016

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 日返盘=一年之新本命盘
rules.original_text: For the SR, a chart is cast with the precise day and time for any given year, and for the place where the native is at the moment of his birthday. The Sun's position in the return chart is exactly the same as in the natal chart. The SR chart is then interpreted as a new natal chart, except that it is valid for one year only.
rules.translation: 日返盘（Solar Return）：太阳回归本命位置的精确时刻/地点起盘，太阳在盘上=本命位置；按新本命盘解读但只有效一年——定年内大主题。
rules.notes: 须与本命盘对比汇聚因子；因盘性所致年内事件不可精确应期

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The Lunar return is also called Lunar revolution.
rules.translation: 月返（Lunar Return）：月回归本命位置时刻起盘，同理管一月。
rules.notes: 来源同上

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The progressions or symbolic directions: the Sun's motion of one degree on the Zodiac equates to one year of life.
rules.translation: 推运·象征（symbolic directions）：黄道 1°=1 年——按此推进各行星与本命相位解读。
rules.notes: 六种推运之一

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 全盘同推太阳日行度×岁数
rules.original_text: The progressions or solar Arcs directions: for one year of life, the Sun's motion is not exactly of one degree. It is the actual motion at the moment of birth that is taken as the reference. The whole natal chart is progressed by X times the daily motion of the Sun, which equates to X years of age.
rules.translation: 太阳弧（Solar Arc）：全盘统一推进出生时太阳日行度×年龄（非整 1°）。
rules.notes: Naibod key≈0°59′08″/年（见 SP-014）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The secondary progressions or directions: one day in the ephemeris = one year of life. The chart calculated X days after birth = X years of age.
rules.translation: 次限（Secondary）：星历 1 日=1 年——出生后 X 日之盘=X 岁之盘。
rules.notes: 见 SP 系列条目

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The secondary converse progressions or directions: the chart calculated for X days before birth equates to X years of age.
rules.translation: 逆向次限（Converse）：出生前 X 日之盘=X 岁之盘（反向推）。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The Tertiary Progressions or Directions: one lunar month = one year. The chart calculated for X months after birth equates to X years of age.
rules.translation: 三限（Tertiary）：1 太阴月=1 年——出生后 X 月=X 岁。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The primary directions: one equatorial degree on the Zodiac equates to one year of life. This method is more complex to explain and depends on the house system chosen (usually Campanus, Placidus, and Regiomontanus).
rules.translation: 主限（Primary）：赤经 1°=1 年；依分宫制（常用 Campanus/Placidus/Regiomontanus）——类宫位行运。
rules.notes: 生时精确度要求极高，现少用（见 SP-017）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: A transit is defined as a planet passing through the Zodiac over a sensitive point of the natal chart (whether an angle or a planet). The transiting planet can form aspects with these sensitive natal points.
rules.translation: 行运定义：行星过黄道触本命敏感点（角/行星）成相位。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 本命快行星被触发=效应显著
rules.original_text: Transits are more significant and personal when they activate a natal fast-moving planet than when they activate a natal outer planet. In the case of a natal fast-moving planet, the person is very likely to strongly feel its effects.
rules.translation: 行运触发本命内行星>外行星——触发本命快行星时感受最强烈。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 天海冥=重大事件触发器
rules.original_text: Major disruptions and life-turning events are often triggered by the transits of Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto although Saturn and Jupiter, in a lesser extent, also have powerful impacts.
rules.translation: 重大转折事件多由行运天王/海王/冥王触发；土木次之但亦强。
rules.notes: 外行星行运久驻一点，影响深渗本命关键点

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: When outer planets turn into the retrograde mode, the effects are proportional to the duration of their transit.
rules.translation: 外行星逆行时效应与其行运驻留时长成正比（驻留越长影响越久）。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: the transit technique considers the aspects formed between planets in transit and the important points of the natal chart, in this latter case, generally with a narrower orb of one degree.
rules.translation: 行运-本命相位 orb：通常收窄至 1°。
rules.notes: 可编码阈值

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 内行星行运=日期触发器
rules.original_text: Forecasts are usually fine-tuned with the transits of fast-moving planets (Mercury through Mars) in order to identify the dates when events are triggered.
rules.translation: 内行星（水星-火星）行运定具体触发日期。
rules.notes: 月可激活数小时次要角色

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The degree of importance of events and inner experiences depends on newly formed aspects which repeat aspects existing in the natal chart. Otherwise, newly formed aspects have less strong effects.
rules.translation: 行运效应分级：行运-本命新相位若重复本命已有相位则效应强；否则较弱。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: the astrologer often forgets that it is only the natal chart that contains all the potentialities, and that nothing can occur if it is not promised in the natal chart. Diagnosis errors often come from such oversights.
rules.translation: 原则：本命盘含一切潜能——本命未许之事不会发生；诊断错误多源于此遗忘。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Secondary progressions... are a forecasting technique based on a symbolic analogy between astronomical time and lived time. The principle is that one day after birth symbolically corresponds to one year of life.
rules.translation: 次限原理：天文时间↔人生时间象征对应——出生后 1 日=1 年。推运盘为象征构造（非实天象），反映内在发展。
rules.notes: 来源：Astrotheme《Secondary Progressions》

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 内在成熟/行运=外部影响
rules.original_text: Unlike transits, which describe external influences related to the real motion of the planets, secondary progressions are often interpreted as reflecting a gradual maturation of the personality and the potentials contained in the natal chart.
rules.translation: 次限 vs 行运：行运=真实行星运动之外部影响；次限=人格渐熟与本命潜能之内在发展。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The positions of the faster planets change noticeably in the progressed chart, especially the Moon, which moves through the zodiac in just over twenty-seven days, corresponding to a cycle of about twenty-seven years in progression.
rules.translation: 月次限：27.3 日走完黄道=次限约 27 年周期——次限中最敏感的快速行星。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The Sun advances by about one degree per year, making it possible to follow changes of sign over the course of life.
rules.translation: 太阳次限约 1°/年——一生可见换座（换座=人生阶段重要转折）。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: By contrast, the slower planets change very little in the progressed chart, as their motion over a few dozen days is minimal. Their role therefore remains close to what it is in the natal chart.
rules.translation: 外行星次限几乎不动——角色近同本命。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The angles of the chart, especially the Ascendant and Midheaven, can also be calculated in progression. However, their determination depends on the house system used and may introduce significant technical variations.
rules.translation: 次限四角（升/MC 尤要）可算，但依分宫制差异显著。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Secondary progressions, in their current form, developed much later, beginning in the 19th century and becoming more widely used during the 20th century. They were popularized in modern Anglo-Saxon astrology largely through the work of Alan Leo... Dane Rudhyar reinforced this orientation.
rules.translation: 次限史：19 世纪成形、20 世纪普及；Alan Leo 推广（心理学转向）、Rudhyar 强化进化/内在维度。
rules.notes: 主限因计算复杂与解读不确定而式微

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Aspects between the progressed chart and the natal chart constitute the primary level of interpretation. Next come changes of sign... Internal configurations of the progressed chart are of secondary importance.
rules.translation: 次限解读层级：①推运-本命互相位（第一优先）②换座（日月升等）③推运内部相位（次级）。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Changes of sign of the Sun, the Moon, or the progressed Ascendant are considered particularly significant, as they mark important phases in personal development.
rules.translation: 日月或推运上升换座=个人发展重要阶段标记（最显著）。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The relationships formed between planets in the progressed chart provide an additional level of analysis, but they must be interpreted with caution, as they can be numerous and are not always clearly meaningful.
rules.translation: 推运内部相位：数量多且意义不显——从属地位，勿喧宾夺主。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: For interaspects between the progressed chart and the natal chart, tight orbs are essential. At Astrotheme, the choice of 230' for major aspects and 130' for minor ones appears reasonable.
rules.translation: 次限-本命互相位 orb（Astrotheme 标准）：主相位 2°30′、次相位 1°30′。
rules.notes: 可编码阈值（截断泛滥组合）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: For internal configurations within the progressed chart itself... it seems reasonable to stay around 1 for major aspects, possibly a little more for a conjunction involving the Sun or the Moon, and to significantly reduce or exclude minor factors.
rules.translation: 推运内部 orb：主相位约 1°（日月合可略放宽）；次相位大幅收窄或排除。
rules.notes: 无统一标准——行业实践值，标 medium 亦可；此按 Astrotheme 惯例

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 独立论 vs 本命基准论（学派开关）
rules.original_text: One widely used approach consists of interpreting progressed aspects according to their own nature, independently of the natal chart... A second, more nuanced approach considers the natal chart as the primary reference. This perspective is particularly developed in humanistic astrology, notably by Dane Rudhyar and Stephen Arroyo.
rules.translation: 矛盾相位两解：①按推运相位自身性质独立解读（四分/冲=张力困难）；②人文派（Rudhyar/Arroyo）本命为基准——推运为潜能激活器：本命和谐而推运不谐=动态激活非真困难；本命紧张而推运和谐=相对缓和。
rules.notes: 严谨立场：永不可弃本命框架，推运=激活/调制因子

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Solar arc directions consist of moving the entire natal chart by an angle equivalent to the average progression of the Sun, approximately 059'08'' per year according to the key of Naibod.
rules.translation: 太阳弧全盘统一推进量=Naibod key 0°59′08″/年（平均太阳日行度）。
rules.notes: 简单一致易结构化；较次限更示意（不取各行星独自行速）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Symbolic directions are also based on a conventional equivalence between time and celestial positions, but without recalculating the actual motion of the planets. They follow an even more abstract logic... more marginal and far less widely accepted.
rules.translation: 象征推运：纯约定对应（不重算实际行度）——更抽象、边缘化、接受度低。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: The solar return... aims to describe the general climate of a year between two birthdays... It provides indications of atmosphere, context, or yearly themes, but does not by itself offer a precise timeline.
rules.translation: 日返定位：生日间一年之总气候/背景/年度主题——本身不提供年内精确时间线。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Primary directions... are based... on the diurnal rotation of the celestial sphere... Historically prestigious, they long held an important place in scholarly astrology. However, their calculation is complex, their use requires a very accurate birth time, and they are now much less commonly used.
rules.translation: 主限：基于天球周日转动（赤道运动）；学术占星史上显赫，然计算复杂、需极准生时、现少用。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Astrotheme does not use this technique in its paid reports. The site favors an approach based on planetary transits, which provide better hierarchy and essential timing accuracy.
rules.translation: 行业立场：Astrotheme 付费报告不用次限——主推行运（层级更清、应期更准）；次限宜作行运+日返之补充。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Annual profections are among the oldest and most elegant timing techniques in Western astrology — originating in Hellenistic astrology and preserved through medieval tradition.
rules.translation: 小限（Annual Profections）：古希腊占星起源、中世纪传承的最古老应期术之一——近年复兴。
rules.notes: 来源：Astrelle《Annual Profections》2026

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: beginning at age zero (birth) in the 1st house, you advance one house each year on your birthday... Every twelve years, the cycle resets.
rules.translation: 小限算法：出生 0 岁起于 1 宫，每过一个生日进一宫；12 年循环归位。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Take your age at your last birthday... Divide by 12 and take the remainder. Add 1 (because the 1st house corresponds to remainder 0). That number is your profected house.
rules.translation: 小限公式：实足年龄÷12 取余数 +1 = 小限宫。
rules.notes: 映射表 A 列全表

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: look at the sign on the cusp of that house in your natal chart. The planet that rules that sign is your Lord of the Year (also called the Timelord).
rules.translation: 年主星（Lord of the Year/时主）：小限宫宫头星座之宫主星。
rules.notes: 例：7宫头天蝎=火星（传统）或冥王（现代）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 庙旺宫强=吉年；落陷失势=难年
rules.original_text: Is the Lord of the Year well-placed natally (in its own sign, exaltation, strong by house)? A well-placed Lord of the Year tends to deliver better results. A weakly placed Lord (in detriment, fall, or poorly aspected) suggests a more challenging year.
rules.translation: 时主断年运：时主本命入庙/旺/宫强=年顺；落陷/失势/弱相位=该领域年艰。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 吉星行运时主=吉事、凶星=挑战
rules.original_text: In Hellenistic technique, you watch for transits to and from your natal Lord of the Year throughout the profected year. When Jupiter transits your natal Lord of the Year, the themes of that year's house are positively activated. When Saturn transits it, challenges and responsibilities arrive.
rules.translation: 触发机制：行运至本命时主=该年宫域事件触发——木星行运时主=正向激活；土星行运时主=挑战责任。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 行运入小限宫=激活该宫主题
rules.original_text: Planets transiting through your profected house also carry extra weight during that year — they directly activate the house whose themes are already highlighted.
rules.translation: 行运过小限宫本身亦加重效应——直接激活当年已高亮之宫域。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 各宫年度主领域（全表见映射B）
rules.original_text: 1st house year: Identity, self, body... 7th house year: Partnerships — romantic, professional, and legal... 10th house year: Career, reputation, and authority...
rules.translation: 12 宫年度主题：1身份自我/2钱财价值/3沟通手足学习/4家宅家族/5创造子女恋情/6工作健康/7伴侣合作诉讼/8转化共享资源/9旅行高教哲学/10事业名声/11社群友谊目标/12隐秘独处灵性终局。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 行运触发+日返印证+月小限细分
rules.original_text: Annual profections identify which house and which planet are 'on' for the year. Transits from major planets to the Lord of the Year, or through the profected house, provide the specific timing... Monthly profections: advancing one house per month starting from the profected house at the birthday.
rules.translation: 组合用法：小限定'开'之宫与星→大行星行运定具体应期；日返叠加印证；月小限（从小限宫起每月进一宫）细分月内子题。
rules.notes: 日返：7宫年之日返应重读关系主题（SR7宫星或SR金星角宫印证）

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 回顾验证（引擎可做回测）
rules.original_text: Historical validation: Identify your profected house and Lord of the Year for years when major life events occurred. Most people find the correspondence striking — major career changes in 10th house years, relationship events in 7th house years...
rules.translation: 历史验证法：回查大事件年份之小限宫/时主——10宫年事业变动、7宫年关系事件、4宫年搬家、6宫年健康事件等对应显著。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.result: 整宫制（非 Placidus 等象限制）
rules.original_text: Traditionally, Whole Sign houses are used with profections — each house corresponds to exactly one sign, making the house ruler straightforward to identify.
rules.translation: 前提：小限用整宫制（Whole Sign）——一宫=一星座，宫主星直取；象限制有截夺星座会使年主计算复杂。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: When the Lord of the Year is also the chart ruler (the planet ruling your rising sign), that planet is doubly highlighted... tends to be a year of particular personal importance and often marked intensity or visibility.
rules.translation: 时主=盘主星：双重高亮——年度尤为个人重要、强度/可见度显著。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Is a 12th house year always bad? Not necessarily, though it tends to be quieter externally... The difficulty comes when the 12th house year coincides with significant challenges from Saturn or Pluto transits.
rules.translation: 12宫年非必凶：外静内丰（灵性/创作可高产）；唯叠加土星/冥王行运挑战时方艰。

rules.book: 推运体系（预测方法）规则库——三篇公共领域教学文章合编
rules.original_text: Yes — that's one of the most practical uses. Calculate which house years are coming up in the next 5-10 years... This doesn't predict specific events, but it does identify which life domains will be in focus.
rules.translation: 前瞻用法：预推未来 5-10 年小限宫——预告聚焦领域非具体事件（可作投资/规划参考）。
